article_content: CANBERRA, Australia — The eruption of Mount Ulawun, Papua New Guinea’s tallest and most active volcano, subsided on Tuesday, but dense ash continued to billow into the sky, covering roofs and nearby palm trees. Mount Ulawun, located on the northeastern island of New Britain, erupted Monday afternoon, sending ash up to 15 kilometers (50,000 feet) high. The Papua New Guinea Geohazards Management Division downgraded the volcano’s alert level to Stage 3, indicating a moderate-to-strong eruption. Previously, it had reached Stage 4, signaling a very strong eruption. Though activity lessened, the volcano—rising 2,334 meters (7,657 feet) above sea level—remained active and the eruption could continue indefinitely, according to the division. Australia’s Volcanic Ash Advisory Center in Darwin reported ash plumes as high as 15,000 meters (50,000 feet) on Monday. On Tuesday, Papua New Guinea’s division observed the ash plume rising at least 5,000 meters (16,000 feet) before dissipating into cloud cover. Ash can travel long distances and threaten aviation. A thick plume extended tens of kilometers northwest of the volcano on Tuesday. Papua New Guinea’s Civil Aviation Safety Authority did not immediately comment about potential effects on air travel. The FlightAware website reported normal activity at the nearest major airports in Port Moresby and Honiara on Tuesday. The closest large town, Bialla, sits among palm oil plantations on Ulawun’s slopes, 47 kilometers (29 miles) to the southwest. Hargy Oil Palm Ltd., based in Bialla, did not respond to requests for comment. The division said heavy deposits of black ash caused leaves to droop in nearby plantations and accumulated on rooftops. According to the World Bank, more than 13,000 people live in Bialla. The eruption prompted Japan to assess tsunami risk on Monday, but the threat was later declared nil. Papua New Guinea sits on the ‘Ring of Fire,’ an area of frequent seismic and volcanic activity. Ulawun has erupted repeatedly since the 1700s; its last major eruption in 2019 led to the evacuation of more than 5,000 people. The division reports no known casualties from Ulawun’s historical eruptions, although significant population displacement, infrastructure damage, and service disruptions are common.

Planina Ulawun, smještena na sjeveroistočnom otoku New Britain, eruptirala je u ponedjeljak poslijepodne, izbacivši pepeo do visine od 15 kilometara (50.000 stopa). Divizija za upravljanje geohazardima Papue Nove Gvineje snizila je razinu uzbune vulkana na stupanj 3, što znači umjerenu do jaku erupciju. Prije toga bila je na stupnju 4, što označava vrlo jaku erupciju. Iako je aktivnost oslabjela, vulkan — visok 2.334 metra (7.657 stopa) nadmorske visine — i dalje je aktivan i erupcija bi mogla potrajati neodređeno vrijeme, priopćila je divizija. Australski Centar za savjetovanje o vulkanskom pepelu iz Darwina izvijestio je o oblačnim stupovima pepela visine do 15.000 metara (50.000 stopa) u ponedjeljak. U utorak je divizija Papue Nove Gvineje zabilježila stupac pepela visok najmanje 5.000 metara (16.000 stopa), prije nego što je nestao u oblacima. Pepeo može putovati na velike udaljenosti i predstavljati prijetnju zračnom prometu. Gusti oblak protezao se desecima kilometara sjeverozapadno od vulkana u utorak. Civilna zrakoplovna uprava Papue Nove Gvineje nije odmah komentirala moguće posljedice za zračni promet. Web stranica FlightAware prikazivala je normalnu aktivnost na najbližim većim aerodromima u Port Moresbyju i Honiari u utorak. Najbliži veći grad, Bialla, nalazi se među plantažama palminog ulja na obroncima Ulawuna, 47 kilometara (29 milja) jugozapadno. Hargy Oil Palm Ltd., kompanija iz Bialle, nije odgovorila na zahtjeve za komentar. Divizija je izvijestila da su velike naslage crnog pepela uzrokovale opuštanje lišća na obližnjim plantažama i nakupljanje pepela na krovovima. Prema podacima Svjetske banke, u Bialli živi više od 13.000 ljudi. Erupcija je potaknula Japan da u ponedjeljak procijeni rizik od tsunamija, ali prijetnja je kasnije proglašena ništavnom. Papua Nova Gvineja nalazi se na ‘Vatrenom prstenu’, području čestih potresa i vulkanskih aktivnosti. Ulawun je eruptirao više puta od 1700-ih; posljednja velika erupcija bila je 2019. godine, kada je evakuirano više od 5.000 ljudi. Divizija navodi da nema poznatih žrtava u povijesti erupcija Ulawuna, iako su pomicanje stanovništva, oštećenje infrastrukture i poremećaji u uslugama česti.

article_content: Medical professionals, including doctors and specialists, are stationed at the Silkyara tunnel where 41 workers remain trapped, working tirelessly as the rescue effort continues. As the situation becomes more challenging with each passing day, these experts are actively guiding the families on how to communicate effectively and positively with their loved ones inside the tunnel—encouraging uplifting conversations and steering away from emotionally heavy topics to preserve the workers’ morale. Dr. RCS Panwar, Chief Medical Officer of Uttarkashi, notes that the ongoing support doesn't just come from medical staff, but also from NDRF, SDRF, and other state officials who are frequently providing motivation and hope to the trapped workers. Beyond supporting the workers underground, medical teams have begun offering counseling to the families waiting outside, who are emotionally strained by the prolonged uncertainty. Furthermore, the workers inside the tunnel receive advice on mental health and hygiene to help them maintain their well-being during this challenging time.

article_content: On May 27, 2013, Romania set a world record by unveiling the largest national flag ever produced. Measuring 1,145 feet in length and 744 feet in width, the enormous tricolor was displayed at an airfield in Clinceni, near Bucharest. Weighing five tonnes and sewn with 44 miles of thread, the flag took weeks to complete. About 200 volunteers worked together to roll out the giant flag, which covered an area similar to three football fields. Sandbags were used to hold the flag down and allow for accurate measurement on the windy day. High-ranking officials, including Prime Minister Victor Ponta, attended the event alongside other ministers. A military brass band played during the ceremony, contributing to the festive and patriotic atmosphere. Jack Brockbank, representing Guinness World Records, measured the flag and confirmed its status as the world's largest national flag—surpassing the previous record held by Lebanon. Adrian Dragomir, manager of Flags Factory, highlighted the extensive preparations involved. The event generated a strong sense of national pride, with volunteers and observers joining together to celebrate Romania's new world record.

Oko 200 volontera razmotavalo je ovu golemunu zastavu, koja prekriva površinu kao tri nogometna igrališta. Vreće s pijeskom pritisnule su zastavu kako bi precizno izmjerili tijekom vjetrovitog dana. Visoki dužnosnici, uključujući premijera Victora Pontu i ostale ministre, nazočili su događaju. Vojni limeni orkestar stvorio je svečanu i domoljubnu atmosferu. Jack Brockbank iz Guinnessove knjige rekorda izmjerio je zastavu te potvrdio njen status najveće nacionalne zastave na svijetu, čime je premašen dotadašnji rekord Libanona. Adrian Dragomir iz Flags Factoryja napomenuo je koliko su pripreme bile zahtjevne. Događaj je probudio snažan osjećaj nacionalnog ponosa, a volonteri i sudionici zajedno su slavili novi svjetski rekord Rumunjske.

article_content: As millions tune in to the Super Bowl on Sunday night, certain football players will be singled out as heroes for their courage and dedication. The word 'hero' will be used generously, perhaps without much thought. In that context, it’s worth taking a moment to recall an example of true valor that occurred exactly 70 years ago. On February 3, 1943, the US Army transport ship Dorchester was carrying over 900 American soldiers across the icy North Atlantic toward Greenland during World War II. The men, many of them young and far from home for the first time, endured difficult conditions—cramped, poorly ventilated quarters, and constant seasickness. In the darkness of night, a German submarine torpedoed the ship, causing chaos as the Dorchester quickly began to sink. Awakened by the attack, soldiers and sailors scrambled in the dark for life jackets and a way to safety. Onboard were four military chaplains from different faiths: Father John Washington (Catholic), Rev. Clark Poling (Reformed Church in America), Rabbi Alexander Goode (Jewish), and Rev. George Fox (Methodist). According to multiple survivor accounts, the chaplains tried to calm those on board and guide them to evacuate, offering comfort and hope. When life jackets ran out, the four chaplains removed their own and gave them to men without. More than 600 people died in the freezing sea that night, but about 230 were rescued. Survivors reported seeing the four chaplains, arms linked, praying together on the deck as the ship went down. One survivor, Navy officer John J. Mahoney, recalled that Rabbi Goode offered him gloves rather than let him risk going below deck for his own. Later, Mahoney realized Goode had given up his own only pair of gloves. Another survivor, John Ladd, described the chaplains' actions as 'the finest thing I have seen or hope to see this side of heaven.' Their sacrifice received recognition soon after the war—a 1948 postage stamp depicted their likenesses, and several memorials still exist. However, national memory has faded. Congress once designated February 3 as Four Chaplains Day, but this is rarely commemorated now. With attention focused on the Super Bowl, perhaps we can pause briefly to remember what true sacrifice means and honor the four 'immortal chaplains.' The views expressed here are solely those of Bob Greene.
translated_content: Dok milijuni gledaju Super Bowl ove nedjelje navečer, neki nogometaši bit će proglašeni herojima zbog hrabrosti i odanosti. Riječ 'heroj' često će se koristiti, možda i olako. U tom duhu, vrijedi se na trenutak prisjetiti prave hrabrosti pokazane upravo prije 70 godina. Dana 3. veljače 1943., američki vojni transportni brod Dorchester prevozio je više od 900 američkih vojnika kroz ledeni sjeverni Atlantik prema Grenlandu tijekom Drugog svjetskog rata. Mnogi su bili mladi i prvi put daleko od kuće, suočeni s teškim uvjetima – skučenim i slabo prozračenim prostorima te stalnom morskom bolešću. Usred noći, njemačka podmornica pogodila je brod torpedom, izazivši kaos dok je Dorchester brzo tonuo. Probuđeni napadom, vojnici i mornari u panici su tražili pojaseve za spašavanje i izlaz u sigurnost. Na brodu su bila četiri vojna kapelana različitih vjera: otac John Washington (katolik), velečasni Clark Poling (Reformirana crkva u Americi), rabin Alexander Goode (Židov) i velečasni George Fox (metodist). Po riječima preživjelih, kapelani su smirivali okupljene, usmjeravali ih prema evakuaciji te pružali utjehu i nadu. Kada je ponestalo pojaseva za spašavanje, četvorica kapelana skinuli su svoje i dali ih onima bez njih. U ledenom moru te je noći poginulo više od 600 ljudi, a oko 230 ih je spašeno. Preživjeli su svjedočili da su četvorica kapelana stajali skupa, povezani rukama, i molili na palubi dok je brod tonuo. Jedan od preživjelih, mornarički časnik John J. Mahoney, ispričao je kako mu je rabin Goode ponudio svoje rukavice radije nego da riskira odlazak po vlastite. Mahoney je tek kasnije shvatio da mu je Goode dao svoj jedini par. Drugi preživjeli, John Ladd, opisao je njihovu žrtvu kao 'najveće djelo kojem sam svjedočio ili kojem se nadam ovdje na zemlji'. Njihovu žrtvu ubrzo nakon rata priznavala je javnost – poštanska marka iz 1948. prikazivala je njihov lik, a i danas su očuvani pojedini memorijali. Ipak, ta je priča izblijedjela iz nacionalnog sjećanja. Kongres je 3. veljače proglasio Danom Četvorice Kapelana, ali danas se rijetko spominje. Dok će pažnja biti na Super Bowlu, možda bismo trebali na trenutak zastati, prisjetiti se što znači istinska žrtva i odati počast 'besmrtnim kapelanima.' Izneseni stavovi isključivo su mišljenje Boba Greenea.

article_content: Duncan Bannatyne, the British entrepreneur and star of Dragon’s Den, received his first tattoo at age 65 while on a family holiday in Sydney, Australia. He had the initials of his six children—Abigail, Hollie, Jennifer, Eve, Emily, and Tom—tattooed on his left arm, spelling 'AHJEET' in bold black letters. Bannatyne, who uses 'AHJEET' as a pet name for his children and previously named a company Ahjeet Limited, shared his new tattoo on Twitter, where he has around 700,000 followers. While Bannatyne’s tattoo was meant as a heartfelt gesture, some social media users responded with jokes. One Twitter user asked if 'AHJEET' was meant to say 'Eejit', a slang term for 'idiot'. Another commented that the tattoo made it look like his arm was franked and ready to be mailed. Bannatyne tweeted that the initials represent his children in order of age. He also commented on how much he was enjoying Australia, even suggesting he might stay there. Earlier in the month, Bannatyne tweeted about becoming interested in the UK Independence Party (UKIP), which led some followers to question whether he was serious. According to the Sunday Times Rich List, Bannatyne has a fortune estimated at £175 million, ranking him 534th among the wealthiest people in Britain. The article also notes that broadcaster David Dimbleby had his first tattoo—a small scorpion—at age 75, referencing singer Cheryl Cole’s more prominent tattoos but saying he was not tempted to go further. Dimbleby remarked on wanting a tattoo for a long time and decided to get one when he was older. Duncan Bannatyne has been pictured alongside his fellow Dragon’s Den investors: Hilary Devey, Theo Paphitis, Deborah Meaden, and Peter Jones.

article_content: YouTube has introduced a set of updates to promote responsible use of artificial intelligence on its platform, particularly as generative AI makes content creation faster and more accessible. India continues to be YouTube’s largest market, with an estimated 462 million users as of October. With AI-generated content growing, YouTube recognizes both the opportunities this technology brings and the potential risks. The platform is updating its policies to address these challenges. In a recent blog post, YouTube stated that all uploaded material must follow its Community Guidelines, regardless of the production method, and that its approach will adapt as AI technology advances. Soon, YouTube will require creators to clearly indicate when their uploads include realistic AI-generated or altered content. Examples include videos simulating events that never occurred, or showing individuals saying or doing things they did not in reality. New labeling tools will help viewers recognize synthetic content, with extra emphasis on sensitive topics. If creators repeatedly avoid disclosing this, they may face content removal, suspension from monetization, or other penalties. Labeled or not, synthetic content that violates YouTube's rules—such as deepfakes designed to mislead, shock, or harm—can be removed. Viewers will see labels in video descriptions, and for higher-risk topics, labels may also be shown directly on the video. Additionally, YouTube will simplify the process for requesting removal of AI-generated or altered videos that convincingly impersonate someone's face or voice. Each request will be evaluated considering whether the individual is publicly known and the context, such as satire or parody. YouTube music partners can also request the removal of AI-generated tracks that mimic an artist’s voice, with removal decisions factoring in whether the content is newsworthy, analytical, or used for critique. The platform’s strategy is expected to evolve further as YouTube gains more experience with generative AI’s impact.
translated_content: YouTube je predstavio niz ažuriranja kako bi potaknuo odgovornu upotrebu umjetne inteligencije na svojoj platformi, posebno dok generativni AI omogućuje bržu i pristupačniju izradu sadržaja. Indija i dalje ostaje najveće tržište YouTubea s procijenjenih 462 milijuna korisnika u listopadu. S obzirom na rast AI-generiranog sadržaja, YouTube prepoznaje prilike i potencijalne rizike koje ova tehnologija donosi. Platforma ažurira svoja pravila kako bi odgovorila na ove izazove. U nedavnom blogu YouTube je naveo da sav preneseni materijal mora slijediti njihove Smjernice zajednice, bez obzira na način izrade, te da će se njihov pristup prilagođavati razvoju AI tehnologije. Uskoro će YouTube zahtijevati od kreatora da jasno naznače kada njihovi sadržaji uključuju realistično AI-generirani ili izmijenjeni materijal. Primjeri su videozapisi koji simuliraju događaje koji se nisu dogodili ili prikazuju osobe kako govore ili rade nešto što nisu učinili. Novi alati za označavanje pomoći će gledateljima da prepoznaju sintetički sadržaj, s naglaskom na osjetljive teme. Ako kreatori opetovano izbjegavaju ove objave, mogu im biti uklonjen sadržaj, obustavljena monetizacija ili izrečene druge sankcije. Sintetički sadržaj koji krši YouTubeova pravila – kao što su deepfake materijali stvoreni radi obmane, šokiranja ili nanošenja štete – može biti uklonjen, bez obzira na to je li označen. Gledatelji će vidjeti oznake u opisu videa, a za rizičnije teme oznake se mogu prikazati direktno na videu. Također, YouTube će olakšati postupak za traženje uklanjanja AI-generiranih ili izmijenjenih videa koji uvjerljivo imitiraju nečije lice ili glas. Svaki zahtjev će se procjenjivati s obzirom je li osoba javno poznata i kontekst, kao što su satira ili parodija. YouTubeovi glazbeni partneri također mogu zatražiti uklanjanje AI-generirane glazbe koja imitira pjevačev glas, a odluke o uklanjanju donosit će se uzimajući u obzir radi li se o vijestima, analizi ili kritici. Očekuje se da će se strategija platforme dalje razvijati kako YouTube stječe više iskustva s utjecajem generativnog AI-ja.

article_content: LOS ANGELES, California (CNN) — On Thursday, the California Public Utilities Commission implemented a ban on texting while on the job, a decision prompted by revelations that a Metrolink train engineer involved in last week's deadly collision near Los Angeles had sent text messages from his cell phone. The precise actions of 46-year-old Robert Sanchez during the Friday crash remain unclear, but the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) is investigating claims that he was texting when his commuter train collided with a Union Pacific freight train in Chatsworth. The collision resulted in 25 fatalities, including Sanchez, and left at least 130 people injured. Investigators, after subpoenaing Sanchez’s phone records, confirmed that he had sent and received text messages on the day of the accident, including some while on duty, according to an NTSB statement on Wednesday. Authorities are working to determine the exact timing of the messages. The commission’s emergency order, passed unanimously on Thursday, is temporary until a permanent decision is made. Commission President Michael Peevey advocated for the ban, noting that cell phone use by engineers 'may have been a factor' in other train incidents earlier this year in San Francisco and Sacramento, though he provided no additional details. While Metrolink already prohibits engineers from using cell phones while on duty, Peevey highlighted the absence of any federal or California regulations explicitly forbidding such use during train operation. According to Kitty Higgins, an NTSB member involved in the investigation, the train’s brakes were not applied before the collision, and the stop signals at the scene were functioning properly. Metrolink confirmed that its train, carrying approximately 220 passengers, failed to stop at a red signal. Twenty-four bodies were discovered at the crash scene; a 25th victim, a man in his 50s, died later in a hospital. More than 130 people sustained injuries. The NTSB also contacted two teenagers who told a local television station they had been exchanging text messages with Sanchez just before the crash. Investigators interviewed the Metrolink train conductor, who had worked with Sanchez since April and reported no concerns about Sanchez’s conduct or operation of the train. The conductor also noted that Sanchez took a two-hour nap during his midday break on the day of the crash. Sanchez was employed as a subcontractor for another company.

Točne radnje 46-godišnjeg Roberta Sancheza u vrijeme nesreće ostaju nepoznate, ali Nacionalni odbor za sigurnost prometa (NTSB) istražuje tvrdnje da je slao poruke kada je njegov prigradski vlak udario u teretni vlak Union Pacifica u Chatsworthu. U sudaru je poginulo 25 osoba, uključujući Sancheza, a najmanje 130 ih je ozlijeđeno. Istražitelji su, nakon što su pribavili Sanchezove telefonske zapise, potvrdili da je slao i primao poruke na dan nesreće, uključujući i dok je bio na dužnosti, navodi se u priopćenju NTSB-a u srijedu. Vlasti pokušavaju utvrditi točno vrijeme slanja poruka. Naredba komisije o hitnoj zabrani, koja je jednoglasno donesena u četvrtak, privremena je dok se ne donese trajna odluka. Predsjednik komisije Michael Peevey zalagao se za zabranu, ističući da je korištenje mobitela kod inženjera 'moglo biti faktor' i u nekim drugim nesrećama ove godine u San Franciscu i Sacramentu, iako nije naveo detalje. Iako Metrolink već zabranjuje korištenje mobitela inženjerima tijekom službe, Peevey je naglasio da ne postoji nijedna savezna niti kalifornijska regulativa koja izričito zabranjuje takvo korištenje dok vlakovi prometuju. Prema riječima Kitty Higgins, članice NTSB-a uključene u istragu, kočnice vlaka nisu bile aktivirane prije sudara, a signali zaustavljanja na terenu funkcionirali su ispravno. Metrolink je potvrdio da njegov vlak, s otprilike 220 putnika, nije stao na crveno svjetlo. Dvadeset četiri tijela pronađena su na mjestu nesreće; 25. žrtva, muškarac u 50-ima, preminuo je kasnije u bolnici. Više od 130 ljudi je ozlijeđeno. NTSB je kontaktirao i dvoje tinejdžera koji su lokalnoj televiziji ispričali da su razmjenjivali SMS-poruke sa Sanchezom netom prije nesreće. Istražitelji su razgovarali s kondukterom Metrolinka, koji je s Sanchezom radio od travnja i nije imao primjedbi na njegovo ponašanje ili upravljanje vlakom. Kondukter je također rekao da je Sanchez tijekom pauze za ručak na dan nesreće odspavao dva sata. Sanchez je bio zaposlen kao podizvođač za drugu tvrtku.

article_content: A sheep endured a painful death after becoming trapped by the hydraulic roof of a cattle transport truck in Pembrokeshire, West Wales. The incident was witnessed by drivers on a country road, who could only watch in distress as the animal's head was caught and crushed by the roof, which is normally intended to keep livestock from escaping. Although the farmer transporting the sheep was eventually stopped, rescue came too late and the animal died from strangulation. The distressing event was captured in a photo by a member of VANAH, an animal welfare charity, which later posted it online and sparked widespread outrage. VANAH's spokesperson criticized the apparent disregard for regulations governing live animal transportation, noting that the mishap resulted in the sheep suffering greatly before death. Local authorities, alongside national departments responsible for agricultural affairs, have launched an investigation into the matter and are reviewing the design of the vehicle involved. This case has reignited calls from animal welfare organizations to improve standards and conditions for livestock transportation.

Vozači na seoskoj cesti svjedočili su događaju, ali su mogli samo bespomoćno gledati dok je glava životinje bila zarobljena i zgnječena krovom, koji inače služi za sprječavanje bijega životinja. Iako su zaustavili farmera koji je prevozio ovce, pomoć je stigla prekasno i životinja je uginula od gušenja. Potresni događaj zabilježio je član udruge VANAH za zaštitu životinja, koji je kasnije fotografiju objavio na internetu i izazvao val ogorčenja među javnosti. Glasnogovornik VANAH-a kritizirao je nepoštivanje propisa o prijevozu živih životinja, naglasivši da je životinja teško patila prije smrti. Lokalne vlasti zajedno s nacionalnim tijelima za poljoprivredu pokrenule su istragu i pregledavaju dizajn predmetnog vozila. Ovaj slučaj ponovno je otvorio pitanje potrebe poboljšanja standarda i uvjeta za prijevoz stoke, na što organizacije za zaštitu životinja već dugo upozoravaju.

article_content: At least 32 people have died and more than 60 have been injured in a multi-vehicle collision on a highway in Egypt’s Beheira governorate, authorities said. The crash took place on Saturday morning in heavy fog when a passenger bus traveling to Cairo collided with a parked vehicle on the highway connecting Cairo and Alexandria. Following the initial crash, other vehicles slammed into the bus, and several caught fire. Social media images showed an overturned truck blocking the fast lane on scorched asphalt, with at least one bus and a minibus burned out, and numerous cars ablaze. Crowds lined the roadside, watching as thick black smoke rose and ambulances arrived to evacuate the injured. According to state-run Al-Ahram newspaper, police sources attributed the collision to an oil leak from one vehicle, leading to the fire that engulfed six vehicles, including the bus. In total, 29 vehicles were involved in the pileup, with at least 18 victims suffering burns. The Egyptian Meteorological Authority had warned of severe fog on highways the previous day. Fatal road accidents are common in Egypt, where official statistics reported 7,000 deaths from road crashes in 2021. Many of these accidents are blamed on reckless driving and poor road conditions, although the government has been investing in new road infrastructure to improve safety.

Nakon početnog sudara, druga su se vozila zabila u autobus, a nekoliko ih je planulo. Fotografije na društvenim mrežama prikazuju prevrnuti kamion koji blokira traku za brzu vožnju na spaljenom asfaltu, najmanje jedan autobus i minibus uništene su u požaru, dok su brojna vozila gorjela. Mnoštvo ljudi stajalo je uz cestu gledajući kako gust crni dim raste i kako hitna pomoć dolazi po ozlijeđene. Prema državnom listu Al-Ahram, policijski izvori navode da je uzrok sudara curenje ulja iz jednog vozila, što je dovelo do požara u kojem je izgorelo šest vozila, uključujući autobus. Ukupno je sudjelovalo 29 vozila, a najmanje 18 žrtava pretrpjelo je opekline. Egipatska meteorološka služba dan ranije upozorila je na gustu maglu na cestama. Smrtne nesreće na cestama česte su u Egiptu, gdje je službena statistika za 2021. godinu zabilježila 7.000 poginulih u prometnim nesrećama. article_content: On the eve of Prime Minister Narendra Modi hosting a virtual G20 leaders' summit, India announced that the meeting will offer an opportunity to advance the Delhi Declaration, foster collaboration on critical challenges, and address gaps in global governance. Speaking at a press conference, India’s G20 Sherpa Amitabh Kant highlighted that since the leaders’ summit in September and the unanimous adoption of the New Delhi Declaration, the world has faced several emerging challenges. He noted that development would be the core agenda, but leaders may discuss a range of issues. 'The virtual summit is a chance to not only review implementation of the declaration but also to exchange views and boost cooperation on key challenges, close governance gaps, reaffirm commitment to SDGs, and work toward a stronger multilateral system that positively impacts lives,' Kant said. Prime Minister Modi will chair the summit, which is set to begin at 5:30 pm Wednesday. In other news, the Income Tax Department has detected nearly ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion by e-commerce sellers operating via social media platforms like Instagram and Facebook over three years. Notices were issued to 45 brands, with more expected. Companies are reassessing GST liabilities before mergers and acquisitions, following over 20,000 notices from GST authorities since 2022. Separately, Gautam Singhania, managing director of Raymond, has been accused by his estranged wife, Nawaz Modi, of assaulting her and one of their daughters two months ago.
translated_content: Dan prije nego što premijer Narendra Modi bude domaćin virtualnog sastanka čelnika G20, Indija je najavila da će sastanak biti prilika za unapređenje Delhi Deklaracije, jačanje suradnje oko ključnih izazova i rješavanje nedostataka u globalnom upravljanju. Govoreći na konferenciji za novinare, indijski G20 šerpa Amitabh Kant naglasio je da se od samita čelnika u rujnu i jednoglasnog usvajanja Nove Delhi Deklaracije u svijetu pojavilo nekoliko novih izazova. Istaknuo je da će razvoj biti glavna tema, ali čelnici mogu raspravljati i o drugim pitanjima. 'Virtualni samit je prilika ne samo za pregled provedbe deklaracije već i za razmjenu mišljenja i jačanje suradnje vezane uz ključne izazove, zatvaranje rupa u upravljanju, potvrdu opredijeljenosti za Ciljeve održivog razvoja (SDG) i za izgradnju snažnijeg multilateralnog sustava koji pozitivno utječe na živote ljudi', rekao je Kant. Premijer Modi predsjedat će samitom, koji počinje u srijedu u 17:30 sati. U drugim vijestima, indijski Porezni ured otkrio je gotovo 10.000 milijardi rupija porezne utaje kod prodavača putem društvenih mreža poput Instagrama i Facebooka u posljednje tri godine. Poslano je obavijesti 45 brendova, a očekuje ih se još. Tvrtke ponovno procjenjuju svoje GST obveze prije spajanja i preuzimanja, nakon više od 20.000 obavijesti izdanih od strane GST vlasti od 2022. article_content: Ahead of a congressional hearing, President Obama stated on Monday that he would hold the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) accountable if allegations of political targeting prove accurate. Obama told reporters, 'If IRS personnel engaged in the practices that have been reported and intentionally targeted conservative groups, that’s outrageous and unacceptable. The IRS must maintain absolute integrity so the public can trust that laws are applied impartially.' Documents soon to be released by the IRS watchdog indicate that the agency targeted tea party groups and other organizations focusing on government spending and federal debt, all seeking tax-exempt status. The IRS also applied extra scrutiny to applicants with statements criticizing national policies or seeking to educate the public about making America a better place to live—criteria that would encompass many conservative political groups applying for 501(c)(4) status. These details are included in an inspector general’s report obtained by CNN, which has sparked widespread concern among both Republican and Democratic lawmakers, as well as conservative groups. An IRS official admitted last Friday that mistakes were made in handling tax-exempt status applications over the past few years, particularly for groups with 'tea party' or 'patriot' in their names. Conservative organizations reported application delays with requests for extensive supporting documents, including website printouts and guest speaker lists. President Obama stated he learned of the allegations through news reports on Friday. He refrained from commenting on the Treasury Department inspector-general's findings, noting, 'If true, such actions are contrary to our traditions and require accountability and correction. We need to wait for all the facts, but I will not tolerate this and will ensure a thorough investigation.' The House Ways and Means Committee, led by Republicans, announced a hearing for Friday morning, with acting IRS commissioner Steve Miller and Treasury inspector-general J. Russell George scheduled to testify. Committee Chairman Dave Camp criticized the IRS actions as 'astounding and appalling', pledging a complete investigation to prevent future occurrences. Ranking Democrat Sander Levin called for a thorough and bipartisan probe and effective corrective measures. Senate Finance Committee Chairman Max Baucus also demanded a full investigation, emphasizing the need to clarify who was responsible and what mistakes occurred. In 2010, Baucus requested the IRS investigate whether some groups were misusing their tax-exempt status for political activities. Senator Orrin Hatch asked Baucus for a prompt hearing, stressing the importance of bipartisan oversight. The Cincinnati IRS office, which processes most 501(c)(4) applications, saw a sharp increase in filings following the Supreme Court’s Citizens United decision, which enabled unlimited corporate campaign spending. Marcus Owens, a former director of the relevant IRS division, stated the agency receives about 60,000 tax-exempt applications yearly, most from civic groups that are quickly approved. He insisted that politically active organizations should be assessed based on their activities, not flagged by name, as occurred in this case—a practice he called mistaken. The inspector general’s report found that targeting of conservative groups began in March 2010, with agency managers instructing specialists to flag 'tea party' applications. Later, groups that criticized government operations received added scrutiny. By June 2011, IRS officials knew conservative groups were being singled out. Owens explained that former standards for identifying problematic applications were largely abandoned after early 2000s reorganization. Craig Holman of Public Citizen noted that while most 501(c)(4) groups operate legitimately, others primarily directed election spending, moving over $1.2 billion into 2012 campaigns. He argued the IRS should investigate political activity but not by targeting specific group names. Holman added, 'They never prevented these groups from registering as nonprofits.' Lois Lerner, who leads the IRS division overseeing tax-exempt groups, admitted last Friday that agents used terms like 'tea party' and 'patriot' as shortcuts to select applications for review, denying it was politically motivated. She said changes had been made to prevent similar errors in the future but did not confirm if any staff were disciplined. A congressional source indicated Lerner knew about the targeting in 2011 but did not fully inform Congress this year. Republicans have questioned why Steve Miller, reportedly informed in May 2012, failed to alert lawmakers when questioned soon afterwards. Chairman Camp stated, 'An apology is not sufficient. The IRS must be accountable to the American people.' The IRS did not respond to queries regarding Miller or former commissioner Doug Shulman’s knowledge of the targeting. Shulman, appointed by President George W. Bush, previously told Congress the IRS did not target conservative groups for political reasons, describing the process as standard review for tax-exempt applications. The IRS later stated Shulman was unaware of the targeting at that time, according to Senator Hatch’s spokeswoman Antonia Ferrier.
translated_content: Pred kongresno saslušanje, predsjednik Obama izjavio je u ponedjeljak da će pozvati na odgovornost Poreznu upravu SAD-a (IRS) ako se optužbe o političkom ciljanju pokažu točnima. Obama je novinarima rekao: 'Ako su zaposlenici IRS-a sudjelovali u prijavljenim radnjama i namjerno ciljali konzervativne skupine, to je skandalozno i neprihvatljivo. IRS mora zadržati apsolutni integritet kako bi javnost imala povjerenje da se zakoni primjenjuju nepristrano.' Dokumenti koje uskoro objavljuje revizor IRS-a pokazuju da je agencija ciljala skupine pokreta Tea Party i druge organizacije fokusirane na državnu potrošnju i savezni dug, a sve su tražile status oslobođenih od poreza. IRS je također pažljivije provjeravao prijavitelje s izjavama koje kritiziraju državne politike ili žele educirati javnost o tome kako učiniti Ameriku boljim mjestom za život—kriteriji koji obuhvaćaju mnoge konzervativne političke skupine koje traže status 501(c)(4). Ti detalji nalaze se u izvješću glavnog inspektora koje je dobio CNN, i koje je izazvalo zabrinutost među republikanskim i demokratskim zastupnicima, kao i konzervativnim skupinama. Službenik IRS-a priznao je prošlog petka da su u posljednjih nekoliko godina učinjene pogreške pri obradi zahtjeva za poreznu izuzeće, posebice za skupine s naslovima 'tea party' ili 'patriot'. Konzervativne organizacije izvijestile su o kašnjenjima u postupku i zahtjevima za opsežnom dokumentacijom, uključujući ispis web stranica i popise gostujućih govornika. Predsjednik Obama izjavio je da je za optužbe saznao iz medijskih izvješća u petak. Suzdražao se od komentiranja nalaza glavnog inspektora Ministarstva financija, navodeći: 'Ako je istina, takva su postupanja protivna našim tradicijama i zahtijevaju odgovornost i ispravak. Trebamo pričekati sve činjenice, ali neću to tolerirati i osigurat ću temeljitu istragu.' Odbor za sredstva i prihode Predstavničkog doma, pod vodstvom republikanaca, najavio je saslušanje u petak ujutro, na kojem će svjedočiti vršitelj dužnosti povjerenika IRS-a Steve Miller i glavni inspektor Ministarstva financija J. Russell George. Predsjednik odbora Dave Camp kritizirao je postupke IRS-a kao 'zapanjujuće i užasavajuće', obećavši potpunu istragu radi sprječavanja sličnih slučajeva. Visokopozicionirani demokrat Sander Levin pozvao je na temeljitu i dvostranačku istragu te učinkovite korektivne mjere. Predsjednik Senatskog odbora za financije Max Baucus također je zatražio potpunu istragu, naglašavajući važnost utvrđivanja odgovornosti i grešaka. Godine 2010. Baucus je zatražio od IRS-a da istraži zloupotrebljavaju li neke skupine svoj status izuzeća od poreza u političke svrhe. Senator Orrin Hatch zatražio je od Baucusa brzo saslušanje, naglašavajući važnost dvostranačkog nadzora. Ured IRS-a u Cincinnatiju, koji obrađuje većinu zahtjeva za status 501(c)(4), zabilježio je nagli porast prijava nakon odluke Vrhovnog suda u predmetu Citizens United, kojom je omogućeno neograničeno financiranje kampanja od strane korporacija. Marcus Owens, bivši direktor odgovornog odjela IRS-a, izjavio je da agencija godišnje primi oko 60.000 zahtjeva za porezno izuzeće, od kojih većinu čine građanske skupine i brzo su odobrene. On smatra da se politički aktivne organizacije trebaju procjenjivati prema djelovanju, a ne prema imenu, kao što se dogodilo u ovom slučaju—a takvu je praksu nazvao pogrešnom. Izvješće glavnog inspektora navodi da je ciljanje konzervativnih skupina započelo u ožujku 2010., kada su rukovoditelji agencije dali upute specijalistima da označavaju prijave s nazivom 'tea party'. Kasnije su nadzirane i skupine koje su kritizirale rad vlade. U lipnju 2011. IRS-ovi službenici su znali da se konzervativne skupine izdvajaju. Owens je naveo da su stariji standardi za identifikaciju problematičnih prijava napušteni nakon reorganizacije početkom 2000-ih. Craig Holman iz organizacije Public Citizen napomenuo je da većina skupina 501(c)(4) djeluje legitimno, ali neke su prvenstveno trošile sredstva na izbore, preusmjeravajući više od 1,2 milijarde dolara u kampanju 2012. godine. Zalagao se da IRS istražuje političke aktivnosti, ali ne na temelju imena skupina. Holman je dodao: 'Nikad nisu onemogućili registraciju tih skupina kao neprofitnih.' Lois Lerner, koja vodi odjel IRS-a za porezno izuzeće, prošlog je petka priznala da su agenti koristili izraze poput 'tea party' i 'patriot' kao prečace za izbor prijava za provjeru, odbacivši političke motive. Rekla je da su provedene izmjene kako bi se spriječile slične pogreške u budućnosti, ali nije potvrdila jesu li zaposlenici sankcionirani. Izvor iz Kongresa naznačio je da je Lerner znala za ciljanje još 2011. godine, ali nije u potpunosti obavijestila Kongres ove godine. Republikanci su doveli u pitanje zašto Steve Miller, prema izvješćima upoznat u svibnju 2012., nije izvijestio zastupnike kada su ga ispitivali. Predsjednik Camp izjavio je: 'Isprika nije dovoljna. IRS mora polagati račune američkoj javnosti.' IRS nije odgovorio na pitanja u vezi Millerove ili bivšeg povjerenika Douga Shulmana o saznanjima o ciljanju. Shulman, kojeg je imenovao predsjednik George W. Bush, ranije je izjavio Kongresu da IRS nije ciljao konzervativne skupine iz političkih razloga, opisujući proces kao standardnu provjeru prijava za porezno izuzeće. Prema glasnogovornici senatora Hatcha, IRS je kasnije naveo da Shulman tada nije znao za ciljanje.

article_content: India's cricket team has faced sharp criticism following a major batting collapse and swift defeat at Old Trafford, raising doubts about their determination in the ongoing series. Observers have questioned the squad’s commitment, especially after light-hearted remarks by captain MS Dhoni—who joked that the loss gave them extra rest days—rubbed fans and media the wrong way. Indian 24-hour news channels, often accused of being dramatic, have amplified this criticism. Since that defeat, several team members have been spotted enjoying off-field activities like touring Manchester United’s stadium and paintballing, rather than intensifying their training ahead of the final match at The Oval. Virat Kohli, struggling with a low batting average in the series, was seen at Chelsea’s Stamford Bridge football ground. These activities added fuel to the perception that the team lacks focus during a critical point in the series. Despite heavy losses in the last two Tests—recalling previous 4-0 defeats against England and Australia—the series is still alive, and India can still turn things around. England had struggled before and only got the upper hand after being handed chances, such as when Ravindra Jadeja dropped Alastair Cook. Now England leads 2-1, but India’s task is not impossible. India can’t bring in any new players for the last match. Their current batsmen need to step up and avoid another collapse. Cheteshwar Pujara has shown some resilience, although umpire errors have affected him. Kohli, however, has been out of form yet received a national honour nomination, which seems odd given his recent performance. Victory in the final Test will demand that India’s bowlers take all 20 wickets—no small feat. The return of Ishant Sharma could be crucial, while Varun Aaron and an increasingly fatigued Bhuvneshwar Kumar are also key options. Spinner Ravichandran Ashwin, who performed well with the bat at Old Trafford, might find more support at The Oval if the conditions suit spin. Ultimately, if India is to salvage this series, their established players must deliver, and Ashwin may be the main hope for a turnaround—provided they can finally post a competitive first-innings score.

Promatrači su doveli u pitanje predanost ekipe, posebice nakon šaljivih komentara kapetana MS Dhonija—koji se našalio da im poraz daje nekoliko dodatnih dana odmora—što nije dobro sjelo ni navijačima ni medijima. Na kraju, ako Indija želi spasiti ovu seriju, njihovi iskusni igrači moraju pokazati što znaju, a Ashwin bi mogao biti glavna nada za preokret—pod uvjetom da konačno postignu konkurentan rezultat u prvoj izmjeni.

article_content: Tensions between Pakistan, Afghanistan, and the United States increased on Monday after a NATO airstrike killed about two dozen Pakistani soldiers. Pakistani Prime Minister Yousuf Raza Gilani told CNN that Pakistan is reconsidering its relationship with the United States in response to the incident, which NATO described as a 'tragic unintended event.' Gilani emphasized that Pakistan wishes to maintain its relationship with the U.S. only if there is mutual respect and recognition of Pakistan's sovereignty. Currently, Gilani does not believe this respect exists. Gilani questioned how mutual respect can exist if he can't protect his nation's sovereignty. The Pakistani Taliban called for Pakistan to respond in kind to the airstrike, while an adviser to Afghan President Hamid Karzai warned the two countries could be headed towards conflict. Gilani cited the killing of Pakistani troops and the U.S. raid that killed Osama bin Laden as recent violations of sovereignty. He said: 'You cannot win any war without the support of the people, and these incidents distance people from supporting cooperation.' Pakistan halted 300 trucks carrying NATO supplies into Afghanistan and has not decided whether to attend the upcoming Bonn conference on Afghanistan's future. The full details of Saturday’s incident remained unclear, and U.S. forces appointed Brig. Gen. Stephen Clark to lead an investigation due to report by December 23, under the direction of Gen. James Mattis. According to U.S. officials, the investigation is looking at coordination failures before the airstrike. Initial reports suggest U.S. and Afghan forces said shots were fired from the Pakistani side of the border, a known insurgent tactic to seek sanctuary. The U.S. states that Pakistani forces were contacted before the attack, though precise coordination is still being reviewed. A NATO official reported Afghan troops and U.S. Special Operations were involved in a combined mission on the Afghan side. Pakistani military spokesperson Maj. Gen. Athar Abbas refuted claims that Pakistani troops fired first and stated that NATO helicopters opened fire on checkpoints. Pakistani forces informed NATO after the attack began and fired back in retaliation. Gen. Martin Dempsey, chairman of the U.S. Joint Chiefs of Staff, recognized the strained relationship with Pakistan but expressed hope it would recover. The White House offered condolences, and the State Department emphasized the shared threat both countries face, calling the relationship vital. A U.S. official told CNN that Pakistan remains a critical counterterrorism partner, and significant changes in cooperation are not anticipated. Meanwhile, the Pakistani Taliban called for a strong response from Pakistan and pledged continued jihad while Pakistan collaborates with the United States. In Kabul, presidential adviser Ashraf Ghani suggested Afghanistan and Pakistan could be on a path toward conflict, accusing Pakistan of involvement in former President Burhanudin Rabbani's assassination. Both countries have exchanged accusations regarding militant support along the border, but Afghanistan invited Pakistan to attend the Bonn conference to further reconciliation. Reporting assistance by Nick Paton Walsh in Kabul, Barbara Starr, Chris Lawrence, Nasir Habib, Shaan Khan, and Saboor Khattak.
translated_content: Napetosti između Pakistana, Afganistana i Sjedinjenih Država porasle su u ponedjeljak nakon što je NATO-ov zračni napad ubio oko dvadeset pakistanskih vojnika. Pakistanski premijer Yousuf Raza Gilani izjavio je za CNN da Pakistan preispituje svoj odnos sa Sjedinjenim Državama zbog ovog incidenta, koji je NATO opisao kao 'tragičan nenamjeran događaj.' Gilani je naglasio da Pakistan želi održati odnose s SAD-om samo ako postoji međusobno poštovanje i priznavanje pakistanskog suvereniteta. Trenutno Gilani smatra da to poštovanje ne postoji. Gilani se zapitao kako može postojati uzajamno poštovanje ako ne može zaštititi suverenitet svoje zemlje. Pakistanski talibani pozvali su Pakistan da odgovori na napad, dok je savjetnik afganistanskog predsjednika Hamida Karzaija upozorio da bi dvije države mogle biti na putu prema sukobu. Gilani je naveo da su ubojstva pakistanskih vojnika i američka operacija u kojoj je ubijen Osama bin Laden predstavljali najnovija kršenja suvereniteta. Rekao je: 'Ne možete dobiti rat bez podrške naroda, a ovakvi incidenti udaljavaju ljude od suradnje.' Pakistan je zaustavio 300 kamiona s NATO-ovom opremom za Afganistan i još nije odlučio hoće li prisustvovati nadolazećoj konferenciji u Bonnu o budućnosti Afganistana. Detalji subotnjeg incidenta i dalje su nejasni, a američke snage imenovale su brigadnog generala Stephena Clarka za voditelja istrage koja bi trebala biti dovršena do 23. prosinca pod nadzorom generala Jamesa Mattisa. Prema američkim dužnosnicima, istraga se fokusira na moguće propuste u koordinaciji prije zračnog napada. Prvi izvještaji sugeriraju da su američke i afganistanske snage tvrdile kako je pucano s pakistanske strane granice, što je poznata taktika pobunjenika za pronalazak utočišta. SAD navode da su upozorili pakistanske snage prije napada, ali točna koordinacija se još uvijek istražuje. NATO-ov dužnosnik je rekao kako su afganistanske trupe i američke specijalne snage sudjelovale u zajedničkoj misiji na afganistanskoj strani granice. Glasnogovornik pakistanske vojske, general bojnik Athar Abbas, odbacio je tvrdnje da su pakistanski vojnici prvi otvorili vatru te izjavio kako su NATO helikopteri prvi napali kontrolne točke. Pakistanske snage su izvijestile NATO nakon što je napad započeo i uzvratile vatru. General Martin Dempsey, predsjednik Zajedničkog stožera SAD-a, priznao je narušene odnose s Pakistanom, ali je izrazio nadu u njihov oporavak. Bijela kuća izrazila je sućut, a State Department naglasio je važnost odnosa, ističući zajedničku prijetnju s kojom se obje zemlje suočavaju. Američki dužnosnik izjavio je za CNN kako Pakistan ostaje ključni partner u borbi protiv terorizma i da nisu očekivane značajne promjene u suradnji. Pakistanski talibani su u međuvremenu pozvali na snažan odgovor i obećali nastavak džihada dok Pakistan surađuje sa SAD-om. U Kabulu je savjetnik predsjednika Ashraf Ghani iznio mišljenje da bi Afganistan i Pakistan mogli biti na putu prema sukobu, optužujući Pakistan za umiješanost u ubojstvo bivšeg predsjednika Burhanudina Rabbania. Obje zemlje su razmjenjivale optužbe o podršci militantima uz granicu, no Afganistan je pozvao Pakistan na bonnsku konferenciju radi pomirenja. article_content: Queen Elizabeth II made a highly anticipated return to Wimbledon on Thursday, her first visit in more than 30 years. Her previous attendance was in 1977, when she saw Virginia Wade claim the women’s singles title. Wearing a teal outfit and matching hat while holding a bouquet, the Queen toured the venue as eager fans gathered to see her. She greeted an impressive list of tennis legends, including Billie Jean King, Martina Navratilova, Venus Williams, Serena Williams, Jelena Jankovic, and Roger Federer. The Queen then took her seat in Centre Court’s Royal Box to watch British favorite Andy Murray, the fourth seed, play against Finland’s Jarkko Nieminen beneath a mostly sunny sky. Later, she planned to share lunch at the clubhouse with current and past players. Organizers mentioned the menu would likely include poached salmon, new potatoes, and the traditional Wimbledon treat: strawberries and cream. Her visit brought a renewed sense of tradition and buzz to the championships, appreciated by both players and spectators.

Odjevena u tirkiznu odjeću s pripadajućim šeširom i u ruci noseći buket, kraljica je obišla teniska igrališta, dok su se uzbuđeni navijači okupljali kako bi je vidjeli. Pozdravila je impresivnu skupinu teniskih legendi, među kojima su Billie Jean King, Martina Navratilova, Venus Williams, Serena Williams, Jelena Janković i Roger Federer. Kraljica je zatim zauzela svoje mjesto u Kraljevskoj loži na središnjem terenu kako bi gledala omiljenog britanskog tenisača Andyja Murraya, četvrtog nositelja, protiv Finca Jarkka Nieminena pod uglavnom sunčanim nebom. Kasnije je planirala ručati u klupskom restoranu s trenutnim i bivšim igračima. Organizatori su naveli da će jelovnik vjerojatno uključivati poširani losos, nove krumpire i tradicionalnu wimbledonsku slasticu: jagode sa šlagom. Njezin dolazak donio je osjećaj tradicije i uzbuđenja na turnir, što su cijenili i igrači i gledatelji.

article_content: Paris Couture Fashion Week ended on a high note with remarkable presentations by Zahair Murad, Valentino, Jean Paul Gaultier, and Vionnet. The Fall-Winter collections transported audiences to diverse settings, ranging from dramatic opera houses to circus-inspired themes and international influences. Highlights included a performance by Chinese singer Li Yugang, as well as impressive designs from Lawrence Xu. Zahair Murad showcased a glamorous collection, matching the elegance often associated with fellow Lebanese designer Elie Saab. While many collections displayed extravagant glamour and sequins, Rad Hourani stood out with a minimalist, monochrome collection influenced by Scandinavian silhouettes, offering a stark contrast to traditional Middle Eastern fashion. Jean Paul Gaultier's show drew inspiration from Federico Fellini and 'The Pink Panther', combining theatrical flair with animal motifs. His creations featured inventive uses of leopard print, feathered coats resembling animal pelts, and dramatic, clown-inspired shapes. The show was lively and engaging, with models walking to the 'Pink Panther' theme and guests divided into animal-themed sections. Valentino's collection continued the cinematic inspiration by blending elements from various cultures and eras. Baz Luhrmann and Anna Wintour were among the distinguished front row guests. Designers Maria Grazia Chiuri and Pierpaolo Piccioli incorporated Oriental designs, Scottish tweed, and Renaissance influences, making it one of their most creative presentations to date. Returning after a 13-year break, Viktor & Rolf presented a minimalist collection inspired by a Japanese garden. The designers sculpted their 20 black, architectural pieces live on stage, creating striking visual arrangements. Vionnet offered elegant, romantic gowns, contributing to the event’s overall sense of sophistication. Meanwhile, at Berlin’s Mercedes-Benz Fashion Week, Satu Maaranen debuted vibrant, colorful designs and oversized sun hats. Paris Couture Fashion Week drew prominent attendees, including Kristen Stewart, Princess Madeleine of Sweden, Olivia Palermo, and Nicky Hilton.

article_content: Los Angeles, California (CNN) — A federal judge ruled Thursday that same-sex couples can marry in California starting August 18, marking another major victory for supporters of gay rights. Both advocates and opponents have said this high-stakes case is likely to be considered by the U.S. Supreme Court. Chief U.S. District Judge Vaughn Walker, based in San Francisco, struck down California’s voter-approved Proposition 8 last week, finding that the ban on same-sex marriage violates the U.S. Constitution. Though Walker initially issued a temporary stay on his decision, he announced Thursday he would lift it, clearing the way for same-sex marriages to resume. The case is drawing national attention—many believe it could lead to a landmark Supreme Court ruling on same-sex marriage rights in the United States. Currently, same-sex marriage is legal in five states—Massachusetts, Connecticut, Vermont, Iowa, and New Hampshire—and in the District of Columbia. New Jersey permits civil unions. California allowed same-sex marriages briefly before Proposition 8 passed in 2008, defining marriage as a union between a man and a woman. The proposition was approved by 52 percent of voters in November of that year. Rick Jacobs, founder of the Courage Campaign, hailed the judge’s decision: “Today’s ruling means that in less than one week, equality under the law will be restored for millions of loving families across California.” Ahead of Judge Walker’s announcement, dozens of same-sex couples gathered outside San Francisco City Hall, waving rainbow flags and holding signs like “I DO support the freedom to marry.” Their celebration erupted once the ruling was announced, though they must wait at least a week to wed. Proposition 8 has been a focal point in ongoing debates and legal battles over same-sex marriage in California. Opponents of same-sex marriage, seeing their best chance in higher courts, have appealed Judge Walker’s ruling. The next step is the 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals, with the possibility of the case reaching the U.S. Supreme Court. By maintaining the stay until August 18, Judge Walker gave Proposition 8 supporters more time for the appeals court to consider the case. The court may allow same-sex marriages to proceed or put them on hold as legal proceedings continue. Tom McClusky, of the Family Research Council—which opposes same-sex marriage—warned, “Judge Walker is in fact making victims out of these people who might now go get married and then not know what the status of their relationship is.” A recent CNN/Opinion Research Corporation Poll shows Americans remain divided: 49 percent believe same-sex couples have a constitutional right to marry and have legal recognition, while 51 percent say such rights do not exist.

Sljedeća instanca je 9. američki žalbeni sud, s mogućnošću da slučaj završi i pred Vrhovnim sudom SAD-a. Produljujući suspenziju do 18. kolovoza, sudac Walker dao je pobornicima Prijedloga 8 dodatno vrijeme kako bi žalbeni sud razmotrio slučaj. Sud može dopustiti nastavak sklapanja istospolnih brakova ili ih privremeno zaustaviti dok traju pravni postupci. Tom McClusky iz Family Research Council — organizacije koja se protivi istospolnim brakovima — upozorio je: “Sudac Walker zapravo čini žrtvama ljude koji bi sada mogli stupiti u brak, a zatim ne bi znali kakav je pravni status njihova odnosa.” Prema nedavnoj anketi CNN/Opinion Research Corporation, Amerikanci su i dalje podijeljeni: 49 posto vjeruje da istospolni parovi imaju ustavno pravo na brak i zakonsko priznanje, dok 51 posto smatra da takva prava ne postoje.

article_content: Jeffrey Kantor, a former government contractor, claims he suffered serious emotional distress after a Google search he conducted in October 2009 was auto-completed in a way that attracted government attention. Kantor states he typed ‘how do I build a radio controlled’ but Google auto-completed it to ‘how do I build a radio controlled bomb.’ Kantor alleges that after the search, he was investigated and harassed by federal authorities, leading to a hostile work environment and his eventual dismissal from Appian Corporation, where he worked at the time. He has filed a $60 million lawsuit against several top U.S. government officials and departments, alleging harassment and privacy violations. According to the complaint cited by Courthouse News, Kantor claims his co-workers, as well as employees of subcontractors CRGT and Northrop Grumman, repeatedly referenced his private information—such as emails, websites visited, library activity, conversations, and phone calls—as a form of intimidation. Kantor interprets these comments as veiled threats. He further claims that, over a period of months, investigators engaged in harassing behavior, which included inappropriate remarks and the use of intimidation tactics. Kantor alleges that a GPS tracking device was placed on his car as part of the surveillance against him. Kantor seeks $13.8 million in compensatory damages and $45 million in punitive damages, as well as an end to what he characterizes as government stalking and harassment. The complaint names officials including former CIA Director John Brennan, former National Intelligence Director James Clapper, former Secretary of State John Kerry, former Secretary of Defense Chuck Hagel, and former Attorney General Eric Holder as defendants. As of now, there are no comments from the named officials or agencies regarding Kantor’s allegations.

Kantor navodi da je upisao ‘kako izraditi radio upravljani’, no Google je automatski predložio ‘kako izraditi radio upravljanu bombu’. Kantor tvrdi da su ga nakon te pretrage istraživale i uznemiravale savezne vlasti, što je dovelo do neprijateljske radne okoline i njegovog otpuštanja iz Appian Corporationa, gdje je tada radio. Podnio je tužbu vrijednu 60 milijuna dolara protiv nekoliko visokih američkih dužnosnika i institucija, optužujući ih za uznemiravanje i narušavanje privatnosti. Prema tužbi koju navodi Courthouse News, Kantor tvrdi da su njegovi kolege, kao i zaposlenici podizvođača CRGT i Northrop Grumman, opetovano spominjali njegove privatne informacije—poput e-mailova, posjećenih web stranica, aktivnosti u knjižnici, razgovora i telefonskih poziva—kao oblik zastrašivanja. Kantor te komentare tumači kao prikrivene prijetnje. Također tvrdi da su istražitelji tijekom nekoliko mjeseci koristili ponašanja uznemiravanja, uključujući neprimjerene primjedbe i taktike zastrašivanja. Kantor traži 13,8 milijuna dolara odštete i 45 milijuna dolara kaznene odštete, kao i prestanak onoga što opisuje kao vladino praćenje i uznemiravanje. U tužbi su kao tuženici navedeni bivši direktor CIA-e John Brennan, bivši direktor nacionalne obavještajne službe James Clapper, bivši državni tajnik John Kerry, bivši ministar obrane Chuck Hagel i bivši državni odvjetnik Eric Holder. Za sada nema komentara od navedenih dužnosnika ili institucija u vezi Kantorovih navoda.

article_content: Geert Wilders, leader of the right-wing Party for Freedom (PVV), is set to become the next Prime Minister of the Netherlands following a significant win in the general elections. This outcome marks a major shift in Dutch politics and has broader implications for Europe, where right-wing movements are on the rise. With nearly all votes counted as of early Thursday, Wilders’ PVV is projected to win 37 seats in the 150-seat parliament, more than doubling its previous count and exceeding exit poll predictions. Wilders described his win as surreal, saying, “I had to pinch my arm.” Political parties planned to meet separately on Thursday, with coalition talks expected to begin Friday and likely to be complex. While Wilders is known for his strong positions on migration and Islam, he has emphasized that his policies will fully comply with Dutch law and the constitution. His platform includes advocating for a referendum on EU membership, stopping the acceptance of asylum seekers, stricter border control, and reducing the influence of Islam in Dutch society. He adopted a milder tone during this campaign, focusing more on migration, the cost-of-living crisis, and housing shortages. Wilders stated, “Voters said, ‘We are sick of it. Sick to our stomachs,’” referring to dissatisfaction with asylum policies. He pledged to prioritize Dutch citizens and “give the people their nation back.” Forming a coalition government may prove difficult given the reluctance of many mainstream parties to work with Wilders and the PVV. However, the scale of his victory strengthens his negotiating position. Pieter Omtzigt, founder of New Social Contract, secured 20 seats and expressed willingness to enter coalition discussions. The center-left Labor Party and Green Left alliance, led by Frans Timmermans, is projected to win 25 seats. Timmermans firmly rejected joining any coalition targeting asylum seekers. The election result follows Italian Premier Giorgia Meloni's rise last year and fits a wider European trend of growing support for right-wing and populist parties. Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban congratulated Wilders, calling it a sign of change. Outgoing Prime Minister Mark Rutte resigned in July after his coalition failed to agree on migration reforms. Dilan Yesilgöz-Zegerius, who succeeded Rutte as VVD leader, could have become the first female Dutch prime minister, but her party lost seats. The Dutch election highlights ongoing shifts in Europe's political landscape, with several nations seeing increased influence from populist and right-wing parties.

Wilders je opisao svoju pobjedu kao nestvarnu, rekavši: 'Morao sam se uštipnuti.' Iako je Wilders poznat po svojim oštrim stavovima o migracijama i islamu, naglasio je da će njegove politike u potpunosti biti u skladu s nizozemskim zakonima i ustavom. Njegov program uključuje zagovaranje referenduma o članstvu u EU, zaustavljanje prihvata tražitelja azila, strožu kontrolu granica i smanjenje utjecaja islama u nizozemskom društvu. Tijekom ove kampanje zauzeo je blaži ton, više se fokusirajući na migracije, krizu troškova života i nestašicu stanova. Obećao je da će prioritet dati nizozemskim građanima i 'vratiti narod njegovoj zemlji.' Formiranje koalicijske vlade moglo bi biti teško zbog nevoljkosti mnogih glavnih stranaka da surađuju s PVV-om i Wildersom. Ipak, veličina njegove pobjede osnažuje njegovu poziciju u pregovorima. Pieter Omtzigt, osnivač stranke Novi društveni ugovor, osvojio je 20 mjesta i izrazio spremnost na sudjelovanje u koalicijskim razgovorima. Savez lijevog centra Stranke rada i Zelene ljevice, predvođen Fransom Timmermansom, predviđa se da će osvojiti 25 mjesta. Timmermans je odlučno odbio sudjelovati u koaliciji koja bi ciljala tražitelje azila. Rezultat izbora dolazi nakon uspona talijanske premijerke Giorgie Meloni prošle godine i uklapa se u širi europski trend sve većeg podržavanja desničarskih i populističkih stranaka. Mađarski premijer Viktor Orban čestitao je Wildersu, nazvavši to znakom promjena. Odlazeći premijer Mark Rutte podnio je ostavku u srpnju nakon što koalicija nije uspjela dogovoriti reforme migracija. Dilan Yesilgöz-Zegerius, koja je naslijedila Ruttea kao čelnica VVD-a, mogla je postati prva žena premijerka Nizozemske, ali njezina stranka je izgubila mjesta. article_content: After using the OnePlus Open over the past few weeks, it's evident that this model distinguishes itself in the U.S. foldable phone landscape. Multiple reviewers, including Harish Jonnalagadda, consider it the best foldable now available to American buyers. Still, it's significant that the U.S. market doesn’t face the same level of competition as other regions, as brands like Xiaomi, Honor, Vivo, and Huawei offer more variety overseas. This limitation is largely shaped by carrier influence and possibly politics. Currently, Samsung dominates the U.S. foldable sector, though the Galaxy Z Fold 5 falls behind the OnePlus Open in several respects. The OnePlus Open brings an almost crease-free display, includes a hardware mute switch, and offers faster-than-30W charging—rare in U.S. foldables. OnePlus is also emphasizing improved camera performance, with claims that the Open may surpass the Google Pixel 8 Pro. While further direct comparisons are still postulated, initial impressions suggest it competes strongly with phones like the Galaxy S23 Ultra and the iPhone 15 Pro Max. However, the lack of major carrier partnerships remains a hurdle for the OnePlus Open, as it's offered mainly through Best Buy, Amazon, or directly from OnePlus rather than most U.S. carriers. This limits widespread access and, combined with its steep price—$1,699 retail or $1,499 with select trade-ins like the LG Wing—makes the device less accessible, since most carrier installment plans are unavailable. With minimal competition, Samsung has little incentive to push innovation forward in this market, and significant changes may only occur if Apple moves into foldables. For now, U.S. consumers face fewer choices compared to those abroad, and there’s unlikely to be a dramatic shift until more carriers and manufacturers join the foldable space.

Ipak, važno je napomenuti da američko tržište nema jednaku razinu konkurencije kao druga tržišta, gdje brendovi poput Xiaomija, Honora, Viva i Huaweija nude više opcija. Ova ograničenja uglavnom su rezultat utjecaja operatera i, moguće, političkih razloga. OnePlus također naglašava poboljšane performanse kamera, uz tvrdnje da Open može nadmašiti Google Pixel 8 Pro. Iako se očekuju daljnje izravne usporedbe, prvi dojmovi sugeriraju da se uspješno natječe s uređajima poput Galaxyja S23 Ultra i iPhonea 15 Pro Max. Međutim, nedostatak velikih partnerstava s operaterima i dalje predstavlja prepreku za OnePlus Open jer se uređaj uglavnom prodaje preko Best Buy-a, Amazona ili izravno od OnePlusa, a ne putem većine američkih operatera. To ograničava dostupnost, a u kombinaciji s visokim cijenama – 1.699 dolara u maloprodaji ili 1.499 dolara uz određene uređaje za zamjenu poput LG Wing – uređaj postaje manje pristupačan jer većina operatera ne nudi plaćanje na rate. Zbog manjka konkurencije Samsung nema previše poticaja za inovacije na ovom tržištu, a značajne promjene vjerojatno će se dogoditi tek kad Apple krene u preklopne uređaje. Za sada američki potrošači imaju manje izbora nego oni u inozemstvu, a veće promjene se neće dogoditi dok se više operatera i proizvođača ne uključi na tržište preklopnih telefona.

article_content: Google Play Games for PC beta is making big strides to enhance the experience of playing mobile games on computers. The latest update introduces full support for major console controllers—including PS5 DualSense, PS4 DualShock, Xbox One, and Xbox Series S/X. However, not all games will be immediately compatible, so users should check each game for controller support. Asphalt 9 Legends and BADLAND are among the first titles to work with controllers. Visual improvements are also arriving, with support for 4K resolution now available for players whose monitors support it. Players can quickly adjust screen resolution mid-game using the Shift+Tab shortcut to access a new menu, making it easier to optimize visuals. The catalog of over 3,000 games continues to grow, and popular titles like Clash of Clans and Clash Royale can now be played on Windows 10 and 11 computers. To help users discover games quickly, a search bar is now available in the 'All Games' section of the launcher. Since entering open beta in 2022, Google Play Games for PC has spread to more than 60 regions, including a recent launch in India. With Google account integration, gamers can access their saved progress and collected items across multiple devices, whether using a Chromebook or PC. Additionally, Google has lowered the technical requirements: you'll need at least Windows 10, an SSD with 10 GB free, 8GB RAM, and hardware virtualization enabled. The platform also features keyboard mapping for customizable controls, and step-by-step instructions help users set up necessary features.

Najnovije ažuriranje uvodi potpunu podršku za glavne konzolaške kontrolere — uključujući PS5 DualSense, PS4 DualShock, Xbox One i Xbox Series S/X. Ipak, nisu sve igre odmah kompatibilne, stoga korisnici trebaju provjeriti podržava li igra kontroler. Asphalt 9 Legends i BADLAND među prvima su koji rade s kontrolerima. Stižu i vizualna poboljšanja, jer je sada dostupna podrška za 4K rezoluciju za monitore koji to podržavaju. Igrači mogu brzo mijenjati rezoluciju tijekom igre koristeći prečac Shift+Tab i pristupiti novom izborniku, što olakšava optimizaciju prikaza. Katalog od više od 3.000 igara i dalje raste, a popularni naslovi poput Clash of Clans i Clash Royale sada se mogu igrati na računalima s Windows 10 i 11. Kako bi korisnici lakše pronašli igre, u odjeljku 'Sve igre' pokretača sada je dostupan pretraživač. Od ulaska u otvorenu betu 2022. godine, Google Play Games za PC proširio se na više od 60 regija, uključujući nedavno lansiranje u Indiji. Integracijom Google računa, igrači mogu pristupiti spremljenom napretku i svim prikupljenim predmetima na više uređaja, bilo da koriste Chromebook ili PC. Također, Google je snizio tehničke zahtjeve: sada je potrebno imati barem Windows 10, SSD s 10 GB slobodnog prostora, 8 GB RAM-a i omogućenu hardversku virtualizaciju. Platforma nudi i mapiranje tipkovnice za prilagodljive kontrole, a korisnicima su dostupne upute za podešavanje svega što je potrebno.

Since taking over as head coach in 2011, Jurgen Klinsmann has led the US men’s national soccer team to significant progress. He now seeks to highlight this growth with a potential match against England at Wembley, a stadium where the US lost 2-0 on both their previous visits (1994 and 2008). The team’s impressive run to the knockout stage of the last World Cup—where they were ultimately eliminated by Belgium—has increased international recognition of American soccer, especially among English fans, who took notice amid their own squad’s early exit.

Klinsmann credits the development of talented players and the rapid expansion of Major League Soccer (MLS) for the team’s improved competitiveness. With upcoming friendlies against Colombia at Craven Cottage in London and the Republic of Ireland in Dublin, Klinsmann is eager to build on his team’s reputation abroad.

He stresses the need for US players to maintain strong performances back at their clubs, likening the required professionalism to that of soccer stars like Messi, Ronaldo, and Muller. Klinsmann also highlighted Robbie Keane’s dedication and the positive impact the Irish striker has brought to MLS since joining LA Galaxy in 2011. The German coach, a former Tottenham striker himself, expressed excitement for returning to soccer-driven London and reiterated his hope for a high-profile match against England at Wembley to further demonstrate the US team’s evolution.

Sada taj napredak želi dokazati mogućim susretom protiv Engleske na Wembleyju, mjestu na kojem je SAD izgubio obje dosadašnje utakmice (1994. i 2008., oba puta 2:0). Sjajan nastup na posljednjem Svjetskom prvenstvu—gdje su Amerikanci ispali od Belgije u nokaut fazi—povećao je međunarodno priznanje američkog nogometa, posebno među engleskim navijačima koji su to primijetili nakon rane eliminacije svoje reprezentacije.

Klinsmann zasluge za uspjeh pripisuje razvoju talentiranih igrača i brzom rastu Major League Soccera (MLS), koji je američku reprezentaciju učinio konkurentnijom. Pred njima su prijateljske utakmice protiv Kolumbije na londonskom Craven Cottageu i Republike Irske u Dublinu, a Klinsmann želi na tim susretima dodatno potvrditi reputaciju SAD-a u međunarodnom nogometu.

Ističe važnost da američki igrači i u klupskim utakmicama održavaju visoke standarde, nadahnjujući se na profesionalizmu igrača poput Messija, Ronalda i Mullera. Pohvalio je i Robbieja Keanea zbog njegove predanosti i pozitivnog utjecaja na MLS otkad je 2011. prešao u LA Galaxy. Klinsmann, bivši napadač Tottenhama i Nijemac, raduje se povratku u sportski nastrojeni London i nada se da će u skoroj budućnosti dobiti priliku odmjeriti snage protiv Engleske na Wembleyju, kako bi pokazao koliko je napredovala američka nogometna reprezentacija.

article_content: A range of new entertainment options is coming to various platforms, including music, movies, TV, and games. Taylor Swift has released '1989 (Taylor’s Version),' the fourth album in her re-recording project, featuring five unreleased tracks and fan favorite 'New Romantics.' On Paramount+, a documentary revisits the Milli Vanilli lip-syncing scandal, suggesting their producers were more involved than previously known. ‘Pain Hustlers’ debuts on Netflix, starring Emily Blunt, Chris Evans, and Andy Garcia. Based on Evan Hughes’s reporting, the film follows a pharmaceutical startup involved in illegal activities to promote their fentanyl spray Subsys. Directed by David Yates, the film received mixed critical reception at the Toronto International Film Festival. The horror game 'Five Nights at Freddy’s' has been adapted into a movie available in theaters and on Peacock. The film, from Blumhouse Productions, stars Josh Hutcherson as a security guard who discovers animatronic mascots with sinister intentions after midnight. Paul Schrader’s 'Master Gardener,' completing his 'Man in a Room' trilogy, is now streaming on Hulu. Joel Edgerton stars as a horticulturist with a mysterious past, joined by Sigourney Weaver and Quintessa Swindell. Barbra Streisand, alongside Columbia Records, releases new albums 'EVERGREENS: Celebrating Six Decades on Columbia Records' and 'YENTL: 40th Anniversary Deluxe Edition.' These titles arrive just ahead of her memoir, 'My Name is Barbra.' DJ Shadow’s new album ‘Action Adventure’ is the result of extensive research, including sifting through hundreds of tapes and a vast personal record collection. The new Paramount+ documentary ‘Milli Vanilli’ explores the infamous lip-syncing scandal involving Rob Pilatus and Fab Morvan, with new evidence about the producers’ role. Apple TV+ launches the family animated series ‘CURSES!,’ produced by DreamWorks, just in time for Halloween. The show follows the Vanderhouven family as they attempt to break a family curse and return stolen artifacts. The cast includes John Krasinski, Reid Scott, Rhea Perlman, Phylicia Rashad, and Robert Englund. 'Fellow Travelers’ premieres Friday on Paramount+ and Sunday on Showtime. The series stars Matt Bomer and Jonathan Bailey as lovers who meet during the 1950s McCarthy era, with their story spanning key moments in U.S. history. 'The Gilded Age' returns for its second season on HBO and MAX. Created by Julian Fellowes, the show follows the lives of wealthy families and their employees during New York’s industrialization in the late 1800s. ‘Alan Wake II,’ a sequel to the cult favorite video game, releases this Friday on PlayStation, Xbox, and PC. The story follows Alan Wake and new character Saga Anderson as they struggle with supernatural forces.

article_content: Subaru has announced plans to adopt the North American Charging Standard (NACS) for select electric vehicles beginning in 2025. In the same year, Subaru will also offer NACS charging adapters to customers who own or lease Subaru electric vehicles using the Combined Charging System (CCS). The automaker has taken a cautious approach to electric vehicles so far. Currently, Subaru only offers the Solterra, which was developed in partnership with Toyota; all of Subaru's other vehicles remain gas-powered. However, Subaru is planning to expand its EV lineup with three new models set to be revealed by 2026. Industry-wide, adoption of the NACS charging port has surged since Tesla opened the format in the previous year. Subaru now joins other major car manufacturers—such as Toyota, Ford, GM, Rivian, Volvo, Polestar, Nissan, Mercedes-Benz, Jaguar Land Rover, Fisker, Hyundai, and BMW—in supporting the standard. Nevertheless, companies like Volkswagen and Stellantis have yet to announce plans to adopt NACS. Despite these changes, there is still significant room for improvement in EV charging infrastructure in the US, and it remains uncertain if the shift to NACS will resolve existing issues.

U istoj godini Subaru će također ponuditi NACS adaptere za punjenje kupcima koji posjeduju ili unajmljuju Subaru električna vozila sa standardom Combined Charging System (CCS). Proizvođač automobila do sada je bio oprezan s električnim vozilima. Trenutno Subaru nudi samo model Solterra, razvijen u suradnji s Toyotom; svi ostali Subaru modeli su na benzin. Ipak, Subaru planira proširiti svoju ponudu električnih vozila s tri nova modela koja bi trebala biti predstavljena do 2026. godine. Na razini industrije, usvajanje NACS priključka značajno je poraslo otkako je Tesla prošle godine otvorio svoj format. Subaru se sada priključuje drugim velikim proizvođačima automobila—poput Toyote, Forda, GM-a, Riviana, Volva, Polarstara, Nissana, Mercedes-Benza, Jaguar Land Rovera, Fiskera, Hyundaija i BMW-a—koji podržavaju taj standard. Ipak, Volkswagen i Stellantis još nisu najavili planove za usvajanje NACS-a. Unatoč svim tim promjenama, još uvijek postoji dosta prostora za poboljšanje infrastrukture za punjenje električnih vozila u SAD-u, a nije sigurno hoće li prelazak na NACS riješiti postojeće probleme.
