article_content: Former U.S. state Senator Michael Katz and his two daughters were injured when a chairlift derailed at Sugarloaf Mountain ski resort in Maine, causing them to fall 35 feet to the ground. The incident happened in December 2010, when high winds dislodged a chairlift cable, causing five cars to fall and injuring eight people. Katz, a Democratic politician and doctor, suffered a broken back and a brain injury, reportedly the most severe among those injured. He is suing the resort for unspecified damages, including on behalf of his then 11- and 13-year-old daughters, Abigail and Emily, who were also hurt. The lawsuit states that Abigail was thrown from her chair after the impact, while Emily was dragged up the mountain because her ski equipment was caught. Abigail and Emily saw their father lying motionless in the snow and feared he had died. The family claims the resort was negligent for operating the lift despite allegedly knowing about its safety hazards. The resort stated it had tried to avoid legal proceedings and was not surprised by the lawsuit. The chairlift, a two-passenger monocable fixed-grip model built by Borvig in 1975, was 4,013 feet long, had 162 chairs, and was replaced in December 2011. Katz served a single term in the Delaware Senate before losing his seat to Republican Greg Lavelle. Katz’s injuries became a contentious issue during the election, with his opponent criticizing his attendance record. Katz’s wife, Patricia, recorded a radio advertisement accusing Lavelle of exploiting Michael’s accident for political gain. Sugarloaf, at 4,237 feet, is Maine’s second-highest mountain after Mount Katahdin.
translated_content: Bivši američki senator Michael Katz i njegove dvije kćeri ozlijeđeni su kada je žičara ispala iz tračnica u skijalištu Sugarloaf Mountain u Maineu, zbog čega su pali 11 metara na tlo. Incident se dogodio u prosincu 2010. kada je jak vjetar otkačio sajlu žičare, što je uzrokovalo pad pet kabina i ozlijedilo osam osoba. Katz, demokratski političar i liječnik, zadobio je prijelom leđa i ozljedu mozga, što su bile najteže ozljede među stradalima. article_content: Binge drinking might seem like a modern issue, but these remarkable mugshots reveal that authorities have addressed alcohol abuse for many decades. Photographs from early 20th-century Birmingham show women banned from local pubs after arrest, labeled as 'habitual drunkards.' These women were placed on the city's 'Black List,' preventing them from being served in pubs. Among them was Kate Kibble, known as 'One-eyed Kate,' who was one of the 37 women banned in 1902. Alice Tatlow had the Prince of Wales's feathers tattooed on her foot, and Mary Bayliss exemplified respectable-looking women who were also barred. Officials distributed a list of 82 people—37 women included—across Birmingham's pubs, warning landlords to watch for them. The notices featured mugshots and physical descriptions. These records were recently discovered by ancestry.co.uk. A spokesperson from the website explained that, to enforce the 1902 Sale of Liquor to Habitual Drunkard’s Licensing Act, the Birmingham Watch Committee gave licensed sellers photos and descriptions of people identified as 'habitual drunkards' to ensure they were not served. Many people on the list, like Susannah Booton, had been arrested for public drunkenness. Most women were between 30 and 40 years old. Elizabeth Thompson was photographed after an arrest for public drinking. Between 1903 and 1906, all 82 individuals were convicted of drunkenness, usually at the Birmingham City Police Court. Many had physical deformities or tattoos and still held jobs such as cleaning, chopping wood, polishing, or selling grease. Some women, such as Sarah Teresa Evans and Ellen Heaton, were described as imposing. Annie Hodgkins (also known as 'Hodgkiss') faced charges of drunken and disorderly conduct. While Eliza Fallon was unemployed, many others were working. Police circulated posters with their photos and descriptions. Some women earned income as street performers, and a few as prostitutes. Frequently using aliases, many were considered repeat offenders. Despite modern associations of public drunkenness with youth, only two women were under 25 and five were over 50. For example, 46-year-old Mary Bayliss still encountered trouble. Sarah Henson balanced work as a dressmaker with other income. Elizabeth Thompson reportedly had several aliases. Susannah Booton and Sarah Evans are noted for visible disfigurements or health issues. These mugshots resulted from the 1902 law aimed at reducing public drunkenness.

Fotografije iz ranog 20. stoljeća u Birminghamu prikazuju žene koje su nakon uhićenja bile izbačene iz lokalnih pubova i označene kao 'navike pijanke'. Ove žene stavljene su na gradski 'Crni popis', čime im je onemogućeno usluživanje u pubovima. Među njima je bila i Kate Kibble, poznata kao 'Jednooka Kate', jedna od 37 žena izbačenih 1902. godine. Alice Tatlow imala je tetovažu pera princa od Walesa na stopalu, a Mary Bayliss predstavljala je ugledno izgledajuće žene koje su također bile izbačene. Službenici su po pubovima u Birminghamu dijelili popis od 82 osobe—među njima i 37 žena—upozoravajući vlasnike da pripaze na njih. Na obavijestima su bile priložene fotografije i fizički opisi. Ti su zapisi nedavno otkriveni na ancestry.co.uk. Glasnogovornik te stranice objasnio je da je, radi provedbe Zakona o prodaji alkohola naviklim pijancima iz 1902., Watch Committee Birminghama davao licenciranim prodavačima pića fotografije i opise osoba označenih kao 'navikle pijanke' kako bi im bilo zabranjeno posluživanje. Mnoge osobe s popisa, poput Susannah Booton, bile su uhićene zbog javnog opijanja. Većina žena imala je između 30 i 40 godina. Elizabeth Thompson fotografirana je nakon uhićenja zbog pijančevanja na javnom mjestu. Između 1903. i 1906. svih 82 osobe osuđene su zbog pijančevanja, uglavnom pred Gradskim policijskim sudom Birminghama. Mnoge su imale tjelesne deformacije ili tetovaže i pritom su zadržale poslove, poput čistačica, sječačica drva, polirki ili prodavačica masti. Neke žene, poput Sarah Terese Evans i Ellen Heaton, opisane su kao impozantne. Annie Hodgkins (poznata i kao 'Hodgkiss') suočila se s optužbom za pijano i neposlušno ponašanje. Dok je Eliza Fallon bila nezaposlena, mnoge druge žene radile su razne poslove. Policija je dijelila plakate s njihovim fotografijama i opisima. Neke žene dodatno su zarađivale kao ulične izvođačice, a nekoliko ih je radilo kao prostitutke. Često su koristile pseudonime, što ukazuje na ponovljene prekršaje. Iako se danas javno opijanje često povezuje s mladima, samo su dvije žene imale manje od 25 godina, a pet više od 50. Primjerice, 46-godišnja Mary Bayliss i dalje je imala problema sa zakonom. Sarah Henson je bila krojačica i imala dodatne prihode. Elizabeth Thompson navodno je imala više lažnih imena. Susannah Booton i Sarah Evans bile su poznate po vidljivim tjelesnim oštećenjima ili zdravstvenim problemima. Ove fotografije snimljene su u sklopu provedbe zakona iz 1902. s ciljem smanjenja javnog pijančevanja.

article_content: A magnitude 5.6 earthquake struck northwestern Nepal just before midnight on Friday, November 3, 2023, killing more than 150 people and injuring dozens more. Officials reported that the death toll was expected to rise as rescuers searched remote Himalayan villages where communication was cut off. Earthquakes are common in mountainous Nepal. Here are some of the strongest recent earthquakes in the region: — July 29, 1980: At least 200 people died and thousands were injured when a 6.5 magnitude earthquake hit the Nepal-India border. — August 20, 1988: A 6.9 magnitude earthquake shook the capital Kathmandu, killing at least 1,000 people and injuring thousands more. — April 25, 2015: Nepal suffered its worst earthquake in history, a 7.8 magnitude event that killed around 9,000 people and damaged about 1 million structures. The previous deadliest earthquake was in 1934, which resulted in over 8,000 fatalities. — May 12, 2015: An aftershock of the April quake, among about two dozen, killed over 200 people and injured more than 2,000. — November 10, 2022: At least six people were killed after a 5.7 magnitude earthquake struck western Nepal. — November 3, 2023: A 5.6 magnitude earthquake hit northwestern Nepal, resulting in more than 150 deaths and dozens of injuries.

Dužnosnici su izvijestili da se očekuje porast broja žrtava dok spasilačke ekipe pretražuju udaljena himalajska sela gdje su komunikacije prekinute. Potresi su česti u planinskom Nepalu. Ovo su neki od najjačih potresa u regiji u posljednje vrijeme: — 29. srpnja 1980.: Najmanje 200 osoba je poginulo, a tisuće su ozlijeđene kada je potres magnitude 6,5 pogodio granicu Nepala i Indije. — 20. kolovoza 1988.: Potres magnitude 6,9 pogodio je glavni grad Kathmandu, usmrtivši najmanje 1.000 osoba i ozlijedivši tisuće drugih. — 25. travnja 2015.: Nepal je doživio najgori potres u svojoj povijesti, jačine 7,8, u kojem je poginulo oko 9.000 ljudi i oštećeno oko milijun objekata. Ranije je najsmrtonosniji potres bio 1934., s preko 8.000 smrtnih slučajeva. — 12. svibnja 2015.: Naknadni potres iz travnja, jedan od oko dvadesetak, usmrtio je više od 200 ljudi i ozlijedio više od 2.000. — 10. studenog 2022.: Najmanje šest osoba je poginulo nakon što je potres magnitude 5,7 pogodio zapadni Nepal. — 3. studenog 2023.: Potres magnitude 5,6 pogodio je sjeverozapadni Nepal, pri čemu je poginulo više od 150 ljudi i deseci su ozlijeđeni.

article_content: The Copa Sudamericana final remains evenly poised after Atletico Nacional and River Plate played to a 1-1 draw in the first leg in Medellin, Colombia, on Wednesday night. Atletico Nacional led in the 34th minute through Orlando Berrio, assisted by Edwin Cardona. River Plate equalized in the second half thanks to a well-struck goal by Leonardo Pisculichi, setting up an exciting second leg in Buenos Aires. Atanasio Girardot Stadium was packed with enthusiastic fans, with Atletico Nacional supporters creating a lively atmosphere with green smoke flares and firecrackers. Despite dominating much of the game, Nacional were held to a draw, and River Plate’s away goal leaves the contest evenly balanced. River Plate, who beat Boca Juniors in the semi-finals, and Nacional, who eliminated Sao Paulo, are both aiming for the title. The decisive second leg is scheduled for November 10 at Estadio Monumental Antonio Vespucio Liberti in Buenos Aires.

article_content: In a conservative town in southern Germany, Nils Pickert's young son faced ridicule for wearing dresses and skirts. Wanting to give his child the confidence to express himself, Pickert began wearing skirts himself as an act of solidarity. The family had once lived in Berlin's Kreuzberg district, where such choices attracted little attention. After relocating to a more traditional community, the boy became self-conscious and hesitated to wear dresses to nursery school. In response, Pickert started dressing similarly to show support and offer a positive role model. As Pickert described in an interview with the magazine Emma, their actions sparked local discussion, but most importantly, gave his son the courage to embrace his style. Not only does the boy now confidently choose his outfits—including painting his nails—but he also calmly responds to teasing, attributing his self-assurance to his father's example.

Nakon selidbe u tradicionalniju sredinu, dječak je postao nesiguran i oklijevao nositi haljine u vrtić. Kao odgovor, Pickert se odijevao slično kako bi pružio podršku i bio pozitivan uzor. U intervjuu za časopis Emma, Pickert je ispričao kako su njihove odluke izazvale rasprave u zajednici, ali najvažnije, dječaku su dale hrabrost da bude svoj. article_content: Nearly two decades ago, BioWare's journey into the 'Star Wars' universe began with a pivotal phone call from Simon Jeffery, then-president of LucasArts. The Canadian game studio was seeking its next major project when Jeffery proposed they create the first 'Star Wars' role-playing game. BioWare eagerly agreed, leading to the well-known 'Knights of the Old Republic' console games. This week marked the release of 'Star Wars: The Old Republic,' BioWare's most ambitious endeavor so far—a massive multiplayer online (MMO) game that builds on their longstanding relationship with LucasArts. In this game, players become Jedi, bounty hunters, and other legendary characters, experiencing adventures on various planets throughout the galaxy, set thousands of years before the original films. Ray Muzyka, BioWare’s co-founder and general manager, shared that LucasArts allowed the team to choose between developing stories around established film characters or exploring an earlier era. Opting for creative freedom, BioWare set out to create expansive worlds, filled with new stories, monsters, and treasures—supported by a cast of about 1,000 voice actors performing over 260,000 lines of dialogue. To build this enormous MMO, BioWare brought on experienced developers at its Austin, Texas studio. Muzyka compared it to making several console games alongside developing an online service. 'This is definitely the biggest game BioWare has ever made,' he remarked. Analysts estimate that EA, which acquired BioWare in 2007, invested between $100 million and $300 million in the project—making it the company’s largest game investment. EA cited BioWare's reputation from their earlier LucasArts collaborations as a key factor in the deal. Despite BioWare’s creative input, LucasArts still reviews and occasionally influences major concepts and designs. The release of 'The Old Republic' coincided with a growing MMO market, highlighted by the rise of 'World of Warcraft' and the recent closure of 'Star Wars Galaxies' servers. 'The Old Republic' adopts a familiar MMO subscription model: an initial $60 fee, followed by a $15 monthly payment (or slightly less for long-term plans). Developers say these fees support ongoing server operation and regular addition of new content—a new approach for BioWare. Now, BioWare relies on sophisticated analytics to track how players interact with the game, helping guide updates and future content. While some beta players have already reached the highest level, co-founder Greg Zeschuk emphasizes that updates will cater to all users, not just devoted fans. BioWare leaders are already planning to introduce new features and community-based content updates over time. The game’s initial launch was smooth, with stable servers during the early influx. The bigger question remains: can 'The Old Republic' maintain its success in the ever-changing 'Star Wars' gaming universe?

Kanadski studio je tražio svoj idući veliki projekt kad je Jeffery predložio izradu prve igre uloga na temu 'Star Warsa'. BioWare je rado prihvatio izazov, što je rezultiralo poznatom serijom konzolaških igara 'Knights of the Old Republic'. Ovaj tjedan stigla je 'Star Wars: The Old Republic', najambiciozniji BioWareov projekt dosad—masivna online igra za više igrača (MMO) koja nastavlja dugogodišnju suradnju s LucasArtsom. Igrači mogu postati Jedi, lovci na ucjene i drugi legendarni likovi, istražujući razne planete galaksije tisućama godina prije originalnih filmova. Ray Muzyka, suosnivač i generalni direktor BioWarea, kaže kako im je LucasArts dao izbor između razvoja priča o postojećim filmskim likovima ili istraživanja prijašnje ere. BioWare je izabrao više kreativne slobode i osmislio bogate svjetove, čudovišta i blaga—uz ekipu od oko 1.000 glasovnih glumaca koji su pročitali više od 260.000 rečenica. Za razvoj ove grandiozne MMO igre, BioWare je zaposlio iskusne developere u svom studiju u Austinu, Texas. Muzyka je proces usporedio s izradom nekoliko konzolaških igara i razvojem online platforme odjednom. 'Ovo je zasigurno najveća igra koju je BioWare ikad napravio', rekao je. Analitičari procjenjuju da je EA, koji je preuzeo BioWare 2007. godine, uložio između 100 i 300 milijuna dolara u ovaj projekt—što ga čini njihovim najvećim ulaganjem u igru. EA je naveo reputaciju BioWarea i prethodnu suradnju s LucasArtsom kao ključne razloge akvizicije. Premda BioWare ima značajnu kreativnu slobodu, LucasArts i dalje nadgledava i povremeno utječe na najveće koncepte i dizajn igre. Lansiranje 'The Old Republic' dogodilo se u vrijeme procvata MMO tržišta, posebno zahvaljujući usponu 'World of Warcrafta' i gašenju servera igre 'Star Wars Galaxies'. 'The Old Republic' koristi poznat MMO model pretplate: osnovna cijena iznosi 60 dolara, a mjesečna pretplata 15 dolara (ili nešto manje za dugoročnije pretplate). Tvorci naglašavaju da ti prihodi pokrivaju održavanje servera i stalna ažuriranja sadržaja—što je novost za BioWare. BioWare sada koristi naprednu analitiku igranja kako bi pratio ponašanje igrača i lakše razvijao nove nadogradnje. Iako su neki igrači iz beta perioda već dosegli najvišu razinu, suosnivač Greg Zeschuk naglašava da je cilj obuhvatiti sve korisnike, a ne samo one najposvećenije. BioWareovi čelnici već planiraju novi sadržaj i ažuriranja temeljena na povratnim informacijama zajednice. Igra je startala stabilno, s pouzdanim serverima tijekom prvog vala igrača. article_content: The finalists for this year's Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards have been announced, showcasing a selection of remarkable images whittled down from thousands of entries submitted by both professional and amateur photographers across the globe. Accompanying many of these photos are comments from the photographers themselves, providing insights into the moments they captured. The winners will be revealed on November 23. One photographer described a scene with western grey kangaroos in a field of yellow flowers: 'I noticed one kangaroo strike a comical pose — to me, it looked like he was practising on his air guitar.' Another image features a surprised swamp turtle appearing to smile at a dragonfly perched on its nose. While visiting Suffolk and making a detour to the RSPB's Minsmere reserve, a photographer observed an Egyptian goose flying towards a small island. Anticipating action, they focused on an avocet preparing to chase off the goose. A notable photo of a leopard displays its effort to leap into the air, as it was being pestered by three young cheetahs and showed clear irritation. A young chacma baboon is shown playfully riding on its mother's back, 'playing the fool.' Other featured moments include seals arriving from the North Sea in late autumn to give birth, a Masai Mara evening shot taken in low light, and the abundance of grizzly bears at Katmai National Park, which the photographer notes as a paradise for unique shots. In Ubud's monkey forest in Bali, a photographer captured the quirky antics of monkeys that rule the area. A scene from Bialowieza Forest highlights a young greenfinch still being fed by its parents, though occasional squabbles looked much like family arguments. At Westerfolds Park in Melbourne, a playful kangaroo joey is seen trying its hand at boxing in the morning sun. A cold winter in Spitsbergen set the stage for a shot of a white grouse striding toward the camera, resembling a snowball with eyes. A great grey owl in this series posed majestically for much of the afternoon, but was also captured in a comical, slouched pose as if asking, 'Is Monday over yet?' A polar bear cub in another photo found amusement in a piece of wood, suddenly standing up and playfully wielding it. At RSPB Bempton Cliffs, approximately half a million seabirds nest and raise their families each year from March to October. Gannets, who mate for life and return to the same nest annually, were captured in a moment of affection as they rubbed beaks and entwined necks. One image, not realized by the photographer until returning home, shows the gannets appearing as proud parents posing for a family portrait. All photographs are courtesy of the Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards 2023.
translated_content: Finalisti za Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards ove godine su najavljeni, prikazujući izvanredne fotografije odabrane među tisućama prijava profesionalnih i amaterskih fotografa iz cijelog svijeta. Uz mnoge od ovih fotografija dolaze i komentari samih fotografa, koji nude uvid u trenutke koje su uhvatili. Pobjednici će biti objavljeni 23. studenog. Jedan fotograf opisuje prizor s vestern sivim klokanjima u polju žutog cvijeća: 'Primijetio sam jednog klokana u smiješnoj pozi – izgledalo mi je kao da vježba sviranje zračne gitare.' Druga fotografija prikazuje iznenađenu močvarnu kornjaču koja se smiješi vretencu koje joj sjedi na nosu. Tijekom posjeta Suffolku i zaobilaska prema RSPB-ovom rezervatu Minsmere, fotograf je uočio egipatsku gusku kako slijeće na mali otočić. Predosjećajući akciju, fokusirao se na avgveta koji se spremao protjerati gusku. Jedna upečatljiva fotografija leoparda prikazuje njegov trud da skoči u zrak, dok ga gnjave tri mlada geparda, što jasno pokazuje iritaciju. Mladi babun vrste chacma prikazan je kako se razigrano vozi na leđima svoje majke, 'glumeći budalu.' Među ostalim trenucima su tuljani koji krajem jeseni dolaze iz Sjevernog mora kako bi rodili mlade, večernja fotografija iz Masai Mare snimljena pri slabom svjetlu i obilje mrkih medvjeda u nacionalnom parku Katmai – što fotograf vidi kao raj za jedinstvene kadrove. U šumskom rezervatu majmuna u Ubudu na Baliju, fotograf je zabilježio šaljive nestašluke majmuna koji tamo vladaju. Prizor iz šume Bialowieza prikazuje mladu zelendjevku koju još hrane roditelji, ali povremene prepirke podsjećaju na obiteljske svađe. U parku Westerfolds u Melbourneu, zaigrani mali klokan viđen je kako se ujutro okušava u boksanju na suncu. Hladna zima na Spitsbergenu bila je okruženje za fotografiju bijele ljetne koke (bijele jarebice), koja dolazi prema fotografu i podsjeća na snježnu grudu s očima. Sivi veliki ćuk iz ove serije većinu je poslijepodneva pozirao dostojanstveno, ali uhvaćen je i u smiješnoj, pogrbljenoj pozi kao da pita: 'Je li ponedjeljak konačno prošao?' Mlado mladunče polarnog medvjeda na drugoj fotografiji pronašlo je zabavu u komadiću drveta, naglo se uspravilo i počelo se igrati njime kao izvođač. Na liticama RSPB Bempton svake godine od ožujka do listopada gnijezdi se i odgaja obitelj oko pola milijuna morskih ptica. Gnjurci, koji biraju istog partnera za cijeli život i vraćaju se na isto gnijezdo iz godine u godinu, snimljeni su u trenutku nježnosti dok isprepliću vratove i trljaju kljunove. Jedna fotografija, koju je fotograf primijetio tek kod kuće, prikazuje gnjurce kao ponosne roditelje u obiteljskom portretu. Sve fotografije su ljubaznošću Comedy Wildlife Photography Awards 2023.

Chloe Smith's rapid promotion to Economic Secretary to the Treasury surprised many at Westminster. At 29, she became the youngest minister in the government. Some reports suggest Prime Minister David Cameron may have mistaken her for a chartered accountant when offering her the role.

Smith, who became MP for Norwich North in 2009, clarified to Cameron that she had been a management consultant at Deloitte, not an accountant. Despite this misunderstanding, Cameron finalized her appointment after the government reshuffle prompted by Liam Fox's resignation.

Some senior MPs, seeing parallels with Labour’s promotion of young women MPs, criticized Smith’s appointment and labeled it as more symbolic than substantive. However, supporters like Chancellor George Osborne and MP Elizabeth Truss commended Smith for her competence and energy. Smith expressed both surprise and pride in receiving the Prime Minister's trust. She won her Norwich North seat decisively following Dr Ian Gibson's resignation and kept it in the next general election.

Smith, koja je postala zastupnica Norwich North 2009. godine, objasnila je Cameronu da je radila kao konzultantica za upravljanje u Deloitteu, a ne kao računovotkinja. Unatoč toj zabuni, Cameron je potvrdio njezino imenovanje nakon rekonstrukcije vlade izazvane ostavkom Liama Foxa.

Neki iskusni zastupnici, gledajući paralelu s promocijama mladih zastupnica u Laburistima, kritizirali su Smithino imenovanje i nazvali ga više simboličnim nego stvarnim pomakom. Ipak, njezini podržavatelji, uključujući ministra financija Georgea Osbornea i zastupnicu Elizabeth Truss, istaknuli su njezinu stručnost i energiju. Smith je izjavila kako je bila iznenađena, ali i ponosna na povjerenje premijera. Svoj je mandat u Norwich Northu osvojila nakon ostavke dr. Iana Gibsona i potvrdila ga na sljedećim izborima.

article_content: Amazon Fire TV devices are among the best streaming products available. They’re reliable, user-friendly, and provide easy access to movies, TV shows, and sports with just a few button presses on the Fire TV remote. Occasionally, you may need to reset your Fire TV remote, which is a common issue but one that’s simple to resolve. There are several versions of the Amazon Fire TV remote, often called Alexa remotes. The following instructions work for the Alexa Voice Remote Pro, third-generation Fire TV remote, and second-generation Alexa Voice Remote Lite.  How to Reset Most Amazon Fire TV Remotes: 1. Unplug your Fire TV’s power cable and wait 1 minute. 2. Press and hold the Left button, Menu button (three lines), and Back button simultaneously for 12 seconds. 3. Release all three buttons and wait for 5 seconds. 4. Remove the batteries from the remote. 5. Plug the Fire TV device back in and let it reboot. 6. Once prompted for a remote, reinsert the batteries. 7. Press the Home button. If the remote light blinks blue, it’s ready. If not, hold the Home button for 10 seconds.  Alternate Method (button layout may vary): 1. Hold the Home button and, at the same time, press the Menu button three times. 2. Release the Home button. 3. Press the Menu button nine times. 4. Remove the batteries. 5. Unplug your Fire TV device and wait 60 seconds. 6. Replace the batteries and reconnect the Fire TV. 7. When the home screen appears, hold the Home button for 40 seconds.  Resetting the First-Generation Alexa Voice Remote: 1. Unplug your Fire TV device and wait 60 seconds. 2. Press and hold the Left and Menu buttons for 12 seconds. 3. Release the buttons and wait for five seconds. 4. Remove the batteries. 5. Plug the device back in. 6. When prompted, reinsert the batteries. 7. Press the Home button. If the remote is still not paired, hold the Home button for 10 seconds.  Resetting your Amazon Fire TV remote should only take a minute or two.

Povremeno ćete možda morati resetirati svoj Fire TV daljinski upravljač, što je čest problem, ali ga je vrlo lako riješiti. Postoji nekoliko verzija Amazon Fire TV daljinskog upravljača, često nazivanih Alexa daljinskim. Sljedeće upute vrijede za Alexa Voice Remote Pro, daljinski treće generacije i Alexa Voice Remote Lite druge generacije.  Kako resetirati većinu Amazon Fire TV daljinskih upravljača: 1. Isključite Fire TV iz napajanja i pričekajte 1 minutu. 2. Istovremeno pritisnite i držite gumbe Left (lijevo), Menu (izbornik – tri crte) i Back (natrag) 12 sekundi. 3. Otpustite sva tri gumba i pričekajte 5 sekundi. 4. Izvadite baterije iz daljinskog upravljača. 5. Ponovno priključite Fire TV i pustite da se pokrene. 6. Alternativna metoda (raspored tipki može varirati): 1. Držite pritisnut gumb Home i istovremeno pritisnite gumb Menu tri puta. 2. Otpustite gumb Home. 3. Pritisnite gumb Menu devet puta. 4. Izvadite baterije iz daljinskog. 5. Isključite Fire TV uređaj i pričekajte 60 sekundi. 6. Vratite baterije i ponovno priključite uređaj. 7. Kada se pojavi početni zaslon, držite gumb Home 40 sekundi.  Resetiranje Alexa Voice Remote prve generacije: 1. Isključite Fire TV uređaj iz napajanja i čekajte 60 sekundi. 2. Držite istovremeno pritisnute gumbe Left i Menu 12 sekundi. 3. Otpustite gumbe i čekajte pet sekundi. 4. Izvadite baterije. 5. Priključite uređaj nazad. 6. Kada sustav to zatraži, vratite baterije. 7. Pritisnite gumb Home. Ako i dalje nije uparen, držite gumb Home 10 sekundi.  Resetiranje vašeg Amazon Fire TV daljinskog traje svega minutu ili dvije.

article_content: Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke has approved the appointment of 309 individuals to various non-statutory boards and Local Government Education Boards across the state. The appointments, announced by his spokesperson Olawale Rasheed, are effective immediately. The appointees include chairmen, secretaries, and members for all Local Government Education Boards covering the state’s 30 Local Government Areas (LGAs) and area offices. The appointments also extend to the governing boards of all state-owned tertiary institutions, the Christian and Muslim Pilgrims Boards, Internal Revenue Service, and Council for Art and Culture, among others. Other appointees will serve on the State Universal Basic Education Board and the Local Government Service Commission Board. Governor Adeleke has urged the new members to uphold the rule of law, due process, and procurement regulations in their roles, and to contribute to Osun State’s development. Those appointed to the Osun State University Governing Council are Gbadeshin Lawal, Prof. David Oladeji, Tunji Omole, Olawale Oludayo, Hassan Adegoke, Prof. Aworemi, and Dr. Kamoru Kadiri. For the University of Ilesa, the members are Wale Olunloye, Prof. Rotimi Tayo, Prof. Adejumoke Adefisoye-Adelowo, Dr. Adetunji Dare, and Prof. Emmanuel Akande. Serving as board members for Osun State Polytechnic, Iree are Sunday Ogundiji, Adesoye Idowu, Hammed Adedoyin, Dr. David Ogunsade, Gbenga Olakolu, Sunday Adebiyi, Ademola Opadola, and Brig. Gen. Derin Awodele. The board of the College of Education, Ila includes Durosomo Ademola, Serifat Bakare, Musiliyu Adeyemi, Isiaq Olaniyan, Dare Ajimotokin, Esan Lawal, Lekan Obisakin, and Kamo Adekunle.

article_content: Standards of living in Britain have risen to among the best in Europe, despite Labour's claims of an ongoing ‘cost of living crisis’. Official figures show families in the UK now enjoy the sixth highest quality of life in the EU, tied with Denmark and France and ahead of Belgium and the Netherlands. This improvement follows a steady economic recovery since David Cameron became Prime Minister. Data from the Office for National Statistics (ONS), and the European statistics agency Eurostat, reveal that UK living standards have climbed since 2011, contradicting Labour's assertions that families remain in crisis. Last week, Shadow Chancellor Ed Balls claimed that 'for most people there is no recovery at all' and accused the government of lacking real action to raise living standards, describing Britain's economic upturn as 'the slowest recovery for over 100 years’. Labour leader Ed Miliband also accused Prime Minister Cameron of being ‘utterly complacent’ and ‘in denial’ about the rising cost of living, to which Cameron responded by highlighting Britain’s rapid economic growth among Western economies. Despite criticisms that the recovery is not benefiting ordinary families, Chancellor George Osborne stated that 'Britain’s economic plan is working' as economic growth forecasts have doubled. Eurostat’s data shows living standards have improved since 2011. Luxembourg ranks highest, followed by Germany, whose economy has benefited from the single currency. In 2011, Britain shared seventh place with Belgium, lagging behind France. However, since then, under French President Francois Hollande, France's living standards have stagnated, while Britain's have improved. The ONS notes that in 2012, the UK’s standard of living matched that of France and Denmark, up from the previous year. Their measurements include consumption of goods and services and benefits like free healthcare and education. UK living standards were 14% above the EU average, with the lowest rankings for Bulgaria and Romania. Norway and Sweden—outside the EU—also enjoy much higher living standards. The latest figures relate to 2012, but improvements are expected to continue as the economy recovers. The Office of Budget Responsibility recently increased its growth forecast for 2013 to 1.4% and for 2014 from 1.8% to 2.3%. Additionally, UK unemployment and inflation have declined. Ed Miliband has promised a freeze on energy prices if Labour wins the next election, a move criticized by industry experts as ‘economic vandalism’. In the recent Autumn Statement, the Chancellor maintained that Labour had been ‘comprehensively wrong’ to oppose austerity and projected the annual deficit will be eliminated by 2018. Separately, the pay gap between men and women has widened for the first time in five years, now standing at 10% compared to 9.5% the previous year, with full-time men earning £13.60 an hour on average versus £12.24 for women, according to the ONS.
translated_content: Životni standardi u Britaniji porasli su i među najvišima su u Europi, unatoč tvrdnjama Laburističke stranke o aktualnoj ‘krizi troškova života’. Službeni podaci pokazuju da britanske obitelji sada uživaju šestu najvišu kvalitetu života u EU, izjednačene s Danskom i Francuskom, ispred Belgije i Nizozemske. Ovo poboljšanje rezultat je stalnog gospodarskog oporavka otkad je David Cameron postao premijer. Podaci Ureda za nacionalnu statistiku (ONS) i europske statističke agencije Eurostat pokazuju da su životni standardi u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu porasli od 2011., suprotno tvrdnjama Laburista da su obitelji i dalje u krizi. Prošlog tjedna zamjenik ministra financija u sjeni Ed Balls izjavio je da ‘za većinu ljudi oporavka nema‘ te je optužio vladu za nedostatak stvarnih poteza za poboljšanje životnog standarda, opisavši ekonomski rast Britanije kao ‘najsporiji oporavak u posljednjih 100 godina’. Vođa Laburista Ed Miliband također je optužio premijera Camerona za ‘potpunu samozadovoljnost’ i ‘poricanje’ rasta troškova života, na što je Cameron odgovorio ističući brz ekonomski rast Britanije među zapadnim državama. Unatoč kritikama da oporavak ne koristi svim obiteljima, ministar financija George Osborne izjavio je da ‘britanski ekonomski plan funkcionira’ jer su prognoze rasta gospodarstva udvostručene. Eurostatovi podaci pokazuju da su životni standardi porasli od 2011. Luksemburg je na vrhu, a slijedi ga Njemačka, čije gospodarstvo koristi jedinstvenu valutu. Godine 2011. Velika Britanija dijelila je sedmo mjesto s Belgijom i zaostajala za Francuskom. Međutim, od tada, pod vodstvom francuskog predsjednika Francoisa Hollandea, životni standard u Francuskoj stagnira, dok britanski raste. ONS navodi da je 2012. britanski životni standard bio jednak Francuskoj i Danskoj, što je napredak u odnosu na prethodnu godinu. Mjeri se potrošnjom dobara i usluga te pogodnostima poput besplatnog zdravstva i obrazovanja. Britanska razina života 2012. bila je 14% iznad prosjeka EU, dok su na najnižim pozicijama Bugarska i Rumunjska. Norveška i Švedska, koje nisu članice EU, također imaju znatno viši životni standard. Najnoviji podaci odnose se na 2012., ali očekuje se daljnje poboljšanje kako se ekonomija oporavlja. Ured za proračunsku odgovornost nedavno je povisio prognozu rasta za 2013. na 1,4%, a za 2014. s 1,8% na 2,3%. Također, nezaposlenost i inflacija u Velikoj Britaniji su smanjeni. Ed Miliband obećao je zamrzavanje cijena energije ako Laburisti pobijede na sljedećim izborima, što su industrijski stručnjaci kritizirali kao ‘ekonomsku sabotažu’. U nedavnoj izjavi o proračunu, ministar financija rekao je da su Laburisti bili ‘potpuno u krivu’ što su se protivili štednji i predvidio da će godišnji deficit biti ukinut do 2018. Odvojeno, razlika u plaćama između muškaraca i žena prvi je put u pet godina porasla, sada iznosi 10% u odnosu na 9,5% godinu ranije, pri čemu muškarci radeći puno radno vrijeme u prosjeku zarađuju 13,60 £ po satu, a žene 12,24 £, prema ONS-u.

article_content: Sandis Ozolins, a former Soviet soldier, assumed a new leadership role at the Sochi Olympics—this time as Latvia’s flag bearer, carrying an ice hockey stick rather than a weapon. At 41, Ozolins not only represents his country but also brings memories of his championship days in the NHL, including a Stanley Cup victory. Ozolins’ journey to hockey stardom began unexpectedly. While serving in the Soviet army in 1991, he discovered via a newspaper that he’d been drafted by the San Jose Sharks—unfamiliar with the concept of a draft or where San Jose was. This surprise ignited a career that went well beyond what he imagined. Over 15 years in the NHL, Ozolins played 875 games, scored 167 goals, tallied 397 assists, and appeared in seven All-Star Games. His pinnacle was helping the Colorado Avalanche win the 1996 Stanley Cup, sweeping the Florida Panthers in the finals. Though his winner’s ring is now lost, the memory remains clear. There were difficulties, too. The Avalanche lost the next year’s conference final, and subsequent trades to teams like the Carolina Hurricanes—where he signed a $25 million contract—Florida Panthers, Anaheim Ducks, and New York Rangers brought a mix of success and struggles. Injury and personal problems, including a DUI and entrance into the NHL’s substance abuse program, challenged his career. After taking a year off and declining an offer from the LA Kings, Ozolins returned to Latvia to play for Dinamo Riga (KHL). What began as retirement turned into a new chapter, as he found the motivation to compete at a high level in his homeland. Now in Sochi, proudly carrying the Latvian flag, Ozolins relishes what could be his last international appearance. Despite Latvia’s long-shot medal hopes, he sees this as a crowning moment, fueled by national pride and the unique Olympic atmosphere. Whether sharing meals with other athletes or skating on the Olympic ice, Ozolins values his role as a veteran leader and symbol of Latvian sports.

Sa 41 godinom, Ozoliņš ne predstavlja samo svoju zemlju, već donosi i sjećanja na šampionske dane u NHL-u, uključujući osvajanje Stanleyjeva kupa. Ozoliņšev put do hokejaške slave započeo je neočekivano. Tijekom služenja u sovjetskoj vojsci 1991. godine, iz novina je doznao da ga je draftirala NHL momčad San Jose Sharks – nije znao što je draft niti gdje je San Jose. Ovo iznenađenje pokrenulo je karijeru koja je nadmašila sva njegova očekivanja. Tijekom 15 godina u NHL-u, Ozoliņš je odigrao 875 utakmica, postigao 167 golova, upisao 397 asistencija i nastupio na sedam All-Star utakmica. Vrhunac mu je bilo osvajanje Stanley Cupa s Colorado Avalancheom 1996., kada su uvjerljivo pobijedili Florida Pantherse u velikom finalu. Iako je pobjednički prsten nestao, uspomene su i dalje svježe. Bilo je i izazova. Avalanche su iduće godine izgubili u finalu konferencije, a nakon toga su uslijedili transferi u klubove poput Carolina Hurricanes (gdje je potpisao ugovor vrijedan 25 milijuna dolara), Florida Panthers, Anaheim Ducks i New York Rangers, s mješovitim uspjesima i poteškoćama. Ozljede i osobni problemi, uključujući vožnju pod utjecajem i ulazak u NHL-ov program za zlouporabu supstanci, obilježili su njegovu karijeru. Nakon što je godinu dana pauzirao i odbio ugovor s LA Kingsima, Ozoliņš se vratio kući i priključio Dinamu Riga (KHL). Umjesto kraja, to je bio novi početak, jer je pronašao motivaciju da ponovno igra na visokoj razini u domovini. Sada u Sočiju, ponosno noseći latvijsku zastavu, Ozoliņš uživa u svom možda posljednjem nastupu na međunarodnoj sceni. Iako Latvija nije favorit za medalju, on ovo vidi kao vrhunac svoje sportske priče, vođen nacionalnim ponosom i posebnim olimpijskim duhom. Bilo dijeleći stol s ostalim sportašima ili klizeći na olimpijskom ledu, Ozoliņš je postao simbol latvijskog sporta i iskusni vođa.

article_content: Burger King is responding to McDonald's latest chicken menu expansion by launching its own value-focused item: the French Fry Burger, which will be available for $1 starting September 1 and through the fall. This announcement comes just a day after McDonald's revealed its new 'Mighty Wings'—bone-in chicken wings sold in packs of three, five, or ten pieces, starting at $2.99. These wings will be served with nine sauces, including Chipotle Barbecue, Spicy Buffalo, and Tangy Barbecue, and will be available nationwide as a limited-time offer through November. Burger King's new burger features a standard beef patty topped with four of the chain's french fries, totaling 360 calories and 19 grams of fat. This menu addition is aimed at budget-conscious customers and does not require new ingredients. The move highlights the heightened competition among fast food chains to win customers by emphasizing value and lower prices. McDonald's recently bolstered its Dollar Menu, now featuring items like the Grilled Onion Cheddar Burger and the McDouble, with two beef patties and a slice of cheese. As a result, competitors like Burger King and Wendy's have shifted strategies to highlight more affordable menu items. Earlier this year, Burger King introduced deals such as any two sandwiches for $5 and a Junior Whopper for $1.29. It remains uncertain if these value-focused tactics will lead to sustained profit growth for the chains. In the latest quarter, Burger King's same-store sales in North America slipped by 0.5%, while Wendy's reported a 0.4% rise, and McDonald's reported a 1% increase at U.S. restaurants. In contrast, Chipotle saw a 3.4% sales increase, and Starbucks reported a 9% gain in the same period. These figures measure sales performance at locations open at least a year, excluding newly opened and closed stores.

Ova najava dolazi samo dan nakon što je McDonald's predstavio 'Mighty Wings'—pileća krilca s kostima koja se prodaju u porcijama od tri, pet ili deset komada, po početnoj cijeni od 2,99 dolara. Krilca će dolaziti s devet različitih umaka, uključujući Chipotle BBQ, Spicy Buffalo i Tangy BBQ, a dostupna su diljem zemlje kao vremenski ograničena ponuda do studenoga. Novi burger iz Burger Kinga sastoji se od standardne pljeskavice na koju su dodana četiri poznata krumpirića lanca, ukupno sadržeći 360 kalorija i 19 grama masti. Ova stavka menija namijenjena je kupcima koji paze na cijenu i ne zahtijeva uvođenje novih sastojaka. Ovaj potez naglašava pojačanu konkurenciju među lancima brze hrane koji pokušavaju osvojiti goste isticanjem povoljne ponude i niskih cijena. McDonald's je nedavno pojačao svoj Dollar Menu, na kojem se sada nalaze primjerice Grilled Onion Cheddar Burger i McDouble, koji uključuje dvije juneće pljeskavice i krišku sira. Kao odgovor su konkurenti poput Burger Kinga i Wendy'sa također prilagodili svoje strategije kako bi naglasili povoljnije stavke na jelovniku. Tako je Burger King ranije ove godine uveo ponude poput bilo koja dva sendviča za 5 dolara i Junior Whopper za 1,29 dolara. Još uvijek nije jasno hoće li ovakve strategije dugoročno dovesti do rasta profita za lance. U posljednjem tromjesečju, prodaja Burger Kinga u restoranima otvorenima najmanje godinu dana u Sjevernoj Americi pala je za 0,5 %, Wendy’s je imao rast od 0,4 %, a McDonald’s je zabilježio povećanje od 1 % u američkim restoranima. Za usporedbu, Chipotle je ostvario rast od 3,4 %, a Starbucks porast od 9 % u istom razdoblju. Ove brojke odnose se samo na prostore koji posluju dulje od godinu dana, bez novih i zatvorenih restorana.

article_content: Mario Balotelli continues to draw attention for his unpredictable behavior both on and off the field, raising concern at Manchester City. In the past two weeks, the striker has interrupted a press conference, argued with teammates, and crashed his Bentley. These incidents have left manager Roberto Mancini clearly frustrated. When asked about a reported locker room altercation between Balotelli and Kolo Toure, Mancini expressed empathy for his squad's frustration: 'I understand them. I told him, if you played with me 10 years ago, I would have given you a punch in the head every day,' Mancini joked before the important match against Arsenal. Mancini said that while Balotelli performs well in big games, his main issue is maintaining focus. 'I work with him every day. I don't speak with him every day—otherwise, I would need a psychologist—but every couple of days, I do,' he said. This frank discussion is one of Mancini's most open about the challenges Balotelli presents. Earlier this season, Balotelli caused serious damage by setting off fireworks in his home bathroom. The controversy continued when Balotelli interrupted the inaugural press conference for Inter Milan coach Andrea Stramaccioni, as Stramaccioni was introduced as Claudio Ranieri's replacement. Soon after, Balotelli was reportedly involved in a dispute with Yaya Toure during Manchester City's 3-3 draw with Sunderland, a game in which he scored twice yet still faced criticism. He also disagreed with Aleksandar Kolarov over a free-kick during that same match. Mancini played down these incidents, commenting, 'What happened with Kolarov on the pitch is the sort of thing that can occur during difficult moments. It wasn't ideal, but it's understandable. Everything was resolved after the game.' On Thursday, Balotelli was involved in a car crash in Manchester's city center. He was unharmed, but a passenger from another car was taken to the hospital as a precaution, according to police. With Balotelli's controversial behavior continuing to generate headlines, Mancini faces pressure to settle locker room tensions and concerns about special treatment. Nevertheless, Mancini has avoided fully condemning the talented but unpredictable 21-year-old. 'When you have someone like Mario, you shouldn't criticize him in public—he's your teammate. If you have something to say, say it to his face,' Mancini stated. 'Mario is young; he makes mistakes and has faced consequences. I understand the players' frustration, but there are other ways to help someone like him.'

article_content: Wood-fired heating sources are becoming increasingly popular in the UK to reduce heating costs, with around 200,000 stoves installed each year. These stoves are highly sought after among Britons hoping to lower their energy bills. Estate agents note that installing a wood-burning stove can add up to 5 percent to a home's value. They are often viewed as environmentally friendly since the carbon dioxide released by burning wood is absorbed by growing trees, making the fuel potentially carbon neutral. For this reason, homeowners may be eligible for government subsidies when they install wood-fired boilers. However, scientists warn that wood-burning stoves contribute to air pollution. Research from King's College London indicates that levels of certain harmful particulates increase during winter, particularly when stoves and open fires are used. In some British cities, wood-burning contributes up to 13 percent of airborne particulates during winter evenings. In localized hotspots, pollution from wood stoves can be similar to that from traffic. Dr. Gary Fuller of King's College London explained that while wood is often considered environmentally friendly, there is growing evidence of health risks associated with wood smoke, including higher chances of heart disease, asthma attacks, and reduced life expectancy. Dr. Fuller pointed out that because domestic wood burning typically occurs in residential areas, often during calm night-time conditions, even moderate use can expose people to particulates at levels similar to those caused by traffic. The Stove Industry Alliance, representing stove manufacturers, argues that modern wood stoves are cleaner and more efficient than older models. Deputy chairman Hugh Wells says current stoves emit about 14 milligrams of particulates per cubic meter of air, compared to 100 milligrams five years ago. He describes wood-burning stoves as a genuinely green and carbon-neutral way of heating homes, offering savings and reduced dependence on large energy companies. The Department of Energy and Climate Change maintains that wood heating technology has a significant role to play in transforming how homes are heated. Regardless, scientists stress that urban air emissions must be managed so that increased wood burning does not undermine the benefits of reduced traffic pollution.

One se često smatraju ekološki prihvatljivima jer ugljikov dioksid koji se oslobađa izgaranjem drva apsorbiraju rastuća stabla, što ovaj izvor energije potencijalno čini ugljično neutralnim. Zbog toga vlasnici kuća mogu imati pravo na državne subvencije prilikom ugradnje kotlova na drva. Međutim, znanstvenici upozoravaju da peći na drva doprinose onečišćenju zraka. Dr. Gary Fuller s King's Collegea u Londonu objasnio je da, iako se drvo često smatra ekološki prihvatljivim, postoje sve veći dokazi o zdravstvenim rizicima povezanim s dimom iz drva, uključujući veće šanse za srčane bolesti, napade astme i skraćenje životnog vijeka. Dr. Fuller ističe da su kućna ložišta uglavnom u stambenim područjima i često tijekom mirnih noćnih sati, pa čak i umjerena upotreba može ljude izložiti česticama na razini sličnoj prometu. Opisuje peći na drva kao zaista zelenu i ugljično neutralnu opciju grijanja doma, koja donosi uštede i smanjuje ovisnost o velikim energetskim kompanijama. Volker Kauder, a senior ally to German Chancellor Angela Merkel, has urged Britain to play a more supportive role in addressing the eurozone crisis, criticizing the UK for focusing solely on its own interests. Kauder emphasized that although Britain is outside the single currency, it still has a duty to contribute to Europe's stability.

He further stated that the UK should not have the power to block a proposed European Union financial transactions tax, a policy that could significantly impact the City of London’s financial sector. Kauder noted that many European countries are now adopting economic strategies associated with Merkel’s leadership, commenting that 'Europe is speaking German' to reflect this alignment.

His remarks have provoked strong reactions among British Conservative politicians. Eurosceptic MP Philip Hollobone warned that Germany’s approach could lead to excessive centralization of power in Europe, potentially threatening British national interests. The ongoing eurozone economic turmoil has heightened such anxieties, with Italy’s borrowing costs remaining above 7%, Spain facing difficulties in securing funding at high interest, and prior bailouts being issued for Ireland, Portugal, and Greece.

At the same time, Deputy Prime Minister Nick Clegg criticized Prime Minister David Cameron’s claim that the crisis gave Britain a chance to reclaim powers from Brussels. Speaking at the CDU’s congress in Leipzig, Kauder reiterated his call for stricter debt control and deeper economic integration across the EU, framing Germany as a key driver of the bloc’s response to its financial challenges.

Kauder je naglasio kako, iako Britanija nije dio eurozone, ima odgovornost pridonijeti stabilnosti Europe.

Također je izjavio da UK ne bi smjela moći blokirati predloženi europski porez na financijske transakcije, mjeru koja bi znatno utjecala na londonski financijski sektor. Kauder je napomenuo da brojne europske države sad prihvaćaju gospodarske mjere za koje se zalaže Merkel, ističući kako 'Europa govori njemački' kao opis te usklađenosti.

Njegove izjave izazvale su burne reakcije među britanskim konzervativcima. Euroskeptični zastupnik Philip Hollobone upozorio je da bi njemački pristup mogao dovesti do prevelike centralizacije moći u Europi, što bi moglo ugroziti britanske nacionalne interese. Dugotrajna ekonomska previranja u eurozoni dodatno su pojačala te strahove—Italija ima kamatne stope iznad 7%, Španjolska se teško zadužuje uz visoku cijenu, a Irska, Portugal i Grčka su prethodno već primili pomoć.

U isto vrijeme, zamjenik premijera Nick Clegg kritizirao je tvrdnju premijera Davida Camerona da trenutna kriza pruža priliku Britaniji za povrat ovlasti iz Bruxellesa. Govoreći na CDU kongresu u Leipzigu, Kauder je ponovo pozvao na strožu kontrolu duga i dublju gospodarsku integraciju zemalja EU-a, predstavljajući Njemačku kao ključnog vođu europske reakcije na financijske izazove.

article_content: Donald Trump’s legal team will begin presenting defense witnesses as the New York civil fraud trial against the former president resumes on Monday. First on the stand is Donald Trump Jr., returning to testify just two weeks after being questioned by state lawyers. Trump Jr., executive vice president of the Trump Organization, previously testified on November 1 and 2, stating he had no direct role in compiling the financial statements at the center of Attorney General Letitia James’s lawsuit. James alleges that Trump, his company, and executives, including his sons, significantly overstated Trump’s wealth, providing these estimates to banks and insurers for better loan and deal conditions. The Attorney General seeks more than $300 million and aims to prohibit the Trumps from conducting business in New York. Prior to trial, Judge Arthur Engoron found that Trump had committed fraud by inflating asset values and his net worth in financial disclosures, initially imposing penalties that could impact properties like Trump Tower. However, Trump currently remains in control pending appeal. The Trumps deny any wrongdoing. Their attorneys argue the prosecution has not met the required legal standards and believe the case is politically motivated. State prosecutors concluded their case after six weeks of witness testimony from insiders, accountants, bankers, and former Trump lawyer Michael Cohen. A defense motion to end the trial early was rejected, so proceedings continue as planned. After his previous testimony, Trump Jr. claimed the suit was intended to damage his father’s prospects in the 2024 presidential race, reiterating that, acting as trustee for his father’s assets while in office, he depended on outside accountants and chief financial officer Allen Weisselberg for the accuracy of statements. Trump Jr. emphasized he did not participate directly in preparing the documents. This week, Trump Jr. is due to be questioned by both his defense and state attorneys. Additional defense witnesses, including a tax lawyer and various experts, will also testify, aiming to counter the state’s argument that Trump’s statements allowed for more favorable lending and insurance terms. Trump Jr. maintains that as trustee, he relied on the judgment of financial professionals and was not personally involved in creating his father’s financial statements, signing them only after receiving assurances of their accuracy.

article_content: The long-anticipated meeting between Martha Levinson and Dowager Countess Violet finally took place in Downton Abbey’s new series. As Lady Mary and Matthew Crawley’s wedding approached, the encounters between Martha and Violet were memorable, filled with witty exchanges. Across dinner tables and in church pews, they faced off with clever remarks rather than hostility. Martha, played by Shirley MacLaine, made her entrance as Lady Grantham’s American mother, eager to comment on British traditions and promote her own New World values. She brings humor and contrast, regularly questioning English customs and requesting boiled water and goat’s milk. Meanwhile, Violet, played by Maggie Smith, delivers equally sharp comebacks. Lord Grantham faces trouble, as his investments have failed and the family fortune is lost. He’s forced to travel to London and confront the reality that much of his wife Cora’s fortune, invested in the Canadian Grand Trunk Line, has disappeared. Despite the setback, Cora remains surprisingly calm and supportive. Edith continues to navigate her role as the often overlooked sister, setting her sights on Sir Anthony Strallan. She is depicted as bright but single, and there is uncertainty about her romantic future. Branson, the former chauffeur now married to Lady Sybil, is back amidst tension. His outspoken views on Ireland create friction, prompting concern from Sybil and other family members. His presence at Downton remains contentious due to his background and political opinions. Elsewhere, Mr. Bates is still imprisoned, and Mr. Carson reminds everyone of his difficult circumstances. The episode is lauded for reintroducing viewers to the characters and offering a blend of drama, humor, and reminders of previous plot points. It ends with Lady Mary about to marry Matthew, but uncertainty remains regarding their future. Tender moments between them suggest hope, while unresolved plotlines—such as financial woes and inheritance questions—linger as the series continues.

article_content: General Motors (GM) has withdrawn an advertisement for the Chevrolet Trax SUV following accusations that its jingle contained racist language referencing Chinese stereotypes. The commercial, which referred to China as 'the land of Fu Manchu' and included lyrics such as 'ching-ching, chop suey,' was criticized for being offensive. The advert aired in Canada starting in April and was also posted on Chevrolet’s European website before being removed. About a week ago, the commercial disappeared from Canadian TV and was replaced with a version that excluded the controversial lyrics. A GM spokesperson stated that the decision was made in response to negative feedback: 'Once the issue was brought to our attention, GM immediately removed the offensive content from the commercial. Our aim is to engage audiences positively, and it was never our intention to offend.' The advert, titled 'After Midnight,' featured the song 'Booty Swing' by Austrian musician Parov Stelar, with adapted lyrics that sparked the controversy. The Chevrolet Trax is being launched in various markets worldwide, excluding the United States. The model is already available in South Korea and is set for release in Europe and Canada. Last month, GM announced plans to launch 17 new or updated models in China, the world’s largest car market, aiming to expand in the country’s luxury auto segment.

article_content: By Daniel Mills. A rarely seen Megamouth shark was recently displayed to the public in Shizuoka, Japan. The specimen, nearly four meters long, was brought up from a depth of about 800 meters. More than 1,500 people attended a public autopsy at the city's Marine Science Museum, giving scientists and onlookers a closer look at this unusual species. Though still mysterious to scientists, the Megamouth shark is known for its large size and distinctive appearance. Experts estimate these sharks can grow up to five meters in length and typically inhabit deep waters, coming closer to the surface at night to feed. This event marks only the 58th recorded sighting of a Megamouth shark, and the 13th caught in Japan. The first was discovered off Hawaii when it became entangled in a research vessel's anchor at 165 meters. The Museum of Western Australia houses a specimen found washed ashore in 1988. The Megamouth shark's diet consists mainly of shrimp-like krill and planktonic animals—including euphausiid shrimps, copepods, and Pancake Jellyfish—which it filters through its gills. Around one quarter of the 58 reported sightings involved specimens caught by fishermen for human consumption. The Discovery Channel has featured the Megamouth shark during its 'Shark Week' series, calling it an 'alien shark.'

Više od 1.500 ljudi prisustvovalo je javnoj autopsiji u Gradskom muzeju morske znanosti, dajući znanstvenicima i promatračima priliku da bolje upoznaju ovu neobičnu vrstu. Iako je još uvijek zagonetka znanstvenicima, megausta ajkula poznata je po svojoj veličini i neobičnom izgledu. Officials have stated that a deadly train collision in Andhra Pradesh’s Vizianagaram district was the result of human error, leading to at least 14 deaths and nearly 50 injuries. The incident occurred when a passenger train ran past a signal between Alamanda and Kantakapalle, hitting a stationary train, which caused three cars to derail, according to senior railway officer Saurabh Prasad.

Rescue efforts have ended, and authorities are now focused on restoring the railway tracks. Prime Minister Narendra Modi, addressing the public on social media, assured that help is being given to the victims, and that he has spoken with Railway Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw to monitor the response. The Ministry of Railways has announced cancellations and diversions of train services following the crash.

Train accidents are common in India due to human mistakes or outdated signaling infrastructure. The country’s rail network covers 64,000 kilometers and transports over 12 million people each day. A more severe accident in June this year led to the deaths of at least 288 people.

Nesreća se dogodila kada je putnički vlak prošao signal između Alamande i Kantakapallea i udario u nepomični vlak, zbog čega su tri vagona iskočila iz tračnica, prema riječima višeg željezničkog dužnosnika Saurabha Prasada.

Spasilački napori su završeni, a vlasti sada rade na obnovi pruge. Premijer Narendra Modi je preko društvenih mreža poručio da se žrtvama pruža pomoć te da je u kontaktu s ministrom željeznica Ashwinijem Vaishnawom radi praćenja situacije. article_content: Hailing a taxi in New York City is often a feat in itself, but for John Belitsky and his friend Dan Wuebben, their cab adventure went far beyond city limits. The two friends decided to hire a taxi to take them from New York City to Los Angeles, offering $5,000 for the trip. John’s father, a former taxi driver, was doubtful about the journey, but that didn’t stop them. With the help of Mohammed Alam, a Bangladeshi-born New York City cab driver, they embarked on the six-day, 3,000-mile journey. Alam left behind a tearful family for the chance to be part of this remarkable road trip, battling exhaustion and homesickness along the way. Despite his fatigue and the personal sacrifices, Alam pressed on, even refusing to let the passengers drive in his place due to licensing rules. Throughout their travels, the trio documented their experiences on Twitter and with video, sharing updates from each state they crossed—from Pennsylvania and Ohio, through Chicago and Omaha, and onward to the Grand Canyon. In Omaha, Alam briefly considered quitting due to exhaustion, but after a rest and encouragement from the others, he continued. The journey through the Rocky Mountains was challenging, but their spirits lifted as they neared California. By the time they reached Los Angeles, the excitement was palpable. Wuebben tweeted as they hit LA traffic, and Belitsky chronicled their success online. While the two friends enjoyed the trip as both a daring adventure and as a tribute to Belitsky’s father, for Alam, it was about more than just money—he saw it as a chance to set a record and create lasting memories. Ultimately, the trip was a test of perseverance and camaraderie—an adventure none of the participants would forget.

Dvojica prijatelja odlučili su iznajmiti taksi kako bi stigli od New Yorka do Los Angelesa, ponudivši 5.000 dolara za vožnju. Johnov otac, bivši taksist, sumnjao je u ovaj podvig, ali to ih nije zaustavilo. Uz pomoć Mohammeda Alama, taksista iz New Yorka podrijetlom iz Bangladeša, krenuli su na šesto-dnevno putovanje dugo 4.800 kilometara. Alam je ostavio svoju uplakanu obitelj kako bi imao priliku sudjelovati u ovom iznimnom putovanju, boreći se pritom s iscrpljenošću i čežnjom za domom. Unatoč umoru i osobnim žrtvama, Alam je nastavio voziti, čak nije dopustio putnicima da ga zamijene za volanom zbog pravila o licenciranju. Tijekom putovanja, trojac je na Twitteru i videozapisima bilježio svoja iskustva, dijeleći trenutke iz svake američke savezne države koju su prošli – od Pennsylvanije i Ohija, kroz Chicago i Omahu, pa do Grand Canyona. U Omahi, Alam je na trenutak razmišljao o odustajanju zbog iscrpljenosti, ali je nakon odmora i poticaja prijatelja nastavio dalje. Vožnja kroz Rocky Mountains bila je izazovna, ali su im se raspoloženje i entuzijazam vratili kako su se približavali Kaliforniji. Kad su napokon stigli u Los Angeles, uzbuđenje je bilo očito. Wuebben je tvitao dok su zapeli u prometu, a Belitsky je na internetu bilježio njihov uspjeh. Dok su dvojica prijatelja put doživjeli kao hrabru avanturu i posvetu Belitskyjevom ocu, za Alama je ovo bilo više od novca—bila je to prilika za postavljanje rekorda i stvaranje nezaboravnih uspomena. Na kraju, ovo je bilo putovanje izdržljivosti i prijateljstva—avantura na koju nitko od sudionika neće zaboraviti.

article_content: Tata Technologies’ initial public offering (IPO) was subscribed 14.85 times by the end of the second day of bidding, signaling robust investor demand. The retail segment was subscribed 11 times, while non-institutional investors (NIIs) and qualified institutional buyers (QIBs) subscribed 31 and 8.5 times, respectively. The IPO closes tomorrow. The Tata Group company, launching its first IPO in two decades, aims to raise Rs 3,042 crore through this offering. In just 40 minutes of opening, the IPO was fully subscribed, driven by heavy participation from large institutional investors. This public issue is an Offer for Sale (OFS) of 65,850,278 shares, with Tata Motors and co-investors Alpha TC Holdings and Tata Capital Growth Fund-I selling stakes. The allocation for QIBs was subscribed about 2 times, non-institutional investors 1.25 times, Tata Motors shareholders 1.26 times, and the retail portion 86%. Tata Technologies is a specialized engineering research and development company focused primarily on the automotive sector. The company counts 7 of the top 10 global automotive ER&D spenders and 5 of the 10 new energy ER&D leaders among its clients. Airbus recently included Tata Technologies as a preferred partner, offering further growth prospects. Grey market activity predicts a listing premium of around 70%. Brokerages suggest subscribing to the IPO for both initial gains and long-term investment. Anand Rathi notes that at its upper price band, the company is valued at a price-to-earnings ratio of 32.5x with a post-issue market capitalization of Rs 20,283 crore and a return on net worth of 20.8%. They consider the valuation fair and recommend subscribing for the long term. Following the IPO, Tata Motors’ shareholding in Tata Technologies will decrease from 64.79% to 53.39%. Valuation comparisons indicate Tata Technologies is less expensive than peers such as LTTS, Tata Elxsi, KPIT, and Cyient, based on FY23 earnings multiples. SBI Securities highlights Tata Technologies’ ability to capitalize on engineering R&D opportunities due to its competitive valuation. The company has progressively reduced its dependence on anchor clients Tata Motors and JLR, with their contribution to revenues declining to 46% in H1FY24 from 54.4% in FY20. Expansion to other original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and new energy companies, such as VinFast, supports client diversification. Tata Technologies’ revenue and profit after tax (PAT) have risen at CAGRs of 36% and 62% respectively over FY21–FY23, with H1FY24 showing 34% YoY revenue growth and 36% YoY PAT growth. The IPO remains open for subscription until November 24. Brokerage recommendations and market speculation are based on their own analysis. These views do not represent The Economic Times’ official position.

article_content: Recreating one of music’s most legendary concerts is an act of remarkable artistic bravery. Cat Power, born Chan Marshall, demonstrates this courage on her latest live album: a faithful recreation of Bob Dylan’s iconic 1966 performance. Recorded last November at Manchester Free Trade Hall—the original venue—Cat Power Sings Dylan: The 1966 Royal Albert Hall Concert captures every aspect of that historic night, right down to the audience member who famously shouted “Judas.” Marshall, reflecting on her motivations and artistic journey, shares that Dylan’s songs—though written decades ago—retain striking relevance today, especially in a world troubled by conflict and injustice. She recounts the serendipity of performing on Guy Fawkes Day at such an iconic venue, and describes her approach as rooted not in academic training but in lived experience. During their conversation, Steve Baltin and Marshall discuss the nuances of interpreting Dylan’s work. Marshall highlights how she brings her own harmonies and interpretations to the music, resulting in a performance that, while honoring the original, bears her unique signature. Performing these songs felt deeply personal, she explains, and evoked a sense of fun and collective nostalgia with each audience. Marshall reveals that certain songs presented more emotional challenges than others: “Mr. Tambourine Man,” for example, carried a weight of memories and responsibility. After her performance, fellow musician Thurston Moore told her the rendition moved him to tears—a meaningful validation for her. For Marshall, affecting listeners deeply is the ultimate reward. On the subject of Dylan himself, Marshall recounts several personal anecdotes, noting that while she’s often tried to connect with him, they’ve only exchanged brief greetings. She is clear, however, that she doesn’t seek permission or validation from Dylan for the project, yet senses he is aware and attentive to her work. Marshall also reflects on motherhood, describing her eight-year-old son’s passion for math and sports. She shares a humorous story about explaining her work to him, including his curiosity about whether Bob Dylan and Iggy Pop are friends. His questions reveal the fresh, innocent perspective children bring, offering another layer of joy to her journey. Overall, the interview paints a portrait of Cat Power as a thoughtful, committed artist who finds inspiration in the past, connection in the present, and humor in her everyday life.

Cat Power, pravog imena Chan Marshall, pokazuje tu hrabrost na svom najnovijem live albumu: vjernoj rekreaciji legendarnog nastupa Boba Dylana iz 1966. godine. Album je snimljen prošlog studenog u Manchester Free Trade Hallu—izvornom mjestu događanja—i Cat Power Sings Dylan: The 1966 Royal Albert Hall Concert bilježi svaki aspekt te povijesne večeri, uključujući i čuvenog gledatelja koji je povikao “Judas”. Marshall, osvrćući se na svoje motive i umjetnički put, ističe kako Dylanove pjesme—iako napisane prije desetljeća—imaju iznenađujuću aktualnost i danas, posebno u svijetu punom sukoba i nepravde. Priča o slučajnosti nastupa na Dan Guya Fawkesa na tako kultnom mjestu i opisuje svoj pristup kao onaj koji se temelji na životnom iskustvu, a ne formalnom obrazovanju. U razgovoru sa Steveom Baltinom, Marshall istražuje nijanse interpretacije Dylanovih pjesama. Naglašava kako u glazbu unosi vlastite harmonije i interpretacije, pa izvedba, iako ostaje vjerna originalu, nosi njezin jedinstveni pečat. Izvodi su joj bili duboko osobni te su pobudili osjećaj zabave i zajedničke nostalgije s publikom. Marshall otkriva kako su joj neke pjesme bile emocionalno zahtjevnije od drugih: primjerice, “Mr. Tambourine Man” nosila je težinu uspomena i odgovornosti. Nakon nastupa, kolega glazbenik Thurston Moore rekao joj je da ga je izvedba rasplakala—što je za Marshall bila posebna potvrda vrijednosti izvedbe. Njezina najveća nagrada je kada duboko dirne publiku. Na temu samog Dylana, Marshall prepričava nekoliko osobnih anegdota, napominjući kako je više puta pokušala uspostaviti kontakt, ali su razmijenili tek kratke pozdrave. Jasno ističe da ne traži dopuštenje ni priznanje od Dylana za ovaj projekt, ali ima osjećaj da je svjestan i prati njezin rad. Marshall se osvrće i na majčinstvo, opisujući sinovu strast prema matematici i sportu. Dijeli duhovitu priču o tome kako mu je objašnjavala svoj posao, uključujući njegovu znatiželju o tome jesu li Bob Dylan i Iggy Pop prijatelji. Njegova pitanja otkrivaju svježu, nevinu dječju perspektivu koja joj pruža dodatnu radost. Cijeli intervju tako prikazuje Cat Power kao promišljenu i predanu umjetnicu, koja nadahnuće pronalazi u prošlosti, povezanost u sadašnjosti i humor u svakodnevnom životu.

article_content: A Delta Air Lines flight from Fort Lauderdale to Minneapolis returned to the airport shortly after takeoff on Sunday morning following an engine warning. The Boeing 737-800, carrying 119 passengers and six crew members, took off at 7:45 a.m. and safely landed back at Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport within minutes. There were no injuries. Delta spokesman Anthony Black stated that mechanics confirmed engine damage, though the exact components affected were unknown. All passengers were accommodated on a later flight to Minnesota the same day. Broward County Aviation Department spokesman Greg Meyer reported that suspected engine parts were recovered near the airport. FAA spokeswoman Kathleen Bergen said their early inspection indicated a 'contained failure,' where turbine blades left the engine through the back but did not penetrate the engine cover. Delta emphasized that while such events are rare, the crew followed correct procedures. The FAA is still investigating.

Glasnogovornik Odjela za zrakoplovstvo okruga Broward, Greg Meyer, rekao je da su dijelovi za koje se vjeruje da su s oštećenog motora pronađeni blizu zračne luke. article_content: ATLANTA — People in Georgia will continue to pay no state taxes on gasoline and diesel at least until lawmakers convene for a special legislative session. Republican Governor Brian Kemp on Wednesday extended the fuel tax suspension — 31.2 cents per gallon for gasoline and 35 cents per gallon for diesel — until November 29. Georgia’s governor can suspend tax collection during emergencies, pending legislative approval at the next session. That session, originally set for January 8, is now scheduled for November 29, when Kemp called lawmakers to redraw Georgia's congressional and state legislative districts following a federal court ruling that some districts unlawfully diluted Black voting power. It's unclear if Kemp will request an extension of the tax break during this session; he could also declare another emergency and resume waiving taxes afterward. Spokesperson Garrison Douglas said there is no information yet on what Kemp will propose. In September, Kemp reinstated a tactic from his 2022 reelection campaign, signing a law to suspend the gas tax with broad bipartisan support. He has since signed seven extensions, and the state gave up an estimated $1.7 billion in revenue from March 2022 to January 2023. The governor resumed waiving taxes in September by issuing a new legal declaration, finding that high prices constituted an emergency. The 2022 suspension was tied to a COVID-19–related state of emergency. Kemp argues that tax relief helps Georgians cope with inflation, which he blames on Democratic President Joe Biden, though most economists agree that more consumer money usually increases inflation. 'Thanks to our responsible budgeting, we’re able to deliver relief to families dealing with the effects of Bidenomics,' Kemp said in a statement. 'I’m proud this action has helped put millions of dollars back into hardworking Georgians’ pockets and look forward to seeing that impact as Thanksgiving approaches.' The governor has been cutting fuel taxes worth about $180 million monthly while noting that state tax collections are declining, which may signal a slowing economy. Tax revenues decreased about 3% in October, even as some fuel taxes continued after Kemp's September action. Georgia's fuel taxes primarily support road construction. Despite revenue drops, the state is on track for another surplus this year unless the economy worsens or lawmakers increase tax relief. Kemp capped state spending more than $5 billion below the $37.7 billion collected last year. Georgia also has a full rainy day fund and $11 billion in extra surplus. According to AAA, as of Tuesday, Georgia drivers paid an average of $2.89 for a gallon of unleaded gas — second-lowest among U.S. states after Texas, and down 68 cents since the tax suspension. The national average is $3.41, down 43 cents in the same period. Pump prices also include a federal tax: 18.4 cents per gallon on gasoline and 24.4 cents per gallon on diesel.

article_content: A council inspector visited a notably unsafe construction site in Swalecliffe, Kent, just hours before 24-year-old Callum Osborne, soon to become a father, was killed when a trench collapsed. Julie Darbyshire, the inspector, described the site as ‘exceptionally bad’ and felt it was risky, but still chose not to report the conditions to the Health and Safety Executive. She explained during the inquest that she didn't report it because the work was almost done and she lacked the authority to close the site. On the day of the April 2011 accident, Osborne, a self-employed laborer for Coopers Services Ltd, was helping lay utility pipes for two new bungalows. Having only been on the job for two days, he was buried by a collapsing trench. His coworkers tried to rescue him, but he died on site from heart failure. Osborne's partner, Colette, who was eight months pregnant, recalled he had texted her a couple of hours before the incident to say he hadn’t had a break and was working in a very deep trench. Although he had talked about the dangers of unsupported trenches and said he wouldn’t work in unsafe conditions, Colette noted he was desperate for work and took the risk. With a previous inquest failing to reach a conclusion, this is the second formal investigation into his death. The ongoing hearing in Sandwich, Kent, has highlighted serious questions about construction site safety and regulatory responsibility.

Inspektorica Julie Darbyshire opisala je gradilište kao 'iznimno loše' i smatrala ga rizičnim, ali nije prijavila uvjete Izvršnom odboru za zdravlje i sigurnost. Tijekom istrage objasnila je da to nije učinila jer je posao bio gotovo završen i nije imala ovlasti zatvoriti gradilište. Bio je na poslu samo dva dana kada ga je zatrpao rov koji se urušio. Njegove kolege pokušale su ga spasiti, ali je preminuo na mjestu od zatajenja srca. Osborneova partnerica Colette, koja je bila trudna osam mjeseci, prisjetila se kako joj je nekoliko sati prije nesreće poslao poruku da nije imao pauzu i da radi u vrlo dubokom rovu. Iako je ranije govorio o opasnostima neosiguranih rovova i tvrdio da ne bi radio u nesigurnim uvjetima, Colette je napomenula da je bio očajan zbog posla i ipak preuzeo rizik. Nakon što prvi istražni postupak nije donio zaključak, ovo je druga službena istraga njegove smrti. Aktualna istraga u Sandwichu, Kent, istaknula je ozbiljna pitanja o sigurnosti na gradilištima i odgovornosti regulative.
