article_content: The remarkable discovery that our universe is expanding at an accelerating rate—nearly 14 billion years after the Big Bang—has earned three scientists the 2011 Nobel Prize in Physics, the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced Tuesday. Initially reported in 1998 by competing research teams from the United States and Australia, this breakthrough challenged fundamental assumptions in physics and astronomy. The finding led scientists to conclude that approximately three-quarters of the universe is made up of 'dark energy,' a mysterious force that counters gravity and drives the universe's continual expansion. According to the Nobel organization, understanding dark energy remains one of the most profound mysteries in modern physics. Half of the Nobel Prize was awarded to Saul Perlmutter of the Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and the University of California, Berkeley. The other half went to Brian P. Schmidt of the Australian National University and Adam G. Riess of Johns Hopkins University and the Space Telescope Science Institute. The prize totals 10 million Swedish kronor, equivalent to about $1.44 million. 'I am delighted, excited, and deeply honored,' Perlmutter stated. In a statement from Johns Hopkins University, Riess described the project as 'an incredibly exciting adventure' and expressed gratitude for the recognition. Both teams conducted measurements of light from specific types of exploding stars, called supernovae, initially aiming to confirm that the universe's expansion was slowing. Instead, their results showed these supernovae appeared dimmer than expected, meaning their host galaxies were moving away from each other at an accelerated pace. This widely celebrated discovery implied that an unknown and invisible form of energy is pushing matter apart faster and faster, opposing the force of gravity. 'We now know that 74 percent of the universe consists of this dark energy,' Riess wrote on his website prior to the announcement. 'Understanding its nature remains a top challenge for physicists and astronomers.' The implication is that the universe will likely continue to expand indefinitely, rather than slowing to a halt or collapsing in a 'big crunch.' The Academy, upon announcing the prize, noted, 'The findings of the 2011 Nobel Laureates in Physics have revealed a universe largely unknown to science. Everything is possible again.' The Nobel Prize in Physics is the second of six Nobel prizes announced this month. Last year's prize was awarded to Andre Geim and Konstantin Novoselov from the University of Manchester for groundbreaking work with graphene, a two-dimensional material. Since 1901, the Nobel Committee has awarded the Physics prize 104 times. Lawrence Bragg remains the youngest recipient, having won in 1915 at age 25, while Raymond Davis Jr. is the oldest, receiving the honor in 2002 at age 88. Upcoming Nobel announcements include prizes in chemistry, literature, economics, and peace. On Monday, the Nobel committee named Ralph Steinman of Rockefeller University, Bruce A. Beutler, and Jules A. Hoffmann as winners of the 2011 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine. Steinman passed away from pancreatic cancer at age 68 three days before the announcement. Although Nobel rules prohibit posthumous awards, the Assembly determined that since Steinman's death was unknown at the time of the decision, the award would still stand.

Ovo otkriće, koje su 1998. godine prvi put objavili suparnički istraživački timovi iz SAD-a i Australije, izazvalo je temeljne postavke u fizici i astronomiji. Ovo otkriće dovelo je znanstvenike do zaključka da je otprilike tri četvrtine svemira sastavljeno od 'tamne energije', tajanstvene sile koja nadjačava gravitaciju i pokreće stalnu širenje svemira. Prema Nobelovoj organizaciji, razumijevanje tamne energije ostaje jedno od najdubljih misterija moderne fizike. Polovica Nobelove nagrade dodijeljena je Saulu Perlmutteru iz Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory i Sveučilišta Kalifornija u Berkeleyju. Druga polovica pripala je Brianu P. Schmidtu s Australskog nacionalnog sveučilišta i Adamu G. Riessu sa Sveučilišta Johns Hopkins i Space Telescope Science Institutea. Nagrada iznosi 10 milijuna švedskih kruna, što je oko 1,44 milijuna američkih dolara. "Oduševljen sam, uzbuđen i duboko počašćen," izjavio je Perlmutter. U priopćenju Sveučilišta Johns Hopkins, Riess je projekt opisao kao "nevjerojatno uzbudljivu avanturu" i zahvalio na priznanju. Oba tima mjerila su svjetlost određenih vrsta eksplodirajućih zvijezda, poznatih kao supernove, s namjerom da potvrde ideju o usporavanju širenja svemira. Međutim, podaci su pokazali da su te supernove bile slabije nego što se očekivalo, što znači da se galaksije međusobno udaljavaju ubrzanom brzinom. Ovo hvaljeno otkriće navelo je znanstvenike da zaključe da nepoznata i nevidljiva energija ubrzava širenje materije, suprotstavljajući se gravitaciji. "Danas znamo da 74 posto svemira čini tamna energija," napisao je Riess na svojoj web stranici prije objave nagrade. "Razumijevanje njezine prirode i dalje je veliki izazov za fizičare i astronome." To znači da će se svemir najvjerojatnije nastaviti širiti beskonačno, umjesto da uspori ili se uruši u takozvani 'veliki prasak'. Akademija je prilikom objave nagrade naglasila: "Otkrća ovogodišnjih laureata Nobelove nagrade za fiziku otkrila su svemir koji je u velikoj mjeri još uvijek nepoznat znanosti. Sve je opet moguće." Nobelova nagrada za fiziku druga je od šest nagrada koje se objavljuju ovog mjeseca. Prošlogodišnji laureati bili su Andre Geim i Konstantin Novoselov sa Sveučilišta u Manchesteru za revolucionarni rad s grafenom, materijalom debljine jednog atoma. Od 1901. godine Nobelov odbor dodijelio je nagradu za fiziku 104 puta. Lawrence Bragg ostaje najmlađi dobitnik, osvojivši nagradu 1915. sa samo 25 godina, dok je Raymond Davis Jr. najstariji, primivši priznanje 2002. sa 88 godina. Ovih dana očekuju se objave Nobelovih nagrada za kemiju, književnost, ekonomiju i mir. U ponedjeljak je Nobelov odbor proglasio Ralpha Steinmana sa Sveučilišta Rockefeller, Brucea A. Beutlera i Julesa A. Hoffmanna dobitnicima Nobelove nagrade za fiziologiju ili medicinu 2011. Steinman je preminuo od raka gušterače u dobi od 68 godina, tri dana prije objave nagrade. Iako pravila Nobelove nagrade ne dopuštaju posthumno dodjeljivanje, skupština je odlučila da nagrada ostaje jer nisu znali za Steinmanovu smrt prilikom donošenja odluke.

article_content: As global temperatures increase, Antarctica is losing ice more rapidly. However, a recent study from Penn State scientists indicates that diminished sea ice in regions like the Amundsen Sea, West Antarctica, is enabling more moisture in the atmosphere and thus heavier snowfall onto the ice sheet. While this additional snowfall cannot fully make up for the ice being lost, incorporating this factor into climate models could enhance sea level rise predictions, according to assistant professor Luke Trusel.  The Antarctic ice sheets store massive amounts of freshwater, so even minor changes can impact global sea levels. Trusel pointed out that, beyond dramatic events like iceberg calving, increases in snowfall also significantly affect sea level. He explained, 'The amount of snowfall on Antarctica's vast ice sheets is as essential as melting or ice breaking away. Tracking both helps us clarify the processes adding or removing water from the oceans.'  Sea ice plays a critical part in these dynamics by regulating both evaporation and precipitation. Lead author Jessica Kromer explained that sea ice reflects sunlight, cools the region, and influences how much ocean water evaporates and returns as precipitation. 'There are significant annual variations in precipitation that can sometimes offset the effect of ice loss,' Kromer said.  By employing satellite observations alongside climate data, the researchers evaluated the relationship between the ocean surface, atmospheric moisture, and the Antarctic ice sheet. Their findings show that when sea ice diminishes, more open ocean leads to enhanced evaporation, which increases atmospheric moisture. This moisture ultimately condenses over the cold ice sheet, causing heavier snowfall.  This dynamic creates a feedback loop: reduced sea ice lifts evaporation, raises atmospheric moisture, and triggers a localized greenhouse effect. This process increases downward longwave radiation and accelerates further sea ice loss in the following months.  Kromer drew attention to satellite data indicating Antarctic sea ice grew slightly until 2015 but has dropped sharply since, reaching a record low in 2022 and falling even further this year. These sudden shifts highlight the urgency of understanding what's driving Antarctic sea ice changes and their greater implications.  The research team emphasizes the pressing need to upgrade climate models to better forecast sea level changes. As Trusel remarked, 'More accurate predictions require better modeling of sea ice processes.'
translated_content: Kako globalne temperature rastu, Antarktika gubi led sve brže. No, nedavno istraživanje znanstvenika Penn Statea pokazuje da smanjenje morskog leda u područjima poput Amundsenova mora u zapadnoj Antarktici dovodi do više vlage u atmosferi i obilnijih snježnih padalina na ledenoj ploči. Iako ovaj dodatni snijeg ne može u potpunosti nadoknaditi izgubljeni led, uključivanje ovog faktora u klimatske modele moglo bi poboljšati predviđanja porasta razine mora, navodi docent Luke Trusel.  Antarktičke ledene ploče pohranjuju ogromne količine slatke vode, pa i male promjene mogu utjecati na globalnu razinu mora. Trusel ističe kako, uz spektakularne događaje poput odlamanja santi, i porast snježnih padalina znatno utječe na razinu mora. Objasnio je: 'Količina snijega na golemim antarktičkim ledenim pločama jednako je važna kao i topljenje ili odlamanje leda. Praćenje oba procesa pomaže nam shvatiti što povećava ili smanjuje vodu u oceanima.'  Morski led igra ključnu ulogu u ovom procesu jer regulira isparavanje i padaline. Glavna autorica Jessica Kromer pojašnjava da morski led reflektira sunčevu svjetlost, hladi područje i utječe na količinu vode koja isparava iz oceana i vraća se kao oborina. 'Godišnje količine padalina se jako razlikuju, što ponekad može ublažiti utjecaj gubitka leda,' kaže Kromer.  Korištenjem satelitskih snimaka i klimatskih podataka, istraživači su analizirali odnos između površine oceana, atmosferske vlage i antarktičke ledene ploče. Rezultati pokazuju da smanjenje morskog leda povećava količinu otvorenog oceana i time povećava isparavanje, što vodi do više vlage u atmosferi. Ta se vlaga kondenzira nad hladnim ledenim pločama i uzrokuje jače snježne padaline.  Ova dinamika stvara povratnu petlju: smanjeni morski led znači više isparavanja, više vlage u zraku i pojačan lokalni staklenički efekt. To povećava silazno dugovalno zračenje te ubrzava daljnji gubitak morskog leda u sljedećim mjesecima.  Kromer ističe da satelitski podaci otkrivaju kako je antarktički morski led lagano rastao do 2015., ali je od tada naglo pao, dosegnuvši rekordnu nisku razinu 2022., a ove godine je još niži. Ove brze promjene potvrđuju hitnost boljeg razumijevanja uzroka promjena u antarktičkom morskom ledu i njihovih širih posljedica.  Autori naglašavaju hitnu potrebu za poboljšanjem klimatskih modela kako bi preciznije predviđali promjene razine mora. Trusel zaključuje: 'Za bolja predviđanja potrebno je unaprijediti modele procesa vezanih uz morski led.'

article_content: Former Nigerian Minister of Finance, Kemi Adeosun, participated alongside Nobel Prize-winning economist Joseph Stiglitz in a panel discussion on sovereign debt crises held in Paris, according to organizers on Wednesday. Adeosun held office as Nigeria's finance minister from November 2015 to September 2018. During the discussion, Adeosun pointed out that the prolonged nature of debt restructuring—such as in the case of Zambia—often arises from insufficient early action before a default. She remarked that governments under debt distress are frequently reluctant to acknowledge their predicament due to the political sensitivity of cutting social spending, particularly in democracies. "This leads to a tendency to kick the can down the road," she noted. Adeosun recommended that Eurobond holders initiate dialogue with sovereign governments ahead of potential defaults. While starting such talks might be premature if a country continues making payments, these discussions can expedite restructuring when necessary. Stiglitz stressed that the lack of an international mechanism for sovereign debt restructuring undermines Africa’s ability to achieve sustainable public finances and limits contributions to the clean energy transition. He explained that coordinating among diverse creditors—such as China and Western hedge funds that often lack mutual trust—adds complexity to the process. "There is currently no comprehensive framework for sovereign debt restructuring, resulting in too little, too late restructuring," said Stiglitz. The organizers also reported that Zambia’s debt restructuring has been drawn out since the country defaulted on its debt in November 2020.

Adeosun je bila ministrica financija Nigerije od studenog 2015. do rujna 2018. Tijekom rasprave, Adeosun je naglasila da se dugotrajno restrukturiranje duga – kao što je slučaj sa Zambijom – često događa zbog nedostatka rane intervencije prije samog stečaja. Navela je da su vlade koje se nalaze u dužničkoj krizi često nevoljke priznati svoje stanje zbog političke osjetljivosti smanjenja socijalne potrošnje, osobito u demokracijama. "To vodi tendenciji odgađanja rješavanja problema," primijetila je. Adeosun je preporučila da vlasnici euroobveznica trebaju započeti razgovore s državama prije potencijalnog stečaja. Iako takvi razgovori ponekad mogu biti preuranjeni ako država nastavi redovno isplaćivati dug, oni mogu pomoći da se proces ubrza kada restrukturiranje postane potrebno. Stiglitz je istaknuo kako nedostatak međunarodnog mehanizma za restrukturiranje suverenog duga otežava Africi postizanje održivih javnih financija i ograničava doprinos energetskoj tranziciji. Objasnio je da koordinacija među raznolikim vjerovnicima – poput Kine i zapadnih hedge fondova koji često nemaju međusobno povjerenje – dodatno komplicira ovaj proces. "Trenutno ne postoji sveobuhvatan okvir za restrukturiranje suverenog duga, zbog čega je restrukturiranje često prekasno i nedovoljno," izjavio je Stiglitz. Organizatori su također izvijestili da restrukturiranje duga Zambije traje još od kad je zemlja proglasila stečaj u studenom 2020.

article_content: LONDON, England (CNN) -- After being untraceable for a week, Egyptian striker Amir Zaki has returned to his Premier League club, Wigan Athletic, in northern England. Zaki and Wigan manager Steve Bruce have reconciled after a recent dispute. According to Bruce, the two resolved their differences after he had publicly criticized the 26-year-old striker. Zaki told Al-Hayat TV that the pair 'ended up laughing' about his absence—he had failed to return from international duty and had a hamstring strain of unknown severity. However, relations were tense a week earlier. On Wigan's official website, Bruce stated: 'I just feel it's time that we went public on just what a nightmare he has been to deal with. I can honestly say that in all my time in football I have never worked with someone as unprofessional.' Bruce added, 'I have already fined him the maximum allowed but this seems to have no effect.' This was reportedly the fourth time Zaki had not returned promptly from international duty. The issue raises questions about whether players are letting down their clubs and fans when they go AWOL and how clubs should respond. Zaki's situation is not unique: Inter Milan striker Adriano sparked concern when he failed to return after a World Cup qualifier in South America earlier this month. It was not his first incident of failing to report to his club. After a two-week absence, Adriano announced at a news conference in Brazil that he was taking a break from professional football because he had 'lost the happiness of playing.' He said he might stay in Brazil for an indefinite period. Other cases include Nigerian forward Ayegbeni Yakubu, who was fined £80,000 by Everton after not returning from the African Cup of Nations last year; manager David Moyes commented that the incident was over. Schalke fined defender Rafinha a reported $1 million for making an unauthorized trip to the Beijing Olympics and being away for 35 days. One of the most unusual cases involved Moroccan defender Youssef Rossi, who returned to training at Dunfermline Athletic a year after his wages had been stopped for going AWOL. Rossi had previously left the club and trained with Raja Casablanca in Morocco.

Zaki i menadžer Wigana, Steve Bruce, izgladili su nesuglasice nakon nedavne prepirke. Prema Bruceu, dvojac je riješio nesuglasice nakon što je on javno kritizirao 26-godišnjeg napadača. Zaki je za Al-Hayat TV rekao da su se na kraju 'smijali' njegovom izostanku—nije se vratio s reprezentativnih obaveza i imao je ozljedu zadnje lože nepoznate težine. No, odnosi su bili napeti tjedan dana ranije. Na službenoj web stranici Wigana, Bruce je izjavio: 'Mislim da je vrijeme da javno kažemo kakva je noćna mora bilo surađivati s njim. Rossi je tada trenirao s Raja Casablancom u domovini.

article_content: Scottish Justice Minister Kenny MacAskill has indicated that if Scotland becomes independent, the population should have the authority to decide whether to keep the Queen as head of state. While the Scottish National Party's official stance is to retain the monarchy, significant discussion exists within the party about the country's future direction. MacAskill's recent comments have contributed to ongoing debates, as he expressed openness to a possible referendum on the monarchy following independence. First Minister Alex Salmond argues that an independent Scotland would maintain the status quo, including sharing the pound and retaining the monarchy. Yet, some senior SNP members, such as Aileen Campbell and Fiona Hyslop, support the idea of consulting the public on the monarchy through a referendum after independence is achieved. Yes campaign chair Dennis Canavan has also supported moving towards a republic. Recent polling by ICM Research highlights growing support for independence at 39 percent, with 46 percent opposing and 15 percent undecided, indicating a narrowing gap as the September 18 referendum nears. Doubts remain among opposition leaders like Scottish Conservative deputy leader Jackson Carlaw, who questions whether assurances about the monarchy's future would be upheld, given the presence of republican sentiment among SNP leadership. Historically, the crowns of Scotland and England merged in 1603, later resulting in the political union of 1707. As the referendum approaches, financial analysts at BlackRock caution that Scotland could face significant economic uncertainty, including difficult decisions about currency, but consider a large-scale bank exodus unlikely.

Iako je službeni stav Škotske nacionalne stranke (SNP) očuvanje monarhije, unutar stranke vodi se značajna rasprava o budućnosti zemlje. MacAskillove nedavne izjave dodatno su potaknule te rasprave, jer je izrazio otvorenost prema mogućem referendumu o monarhiji nakon neovisnosti. Premijer Alex Salmond tvrdi da bi neovisna Škotska zadržala postojeće stanje, uključujući funtu i monarhiju. Ipak, neki viši članovi SNP-a, poput Aileen Campbell i Fione Hyslop, podržavaju prijedlog da se građani izjasne na referendumu o monarhiji nakon što se postigne neovisnost. Predsjednik kampanje 'Yes' Dennis Canavan također se zalaže za republikanske stavove. Nedavno istraživanje ICM Researcha bilježi rast podrške neovisnosti na 39 posto, dok je 46 posto protiv i 15 posto neodlučnih, što pokazuje smanjenje razlike kako se bliži referendum 18. rujna. Opaske oporbenih čelnika, poput zamjenika šefa škotskih konzervativaca Jacksona Carlawa, ukazuju na sumnju hoće li obećanja oko monarhije ostati, s obzirom na republikanske poglede unutar vodstva SNP-a. Povijesno, krune Škotske i Engleske spojene su 1603. godine, što je kasnije dovelo do političke unije 1707. godine. Kako se referendum približava, financijski analitičari iz BlackRocka upozoravaju da bi neovisna Škotska mogla iskusiti značajnu ekonomsku neizvjesnost i teške odluke o valuti, no ne predviđaju masovni odlazak banaka.

article_content: Thomas Beatie, a transgender man who gave birth to a daughter earlier this year, says he is expecting his second child. Beatie told ABC News that after giving birth to Susan on June 29, he chose not to resume testosterone treatment so he could have another baby. "I feel good," Beatie told journalist Barbara Walters, adding that his medical checkups show everything is proceeding well. Beatie and his wife, Nancy, live in Bend, Oregon. The new baby is expected on June 12. Beatie was assigned female at birth and underwent hormone therapy and a mastectomy before legally becoming a man, but he retained his female reproductive organs during his transition in the late 1990s. Beatie and Nancy decided they wanted to start a family, and he was artificially inseminated late last year. Barbara Walters said on her show, 'The View,' that Beatie revealed his second pregnancy to her during an interview for a documentary set to air Friday night on U.S. television. Beatie discussed Susan's birth with Walters, noting it was not via Caesarean section. Prior to Susan's birth, Beatie released a photo displaying his bearded face and pregnant belly, which attracted widespread media attention.

article_content: Essendon Football Club coach James Hird is persisting with his legal challenge against the Australian Sports Anti-Doping Authority (ASADA), asserting that the agency improperly used the AFL’s power to exceed its own investigative limits during the club’s supplements inquiry. On Monday, Hird, supported by his wife Tania at the Federal Court in Melbourne, renewed his appeal following an earlier decision in September that ruled ASADA’s joint investigation with the AFL was lawful. Hird’s lawyer, Peter Hanks QC, argued that ASADA overstepped by involving the AFL, which allowed them to compel Essendon staff and players to participate in interviews using the threat of AFL contract penalties. According to Hanks, ASADA can ask for information but does not have the legal power to force disclosure, unlike the AFL. Hanks added that ASADA led most of the questioning during interviews, with the AFL providing additional questions, calling this a tactic to bypass ASADA’s legal restrictions. He pointed out that, under the law at the time, ASADA could only be assisted by named individuals, not a sports governing body like the AFL. Justice John Middleton’s prior ruling found ASADA’s joint operation with the AFL to be legal, after which ASADA delivered show-cause notices to 34 past and present Essendon players. Hird’s appeal focuses on the exact scope of ASADA’s authority, with Tania Hird continuing her visible support as proceedings go on.
translated_content: Trener nogometnog kluba Essendon, James Hird, nastavlja pravnu borbu protiv Australske antidopinške agencije (ASADA), tvrdeći da je agencija nepravilno koristila moć AFL-a kako bi prekoračila vlastite ovlasti tijekom istrage o klupskom programu dodataka prehrani. U ponedjeljak je Hird, uz podršku supruge Tanie na Saveznom sudu u Melbourneu, obnovio svoju žalbu nakon što je ranija odluka iz rujna presudila da je zajednička istraga ASADA-e i AFL-a zakonita. Hirdov odvjetnik, Peter Hanks QC, tvrdio je da je ASADA prešla granice uključivanjem AFL-a, što im je omogućilo da osoblju i igračima Essendona nametnu sudjelovanje u ispitivanjima uz prijetnju kazni iz ugovora s AFL-om. Prema Hanksu, ASADA može tražiti informacije, ali nema ovlast prisiljavati na otkrivanje, za razliku od AFL-a. article_content: ‘Photobomb’ has been selected as the 2014 Word of the Year by the Collins English Dictionary, standing out among 50,000 new additions, including ‘twerk’, ‘bakeoff’, and ‘normcore’. Although the term dates back to at least 2008, ‘photobomb’ received widespread attention this year due to high-profile instances involving Queen Elizabeth II and Prince Harry, who were photographed playfully appearing in the background of athletes' photos at the Commonwealth Games. According to the Collins English Dictionary, ‘photobomb’ is defined as ‘to intrude into the background of a photograph without the subject’s knowledge’. Other notable photobombs this year featured Benedict Cumberbatch with U2 at the Academy Awards and Jennifer Lawrence with Taylor Swift at the Golden Globes. Collins announced its decision alongside the launch of its 12th edition dictionary, where 50,000 new words have become official. The publisher noted the word’s first recorded use was in 2008, with internet popularity growing in 2012 as viral photos circulated online. Ian Brookes, a lexicographer for Collins, highlighted that the rise of high-profile media and sporting events contributed significantly to the word’s mainstream acceptance. The shortlist for Word of the Year included: 1. Photobomb; 2. Tinder—a dating app matching users in their local area with a swipe feature; 3. Bakeoff—a baking competition, popularized by the TV show ‘The Great British Bakeoff’; 4. Normcore—a fashion trend favoring simplicity; and 5. Devo max—maximum devolution of powers from a central government to a regional one. ‘Twerk’, a form of suggestive dance popularized by Miley Cyrus, also made the list, along with ‘adorkable’, meaning someone who is endearingly awkward. Despite the competition, ‘photobomb’ took the top spot, reflecting its rise in popular culture during 2014.

article_content: Monty Python’s Flying Circus remains as influential and unstoppable as ever. This week, the five surviving members of the renowned British comedy troupe announced they would reunite for live performances—their first together in over a decade. For fans of comedy, this reunion is nearly as monumental as if the Beatles had come back together. Monty Python’s approach, since their BBC debut in 1969, was to remix and reinvent the variety-revue format, much like American innovator Ernie Kovacs. They introduced audiences to surreal, unpredictable sketches—from Spanish Inquisitors bursting into drawing rooms to recurring gags featuring eccentric characters like dotty old ladies, overzealous cheese shop employees, and, of course, ample references to Spam. Their show found an enthusiastic following in the United States during the early 1970s, with American public television airing their uniquely anarchic and slyly surreal humor. While some critics at the time found their irreverence out of touch with the pressing social and political issues of the era, Monty Python’s absurd scenarios—like the infamous 'dead parrot' sketch or the lament over a dirty fork—have stood the test of time. Today, their work is easily accessible to new generations, thanks largely to the official Monty Python YouTube channel, established in 2008, where classic BBC sketches and scenes from beloved films such as 'Monty Python and the Holy Grail,' 'Life of Brian,' and 'The Meaning of Life' are available. With their trademark humor, the group's YouTube page encourages viewers to support them by buying their shows and movies, lightly jesting about being 'ripped off' over the years. Although the reunion will be without Graham Chapman, who died in 1989, it seems likely that the wave of new digital fans inspired the group to come together again. The key question now is whether the troupe, now in their seventies, can still deliver the spontaneous silliness and wit that made them famous. Many are optimistic—and eager to see if their signature acts and comedic style remain as sharp as ever. The opinions expressed in this commentary are solely those of Gene Seymour.

article_content: CDs and vinyl records remain cherished by music enthusiasts for their perceived sound quality, but the convenience and advancements of digital streaming services have made digital audio the primary way most people listen to music today. As home audio setups become more diverse, both in age and technology, one of the best ways to integrate digital audio—and your favorite online music services—into your system is through a network music streamer. A network music streamer is an internet-connected device designed to play digital music on your audio system. The best streamers are simple to operate, support a wide range of audio file formats and streaming services, and deliver excellent sound quality for both casual listeners and passionate audiophiles. With so many options and features on the market, understanding the basics is the first step. Leading manufacturers like Sonos, Cambridge Audio, Naim, NAD, Yamaha, Technics, as well as smaller brands like Wiim and Audioengine, offer streamers in various sizes, from compact units to those resembling Blu-ray players or AV receivers. These devices offer multiple connectivity options—including digital and analog outputs, USB ports, XLR, Bluetooth, AirPlay, and Chromecast—and connect to the internet via Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or both. This gives you the versatility to link your streamer to everything from receivers and amplifiers to powered speakers, smartphones, headphones, TVs, and beyond. Once connected to your audio system and network, a streamer can access platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, Qobuz, Deezer, and more. Many streamers also allow you to play music stored on USB drives or external hard drives, and some support playback from compatible network-attached storage (NAS) devices or computers on the same network. Some network streamers support multi-room audio systems—like Sonos and Bluesound—or can be linked with other compatible devices for whole-home listening. Certain models offer internal storage for hi-res audio files, providing a convenient way to organize and access your library. Key advantages of a network music streamer include superior and efficient DACs (digital-to-analog converters), which are typically more advanced than those found in smartphones or computers. These DACs are designed to handle high-resolution audio formats such as FLAC, DSD, WAV, AIFF, and ALAC, ensuring you hear your music in the best possible quality. Internet connectivity via LAN or Wi-Fi provides the necessary bandwidth for streaming high-quality audio. It’s important to note that not all DACs are created equal. For example, while the Wiim Mini is an affordable way to access various platforms, its built-in DAC may not match the audio quality of those in higher-end devices like the Cambridge Audio CXN, which features dual Wolfson DACs for improved sound. Many network streamers offer unified interfaces and dedicated apps, allowing control of all sources—streaming services, inputs, NAS, speakers—from one device, be it a smartphone or computer. There are also physical controls and displays for hands-on operation. When choosing a network music streamer, consider your budget, needs, and existing equipment. Prices range from just over $100 to several thousand dollars, with many mid-range options offering excellent features and sound quality, such as the $150 Wiim Pro. Most network streamers provide at least CD-quality sound (16-bit/44.1kHz), but if you require hi-res playback or support for lossless services like Tidal or Apple Music, make sure your chosen device is compatible with these formats and platforms. While Bluetooth and Wi-Fi are standard, features like native app support for services, touchscreen displays, remotes, and customizable apps can further enhance the user experience. For instance, Sonos excels at native integration with Apple Music and Tidal, allowing full-quality playback, while some streamers without native support require workarounds (e.g., streaming via AirPlay or Bluetooth) that may limit audio quality. It’s also possible to enjoy quality streaming through devices like the Apple TV 4K (2022) or Chromecast with Google TV, which support a range of music apps when connected to your AV system. For example, using the Tidal app directly on Apple TV eliminates the need for intermediary devices and preserves sound quality. A network music streamer doesn’t have to be expensive to be worthwhile—they provide easy access to high-quality music and other audio content on a wide range of audio setups, whether you prefer vintage receivers, powered speakers, or modern amplifiers. Equipped with this knowledge, you can explore our picks for the best network music streamers. Happy streaming!

article_content: The Marquess of Northampton married Tracy Goodman last year after five previous marriages. Friends were concerned for the Marquess, one of Britain’s wealthiest aristocrats, especially after his fifth marriage ended acrimoniously with a £17 million settlement. Nevertheless, just months after the divorce, he married Tracy Goodman, a psychotherapist and yoga teacher 18 years his junior. A year after their wedding at the Chelsea Register Office, Tracy reflected on her transformation from a state-school educated professional in Chiswick, London, to Marchioness and chatelaine of two stately homes, including the 84-room Compton Wynyates in Warwickshire. She insists her marriage hasn’t changed her, saying, ‘I haven’t changed and I don’t intend to.’ The Marquess’s fifth marriage to Pamela Haworth, which lasted 23 years, ended after her affair with Dr. Dan Stoicescu, a pharmaceutical tycoon. The divorce resulted in a significant financial settlement for Pamela. Tracy met the Marquess through his daughter Lady Louisa during a visit to California, and recalls the connection felt natural. Tracy, originally from Plymouth, once worked as an air stewardess for British Airways before qualifying in psychotherapy and yoga. She served as the manager and clinical supervisor of BA’s Crewcare service and later worked at The Priory and the Meadows Clinic in Arizona, specializing in therapy for eating disorders and sex addiction. She now works at The Recovery Centre in Belgravia and maintains her practice, though she has scaled back due to travel. Despite her new aristocratic status, Tracy prioritizes her independence and avoids using her title professionally. She is also stepmother to the Marquess’s four children and five grandchildren. The Marquess, known as 'Spenny' and sometimes as the 'Mystic Marquess' for his interest in Freemasonry and mysticism, has an estimated fortune of £120 million. The Marquess’s marital history includes Henriette Bentinck, Annette Smallwood, Rosie Dawson-Damer, Fritzi (Ellen) Erhardt, and Pamela Haworth. Most of these marriages ended in divorce and sizable settlements. His divorce from Pamela was especially scandalous, centering on her relationship with Dr. Stoicescu, who himself is very wealthy and later married Maria Torres. Tracy recently hosted a charity event for International Animal Rescue and remains committed to philanthropy. She emphasizes her practical nature and connection to her roots despite her new life. Readers are encouraged to support the charity, particularly for causes such as orangutan conservation.

Ipak, samo nekoliko mjeseci nakon razvoda, oženio je Tracy Goodman, psihoterapeutkinju i učiteljicu joge, 18 godina mlađu od njega. Godinu dana nakon njihovog vjenčanja u matičnom uredu u Chelseaju, Tracy razmišlja o svojoj transformaciji – od zaposlenice obrazovane u državnoj školi u Chiswicku, London, do markize i domaćice dva dvorca, uključujući 84-sobni Compton Wynyates u Warwickshireu. Ističe da je brak nije promijenio: 'Nisam se promijenila i nemam namjeru.' Peti markizov brak s Pamelom Haworth, koji je trajao 23 godine, završio je nakon njezine veze s farmaceutskim tajkunom dr. Danom Stoiescuom. Razvod je Pamelu doveo do značajne financijske nagodbe. Tracy je markiza upoznala preko njegove kćeri Lady Louise tijekom posjeta Kaliforniji, a veza im je, kaže, bila prirodna. Tracy, porijeklom iz Plymoutha, radila je kao stjuardesa u British Airwaysu prije nego što je stekla kvalifikacije iz psihoterapije i joge. Bila je voditeljica i klinička supervizorica službe Crewcare, te kasnije radila u klinici The Priory i Meadows Clinic u Arizoni, specijalizirajući se za poremećaje prehrane i ovisnosti o seksu. Sada radi u The Recovery Centre u Belgraviji i održava praksu, iako je smanjila opseg zbog putovanja. Unatoč novom aristokratskom statusu, Tracy naglašava svoju neovisnost i ne koristi naslov u profesionalnom životu. Također je maćeha markizovoj četvero djece i pet unučadi. Markiz, poznat kao 'Spenny' i ponekad 'Mistični markiz' zbog interesa za masonstvo i mistiku, procjenjuje se da vrijedi 120 milijuna funti. Markizova povijest brakova uključuje Henriette Bentinck, Annette Smallwood, Rosie Dawson-Damer, Fritzi (Ellen) Erhardt i Pamelu Haworth. Većina tih brakova završila je razvodom i znatnim nagodbama. Razvod od Pamele bio je posebno skandalozan zbog njezine veze s dr. Stoiescuom, koji je i sam vrlo imućan i kasnije se oženio Marijom Torres. Tracy je nedavno bila domaćica humanitarne večeri za International Animal Rescue i ostaje posvećena filantropiji. Ističe svoju praktičnost i povezanost sa svojim korijenima unatoč novom životu. Čitatelji su pozvani podržati udrugu, osobito u kampanjama za spas orangutana.

article_content: Generative AI may eventually displace some jobs, but for now, it's creating new opportunities for others. According to a recent report from the online freelance platform Fiverr, demand for certain digital services has surged. Over the past six months, global searches on Fiverr for freelancers with AI-content-editing skills jumped by more than 10,000% compared to the previous six months, with the United States seeing a more than 7,000% increase. A Fiverr representative told Insider that pay for these projects generally starts at around $100 to $125. Many businesses are searching for freelancers who can refine and legitimize AI-generated content—such as material created using ChatGPT. Clients often request help to fine-tune marketing materials or optimize AI-generated content for search engines. "Many small-business owners and entrepreneurs who use AI to generate content worry that their material might be penalized by search engines or might not connect with their audience," the representative said. "AI-content-editing services ensure a human touch so nothing is lost in translation." One example is editing AI-generated slide decks used in business presentations. As the representative noted, "Before AI, you needed a person to write text and design graphics. Now, entire presentations can be built from a single headline." Businesses are turning to AI content for a variety of reasons. For instance, in August, Time Magazine reported that Nao Medical—a New York City urgent-care clinic—had published numerous AI-generated articles to boost its search rankings, with titles like 'Why Are Unicorns Healthier Than Dragons.' As students and businesses continue to experiment with generative AI, the demand for content-editing services is likely to increase. While ChatGPT and similar tools often produce impressive results, they can sometimes spread misinformation or generate content that lacks clarity or appeal. There are concerns about the impact of AI on freelance work. Sheraz Shoukat, a Fiverr freelancer based in Australia who offers various writing services, told Insider that he hasn't seen much demand for AI editing so far. He believes the widespread adoption of technologies like ChatGPT could decrease demand for freelance writing. 'It has way more negative impact on our earnings,' he said. Content editing isn't the only AI skill gaining traction on Fiverr. Searches for 'prompt engineering' and 'AI video' services have grown by over 7,000% and 3,000% worldwide, respectively, in the last six months. These projects can command starting pay as high as $5,000. Are you a freelancer getting paid for work related to generative AI? If you're willing to share your experience, reach out to the reporter at jzinkula@insider.com.

article_content: Booking.com has settled a longstanding dispute over taxes in Italy by agreeing to pay 94 million euros (about $100 million), according to Genoa prosecutors. The investigation, launched in 2018, examined how the Dutch-based travel website handled taxation for properties listed on its platform. Italian tax authorities alleged that Booking.com failed to pay 153 million euros in value added tax for holiday rentals between 2013 and 2019. Investigators were given permission to question two of the company's former chief financial officers, and the scope of the investigation expanded to include 2022. This settlement followed direct negotiations between Booking.com and the Italian tax agency.
translated_content: Booking.com je riješio dugogodišnji porezni spor u Italiji pristavši platiti nagodbu od 94 milijuna eura (oko 100 milijuna dolara), navode tužitelji iz Genove. Istraga, pokrenuta 2018. godine, ispitivala je kako nizozemska platforma za putovanja obračunava poreze za nekretnine oglašene na svojoj stranici. Talijanske porezne vlasti tvrdile su da Booking.com nije platio 153 milijuna eura poreza na dodanu vrijednost (PDV) za iznajmljivanja u razdoblju od 2013. do 2019. Istražitelji su dobili odobrenje za ispitivanje dvojice bivših glavnih financijskih direktora kompanije, a opseg istrage proširen je i na 2022. godinu. Nagodba je postignuta nakon izravnih pregovora Booking.com-a i talijanske porezne uprave.

article_content: LivSYT, a construction management software provider founded by Karthik Thumu, announced on Tuesday that it raised $2.5 million in a seed funding round led by Silicon Valley Quad and Inventus Capital. This brings the company's total funding to $4.5 million. The new capital will support LivSYT's expansion into the US market and enable it to explore new applications of artificial intelligence and machine learning. LivSYT, founded in 2021, currently has an annual recurring revenue (ARR) of $1 million and aims to reach $5 million in ARR by November 2025, according to its Chief Financial Officer, Brajesh Bhanj Deo. Founder Karthik Thumu said, 'We are excited to embark on this new journey, leveraging the expertise and support of our investors to further our mission of transforming construction management.' The company noted that the global construction market was valued at $13.57 trillion in 2023, driven by increased investment in infrastructure projects worldwide and greater reliance on technology, particularly mobile platforms and AI, to improve efficiency and safety. In the United States, construction industry deliveries are projected to grow by 5.9% in 2023 according to real estate services firm JLL. Non-residential construction inputs in the US and Canada have surpassed historical averages, offering substantial opportunities for LivSYT's services. LivSYT's client portfolio includes consulting and engineering firms such as Systra, DRA, and Elemental Realty. The company provides on-site construction management software designed to boost project productivity and profitability. The on-site construction software sector in India has seen limited funding in recent years, with companies like Onsite raising $1.5 million in a 2022 seed round, and Powerplay securing $7.14 million in a Series A round led by Accel the same year.

Time je ukupno financiranje tvrtke doseglo 4,5 milijuna dolara. Novi kapital omogućit će LivSYT-u širenje na američko tržište i razvoj novih primjena umjetne inteligencije i strojnog učenja. LivSYT je osnovan 2021. godine i trenutno ima godišnji ponavljajući prihod (ARR) od 1 milijun dolara, s ciljem dosezanja 5 milijuna dolara ARR-a do studenog 2025., prema riječima financijskog direktora Brajesha Bhanj Deoa. Osnivač Karthik Thumu izjavio je: "Uzbuđeni smo što krećemo na ovo novo putovanje, koristeći stručnost i podršku naših investitora kako bismo unaprijedili našu misiju transformacije upravljanja građevinskim projektima." Tvrtka je istaknula da je globalno tržište građevine 2023. godine vrijedilo 13,57 bilijuna dolara, potaknuto povećanim ulaganjem u infrastrukturne projekte i većom upotrebom tehnologije, osobito mobilnih platformi i umjetne inteligencije, za poboljšanje učinkovitosti i sigurnosti. U Sjedinjenim Državama očekuje se da će se građevinski projekti povećati za 5,9% u 2023. godini prema podacima tvrtke JLL za nekretninske usluge. Ulaganja u nenastanjive građevinske projekte u SAD-u i Kanadi premašila su povijesne prosjeke, što predstavlja značajnu priliku za usluge koje nudi LivSYT. LivSYT-ev portfelj klijenata uključuje konzultantske i inženjerske tvrtke poput Systra, DRA i Elemental Realty. Tvrtka nudi softver za upravljanje gradilištima koji poboljšava produktivnost i profitabilnost projekata. article_content: Aniruddha Sarkar, Chief Investment Officer and Portfolio Manager at Quest Investment, affirms that India's midcap and smallcap sectors still provide attractive opportunities—especially for companies with promising earnings growth potential. While discussions over market valuation have heightened as benchmark indices reached new highs, Sarkar asserts that investors can still identify quality firms trading at fair value. He observes that many midcap and smallcap companies are surpassing the earnings growth rates of their largecap counterparts. Sarkar advises investors to focus on projecting where company earnings may be in the next 18 to 24 months, rather than concentrating solely on current valuations or past performance. Among various industries, Sarkar identifies domestic consumption—particularly organized retail and hotels—as areas with notable resilience. He explains that these sectors are largely disconnected from international market uncertainties, such as economic slowdowns in Europe or potential recessions in the United States. While some organized retail companies have high price-to-earnings ratios (40-70), their strong earnings trajectories often justify these premiums. Sarkar also highlights the hotel sector, which sees consistent demand from domestic travelers throughout the year. This ongoing activity, in his view, supports favorable valuations in the sector. Turning to industrials, Sarkar points to the wires and cables industry, which benefits significantly from real estate growth and industrial investments. Though Quest Investment has exited its holding in Polycab, Sarkar sees robust prospects for the sector, driven by ongoing infrastructure projects and anticipated increases in private sector capital expenditure following elections. Summing up, Sarkar maintains that the current Indian market environment still offers strong prospects among select midcap and smallcap stocks, particularly those positioned in growth-oriented domestic sectors like retail, hotels, and infrastructure.

Usprkos sve češćim raspravama o visokim tržišnim vrijednostima nakon rasta indeksa, Sarkar smatra da se među njima mogu pronaći kvalitetne dionice po realnim cijenama. Sarkar primjećuje da mnoge midcap i smallcap tvrtke bilježe veći rast zarade od velikih kompanija. Investitorima savjetuje da planiraju gdje će biti zarada kompanije u narednih 18 do 24 mjeseca umjesto da gledaju samo na prošlost ili sadašnju vrijednost. Izdvaja sektore domaće potrošnje, posebice organiziranu maloprodaju i hotele, kao vrlo otporne na globalne ekonomske promjene poput recesije u SAD-u ili usporavanja Europe. Iako dionice organizirane maloprodaje često imaju visoke omjere cijene i zarade, brz rast zarade opravdava takve razine. Posebno izdvaja hotelski sektor zbog stalne potražnje domaćih putnika, što podržava pozitivne procjene. Sarkar ističe i industriju žica i kabela, koja profitira od razvoja nekretnina i industrijskih investicija. Iako više ne ulažu u Polycab, vjeruje u dobre izglede sektora zbog infrastrukturnih projekata i očekivanog rasta privatnih ulaganja nakon izbora. Zaključno, Sarkar smatra da hrvatski investitori u indijskom tržištu mogu pronaći potencijal među midcap i smallcap dionicama, pogotovo u sektorima maloprodaje, hotela i infrastrukture.

article_content: Amerikanci bi napokon mogli doživjeti financijsko olakšanje u 2024. Bank of America objavila je svoju prognozu u ponedjeljak i navodi kako bi, nakon godine smirujuće inflacije i bez recesije tijekom oporavka od pandemije, kamatne stope mogle početi padati sredinom 2024. Dok Bank of America očekuje da će građani još osjetiti posljedice ranijih povećanja kamatnih stopa od strane Federalnih rezervi — što bi moglo usporiti rast i potencijalno povećati nezaposlenost — prognozira se 'meko prizemljenje' američkog gospodarstva. To znači da vjeruju kako će zemlja uspjeti obuzdati inflaciju bez ozbiljne recesije. Osvrćući se na prošlu godinu, Candace Browning, voditeljica BofA Global Researcha, izjavila je: '2023. iznenadila je gotovo sve: izostale su najavljene recesije, očekivana smanjenja kamatnih stopa nisu se ostvarila, tržište obveznica bilo je nestabilno, a rast dionica razočarao je oprezne ulagače.' Dodala je i: 'Očekujemo da će 2024. omogućiti središnjim bankama uspješno meko prizemljenje, iako je više rizika nego prilika.' Prema Michaelu Gapenu, čelniku odjela za američku ekonomiju pri banci, prvo smanjenje kamatnih stopa moglo bi doći u lipnju, a potom bi slijedio postupan tempo smanjenja od oko 25 baznih bodova po kvartalu do kraja godine. Ipak, Bank of America ističe 'neizvjesnost politike' uoči predsjedničkih izbora, koja bi mogla utjecati na odluke o kamatnim stopama ovisno o ekonomskim smjernicama kandidata. Ostali ekonomski stručnjaci nisu složni oko vremenskog okvira. UBS ekonomisti predviđaju da će Fed početi smanjivati stope već u ožujku, dok tim iz Vanguarda očekuje rezove u drugoj polovici 2024. Što se tiče samih Federalnih rezervi, smanjenje kamatnih stopa zasad nije u fokusu. Predsjednik Feda Jerome Powell je, nakon odluke u studenom o pauziranju povećanja stopa, rekao: 'Ne govorim o smanjenju kamatnih stopa.' Naglasio je da je prioritet Feda osigurati dovoljno restriktivnu monetarnu politiku kako bi se inflacija održivo vratila na 2%. Powell je ipak primijetio pozitivan pomak u gospodarstvu. Indeks potrošačkih cijena pokazuje godišnju inflaciju od 3,2 % u listopadu, što je pad u odnosu na 3,7 % u rujnu. Powell također trenutačno ne očekuje recesiju i ističe da su rizici u ekonomiji sve uravnoteženiji.

article_content: Jack Logan emerged as Hull FC's hero, scoring two late tries to secure a thrilling 24-19 victory over Leeds Rhinos and end their First Utility Super League season with a memorable comeback. Leeds appeared set to end a four-game losing streak after building a 19-4 lead just before the hour mark. However, the Airlie Birds rallied, handing Leeds another defeat ahead of their looming play-off against the Catalan Dragons. Carl Ablett stood out in the first half—denying Richard Horne a try in his 387th and final appearance for Hull before scoring himself to cancel out Tom Lineham's 16th-minute opener. After halftime, Leeds increased their advantage through Danny McGuire, who returned from injury to score a characteristic try, and Ryan Hall, whose effort marked his 200th career touchdown. Former Leeds player Gareth Ellis narrowed the deficit and then assisted Fetuli Talanoa for another Hull try, fueling Hull’s comeback. Logan’s late tries created a tense final ten minutes for Leeds, and the 19-year-old centre clinched the win for Hull. The first half offered few highlights, though Hall tried to liven things up after catching Kevin Sinfield's kick and combining with Ablett, but Hull regained possession. A handling error by Zak Hardaker allowed Logan to set up a straightforward try for Lineham in the corner. Leeds nearly responded immediately, but Talanoa’s critical tackle on Kallum Watkins denied a certain try after Sinfield broke through Hull’s defensive line. As halftime approached, Horne looked set to score, but Ablett made a crucial ankle tap to prevent the try. Ablett then scored at the other end three minutes before the interval, taking Rob Burrow’s pass and powering over. Sinfield added the conversion and a drop goal on the halftime whistle, giving Leeds a three-point lead at the break. McGuire, renowned for his support play, finished off a move started by Watkins early in the second half. Sinfield converted, though he later missed a penalty opportunity after a high tackle on Burrow. Nevertheless, Leeds extended their lead soon after with Hall’s try following good passing from McGuire and Liam Sutcliffe. Hull responded quickly: Ellis chased a grubber kick from Kirk Yeaman, controlling the ball with his knee and scoring. Ellis then provided an offload near the Leeds line for Talanoa to touch down. The momentum shifted at the KC Stadium as Logan scored from a Lineham pass, reducing Hull’s deficit. Rankin converted, narrowing the score to just one point. Pushed on by their passionate supporters, Hull continued their offensive push, and Logan secured the victory with his second try late on.

article_content: Stratospheric clouds over the Arctic may help explain why climate models often underestimate polar warming, according to researchers from UNSW Sydney. While Earth's average surface temperature has risen rapidly since the Industrial Revolution, warming at the poles is especially pronounced. Climate models account for this increased polar heating, but frequently still predict less warming than what is actually observed—especially for periods millions of years ago with very high greenhouse gas concentrations. This gap is problematic, as projections about future climate change use these same models. If models fail to capture past polar warming, they may also underestimate future risks such as ice sheet or permafrost melting. Scientists at the UNSW Climate Change Research Center noticed that most models do not accurately represent the upper atmosphere. Dr. Deepashree Dutta, lead author of the study, explained, 'During my Ph.D., I observed that the models we use do not represent the magnitude of warming in the Arctic.' She added that the poor representation of the atmosphere's upper layers might be the missing link. The team investigated polar stratospheric clouds—missing from most models—and found they could explain a significant portion of the missing warming. The study, published Nov. 7 in Nature Geoscience, shows there is still much to learn about the climate's past, present, and future, said co-author Dr. Martin Jucker. Climate models simulate our global climate system but can't incorporate every real-world process. Consequently, they often underestimate the extent of polar warming. Dr. Jucker noted, 'The more detail you include, the more resources are required. Often, surface detail is prioritized over upper atmosphere resolution.' In 1992, Dr. Lisa Sloan proposed that intense polar warming in past warm periods might be linked to polar stratospheric clouds. These clouds, also known as nacreous or mother-of-pearl clouds, form 15–25 km above Earth at very low temperatures and can trap surface heat much like greenhouse gases. 'These clouds form under complex conditions most models can't replicate, which may lead to underestimating polar surface warming,' said Dr. Dutta. Dr. Dutta tested this theory using a rare atmospheric model that includes polar atmospheric clouds. She set it to early Eocene conditions (over 50 million years ago), a warm period when the Arctic was ice-free year-round and methane levels were high. The researchers found that elevated methane in the Eocene increased polar stratospheric cloud formation, causing local surface warming of up to 7°C during winter. This helped align model simulations closer to climate record evidence. Importantly, the study showed methane alone isn't enough. Continental arrangement also played a crucial role in forming these clouds. Dr. Dutta said, 'If we input the same methane for future scenarios, we don't see the same cloud increase because today's continents are arranged differently.' The findings address why real-world polar temperatures often exceed model predictions and provide insights for future projections. 'Stratospheric clouds account for missing polar warming in models, which suggests future projections might also be too mild,' Dr. Jucker said. However, he added that the unique cloud formation conditions of the Eocene are unlikely to recur because of today's different continental layout. 'Our study highlights the value of improving climate model detail,' Dr. Dutta concluded. 'Until we include features like these clouds, we can't fully understand their impact.'
translated_content: Stratosferski oblaci iznad Arktika mogli bi objasniti zašto klimatski modeli često podcjenjuju zagrijavanje polarnih područja, navode istraživači s UNSW Sydney. Dok je prosječna temperatura Zemljine površine naglo porasla od industrijske revolucije, zagrijavanje na polovima posebno je izraženo. Klimatski modeli uzimaju u obzir ovo povećano zagrijavanje, ali često predviđaju manje zatopljenja nego što se zapravo mjeri—pogotovo za razdoblja stara milijunima godina s vrlo visokim koncentracijama stakleničkih plinova. Ovaj jaz predstavlja problem jer se projekcije budućih klimatskih promjena temelje na tim istim modelima. Ako modeli nisu precizni za prošla polarna zagrijavanja, mogli bismo podcijeniti buduće rizike poput otapanja leda ili trajno smrznutog tla. Znanstvenici iz Centra za istraživanje klimatskih promjena na UNSW-u primijetili su da većina modela ne prikazuje točno gornje slojeve atmosfere. Dr. Deepashree Dutta, glavna autorica studije, objasnila je: 'Tijekom doktorata primijetila sam da modeli koje koristimo ne prikazuju razmjer zagrijavanja u Arktiku.' Dodala je da loše prikazivanje gornjih slojeva atmosfere može biti ključna poveznica. Tim je istraživao polarne stratosferske oblake—koji nedostaju u većini modela—a otkrili su da oni mogu objasniti značajan dio 'nedostajućeg' zagrijavanja. Studija, objavljena 7. studenog u časopisu Nature Geoscience, pokazuje da još puno toga moramo naučiti o klimi prošlosti, sadašnjosti i budućnosti, rekao je suautor dr. Martin Jucker. Klimatski modeli simuliraju naš globalni klimatski sustav, ali ne mogu uključiti sve stvarne procese. Posljedično, često podcjenjuju opseg zagrijavanja na polovima. Dr. Jucker je napomenuo: 'Što više detalja dodate, više resursa je potrebno. Često se prioritet daje detaljima bližim površini nego onima u višim slojevima atmosfere.' Godine 1992. dr. Lisa Sloan predložila je da intenzivno zatopljenje polova u prošlim toplim razdobljima može biti povezano s polarnim stratosferskim oblacima. Ovi oblaci, poznati i kao biserni oblaci, nalaze se 15–25 km iznad Zemlje pri vrlo niskim temperaturama i zadržavaju toplinu na površini slično stakleničkim plinovima. 'Ti oblaci nastaju pod složenim uvjetima koje većina modela ne može reproducirati, što može dovesti do podcjenjivanja zagrijavanja polova,' rekla je dr. Dutta. Dr. Dutta je testirala ovu teoriju pomoću rijetkog atmosferskog modela koji uključuje polarne oblake i postavila ga na uvjete ranog eocena (prije više od 50 milijuna godina), toplog razdoblja kada je Arktik bio bez leda tijekom cijele godine, a razina metana bila visoka. Istraživači su otkrili da je povišena razina metana u eocenu povećala nastanak polarnih stratosferskih oblaka, uzrokujući lokalno zagrijavanje površine do 7°C tijekom zime. Ovo je uskladilo simulacije modela s klimatskim zapisima. Važno je što studija pokazuje da samo metan nije dovoljan. Položaj kontinenata također ima ključnu ulogu u formiranju oblaka. Dr. Dutta je rekla: 'Ako unesemo istu količinu metana u buduće scenarije, ne vidimo isti porast oblaka jer su današnji kontinenti drukčije raspoređeni.' Ova otkrića pomažu objasniti zašto su stvarne polarne temperature često više od modeliranih i nude uvide za buduće projekcije. 'Stratosferski oblaci objašnjavaju previđeno polarno zagrijavanje u modelima, što znači da bi i buduće procjene mogle biti preblage,' rekao je dr. Jucker. No, dodao je da se specifični uvjeti za nastanak oblaka iz eocena vjerojatno neće ponoviti zbog današnjeg rasporeda kontinenata. 'Naša studija ističe važnost poboljšanja detalja u klimatskim modelima,' zaključila je dr. Dutta. 'Dok ne uključimo ovakve oblake, ne možemo u potpunosti razumjeti njihov utjecaj.'

article_content: The Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIM Lucknow) has announced the launch of the fourth batch of its unique Chief Operations Officer Programme, starting December 30, 2023, in collaboration with Emeritus, a global leader in accessible education. According to IBM Insight (2021), 81% of COOs rely heavily on data to improve operational efficiency. As businesses face rapid changes in demand, technology, and data, the COO role has become increasingly strategic, focusing on operational transformation and greater customer-centricity. The position involves leading operational excellence, executing business strategies, driving innovation, mentoring teams, optimizing costs, and problem-solving across functions. The IIM Lucknow Chief Operations Officer Programme is designed for mid and senior-level professionals looking to advance or transition into COO roles. It blends live online sessions with a five-day on-campus immersion at IIM Lucknow and is best suited for those with over ten years of work experience. The curriculum features nine modules, a capstone project, and real-world case studies to help participants master operations and supply chain management. Upon successful completion, participants receive a certificate and eligibility for IIM Lucknow Executive Alumni Status. Graduates benefit from insights delivered by esteemed faculty and gain practical tools to digitize operations and improve supply chain efficiency. The programme fee is INR 5,50,000 plus GST, and is delivered by Emeritus via a high-engagement, digital learning experience. Over 2,000 professionals from India have advanced their careers by participating in IIM Lucknow’s executive certificate programmes through Emeritus. Its offerings range from short workshops to comprehensive learning programmes, and the company is backed by leading investors, with a valuation of $3.2 billion as of the 2021 funding round. article_content: Andrew Hall, an 18-year-old Stoke City under-18 midfielder, has been arrested on suspicion of murdering his 15-year-old girlfriend, Megan-Leigh Peat, who was fatally stabbed at a house in Ampthill, Bedfordshire, in the early hours of Saturday. Hall, currently hospitalized for a partially severed finger, has not yet been questioned by police. Megan-Leigh, who dreamed of becoming a midwife, was reportedly in an on-and-off relationship with Hall. Her family, including parents David and Nicola Peat, both 39, are mourning her loss and have left floral tributes at the scene. Tributes have also been left at the family's home in Westoning, Bedfordshire, where friends and relatives have set up a memorial. Initial media reports suggested there was a large party at the house, but police have clarified that only Megan-Leigh, Hall, and at least one friend were present after spending the evening at local pubs. Despite the efforts of emergency services who arrived at 1:30am, Megan-Leigh was pronounced dead at the scene. Hall was arrested in a nearby street shortly after and remains in hospital under police supervision. Megan-Leigh attended Harlington Upper School, where students are being supported, and friends have paid tribute by leaving flowers and messages. Specially trained Family Liaison Officers from the Major Crime Unit are supporting both parents during the ongoing investigation. A post-mortem examination is scheduled. Police and the football club have stated their support for the family, while the investigation proceeds.

Hall, koji je trenutno hospitaliziran zbog djelomično odsječenog prsta, još nije ispitan od strane policije. Megan-Leigh, koja je sanjala postati primalja, navodno je bila u povremenoj vezi s Hallom. Njezina obitelj, uključujući roditelje Davida i Nicolu Peat, oboje stari 39 godina, tuguje za njom i ostavila je cvjetne počasti na mjestu događaja. Cvijeće i poruke ostavljeni su i ispred njihove kuće u Westoningu, Bedfordshire, gdje su prijatelji i rodbina napravili spomenik u Megan-Leighinu čast. Prvotni medijski izvještaji sugerirali su da je u kući bila velika zabava, no policija je pojasnila da su nakon večeri provedene u lokalnim pubovima u kući bili samo Megan-Leigh, Hall i barem još jedan prijatelj. Unatoč naporima hitnih službi koje su stigle u 1:30 ujutro, Megan-Leigh je proglašena mrtvom na mjestu događaja. Megan-Leigh je pohađala Srednju školu Harlington, gdje učenici dobivaju podršku, a prijatelji joj odaju počast ostavljanjem cvijeća i poruka. article_content: MI5 head Sir Jonathan Evans has cautioned new recruits about the temptation to cut corners in efforts to catch terrorists. He stressed that working within the law and maintaining ethical standards is essential for upholding public trust in the security service. Sir Jonathan Evans pointed out that while spies might sometimes feel pressure to act quickly, long-term trust from the public and government can only be ensured by following legal and proportionate procedures. He warned that disregarding these standards could create enduring problems for the agency. These remarks were made amid plans to introduce secret courts in the UK, which would allow evidence from intelligence services to be heard privately. The proposed Justice and Security Bill, put forward by the government, would expand the use of closed court hearings in cases involving national security. Critics, including senior lawyers and former Army officers, argue that such measures could limit public oversight and scrutiny, possibly shielding intelligence officers who have knowledge of or involvement in practices like torture and rendition. Government ministers argue that such legal reforms are necessary, noting that foreign agencies like the CIA have reduced intelligence sharing with the UK out of concern about information being disclosed in open court. In an interview on BBC Radio 4, Sir Jonathan—who was named a Knight Commander of the Order of the Bath in the 2013 New Year's Honours—emphasized that MI5 must always act ethically and proportionally. He stated, ‘One of the things I always say to new members of the Service is that there may be a temptation to cut corners, but in the long term that will be a real problem for us. We depend on the support of government and ultimately the British people to do the things that we do.’ The two-part radio series, 'In Defence of Bureaucracy,' features Sir Jonathan discussing how bureaucracy and legal safeguards bolster public confidence and help officers act within the law. The programme, presented by former Cabinet Secretary Lord Gus O'Donnell, also includes contributions from former Deputy Prime Minister Michael Heseltine and Sir Antony Jay, co-author of 'Yes, Prime Minister'. Background: MI5 is the UK's security intelligence agency responsible for protecting the country and its interests from national security threats, primarily by detecting and disrupting terrorist activity within the UK. Its headquarters are at Thames House, London, with offices across Great Britain and Northern Ireland. Sir Jonathan Evans leads the agency under the oversight of the Home Secretary. MI6, or the Secret Intelligence Service, gathers intelligence relevant to the UK’s national security, defence, and foreign policy interests outside the UK. Its headquarters is at Vauxhall Cross, London. Sir John Sawers heads MI6, reporting to the Foreign Secretary.

article_content: Doctors have successfully saved all four quadruplets of expecting mother Ashley Gardner in what specialists are calling a 'miraculous' outcome. Ashley and her husband Tyson, who spent eight years trying to conceive, were overjoyed to learn of their rare pregnancy—two sets of identical twins, an event with odds estimated at one in 70 million. Earlier this week, doctors discovered that one set of twins was affected by twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS), a condition that disrupts the blood flow between identical twins sharing a placenta. After urgent medical intervention at Hollywood Presbyterian Hospital, Ashley underwent emergency surgery to correct the imbalance and prevent premature labor. Following the procedure, the couple shared their relief and gratitude on social media, announcing that doctors had detected steady heartbeats for all four babies. Tyson described the previous days as extremely stressful but expressed hope now that the surgery had succeeded. Ashley, who has struggled with endometriosis and undergone multiple failed fertility treatments, finally conceived through IVF. The Gardners' emotional journey—documented in viral videos and social media updates—has drawn national attention. According to the medical team, the surgery to address TTTS went exceptionally well, and Ashley will remain on bed rest for the remainder of her pregnancy. The Gardners are expecting four girls, who are due to be delivered by cesarean section in December.

Ranije ovog tjedna liječnici su otkrili da je jedan par blizanaca pogođen sindromom transfuzije krvi između blizanaca (TTTS), stanjem koje narušava protok krvi između identičnih blizanaca koji dijele posteljicu. Nakon hitne medicinske intervencije u bolnici Hollywood Presbyterian, Ashley je podvrgnuta operaciji kako bi se ispravila neravnoteža i spriječio prijevremeni porod. Nakon zahvata, par je na društvenim mrežama podijelio olakšanje i zahvalnost, objavivši da su liječnici zabilježili stabilne otkucaje srca kod sve četiri bebe. Ashley, koja se godinama borila s endometriozom i prošla kroz više neuspjelih pokušaja potpomognute oplodnje, napokon je začela putem IVF-a. Emotivno putovanje Gardnerovih—zabilježeno u viralnim videozapisima i objavama na društvenim mrežama—privuklo je veliku pozornost javnosti. Medicinski tim navodi da je operacija zbog TTTS-a prošla iznimno dobro, a Ashley će ostatak trudnoće provesti na strogom mirovanju. Gardnerovi očekuju četiri djevojčice, koje bi trebale biti rođene carskim rezom u prosincu.

article_content: The Children of Africa Leadership and Values Development Initiative (CALDEV) launches a four-day national children's leadership conference this Saturday, marking the 2023 International Universal Children’s Day. Themed 'Rebuilding Nigeria through Investment in Children’s Education, Welfare and Security,' the event features leadership training, a children's parliament, panel sessions, competitions, exhibitions, and award presentations. Distinguished guests include First Lady Oluremi Tinubu, Federal Capital Territory Minister Nyesom Wike, Dr. Yahaya Abubakar (Etsu Nupe and Chairman of Niger State Council of Traditional Rulers), Dr. Linus Okorie (National International Centre), Adewunmi Onanuga (Deputy Chief Whip, House of Representatives), Ojuawo Adeniyi (Deputy Chairman, House Committee on Air Force), Dr. Sabeeha Hussein (motivational speaker), and Oluwatosin Oyetayo (Junior Achievement Nigeria). First Ladies Dr. Olayemi Oyebanji (Ekiti), Fatima Bago (Niger), Gumsu Buni (Yobe), and Fatima Abbas (wife of the Speaker of the House of Representatives) are slated to receive awards in recognition of their efforts to champion child rights. Founded in 2015 by a serving National Assembly member representing Ede North, Ede South, Egbedore, and Ejigbo federal constituency in Osun State, CALDEV is dedicated to guiding and mentoring children and youth toward leadership and responsible citizenship.

article_content: Manuel Pellegrini has set his sights on winning the FA Cup this season to complete his collection of domestic honors in just his second year in charge at Manchester City. Achieving this would place the Chilean manager alongside Jose Mourinho as the only two managers from outside England to have won the FA Cup, Premier League, and Capital One Cup. While comparisons have been made to Mourinho, Pellegrini insists that his main motivation is personal. He is determined to win the FA Cup to compensate for last season’s disappointing exit to Wigan, a repeat of the previous year’s final. Reflecting on last season, Pellegrini noted that winning every competition is extremely challenging with a busy fixture schedule. With the Capital One Cup not in City’s plans this year, he hopes the team can progress in the FA Cup and continue fighting for the Premier League title. City are set to play Sheffield Wednesday again this weekend, a team they defeated 7-0 earlier in the season. Still, Pellegrini cautioned his players against complacency, pointing out that the first half of that previous match was competitive. Due to injuries to Edin Dzeko and Sergio Aguero, Stevan Jovetic is likely to have more opportunities to play. The 25-year-old Montenegrin striker, who has faced injury setbacks since his £22 million transfer from Italy in 2013, now feels fit and is eager to prove himself to City fans. Jovetic commented, 'I've had some difficult times with injuries over the past 18 months, but I feel much better now. I don’t think the City fans have seen the best of me yet, but if I stay healthy, they will soon.'

Iako ga uspoređuju s Mourinhom, Pellegrini tvrdi da mu je glavna motivacija osobna. Odlučan je osvojiti FA Cup kako bi nadoknadio prošlogodišnje razočaravajuće ispadanje od Wigana, ponavljanje finala iz prethodne godine. Osvrćući se na prošlu sezonu, Pellegrini je naglasio koliko je teško osvojiti sva natjecanja uz zgusnut raspored utakmica. Budući da ove godine nema Capital One Cupa, nada se da će njegova momčad dogurati dalje u FA Cupu i nastaviti borbu za naslov u Premier ligi. City će ovog vikenda ponovno igrati protiv Sheffield Wednesdayja, ekipe koju su ranije ove sezone pobijedili 7-0. Ipak, Pellegrini je upozorio igrače na opuštenost, ističući da je prvo poluvrijeme te utakmice bilo vrlo izjednačeno. A diplomatic rift emerged on Monday after UK Prime Minister Rishi Sunak canceled a meeting with his Greek counterpart, Kyriakos Mitsotakis, who was in London aiming to discuss Greece’s ongoing call for the return of the Parthenon Marbles from the British Museum.

Mitsotakis issued a statement expressing his disappointment over the cancellation and underlined the longstanding friendship between Greece and Britain. He stated he had hoped to raise not only the Marbles issue but also pressing global matters like Gaza, Ukraine, climate change, and migration. According to Mitsotakis, a strong case should stand up to open discussion.

Instead of Sunak, the UK offered a meeting with Deputy Prime Minister Oliver Dowden, which, according to the BBC, Mitsotakis declined. Sunak’s office underlined the significance of UK-Greece relations, citing areas like NATO cooperation and global crises, but omitted mention of the marbles.

For years, Greece has sought the return of the sculptures, taken by Lord Elgin in the 1800s. Half remain in London’s British Museum, while the rest are exhibited at the Acropolis Museum in Athens. In a recent UK TV appearance, Mitsotakis likened splitting the marbles to cutting the Mona Lisa in half, a comparison which reportedly frustrated British officials. The British Museum cannot return them under current law, though discussions with Greece over solutions such as a long-term loan have occurred. Sunak’s spokesperson stated there were no plans to alter this legal situation, emphasizing the marbles’ lawful acquisition and continued stewardship by the museum.

On the political front, Mitsotakis met with UK Labour leader Keir Starmer. Following the meeting’s cancellation, Labour criticized Sunak, questioning his leadership and insisting their party is ready to engage with Greece on important issues.

Mitsotakis je izrazio razočaranje zbog otkazivanja sastanka i naglasio dugogodišnje prijateljstvo između Grčke i Britanije. Istaknuo je da je želio razgovarati ne samo o pitanju skulptura, već i o ključnim globalnim temama poput Gaze, Ukrajine, klimatskih promjena i migracija. Po Mitsotakisu, jaki argumenti trebaju izdržati otvorenu raspravu.

Umjesto Sunaka, Vlada UK-a ponudila je sastanak s potpredsjednikom Oliverom Dowdenom, koji je, prema BBC-u, Mitsotakis odbio. Sunakov ured ističe važnost odnosa Grčke i UK-a, suradnje u NATO-u i zajedničkog rješavanja svjetskih kriza, ali nije spomenuo sporne skulpture.

Grčka dugi niz godina traži povrat skulptura koje je lord Elgin odnio početkom 19. stoljeća. Polovica preostalih skulptura nalazi se u Britanskom muzeju, dok su ostale u Muzeju Akropole u Ateni. U nedavnom nastupu na britanskoj televiziji, Mitsotakis je usporedio podjelu skulptura s rezanjem Mona Lise napola, što je izazvalo nezadovoljstvo britanske vlade. Britanski zakon zabranjuje povrat skulptura, iako se razmatraju rješenja poput dugoročnih posudbi. Sunakov glasnogovornik izjavio je kako nema namjere mijenjati zakon niti stav UK-a, naglašavajući zakonitost stjecanja i dugotrajnu brigu muzeja za skulpture.

Mitsotakis se također susreo s čelnikom britanske Laburističke stranke Keirom Starmerom. Nakon otkazivanja Sunakovog sastanka, laburisti su ga kritizirali, doveli u pitanje njegovo vodstvo i naglasili svoju spremnost na dijalog s Grčkom o važnim pitanjima.

Nearly 100 people were arrested in China for spreading doomsday rumors, according to Chinese state media. Among those detained are members of a banned anti-communist group called 'Almighty God,' who distributed leaflets predicting that the sun would stop shining and electricity would fail on December 21. The group has also called for a 'decisive battle' to defeat the Communist Party, which they refer to as the 'Red Dragon.'

Some people fear that the Mayan calendar’s end on December 21 signals the end of the world. In a related incident, a man who injured 23 children at a school in Henan province told authorities he was psychologically affected by apocalypse predictions.

A total of 93 arrests were made across seven provinces for distributing leaflets and spreading rumors about an impending apocalypse. Officials in Xining, the capital of Qinghai province, said cult members used the Mayan doomsday story to spread panic, predicting three days of darkness starting December 21.

Chinese authorities have intensified their crackdown on the 'Almighty God' group and stressed the importance of maintaining social stability, even as internet rumors continue to spread rapidly. The arrests reflect ongoing challenges in controlling misinformation and protecting party rule.

Ova skupina je također pozvala na "presudnu bitku" protiv Komunističke partije, koju nazivaju "Crveni Zmaj".

Neki strahuju da završetak majanskog kalendara 21. prosinca označava kraj svijeta. U povezanom incidentu, muškarac koji je ranio 23 djece u školi u provinciji Henan izjavio je vlastima da je bio psihički pogođen predviđanjima o apokalipsi.

Ukupno je u sedam provincija uhićeno 93 osobe zbog dijeljenja letaka i širenja glasina o nadolazećem smaku svijeta. Dužnosnici iz Xininga, glavnog grada provincije Qinghai, rekli su da su članovi kulta koristili priču o majanskom smaku svijeta kako bi širili paniku, predviđajući tri dana tame počevši od 21. prosinca.
