article_content: The Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is expected to discuss new regulations for investment platforms offering fractional ownership of real estate assets and changes to delisting rules at its meeting on November 25, according to two sources familiar with the matter. SEBI aims to allow companies with frequently traded shares to go private at a fixed price, moving away from the current reverse book-building process. Interest in fractional ownership platforms (FOPs) for real estate has grown significantly in the past 2-3 years, prompting SEBI to consider rules to regulate them. These platforms enable groups of investors to pool funds and purchase properties together, primarily pre-leased real estate generating rental income and potential capital appreciation. Returns are distributed after deducting management fees and other charges. The minimum investment on such platforms could range from ₹10 lakh to ₹25 lakh. Anuj Puri, Chairman of Anarock Property Consultants, noted that fractional ownership in income-generating assets is becoming an attractive option for retail investors, allowing them to access high-quality assets usually out of reach due to high price tags. Examples of domestic FOPs include PropShare, Hbits, Strataprop, AssetMonk, and Myre Capital. According to SEBI, the largest FOP manages assets worth ₹960 crore. Internationally, companies like US-based Fundrise handle billions in real estate assets. SEBI observed that unlisted securities are issued to investors in these platforms, and exits depend heavily on the platform finding buyers, which can result in limited liquidity and transparency. Regulation is seen as necessary to protect investors, increase market transparency, prevent unreliable operators, and attract more capital to quality assets. SEBI's board will also discuss whether companies can delist at a fixed price rather than through reverse book building, a change that would apply only to companies whose shares are actively traded. Recent IPO activity in India has been strong, with Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery all fully subscribed within hours of opening. IndiGo, India's largest airline, may introduce a premium class, hot food, and a loyalty program by the end of 2024 to attract business travelers and compete with Air India. Creditors have withdrawn over 26,500 insolvency cases involving defaults totaling ₹9.33 lakh crore before their applications were processed under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code (IBC), indicating the effectiveness of insolvency threats in debt recovery.

article_content: Mumbai, Nov 21, 2023: In a significant judgment offering relief to taxpayers, the Delhi High Court has clarified that the extended 10-year period for reopening income tax assessments is applicable only when the alleged escaped income exceeds Rs 50 lakh. For cases where the escaped income is below this threshold, the limit for reopening assessment remains three years. The court's decision came in response to multiple petitions concerning notices issued under Section 148 for the financial years 2016 and 2017. Petitioners had argued that when the escaped income is less than Rs 50 lakh, the limitation period prescribed in Section 149(1)(a) should apply, meaning only three years are allowed for reopening assessments. The tax authorities, however, maintained that their actions were valid due to a Supreme Court judgment in the Ashish Agarwal case (May 2022) and a circular from the Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT). The authorities further cited the Taxation and Other Laws (Relaxation and Amendment of Certain Provisions) Act, 2020 (TOLA), using a 'travel back in time' argument to justify later issued notices as if they were served earlier. The High Court found this interpretation unsound, specifically for cases involving escaped income under Rs 50 lakh. Legal expert Deepak Joshi praised the ruling, noting that it invalidates the 'travel back in time' theory contained in CBDT guidance, which is a positive outcome for taxpayers facing belated reassessment proceedings for lower amounts. As the decision applies generally (in rem), it will benefit those who did not file writ petitions as well. The Court also referenced the finance minister’s statement and the Finance Bill, 2021's documentation, which reduced the time limit for reenactments to three years from six to promote ease of doing business. The extended 10-year window is reserved for suspected tax evasion cases above Rs 50 lakh. Importantly, these new parameters apply retroactively for cases where Section 148 notices were issued after April 1, 2021. Separately, the Income Tax Department has reportedly uncovered nearly Rs 10,000 crore in tax evasion over three years by retailers selling via social media platforms like Instagram and Facebook. The department has sent notices to 45 brands, with more under scrutiny. In addition, over 20,000 GST notices have been sent since 2022, prompting Indian businesses to reevaluate tax liabilities before finalizing mergers or other key deals. In other news, Nawaz Modi has alleged that Gautam Singhania, managing director at Raymond, assaulted her and one of their daughters two months ago.

article_content: Chelsea's emphatic 6-0 victory over Arsenal on Saturday has put them at the forefront of the Premier League title race. While Mourinho refers to his team as underdogs, their recent performances suggest otherwise. Argentine President Cristina Fernandez has started a controversial effort to bring YPF, the country's biggest oil company, back under state ownership. Currently, Repsol, a Spanish energy firm, holds about 51% of YPF, but Fernandez's plan would give Argentina a controlling stake—marking a significant change in its energy strategy. The government insists this is about restoring national sovereignty, not returning to sweeping state control.

Spain and Repsol strongly oppose the move, warning it could damage Argentina’s global reputation and bilateral relations. European officials are siding with Spain, cautioning that the action could hurt foreign investment and economic confidence. YPF shares have fallen amid concerns over more government intervention.

Despite being an oil-producing nation, Argentina is facing a major energy crisis and has had to import large amounts of gas. Fernandez has blamed Repsol for failing to invest in YPF’s growth, which she says led to production problems. Supporters in Buenos Aires have rallied for the plan, with banners celebrating the idea of reclaiming YPF for Argentina.

However, specific details about how Repsol will be compensated remain unclear, worrying investors about legal fairness. Several Argentine provinces have also revoked some of YPF’s oil leases, citing lack of development. Meanwhile, international opinion is divided: while the EU and Mexico call for dialogue, Venezuela has expressed strong support for Argentina and offered to help its oil sector.

Critics—both inside and outside Argentina—fear the move may scare off investors, trigger economic retaliation, and create uncertainty across other business sectors. Despite this pushback, Fernandez insists her aim is to ensure Argentina controls its own resources for the nation’s benefit.

article_content: Police have released before-and-after photographs of Jamie Lynn France, a former Oregon beauty queen whose life was significantly impacted by drug addiction. France, 23, who won the Miss Teen Oregon-World pageant in 2009, was arrested on Wednesday on charges of possessing methamphetamine, heroin, and suboxone after she was located in a motel room with her alleged dealer. The images reveal France's physical changes before and after her involvement with drugs. Alongside France, police arrested Jarrod Wells, 37, who faces charges including possession and delivery of methamphetamine near a school, child neglect, and heroin possession. A five-month investigation led to police raiding a Keizer home shared by Wells and his partner Erin Wells, 37. Officers discovered more than one ounce of heroin, several grams of methamphetamine, and hallucinogenic mushrooms. Two boys, aged four and seven, were found in the home and taken into the care of relatives. Subsequently, police traced France and Jarrod Wells to a motel about three miles from the residence, where they found various drugs and records related to drug sales. Erin Wells was later booked on suspicion of child neglect, possessing methamphetamine and heroin, and frequenting a place where controlled substances are used. France was held on $30,000 bail and has since bonded out, as reported by The Oregonian. The Keizer Police Department released France’s arrest and prior photographs to warn the public about the potential dangers and long-term effects of drug abuse. In their statement, police emphasized the serious consequences for users, their families, and the community. According to her Facebook page, France had recently moved from Redmond, claimed she nearly died in a car accident earlier in the year, and subsequently lost her job. article_content: Iceland has declared a state of emergency and advised residents of Grindavík, located in the southwest, to evacuate due to the threat of a possible volcanic eruption. The Icelandic Met Office (IMO) announced late Friday that the highest level of civil protection is now in effect. However, officials clarified this is not an emergency evacuation, but residents should proceed with caution. According to the Icelandic Civil Protection Agency, 'there is no immediate danger,' and the evacuation is primarily a preventive measure to ensure safety. The IMO reported that, since midnight, over 800 earthquakes have occurred in the region where magma—a hot, molten rock beneath the Earth’s surface—is accumulating. Volcanic eruptions happen when magma breaches the Earth’s surface. The IMO indicated that significant magma movement is occurring in an area stretching from Sundhnjúkagígum in the north to Grindavík. The likelihood of a volcanic eruption happening soon is considered considerable. As a precaution, the Blue Lagoon, one of Iceland’s most popular tourist attractions near Grindavík, has been closed. The Reykjanes Peninsula, where Grindavík is situated, has experienced volcanic eruptions almost annually since 2021, with the most recent eruption in August 2023, according to the tourist website Visit Iceland. Experts suggest this recent activity may signal a new era of volcanic activity in the region after centuries of dormancy, as reported by National Geographic. Ingibjorg Lilja Omarsdottir of the Icelandic Civil Protection Agency told the BBC there is no risk of events similar to the disruptive 2010 Eyjafjallajökull eruption, which closed much of northern Europe’s airspace.

article_content: Microsoft and Alphabet, Google's parent company, have decided not to challenge their designation as 'gatekeepers' under the European Union's Digital Markets Act (DMA). The DMA is designed to rein in the market power of major tech firms by requiring them to ensure their services—such as social networks, messaging platforms, and web browsers—are compatible with competitors’ products. In September, the EU designated 22 services run by six major tech companies—Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, and ByteDance (owner of TikTok)—for tougher regulations. These rules mandate increased interoperability among messaging apps and give users more freedom to choose which apps to install by default. Companies that object to their 'gatekeeper' label have until November 16 to file appeals with the EU’s General Court in Luxembourg. While Microsoft and Google have accepted the new regulations and said they will cooperate with EU authorities, other firms, including TikTok and possibly Apple, are expected to challenge their designations. TikTok indicated its opposition, and Apple has not issued a public response, according to news outlets. Google, which operates the largest number of designated services, including Android, Maps, and Search, will be the most heavily impacted. Meta’s services—Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Marketplace—are also classified as gatekeepers. Meta and Amazon have yet to comment on the designations.

Cilj DMA-a je ograničiti tržišnu moć velikih tehnoloških kompanija tako što im nalaže da osiguraju kompatibilnost svojih usluga—poput društvenih mreža, aplikacija za razmjenu poruka i internetskih preglednika—s proizvodima konkurenata. U rujnu je EU odabrala 22 usluge koje vode šest velikih tehnoloških kompanija—Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft i ByteDance (vlasnik TikToka)—za strožu regulaciju. Nova pravila traže veću interoperabilnost između aplikacija za razmjenu poruka te korisnicima daju veću slobodu pri odabiru aplikacija koje će biti unaprijed instalirane. Kompanije koje se protive oznaci 'gatekeeper' imaju rok do 16. studenog za podnošenje žalbi Općem sudu Europske unije u Luksemburgu. Iako su Microsoft i Google prihvatili nove propise i najavili suradnju s europskim tijelima, druge tvrtke, uključujući TikTok i vjerojatno Apple, očekuje se da će osporiti svoje oznake. TikTok je naveo da se protivi odluci, dok se Apple nije javno oglasio, navode mediji. Google, koji vodi najveći broj označenih usluga—uključujući Android, Maps i Search—bit će najviše pogođen novim obvezama. Metaine usluge—Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp i Marketplace—također su označene kao 'gatekeeperi'. Meta i Amazon još nisu komentirali ove odluke.

article_content: Today marks the launch of EE’s 4G mobile network in the UK, offering significantly faster data speeds to millions in 11 cities. Promising speeds up to five times greater than 3G, the move is hailed as a technological leap, though experts flag high prices and restrictive data plans as obstacles to early adoption. EE—formerly Everything Everywhere—is debuting 4G in cities such as London, Bristol, Birmingham, Cardiff, Leeds, Sheffield, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Liverpool, Southampton, and Manchester. The cheapest plan offers 500MB for £36 per month, while going over this limit can result in up to £180 extra charges a year. The top EE plan provides 8GB monthly at £56. There are no unlimited data options. To access 4G, customers must switch their mobile contract to EE and have a compatible device, like the iPhone 5 or select models by Samsung, HTC, Nokia, or Huawei. Experts, including Jason Jenkins from CNET, recommend waiting for wider coverage and more affordable prices, since EE’s service is currently limited to those initial 11 cities. By the end of the year, EE aims to extend coverage to Belfast, Derby, Hull, Newcastle, and Nottingham, planning to reach 70% of the UK population, with a target of 98% by 2014. Competitor networks such as Vodafone, O2 (Telefonica), and Three are set to introduce their own 4G offerings from spring, spurred by legal disputes over Ofcom’s auction process that initially gave EE exclusive access. Vodafone recently rolled out a promotion allowing eligible clients to trade in their existing contracts for substantial discounts on 4G devices. However, with different operators using varying network frequencies, not all '4G-ready' phones will work on every network, a source of potential customer confusion. Research shows that 45% of UK consumers don’t see a need for 4G, and 29% don’t know what it is. Industry experts urge mobile companies to provide clear, jargon-free information. Olaf Swantee, EE’s CEO, calls the launch a landmark for UK mobile technology, but advisers suggest consumers think carefully before making the switch.

EE – prethodno Everything Everywhere – uvodi 4G u gradove kao što su London, Bristol, Birmingham, Cardiff, Leeds, Sheffield, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Liverpool, Southampton i Manchester. Najjeftiniji paket uključuje 500 MB za £36 mjesečno, a prekoračenje te granice može dovesti do dodatnog troška i do £180 godišnje. Najskuplja tarifa EE-a nudi 8 GB mjesečno za £56. Ne postoje opcije s neograničenim podacima. Za pristup 4G mreži korisnici moraju preći na EE i imati kompatibilan uređaj, poput iPhonea 5 ili nekih modela Samsunga, HTC-a, Nokije ili Huaweija. Stručnjaci, uključujući Jasona Jenkinsa iz CNET-a, preporučuju da se pričeka bolja pokrivenost i povoljnije cijene, jer je EE-ova usluga zasad dostupna samo u tih 11 gradova. Do kraja godine EE planira proširiti pokrivenost na Belfast, Derby, Hull, Newcastle i Nottingham, s ciljem da dosegne 70% stanovništva, a krajnji cilj je 98% pokrivenosti do 2014. godine. Konkurentske mreže poput Vodafonea, O2 (Telefonica) i Three planiraju lansirati svoje 4G ponude od proljeća, što je rezultat pravnih sporova oko Ofcomove aukcije koja je u početku EE-u dala ekskluzivu. Olaf Swantee, izvršni direktor EE-a, naziva lansiranje prekretnicom za britansku mobilnu tehnologiju, ali stručnjaci savjetuju korisnicima da dobro razmisle prije prelaska.

article_content: The Congress released its Telangana manifesto at Gandhi Bhavan on Friday, announced by party president Mallikarjun Kharge. The 42-page manifesto, titled “Abhay Hastham (The hand that protects)”, carries the slogan “Marpu kavali, Congress ravali” (Change is required, Congress has to come). It outlines six main guarantees should the party form the government. The manifesto includes various declarations: Warangal Rythu, Hyderabad Youth, Chevella Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe, Minority, and Kamareddy Backward Classes. Notable promises include gold coins for below-poverty-line (BPL) women at marriage, free scooters for girl students, free Wi-Fi for students, salary hikes for government and contract workers, and an increased minimum support price for crops. The party pledges more extensive welfare than the ruling Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) has offered. The manifesto covers 37 points on topics ranging from welfare for Telangana Movement martyrs’ families, farmers, and transgender people to excise policy and municipal development. It assures 24-hour free power to farmers and offers financial gifts for families below the poverty line: Rs 1 lakh and 10 grams of gold for the weddings of Hindu girls, and Rs 1.6 lakh for minority girls, called the “Indiramma” gift. Free electric scooters will be provided to women students above 18 years pursuing higher education. 1. Under the Mahalakshmi scheme, women will receive Rs 2,500 monthly assistance, LPG cylinders at Rs 500, and free travel on state-run buses. 2. Under Rythu Bharosa, Rs 15,000 per acre will be given to farmers, Rs 12,000 to tenant farmers, and a Rs 500 per quintal paddy bonus. 3. Under Gruha Jyothi, households will get up to 200 units of free electricity. 4. Under Indiramma Indlu, families without homes will receive land and Rs 5 lakh for construction; Telangana Movement martyrs’ families will get 250-square-yard plots. 5. Under Yuva Vikasam, students with Vidya Bharosa cards will receive up to Rs 5 lakh for educational expenses and every mandal will get a Telangana International School. 6. Under Cheyutha, a Rs 4,000 monthly pension will go to senior citizens, widows, people with disabilities, beedi workers, single women, toddy tappers, weavers, AIDS and filaria patients, and those undergoing dialysis. Rajiv Aarogyasri will offer health insurance up to Rs 10 lakh. The Congress also announces a crop loan waiver up to Rs 2 lakh, a promise to reopen closed sugar factories, establish a turmeric board, and increase the minimum support price for ten crops. The Minority Declaration states a caste survey will be conducted within six months of government formation, with fair reservations in jobs, education, and welfare for all backward classes, including minorities. The annual minority welfare budget will be raised to Rs 4,000 crore, and a dedicated minorities sub-plan will be created. Congress’s welfare promises often exceed those of the BRS, such as immediate Rs 15,000 per acre to farmers (BRS promises Rs 16,000 phased), Rs 4,000 per month pension (BRS promises Rs 5,000, phased), and Rs 500 LPG cylinders (BRS offers at Rs 400). Both parties promise land and construction aid for the homeless. A potentially contentious promise is a judicial inquiry into the Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation Project’s alleged irregularities, stating a sitting or retired High Court judge will conduct full investigations. The Congress cites recent controversy over damage to the Medigadda barrage. On legacy issues, Congress says it will name a district after former PM P. V. Narasimha Rao and promises greater support to Telangana Movement martyrs’ families—offering jobs, pensions, and withdrawing agitation-related cases. The party has pledged substantial welfare for Backward Classes, promising to increase BC reservation in local bodies to 42%, set up a Most Backward Classes ministry, and spend Rs 20,000 crore annually on BC welfare, even though it fields fewer OBC candidates than other major parties. It also promises sub-categorization in BC reservations, new leadership positions for BCs, corporations for BC development, loans for BC youth, and lowering pension eligibility age for those in caste-based occupations from 57 to 50.

Prema Yuva Vikasam, studenti s Vidya Bharosa karticama dobit će do 5 lakh rupija za obrazovne troškove, a svaki mandal dobit će Telangana međunarodnu školu. 6. Prema Cheyutha, mirovina od 4.000 rupija mjesečno bit će isplaćivana starijima, udovicama, osobama s invaliditetom, radnicima u industriji beedija, samohranim ženama, beračima toddyja, tkalcima, pacijentima s AIDS-om i filarijom te bubrežnim bolesnicima na dijalizi. Rajiv Aarogyasri pokriva zdravstveno osiguranje do 10 lakh rupija. Kongres također najavljuje otpis poljoprivrednih kredita do 2 lakh rupija, ponovno otvaranje zatvorenih šećerana, osnivanje odbora za kurkumu i povećanje minimalnih otkupnih cijena za deset kultura. Deklaracija za manjine predviđa provedbu kaste ankete unutar šest mjeseci od formiranja vlade, pravednu zastupljenost pri zapošljavanju, obrazovanju i socijalnim pravima za sve zaostale klase, uključujući manjine. Godišnji proračun za manjinska prava podignut će se na 4.000 crore rupija, a izradit će se i poseban pod-plan za manjine. Kongresova socijalna obećanja često nadmašuju ona BRS-a: npr. 15.000 rupija po hektaru bit će isplaćivano odmah (dok BRS najavljuje 16.000 kroz nekoliko godina), 4.000 rupija mirovine mjesečno odmah (BRS obećava 5.000 kroz faze), a plinske boce po 500 rupija (BRS nudi po 400). Obje stranke obećavaju zemljišta i sredstva za izgradnju domova za beskućnike. Potencijalno sporno obećanje je sudska istraga navodnih nepravilnosti u projektu Kaleshwaram Lift Irrigation, navodeći kako će istragu provesti aktualni ili umirovljeni sudac Visokog suda. Kongres spominje nedavnu kontroverzu oštećenja brane Medigadda. Što se tiče naslijeđa, Kongres obećava da će jedna županija nositi ime bivšeg premijera P. V. Narasimha Raoa te veću podršku obiteljima poginulih tijekom Pokreta za Telangana — nudeći zaposlenja, mirovine i povlačenje optužbi protiv sudionika. Stranka obećava značajna socijalna prava za zaostale klase: povećanje njihove zastupljenosti u lokalnim tijelima na 42%, osnivanje Ministarstva za najzaostalije klase i godišnja ulaganja od 20.000 crore rupija, iako ima manje OBC kandidata od drugih stranaka. Također obećava potkategorizaciju u kvotama za BC, nova vođenja za BC, korporacije za razvoj BC-a, kredite za mlade BC-a i smanjenje dobnog praga za mirovinu s 57 na 50 godina za one u zanimanjima vezanim uz kaste.

article_content: Scientists have discovered hundreds of harmful chemicals—including pesticides and pharmaceutical residues—in pellets made from recycled plastic collected in 13 countries, according to a recent study led by the University of Gothenburg. Because of these findings, researchers argue that recycled plastics are unsuitable for most uses, posing challenges to efforts aimed at developing a circular economy. Next week, delegates, scientists, and advocates from around the world will gather in Nairobi, Kenya, for the third session of the Plastics Treaty Intergovernmental Negotiating Committee (INC-3). Researchers plan to urge attendees to consider the latest scientific evidence: all plastics are manufactured using toxic chemicals and can absorb additional substances during their lifecycle, making it impossible to declare any plastic wholly safe or truly circular. Professor Bethanie Carney Almroth from the University of Gothenburg emphasized, "Plastic recycling has been promoted as a solution to the plastic pollution crisis, but the presence of toxic chemicals complicates reuse, proper disposal, and recycling." In their recent publication in Data in Brief on ScienceDirect, Carney Almroth and her team analyzed plastic pellets from recycling facilities in 13 countries across Africa, South America, Asia, and Eastern Europe. They identified 491 organic compounds and tentatively annotated another 170. Detected substances included pesticides, pharmaceuticals, industrial chemicals, and various plastic additives—many highly toxic. Currently, few regulations exist regarding chemicals in plastics, and the international plastics waste trade further complicates oversight. In a correspondence published this month in Science journal, researchers from the University of Gothenburg, IPEN, Aarhus University, and the University of Exeter note: "The hazardous chemicals present risks to recycling workers, consumers, broader society, and the environment. Before recycling can be a meaningful solution to plastic pollution, the plastics industry must significantly limit hazardous chemical use." With over 13,000 chemicals used globally in plastic production—and at least 25% classified as hazardous—scientists argue that no plastic chemical can currently be considered safe. Professor Almroth’s message for the Nairobi meeting is clear: "Numerous studies show that hazardous chemicals can accumulate even in relatively closed-loop recycling systems. It is urgent that we phase out harmful plastic chemicals to safeguard human health and the environment."
translated_content: Znanstvenici su otkrili stotine štetnih kemikalija—uključujući pesticide i farmaceutske ostatke—u peletima napravljenim od reciklirane plastike prikupljene u 13 zemalja, prema nedavnom istraživanju Sveučilišta u Gothenburgu. Zbog ovih nalaza, istraživači tvrde da reciklirana plastika nije prikladna za većinu namjena, što otežava razvoj kružnog gospodarstva. Sljedećeg će se tjedna delegati, znanstvenici i zagovaratelji iz cijelog svijeta okupiti u Nairobiju, Kenija, na trećoj sjednici Međuvladinog pregovaračkog odbora za Plastični sporazum (INC-3). Znanstvenici planiraju pozvati sudionike da uzmu u obzir najnovije znanstvene dokaze: sva plastika nastaje korištenjem toksičnih kemikalija i može tijekom života apsorbirati dodatne tvari, zbog čega nije moguće nijednu plastiku proglasiti potpuno sigurnom ili zaista kružnom. Profesorica Bethanie Carney Almroth sa Sveučilišta u Gothenburgu naglasila je: "Recikliranje plastike promovira se kao rješenje za plastičnu krizu, ali prisutnost toksičnih kemikalija otežava ponovnu upotrebu, pravilno zbrinjavanje i recikliranje." U nedavno objavljenoj studiji u časopisu Data in Brief na ScienceDirectu, Carney Almroth i njezin tim analizirali su plastične pelete iz postrojenja za recikliranje u 13 zemalja Afrike, Južne Amerike, Azije i Istočne Europe. Identificirali su 491 organski spoj i još 170 okvirno označili. Pronađene su tvari kao što su pesticidi, farmaceutski spojevi, industrijske kemikalije i različiti plastični aditivi—mnogi od njih visoko toksični. Trenutno postoji malo regulacija u vezi s kemikalijama u plastici, a međunarodna trgovina plastičnim otpadom dodatno otežava nadzor. U dopisu objavljenom ovog mjeseca u časopisu Science, istraživači sa Sveučilišta u Gothenburgu, IPEN-a, Sveučilišta Aarhus i Sveučilišta Exeter ističu: "Opasne kemikalije predstavljaju rizik za radnike u recikliranju, potrošače, širu zajednicu i okoliš. Prije nego što recikliranje postane smisleno rješenje za plastičnu krizu, plastična industrija mora znatno ograničiti uporabu opasnih kemikalija." U proizvodnji plastike globalno se koristi više od 13.000 kemikalija—najmanje 25% njih smatra se opasnima—zbog čega znanstvenici tvrde da nijedna kemikalija u plastici trenutačno nije sigurna. During a recent World Cup cricket match between India and South Africa, Virat Kohli faced criticism from Mohammad Hafeez, a former Pakistani cricket all-rounder. Hafeez accused Kohli of focusing too much on completing his own milestone—his 49th One Day International (ODI) century—by choosing singles over boundary shots in the final overs, implying that Kohli placed personal achievement above team interests.

Hafeez's remarks quickly drew responses from other former cricketers. Michael Vaughan, previously England’s cricket captain, dismissed Hafeez’s comments, describing them as 'utter nonsense.' Vaughan argued on social media that Kohli played a necessary anchor role on a challenging pitch and highlighted the team’s overwhelming win as evidence that Kohli’s approach was correct.

Indian ex-pacer Venkatesh Prasad also entered the discussion, suggesting that if anything, Kohli’s 'selfishness' is reflected in his commitment to realizing the hopes of countless fans and consistently setting new standards of excellence. Prasad, through a pointed social media post, redefined the criticism by applauding Kohli’s relentless drive and focus on ensuring his team’s victory.

This debate showcases varying interpretations of ambition and leadership in sports, particularly as players balance personal achievements with broader team goals.

Tijekom nedavne utakmice Svjetskog kupa u kriketu između Indije i Južne Afrike, Virat Kohli našao se na meti kritika Mohammeda Hafeeza, bivšeg pakistanskog all-roundera. Hafeez je optužio Kohlia da je previše usmjeren na vlastito postignuće—svoju 49. stoljeće u ODI utakmicama—jer je u završnim overima birao single umjesto udaraca za granicu, implicirajući da je stavio osobni uspjeh ispred interesa tima.

Na Hafeezove izjave brzo su reagirali drugi bivši igrači. Michael Vaughan, bivši kapetan engleske reprezentacije, odbacio je Hafeezove komentare kao "potpune besmislice". Vaughan je na društvenim mrežama istaknuo da je Kohli odigrao ključnu ulogu u teškim uvjetima i naglasio uvjerljivu pobjedu indijskog tima kao dokaz ispravnosti Kohliove taktike.

Bivši indijski bacač Venkatesh Prasad također se uključio u raspravu, sugerirajući da se Kohli "sebičnost" ustvari odražava kroz njegovu predanost ispunjavanju snova milijuna obožavatelja i podizanju ljestvice izvrsnosti. Prasad je kroz objavu na društvenim mrežama preoblikovao kritiku, pohvalivši Kohliovu upornost i fokusiranost na pobjedu svog tima.

Ova rasprava pokazuje različite interpretacije ambicija i vođstva u sportu, osobito kad igrači balansiraju između osobnih postignuća i ciljeva ekipe.

article_content: HomeGoods will be shutting down its online store after October 21, according to an announcement made to customers. The discount home decor retailer, owned by TJX Companies, stated in an email that it has decided to focus its resources on its brick-and-mortar stores and plans to announce many new store openings. HomeGoods is known for selling off-price furniture, lamps, art, and other home decor, attracting customers with its treasure-hunt shopping experience. TJX Companies reported in August that online sales are less than 2% of total revenue. Chief Financial Officer John Joseph Klinger noted in an August earnings call that e-commerce remains a very small part of the business, although new merchandise is regularly added to the company's websites. The cost of shipping large items, such as furniture and lamps, may have contributed to the company’s decision to close HomeGoods.com. This change will only affect the HomeGoods website; customers can still use HomeGoods gift cards and merchandise credit at other TJX-affiliated stores and websites. TJX Companies also owns TJ Maxx, Marshalls, HomeSense, and Sierra, but did not respond to Insider's request for comment. HomeGoods' online store originally launched in September 2021 after some hesitation over the best business model for its discount-oriented, in-person retail experience, according to a report from RetailDive. In the recent quarter, TJX reported net sales of $12.8 billion, up 8% from the same period last year, and is planning to open approximately 125 new stores in fiscal 2024. Some customers have voiced their disappointment on social media about the closure of the HomeGoods online store. One X user called the news 'devastating,' while another wrote on the brand's Facebook page about plans to cancel their card, citing inconvenience related to store locations. HomeGoods and T.J. Maxx employees are invited to share their experiences with this reporter via email or Signal app.

Microsoft is reportedly thinking about moving away from its often-criticized 'Metro' tile start screen, possibly returning to launching directly into the classic Windows desktop in new updates to Windows 8.1. Developer builds are already showing this default, according to insider sources. This follows earlier decisions to reinstate the Start button after customers expressed frustration with its removal.

The Metro interface, intended to create consistency across PCs, tablets, and phones—mainly for touchscreen convenience—has proven confusing for many users who prefer using a keyboard and mouse. Reports from The Verge and a Russian developer, Wzor, suggest that Microsoft is now prioritizing a better experience for these users by defaulting to the desktop view.

At a past Build developer conference, former CEO Steve Ballmer received positive reactions for confirming the Start button’s return and affirming users could boot straight to desktop. He also highlighted the Windows Store’s growth, surpassing 100,000 apps, with major new additions like Flipboard, Facebook, and the NFL. Looking forward, rumors say Microsoft is considering allowing Metro-style apps to run directly from the desktop, further integrating classic and modern Windows experiences.

Prema izvorima iznutra, razvojne verzije sustava već to prikazuju kao zadanu postavku. Ova promjena dolazi nakon što je Microsoft, zbog povratnih informacija korisnika, prethodno vratio Start gumb.

Metro sučelje, osmišljeno kako bi ujedinilo iskustvo korištenja na PC-ju, tabletima i telefonima – prije svega radi lakšeg korištenja na ekranima osjetljivim na dodir – pokazalo se zbunjujućim mnogim korisnicima koji preferiraju tipkovnicu i miša. Izvješća portala The Verge te ruskog developera poznatog kao Wzor sugeriraju da Microsoft sada prioritet daje upravo tim korisnicima, te zadano postavlja radnu površinu kao početni zaslon.

Na developerskoj konferenciji Build, bivši direktor Steve Ballmer dobio je ovacije nakon što je potvrdio povratak Start gumba i omogućavanje pokretanja direktno na radnu površinu. Istaknuo je i rast Windows Store-a, koji je premašio brojku od 100.000 aplikacija, uključujući značajne novitete poput Flipboarda, Facebooka i NFL-a. Prema najnovijim glasinama, Microsoft razmatra i omogućavanje pokretanja Metro aplikacija izravno s radne površine, čime bi dodatno spojio klasične i moderne značajke Windows-a.

article_content: Nottingham Forest fans traveled to White Hart Lane for the Capital One Cup match against Tottenham Hotspur, many wearing commemorative green jumpers honoring their legendary former manager, Brian Clough, who passed away ten years ago this week. Capital One, the tournament sponsor, gifted 1,000 green jumpers to Forest supporters to commemorate Clough’s influential legacy. The jumpers replicate the iconic round-neck style frequently worn by Clough during his 18-year spell as Forest manager from 1975 to 1993. Photographs posted on the Capital One Cup Twitter page captured large groups of Forest fans queuing to board coaches for their trip to London, while television crews documented their departure. Some supporters also received the commemorative jumpers at the stadium on a first-come, first-served basis, further highlighting Clough’s enduring presence in the club’s culture. Clough led Nottingham Forest to their most successful period, including two consecutive European Cup victories (1979, 1980), a league title, and four League Cup triumphs. Last Sunday, Forest and Derby County fans united to honor Clough with a minute’s applause during their Championship fixture, recognizing his achievements as a manager for both clubs. On the pitch at White Hart Lane, Forest fans celebrated as Jorge Grant put the visitors ahead, though Forest eventually lost 3-1. Forest players applauded their traveling supporters after the match, acknowledging their loyal presence. John McGovern, Nottingham Forest’s club ambassador, praised Clough’s unique character and lasting impact, stating, 'Brian was simply the best. There will never ever be anyone in football quite like Brian again.' Jason Carr, head of sponsorship at Capital One, emphasized the company’s connection to Nottingham and expressed hope that the green jumpers would serve as a meaningful tribute to Clough.

article_content: Saudi Arabia is considering purchasing a multibillion-dollar stake in the Indian Premier League (IPL), cricket’s most lucrative competition. This move comes after several major Saudi investments in football and golf. According to sources familiar with the matter, advisers to Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman held discussions with Indian government officials about potentially restructuring the IPL as a holding company valued at up to $30 billion, allowing Saudi Arabia to take a substantial stake.  The talks reportedly took place during Prince Mohammed’s visit to India in September. The plan could see Saudi Arabia invest as much as $5 billion and spearhead IPL’s future expansion into foreign markets, similar to the English Premier League and the European Champions League. Final decisions have not yet been made, and the Indian government along with the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI) are expected to consider the proposal after the upcoming federal elections. The BCCI is currently led by Jay Shah, son of India’s Home Minister Amit Shah.  Saudi Arabia’s sovereign wealth fund (Public Investment Fund or PIF), which has backed numerous previous sports deals, would likely facilitate this investment if approved. Representatives from the BCCI and Saudi Arabia’s Center for International Communication have not provided comments.  Since beginning in 2008, the IPL has combined American-style marketing, Bollywood glamour, and India’s large population to create a high-energy, short-format spectacle. This strategy includes three-to-four-hour matches that encourage aggressive play and frequent big scoring shots, making games more exciting for broadcasters and sponsors. Major partners include Aramco and Saudi Arabia’s tourism authority. Despite the league’s short eight-week season, a recent media rights auction attracted $6.2 billion in bids for coverage through 2027, equating to $15.1 million per match—more than the English Premier League and close to the NFL in the US.  Should Saudi Arabia make a significant investment or prompt changes to the IPL’s structure, existing broadcasting and media rights agreements would likely need to be renegotiated, according to industry experts.  Saudi Arabia has invested heavily in global sports in recent years, expressing ambitions to establish itself as a major cricket hub. England cricket captain Ben Stokes commented that the financial power Saudi Arabia brings is difficult to match. Meanwhile, other leagues seek to mimic the IPL’s success, such as the US-based Major League Cricket, part-funded by Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella and Adobe CEO Shantanu Narayen, as well as efforts in South Africa and the UAE. These projects, however, have yet to challenge IPL’s commercial supremacy.  Saudi spending in sport includes funding for LIV Golf and buying Newcastle United FC, as well as bidding to host the 2034 FIFA World Cup. The kingdom has spent large sums on players like Neymar, Karim Benzema, and Cristiano Ronaldo. While these moves have drawn criticism related to 'sportswashing' and attention to Saudi Arabia’s human rights record, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman maintains that these investments are aimed at economic growth.
translated_content: Saudijska Arabija razmatra kupovinu udjela vrijednog više milijardi dolara u Indijskoj Premier ligi (IPL), najprofitabilnijem natjecanju u kriketu. Ovaj potez dolazi nakon nekoliko velikih saudijskih ulaganja u nogomet i golf. Prema izvorima upoznatima s temom, savjetnici prijestolonasljednika Mohammeda bin Salmana razgovarali su s indijskim vladinim dužnosnicima o mogućem restrukturiranju IPL-a u holding kompaniju procijenjenu na do 30 milijardi dolara, što bi Saudijskoj Arabiji omogućilo značajan udio.  Pregovori su navodno održani tijekom posjeta princa Mohammeda Indiji u rujnu. Plan bi mogao rezultirati saudijskim ulaganjem do 5 milijardi dolara i vodstvom u budućoj ekspanziji IPL-a na strana tržišta, slično Engleskoj Premier ligi i Ligi prvaka. Konačne odluke još nisu donesene, a indijska vlada i Odbor za kontrolu kriketa u Indiji (BCCI) razmotrit će prijedlog nakon predstojećih saveznih izbora. BCCI trenutno vodi Jay Shah, sin indijskog ministra unutarnjih poslova Amita Shaha.  Saudijski suvereni investicijski fond (Public Investment Fund ili PIF), koji je već podupirao brojne sportske ugovore, vjerojatno bi bio glavni kanal za ulaganje, ako bude odobreno. Predstavnici BCCI-ja i Centra za međunarodnu komunikaciju Saudijske Arabije nisu dali komentare.  Od početka 2008. godine, IPL je spojio američki stil marketinga, bollywoodsku raskoš i veliko indijsko stanovništvo u dinamičan, kratki format natjecanja. Ova strategija uključuje utakmice u trajanju od tri do četiri sata koje potiču agresivnu igru i česta velika postignuća, čineći ih atraktivnijima za emitere i sponzore. Među glavnim partnerima su Aramco i Saudijska turistička uprava. Iako liga traje samo osam tjedana godišnje, na nedavnoj aukciji medijskih prava ponuđeno je 6,2 milijarde dolara za prijenos do 2027., što iznosi 15,1 milijun dolara po utakmici—više nego u Engleskoj Premier ligi i gotovo kao u NFL-u u SAD-u.  Ako Saudijska Arabija ostvari veliko ulaganje ili promijeni strukturu IPL-a, trenutno važeći ugovori o pravima prijenosa i medijskim pravima vjerojatno će trebati biti ponovno razmotreni, tvrde industrijski stručnjaci.  Saudijska Arabija posljednjih je godina intenzivno ulagalo u svjetski sport, sa željom da postane glavni čimbenik u kriketu. Kapetan engleske reprezentacije Ben Stokes izjavio je kako je financijsku snagu Saudijske Arabije teško nadmašiti. U međuvremenu, druge lige pokušavaju oponašati uspjeh IPL-a, poput američke Major League Cricket, koju djelomično financiraju Satya Nadella (CEO Microsofta) i Shantanu Narayen (CEO Adobea), kao i liga u Južnoafričkoj Republici i UAE-u. Međutim, ovi projekti još nisu izazvali komercijalnu dominaciju IPL-a.  Saudijska ulaganja u sport uključuju podršku LIV golfu, kupnju Newcastle United FC-a te kandidaturu za domaćina Svjetskog prvenstva u nogometu 2034. article_content: Nearly two weeks after Arizona’s largest wildfire swept through, residents of Greer are finally returning home. The Wallow Fire forced the evacuation of this 200-person community starting June 6, destroying at least 22 homes, 24 outbuildings, and one truck. Residents with proper ID were permitted to return on Monday, with Greer opening to visitors Tuesday, according to the Southwest Incident Management Team leading firefighting efforts. Authorities report steady progress, stating the blaze is now 56% contained. Weather is improving, with lighter winds and higher humidity expected Tuesday, making it easier for crews battling several active wildfires across Arizona. Over the weekend and Monday, flames outpaced firefighters in some regions, notably near the Monument Fire in southern Arizona—currently identified as the nation’s No. 1 priority, according to U.S. Forest Service Chief Tom Tidwell. Forecasts from the National Weather Service predict calmer conditions in southern Arizona, with winds expected between 5 and 10 mph—substantially less than the 30-plus mph gusts during the weekend. Across the United States, wildfires have already burned about 3.1 million acres in the first five months of 2011, almost matching the total acreage burned during all of 2010, per the National Interagency Fire Center. (With reporting from CNN’s Ed Payne and Greg Botelho.)

Stanovnicima s ispravnom identifikacijom dopušten je povratak u ponedjeljak, a Greer se za posjetitelje otvara u utorak, prema Southwest Incident Management Teamu koji vodi gašenje. Nadležne službe izvještavaju o stalnom napretku—požar je sada pod kontrolom 56%. Vremenske prilike se poboljšavaju, s blažim vjetrom i višom vlagom predviđenima za utorak, što pomaže ekipama koje se bore protiv nekoliko požara diljem Arizone. Nacionalna meteorološka služba predviđa mirnije uvjete na jugu države, s vjetrom između 8 i 16 km/h—znatno manje nego tijekom vikenda kad su puhali udari preko 50 km/h. article_content: A remarkable collection of early tabloid newspapers, known as 'Execution Broadsides,' is set to go under the hammer next week. These rare single-sheet publications documented the shocking crimes, trials, and dying confessions of those hanged in the 18th and 19th centuries. Typically sold for a penny near the gallows on execution days, the broadsides included dramatic descriptions of crimes, woodcut illustrations, details of the convicted person's final hours, and their last words. 'Execution Broadsides' emerged with the advent of cheap printing in the 16th and 17th centuries, quickly evolving into one of the earliest forms of tabloid journalism. Vendors gathered at execution sites, selling these memorable sheets alongside food, drinks, souvenirs, and other wares to crowds eager for both entertainment and news. The collection now being auctioned at Dominic Winter Auctioneers in Cirencester, Gloucester, consists of eleven broadsides from the 18th and 19th centuries. These feature notorious cases such as Patrick Carroll's trial for the murder of Mrs. Browning in 1835, Henry Hughes's 1834 execution for violating eight-year-old Emma Cock, William Harley's hanging for burglary in 1836, the 1841 execution of R. Blakesley for killing James Burdon, J. Tawell’s 1845 confession and execution for the murder of Sarah Hart, and the tragic case of James Andrew Macauley, a young sailor murdered in 1834. Each broadside provided readers with detailed narratives and illustrations, often using sensational and dramatic language to attract attention. Chris Albury, senior auctioneer and valuer, describes them as entertaining examples of early tabloid journalism, noting their crude woodcut images and the public’s fascination with grisly stories. ‘The more gruesome the crime, the more interested people are,’ Albury remarked. Headlines from the collection include accounts such as ‘The Father’s Crime; or Fatal Curiosity. An affecting and true history of The Unnatural Murder of James Andrew Macauley, a Young Sailor, For his Wealth, and who proved, on the Morning after the Fatal Deed, to be the Murderer’s long-lost and only son!’ As broadsides catered to the public interest, they often covered multiple types of crimes, with some focused on murder and others on offenses like burglary. The auction highlights the enduring fascination with forensic narratives and the evolution of crime reporting, preserving a dramatic chapter of media history for collectors and historians.
translated_content: Izvanredna kolekcija ranih tabloidnih novina, poznatih kao 'Execution Broadsides', uskoro će biti ponuđena na aukciji. Ove rijetke jednodnevne publikacije bilježile su šokantne zločine, suđenja i posljednje ispovijesti osoba obješenih u 18. i 19. stoljeću. Obično su se prodavale za jedan peni blizu vješala na dan pogubljenja, a sadržavale su dramatične opise zločina, drvoreze, detalje o posljednjim satima osuđenika i njihove posljednje riječi. 'Execution Broadsides' pojavile su se s razvojem jeftinog tiska u 16. i 17. stoljeću, brzo evoluirajući u jedan od najranijih oblika tabloidnog novinarstva. Prodavači su se okupljali na mjestima pogubljenja, prodavajući ove nezaboravne listove uz hranu, piće, suvenire i drugu robu mnoštvu željnom zabave i vijesti. Kolekcija koja će uskoro biti aukcionirana u Dominic Winter Auctioneersu u Cirencesteru, Gloucestershire, obuhvaća jedanaest broadsida iz 18. i 19. stoljeća. Sadrži poznate slučajeve poput suđenja Patricka Carrolla za ubojstvo gospođe Browning 1835. godine, pogubljenja Henryja Hughesa 1834. zbog nasilja nad osmogodišnjom Emmom Cock, vješanja Williama Harleya zbog provale 1836., pogubljenja R. Blakesleya 1841. za ubojstvo Jamesa Burdona, priznanja i pogubljenja J. Tawella 1845. za ubojstvo Sarah Hart te tragičnog slučaja Jamesa Andrewa Macauleya, mladog mornara ubijenog 1834. Svaki broadsid nudio je čitateljima detaljne pripovijesti i ilustracije, često koristeći senzacionalistički i dramatičan jezik kako bi privukao pažnju. Chris Albury, viši aukcionar i procjenitelj, opisuje ih kao zabavne primjere ranog tabloidnog novinarstva, ističući njihove grube drvoreze i fascinaciju javnosti mračnijim pričama. 'Što je zločin jeziviji, to su ljudi više zainteresirani', komentirao je Albury. Naslovi iz kolekcije uključuju zapise poput 'Očev zločin; ili Fatalna znatiželja. Dirljiva i istinita povijest neprirodnog ubojstva Jamesa Andrewa Macauleya, mladog mornara, zbog njegovog bogatstva, a koji se jutro nakon kobnog djela pokazao kao davno izgubljeni i jedini sin ubojice!' Broadsidi su zadovoljavali interese javnosti i često su pokrivali različite vrste zločina, neki su se bavili ubojstvima, a drugi djelima poput provale. Aukcija naglašava trajnu fascinaciju forenzičkim pričama i razvoj izvještavanja o kriminalu, čuvajući dramatično poglavlje medijske povijesti za kolekcionare i povjesničare.

article_content: In his first interview since Facebook went public in May, CEO Mark Zuckerberg acknowledged that the company’s poor stock market debut had hurt its image. Speaking at a technology conference in San Francisco, Zuckerberg admitted, 'The performance of the stock has obviously been disappointing.' During the interview, he also shared insights into his coding approach, saying to applause, 'Everything I do breaks, but we fix it quickly.' The interview comes amid significant internal challenges, including the departure of several top executives and a drop in company morale after Facebook’s share price plunged to nearly half of its IPO value. At TechCrunch Disrupt, interviewer Michael Arrington—who has previously been critical of Facebook—asked about the impact of falling stock values on staff morale. Zuckerberg replied, 'Well, it doesn't help.' Employees paid in stock have been most affected, but Zuckerberg explained that Facebook adjusts compensation to account for undervalued shares. He emphasized Facebook’s focus on long-term value: 'We're going to do the things we think will build value over the long run.' He reiterated that Facebook is a mission-driven company, aiming to make the world more open and transparent, but acknowledged the need for a strong business model. Zuckerberg’s appearance was seen as an effort to re-energize the company and stem the departure of key staff, as five department heads left over the summer. 'I actually think that it's a great time for people to stay,' Zuckerberg said, drawing some applause from the audience. Analysts noted a positive market response: Facebook's stock rose by two percent in after-hours trading, increasing the company's market capitalization by $1.7 billion following the interview. Zuckerberg took a cautious approach to the company’s public image, telling employees not to be swayed by overly positive or negative press. He admitted to missteps, especially focusing too long on HTML for web instead of prioritizing mobile development. He now views mobile as essential for Facebook's growth and advertising revenue, noting higher engagement and user numbers on phones compared to computers. 'I basically live on my mobile device,' he said, explaining that the founders' letter in Facebook's S-1 was written on his phone. Addressing persistent rumors, Zuckerberg once again denied that Facebook has plans to develop its own phone, stating it's better for the platform to be available on all devices. He explained that launching a proprietary phone would reach too small a user base to be viable for Facebook. Zuckerberg mentioned ongoing development of Facebook’s Android app and improvements to the search function, which he believes is underutilized. He suggested deeper integration with user data would make search more powerful, such as helping people find where friends have eaten or work. He praised tech startups like Airbnb, Spotify, and Instagram—highlighting Instagram’s strong performance after Facebook acquired it. Despite challenges, Zuckerberg remained focused on Facebook’s mission: 'For me it's not really about fun. It's about mission. There are cycles of optimism and pessimism. I’d rather be underestimated. That gives us freedom.' He closed by reflecting on Facebook’s long-term vision: connecting everyone and enabling them to share freely.
translated_content: U svom prvom intervjuu otkako je Facebook izašao na burzu u svibnju, izvršni direktor Mark Zuckerberg priznao je da je loš debi tvrtke na burzi narušio njezin imidž. Govoreći na tehnološkoj konferenciji u San Franciscu, Zuckerberg je priznao: 'Očito je da je izvedba dionica bila razočaravajuća.' Tijekom intervjua je podijelio i svoja razmišljanja o kodiranju, izjavivši uz pljesak: 'Sve što radim se pokvari, ali to brzo popravimo.' Intervju se događa usred znatnih internih izazova, uključujući odlazak nekoliko vodećih rukovoditelja i pad morala zaposlenika nakon što je cijena dionica Facebooka pala na gotovo polovicu vrijednosti s burzovnog debija. Na konferenciji TechCrunch Disrupt, voditelj Michael Arrington—koji je ranije bio kritičan prema Facebooku—upitao je kako pad vrijednosti dionica utječe na moral zaposlenika. Zuckerberg je odgovorio: 'Pa, ne pomaže.' Najviše su pogođeni zaposlenici koji dio plaće primaju u dionicama, no Zuckerberg je objasnio kako Facebook prilagođava naknade kako bi nadoknadio podcijenjene dionice. Naglasio je Facebookovu usmjerenost na dugoročnu vrijednost: 'Radit ćemo ono što mislimo da će u konačnici povećati vrijednost.' Ponovno je istaknuo da je Facebook kompanija vođena misijom čiji je cilj učiniti svijet otvorenijim i transparentnijim, ali je priznao i potrebu za snažnim poslovnim modelom. Zuckerbergov nastup doživljen je kao pokušaj da ponovno potakne energiju u tvrtki i spriječi odlaske ključnog osoblja jer je tijekom ljeta otišlo pet voditelja odjela. 'Zapravo mislim da je ovo odlično vrijeme za ostati,' rekao je Zuckerberg, što je naišlo na pljesak publike. Analitičari su primijetili pozitivan tržišni odjek: dionica Facebooka porasla je za dva posto u trgovini nakon zatvaranja burze, a tržišna kapitalizacija tvrtke povećana je za 1,7 milijardi dolara nakon intervjua. Zuckerberg je zauzeo oprezan pristup javnoj slici tvrtke, govoreći zaposlenicima da ne vjeruju previše ni pozitivnim ni negativnim napisima. Priznao je i pogreške, osobito to što su se predugo fokusirali na HTML za web umjesto da prijeđu na razvoj za mobilne uređaje. Sada mobilne uređaje smatra ključnima za rast Facebooka i prihode od oglašavanja, ističući kako je angažman i broj korisnika veći na telefonima nego na računalima. 'Praktički živim na svom mobitelu,' rekao je, objašnjavajući da je pismo osnivača u Facebookovu S-1 dokumentu napisao na svom telefonu. Odgovarajući na uporne glasine, Zuckerberg je još jednom odbacio da Facebook planira razvijati vlastiti mobilni telefon, ističući kako je bolje biti prisutan na svim uređajima. Objasnio je kako lansiranje vlastitog uređaja ne bi donijelo dovoljno korisnika da bi imalo smisla za Facebook. Zuckerberg je spomenuo i razvoj Facebookove Android aplikacije te poboljšanja tražilice, za koju smatra da je trenutno nedovoljno iskorištena. Predložio je dublju integraciju s korisničkim podacima kako bi pretraživanje bilo korisnije, primjerice u pronalaženju mjesta na kojima su prijatelji jeli ili gdje rade. Pohvalio je tehnološke tvrtke poput Airbnba, Spotifyja i Instagrama—naročito istaknuvši uspjeh Instagrama nakon što ga je Facebook preuzeo. Unatoč izazovima, Zuckerberg je ostao usmjeren na Facebookovu misiju: 'Za mene nije stvar u zabavi, već u misiji. Postoje ciklusi optimizma i pesimizma. Više volim biti podcijenjen jer nam to daje slobodu.' Za kraj je istaknuo dugoročnu viziju Facebooka: povezati sve ljude i omogućiti im slobodno dijeljenje sadržaja.

article_content: UK ministers are reviewing plans to prevent a possible influx of money and people from Europe if the single currency, the euro, collapses. Experts fear that the collapse could trigger significant movements of both people and capital, with potentially harmful consequences for Britain if unaddressed. The Treasury is working on contingency plans to block investors from transferring large sums from the Eurozone to Britain, amid concerns that such inflows could strengthen the Pound too much. Additionally, officials have indicated that Britain's borders might be temporarily closed to economic refugees if widespread unrest erupts in Europe. The Foreign Office is preparing for possible emergency evacuations of thousands of British citizens and tourists from affected countries. Officials emphasize that these plans are only precautions and do not suggest the government expects the euro to collapse imminently. Despite continued efforts by Eurozone nations to stabilize the currency, many experts doubt that the 17-member currency will last another year unchanged. British officials think some countries, such as Greece or Portugal, may leave the currency to resolve severe economic issues. There are concerns that the euro's breakup could negatively affect Britain's economy, undermining hopes for recovery and possibly causing a recession. Some wealthy individuals, particularly from Greece, are reportedly already moving money to the UK and purchasing London property. The Treasury believes a euro breakup could spark an international rush to the UK as a safe haven, which could lead to a sharp rise in Sterling—harming British exports central to the government's economic strategy. Earlier this year, Switzerland faced similar pressures and had to peg its currency to the euro after massive capital inflows. Banks are parking record amounts of cash at the European Central Bank due to fears of a Eurozone breakup; recently, 412 billion euros were deposited, despite a low interest rate of just 0.25 percent, suggesting high anxiety among financial institutions. This comes after 520 banks borrowed 489 billion euros in three-year loans from the ECB amid crisis concerns. Recently, a drop in Italy's borrowing costs eased market fears about Eurozone debt, helping boost London's main share index. After Mario Monti replaced Silvio Berlusconi as Italy's prime minister, confidence rose despite new austerity measures involving tax increases and pension reforms. The UK Treasury is considering strict limits on money movements into or out of the country and is also preparing for the impact on major British banks, which have a combined exposure of £170 billion to troubled European economies like Greece, Ireland, Portugal, Italy, and Spain. Elsewhere in Whitehall, there are concerns that a euro collapse could spark widespread disorder and movement of people. Some countries may respond by grounding flights and sealing borders. Britain is also reportedly considering such measures, although restricting free movement conflicts with EU law. The Ministry of Defence has been placed on standby to assist with the rescue of British nationals from potentially unstable European countries. Other EU member states, such as Portugal, are also devising contingency plans, including border closures and limits on cash withdrawals. In Portugal, reports suggest new currency notes would be marked until an official replacement is available. A Conservative Party poll found most members favor the UK leaving the EU and seeking a free-trade agreement instead. Of those surveyed, 54 percent support leaving, while other members prefer alternative arrangements or greater flexibility. In ranking influential politicians, members identified most with Baroness Thatcher, followed by Boris Johnson and Ronald Reagan. ConservativeHome polled 1,566 party members on December 22 and 23.

Stručnjaci strahuju da bi kolaps mogao uzrokovati značajna preseljavanja ljudi i kapitala, što bi moglo imati štetne posljedice za Britaniju ako se ništa ne poduzme. Trezor priprema planove za sprječavanje prebacivanja velikih iznosa iz eurozone u Britaniju, uz zabrinutost da bi takav priljev mogao previše ojačati funtu. Osim toga, dužnosnici su nagovijestili da bi britanske granice mogle biti privremeno zatvorene za ekonomske izbjeglice u slučaju nemira širom Europe. Ministarstvo vanjskih poslova priprema mogućnost hitne evakuacije tisuća britanskih državljana i turista iz pogođenih zemalja. Dužnosnici naglašavaju da su ovi planovi samo mjera predostrožnosti i ne znače da vlada očekuje neposredni kolaps eura. Unatoč stalnim naporima europskih zemalja za stabilizaciju valute, mnogi stručnjaci sumnjaju da će valuta sa 17 članica opstati još jednu godinu bez promjena. Britanski dužnosnici vjeruju da bi neke zemlje, poput Grčke ili Portugala, mogle napustiti euro kako bi riješile ozbiljne ekonomske probleme. Strahuje se da bi potencijalni raspad eura mogao negativno utjecati na britansku ekonomiju, umanjujući nade za oporavak i možda izazvati novu recesiju. Neki bogati pojedinci, posebice iz Grčke, već navodno prebacuju novac u UK i kupuju nekretnine u Londonu. Trezor smatra da bi raspad eura mogao izazvati međunarodno preusmjeravanje kapitala u UK kao sigurno utočište, što bi moglo izazvati nagli rast funte i negativno utjecati na izvozni oporavak. Ranije ove godine, Švicarska je doživjela sličan pritisak i morala je vezati svoju valutu za euro zbog velikih priljeva kapitala. Banke ulažu rekordne iznose u Europsku centralnu banku zbog straha od raspada eurozone; nedavno je deponirano 412 milijardi eura, unatoč niskoj kamatnoj stopi od samo 0,25 posto, što ukazuje na visoku razinu zabrinutosti među bankama. Ovo se dogodilo nakon što je 520 banaka posudilo 489 milijardi eura kroz trogodišnje kredite od ECB-a u razdoblju krize. Nedavni pad troškova zaduživanja Italije smanjio je zabrinutost tržišta zbog duga eurozone, što je pomoglo rastu londonskog burzovnog indeksa. Nakon što je Mario Monti naslijedio Silvija Berlusconija na mjestu talijanskog premijera, povećano je povjerenje unatoč novim mjerama štednje vezanim uz poreze i mirovine. Trezor UK razmatra stroga ograničenja na transfere novca u i iz zemlje te se priprema na utjecaj na velike britanske banke, koje su izložene s ukupno 170 milijardi funti prema nestabilnim europskim ekonomijama poput Grčke, Irske, Portugala, Italije i Španjolske. U Whitehallu postoje strahovi da bi raspad eura mogao dovesti do nemira i preseljavanja ljudi. Neke države mogle bi zabraniti letove i zatvoriti granice. Izvještava se da i Britanija razmatra takve mjere, iako bi ograničavanje kretanja bilo u suprotnosti s pravom EU-a. Ministarstvo obrane je u pripravnosti kako bi pomoglo u spašavanju Britanaca iz potencijalno nestabilnih europskih država. I druge zemlje EU-a, poput Portugala, pripremaju izvanredne planove, uključujući privremeno zatvaranje granica i ograničenja podizanja gotovine. U Portugalu bi gotovina bila žigosana do tiskanja nove valute. Istraživanje Konzervativne stranke pokazalo je da većina članova podržava izlazak UK iz EU-a i sklapanje sporazuma o slobodnoj trgovini. Od ispitanih, 54% ih podržava izlazak, dok ostali traže fleksibilnija rješenja. Najviše se identificiraju s barunicom Thatcher, zatim sa Borisom Johnsonom i Ronaldom Reaganom. article_content: A 21-year-old woman in Barnegat Township, New Jersey, gave birth unexpectedly to a baby boy on her front lawn, not realizing she was pregnant. Elizabeth Whitehead, already a mother to a nine-month-old, had taken two pregnancy tests that both came back negative. Thinking she was experiencing cramps from a late period, she was on her way to the hospital when she suddenly went into labor on the front yard, delivering a 2.5-pound son. Her partner, David Windham, called 911 immediately. Barnegat police officers Vinnie Damiano and Michael Moore arrived quickly, finding Elizabeth and her newborn on the grass, the umbilical cord still attached. The baby, born three months early, was not breathing initially, but the officers performed CPR, and he soon began to cry. Emergency crews cleared his airways, and both mother and baby were taken to local hospitals—Elizabeth to Southern Ocean County Hospital and the infant to Jersey Shore University Medical Center's Neonatal Intensive Care Unit. Neighbors were stunned, with some noting they hadn't noticed she was pregnant. Elizabeth and her baby are recovering, with the infant still under specialized care. The family thanked the officers for their quick action in saving the newborn's life.

Elizabeth Whitehead, već majka devetomjesečnog sina, napravila je dva testa na trudnoću i oba su bila negativna. Mislila je da su grčevi koje je osjećala posljedica zakašnjele menstruacije, pa se spremala otići u bolnicu kad je iznenada na travnjaku rodila sina teškog 1,1 kilogram. Njezin partner David Windham odmah je nazvao 911. Policajci iz Barnegata, Vinnie Damiano i Michael Moore, brzo su stigli i pronašli Elizabeth i novorođenče na travi, još uvijek spojene pupčanom vrpcom. Beba, rođena tri mjeseca prerano, u početku nije disala, ali policajci su izveli reanimaciju i ubrzo je počela plakati. Hitna pomoć je očistila dišne puteve, a majka i dijete su odvedeni u bolnice—Elizabeth u Southern Ocean County Hospital, a beba u Jedinicu intenzivne njege novorođenčadi u Jersey Shore University Medical Center. Susjedi su bili šokirani, a neki su rekli da nisu ni primijetili njezinu trudnoću. Elizabeth i beba se oporavljaju, dok je novorođenče još pod posebnom liječničkom skrbi. Obitelj je zahvalila policajcima na brzoj reakciji i spašavanju života djeteta.

article_content: Bhutan's King Jigme Khesar Namgyel Wangchuck will begin an eight-day official visit to India on November 3. Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma stated on X: 'Bharat and Bhutan share a unique relationship which has grown stronger over time. For centuries, knowledge and education have formed the basis of this special bond. Assam eagerly looks forward to welcoming His Majesty, the King of Bhutan, on his first official visit to our State. This visit will further deepen the friendship between our countries.' The Bhutan India Friendship Association, Gelephu Chapter, noted that true friendship transcends borders, as in the case of Bhutan and Assam. The two neighbours share over 265 kilometers of international border and have maintained a strong relationship for centuries, except for a brief period of tension between the 1990s and 2020. After many years of peaceful coexistence, the bond between Bhutan and Assam was tested by insurgent groups operating along the border for nearly two decades. While these issues posed significant security challenges, the leaders of both countries prioritized their partnership and worked together to reach amicable solutions. The Association credited Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma for ushering in a renewed era of peace, particularly for their role in bringing the National Democratic Front of Bodoland (NDFB) into the mainstream, which has contributed to lasting stability in the area. Historically, there has not been an official visit by the King of Bhutan to Guwahati, as most interactions took place with the central government in New Delhi. The King's upcoming visit to Assam is seen as a historic moment that will further strengthen the friendship and demonstrate the goodwill of the Bhutanese people. This visit highlights the enduring relationship between Bhutan and Assam, and is expected to foster an even brighter and more harmonious future for the region.

Udruženje prijateljstva Butan-Indija, ogranak Gelephu, istaknulo je da pravo prijateljstvo nadilazi granice, kao što je slučaj s Butanom i Assamom. Dvije susjedne zemlje dijele više od 265 kilometara međunarodne granice i stoljećima održavaju snažan odnos, osim tijekom kratkog razdoblja napetosti između 1990-ih i 2020. Nakon mnogih godina mirnog suživota, vezu između Butana i Assama testirale su pobunjeničke skupine na granici gotovo dva desetljeća. Dok su ti problemi predstavljali značajne sigurnosne izazove, čelnici obje zemlje stavljali su partnerstvo u prvi plan i zajednički radili na pronalaženju prijateljskih rješenja. Povijesno gledano, kralj Butana dosad nije službeno posjetio Guwahati, jer su se većina susreta odvijala s centralnom vladom u New Delhiju. article_content: Next week, India's main stock market will see a flurry of activity as five companies plan to launch IPOs worth over Rs 7,000 crore. With strong sentiment in secondary markets, experts believe this could contribute to robust performances for the new IPOs, especially for those chasing early listing gains. Analysts suggest retail investors—especially those with limited investment funds—should focus on Tata Technologies and IREDA, which are seen as the most promising. Limited capital and the number of simultaneous IPOs are reasons for this more selective approach, according to an ET report. Satyen Shah from Nuvama Investment Banking reassures investors that the large number of IPOs won't cause liquidity problems in the wider market. Although funds put into one IPO may not be available for another, he does not expect this to have a significant impact. However, he points out that retail investors will likely weigh company valuations and sectors more carefully than institutional investors, who generally have more funds to allocate. A breakdown of the upcoming IPOs: Tata Technologies: Coming to the market after more than 20 years, Tata Technologies plans an IPO of Rs 3,042 crore with shares priced between Rs 475 and Rs 500 (open Nov 22-24). Analysts see strong demand, citing attractive growth prospects and more reasonable valuations compared to competitors—IDBI Capital notes a price-to-earnings ratio of 33x FY23 earnings versus an industry average of 63. However, due to heavy demand, retail investors may find it difficult to get shares. IREDA: The Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency, supported by the government, is launching a Rs 2,150 crore IPO (price band Rs 30-32, Nov 21-23). With the government aiming for 50% of energy from renewables by 2030, IREDA stands to benefit, and its history of good performance and affordable pricing strengthens its investment case. Gandhar Oil Refinery: This company, which produces personal care and lubricant products, is offering a Rs 500 crore IPO at Rs 160-169 per share (Nov 22-24). Some analysts point to a likely short-term gain due to a grey market premium, but caution that it may not suit long-term investors. It's compared to Galaxy, another expensive stock that has done well. Flair Writing Industries: The company aims to raise Rs 593 crore (Rs 288-304 per share, Nov 22-24) and could benefit from positive sentiment following Cello World’s successful IPO, which listed at a 28% premium. Fedbank Financial Services: Backed by Federal Bank, this company is offering Rs 1,092 crore in shares (Rs 133-140, Nov 22-24). Analysts urge caution for long-term buyers due to recent RBI policy changes affecting the banking sector, though some recommend applying for possible short-term listing gains.

article_content: For centuries, humans have wondered what it would be like to experience the world as a bird. Now, advanced technology has given scientists unprecedented insight into the hunting strategies of falcons. American researchers attached helmets equipped with tiny cameras to the birds’ heads, along with lightweight backpacks, in order to record their predatory flights from the falcons’ own perspective. Through collaboration with 13 falconers in Europe and the United States, the researchers meticulously documented footage of falcons in pursuit—such as chasing a crow—from the birds' point of view. Frame-by-frame analysis allowed scientists to chart each falcon’s position in flight and reconstruct their hunting techniques. Adult falcons have slender, tapered wings that enable them to fly at astonishing speeds and quickly change direction. During a hunt, they intercept prey mid-flight by tracking it from a distance and keeping the target centered in their field of vision. To maximize efficiency and conserve energy, falcons adjust their flight so that their prey appears motionless against the background landscape. This unique strategy allows the birds to predict where the prey will be and execute precision attacks with less effort than by simply tailing the target. Similar approaches, known as motion camouflage, have also been observed in bats and dragonflies. According to Professor Suzanne Kane and her team at Haverford College, Pennsylvania, this hunting method allows falcons to surprise prey by intercepting it without close pursuit. By mapping the position of the prey within the falcon’s field of vision, researchers were able to chart the birds’ precise flight paths. Although heading directly toward the prey would seem straightforward, the birds often employ more sophisticated strategies. Professor Kane explained to Live Science that a direct approach is often inefficient, requiring the falcon to follow a winding path. Instead, by keeping the prey stationary relative to the landscape, the birds optimize their path to conserve energy and time. Special hoods were devised by falconers to secure cameras onto the birds’ heads without obstructing their vision. While some birds resisted the equipment, most tolerated the cameras well. The study, published in the Journal of Experimental Biology, used data from eight different falcons in the U.S., Belgium, the Netherlands, and the United Kingdom. Looking ahead, the scientists plan to investigate additional aspects of falcon hunting behavior, such as how these birds select individual targets from groups. As Professor Kane remarked, watching a falcon’s-eye view of the hunt is both dramatic and revealing, offering powerful insight into the fundamental struggle between predator and prey.
translated_content: Tisućama godina ljudi su se pitali kako je gledati svijet očima ptice. Sada je napredna tehnologija omogućila znanstvenicima dosad neviđen uvid u lovačke strategije sokolova. Američki istraživači postavili su kacige s minijaturnim kamerama na glave ptica, zajedno s laganim ruksacima, kako bi snimili njihova lovačka leta iz sokolove perspektive. U suradnji s 13 sokolara iz Europe i Sjedinjenih Država, istraživači su pomno bilježili snimke sokolova u potjeri – primjerice za vranom – iz ptičje perspektive. Analizom svakog kadra, znanstvenici su mogli pratiti položaj svakog sokola u letu i rekonstruirati njihove lovačke tehnike. Odrasli sokolovi imaju vitka, sužena krila koja im omogućuju nevjerojatnu brzinu i okretnost. Tijekom lova, presreću plijen u zraku prateći ga iz daljine i držeći metu u središtu svog vidnog polja. Kako bi maksimalno štedjeli energiju i bili učinkovitiji, sokolovi prilagođavaju let tako da im se plijen čini nepomičnim u odnosu na pejzaž. Ova posebna strategija omogućuje im da predvide gdje će se plijen nalaziti i izvedu precizan napad uz manje napora nego da ga jednostavno slijede. Slične metode, poznate kao kamuflaža pokretom, primijećene su i kod šišmiša i vilinih konjica. Prema riječima profesorice Suzanne Kane i njezinog tima s Haverford Collegea u Pennsylvaniji, ova metoda omogućuje sokolovima da iznenade plijen tako što ga presreću bez bliske potjere. Prateći položaj plijena u odnosu na vidno polje sokola, istraživači su mogli precizno mapirati putanju ptica. Iako bi se izravni napad na plijen mogao činiti najjednostavnijim, sokolovi često koriste sofisticiranije strategije. Profesorica Kane objasnila je za Live Science da je izravan pristup često neučinkovit, jer zahtijeva više zaobilaznih puteva. Umjesto toga, održavanjem plijena 'mirnim' u odnosu na pejzaž, sokolovi optimiziraju svoju putanju i štede vrijeme i energiju. Sokolarima su izrađene posebne kapuljače kako bi kamere čvrsto pričvrstili na glave ptica bez ometanja vida. Iako su neke ptice odbijale opremu, većina ju je dobro podnosila. Studija, objavljena u časopisu Journal of Experimental Biology, temeljena je na podacima osam različitih sokolova iz SAD-a, Belgije, Nizozemske i Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva. U budućnosti znanstvenici planiraju proučavati dodatne aspekte sokolovog lovačkog ponašanja, poput odabira pojedinačne žrtve iz jata. Kako je profesorica Kane naglasila, pogled na lov iz sokolove perspektive je dramatičan i izuzetno otkriva, nudeći vrijedan uvid u iskonsku borbu predatora i plijena.
