article_content: It's a mouthwatering sight: a generous, juicy burger patty nestled in a seeded bun and topped with ketchup, gooey cheese, crisp lettuce, and ripe tomatoes. These pictures of perfectly fried eggs, elegant iced cakes, and stunning pastries look good enough to eat—but if you tried, you’d end up with a mouthful of paint. They are actually oil paintings. These hyperrealistic images are the work of Dutch artist Tjalf Sparnaay, who creates lifelike representations of everyday food. One example is a juicy hamburger stuffed with salad, ketchup, and melted cheese. Another is an iced cake covered in yellow icing, topped with a swirl of cream and a cherry. On his website, Sparnaay explains: 'My paintings are intended to enable the viewer to experience reality again—to rediscover the essence of objects that have become so commonplace. I want to return to the DNA of the universal structure in all its beauty. I call it “the beauty of the ordinary.”' Sparnaay, 61, is regarded as a leading figure in the international Hyperrealism movement and has been working on his 'Mega Realism' series since 1987. His portfolio includes paintings of roast beef with vegetables and gravy, chocolate-covered pastries with whipped cream and strawberries, and whimsical sundaes with umbrellas in vintage glasses. He finds inspiration for his work in everyday items around him. 'Using trivial and everyday objects, I let them flow back into reality through my brush,' he writes. 'My intention is to give these objects a soul and a presence.' Sparnaay aims to produce work that viewers find recognizable, accessible, and simple. He adds: 'I hope my paintings will let the viewer re-experience reality and rediscover the essence of things that have become ordinary, from their DNA to their beauty at the universal level. In an era saturated with images, where anything can be reproduced anywhere in unlimited quantities, it’s clear that rare, unique, powerful images are more cherished than ever.' Based in the Netherlands, Sparnaay’s work is displayed worldwide. Prices for his original paintings range from €17,500 (£13,200) to over €120,000 (£90,000), depending on size. He also accepts commissions.
translated_content: Prizor za poželjeti: sočan, veliki pljeskavica u mekanom pecivu sa sjemenkama prelivena ketchupom, rastopljenim sirom, hrskavom salatom i zrelim rajčicama. Ove slike savršeno pečenih jaja, elegantnih torti i prekrasnog peciva izgledaju kao da su za jelo—ali ako pokušate, završit ćete s ustima punim boje. Naime, radi se o uljanim slikama. Ove hiperrealistične slike djelo su nizozemskog umjetnika Tjalfa Sparnaaya, koji stvara izuzetno životopisne prikaze svakodnevne hrane. Primjerice, sočan hamburger punjen salatom, ketchupom i rastopljenim sirom. Ili torta prekrivena žutom glazurom, ukrašena spiralom šlaga i trešnjom. Na svojoj web stranici Sparnaay objašnjava: 'Moje slike namijenjene su tome da gledatelju omoguće ponovno doživjeti stvarnost—da ponovno otkrije bit predmeta koji su postali toliko svakodnevni. Želim se vratiti DNK univerzalne strukture u svoj njenoj ljepoti. To zovem “ljepota običnog”.' Sparnaay, 61 godina, smatra se vodećom osobom međunarodnog hiperrealističnog pokreta i radi na svojoj seriji 'Mega Realism' od 1987. Njegov portfelj uključuje slike pečene govedine s povrćem i umakom, čokoladnih kolača sa šlagom i jagodama te maštovitih sladoleda sa šarenim kišobranima u starinskim čašama. Inspiraciju za svoja djela pronalazi u svakodnevnim predmetima oko sebe. ‘Koristeći trivijalne i svakodnevne predmete, vraćam ih natrag u stvarnost kroz svoj kist’, piše. ‘Moja je namjera tim predmetima dati dušu i prisutnost’. Sparnaay nastoji stvarati djela koja su gledateljima prepoznatljiva, dostupna i jednostavna. Dodaje: 'Nadam se da će moje slike omogućiti gledatelju da ponovno doživi stvarnost i otkrije bit onoga što je postalo obično, od njihove DNK do ljepote na univerzalnoj razini. U eri preplavljenoj slikama, gdje se bilo što može reproducirati bilo gdje u neograničenim količinama, jasno je da su rijetke, jedinstvene, snažne slike danas cjenjenije nego ikad prije.' Sparnaayeva djela izlažu se diljem svijeta, a originalne slike postižu cijene od 17.500 € (13.200 £) do više od 120.000 € (90.000 £), ovisno o veličini. Također prima narudžbe.

article_content: Coinbase Singapore has officially been granted a Major Payment Institution license by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, authorizing the exchange to broaden its digital payment token offerings for both individual and institutional customers throughout the country. This milestone follows earlier in-principle approval and reinforces Coinbase’s commitment to Singapore’s market. The company cited Singapore’s robust interest in cryptocurrencies and progressive regulatory environment as decisive factors in its expansion strategy. Hassan Ahmed, Coinbase Singapore’s country director, observed that the regulatory clarity in Singapore stands in contrast to more uncertain conditions in the United States, establishing Singapore as a strategic hub in Coinbase’s international growth plans. In addition to this news, Coinbase already secured licensing or registration in Spain, Italy, Ireland, and the Netherlands. Coinciding with the announcement, Coinbase’s share price climbed by more than 2%. The company reaffirmed its dedication to supporting Singapore’s broader Web3 ecosystem, including recruitment and training at its Singapore tech hub, and described the Monetary Authority of Singapore as a leader among global Web3 regulators. Coinbase expressed optimism about further contributing to Singapore’s crypto and Web3 sectors.

article_content: Japan has twice delayed the launch of its Hayabusa2 space probe due to unfavorable weather. The mission is now planned for Wednesday at 1:22 pm local time from the Tanegashima Space Center in southern Japan. Initially scheduled for today, the probe’s launch was postponed first because of heavy clouds and again due to strong winds. The Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency (JAXA) cautioned that further delays are possible if weather conditions do not improve. The Hayabusa2 mission, with a budget of 31 billion yen ($260 million), aims to study the asteroid 1999JU3 by blasting a small crater into its surface and collecting subsurface material. Scientists seek to use these samples to investigate key questions about the origins of life and the universe. The spacecraft, roughly the size of a household refrigerator, is expected to reach its target in mid-2018 and remain in proximity for about 18 months. It will also deploy small robots onto the asteroid’s surface, with the goal of returning asteroid samples to Earth by late 2020. This launch follows just weeks after the European Space Agency’s historic landing of its Philae laboratory on a comet, which detected organic molecules and a much harder surface than expected. Philae entered hibernation after running out of battery following around 60 hours of scientific work. Hayabusa2 is accompanied by the Procyon microsatellite, co-developed by the University of Tokyo and JAXA.

article_content: More than 1,000 rare artifacts from the Third Reich are being auctioned in one of the largest sales of Nazi-era memorabilia to date, held in Stamford, Connecticut. The collection features notable items such as Adolf Hitler’s ceremonial brass desk, used to sign the Munich Pact prior to World War II, which sold for $423,000. The desk bears the ‘AH’ inscription, ink wells, and the Nazi crest with an eagle and swastika, and is reportedly designed by Hitler himself. Other significant lots include a photograph from a Hitler Youth rally signed by Arthur Axmann, estimated to fetch $200, and a series of handwritten love letters from a Jewish schoolteacher, Esle Janke, to Nazi Propaganda Minister Joseph Goebbels, valued at up to $9,000. Private letters written by Hitler during and just after his incarceration at Landsberg Prison are also part of the auction. The Munich Pact, signed on September 30, 1938, allowed Germany to annex the Sudetenland in Czechoslovakia in hopes of averting further conflict, though war ultimately followed. The pact was negotiated by British Prime Minister Neville Chamberlain, French premier Édouard Daladier, Italian leader Benito Mussolini, and Adolf Hitler. Chamberlain famously declared ‘peace in our time’ upon his return, but Hitler continued his plans for expansion, leading to World War II. Auctioneers Bill Panagopulos and Andreas Kornfeld from Alexander Auction House noted a rising interest in Nazi-era collectibles, attributing it to the passage of time since World War II. The buyer of Hitler's desk is a private collector from the U.S. West Coast. The clientele spans collectors, historians, museums, and Jewish buyers seeking historically significant pieces for preservation. Additional items include Goebbels’ childhood school journal, signed Adolf Hitler portraits, and various artifacts from Nazi officials. Auctioneers emphasize that their customers are not neo-Nazis, highlighting the historical and memorial significance of the collection.

Kolekcija uključuje značajne predmete poput svečanog mjedenog stola Adolfa Hitlera, korištenog za potpisivanje Münchenskog sporazuma prije Drugog svjetskog rata, koji je prodan za 423.000 dolara. Sporazum su pregovarali britanski premijer Neville Chamberlain, francuski premijer Édouard Daladier, talijanski vođa Benito Mussolini i Adolf Hitler. Aukcionari Bill Panagopulos i Andreas Kornfeld iz Alexander Auction Housea istaknuli su porast interesa za kolekcionarske predmete iz nacističkog razdoblja, što pripisuju prolasku vremena od Drugog svjetskog rata. Aukcionari naglašavaju da njihovi kupci nisu neonacisti, već ističu povijesnu i memorijalnu važnost kolekcije.

article_content: Russia has officially finalized its withdrawal from the Treaty on Conventional Armed Forces in Europe (CFE), a historic agreement from the Cold War era. The Russian Foreign Ministry confirmed the move on Tuesday, which followed the approval by both chambers of parliament and the signing by President Vladimir Putin in May. The CFE treaty, signed in November 1990, was designed to prevent major military buildups near the borders of rival blocs to avoid heightened tensions between Russia (formerly the Soviet Union) and the United States. Although Russia stopped participating in 2007 and indicated in 2015 it would leave the treaty, the process was only completed recently. Russian officials assign responsibility for the withdrawal to the United States and its allies, accusing them of undermining the agreement and adopting a 'destructive' approach. The ministry stated that Russia was open to discussions about restoring arms control in Europe, but alleged Western countries did not participate. The Russian Foreign Ministry also cited ongoing developments in Ukraine and NATO’s enlargement as reasons the treaty is no longer tenable for Russia’s security interests. The tension escalated with Russia’s large military intervention in Ukraine in February 2022; Ukraine borders NATO members Poland, Slovakia, Romania, and Hungary.

Rusko ministarstvo vanjskih poslova potvrdilo je taj potez u utorak, nakon što su ga odobrila oba doma parlamenta i potpisao predsjednik Vladimir Putin u svibnju. CFE ugovor, potpisan u studenom 1990., bio je zamišljen kako bi spriječio velike vojne koncentracije uz granice suprotstavljenih blokova i izbjegao eskalaciju između Rusije (nekadašnjeg Sovjetskog Saveza) i Sjedinjenih Država. Rusko ministarstvo vanjskih poslova kao razloge navodi aktualna zbivanja u Ukrajini i proširenje NATO saveza, tvrdeći kako je nastavak sudjelovanja u ugovoru postao neodrživ za temeljne sigurnosne interese Rusije. article_content: Leicester City manager Nigel Pearson faced renewed controversy after an incident in Saturday's defeat to Crystal Palace, where he was seen grabbing midfielder James McArthur by the throat. The situation began when McArthur collided with Pearson near the technical area; Pearson then pulled McArthur up and appeared to hold onto his shirt, not releasing him immediately. Although both men initially seemed to be smiling, footage suggested the incident was more intense than it first appeared, leading to mixed reactions from those present. That evening, reports emerged claiming Pearson had been fired, with figures like Gary Lineker commenting on social media. The club, however, took several hours before releasing a statement denying these rumors and affirming that Pearson remained in charge. Leicester City's Thai owners, the Srivaddhanaprabha family, have consistently supported Pearson despite a turbulent season, including after off-field controversies and poor results. Earlier, the club spent £9 million on striker Andrej Kramaric, who started on the bench during the Palace match—a decision questioned by some observers given Leicester’s struggles at the bottom of the Premier League. The confrontation with McArthur brought scrutiny back onto Pearson’s leadership style and prior incidents, such as his previous suspension for verbally abusing a supporter. Off the field, Pearson is said to be personable, but his public conduct is often combative. After the match, McArthur used social media to downplay the incident, though pundits described the confrontation as bizarre. Commentators observed the tense atmosphere at Leicester as they fight relegation, with an important match against Arsenal up next. Leicester’s form has been poor, having just one home win in nine games and conceding among the most goals in the league. In response to the controversy, Pearson stated in interviews that he harbors no ill will towards McArthur, linking any lingering tension to McArthur’s failed transfer from Wigan Athletic, which Pearson attributed to Wigan’s management. Despite attempts to clarify the situation, the incident increased scrutiny on Pearson amid Leicester’s disappointing season.

article_content: The proposal to simply expel Palestinians from Gaza is both uninformed and unrealistic. Many people hold strong views on Middle Eastern conflicts even if they have never visited the region or studied its complex history, especially over the past century. A frequently asked question online since October 7 has been: 'Why don't Arab states or other countries open their borders and allow the people of Gaza to leave?' Some suggest that if borders were opened, civilians could escape, while fighters aligned with Hamas and other Palestinian armed factions would stay behind, making it easier for Israel to defeat them and later allow the civilians to return. This is a simplistic and disconnected solution, lacking any real understanding of the situation. Despite enduring immense hardship, most Palestinians strongly believe they should remain in Gaza. At the same time, neighboring states feel unable to accept two million more refugees. Outsiders might find it illogical that people would choose to stay in such dangerous circumstances, or doubt the sincerity of Arab states claiming to support Palestinians while not granting them refuge. Both positions stem from deeply rooted historical trauma and collective fears. Over the past 75 years, generations of Palestinians have been forced from their homes through various waves of conflict. United Nations resolutions have affirmed their right to return, but they and their descendants remain refugees. Once displaced, their status rarely changes. The first mass expulsion, known as the Nakba or 'catastrophe,' occurred in 1948, when nearly a million Palestinians—over 85% of those living in what became Israel—were driven from their homes. Neighboring Arab states tried, but failed, to defeat the new state militarily. They accepted many refugees, mainly in today's Lebanon, Syria, and Jordan. These refugees faced hardship and uncertainty, hoping to one day return. That hope went unfulfilled as the international community failed to implement lasting solutions, despite many promises, and new wars created yet more refugees. Some Palestinians still have the keys to their original homes. The 1956 Suez crisis, fought primarily over Egypt’s Suez Canal, displaced comparatively few Palestinians, but many Jewish and non-Arab communities were forced to leave Arab states at that time. The 1967 war brought further upheaval: Jordan lost the West Bank and Jerusalem, and Syria lost the Golan Heights. More than 300,000 Palestinians fled the West Bank to Jordan, with 100,000 people leaving the Golan. Like those from 1948, these refugees often lived in basic conditions, and Palestinian integration in host countries was difficult. Despite generations passing, Palestinians and their hosts often continued to see each other as outsiders. This tension boiled over in 1970-71 during violent clashes in Jordan between the country's forces and Palestinian fighters of the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO), led by Yasser Arafat. Having relocated from the West Bank, the PLO launched attacks on Israel from Jordan, prompting Israeli reprisals on Jordanian territory. Refugees from 1948 were granted citizenship in Jordan, but later arrivals had only refugee status. Fearing the PLO might overthrow the monarchy, Jordan’s royal family acted, resulting in an Arab-Arab conflict that killed around 4,000 people. The PLO was allowed to leave for Lebanon, where further violence contributed to Lebanon’s 1975–1990 civil war. Given these historical experiences, it is understandable that Arab states are reluctant to accept new refugees, believing they will remain permanently. Other countries outside the region have also not offered refuge to Palestinians fleeing conflict. People in the Arab world often question why larger, wealthy countries like the United States, Canada, Russia, Australia, or Argentina have not opened their doors. Even after the 1993 Oslo Accords, which were supposed to address such issues, Palestinian refugees found it almost impossible to return. Very few refugees from Lebanon, Syria, or Jordan ever made it back to their homes. Many feel forgotten or ignored by the world—a population now estimated at six million refugees, spanning four generations. In Gaza, residents worry that a major Israeli military action could forcibly push them into Egypt, despite their desire to stay. Having managed to survive for years in the harsh conditions of the crowded Gaza Strip, they are deeply afraid of losing even what little they still have, and do not wish to become political pawns in the wider conflict. Now, more than ever, they are determined to resist further displacement by whatever means available to them.
translated_content: Prijedlog da se Palestince jednostavno protjera iz Gaze je i neinformiran i nerealističan. Mnogi ljudi imaju snažna mišljenja o bliskoistočnim sukobima, iako nikada nisu posjetili regiju niti proučavali njezinu složenu povijest, posebice zadnjih stotinu godina. Jedno od najčešćih pitanja na internetu od 7. listopada glasi: 'Zašto arapske države ili druge zemlje ne otvore granice i ne dopuste stanovnicima Gaze da izađu?' Neki predlažu da bi se, kada bi se granice otvorile, civili mogli spasiti, dok bi borci povezani s Hamasom i drugim palestinskim frakcijama ostali, čime bi Izraelu bilo lakše poraziti ih i kasnije dopustiti civilima povratak. To je pojednostavljena i od stvarnosti odvojena ideja, bez stvarnog razumijevanja situacije. Unatoč ogromnim teškoćama, većina Palestinaca čvrsto vjeruje da trebaju ostati u Gazi. Istovremeno, susjedne države smatraju da nisu sposobne primiti još dva milijuna izbjeglica. Promatračima izvana može se činiti nelogičnim da netko želi ostati u opasnosti ili mogu sumnjati u iskrenost arapskih država koje tvrde da podržavaju Palestince, ali im ne nude sklonište. Oboje potječe iz duboko ukorijenjenih povijesnih trauma i kolektivnih strahova. Tijekom zadnjih 75 godina generacije Palestinaca bile su prisilno raseljene u raznim valovima sukoba. Rezolucije Ujedinjenih naroda priznale su im pravo na povratak, no oni i njihovi potomci još su uvijek izbjeglice. Nakon što jednom izgube dom, njihov status rijetko se promijeni. Prva masovna protjerivanja, poznata kao Nakba ili 'katastrofa', dogodila su se 1948., kad je skoro milijun Palestinaca—više od 85% onih koji su živjeli na području današnjeg Izraela—protjerano iz svojih domova. Susjedne arapske države pokušale su, ali nisu uspjele vojno poraziti novu državu. Prihvatili su mnoge izbjeglice, uglavnom u današnji Libanon, Siriju i Jordan. Te su izbjeglice pretrpjele teškoće i nesigurnost, nadajući se povratku koji se nikad nije ostvario. Međunarodna zajednica nije provela trajna rješenja, usprkos brojnim obećanjima, a novi ratovi stvarali su sve više izbjeglica. Neki Palestinci još uvijek čuvaju ključeve svojih prvotnih domova. Sueska kriza 1956., vođena uglavnom zbog Sueskog kanala, raselila je relativno malo Palestinaca, no mnoge židovske i nearapske zajednice bile su tada prisiljene napustiti arapske zemlje. Novi potresi stižu nakon rata 1967.: Jordan gubi Zapadnu obalu i Jeruzalem, a Sirija Golansku visoravan. Više od 300.000 Palestinaca bježi sa Zapadne obale u Jordan, a 100.000 ljudi napušta Golan. Poput prognanika iz 1948., i ove izbjeglice često žive u skromnim uvjetima, a integracija Palestinaca u zemljama domaćina bila je teška. I nakon nekoliko generacija, Palestinci i njihovi domaćini često se još uvijek smatraju strancima. Tenzije su kulminirale 1970.-71. u krvavim sukobima u Jordanu između jordanskih snaga i palestinskih boraca Organizacije za oslobođenje Palestine (PLO) koju je vodio Yasser Arafat. Preselivši se sa Zapadne obale, PLO je pokretao napade na Izrael iz Jordana, što je izazivalo izraelske odmazde na jordanskom teritoriju. Izbjeglice iz 1948. dobile su jordansko državljanstvo, dok su kasniji došljaci imali samo status izbjeglica. Bojeći se da bi PLO mogao svrgnuti monarhiju, jordanska kraljevska obitelj reagira, zbog čega dolazi do arapsko-arapskog sukoba u kojem je poginulo oko 4.000 ljudi. PLO je tada dobio dopuštenje da ode u Libanon, gdje su novi sukobi dodatno doprinijeli libanonskom građanskom ratu od 1975. do 1990. Zbog takvih povijesnih iskustava, razumljivo je da su arapske države nevoljke primiti nove izbjeglice, vjerujući da bi oni ostali trajno. Države izvan regije također se nisu ponudile prihvatiti Palestince koji bježe od sukoba. Ljudi u arapskom svijetu često pitaju zašto velike i bogate zemlje poput SAD-a, Kanade, Rusije, Australije ili Argentine nisu otvorile svoja vrata. Čak i nakon Sporazuma iz Osla iz 1993., koji su trebali rješavati ovakva pitanja, palestinskim izbjeglicama povratak je ostao gotovo nemoguć. Vrlo malo izbjeglica iz Libanona, Sirije ili Jordana uspjelo se vratiti svojim domovima. Mnogi osjećaju da ih je svijet zaboravio ili zanemario—populacija izbjeglica sada se procjenjuje na šest milijuna u četiri generacije. Stanovnici Gaze strahuju da bi izraelska vojna ofenziva mogla silom natjerati njih u Egipat, usprkos njihovoj želji da ostanu. Godinama su preživljavali u teškim uvjetima prenapučene i siromašne Gaze i jako ih plaši mogućnost da izgube i to malo što imaju. Ne žele postati pijuni u širem političkom sukobu i sada, više nego ikad, odlučni su oduprijeti se novom raseljavanju na sve načine koji su im na raspolaganju.

article_content: In 2013, University of Michigan paleontologist Bill Sanders traveled with a research group to explore fossil sites in Abu Dhabi. Though Sanders has spent decades studying elephants and their extinct relatives, he encountered something extraordinary—a site in the desert that, millions of years ago, was part of the African-connected landmass. Animals once crossed freely here, and about 7–8 million years ago, a herd of at least 13 elephants left giant footprints in the sediment—tracks that Sanders and his team could see with their own eyes. He immediately recognized the ancient trail as belonging to a matriarch-led elephant group, with a separate path from a solitary bull passing afterward. The discovery of these rare, behavioral fossil traces moved Sanders and his colleagues deeply. Sanders has spent 40 years tracing the evolutionary story of elephants and their relatives, the proboscideans, over the past 60 million years. His latest work mapped their journey from small, trunkless ancestors like Eritherium (about the size of a poodle) through waves of evolution that unfolded on the old Afro-Arabian supercontinent. Over time, larger species such as Barytherium emerged, followed by gomphotheres, which sometimes had elongated jaws or resembled today's elephants. When the Afro-Arabian continent collided with Eurasia, proboscideans diversified further, producing mammoths, mastodons, and four-tusked tetralophodons that ranged across many continents. Out of over 180 identified, now-extinct proboscidean families, just three elephant species remain today. Essential adaptations—like continually replaced horizontal molars, muscular trunks, and wide ears (especially on African savannah elephants, aiding heat control)—enabled elephants to thrive. Their dietary versatility, massive size, and distinctive tusks have been key to their long survival. Elephants have been vital in shaping Africa's ecosystems, modifying habitats and helping create environments that benefited other species, including early humans, who made use of the altered landscape. Recently, Sanders' research has unfolded against a backdrop of drastic elephant population declines. Habitat destruction, human-wildlife conflict, and illegal poaching have caused African savannah elephant numbers to plummet by around 60%, and forest elephants by almost 90%, according to World Wildlife Fund data. For Sanders, the possible extinction of elephants signals profound risks to biodiversity everywhere. The disappearance of such large, ecologically important creatures would tear at the fabric of life and could even endanger humanity. His recent book, 'Evolution and Fossil Record of African Proboscidea,' captures not only these scientific findings but also the essential need for conservation, highlighting the combined efforts of many paleontologists and University of Michigan colleagues who contributed to this research.
translated_content: Godine 2013. paleontolog sa Sveučilišta Michigan, Bill Sanders, otputovao je s istraživačkom ekipom u Abu Dhabi kako bi proučavao nalazišta fosila. Iako Sanders već desetljećima proučava slonove i njihove izumrle rođake, ovoga puta naišao je na izuzetan nalaz – mjesto u pustinji koje je prije milijuna godina bilo povezano s Afrikom. Životinje su tada slobodno prelazile tim područjem, a prije otprilike 7–8 milijuna godina krdo od najmanje 13 slonova ostavilo je divovske otiske u sedimentu – tragove koje su Sanders i tim mogli izravno vidjeti. Odmah je prepoznao da tragovi pripadaju krdu kojim je upravljala ženka, dok je kasnije prošao usamljeni bik. Otkriće ovako rijetkih fosilnih tragova ponašanja životinja duboko je dojmilo Sandersa i njegove kolege. Sanders već 40 godina prati evolucijski put slonova i njihovih srodnika proboscideja kroz 60 milijuna godina. Njegovo najnovije djelo prati razvoj od malih predaka bez surle, poput Eritheriuma (veličine pudlice), kroz evolucijski mozaik na afro-arapskom superkontinentu. S vremenom su se pojavile veće vrste, poput Barytheriuma, zatim gomphotheresi – neki s izduženim čeljustima, drugi nalik današnjim slonovima. Kad se Afro-Arapski kontinent sudario s Euroazijom, proboscideje su se još više razgranale – pojavili su se mamuti, mastodonti i tetralofodonti s četiri kljove koji su nastanjivali nekoliko kontinenata. Od preko 180 opisanih izumrlih porodica proboscideja, danas postoje samo tri vrste slonova. Ključne prilagodbe – poput izmjene kutnjaka, snažne surle i velikih ušiju (posebno kod afričkih savanskih slonova, koje im pomažu rashladiti tijelo) – omogućile su njihov opstanak. Njihova prilagodljivost u prehrani, veličina i kljove bili su ključ preživljavanja kroz povijest. Slonovi su igrali presudnu ulogu u oblikovanju afričkih ekosustava, svojim utjecajem na staništa stvarali su uvjete od kojih su korist imali i drugi organizmi, uključujući rane ljude koji su koristili krajolike preoblikovane djelovanjem slonova. Nedavno su Sandersova istraživanja odvijala se paralelno s dramatičnim padom broja slonova. Zbog gubitka staništa, sukoba ljudi i životinja te krivolova, broj afričkih savanskih slonova pao je oko 60 %, a šumskih slonova čak 90 %, prema podacima World Wildlife Funda. Za Sandersa nestanak slonova označava ozbiljne rizike za bioraznolikost na Zemlji. Gubitak tako velikih i važnih životinja poremetio bi ravnotežu života i mogao imati posljedice i za ljude. Njegova nedavno izdana knjiga, 'Evolution and Fossil Record of African Proboscidea', objedinjuje ova znanstvena saznanja i naglašava hitnost za zaštitom, slaveći doprinos brojnih paleontologa i kolega sa Sveučilišta Michigan koji su sudjelovali u istraživanju.

article_content: After several unsuccessful attempts to be elected Speaker of the House, Jim Jordan and his supporters appear to have accepted defeat. With each round of voting, the number of Congressional members opposing Jordan increased. Although some believed that persistence and pressure might change the outcome, a closed-door Republican conference vote reportedly informed Jordan to step aside, confirming he would not become Speaker. Previous similar internal votes had also indicated Jordan's unlikelihood of winning but were not heeded. CNN reports that, according to Representative Barry Moore, Jordan is expected to give up, and the process for selecting a Speaker will begin anew on Monday. Jordan lost a secret ballot vote of the House GOP in a private meeting, sources tell CNN. Rep. Barry Moore noted that members were taking a 'yes' or 'no' vote on keeping Jordan as their nominee. Earlier, House Majority Leader Steve Scalise had won the initial closed-door vote but faced challenges within the party. As the conference concluded, Scalise stated that the House would adjourn until Monday, when the process would restart: 'Monday we're going to come back and start over,' he said as he left the conference.
translated_content: Nakon nekoliko neuspješnih pokušaja da bude izabran za predsjednika Zastupničkog doma, čini se da su Jim Jordan i njegovi pristaše prihvatili poraz. Sa svakim krugom glasanja, broj članova Kongresa koji se protive Jordanu povećavao se. Iako su neki vjerovali da bi upornost i pritisak mogli promijeniti ishod, zatvoreno glasanje republikanske konferencije navodno je obavijestilo Jordana da odustane, potvrđujući da neće postati predsjednik. Prijašnja slična interna glasanja također su ukazivala na malu vjerojatnost Jordanove pobjede, ali nisu bila uvažena. CNN prenosi da, prema riječima zastupnika Barryja Moorea, Jordan namjerava odustati i proces biranja predsjednika u ponedjeljak će krenuti ispočetka. Jordan je izgubio tajno glasanje Zastupničkog doma republikanaca na privatnom sastanku, izvori navode za CNN. Zastupnik Barry Moore napomenuo je da su članovi glasali 'da' ili 'ne' o tome hoće li Jordan ostati njihov kandidat. Ranije je vođa većine u Zastupničkom domu Steve Scalise pobijedio na prvom zatvorenom glasanju, ali se suočio s izazovima unutar stranke. Po završetku konferencije, Scalise je izjavio da će se Zastupnički dom sastati ponovno u ponedjeljak kako bi proces krenuo ispočetka: 'U ponedjeljak ćemo se vratiti i krenuti ispočetka', rekao je napuštajući konferenciju.

article_content: Summer holidays are often the first to be sacrificed during tough economic times, but Google now offers a way to explore the world without leaving your computer. The tech giant has launched 15,000 free photo tours of global landmarks, creating interactive 3D scenes using tourist photos from Google’s Picasa and Panoramio services. Landmarks such as Rome’s Trevi Fountain, Half Dome in Yosemite National Park, and St Mark’s Basilica in Venice are among the locations users can virtually 'fly around.' Berlin’s Brandenburg Gate is also featured, with these tours available directly through Google Maps. According to Google’s official Maps blog: 'Every year, millions of people travel to experience new sights and cultures. With today’s introduction of photo tours—a Google Maps feature guiding you through a 3D photo scene—we’re all one step closer.' Google used advanced computer vision to assemble the 3D panoramas from public, user-submitted photos. The tours are accessible in Google Maps in two ways: by searching for a place and clicking on its photo tour thumbnail, or by clicking on a landmark label while browsing the map to see if a tour is available. To create these tours, Google’s system finds clusters of overlapping photos around landmarks. It then computes the 3D shape and determines the location and orientation of each photo to build a navigable scene. These 3D tours rely on WebGL technology, which works in browsers like Firefox, Chrome, and Safari. Internet Explorer users, however, will need to switch browsers or miss out on the virtual exploration. The animated 3D panoramas offer a new layer to the Google Maps experience, complementing existing features such as Street View and allowing users to 'fly around' some of the world’s most famous sights from their own browsers.

Berlinski Brandenburška vrata su također uključena, a ture su dostupne izravno putem Google Mapsa. Prema službenom blogu Google Mapsa: 'Svake godine milijuni ljudi putuju kako bi doživjeli nova mjesta i kulture. S današnjim predstavljanjem foto tura – značajkom Google Mapsa koja vas vodi kroz 3D foto scene – svi smo korak bliže tome.' Lead generation is crucial for businesses seeking growth, particularly for technology companies that have flourished following the rapid digital expansion triggered by the pandemic. Sustaining this growth requires technology firms to attract and convert new prospects systematically.

Effective strategies for lead generation in tech include:

1. Landing Pages: Professionally designed, mobile-optimized landing pages build credibility and improve conversion rates. Employ A/B testing and analytics for ongoing optimization.

2. Chatbots: Automated chat tools gather leads and qualify prospects 24/7, saving resources and improving efficiency.

3. Webinars: Educational online events help demonstrate expertise, engage prospects, and boost brand trust.

4. Free Trials: Allowing users to test offerings risk-free increases trust, insight, and conversion likelihood.

5. Content Syndication: Sharing content on third-party platforms raises brand visibility—using SEO best practices ensures online authority remains intact.

6. Surveys: Collecting direct feedback helps shape marketing messages and better address customer needs.

7. Explainer Videos: Short, clear videos simplify complex products and improve understanding for potential buyers.

8. Referral Programs: Incentivizing happy customers to refer others can generate high-quality leads based on trust.

9. Influencer Marketing: Collaborating with industry influencers extends reach and provides authentic recommendations.

10. Customer Testimonials: Positive feedback and case studies enhance credibility and search engine rankings.

11. Social Media Engagement: Active participation on targeted platforms enables direct interaction and targeted advertising.

12. Intent Data: Analyzing user behavior, such as page visits or downloads, allows for more targeted and effective outreach.

Applying a strategic mix of these approaches and focusing on the specific audience can help technology companies stand out, nurture high-value leads, and continue their market success.

article_content: Christie Brinkley and her ex-husband Peter Cook continue to exchange public accusations following their 2008 divorce after 12 years of marriage. Brinkley became emotional during a Today Show interview with Matt Lauer, where she called Cook a narcissist and described the distress the conflict has caused her and her family, emphasizing her desire for peace. Cook responded by describing her interview as a 'cunning and shameless display,' accusing her of trying to gain public sympathy through dishonest means. He also stated that Brinkley was dishonest about court proceedings and claimed she was damaging their children by keeping the drama alive. Brinkley alleged that Cook tries to undermine her happiness and does not fulfill his child support obligations, specifying on the Today Show that he pays $600 per month for each child, which she considers minimal. Cook denied being behind on payments and stated he pays more than required. She also called for legislation to protect families from individuals diagnosed as extreme narcissists by court-appointed professionals. The couple’s divorce was marked by public disputes over Cook's infidelity, including an affair with neighbor Diana Bianchi, and allegations of excessive discipline and use of internet pornography by Cook. Brinkley’s attorney, Tom Campagna, claimed that Cook repeatedly broke a confidentiality agreement and made false, sexist statements in the media. Brinkley has three children: Alexa Ray with musician Billy Joel, Jack with Richard Taubman (later adopted by Cook), and Sailor with Cook. She is well known for her modeling career, particularly her multiple appearances on Sports Illustrated swimsuit covers. The ongoing conflict has attracted significant media attention, with both parties making appearances and statements to defend their reputations and criticize each other.

article_content: James Rodriguez delivered an outstanding performance, scoring both goals to send Colombia into the World Cup quarter-finals. At just 22 years old, Rodriguez became the tournament’s leading scorer with five goals, elevating his status among players like Messi and Muller. Playing at the iconic Maracana stadium, he scored the first goal with a brilliant strike from outside the box, followed by a well-finished team move for his second, securing Colombia’s best-ever World Cup finish as they advanced to face Brazil in Fortaleza. The atmosphere was one of joy and celebration for Colombian fans, who were delighted with their team’s exciting and entertaining style. Rodriguez received high praise for his performance, while Uruguay, without star player Luis Suarez, struggled to make an impact. Despite the pressure and jeers from the crowd, Uruguay kept their discipline but could not overcome Colombia’s skill. Player ratings highlighted Rodriguez (8.5) and goalkeeper Ospina (8) as standouts for Colombia. The game ended 2-0, and with this result, Colombia continued to impress at the 2014 World Cup. Attendance was 73,804, with Bjorn Kuipers of the Netherlands officiating. Colombia’s next match is against Brazil, promising another exciting encounter.

article_content: Surrounded by music and neon lights, groups gathered each night near a US military base in Uijeongbu City, Gyeonggi Province, South Korea. Now, more than 120 women who previously worked as prostitutes near the complex are seeking compensation from the South Korean government. The former sex workers, now elderly and impoverished, claim that local authorities facilitated their work to please American forces, while neglecting their own welfare. At a community center in a makeshift 'camp-town' next to the base, the women shared tearful accounts, explaining their plan to sue the government for $10,000 each. They argue that the government established a system that included compulsory sexual health check-ups, 'Western etiquette' training, and economic pressures, which contributed to a prostitution culture that left them worse off in old age. The women emphasize that their involvement was voluntary, distinguishing themselves from Japan's WWII-era 'comfort women.' However, they say government intervention and the need for foreign currency in the 1970s encouraged their work. Authorities, worried about the potential withdrawal of US troops, welcomed their presence. Former sex worker Cho Myung-ja, 76, recalls serving US military personnel at Camp Humphreys during the 1960s and 70s. Another woman noted the belief that earning dollars in the clubs was considered patriotic and brought significant income. Kathy Moon of the Brookings Institution, an expert on South Korea’s sex industry, says that during the 1970s, some central government officials visited camp-towns to encourage cooperation with US military command. The South Korean government eventually set up sexual health clinics, replacing unofficial providers, but according to Moon, the clinics focused more on safeguarding US troops’ health than the women's. Kim Sook-ja, 70, tearfully recalled her experiences serving at Camp Humphreys. She stands outside a now-closed hostess club for US soldiers in Pyeongtaek. If the case goes to court, the government may contend that the clinics helped protect the women. However, Moon argues the clinics prioritized the well-being of US troops over the women. In recent years, US Forces Korea has enforced a 'zero tolerance' policy for servicemen engaging in prostitution, and South Korea officially banned prostitution in 2004. The article also references a recent case in which elderly South Korean women, forced into prostitution by Japanese soldiers during World War II, sought public acknowledgment and compensation. In August, Lee Yong-soo, 86, and other former 'comfort women' attended a Mass with Pope Francis, hoping to share their pain and seek reconciliation.

Sada više od 120 žena koje su nekad radile kao prostitutke blizu tog kompleksa traži odštetu od južnokorejske vlade. Bivše prostitutke, sada starije i siromašne, tvrde da su lokalne vlasti poticale njihov rad kako bi zadovoljile američke vojnike, pritom zanemarujući njihovu dobrobit. Tvrde da je vlada uspostavila sustav koji je uključivao obvezne zdravstvene preglede, tečajeve 'zapadne etikete' i ekonomske pritiske, što je dovelo do kulture prostitucije koja ih je dodatno osiromašila u starosti. Žene ističu da su u posao ušle dobrovoljno, razlikujući se od japanskih 'žena za utjehu' iz Drugog svjetskog rata. Ipak, napominju da su državni utjecaj i potreba za devizama 1970-ih godina potaknuli njihovo bavljenje tim poslom. Vlasti su, zabrinute zbog mogućeg povlačenja američkih trupa, podržavale njihovu prisutnost. Bivša prostitutka Cho Myung-ja (76) prisjeća se služenja američkom vojnom osoblju u Camp Humphreysu tijekom 1960-ih i 70-ih. Druga žena navodi da je zarađivanje dolara u klubovima tada smatrano domoljubnim činom i donosilo je znatnu zaradu. Kathy Moon iz Brookings Institutiona, stručnjakinja za južnokorejsku seksualnu industriju, kaže kako su tijekom 1970-ih neki državni službenici posjećivali kamp-naselja kako bi potaknuli suradnju s američkim vojnim zapovjedništvom. Južnokorejska vlada potom je uspostavila zdravstvene klinike, zamijenivši neslužbene pružatelje usluga, ali prema Moon, fokus klinika bio je više na zdravlju američkih vojnika nego samih žena. Kim Sook-ja (70) također sa suzama prisjeća se iskustava iz Camp Humphreysa te stoji ispred sada zatvorenog kluba za američke vojnike u Pyeongtaeku. Ako slučaj dođe na sud, vlada će možda tvrditi da su klinike štitile žene, ali Moon smatra da su prvenstveno brinule o američkim trupama. Posljednjih godina američke snage u Koreji provode politiku 'nulte tolerancije' prema prostituciji, a Južna Koreja službeno je zabranila prostituciju 2004. Tekst također spominje skorašnji slučaj u kojem su starije Korejke, koje su za vrijeme Drugog svjetskog rata bile prisiljene na prostituciju od strane japanskih vojnika, tražile priznanje i odštetu. U kolovozu su Lee Yong-soo (86) i druge bivše 'žene za utjehu' prisustvovale misi s papom Franjom, nadajući se podijeliti svoju bol i pronaći mirenje.

article_content: Film fans now have a rare opportunity to own a piece of Hollywood history: the luxury home featured in the iconic 1986 movie Ferris Bueller's Day Off is on the market. The 5,300-square-foot house is located in Highland Park, a suburb of Chicago, Illinois, and is listed for $1.5 million. This famous home served as the residence of Cameron Frye, Ferris Bueller’s anxious best friend, played by Alan Ruck. One of the movie’s most memorable scenes shows Cameron watching in horror as his father’s beloved Ferrari crashes through a glass wall and tumbles into a ravine. The glass-fronted garage from this scene is instantly recognizable to fans of the film. The distinctive property is partly suspended over a wooded ravine and includes a main four-bedroom house as well as a separate pavilion with its own kitchen, bathroom, and space for four cars. In a pivotal moment of the film, Cameron has a breakdown in the pavilion and ends up sending the prized Ferrari through the glass to the ravine below after discovering more miles have been put on the car's speedometer. The house is listed for the second time in two years after failing to sell at $1.65 million in 2011. Originally, the owners put it on the market in 2009 for $2.3 million, but it did not sell and has since been renovated. The home was built in 1953 by architect A. James Speyer, a protégé of renowned architect Ludwig Mies van der Rohe. The glass pavilion garage, designed by David Haid, was added around 20 years later to display a collection of vintage cars. According to the Chicago Tribune, the house has only had one family of owners. Ferris Bueller’s Day Off is a classic coming-of-age comedy in which Ferris (played by Matthew Broderick) skips school for a day of adventure in Chicago, along with his girlfriend Sloane (played by Mia Sara) and best friend Cameron. The film was written and directed by the late John Hughes, who also made The Breakfast Club, Sixteen Candles, and Pretty in Pink. As an extra treat for fans, a replica of the Ferrari 250 GT Spyder used in the movie will be auctioned next week. The actual Ferrari was too valuable for filming, so three replicas were created for the movie.

Kuća od 500 kvadratnih metara nalazi se u Highland Parku, predgrađu Chicaga u Illinoisu, a cijena joj je 1,5 milijuna dolara. Ova slavna kuća bila je dom Camerona Fryea, tjeskobnog najboljeg prijatelja Ferrisa Buellera, kojeg tumači Alan Ruck. Jedna od najpoznatijih scena filma prikazuje Camerona kako u užasu gleda kako njegov otacov omiljeni Ferrari prolazi kroz stakleni zid i pada u provaliju. article_content: Recently debuted Super Eagles defender Jordan Torunarigha has set his sights on helping Nigeria win the 2024 Africa Cup of Nations (AFCON) and secure qualification for the 2026 World Cup. The Super Eagles will kick off their pursuit of a fourth AFCON title in Group A, where they will face hosts Ivory Coast, Equatorial Guinea, and Guinea Bissau. Torunarigha made his first appearance for Nigeria in a friendly against Mozambique in Portugal, telling Transfermarkt he is motivated to give his best for the country. "I have two big goals with Nigeria: the Africa Cup of Nations next year and the World Cup in 2026. I will, and we will, give everything for that," Torunarigha said. The 26-year-old defender previously represented Germany at youth level and played in the 2021 Olympic Games, but now fully commits to Nigeria. The son of former Eagles forward Ojokojo Torunarigha, Jordan featured for 75 minutes before being substituted for Calvin Bassey in Nigeria’s exciting 3-2 win over Mozambique. Reflecting on his debut, Torunarigha described the experience as very special and expressed pride in joining a squad full of talented players and strong characters. "Winning is always most important. We would have liked a clean sheet, but it was enjoyable on the pitch. I hope my coach and teammates were pleased," he added. The Gent defender also highlighted his family's pride, especially that of his father, noting their ongoing support. "We talked a lot about my invitation before the announcement. My dad and my whole family are very proud and happy. They were present when I was first invited by Nigeria and will continue to support me. If I need advice from my dad, he's always there for me."

Super Eaglesi započinju potragu za četvrtim naslovom AFCON-a u skupini A, gdje će igrati protiv domaćina Obale Bjelokosti, Ekvatorijalne Gvineje i Gvineje Bisau. Torunarigha je prvi put nastupio za Nigeriju u prijateljskoj utakmici protiv Mozambika u Portugalu te za Transfermarkt izjavio da je motiviran dati svoj maksimum za reprezentaciju. "Imam dva velika cilja s Nigerijom: Afrički kup nacija iduće godine i Svjetsko prvenstvo 2026. Dat ću sve od sebe, i mi ćemo dati sve za to," rekao je Torunarigha. 26-godišnji branič ranije je nastupao za Njemačku u mlađim kategorijama te na Olimpijskim igrama 2021., ali sada je potpuno posvećen Nigeriji. Sin bivšeg napadača Eaglesa Ojokoja Torunarighe, Jordan je igrao 75 minuta prije nego što ga je zamijenio Calvin Bassey u uzbudljivoj pobjedi Nigerije protiv Mozambika rezultatom 3:2. Osvrćući se na svoj debi, Torunarigha je iskustvo opisao kao izuzetno posebno te izrazio ponos što je postao dio tima punog talentiranih igrača i snažnih osobnosti. "Pobjeda je uvijek najvažnija. Voljeli smo sačuvati mrežu netaknutom, ali na terenu je bilo zabavno. Nadam se da su trener i suigrači bili zadovoljni," dodao je. Branič Genta također je istaknuo koliko je njegova obitelj ponosna, posebno otac, te njihovu kontinuiranu podršku. "Prije objave dosta smo razgovarali o pozivu. article_content: Taher Badshah, Chief Investment Officer at Invesco Mutual Fund, shared his perspective with ETMarkets, expressing optimism about India's investment and real estate sectors. He believes they are in the early stages of long-term growth, driven by sustained public and private investment and supportive government policies. Reflecting this view, Invesco has increased its allocation to residential real estate, noting strong and resilient demand alongside improving supply. Addressing recent market trends, Badshah noted that Indian markets started 2023 on a weaker note, behind global peers due to concerns about consumer sector growth, rising interest rates, and high valuations. Yet, over the past six months, Indian markets have outperformed, supported by a robust investment cycle, easing inflation, and a muted impact from interest rates on consumption. He sees the current rally as broad-based and structural, rather than just driven by festive seasons. For Samvat 2080 (the Hindu financial new year), Badshah expects interest rates to start easing in 2024 as inflation normalizes after the pandemic. He anticipates broader growth in both consumption and investments across income segments and industries. Nevertheless, he identified several risks: a possible slowdown in the global economy, particularly in the US; geopolitical uncertainties; delayed rural recovery in India; and political volatility from upcoming domestic elections. Badshah highlighted that India is experiencing a favorable capital expenditure cycle, helped by post-pandemic demand growth and improved corporate and banking sector balance sheets. He foresees opportunities across manufacturing, defense, power, railways, and real estate. Although public sector project activity might slow before national elections, he expects this to be a temporary phase. Regarding foreign investors, Badshah feels they will remain attracted to India despite US interest rates at around 5%, due to strong corporate earnings prospects and a relatively stable rupee. This dynamic could provide attractive returns for overseas investors. article_content: Emmett Perrin, a young boy from Saskatchewan, Canada, gave his family and the internet a reason to smile when he confused a razor for a comb and happily shaved off his hair. His mom, Chanda Campbell, heard laughter from the bathroom and discovered Emmett in the middle of a self-styled haircut. Rather than reacting with anger, Chanda joined in the laughter and recorded the funny moment. During the video, Chanda asks Emmett to say what he’s doing. Giggling, Emmett claims he’s combing his hair. Chanda laughs, noting he’s actually shaving it, and jokes that it might be a while before he can comb his hair again. She reassures him, saying his new look is good and that he’s done an excellent job. After posting the video on Facebook, it quickly went viral, collecting over five million views and even making its way to the Ellen Show. Chanda later said that Emmett finished his impromptu haircut with a little help from his dad and pointed out that ‘it’s only hair—it will grow back.’ She added that although it’s a bit cold for a bare head, there was no stopping Emmett by the time she found him. Chanda told CBC News that since Emmett wasn’t hurting himself, she let him finish his amusing haircut. She described Emmett as an energetic, witty, and clever four-year-old who always keeps the family laughing. The uplifting video continues to spread joy across social media.

article_content: At a recent animation showcase, Netflix unveiled the first look at Blue Eye Samurai, an upcoming original animated series created by Amber Noizumi and Michael Green (writer of Logan). A new trailer has just been released ahead of its premiere in early November. Blue Eye Samurai centers on Mizu, voiced by Maya Erskine, a biracial woman on a quest for revenge against her biological father, Abijah Fowler (voiced by Kenneth Branagh). After years of intense sword training, Mizu sets out through Edo-period Japan, determined to find her father and exact vengeance. Her striking blue eyes mark her as an outsider, drawing attention and complicating her mission with each adversary she defeats. Throughout her journey, Mizu forms alliances and rivalries with various characters, including a cook named Ringo (Masi Oka) and an imperiled bride. The trailer showcases Mizu engaging in stunning, action-packed sword fights, brought to life with vibrant animation from French studio Blue Spirit. While the eight-episode series embraces familiar themes of revenge, its promise of visually striking action is likely to captivate viewers. The voice cast also includes Ming-Na Wen, Randall Park, Stephanie Hsu, and George Takei. Blue Eye Samurai is set to premiere on Netflix on November 3. A Michigan couple who disappeared from their home with their newborn nearly a month ago have contacted relatives to say they are safe, but do not wish to be in touch. Police initially said something seemed to have 'spooked' Timothy Medsker, 33, his wife Sabrina, 34, and their four-month-old son Joshua from Petoskey, Michigan, as they abruptly left their home and successful cleaning business, leaving clothing, computers, food, and paperwork behind.

The family, last seen on February 12, recently reached out to family members to confirm they are well. Detective David Schultz of the Petoskey Department of Public Safety told Fox News that Mr. Medsker called his sister and said the family was fine, without explaining their sudden disappearance or current location. 'Timothy and Sabrina are very private people, and it seems the media pressure led them to make contact. They said they're fine and do not want further communication,' Schultz said.

Authorities stated that the family's reasons for leaving and their whereabouts remain unclear, and announced that they are closing the investigation. Police had launched the search after relatives, worried by their absence, reported them missing on February 23. Investigators found no signs of foul play, and noted the family's finances appeared stable, with all bills up to date.

Friends and relatives observed that the couple, who had made plans to attend a baby shower, showed no signs of trouble before leaving. Timothy's sister, Kelly Mantati, mentioned her brother 'does have a different way of thinking,' and speculated he may have been affected by the economy, but said she could not be sure. Police had searched the Medskers' home twice, seizing computers and personal papers for clues.

Timothy's mother, Laura Medsker, had made a public appeal for the couple to get in touch, expressing concern and love for her son and grandson. Petoskey, the family's hometown, is a small city of about 6,000 residents on Lake Michigan's northeast shore.

article_content: Moulin Rouge might symbolize Paris, but a noteworthy number of its can-can dancers actually come from Australia. Janet Pharaoh, associate artistic director and a former dancer, estimates that about a third of the 75 performers are Australians. To find new stars for the 125th anniversary show—set to feature a large aquarium, five pythons, and six miniature horses—Pharaoh heads to Australia to hold auditions. At Sydney’s Walsh Bay Pier, Pharaoh recently watched as 60 women and 17 men performed elaborate routines, hoping to earn a place in the world-famous Paris cabaret. Across Australia, a total of 400 dancers will compete for just 20 available spots. Auditions are happening in cities like Melbourne, Brisbane, Gold Coast, and Sydney. To join the renowned troupe, candidates typically start in classical ballet and jazz at a young age. Pharaoh carefully assesses each dancer, providing honest feedback and making suggestions to help them meet the high standards expected at Moulin Rouge. But technical skill isn’t the only requirement. Pharaoh emphasizes the importance of personality, saying that great legs, a strong physique, and charisma are just as crucial for success. For 23-year-old Kaycee Paget, a former gymnast, landing a role at the Moulin Rouge would be a dream come true. She describes the chance to dance at such a prominent venue as ‘amazing’ for anyone with a passion for performing. Located in the Pigalle district, the legendary Paris cabaret attracts over 630,000 visitors every year with its twice-nightly shows. Dancers who make the cut join a team of 60, performing on stage as Moulin Rouge marks its historic anniversary this October.

A new type of milk is debuting in the UK, promoted as potentially reducing digestive issues like bloating and nausea. About one in five Britons say dairy causes discomfort—symptoms that can include abdominal pain, diarrhoea, or constipation. Although lactose intolerance is often regarded as the culprit, a study published in the European Journal of Clinical Nutrition found that less than a third of those affected were actually diagnosed with this condition.

The research, which involved 406 randomly selected adults, showed that 20% reported experiencing stomach discomfort after consuming dairy, while only 6% had medically confirmed lactose intolerance. Instead, many may be sensitive to a protein in regular cow’s milk called A1.

A2 Milk, an Australian brand now available in the UK, says its product comes from cows whose milk naturally lacks the A1 protein, possibly making it easier to digest for some people. This milk is sourced from British cows identified via a non-invasive DNA test for producing only the A2 type of beta-casein protein, and these cows are kept in dedicated herds.

Melanie Bibby, UK nutrition manager for a2 Milk and a registered nutritionist, points out that many cut milk from their diets unnecessarily, which could mean missing out on calcium and other nutrients. She stresses people who are diagnosed with lactose intolerance or milk allergies should not use the product, but a2 Milk may be suitable for those sensitive to A1 protein.

The milk will be available in two-litre bottles (whole and semi-skimmed) at a suggested price of £1.99 in select Budgens, Morrisons, and large Tesco stores from next week.

Iako se često pretpostavlja da je razlog tome intolerancija na laktozu, istraživanje objavljeno u časopisu European Journal of Clinical Nutrition pokazuje da je stvarna dijagnoza tog stanja potvrđena kod manje od trećine pogođenih.

Studija na 406 nasumično odabranih odraslih utvrdila je da je 20% ispitanika iskusilo probavne tegobe nakon konzumacije mliječnih proizvoda, ali samo 6% imalo je medicinski potvrđenu intoleranciju na laktozu. Umjesto toga, mnogi su osjetljivi na protein A1, koji se nalazi u običnom kravljem mlijeku.

A2 Milk, australski brend koji je sada dostupan u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu, tvrdi da njihov proizvod dolazi od krava čije mlijeko prirodno ne sadrži A1 protein, što nekima može olakšati probavu. Ovo mlijeko potječe od britanskih krava identificiranih neinvazivnim DNA testom kao proizvođača isključivo A2 vrste beta-kazeina, a te se krave drže u posebnim stadima.

Melanie Bibby, nutricionistica i voditeljica nutricionizma za a2 Milk UK, naglašava da mnogi nepotrebno izbacuju mlijeko iz prehrane, što može dovesti do manjka kalcija i drugih nutrijenata. article_content: NASA's OSIRIS-REx finished a seven-year voyage by delivering a capsule full of asteroid Bennu material to Utah. This is a historic first for the US, matching Japan's earlier achievement with Ryugu. These samples—from dust to pebble-sized bits, totaling about 250–600 grams—are now safely at NASA’s Johnson Space Center. Scientists will examine them in ultra-sterile environments, seeking secrets of the solar system’s beginnings. Why all the fuss? Asteroids like Bennu are considered untouched relics from when the solar system formed 4.5 billion years ago. While telescopes help us study their surface, handling the real material lets researchers dive deeper, literally and figuratively. Planetary scientist Anne Verbiscer from the University of Virginia notes that these findings can directly connect space rocks that fall to Earth to their origins, helping us unravel how planets and asteroids formed and evolved. The OSIRIS-REx itself, about the size of a grand piano, isn’t done yet—it’s now renamed OSIRIS-APEX and is set to rendezvous with Apophis, an asteroid approaching Earth in 2029. Instead of collecting samples, this mission will blast Apophis's surface with thrusters to analyze the dust and debris. And there's more: NASA’s Psyche mission launches soon toward a metallic asteroid, while Lucy is journeying to visit ancient asteroids near Jupiter, making its first close flyby at Dinkinesh. With such missions underway, scientists expect many discoveries about our solar system’s earliest days.
translated_content: NASA-ina letjelica OSIRIS-REx završila je sedmogodišnje putovanje isporučivši kapsulu s materijalom s asteroida Bennu u Utah. Ovo je povijesni prvi takav uspjeh za SAD, izjednačavajući japanski raniji uspjeh s asteroidom Ryugu. Ti uzorci—od prašine do sitnih kamenčića, ukupne mase oko 250 do 600 grama—sada su sigurno pohranjeni u NASA-inom centru Johnson. Znanstvenici će ih analizirati u posebnim sterilnim uvjetima, želeći otkriti tajne nastanka Sunčevog sustava. Zašto toliko uzbuđenja? Asteroidi poput Bennua smatraju se netaknutim ostacima iz vremena formiranja Sunčevog sustava prije 4,5 milijardi godina. Dok ih teleskopi pomažu proučavati izvana, prave uzorke u rukama omogućuju znanstvenicima detaljnije i dublje analize. Planetarna znanstvenica Anne Verbiscer sa Sveučilišta Virginije ističe kako bi ova otkrića mogla izravno povezati svemirske stijene koje padaju na Zemlju s njihovim izvornim mjestima, pomažući nam rasvijetliti nastanak i razvoj planeta i asteroida. Sam OSIRIS-REx, otprilike veličine klavira, nastavlja svoju misiju pod novim imenom OSIRIS-APEX te će se susresti s Apophisom, asteroidom koji će 2029. proći blizu Zemlje. Ovaj put neće prikupljati uzorke, već će snažnim mlazovima proučavati prašinu i krhotine s površine Apophisa. No tu nije kraj: NASA-ina misija Psyche uskoro polijeće prema metalnom asteroidu, a letjelica Lucy već putuje prema drevnim asteroidima oko Jupitera, sa svojim prvim bliskim prolaskom pokraj Dinkinesha. S ovakvim misijama pred nama, znanstvenici očekuju mnoga nova otkrića o prvim danima Sunčevog sustava.

New trends in beauty standards reveal that athletic and elegant body shapes are outpacing the popularity of larger bust sizes. According to research, both men and women now tend to prefer natural, streamlined figures, exemplified by celebrities like Olympian Jessica Ennis-Hill and Helen Mirren. A survey, commissioned by implant manufacturer GC Aesthetics and involving over 2,000 Britons, showed that 72% of women interested in breast enlargement would opt for just a one-cup size increase, while only 1% wanted to go up by four cup sizes. Figures such as Jessica Ennis-Hill, Kelly Brook, and Helen Mirren are among the most admired for their physiques.

Plastic surgeons indicate a growing demand for subtle and proportionate results, aiming for enhancements that are not easily noticeable. Ayse Kocak, CEO of GC Aesthetics, commented that the findings reflect their sales data, highlighting a preference for moderate changes and a focus on boosting confidence rather than drawing attention. Consultant plastic surgeon Douglas McGeorge pointed out that large implants are no longer seen as status symbols, with patients now favoring proportionate enhancements.

Despite the preference for subtlety, breast enlargement remains a leading cosmetic surgery in the UK. Figures from the British Association of Aesthetic Plastic Surgeons (BAAPS) record approximately 11,000 procedures yearly, though the total may be closer to 30,000 across all practices. The average cost for this procedure is about £5,500.

Osobe poput Jessice Ennis-Hill, Kelly Brook i Helen Mirren među najpoželjnijima su zbog svoje građe.

Plastični kirurzi ističu rastuću želju za suptilnim i proporcionalnim zahvatima, s naglaskom na rezultate koji nisu lako vidljivi. Ayse Kocak, izvršna direktorica tvrtke GC Aesthetics, komentirala je da rezultati odražavaju i njihove prodajne podatke te da je naglasak na samopouzdanju, a ne na privlačenju pažnje. article_content: A family from Farnworth, Greater Manchester, is spending Christmas away from their home after a fire—accidentally started by their beagle, Muffin—destroyed their kitchen. The 10-month-old beagle was left alone, and while jumping on the kitchen counter, she switched on the electric hob with her paw. Nearby clothes caught fire, causing flames to spread through the ground floor. Jill Tonge, 33, returned from work that morning to find blackened walls and a ruined kitchen. Her children, Jayden (11) and Lexi (7), are saddened they can't be home for the holiday. Thanks to a neighbor, who heard alarms and Muffin's barking, emergency services were quickly called. Firefighters arrived within a minute, entered the house at around 10:30am, and rescued Muffin, who had suffered smoke inhalation. Despite the rapid response, extensive damage means the kitchen is destroyed, most doors need replacing, and smoke stains cover the home. The family will stay with Jill’s parents over Christmas, where Muffin is already making her playful presence felt. Jill is focusing on her children's well-being despite their disappointment. She said the kids were upset Muffin caused the fire but understand it was accidental. Fortunately, the family’s presents were not damaged, but their Christmas at home has been spoiled. Since the fire, Muffin, after a vet checkup, has returned to her usual boisterous self. Jill, who has had Muffin since April, still loves her dog but is now considering a cage when leaving her home alone to prevent future incidents. When notified about the fire, Jill’s first concern was for Muffin. She’s grateful her children were safe and a neighbor responded so swiftly. The family hopes Muffin will calm down as she grows and looks forward to a better Christmas next year.

article_content: The H1N1 virus has been confirmed in a pig displayed at the Minnesota State Fair, marking the first time the virus has been detected in a U.S. pig, according to the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA). Officials quickly reassured the public that the food supply remains safe. Agriculture Secretary Tom Vilsack stated, "We have fully engaged our trading partners to remind them that international organizations, including the World Organization for Animal Health, have advised there is no scientific reason to restrict trade in pork or pork products." He emphasized, "People cannot get this flu from eating pork or pork products. Pork is safe to eat." The confirmation comes after health officials initially found three pigs at the fair tested positive for H1N1 in preliminary tests. Final results for the other two pigs are still pending. Gene Hugoson, commissioner of the Minnesota Department of Agriculture, said this could be the first indication that H1N1 is present in some U.S. swine. The confirmatory testing was conducted by the USDA's National Veterinary Services Laboratories using samples collected at the fair, held in Saint Paul, Minnesota, from August 26 to September 1. Further testing is ongoing. Officials reported that the pigs tested showed no signs of illness and appeared healthy. The samples were collected as part of a joint research project by the University of Iowa and University of Minnesota, funded by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, to determine if animals at such events have the infection. Vilsack noted that, like humans, swine can contract influenza viruses. He acknowledged that misconceptions about swine flu have hurt pork sales during the pandemic, though the virus is not transmitted through eating pork. The Minnesota State Fair drew a record 1.79 million attendees this year. An outbreak of H1N1 was reported among a group of 4-H participants who attended the fair, but officials believe it is unlikely they contracted the virus from the animals, given limited contact. Health experts were not surprised by the report, since H1N1 has previously infected herds in countries such as Argentina, Canada, Ireland, and Norway. Infected pigs generally recover from H1N1, officials said. The animals from the display were likely sent to slaughter, but Dr. Jeff Bender of the University of Minnesota Center for Animal Health and Food Safety explained that the virus is not present in muscle tissue. Therefore, eating pork from these animals does not pose a risk to consumers. A vaccine to protect swine against H1N1 is being developed, but is not yet available.

Dužnosnici su brzo uvjerili javnost da je opskrba hranom i dalje sigurna. Ministar poljoprivrede Tom Vilsack izjavio je: "Potpuno smo angažirali naše trgovinske partnere kako bismo ih podsjetili da su međunarodne organizacije, uključujući Svjetsku organizaciju za zdravlje životinja, savjetovale da ne postoji znanstveni razlog za ograničavanje trgovine svinjetinom ili svinjskim proizvodima." Istaknuo je: "Ljudi ne mogu dobiti ovu gripu konzumiranjem svinjetine ili svinjskih proizvoda. Svinjetina je sigurna za jelo." Potvrda dolazi nakon što su zdravstveni djelatnici u početku utvrdili da su tri svinje na sajmu bile pozitivne na H1N1 u preliminarnim testovima. Konačni rezultati za preostale dvije svinje još se čekaju. Gene Hugoson, povjerenik Ministarstva poljoprivrede Minnesote, rekao je da bi ovo mogao biti prvi znak prisutnosti H1N1 među američkim svinjama. Potvrdna testiranja provela je Nacionalna veterinarska laboratorija USDA na uzorcima prikupljenim na sajmu održanom u Saint Paulu, Minnesota, od 26. kolovoza do 1. rujna. Dodatna testiranja su u tijeku. Dužnosnici su izvijestili da su testirane svinje bile zdrave i nisu pokazivale znakove bolesti. Uzorke su prikupili u sklopu zajedničkog istraživačkog projekta Sveučilišta Iowa i Sveučilišta Minnesota, kojeg financira Centar za kontrolu i prevenciju bolesti (CDC), kako bi utvrdili imaju li životinje na takvim događajima infekciju. Vilsack je naglasio da, kao i ljudi, i svinje mogu dobiti gripu. Istaknuo je kako su pogrešna shvaćanja o 'svinjskoj gripi' negativno utjecala na prodaju svinjetine tijekom pandemije, iako se virus ne prenosi konzumacijom mesa. Državni sajam Minnesote ove je godine privukao rekordnih 1,79 milijuna posjetitelja. Pojava H1N1 zabilježena je kod grupe članova udruge 4-H koji su sudjelovali na sajmu, no dužnosnici vjeruju da je malo vjerojatno da su zarazu dobili od životinja, budući da je kontakt bio ograničen. Stručnjaci za zdravlje nisu iznenađeni izvješćem, jer su stada u zemljama poput Argentine, Kanade, Irske i Norveške već bila zaražena H1N1. Dužnosnici su kazali da se zaražene svinje općenito oporavljaju od H1N1. Životinje s izložbe vjerojatno su poslane na klanje, ali dr. Jeff Bender sa Sveučilišta Minnesota, Centra za zdravlje životinja i sigurnost hrane, pojasnio je kako virus nije prisutan u mišićnom tkivu. Stoga konzumacija svinjetine tih životinja ne predstavlja rizik za ljude. Vakcina za zaštitu svinja od H1N1 je u razvoju, ali još nije dostupna.

article_content: Unlike preceding decades that were marked by groundbreaking change, the 1980s in rock and roll were more about introspection and rebuilding than revolution. Musicians and fans used this era to reconsider the direction of rock while genres like synth-pop and rap grew in influence, heavy metal persisted, and technology such as the compact disc emerged. To reflect the creativity and variety of the period, Rolling Stone’s editors compiled a list of the 100 best albums from the decade. The absence of a defining revolution led to both creative struggle and rich output, as punk artists evolved, veterans delivered career-defining work, and rap music rose to mainstream prominence. The top ten on Rolling Stone’s list illustrate this: The Clash’s ‘London Calling’ kicked off the decade with defiant energy. Prince and the Revolution’s ‘Purple Rain’ integrated music and film into an unforgettable package. U2’s ‘The Joshua Tree’ became emblematic of the era, and Talking Heads’ ‘Remain in Light’ broke new ground with its blend of genres. Paul Simon’s ‘Graceland’ embraced global inspiration, Bruce Springsteen soared to iconic status with ‘Born in the U.S.A.’, and Michael Jackson’s ‘Thriller’ set new records worldwide. Innovation continued with R.E.M.’s alternative stylings on ‘Murmur’, Richard and Linda Thompson’s emotionally raw ‘Shoot Out the Lights’, and Tracy Chapman’s compelling debut. Challenges like constrained radio formats, commercial pressures, and episodes of bias in the industry did not dim the vitality of rock music in the 1980s. The decade proved that, even without a revolution, rock was full of life—suggesting that new waves of change could arrive at any moment.

Glazbenici i publika iskoristili su taj period za preispitivanje smjera rocka, dok su žanrovi poput synth-popa i rapa dobivali sve veću važnost, heavy metal je ostao popularan, a na scenu su stupile i nove tehnologije poput kompakt diska. Kako bi prikazali kreativnost i raznolikost te ere, urednici Rolling Stonea sastavili su popis 100 najboljih albuma desetljeća. Iako nije došlo do prepoznatljive glazbene revolucije, upravo su potraga za novim izrazima i kreativna borba donijeli bogatu glazbenu produkciju: punk izvođači su sazrijevali, veterani su stvarali svoja najvažnija djela, a rap je osvojio glavni tok. Prvih deset albuma na Rolling Stoneovoj listi to sjajno pokazuje: The Clash su s ‘London Calling’ donijeli buntovnu energiju na sam početak desetljeća. Prince and the Revolution uz ‘Purple Rain’ spojili su film i glazbu u jedinstveno iskustvo. U2 su s ‘The Joshua Tree’ postali simbol ere, Talking Heads su ‘Remain in Light’ obogatili spojem žanrova. Paul Simon sa ‘Gracelandom’ tražio je inspiraciju u svjetskoj glazbi, Bruce Springsteen je s ‘Born in the U.S.A.’ postao rock ikona, a Michael Jackson je s ‘Thrillerom’ pomaknuo sve rekorde. Inovacije su nastavili R.E.M. svojim alternativnim zvukom na ‘Murmur’, emotivnim završetkom Richard i Linda Thompson na ‘Shoot Out the Lights’ te dirljivim debijem Tracy Chapman. Usprkos izazovima kao što su ograničena radijska ponuda, komercijalni utjecaji i diskriminacija u industriji, rock u 1980-ima ostao je živ i dinamičan. Ovo desetljeće je dokazalo da rock još uvijek ima snage, a nova glazbena revolucija možda samo što nije krenula.

article_content: Jeff Bauman, who lost both legs in the Boston Marathon bombing, shared his experiences on the Dennis & Callahan program on WEEI radio. Bauman recalled the moment he learned that Tamerlan Tsarnaev, the older of the two suspected bombers, had been killed in a police shootout. 'He's dead and I'm still here,' said Bauman, 27, reflecting on his survival. Bauman is credited with helping the FBI identify Tamerlan Tsarnaev while he was still in the hospital. He described sensing something was wrong before the blast, noticing that one spectator near him, later identified as a suspect, appeared 'odd.' Moments later, the explosion occurred and Bauman was knocked to the ground. His girlfriend, who was running the marathon, was a mile away at the time and was unharmed. Carlos Arredondo, a bystander in a cowboy hat, is seen in a widely shared photograph helping Bauman after the explosion. Arredondo quickly tied fabric around Bauman's injured legs and pinched an artery to save his life. While in Boston Medical Center, Bauman communicated what he saw to investigators, helping them identify the bombers. He gave a description of Tamerlan Tsarnaev, which proved crucial to the investigation. Bauman spoke about the difficulty of his recovery. Although it is happening quickly, he said it is painful every day. Despite the challenges, he remains optimistic, focusing on moving forward with his life. He hopes to attend the next marathon to support his girlfriend but may avoid the finish line. Arredondo later visited Bauman in the hospital, bringing gifts and expressing pride in his strength. Bauman has received more than $600,000 in donations toward his medical expenses, and his family reports he is concentrating on his recovery with a positive attitude. Bauman was recently photographed delivering a birthday gift to fellow bombing victim Sydney Corcoran, with the image quickly going viral. The story also highlights the personal tragedies of Arredondo, whose son Alexander died in Iraq and whose other son Brian died by suicide. The impact of the bombing—on victims, survivors like Bauman, and heroes like Arredondo—continues to be felt, as the community rallies around those affected.

article_content: A bride-to-be in Valencia, Spain, allegedly became pregnant after a sexual encounter with a dwarf stripper during her hen night, according to reports. After giving birth to a baby with dwarfism earlier this year, she reportedly confessed to her husband about the affair. The identities of the couple and the hospital have not been disclosed. The story was first reported by Spanish news website Las Cinco del Dia, which stated that neither her friends nor family were aware of the incident until after the child’s birth. According to the report, the woman broke down and revealed what happened when she realized she could not conceal the child's condition. An anonymous source identified as a dwarf stripper in Spain commented that, while he knows colleagues in Valencia, he was not aware of any such incident occurring. He described the nature of such work as typically light-hearted and doubted the circumstances of the story, noting that most interactions at hen parties remain playful. The story has attracted significant media interest.
