article_content: U.S. Representative Michael Grimm, R-New York, has been indicted on 20 federal counts, including mail fraud, wire fraud, filing false tax returns, hiring unauthorized workers, and perjury. Federal prosecutors allege Grimm failed to report more than $1 million in sales and wages while operating the Healthalicious restaurant in Manhattan, using unreported cash to pay employees off the books to evade taxes. Grimm pleaded not guilty in Brooklyn federal court and was released on $400,000 bond secured by his Staten Island home. As part of his release, the 44-year-old must surrender his guns and passport. Grimm told reporters he plans to remain in office while contesting the charges and is running for re-election in November. He stated, 'I'm going to fight tooth and nail ... until I am fully exonerated.' His attorney expressed confidence in Grimm's vindication. Grimm stepped down from his position on the Financial Services Committee, requesting removal until legal matters are resolved. Speaker John Boehner's spokesperson, Michael Steel, said Grimm's decision was appropriate. An unsealed indictment alleges that Grimm misled investigators about his taxes after leaving Healthalicious to enter Congress. U.S. Attorney Loretta Lynch said Grimm 'never met a tax he didn't lie to evade.' The allegations stem from his time at the restaurant from 2007 to 2010. He was elected to Congress in 2010 and re-elected in 2012, representing Staten Island and parts of Brooklyn. According to prosecutors, Grimm’s role as an accountant, attorney, former Marine, and ex-FBI agent positioned him for success as a business owner, but he chose to break the law. Many cash payments at Healthalicious were not reported as income, and employees—some unauthorized to work in the U.S.—received part or all of their pay in cash, which was not reported to tax authorities. By under-reporting earnings and wages, the restaurant underpaid sales, income, and payroll taxes. Grimm is also charged with conspiring to commit health care fraud and obstructing an official proceeding. Grimm has called the investigation 'a political witch hunt ... to assassinate my character and remove me from office.' He told reporters he was 'somewhat relieved' the investigation had led to formal charges, as he can now address his accusers. Additional scrutiny has fallen on Grimm’s campaign finances; an investigation continues into illegal contributions linked to a friend and donor. CNN's Brian Vitagliano contributed to this report.

Savezni tužitelji tvrde da Grimm nije prijavio više od milijun dolara prihoda i plaća dok je vodio restoran Healthalicious na Manhattanu, koristeći neprijavljeni gotovinski novac za isplatu radnika 'na crno' kako bi izbjegao poreze. Grimm se izjasnio da nije kriv na saveznom sudu u Brooklynu i pušten je uz jamčevinu od 400.000 dolara, osiguranu svojom kućom na Staten Islandu. Kao uvjet puštanja na slobodu, 44-godišnjak mora predati oružje i putovnicu. Grimm je novinarima rekao da planira ostati na dužnosti dok osporava optužbe te da se kandidira za reizbor u studenom. Izjavio je: 'Borit ću se svim silama ... dok u potpunosti ne budem oslobođen.' Njegov odvjetnik je izrazio uvjerenje u Grimmovu nevinost. Grimm je napustio mjesto u Odboru za financijske usluge, tražeći uklanjanje do rješavanja pravnih pitanja. Glasnogovornik predsjednika Predstavničkog doma, Michael Steel, izjavio je da je Grimmova odluka primjerena. U optužnici koja je postala javna navodi se da je Grimm obmanjivao istražitelje o svojim porezima nakon što je napustio Healthalicious i krenuo u Kongres. Savezna tužiteljica Loretta Lynch je rekla da Grimm 'nikada nije sreo porez kojem nije lagao da ga izbjegne'. Optužbe se odnose na njegov rad u restoranu od 2007. do 2010. U Kongres je izabran 2010., a ponovno 2012., predstavljajući Staten Island i dijelove Brooklyna. Prema tužiteljima, Grimmova uloga računovođe, odvjetnika, bivšeg marinca i bivšeg FBI agenta postavila ga je za uspjeh kao vlasnika tvrtke, ali je odabrao kršiti zakon. Mnogi gotovinski prihodi u Healthaliciousu nisu prijavljeni kao prihod, a zaposlenici – neki bez odobrenja za rad u SAD-u – primali su dio ili cijelu plaću u gotovini, što nije prijavljeno poreznim vlastima. Zbog neprijavljivanja prihoda i plaća, restoran je platio znatno manje poreza na promet, dohodak i plaće. Grimm je također optužen za udruživanje radi prijevare u zdravstvenoj zaštiti i ometanje službenog postupka. Grimm je istragu nazvao 'političkim lovom na vještice ... s ciljem uništenja mog karaktera i uklanjanja iz ureda'. Novinarima je rekao kako se 'donekle osjeća olakšanje' jer sada može izravno suočiti svoje optužitelje. Grimmove kampanje dodatno se ispituju zbog navodnih ilegalnih donacija povezanih s prijateljem i donatorom, a istraga je još u tijeku. CNN-ov Brian Vitagliano doprinio je ovom izvještaju.

article_content: Australian Prime Minister Tony Abbott faced scrutiny over his leadership style and political identity during a challenging interview on national television, as revelations arose that six senior Cabinet members were among those supporting a motion to oust him. These Cabinet ministers, joined by nine MPs who had previously pledged loyalty, shifted their stance and helped bring the total to 39 votes in favor of a leadership spill. In his appearance on ABC’s 7.30 Report with Leigh Sales, Abbott was confronted about inconsistencies in his approach, with Sales pointing out that the public had witnessed different versions of his leadership— from his promises before winning office to unexpected policy changes and reversals once in power. Despite enduring a 61-39 vote against ousting him and professing a renewed commitment to effective governance, Abbott faces questions about his authority to remain as leader. The opposition, led by Bill Shorten, seized the moment to cast further doubt on Abbott's mandate. Public opinion has soured, with polling showing Abbott at a 68 percent disapproval rate, and alternative party leaders like Malcolm Turnbull and Julie Bishop gaining ground among voters. Notably, 64 percent of those polled preferred Turnbull over Abbott as Liberal leader. Abbott's position has been further weakened by controversial decisions such as granting a knighthood to Prince Philip and poor Liberal performance in recent state elections, especially in Queensland. Treasurer Joe Hockey criticized Cabinet members who supported the spill, insisting that disloyal colleagues should resign, and defended the government’s disputed budget reforms targeting health care, education, and welfare. Amid growing internal discord, Abbott defended his administration by citing challenges inherited from predecessors and reiterating his pragmatic approach to governance. Despite these assurances, analysts warn that Abbott's leadership will remain under threat, particularly if upcoming state elections yield unfavorable outcomes. Overall, the episode highlights the current instability within the government and ongoing doubts, both within the Liberal Party and among the public, over Tony Abbott’s direction and leadership.

Unatoč tome što je preživio glasovanje s rezultatom 61-39 protiv njegova smjenjivanja i izrazio obnovljenu predanost učinkovitom upravljanju, Abbott se i dalje suočava s pitanjima o svom autoritetu za ostanak na čelu stranke. article_content: A decade after having a lower back tattoo inked at age 21, Atlanta's Laura Hathaway now feels it no longer suits her life as a mother. Her young son's curiosity about the tattoo prompted her to seek removal. Hathaway is currently undergoing laser tattoo removal, finding the procedures much more painful than getting the tattoo. At Atlanta Dermatology Associates, Dr. Scott Karempelis oversees the treatments. Each brief session uses lasers to break up the tattoo ink, but requires about ten visits spread over months. The demand for tattoo removal has surged. Dr. Karempelis and his colleagues see over 30 patients daily who want tattoos erased, frequently due to lifestyle changes or regret. Nationwide, the American Academy of Dermatology reports nearly a quarter of adults are tattooed, with about one in six considering removal. During the process, the laser shatters pigment beneath the skin for natural absorption. However, it's costly—Hathaway will pay upwards of $2,200—and carries risks like discoloration or scarring, though these effects usually diminish over time. Certain ink colors—especially green, yellow, and purple—are tougher to remove, particularly for those with darker skin. Body area matters too, with ankle tattoos being the most difficult. Emerging tattoo inks, like Freedom-2, may soon allow for easier removal in just one session. But until such technology becomes widely available, patients endure multiple procedures to leave their past behind. The most commonly removed tattoos are former partner's names. For Hathaway, what was once a private flower tattoo has become an unwanted reminder. She got it before low-rise fashions exposed such body art, and now is choosing to move forward without it.
translated_content: Deset godina nakon što je u dobi od 21 godine napravila tetovažu na donjem dijelu leđa, Laura Hathaway iz Atlante više ne smatra da joj odgovara u ulozi majke. Radoznalost njezinog malog sina o tetovaži potaknula ju je da je ukloni. Hathaway trenutno prolazi lasersko uklanjanje tetovaže, koje joj je bolnije nego samo tetoviranje. U Dermatološkoj ordinaciji Atlanta, dr. Scott Karempelis vodi tretmane. Svaka kratka sesija laserom razbija pigment, no potrebno ih je oko deset raspoređenih tijekom nekoliko mjeseci. Potražnja za uklanjanjem tetovaža značajno je porasla. Dr. Karempelis i njegov tim svakodnevno primaju više od 30 pacijenata koji žele ukloniti tetovaže, najčešće zbog životnih promjena ili kajanja. Prema Američkoj akademiji za dermatologiju, gotovo četvrtina Amerikanaca ima tetovaže, a svaki šesti razmišlja o uklanjanju. Laser tijekom obrade razbija pigment u koži koji tijelo potom samo apsorbira. Postupak je skup—Hathaway će ukupno platiti više od 2.200 dolara—a postoji rizik od diskoloracije ili nastanka ožiljaka, premda to uglavnom s vremenom nestane. Neke boje, kao što su zelena, žuta i ljubičasta, teže je ukloniti, posebno kod osoba tamnijeg tena. Lokacija na tijelu također igra ulogu, pa su tetovaže na gležnjevima najzahtjevnije za obraditi. Nove tinte, poput Freedom-2, uskoro bi mogle omogućiti uklanjanje tetovaža u samo jednom tretmanu. Do tada pacijenti prolaze kroz brojne sesije kako bi uklonili tetovaže koje više ne žele. Imena bivših partnera najčešći su motiv za uklanjanje. Za Hathaway, cvijet koji je nekoć bio privatna tetovaža danas je neželjeni podsjetnik. Napravila ju je prije nego su postale moderne hlače niskog struka koje takve tetovaže čine vidljivima, i sada je odlučila krenuti dalje bez nje.

article_content: On Wednesday, the first truck carrying diesel fuel since the outbreak of war arrived in the Gaza Strip through the Rafah border crossing with Egypt. However, the United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees (UNRWA) stated the amount — just over 23,000 liters (about 6,083 gallons), or half a tanker — is 'not at all enough,' representing only 9 percent of the daily fuel required to maintain vital humanitarian activities. The use of this diesel has been strictly limited by the Israeli authorities, who have stipulated that it is only to be used for transporting humanitarian aid from Rafah and not for hospitals or other essential services. 'No fuel for water or hospitals,' Tom White, UNRWA’s Gaza director, said on X, emphasizing that fuel is being 'used as a weapon of war' and calling for more support. Israel imposed a complete siege on Gaza following Hamas’s attacks in southern Israel last month. Since October 21, some humanitarian aid shipments have crossed from Egypt into Gaza, but until now, Israel had not allowed any fuel in. On Tuesday, it approved the entry of 24,000 liters (6,340 gallons) of diesel — only for United Nations trucks, not hospitals, many of which are shutting down for lack of power. According to an Egyptian official cited by Agence France-Presse, the fuel was delivered to the UN to enable aid distribution after trucks on the Palestinian side were immobilized due to fuel shortages. Israel’s Ministry of Defence stated that, at the request of the US, UN aid trucks would be refueled at the Rafah crossing. The United Nations warned that shortages have already closed or are threatening to shut down hospitals, bakeries, sewage facilities, water desalination plants, wells, and could cut telecommunication services within 48 hours. Paltel and Jawwal, Gaza’s two main telecom providers, warned of a total communications blackout due to the fuel crisis. Philippe Lazzarini, UNRWA’s Commissioner-General, stated that the aid operation is 'on the verge of collapse' and projected that about 70 percent of Gaza's population would lose access to clean water by the end of the day. Lazzarini stressed that fuel solely for trucks 'will not save lives.' After the initial fuel truck entered Gaza, witnesses reported two more trucks waiting on the Egyptian side of Rafah, although it was unclear when they would be allowed to cross. Aid groups say the chronic lack of fuel severely restricts the delivery of food, water, and medicine to Palestinians in a territory under siege, with the ongoing Israeli military campaign having killed at least 11,200 people, following Hamas’s October 7 attack that resulted in approximately 1,200 deaths in Israel. On Tuesday, 91 trucks with supplies entered Gaza from Egypt, and since October 21, the UN reports that a total of 1,187 aid trucks have crossed, which covers only a small fraction of daily needs. Distribution has largely stalled due to the ongoing fuel shortage.
translated_content: U srijedu je prvi kamion s dizelskim gorivom od početka rata stigao u Pojas Gaze preko graničnog prijelaza Rafah s Egiptom. Međutim, Agencija Ujedinjenih naroda za pomoć palestinskim izbjeglicama (UNRWA) navela je da količina – nešto više od 23.000 litara (oko 6.083 galona), odnosno pola cisterne – 'nije ni približno dovoljna', što predstavlja samo 9 posto dnevnih potreba za održavanje ključnih humanitarnih aktivnosti. Korištenje ovog dizela strogo je ograničeno od strane izraelskih vlasti, koje su navele da se smije koristiti isključivo za prijevoz humanitarne pomoći iz Rafaha, a ne za bolnice ili druge ključne službe. 'Nema goriva za vodu ili bolnice', rekao je Tom White, direktor UNRWA-e za Gazu, na platformi X, naglašavajući da se gorivo 'koristi kao oružje u ratu' i pozvavši na veću podršku. Izrael je nametnuo potpunu opsadu Gazi nakon napada Hamasa u južnom Izraelu prošlog mjeseca. Od 21. listopada dio humanitarne pomoći prelazi iz Egipta u Gazu, ali do sada Izrael nije dopuštao ulazak goriva. U utorak je odobren unos 24.000 litara (6.340 galona) dizela – samo za kamione Ujedinjenih naroda, ne i za bolnice, od kojih se mnoge zatvaraju zbog nedostatka električne energije. Prema dužnosniku iz Egipta kojeg citira Agence France-Presse, gorivo je isporučeno UN-u kako bi se omogućila distribucija pomoći nakon što su kamioni s palestinske strane stali zbog nedostatka goriva. Izraelsko Ministarstvo obrane navelo je da će, na zahtjev SAD-a, UN kamioni biti opskrbljeni gorivom na prijelazu Rafah. Ujedinjeni narodi upozoravaju da je nestašica goriva već dovela ili prijeti zatvaranjem bolnica, pekara, postrojenja za pročišćavanje otpadnih voda, desalinizacijskih pogona i bunara, te bi mogla prekinuti telekomunikacijske usluge u roku od 48 sati. Paltel i Jawwal, glavne telekomunikacijske kompanije u Gazi, upozoravaju na potpuni gubitak veze zbog krize s gorivom. Philippe Lazzarini, generalni povjerenik UNRWA-e, izjavio je da je humanitarna operacija 'na rubu kolapsa' te procijenio da će oko 70 posto stanovništva Gaze do kraja dana izgubiti pristup čistoj vodi. Lazzarini je naglasio da gorivo isključivo za kamione 'više neće spašavati živote.' Nakon ulaska prvog kamiona s gorivom u Gazu, svjedoci su prijavili da još dva kamiona čekaju na egipatskoj strani Rafaha, ali nije jasno kad će im biti dopušten prelazak. Humanitarne organizacije navode da kronični nedostatak goriva ozbiljno ograničava dostavu hrane, vode i lijekova Palestincima u opsjednutom području, dok je izraelska vojna kampanja odnijela najmanje 11.200 života, nakon Hamasovog napada 7. listopada u kojem je poginulo oko 1.200 Izraelaca. U utorak je iz Egipta u Gazu ušao 91 kamion s humanitarnom pomoći, a UN navodi da je od 21. listopada ukupno 1.187 kamiona prešlo granicu, što pokriva tek mali dio dnevnih potreba. Distribucija pomoći uglavnom je obustavljena zbog nedostatka goriva.

article_content: Country singers, romance novelists, video game artists, and voice actors are urging the U.S. government to act quickly to protect their livelihoods from the threat posed by artificial intelligence. 'Please regulate AI. I’m scared,' wrote a podcaster worried about his voice being replicated by AI, in one of thousands of letters recently sent to the U.S. Copyright Office. Technology companies, meanwhile, are largely satisfied with existing rules that allow them to use published works to improve their AI systems’ ability to imitate human creativity. The nation's top copyright official, Shira Perlmutter, has not taken a public stance. She told The Associated Press that she is listening to all perspectives as the office considers if copyright reforms are needed to address new generative AI tools that can create convincing images, music, videos, and text. 'We’ve received close to 10,000 comments,' said Perlmutter, the U.S. Register of Copyrights. 'Every one of them is being read by a human being, not a computer. And I myself am reading a large part of them.' The U.S. Copyright Office, which registered over 480,000 copyrights last year, is increasingly asked to register works generated by AI. So far, fully machine-generated content has been denied copyright because the law only covers works of human authorship. But Perlmutter notes that as people guide AI and influence its outputs, it raises the question: is there a point where enough human involvement means the result qualifies for copyright? This is one of the questions the Copyright Office has brought to the public. Another is how to handle AI systems that train on copyrighted works from the internet without creators’ permission or compensation. More than 9,700 public comments were submitted before the initial deadline in October. Another round is due by December 6. The Copyright Office will then advise Congress and other policymakers. Addressing the 'Ladies and Gentlemen of the US Copyright Office,' actor and filmmaker Justine Bateman expressed alarm that AI models are 'ingesting 100 years of film' in a way that could undermine the film industry and its workforce. She wrote, 'It appears to many of us to be the largest copyright violation in the history of the United States. I sincerely hope you can stop this practice of thievery.' Similarly, TV showrunner Lilla Zuckerman called AI models 'plagiarism machines' threatening to take over Hollywood and remove human talent from entertainment. Country songwriter Marc Beeson stated that while AI has benefits, if unchecked, it could cause 'irreparable damage to one of the last true American art forms.' Many commenters were individuals, but major organizations such as Universal Music Group, author groups, and news outlets like the New York Times and The Associated Press also voiced concerns about the way AI is trained. Tech companies like Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI told the Copyright Office their AI training falls under 'fair use,' which allows limited use of copyrighted materials for teaching, research, or transforming content. Meta Platforms, parent of Facebook and Instagram, said in a letter that the American AI industry relies on the interpretation that training generative AI with copyrighted material does not violate copyright, since the goal is to identify patterns, not extract individual works. To date, courts have mostly supported tech companies’ understanding of copyright as it relates to AI. A federal judge in San Francisco recently dismissed most of the first major lawsuit against AI image generators, though part of the case will continue. Tech companies regularly cite Google’s previous legal victory over its online book library as precedent. The U.S. Supreme Court in 2016 upheld rulings that Google’s digitizing of millions of books and showing only snippets did not infringe copyright. However, romance author Heidi Bond, aka Courtney Milan, argued that while fair use allows learning from books, Google Books obtained legal copies, whereas many AI companies scrape content from the web without permission. She called this 'outright piracy.' Perlmutter says this distinction is what the Copyright Office is trying to clarify. 'Certainly this differs in some respects from the Google situation,' she said. 'Whether it differs enough to rule out fair use is the question in hand.'
translated_content: Country pjevači, spisateljice romantičnih romana, umjetnici video igara i glumci s glasovima pozivaju američku vladu da brzo djeluje kako bi zaštitila njihove karijere od prijetnje koju donosi umjetna inteligencija. 'Molim vas regulirajte AI. Strah me,' napisao je voditelj podcasta zabrinut što bi AI mogao replicirati njegov glas, u jednom od tisuća pisama nedavno poslanih američkom Uredu za autorska prava. Tehnološke tvrtke, s druge strane, uglavnom su zadovoljne postojećim pravilima koja im dopuštaju korištenje objavljenih djela kako bi unaprijedile svoje AI sustave i poboljšale njihovu sposobnost oponašanja ljudske kreativnosti. Najviša američka dužnosnica za autorska prava, Shira Perlmutter, još nije zauzela javan stav. Za Associated Press izjavila je da sluša sve strane dok ured razmatra treba li autorsko pravo mijenjati zbog novih alata generativne umjetne inteligencije koji mogu stvarati slike, glazbu, video i tekst koji uvjerljivo nalikuju onima koje stvaraju ljudi. 'Primili smo blizu 10.000 komentara,' rekla je Perlmutter, američka registratorica autorskih prava. 'Svaki od njih pročitao je čovjek, a ne računalni program. I osobno sam pročitala velik dio njih.' Američki ured za autorska prava, koji je prošle godine izdao više od 480.000 autorskih prava, sve češće dobiva zahtjeve za registraciju djela koje je generirao AI. Do sada su potpuno strojno generirani sadržaji odbijeni jer zakon štiti isključivo djela ljudskog autorstva. No Perlmutter napominje da, kako ljudi usmjeravaju AI i utječu na njegove rezultate, postavlja se pitanje: postoji li trenutak u kojem je ljudsko sudjelovanje dovoljno da bi se djelo smatralo zaštićenim autorskim pravom? To je jedno od pitanja koje je ured iznio javnosti. Drugo je kako postupati s AI sustavima koji se treniraju na autorskim djelima preuzetim s interneta bez dozvole ili naknade autorima. Više od 9.700 komentara javnosti poslano je prije prvog roka u listopadu. Drugi krug traje do 6. prosinca, nakon čega će ured za autorska prava savjetovati Kongres i druge donositelje odluka. Obraćajući se 'poštovanim članovima američkog ureda za autorska prava,' glumica i redateljica Justine Bateman izrazila je zabrinutost što AI modeli 'upijaju 100 godina filma' na način koji bi mogao potkopati filmsku industriju i radnu snagu. Napisala je: 'Mnogi od nas smatraju da je ovo najveće kršenje autorskih prava u povijesti SAD-a. Iskreno se nadam da možete zaustaviti ovu praksu krađe.' Slično tome, TV producentica Lilla Zuckerman nazvala je AI modele 'strojevima za plagijat' koji prijete preuzimanju Hollywooda i uklanjanju ljudskih talenata iz industrije zabave. Country tekstopisac Marc Beeson rekao je da AI ima prednosti, ali ako ostane nereguliran, može nanijeti 'nepopravljivu štetu jednom od posljednjih pravih američkih oblika umjetnosti.' Iako su mnogi komentatori pojedinci, zabrinutost su izrazile i velike organizacije kao što su Universal Music Group, književne udruge i mediji poput New York Timesa i The Associated Pressa. Tehnički divovi poput Googlea, Microsofta i OpenAI rekli su Uredu za autorska prava da je njihovo treniranje AI sustava u skladu s 'pravednom upotrebom' koja dopušta ograničeno korištenje za potrebe podučavanja, istraživanja ili transformacije sadržaja. Meta Platforms, vlasnik Facebooka i Instagrama, u pismu je naveo da se američka AI industrija temelji na tumačenju da učenje generativne AI putem zaštićenih materijala nije kršenje jer je cilj pronaći obrasce, a ne izvući konkretna djela. Dosad su sudovi uglavnom podržali tehnološke tvrtke u vezi autorskih prava i AI-ja. Savezni sudac u San Franciscu nedavno je odbacio većinu prve velike tužbe protiv AI generatora slika, iako dio slučaja i dalje traje. Tehnološke tvrtke često navode Googleovu pobjedu u slučaju online knjižnice kao presedan. Vrhovni sud SAD-a 2016. je potvrdio presudu da digitalizacija milijuna knjiga i prikazivanje samo isječaka ne predstavlja kršenje autorskih prava. No spisateljica ljubavnih romana Heidi Bond, poznata kao Courtney Milan, smatra da, dok 'pravedna upotreba' dopušta učenje iz knjiga, Google Books je stekao legalne primjerke, dok mnoge AI tvrtke sadržaj uzimaju s interneta bez dozvole autora. To je nazvala 'otvorenom piratizacijom.' Perlmutter kaže da upravo tu razliku ured nastoji razjasniti. 'Ovo se svakako u nekim dijelovima razlikuje od Googleovog slučaja,' rekla je. 'Pitanje je razlikuje li se dovoljno da isključuje pravo pozivanja na pravednu upotrebu.'

article_content: Nitin, founder of QRCodeChimp and seasoned technology leader, highlights the transformative power of professional networking in business development and sales. Building authentic relationships can significantly boost lead generation, sales, and overall revenue.  Importance of Networking for Business Development and Sales  Networking unlocks a wealth of opportunities, allowing professionals to connect with potential clients, investors, partners, and employers. Such connections often lead to collaborations, projects, and ventures that may otherwise remain out of reach.  Furthermore, engaging with industry experts through networking provides valuable marketing insights and a better understanding of market trends. This knowledge supports the creation of informed go-to-market strategies and fuels business growth.  Effective networking also generates high-quality leads and referrals. By cultivating targeted relationships, individuals are more likely to convert prospects into clients, benefiting from the trust inherent in personal recommendations.  Professional networking plays a key role in building brand reputation and visibility. Regular engagement and expertise-sharing foster brand awareness and inspire trust among potential clients and partners. A strong brand presence also opens doors to speaking engagements, guest articles, and other opportunities to demonstrate authority.  Networking Tips to Enhance Business Development and Sales  Consider upgrading from traditional to digital business cards to maximize your networking potential. Digital cards offer convenience, sustainability, security, personalization, and cost-effectiveness. They allow instant contact sharing, multimedia integration, real-time edits, action-oriented features like CTA buttons, and ease of distribution across channels via QR codes or NFC cards.  Leveraging digital platforms such as LinkedIn, Angel List, Opportunity, Xing, and LunchMeet can expand your reach and uncover lucrative networking opportunities. Simply register, complete your profile, and actively connect to grow your professional network.  Physical networking remains equally important. Attending in-person events—seminars, conferences, trade shows, workshops, meet-ups, or roundtable discussions—facilitates deeper relationship-building and enhances trust and credibility.  It is crucial to focus on forming lasting relationships rooted in mutual value, rather than just sales or transactions. Providing genuine value to your contacts increases the likelihood of successful collaborations.  Consistent follow-up is essential. Stay memorable by maintaining communication via messages and social media. This ensures you remain top-of-mind when your contacts require your expertise or services.  Networking Mistakes to Avoid  • Being overly transactional: Effective relationships require time and trust, not just a focus on immediate gains. • Failing to add value: Build mutually beneficial connections by contributing meaningfully. • Neglecting online networking: Most professional connections are now initiated digitally—use these platforms to grow your network. • Overlooking niche networks: In addition to major platforms, join industry-specific networks (e.g., Trulia for real estate, Gust for startups) to maximize opportunities.  Conclusion  Strategic networking remains a powerful tool for business growth—especially in development and sales. By utilizing the right strategies, professionals can meet high-quality prospects and turn them into loyal, repeat customers.  The Forbes Business Council is highlighted as a premier organization fostering growth and networking opportunities for business leaders.
translated_content: Nitin, osnivač QRCodeChimpa i iskusni tehnološki lider, ističe transformativnu moć profesionalnog umrežavanja u razvoju poslovanja i prodaji. Izgradnja autentičnih odnosa može značajno povećati broj potencijalnih klijenata, prodaju i ukupne prihode.  Važnost umrežavanja za razvoj poslovanja i prodaju  Umrežavanje otvara niz prilika, omogućujući profesionalcima povezivanje s potencijalnim klijentima, investitorima, partnerima i poslodavcima. Takve veze često rezultiraju suradnjama, projektima i poslovima koji inače možda ne bi bili dostupni.  Također, suradnja s industrijskim stručnjacima kroz umrežavanje pruža vrijedne marketinške uvide i bolje razumijevanje tržišnih trendova. Ovo znanje podržava stvaranje informiranih strategija i potiče rast poslovanja.  Učinkovito umrežavanje također generira kvalitetne potencijalne klijente i preporuke. Kultiviranjem ciljnih odnosa, pojedinci imaju veću šansu pretvoriti potencijalne klijente u stvarne, što je olakšano povjerenjem koje dolazi s osobnim preporukama.  Profesionalno umrežavanje igra ključnu ulogu u izgradnji reputacije i vidljivosti brenda. Redovito angažiranje i dijeljenje stručnosti potiču prepoznatljivost brenda i povjerenje kod potencijalnih klijenata i partnera. Jaka prisutnost otvara vrata prilikama kao što su javni nastupi, gostujući članci i druge mogućnosti za prikazivanje stručnosti.  Savjeti za poboljšanje umrežavanja u svrhu razvoja poslovanja i prodaje  Razmislite o prelasku s klasičnih na digitalne posjetnice kako biste maksimizirali svoj potencijal umrežavanja. Digitalne posjetnice nude praktičnost, održivost, sigurnost, personalizaciju i isplativost. Omogućuju trenutno dijeljenje kontakata, integraciju multimedije, uređivanje podataka u stvarnom vremenu, akcijske tipke (CTA) i jednostavno dijeljenje putem QR kodova ili NFC kartica.  Korištenje digitalnih platformi poput LinkedIna, Angel Lista, Opportunityja, Xinga i LunchMeeta može proširiti vašu mrežu i otkriti vrijedne mogućnosti za umrežavanje. Dovoljno je registrirati se, popuniti profil i aktivno se povezivati kako biste izgradili svoju profesionalnu mrežu.  Fizičko umrežavanje je jednako važno. Sudjelovanje na događanjima uživo—seminarima, konferencijama, sajmovima, radionicama, neformalnim okupljanjima ili okruglim stolovima—omogućuje dublje razvijanje odnosa i jačanje povjerenja i kredibiliteta.  Važno je usredotočiti se na izgradnju trajnih odnosa temeljenih na obostranoj vrijednosti, a ne samo na prodaju ili transakcije. Pružanje stvarne vrijednosti vašim kontaktima povećava šanse za uspješnu suradnju.  Dosljedno praćenje je ključno. Ostanite zapamćeni održavanjem komunikacije putem poruka i društvenih mreža, kako biste bili prvi na pameti kada kontaktima zatrebaju vaša ekspertiza ili usluge.  Greške koje treba izbjegavati u umrežavanju  • Previše transakcijski pristup: Učinkoviti odnosi zahtijevaju vrijeme i povjerenje, a ne isključivo fokus na trenutnu korist. • Ne dodavati vrijednost: Gradite obostrano korisne veze davanjem stvarnog doprinosa. • Zanemarivanje online umrežavanja: Većina profesionalnih veza danas započinje digitalno—iskoristite te platforme za širenje mreže. • Ignoriranje nišnih mreža: Uz glavne platforme, pridružite se i industrijski specifičnim mrežama (npr. Trulia za nekretnine, Gust za startupe) kako biste pronašli dodatne prilike.  Zaključak  Strateško umrežavanje ostaje moćan alat za razvoj poslovanja—posebno u prodaji. Primjenom pravih strategija, profesionalci mogu upoznati kvalitetne potencijalne klijente i pretvoriti ih u lojalne, trajne kupce.  Forbes Business Council ističe se kao vodeća organizacija za rast i umrežavanje među poslovnim liderima.

article_content: Google Glass has been widely discussed as the next big step in wearable computing. Initial images and demonstrations were seen as underwhelming, but a new first-person video now offers the clearest look yet at what wearing the technology is actually like. Tech expert Rob Jackson, from Phandroid, created the video to show the user's perspective while using Google Glass. In it, he demonstrates functions including getting directions, recording video, converting currency, and participating in a Google+ Hangout video chat. Although these features are already present in modern smartphones, Jackson believes that more innovative uses will emerge as developers start building apps for Glass, particularly when it becomes available to the public. Despite the excitement, there is growing debate over privacy and legal implications. Institutions such as strip clubs, cinemas, and casinos have already banned Google Glass over concerns about covert video recording. In West Virginia, lawmakers have even attempted to outlaw its use while driving. Legal experts like Timothy Toohey warn that Google Glass could spark significant legal challenges about privacy. Nick Pickles from Big Brother Watch suggests that if third parties can access data on the devices, the impact could far exceed previous phone-hacking incidents. Wearable computing pioneer Thad Starner, advising the Glass team, says he has not experienced any serious incidents while testing. However, Steve Mann, a University of Toronto professor, claims he was assaulted in a Paris McDonald’s for wearing a similar device. Google has acknowledged the controversy, with chairman Eric Schmidt and spokesperson Courtney Hohne emphasizing their commitment to user privacy and careful product design. Early versions of Google Glass are being tested by developers and selected 'explorers.' At the same time, Google has organized developer conference sessions aimed at experimenting with the device. Business owners remain wary. Peter Feinstein of Sapphire Gentlemen's Club in Las Vegas stated that guests would have to check in their glasses to prevent unauthorized filming. Technological advancements continue, such as the Winky app, which lets users take pictures by blinking instead of speaking a command. This has further raised privacy concerns. Additionally, Google Glass automatically censors explicit language in its voice recognition system—the feature cannot be disabled. Analyst firm Piper Jaffray has estimated the wearable tech market, along with self-driving cars, could represent a $500 billion opportunity for Google in the long run. In the near term, IHS forecasts that smart glasses shipments could reach 6.6 million units within three years.

Tehnološki stručnjak Rob Jackson s portala Phandroid snimio je video kako bi pokazao perspektivu korisnika tijekom korištenja Google Glassa. U videu demonstrira funkcije poput traženja uputa, snimanja videa, konverzije valuta i sudjelovanja u Google+ Hangout videorazgovoru. Unatoč uzbuđenju, vodi se sve veća rasprava o privatnosti i pravnim implikacijama. Institucije poput striptiz klubova, kina i kockarnica već su zabranile Google Glass zbog zabrinutosti oko prikrivenog snimanja. U Zapadnoj Virginiji zakonodavci su čak pokušali zabraniti korištenje uređaja tijekom vožnje. Pravni stručnjaci poput Timothyja Tooheya upozoravaju da bi Google Glass mogao izazvati značajne pravne izazove oko privatnosti. Nick Pickles iz grupe Big Brother Watch smatra da bi pristup podacima od strane trećih strana mogao imati veće posljedice nego prijašnji slučajevi hakiranja telefona. Pionir nosive tehnologije Thad Starner, savjetnik tima za Glass, kaže da tijekom testiranja nije doživio ozbiljnije incidente. Ipak, Steve Mann, profesor na Sveučilištu u Torontu, tvrdi da je bio napadnut u McDonald'su u Parizu noseći sličan uređaj. Google je priznao kontroverzu — predsjednik Eric Schmidt i glasnogovornica Courtney Hohne ističu svoju predanost privatnosti korisnika i pažljivom dizajnu proizvoda. Rane verzije Google Glassa testiraju developeri i odabrani 'istraživači'. Ujedno, Google organizira konferencijske sesije posvećene eksperimentiranju s uređajem. Poslovni subjekti i dalje su oprezni. Peter Feinstein iz Sapphire Gentlemen's Club-a u Las Vegasu kaže da će gosti morati predati naočale kako bi se spriječilo neovlašteno snimanje. Tehnološki napredak se nastavlja, primjerice s aplikacijom Winky, koja korisnicima omogućuje snimanje fotografija treptajem umjesto glasovne naredbe. To je dodatno izazvalo zabrinutost za privatnost. Također, Google Glass automatski cenzurira eksplicitni jezik u glasovnim naredbama — tu funkciju nije moguće isključiti. Analitička tvrtka Piper Jaffray procjenjuje da tržište nosive tehnologije, zajedno s autonomnim vozilima, dugoročno za Google može značiti priliku od 500 milijardi dolara. Kratkoročno, tvrtka IHS predviđa da bi isporuka pametnih naočala mogla doseći 6,6 milijuna jedinica u sljedeće tri godine.

article_content: Red Bull has been dominant over the past two Formula One seasons, but double world champion Sebastian Vettel has warned that the team's 2012 car may be slower than last year's model. Vettel, who won drivers’ titles in 2010 and 2011 and became F1’s youngest two-time champion, also expects this season’s competition to be much tighter, after winning 11 of the 19 races last year. "Last season, we cleverly incorporated the exhaust system, which made the car faster by providing greater grip," the 24-year-old told Formula One's official website. "That is a thing of the past for 2012, and for now, we have to adapt. This applies to all teams. We are working on ways to regain that grip, and I am confident we will succeed, though it will take time." Vettel added, "We hope to dominate again this season, but I think the performance gaps between the top teams and the midfield will be smaller. We might even see some surprises." Should Vettel secure the championship again in 2012, he would join Argentina’s Juan Manuel Fangio and fellow German Michael Schumacher as the only drivers to have won three consecutive F1 titles. "I didn’t realize only two drivers have done it," Vettel admitted. "As the saying goes, third time’s a charm, so let’s give it another go this year!" The 2012 season will feature six former world champions competing together for the first time. Alongside Vettel are Schumacher with Mercedes, McLaren’s British duo Lewis Hamilton and Jenson Button, Ferrari’s two-time champion Fernando Alonso, and 2007 champion Kimi Raikkonen returning with Lotus. "Having six past champions on the grid is something special that’s never happened before," Vettel said. "Being one of them feels great, but that is history. What matters is the next 20 races, as past wins don’t make you any faster." "Once we start the season in Melbourne, it’s a new game. Past glory is great but must translate to the present," Vettel emphasized. The 2012 campaign is set to be the longest in F1 history, with 20 races scheduled, including the return of the U.S. Grand Prix in Austin, Texas, in November. Vettel isn’t overly concerned by the expanded schedule but believes no more races should be added. "Twenty races is a big workload, but whether it’s 19 or 20 doesn’t make much difference. Few sports have such a long season, so we just need to work hard. Managing your energy will be important, and sometimes we’ll need to say, ‘thanks, but no thanks.’ You can’t be everywhere, no matter how appealing it is."

Proslavljena prošlost je lijepa, ali moraš to prenijeti u sadašnjost," naglasio je Vettel. Sezona 2012. bit će najduža u povijesti F1, s 20 predviđenih utrka, uključujući povratak Velike nagrade SAD-a u Austinu, Texasu, u studenom. Vettela ne zabrinjava posebno prošireni kalendar, ali smatra da više utrka ne bi trebalo biti. "Dvadeset utrka je velik zalogaj, ali je li ih 19 ili 20, nema velike razlike. Malo je sportova s tako dugom sezonom, zato svi moramo zasukati rukave. Bit će važno pametno rasporediti energiju i ponekad reći: 'hvala, ali ne hvala.' Ne možeš biti svugdje, koliko god to bilo primamljivo."

article_content: Shriram Capital, the primary financial company within the Shriram Group, is allocating Rs 300 crore towards launching a new business aimed at aggregating and managing small-scale bad loans. The move leverages the company’s extensive experience in loan recovery. Shriram is currently seeking regulatory approval from the Reserve Bank of India to establish an asset reconstruction company (ARC) and expects to start operations before the fiscal year concludes. Director Umesh Revankar highlighted that the new initiative is designed to focus on retail loans valued at less than Rs 20 lakh—a segment seldom addressed by other ARCs. Shriram Capital will wholly own this new venture and has initiated the process of hiring and training a dedicated team. Furthermore, Shriram Capital is revitalizing and growing its wealth management division to enhance its mutual fund business. Earlier this year, Mission1 Investments LLC invested Rs 35 crore, assigning the mutual fund division a valuation of Rs 150 crore. Once certain financial instruments are converted, Mission1 will acquire a 23% stake. According to Vice Chairman DV Ravi, the expansion of wealth management will help Shriram deepen ties with a wide range of customers, including depositors, two-wheeler borrowers, and small- and medium-sized enterprise clients. The Shriram Group possesses a deposit base of approximately Rs 38,000 crore and serves around 500,000 depositors, whom the company plans to approach with its wealth and asset management offerings. The group’s wealth management, mutual fund, and broking services operate through Shriram Credit, a non-banking financial company (NBFC) subsidiary. Separately, Shriram General Insurance, part of the group’s insurance segment, posted a net profit of Rs 217 crore for the first half of the current fiscal year, reflecting a 47% growth compared to the previous year. The general insurance business is jointly owned by Shriram (67%), Sanlam Group of South Africa (23%), and private equity firm KKR (10%).

article_content: Emotions ran especially high in Game 2 of the World Series at Kauffman Stadium, where the Kansas City Royals and San Francisco Giants nearly clashed on the field during the sixth inning. Royals catcher Salvador Perez and Giants pitcher Hunter Strickland got into a shouting match after Perez's two-run double, prompting players from both dugouts to rush onto the field. That incident seemed to ignite the Royals, who exploded for five runs in the inning—highlighted by Omar Infante’s two-run homer. Kansas City’s relievers Kelvin Herrera, Wade Davis, and Greg Holland kept the Giants in check, helping secure a decisive 7-2 victory to tie the series at one game apiece as the action heads to San Francisco. Perez later described the altercation as a misunderstanding, while Strickland admitted to losing his composure in the moment. Kansas City took the initiative early, with Lorenzo Cain’s first-inning double and Billy Butler’s RBI single. While the Giants remained in contention thanks to Gregor Blanco’s leadoff home run and Brandon Belt’s RBI, the Royals' key hitting and strong bullpen sealed the win. Giants manager Bruce Bochy acknowledged that both teams are evenly matched, hinting at more closely fought contests to come. The teams now prepare for the next matchup, with Jeremy Guthrie set to start for Kansas City and Tim Hudson for San Francisco.

Relieviri Kansasa Kelvin Herrera, Wade Davis i Greg Holland držali su Giantse pod kontrolom, osiguravši uvjerljivu pobjedu 7-2 i izjednačivši seriju na 1-1 dok se radnja seli u San Francisco. Trener Giantsa Bruce Bochy priznao je ravnotežu snaga, predviđajući još neizvjesnih susreta. article_content: Mohammad Soleimani Nia, a respected Iranian literary translator, has gone missing following his release from Evin Prison, according to sources close to him. Soleimani Nia, age 40, disappeared after authorities called him to retrieve his driver’s license, computer, and passport from an office near the Tehran prison. His ordeal started in late November 2011, when Iranian security officials questioned him for unexplained reasons. Surveillance and his own discretion left friends and family in the dark about the motive, though he was barred from leaving the country. In January, Soleimani Nia was summoned to the Revolutionary Court, known for hearing grave charges such as smuggling or anti-government acts. Security officers then brought him to his parents’ home in Karaj, near Tehran, conducted a search, seized documents and devices, and prevented him from speaking to his family. He was subsequently detained on unknown accusations, held partly in solitary at Evin Prison, and later freed on bail after ending a 28-day hunger strike. His recent disappearance has left friends and supporters worried, uncertain if he ever reached the office to collect his belongings or was intercepted earlier. So far, Iranian officials have offered no explanations or claimed responsibility. Soleimani Nia is well regarded for translating the popular memoir 'Funny in Farsi' into Persian. Author Firoozeh Dumas describes him as gentle, apolitical, and deeply committed to his culture and community. Additionally, he pioneered U24, a professional networking platform for Iranians, similar to LinkedIn, to improve job prospects. Dumas noted that such innovation would typically be praised elsewhere, yet brings danger in Iran. As of now, authorities have not responded officially to inquiries about Soleimani Nia’s fate.

Soleimani Nia, koji ima 40 godina, nestao je nakon što su ga vlasti pozvale da preuzme svoju vozačku dozvolu, računalo i putovnicu u uredu blizu zatvora u Teheranu. Njegove nevolje započele su krajem studenog 2011., kada su ga iranski sigurnosni dužnosnici ispitivali iz nepoznatih razloga. Zbog nadzora i vlastite diskrecije, njegova obitelj i prijatelji ostali su bez konkretnih informacija o razlozima, a on je dobio zabranu napuštanja zemlje. U siječnju je Soleimani Nia pozvan na Revolucionarni sud, poznat po procesuiranju ozbiljnih optužbi poput krijumčarenja ili djelovanja protiv države. Nakon toga su ga pripadnici sigurnosti doveli u dom njegovih roditelja u Karaju, predgrađu Teherana, proveli pretragu, oduzeli dokumente i tehniku, te mu zabranili komunikaciju s roditeljima. Potom je bio pritvoren pod nepoznatim optužbama, djelomice u samici u zatvoru Evin, i na kraju pušten uz jamčevinu nakon što je prekinuo 28-dnevni štrajk glađu. Njegov nedavni nestanak izazvao je veliku zabrinutost prijatelja i podržavatelja, koji ne znaju je li stigao po svoje stvari ili je već tada presretnut. Iranske vlasti još uvijek nisu dale nikakvo objašnjenje niti preuzele odgovornost. Soleimani Nia posebno je poznat po prijevodu popularnih memoara „Funny in Farsi” na perzijski. Autorica Firoozeh Dumas opisuje ga kao nježnu, apolitičnu osobu duboko posvećenu kulturi i zajednici. Osim toga, smatra se pionirem zahvaljujući pokretanju U24 – profesionalne mreže za povezivanje Iranaca slične LinkedInu radi boljih mogućnosti zapošljavanja. Dumas napominje da bi takve inovacije drugdje bile slavljene, dok u Iranu donose rizik. Vlasti do danas nisu odgovorile na upite o sudbini Soleimanija Nie.

article_content: As October begins, Netflix introduces a range of new shows set to capture viewer attention, including Lupin, The Fall of the House of Usher, Ballerina, and Elite—titles expected to dominate the streaming charts. While these series are likely to top the 'most popular' lists, there are other compelling shows deserving attention that may not appear on the front page. Here are three underrated Netflix series worth watching this October: Last Chance U is a documentary series that follows junior college football players whose aspirations for a Division I scholarship have been challenged by academic setbacks, personal hardships, or legal troubles. The show provides an inside look at the journeys of athletes at East Mississippi Community College (seasons 1-2), Independence Community College (seasons 3-4), and Laney College (season 5). Both football fans and non-fans will find the off-field stories as engaging as the action on the field. Unorthodox, Netflix’s first Yiddish-language series, adapts Deborah Feldman’s memoir, 'Unorthodox: The Scandalous Rejection of My Hasidic Roots.' The series follows Esty Shapiro (Shira Haas), a young woman in Brooklyn who leaves her arranged marriage and ultra-Orthodox community for a new life in Berlin. As Esty embarks on a journey of self-discovery, her husband, Yanky, and his cousin Moishe attempt to bring her back. This four-episode series offers a rare portrayal of a community seldom depicted on screen and features a standout performance from Haas. Maid is a limited series inspired by Stephanie Land’s memoir, 'Maid: Hard Work, Low Pay, and a Mother’s Will to Survive.' It tells the story of Alex Russell (Margaret Qualley), a young mother near Seattle who leaves her abusive partner and strives to build a better life for her daughter. Facing financial hardship, Alex finds work as a maid and navigates the complexities of government assistance. The series shines a light on perseverance and the challenges faced by those escaping abusive relationships while dealing with bureaucratic obstacles.

article_content: Premier League teams will collectively fly more than 176,000 miles this summer as they play pre-season matches around the world to gear up for the new season. With just over a month separating the World Cup final and the Premier League’s kickoff, nineteen out of twenty top-tier English clubs are heading abroad for their preparations. These international tours underline the major commercial appeal of reaching global fans and markets. Teams will visit destinations such as the United States, New Zealand, Bangkok, and various European cities. The USA is the top choice this year, drawing nine Premier League sides. Although the total air miles traveled (176,164) is slightly lower than last year’s 199,701—reflecting the strains of a busy summer—most clubs still have demanding travel plans. For many players, a restful break is unlikely, as their clubs focus on boosting overseas exposure and growth. Newcastle United and West Ham United stand out for especially long trips, both touring New Zealand and then heading to Germany for the Schalke 04 Cup. Hull City, by contrast, is the only club staying in the UK for all its pre-season games. Other clubs have notable itineraries: Liverpool will visit Copenhagen plus several U.S. cities, Manchester United will start their tour against LA Galaxy in California, and Chelsea, unlike last year, will only play matches in Europe. The club-by-club breakdown highlights the wide range of miles teams will cover, with Newcastle United and West Ham United each traveling over 24,000 miles, while Southampton covers just 637 miles. Overall, English football’s most elite clubs are embarking on ambitious journeys as they further expand their global reach.

article_content: As President of Univention North America, I emphasize the importance of maintaining control over your data, your company, and your future. AI has begun to handle many routine tasks for us, from customer service to meeting management. However, its long-term impact remains uncertain. Will AI free us to focus on what matters most, or simply become the latest tool creating new challenges? Reviewing past technological upheavals offers guidance on maximizing the benefits of AI.  The Evolution of Office Roles Before networked computers, having a secretary alongside middle managers was common. Today, personal assistants are typically reserved for top executives. Middle managers now schedule meetings, write summaries, and handle emails themselves. Technology has simplified administrative work but often shifts responsibilities to users. While this self-service approach streamlines some processes, it can also expand bureaucracies, as noted by management expert Gary Hamel, leading to more managers and sometimes increased stress and burnout instead of productivity.  Digital Transformation and Data Challenges Digital transformation aims to create cohesive IT infrastructure, reduce manual data entry, and minimize errors. Yet, many projects fall short, resulting in redundant systems, excess digital identities, and numerous dashboards needing manual updates. As AI promises more sweeping changes, the question remains: how can we make this digital change more successful than previous ones?  Three Approaches for Effective AI Integration 1. Manage Expectations: AI is Advanced Automation Believing in overhyped AI scenarios can lead to disappointment. While networked computers improved communication, clear messaging still depends on people. Similarly, digital tools only deliver insights if data is accurate. AI won’t replace humans but can offer better tools, like advanced translation and workflow support. When evaluating AI, it's vital to consider real capabilities, as well as cybersecurity and data privacy.  2. Define Real Business Needs Finding the right use for AI in your organization is crucial. Not all businesses require complex solutions — for instance, a local computer repair shop likely needs AI to answer customer emails, not analyze financial results. The focus should be on removing obstacles hindering employee productivity without sacrificing human interaction and workplace satisfaction.  3. Avoid Unnecessary Disruption: Adopt Gradually Introducing too many AI tools can cause confusion and resistance, particularly from non-IT staff wary of disrupted routines. Most employees prefer stable, reliable systems. Implementing AI solutions gradually, one pain point at a time, encourages acceptance and ensures genuine productivity improvements. Poorly executed projects can waste resources and deter future innovation.  Conclusion: Realistic AI Adoption Drives Results By setting achievable goals and addressing real challenges step by step, organizations can harness AI for meaningful productivity gains. Ready-to-use, user-friendly AI solutions can resolve common frustrations and allow people to focus on important work. While not magical, AI—when properly implemented—can empower teams and enhance workplace efficiency.
translated_content: Kao predsjednik tvrtke Univention North America, naglašavam važnost očuvanja kontrole nad vašim podacima, kompanijom i budućnošću. Umjetna inteligencija (AI) već preuzima mnoge rutinske zadatke, od korisničke podrške do organizacije sastanaka. Ipak, još ne znamo kakav će biti njezin krajnji učinak. Hoće li nam AI omogućiti fokus na ono što je najvažnije ili će postati još jedan izvor novih izazova? Pogled na dosadašnje tehnološke promjene može nam pomoći da najbolje iskoristimo AI.  Razvoj uredskih poslova Prije umreženih računala, tajnice su bile česte uz menadžere srednje razine. Danas osobne asistente uglavnom koriste samo najviši rukovoditelji. Srednji menadžeri sada sami zakazuju sastanke, pišu sažetke i šalju e-mailove. Tehnologija je pojednostavila administrativne poslove, ali je često te zadatke prebacila na same korisnike. Iako takvo samoposluživanje ubrzava neke procese, može povećati birokraciju, što ističe stručnjak za menadžment Gary Hamel, te dovesti do više menadžera i dodatnog stresa i izgaranja umjesto veće produktivnosti.  Digitalna transformacija i izazovi s podacima Cilj digitalne transformacije je izgradnja koherentne IT infrastrukture, smanjenje ručnog unosa podataka i minimiziranje pogrešaka. Ipak, mnogi projekti nisu uspjeli pa imamo višestruke sustave, previše digitalnih identiteta i mnoge nadzorne ploče koje treba ručno ažurirati. Kako AI obećava nove promjene, ostaje pitanje: kako ovaj digitalni val učiniti uspješnijim od prethodnih?  Tri pristupa za učinkovitu integraciju AI-a 1. Upravljanje očekivanjima: AI je poboljšana automatizacija Prevelika očekivanja od AI-a mogu rezultirati razočaranjem. Umrežena računala su poboljšala komunikaciju, ali smisao poruka i dalje ovisi o ljudima. Digitalni alati daju prave uvide samo ako su podaci točni. AI neće zamijeniti ljude, no može pružiti bolje alate — npr. napredne prevoditelje i podršku u svakodnevnom radu. Prilikom uvođenja AI-a treba razmotriti stvarne mogućnosti, kibernetičku sigurnost i zaštitu privatnosti.  2. Odredite stvarne poslovne potrebe Ključno je prepoznati gdje AI može stvarno pomoći vašoj organizaciji. Ne trebaju svima kompleksna rješenja — lokalnom servisu računala AI može najviše koristiti u automatskom odgovaranju na uobičajene upite korisnika. Fokus treba biti na uklanjanju zapreka i smetnji koje umanjuju produktivnost zaposlenika, bez zanemarivanja ljudske interakcije i zadovoljstva na poslu.  3. Izbjegavajte nepotrebne poremećaje: Uvodite AI postupno Previše AI alata može uzrokovati zbunjenost i otpor, osobito kod onih izvan IT-a koji ne žele da im se rutine mijenjaju. Većina djelatnika preferira stabilne i provjerene sustave. Uvođenje AI-a korak po korak i rješavanje jednog po jednog izazova omogućuje lakše prihvaćanje i stvarno povećava produktivnost. Loši projekti odvraćaju od idućih inovacija i troše resurse.  Zaključak: Realno uvođenje AI-a daje rezultate Postavljanjem realnih ciljeva i rješavanjem konkretnih izazova, organizacije mogu AI-jem unaprijediti produktivnost. Praktična i jednostavna AI rješenja mogu riješiti svakodnevne frustracije i dopustiti ljudima da se posvete najvažnijem dijelu posla. AI nije magija, ali uz dobru pripremu može ojačati timove i poboljšati radno okruženje.

article_content: Rebecca Kalam, a former firearms officer, was awarded £30,000 after an employment tribunal found she suffered harassment, sex discrimination, and victimisation at West Midlands Police. The tribunal found Ms Kalam was made to strip to her underwear during a training exercise, faced sexist comments, and was not given the same personal protective equipment as male colleagues. She was also chosen as the 'poster girl' for the unit while pregnant and received physical injuries due to unsuitable PPE. These incidents caused significant psychiatric harm, resulting in her being unable to remain in her role. West Midlands Police has admitted its failures and says it is making cultural improvements, but Ms Kalam and her supporters believe more is needed to protect female officers. Her additional claims for lost earnings and pension are yet to be resolved. Ms Kalam encourages others to come forward about discrimination. Deputy Chief Constable Scott Green has apologized for not acting on her concerns sooner and emphasized that new measures, such as tailored uniforms for women, have been introduced. Former superintendent Karen Geddes pointed out that firearms units have been male-dominated and emphasized the need for ongoing cultural change.

Sud je ustanovio da je tijekom treninga morala ostati u donjem rublju, suočila se sa seksističkim komentarima i nije dobila jednaku zaštitnu opremu kao muški kolege. Također je postala 'poster djevojka' jedinice dok je bila trudna, a zbog neodgovarajuće opreme zadobila je i fizičke ozljede. Zbog navedenih događaja zadobila je ozbiljne psihičke posljedice i nije mogla nastaviti karijeru. Policija West Midlands priznala je pogreške i navodi da radi na poboljšanju kulture, ali gđa Kalam i njeni podržavatelji smatraju da je potrebno više napretka za zaštitu žena u policiji. Dodatni zahtjevi za izgubljenu zaradu i mirovinu još su u postupku. Gđa Kalam ohrabruje druge da prijave diskriminaciju. Zamjenik načelnika Scott Green ispričao se zbog kašnjenja u reagiranju i naglasio nove mjere, poput uniformi dizajniranih za žene. Bivša nadzornica Karen Geddes istaknula je da su oružane jedinice većinom muške i pozvala na trajne kulturne promjene.

After introducing its new Chromebook Plus series, Google initially sparked concern among owners of older Chromebooks. Although many of the top Chromebooks met the standards for the Plus branding, they weren’t immediately relabeled. Google soon clarified that most current Chromebooks with Intel or AMD processors released in the last year would also receive all Chromebook Plus features, regardless of the branding.

These features started rolling out on October 17. For those eager to try them sooner, switching to the ChromeOS Beta Channel—highlighted by Chrome Unboxed’s Robby—allows early access to the updates arriving with ChromeOS 118, while most devices are still on ChromeOS 117. Moving to the beta channel is a simple settings change that unlocks the Chromebook Plus boot screen, an upgrade notification, and features such as Magic Eraser in Google Photos, dynamic wallpapers, and upcoming generative AI functionalities.

Importantly, users don’t need new hardware to benefit. The Acer Chromebook Spin 714 is highlighted as a strong, affordable choice that works seamlessly with these new additions.

Google je potom pojasnio da će većina aktualnih Chromebookova s Intel ili AMD procesorima iz posljednje godine također dobiti sve Chromebook Plus značajke, bez obzira na oznaku.

Nove značajke krenule su s uvođenjem 17. listopada. Ako ih želite isprobati prije ostalih, prelaskom na ChromeOS Beta kanal — što je istaknuo Robby s Chrome Unboxed-a — ranije ćete pristupiti nadogradnjama koje donosi ChromeOS 118, dok većina još koristi verziju 117. Prebacivanje na beta kanal jednostavno je u postavkama i omogućuje novi Chromebook Plus početni zaslon, obavijest o nadogradnji te funkcije poput Magic Erasera u Google Photos, dinamičkih pozadina i nadolazećih mogućnosti generativne umjetne inteligencije.

article_content: Comedian Stephen Colbert recently raised eyebrows with Wikipedia after encouraging his audience to make numerous edits to the Wikipedia pages of Mitt Romney’s possible vice presidential choices, hoping to influence public perceptions. In response, Wikipedia took the unusual step of locking most of these candidate pages, restricting editing to experienced contributors. The online commotion followed blogging circles who observed a trend: a spike in Wikipedia edits for potential nominees might predict whom Romney would select. Tech President examined this pattern, which was first noticed in 2008 before the announcements of Sarah Palin and Joe Biden as vice presidential nominees—both saw significant increases in edits to their pages shortly before being named. After these observations, various political blogs speculated about the link between Wikipedia activity and the nominee announcement, an idea that led Colbert to urge his viewers to act. New York Magazine reported that Colbert told his audience to 'make as many edits as possible to your favorite VP contender,' spending part of his show editing Minnesota’s former governor Tim Pawlenty’s page. Soon after, Wikipedia restricted editing for several notable candidates: Tim Pawlenty, Senator Rob Portman, Congressman Paul Ryan, Senator Marco Rubio, Governor Bobby Jindal, Governor Chris Christie, and General David Petraeus, all regarded as top prospects. Though some commentators initially considered Wikipedia edit counts as potential indicators, deeper investigation showed many edits came from the same users and often lacked substantive value. Colbert’s attention further fueled edit activity. To manage the situation, Wikipedia allowed only 'autoconfirmed users'—accounts older than four days with at least ten edits—to update these pages. While this reduces casual editing, many users still have editing access, some possibly with vested interests. Senator Kelly Ayotte’s page had the most edits among VP hopefuls. Notably, in 2008, Sarah Palin’s Wikipedia page had 68 edits the day before her selection, far more than other possibilities at the time, likely because she was relatively unknown outside Alaska and required a more detailed biography. In contrast, candidates like Rubio, Portman, and Ayotte were already under national attention. Despite skepticism about using Wikipedia edit numbers as a predictive tool, the Romney campaign continues to promote its app for news updates. Additional speculation comes from following fundraising efforts and rumors; Politico reported that Portman was expected to raise over $500,000 at Ohio fundraisers, and Republican strategist Ana Navarro tweeted that Romney’s VP announcement might happen in Florida—suggesting Rubio. Speculation is expected to persist until the official announcement, likely after the Olympics for maximum media coverage.

Kao odgovor, Wikipedia je poduzela neuobičajen korak i zaključala većinu tih stranica, dopuštajući izmjene samo iskusnim suradnicima. Ova internetska uzbuna uslijedila je nakon što su blogeri primijetili trend: porast broja izmjena na Wikipedijinim stranicama mogućih kandidata mogao bi sugerirati koga će Romney izabrati. Tech President je analizirao ovaj obrazac, prvi put uočen 2008. prije objave da su Sarah Palin i Joe Biden izabrani za potpredsjedničke kandidate – oboje su tada doživjeli značajan skok u broju izmjena na svojim stranicama. Nakon tih opažanja, razni politički blogovi špekulirali su o povezanosti aktivnosti na Wikipediji i najave kandidata, što je navelo Colberta da potakne gledatelje na akciju. New York Magazine izvijestio je da je Colbert rekao publici da 'naprave što više izmjena na stranici svog omiljenog kandidata', a dio emisije posvetio je uređivanju stranice bivšeg guvernera Minnesote Tima Pawlentyja. Ubrzo nakon toga, Wikipedia je ograničila uređivanje za nekoliko poznatih kandidata: Tim Pawlenty, senator Rob Portman, kongresmen Paul Ryan, senator Marco Rubio, guverner Bobby Jindal, guverner Chris Christie i general David Petraeus, svi percipirani kao ozbiljni kandidati. Iako su neki komentatori u početku smatrali broj izmjena na Wikipediji potencijalnim pokazateljem, dublja analiza pokazala je da su mnoge izmjene dolazile od istih korisnika i često nisu bile značajne. Colbertova pažnja samo je pojačala uređivačku aktivnost. Kako bi situaciju stavili pod kontrolu, Wikipedia je dopustila uređivanje samo 'autopotvrđenim korisnicima' – računima starijim od četiri dana i s barem deset izmjena. Time se smanjuje mogućnost slučajnih izmjena, ali i dalje veliki broj korisnika ima pristup, neki možda s vlastitim interesima. Stranica senatorice Kelly Ayotte imala je najviše izmjena među kandidatima za potpredsjednicu. Zanimljivo, 2008. godine, članak o Sarah Palin na Wikipediji imao je 68 izmjena dan prije njenog odabira, puno više od ostalih, najviše zato što je izvan Aljaske bila gotovo nepoznata te joj je trebala detaljna biografija. Nasuprot tome, kandidati poput Rubia, Portmana i Ayotte već su mjesecima bili pod budnim okom javnosti. Unatoč skepticizmu prema korištenju broja izmjena na Wikipediji kao prediktivnog alata, Romneyjeva kampanja i dalje promovira svoju aplikaciju za vijesti. Dodatne špekulacije proizlaze iz praćenja fundraisinga i glasina; Politico je izvijestio da se od Portmana očekuje da prikupi više od 500.000 dolara na događanjima u Ohiju, dok je republikanska strateginja Ana Navarro tvitala da bi najava mogla biti na Floridi – što bi išlo u prilog Rubiju. Očekuje se da će nagađanja trajati sve do službene objave, koja će vjerojatno uslijediti nakon Olimpijskih igara kako bi se postigla najveća medijska pozornost.

article_content: Nigerian labour unions, including branches of the NLC and TUC in Lagos, commenced an indefinite nationwide strike after their National Executive Council met in Abuja on November 13, 2023. The strike is a reaction to what the unions call government inaction on major worker concerns, like low minimum wages, insecurity, corruption, and lack of effective governance. The dispute intensified after union leaders—including NLC President Joe Ajaero—were allegedly assaulted in Imo State, an incident the unions say remains unaddressed by authorities. Although the federal government, through Attorney-General Lateef Fagbemi, warned against the action and cited a restraining order from the National Industrial Court, workers went forward with the strike. Key sectors have been hit hard, especially the railways. Segun Esan, Secretary General of the Nigeria Union of Railway Workers, reported that all trains stopped running and employees were expected to stay home, leaving stations and offices closed as instructed by union leadership. Meanwhile, the Association of Senior Staff of Banks, Insurance, and Financial Institutions also told its members to participate and cautioned them to safeguard people and property during the industrial action. President Oluwole Olusoji stated the union would keep monitoring the situation amid the ongoing standoff between labour and government.

Štrajk je odgovor na, kako sindikati tvrde, neaktivnost vlade po ključnim pitanjima radnika, poput niskih minimalnih plaća, nesigurnosti, korupcije i neučinkovitog upravljanja. Sukob je eskalirao nakon što su čelnici sindikata, uključujući predsjednika NLC-a Joea Ajaeroa, navodno napadnuti u državi Imo. Sindikati tvrde da vlasti nisu reagirale na taj incident. Unatoč upozorenjima savezne vlade, koju zastupa državni odvjetnik Lateef Fagbemi, i sudskoj zabrani Nacionalnog industrijskog suda, radnici su ipak započeli štrajk. Veliki sektori, posebice željeznica, ozbiljno su pogođeni. Segun Esan, glavni tajnik Sindikata željezničkih radnika Nigerije, potvrdio je da vlakovi ne prometuju, a osoblje je ostalo kod kuće, dok su sve stanice i uredi zatvoreni po nalogu sindikata. Također, Udruga viših djelatnika banaka, osiguranja i financijskih institucija naložila je članovima sudjelovanje i upozorila ih da zaštite ljude i imovinu tijekom štrajka. Predsjednik Oluwole Olusoji rekao je da će sindikat pomno pratiti razvoj događanja u tijeku sukoba s vladom.

article_content: A storm drain in Encanto, San Diego, designed to collect excess rain and groundwater, became an unlikely trap for a one-year-old Siberian husky named Bella on Saturday. The dog was spotted by a passerby, with only her head, ears, and front leg visible above the drain, looking distressed. The exact details of how Bella ended up in the drain—or how long she was stuck—remain unknown. San Diego County Animal Services officers responded quickly after being alerted. When officers approached, Bella retreated further into the pipe. To rescue her, the officers blocked the pipe and guided her toward a nearby grate. With the help of a strong Good Samaritan, the grate was lifted, allowing Bella to be safely pulled out. Bella, who was microchipped, was soon reunited with her owner. The incident took place at the junction of Woodrow Avenue and Viewcrest Drive. Interestingly, this is not the first recent rescue involving an animal named Bella. Just last week, Animal Services responded to a call about a boa constrictor—also named Bella—that emerged from a toilet in a San Diego office building. An employee, Stephanie Lasca, was startled and quickly left the restroom. Animal Services safely captured the snake, though not before it bit one of the handlers.

Prolaznik ju je ugledao, s glavom, ušima i prednjom nogom iznad odvoda, vidno uznemirenu. Točno nije poznato kako je Bella završila u odvodu niti koliko je tamo bila zaglavljena. Službenici Službe za zaštitu životinja okruga San Diego brzo su reagirali nakon dojave. Kada su joj prišli, Bella se povukla dublje u cijev. Kako bi je spasili, službenici su blokirali cijev i usmjerili je prema rešetki. Uz pomoć snažnog prolaznika, rešetka je podignuta i Bella je sigurno izvučena. Bella je bila čipirana i ubrzo je vraćena vlasniku. Incident se dogodio na raskrižju Woodrow Avenue i Viewcrest Drive. Zanimljivo je da ovo nije prva nedavna akcija spašavanja životinje imenom Bella. Prošli tjedan Služba za zaštitu životinja intervenirala je zbog pitona koji se također zove Bella, a pojavio se iz WC školjke u uredu u San Diegu. Zaposlenica Stephanie Lasca ostala je šokirana i brzo napustila toalet. Službenici su uspješno uhvatili zmiju, iako je prije toga ugrizla jednog od njih.

article_content: Canadian authorities are reviewing a video statement from Sikhs for Justice (SFJ), which urges Sikhs to avoid flying with Air India after November 19 over alleged safety threats. SFJ’s legal counsel, Gurpatwant Pannun, is calling for an international boycott of the airline but maintains the message is not meant to incite violence. In the wake of these warnings, Canada has bolstered security for Air India flights, with the RCMP taking the lead in investigating the threat after India raised concerns. India’s High Commissioner in Ottawa, Sanjay Kumar Verma, contends that Pannun’s remarks amount to 'serious criminal intent,' despite Pannun’s insistence of nonviolence. The controversy echoes the tragic 1985 bombing of Air India flight 182, which was carried out by Khalistani extremists and remains the most severe act of terrorism in Canadian history. Each year, Canada marks this event on the National Day of Remembrance for Victims of Terrorism, but challenges persist as some extremist groups continue to honor Talwinder Singh Parmar, identified as the mastermind behind the attack. On the economic front, India’s industrial output rose 5.8% in September, down from 10.3% in August, largely due to statistical effects and production disruptions caused by excessive rainfall. Separately, Ranjan Pai, head of Manipal Education and Medical Group, has invested Rs 1,400 crore in Aakash Institute, a subsidiary of the troubled edtech firm Byju’s. Additionally, manufacturing firms are bringing in more recent graduates to support digital and technological innovations in the industry.

Pravnik SFJ-a, Gurpatwant Pannun, pozvao je na globalni bojkot ove aviokompanije, ali tvrdi da poruka nije nasilna. Ovaj slučaj podsjeća na tragično bombardiranje leta 182 Air India 1985. godine koje su izveli khalistanistički ekstremisti i ostaje najsmrtonosniji teroristički napad u povijesti Kanade. Kanada svake godine obilježava ovu tragediju na Nacionalni dan sjećanja na žrtve terorizma, no izazovi traju jer neke ekstremističke skupine i dalje veličaju Talwindera Singha Parmara, kojeg se smatra glavnim organizatorom napada. Na gospodarskom planu, industrijska proizvodnja u Indiji porasla je za 5,8% u rujnu, što je pad u odnosu na 10,3% u kolovozu, uglavnom zbog statističkih efekata i poremećaja u proizvodnji uzrokovanih obilnim kišama. For a more refined and mature look, Porcelain offers an elegant off-white finish, though it may require more maintenance to keep clean—a protective case can help. Whether you choose Bay, Porcelain, or Obsidian, the Pixel 8 Pro’s variety ensures there’s a style for everyone.
