article_content: Several French high-altitude ski resorts opened ahead of schedule on Saturday, just days after storms swept through the northern Alps and melted early snowfall. Val Thorens and Tignes, both with many runs above 2,000 meters, were the first major downhill ski destinations to welcome visitors. In addition, cross-country trails opened in Bessans on November 4, and Les Saisies followed on Saturday, although only with a short loop using snow stored from last winter. Vincent Lecluyse, who came from the south of France with two friends, enjoyed the early season at Val Thorens, noting that the slopes were less crowded and accommodations were more affordable than during peak times. However, most other resorts remain closed after mild weather and heavy rains washed away much of the snow at lower elevations earlier in the week. Jerome Grellet, director of Val Thorens, said, 'It was important to reassure our clients that we have snow, and that they can come.' According to Gilles Brunot, director of the Chamonix office at Meteo France, there is little to no snow below 1,500–1,700 meters, and significant decline between 1,500 and 2,500 meters following recent storms. 'At 2,500 meters there's still quite a bit of snow,' he said, 'though it's becoming less rare to see rain at that elevation, even in high season.' Most resorts are expected to open in December or for the Christmas holidays, which already appear to be well-booked. The Association of Mayors of Mountain Resorts (ANMSM) reports occupancy at 52% for the start of the season, up from 51% last year. Recent years have seen resorts diversify activities due to warmer winters and a lack of snow, which at times even limits artificial snowmaking. Inflation continues to pose challenges. Vincenzo Coppola, director of the tourism office in Montgenevre, noted that salaries for seasonal workers have been raised in response to rising costs. However, high rents and a shortage of housing remain significant obstacles for workers. Antoine Fatiga, head of the CGT union for ski lift workers, said improvements have been made in wages, but resorts are increasingly bringing in workers from Africa and Asia. According to the price comparison site Ski Express, ski holidays are expected to cost about 9.5% more this year than last, making affordability a concern for visitors as well as workers.
translated_content: Nekoliko francuskih skijališta na velikim visinama otvorilo se prije planiranog rasporeda u subotu, samo nekoliko dana nakon što su oluje pogodile sjeverne Alpe i otopile prvi snijeg. Val Thorens i Tignes, oba s brojnim stazama iznad 2.000 metara, bila su prva velika skijaška odredišta koja su dočekala posjetitelje. Osim toga, staze za skijaško trčanje otvorene su u Bessansu 4. studenog, a Les Saisies su uslijedile u subotu, premda samo s manjom stazom koristeći snijeg pohranjen od prošle zime. Vincent Lecluyse, koji je s dvoje prijatelja došao iz južne Francuske, uživao je u ranoj sezoni u Val Thorensu te primijetio kako su padine manje gužvane, a smještaj jeftiniji nego u vrhuncu sezone. Ipak, većina drugih skijališta i dalje je zatvorena nakon što su blage temperature i jaka kiša odnijele veći dio snijega na nižim nadmorskim visinama ranije ovog tjedna. Jerome Grellet, direktor Val Thorensa, rekao je: 'Bilo je važno uvjeriti naše klijente da imamo snijega i da mogu doći.' Prema Gillesu Brunotu, direktoru ureda Meteo France u Chamonixu, ispod 1.500–1.700 metara gotovo da nema snijega, a značajan je pad i između 1.500 i 2.500 metara nakon posljednjih oluja. 'Na 2.500 metara još uvijek ima dosta snijega,' rekao je, 'iako je sve manje rijetko da na toj visini pada kiša, čak i u visokoj sezoni.' Većina skijališta očekuje otvaranje u prosincu ili za božićne praznike, koji već izgledaju dobro popunjeni. Udruženje načelnika planinskih odmarališta (ANMSM) izvještava o popunjenosti od 52% na početku sezone, što je više od prošlogodišnjih 51%. Posljednjih godina odmarališta su morala ponuditi razne aktivnosti zbog toplijih zima i nedostatka snijega, što ponekad onemogućuje čak i umjetno zasnježivanje. Inflacija i dalje predstavlja izazov. Vincenzo Coppola, direktor ureda za turizam u Montgenevreu, naveo je kako su plaće sezonskih radnika povećane zbog rasta troškova. No, visoke cijene najma i nedostatak smještaja i dalje su velike prepreke za zaposlenike. Antoine Fatiga, voditelj sindikata CGT za radnike na žičarama, rekao je da su plaće poboljšane, ali odmarališta sve češće zapošljavaju radnike iz Afrike i Azije. Prema portalu za usporedbu cijena Ski Express, skijaški odmor ove godine bit će oko 9,5% skuplji nego prošle, što povećava zabrinutost oko pristupačnosti i za posjetitelje i za radnike.

article_content:
Brazilian police detained Fabio Jose Silva Coelho, Google's president in Brazil, for failing to obey a court order to delete YouTube videos that allegedly slandered a politician. The arrest happened in Mato Grosso do Sul, with Coelho charged for not taking down the disputed content tied to a local mayoral race. Authorities deemed the allegation minor, releasing Coelho later that day after he promised to attend court.

Google maintains in legal documents that it should not be liable for content uploaded by users on YouTube and requested the case be dropped. Brazilian law says disobeying a judge’s order could result in up to a year in jail.

Similar situations have occurred before. Earlier in the month, a tech executive in Paraiba faced a comparable order over allegedly defamatory video content. That case was dismissed after Google argued it merely hosts the material. Facebook also dealt with legal demands to remove pages criticizing politicians, even facing threats of a temporary ban, but such decisions were sometimes reversed.
translated_content:
Brazilska policija privela je Fabija Jose Silvu Coelha, predsjednika Googlea u Brazilu, zbog nepoštivanja sudskog naloga za uklanjanje YouTube videa koji navodno ocrnjuju jednog političara. Uhićenje se dogodilo u saveznoj državi Mato Grosso do Sul, a Coelho je optužen jer nije uklonio sporni sadržaj vezan uz lokalne izbore za gradonačelnika. Vlasti su djelo okarakterizirale kao manji prekršaj i pustile Coelha na slobodu istog dana nakon što je obećao da će se pojaviti na sudu.

Google u sudskim dokumentima navodi da ne treba biti odgovoran za sadržaj koji na YouTube postavljaju korisnici te je zatražio odbacivanje slučaja. Prema brazilskom zakonu, nepoštivanje sudskog naloga može rezultirati kaznom zatvora do godinu dana.

Do sličnih situacija dolazilo je i ranije. Početkom mjeseca, jedan je direktor tehnološke tvrtke u Paraibi bio suočen sa sličnim nalogom zbog navodno klevetničkog videa, ali je slučaj odbačen nakon što je Google tvrdio da samo omogućuje platformu za objavu. Facebook je također imao pravne zahtjeve za uklanjanje stranica koje kritiziraju političare, uključujući prijetnje privremenom obustavom rada, no takve su odluke ponekad preinačene.

article_content: Andrew Morrissey and Michael Parke, the executive producers behind the acclaimed BBC prison drama 'Time,' have launched River Pictures—a new scripted production company under BBC Studios. Previously, both played key roles at the BBC’s commercial division, working on both seasons of the BAFTA-winning 'Time,' now starring Bella Ramsey, and all three seasons of RTÉ’s Irish drama 'Smother.' River Pictures is named after the Thames and Mersey rivers and will have offices in both London and Liverpool, aiming to highlight strong regional voices in its productions. The company plans to begin operations before the end of the year. In 2024, Morrissey and Parke will oversee two BBC Studios series: RTÉ’s crime drama 'Blackshore' and BBC Three’s factual drama 'Kidnapped,' which recounts the 2017 abduction of British model Chloe Ayling in Italy, her subsequent public ordeal, and eventual justice. Before joining BBC Studios, Morrissey was Head of Development at Liverpool's LA Productions, working on ‘Moving On’ and the factual drama film 'Reg' for BBC One. Parke served as executive producer at Ecosse Films, handling projects like 'He Kills Coppers' for ITV, five series of 'RAW' for RTÉ, and 'Fleming' for Sky Atlantic, before moving to BBC Scotland in 2016 and then to BBC Studios. Morrissey and Parke will report to Mark Linsey, President of Scripted Productions at BBC Studios. According to the BBC, this move aligns with their strategy to support creative talent and expand their reputation for quality British storytelling. Mark Linsey praised Morrissey and Parke as talented storytellers capable of delivering impactful, thought-provoking dramas, while the duo expressed excitement about creating bold, ambitious drama in a supportive environment and building on creative relationships in both London and the North West. The launch of River Pictures follows recent scripted investments in the UK by BBC Studios, including partnerships with Turbine Studios, Moonage Pictures, ownership of Lookout Point, and development deals with Bonafide Pictures.

Prije toga, obojica su imali ključne uloge u komercijalnom odjelu BBC-ja, radeći na obje sezone BAFTA-om nagrađene serije 'Time', sada s Bellom Ramsey u glavnoj ulozi, te na sva tri nastavka RTÉ-ove irske drame 'Smother.' River Pictures dobila je ime po rijekama Thames i Mersey te će imati urede u Londonu i Liverpoolu, s ciljem isticanja snažnih regionalnih glasova u svojim produkcijama. Tvrtka planira započeti s radom prije kraja godine. U 2024. godini Morrissey i Parke nadgledat će dvije serije iz BBC Studios: krimi dramu 'Blackshore' za RTÉ te dokumentarnu dramu 'Kidnapped' za BBC Three, koja prikazuje otmicu britanskog modela Chloe Ayling u Italiji 2017., njezinu medijsku borbu i na kraju, pravdu. Prije dolaska u BBC Studios, Morrissey je bio voditelj razvoja u LA Productions iz Liverpoola, radeći na seriji ‘Moving On’ i dokumentarcu 'Reg' za BBC One. Parke je bio izvršni producent u Ecosse Filmsu, gdje je nadgledao projekte poput 'He Kills Coppers' za ITV, pet sezona serije 'RAW' za RTÉ, i 'Fleming' za Sky Atlantic, prije prelaska u BBC Scotland 2016. i potom u BBC Studios. Morrissey i Parke odgovarat će Marku Linseyju, predsjedniku odjela za igranu produkciju u BBC Studios. Prema BBC-ju, taj potez dio je strategije podrške kreativnim talentima i jačanja reputacije britanskog pripovijedanja. Mark Linsey pohvalio ih je kao talentirane pripovjedače koji mogu donijeti snažne, poticajne drame, dok su Morrissey i Parke izrazili uzbuđenje zbog stvaranja ambicioznih serija u poticajnom okruženju i gradnje kreativnih odnosa u Londonu i na sjeverozapadu. Pokretanje River Pictures dolazi nakon nedavnih ulaganja BBC Studios-a u produkciju igranih serija u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu, uključujući partnerstva s Turbine Studios, Moonage Pictures, vlasništvo nad Lookout Pointom te razvojne ugovore s Bonafide Pictures.

article_content: Roger Federer has been fined $1,500 for swearing at umpire Jake Garner during his five-set loss to Juan Martin Del Potro in the U.S. Open final. The incident occurred at the end of the second set when Federer argued with Garner, frustrated that Del Potro was taking too long to make challenge decisions. Shortly before the exchange, Del Potro successfully challenged an 'out' call, broke Federer's serve, and claimed the set. Microphones caught Federer telling the umpire, 'Don't tell me when to be quiet, okay? When I want to talk, I'll talk.' Del Potro went on to win his first Grand Slam title, ending Federer's five-year unbeaten run at Flushing Meadows and denying him a 16th Grand Slam title. Federer's fine is minor compared to the $10,000 penalty imposed on Serena Williams after a heated exchange with a line judge during her semifinal loss to Kim Clijsters. Williams reacted angrily to a foot fault call and directed abusive language at the official. The line judge reported the incident to umpire Louise Engzell, resulting in a code violation penalty point that gave Clijsters the match. Williams later apologized for her actions and was also fined $500 for racket abuse in the same match. In total, over $31,000 in fines were given at the final Grand Slam tournament of the season. Canada's Daniel Nestor was fined $5,000 for unsportsmanlike conduct toward a fan. Vera Zvonareva of Russia and Daniel Koellerer of Austria were each fined $1,500 for audible obscenities. Federer will have a chance to move past his U.S. Open disappointment when he represents Switzerland in a World Group Davis Cup playoff against Italy this weekend in Genoa.

article_content: A GoFundMe page supporting Victoria Wilcher, a three-year-old girl with severe facial injuries, was suspended after investigations questioned her family's claims that she was asked to leave a KFC restaurant because of her appearance. The fundraiser had raised over $135,000 before being removed. GoFundMe placed a hold on the funds and is offering refunds to donors. Investigations, including reviews of surveillance video and transaction records from the KFC locations, found no evidence that Victoria or her grandmother, Kelly Mullins, visited the restaurant on the day in question. KFC had initially apologized and pledged $30,000 toward Victoria's medical expenses, and says it will honor this commitment despite the findings. Victoria suffered serious injuries in April when she was attacked by her grandfather’s pit bulls, resulting in loss of her right eye and facial paralysis. Her grandfather was charged with child endangerment and his remaining dogs were seized. The family maintains their account is true and denies any hoax. Both the GoFundMe and Facebook page named 'Victoria’s Victories' have been taken down. KFC and Hannon Food Services, which operates the restaurant, conducted thorough investigations that included reviewing hours of surveillance footage and employee interviews. An independent investigator also participated, with all evidence suggesting the alleged incident did not occur. The family’s attorney, Bill Kellum, expressed gratitude for both KFC’s investigation and the public’s concern, reaffirming the family’s focus on Victoria’s recovery. He emphasized that the family stands by their version of events and denies fabricating the story.

Kampanja je prikupila više od 135.000 dolara prije uklanjanja. GoFundMe je blokirao sredstva i nudi povrat donatorima. Istrage, uključujući pregled snimaka nadzornih kamera i evidencije transakcija iz KFC restorana, nisu pronašle dokaze da su Victoria ili njezina baka, Kelly Mullins, posjetile restoran na navodni dan. KFC je prvo uputio ispriku i obećao donirati 30.000 dolara za Victorijino liječenje, a tvrtka navodi da će to obećanje ispuniti, unatoč rezultatima istrage. Victoria je zadobila teške ozljede u travnju kada su je napali pit bullovi njezinog djeda, zbog čega je izgubila desno oko i ostala s paralizom lica. Djed je optužen za ugrožavanje djeteta, a preostali psi su oduzeti. Obitelj tvrdi da govore istinu i odbacuju optužbe da je riječ o prevari. I GoFundMe stranica i Facebook stranica pod imenom 'Victoria’s Victories' su uklonjene. KFC i Hannon Food Services, koji upravlja restoranom, proveli su temeljite istrage uključujući pregled sati video snimki i razgovore sa zaposlenicima. U istragu je bio uključen i neovisni istražitelj, a svi dokazi upućuju na to da se navodni incident nije dogodio. Obiteljski odvjetnik, Bill Kellum, zahvalio je KFC-u na istrazi i javnosti na brizi, naglašavajući da je fokus obitelji na Victorijinom oporavku. Istaknuo je da obitelj i dalje stoji iza svoje verzije događaja i odbacuje tvrdnje o izmišljanju priče.

article_content: Harry Redknapp made his return to White Hart Lane as manager of QPR for the first time since departing in 2012, but his team suffered a decisive 4-0 defeat against Tottenham Hotspur. Nacer Chadli scored twice, Eric Dier netted his second goal in as many weeks, and Emmanuel Adebayor added a fourth after halftime. Redknapp deployed his team in a 3-5-2 formation, a system he remains committed to despite the heavy loss. QPR’s defensive line of Rio Ferdinand, Steven Caulker, and Richard Dunne struggled to contain Tottenham's attack, leading Redknapp to switch to a back four in the second half. Although QPR slightly improved and conceded only one more goal after the change, Redknapp believes the formation is not the root cause of the defeat. 'I don't know if the system is an issue,' Redknapp said. 'We played well with it last week. It’s about energy—we lacked sharpness and were sluggish in critical areas. The formation allows me to use two strikers, which is important as Loic Remy and Charlie Austin do not perform as well as lone forwards. If you play 4-4-2, you risk being overrun in midfield.' On Tottenham’s side, manager Mauricio Pochettino urged caution despite the win that placed Spurs atop the Barclays Premier League after two matches. 'It means nothing,' he said regarding the table position. 'What matters is developing our style and philosophy; today, we showed our foundation. It’s still the early stage of the season, so we have to stay grounded. If you lose two games, you’re suddenly in a difficult spot.' Pochettino emphasized his goal of establishing a strong playing philosophy for Tottenham, rather than focusing solely on immediate results, and he commended the team's display in their first home game of the season.
translated_content: Harry Redknapp vratio se na White Hart Lane kao trener QPR-a prvi put otkako je otišao 2012., ali njegov tim doživio je težak poraz od 4-0 protiv Tottenham Hotspura. Nacer Chadli postigao je dva pogotka, Eric Dier zabio je svoj drugi gol u isto toliko tjedana, a Emmanuel Adebayor dodao je četvrti nakon poluvremena. Redknapp je postavio svoju momčad u formaciju 3-5-2, sustav kojem ostaje vjeran unatoč teškom porazu. QPR-ova obrambena linija Rio Ferdinand, Steven Caulker i Richard Dunne nije uspjela zaustaviti izuzetno raspoložen napad Tottenhama, što je Redknappa natjeralo da u drugom poluvremenu pređe na četvoricu u obrani. Iako je QPR nakon toga malo popravio igru i primio samo još jedan gol, Redknapp smatra da formacija nije glavni uzrok poraza. "Ne znam je li sustav problem," rekao je Redknapp. "Prošli tjedan smo dobro igrali s njim. Radi se o energiji—nedostajalo nam je oštrine i bili smo tromi u ključnim trenucima. Formacija mi omogućuje da igram s dva napadača, što je važno jer Loic Remy i Charlie Austin ne igraju dobro sami u vrhu napada. Ako igraš 4-4-2, riskiraš da te nadigraju u veznom redu." S druge strane, trener Tottenhama Mauricio Pochettino pozvao je na oprez unatoč pobjedi koja je Spurs dovela na vrh Barclays Premier lige nakon dva kola. "To ništa ne znači," rekao je o trenutnom plasmanu. "Važno je razvijati naš stil i filozofiju igre; danas smo pokazali našu osnovu. Još je početak sezone i moramo ostati prizemljeni. Ako izgubiš dvije utakmice, odmah si u problemima." Pochettino je naglasio da mu je cilj uspostavljanje jasne igračke filozofije u Tottenhamu, više nego brza postizanja rezultata, te pohvalio nastup svoje momčadi u prvoj domaćoj utakmici sezone.

article_content: Ten years since Uber launched in India, hailing an ‘Uber’ has become an everyday phrase. Shantheri Mallaya from ETCIO recently spoke with Manikandan Thangarathnam, Uber India's Senior Director of Engineering, about the company’s rapid growth and future aspirations. Uber’s Hyderabad and Bengaluru tech centers have grown from about 300-350 employees to 1,500 in just three years. But the progress is about more than numbers—these centers now lead projects with worldwide influence. All core taxi-related technology for Uber comes from India. To bridge gaps in cab supply and demand, Uber has partnered with local taxi services, rolling out integrations in 33 countries and many major U.S. cities. The goal is for all taxis globally to join the Uber platform by 2025. Strategies include app integrations and APIs, enabling taxi drivers to accept Uber requests without changing their routines. For sustainability, Uber launched the Sustainovate Startup Challenge, awarding a one crore INR cash prize to mobility startups with innovative, eco-friendly solutions. Uber seeks only to mentor and partner, not to claim intellectual property. Their ambition is that 50% of European Uber rides use sustainable transport by 2025, targeting a worldwide transition by 2040. Uber’s sustainability work goes beyond electric vehicles—it involves algorithms considering factors like battery range when matching trips, ensuring that vehicles are assigned rides they can complete. Such systems are already active in several global cities, including India, supporting the rollout of Uber Green. To reduce emissions, Uber supports Group Rides (shared rides for up to four people), and is piloting Uber Bus with fixed routes and advanced scheduling. Engineering efforts focus on efficient ticketing and helping drivers manage schedules, all to create more reliable, greener mobility. In addition to car rides, Uber now offers auto rickshaw and motorcycle rides, and keeps developing products tailored to Indian needs, focusing on reliability, safety, and affordability. New solutions like Uber Reserve (scheduled rides, especially for airports with flight tracking) and improved Intercity options testify to Uber’s commitment to rider and driver convenience. India is central to Uber’s tech evolution, thanks to a pool of adaptable engineers and a strong educational foundation in cutting-edge fields like AI and data science. This keeps Uber flexible and innovative, helping the company scale both locally and globally.
translated_content: Deset godina nakon što je Uber stigao u Indiju, 'Uber' je postao svakodnevni izraz za naručivanje prijevoza. Shantheri Mallaya iz ETCIO-a razgovarala je s Manikandanom Thangarathnamom, višim direktorom inženjeringa u Uberu Indija, o brzom rastu i budućim planovima kompanije. Uberovi tehnološki centri u Hyderabadu i Bangaloreu narasli su sa 300-350 zaposlenika na 1.500 u samo tri godine, a sada vode globalno važne projekte. Sva glavna tehnologija za taksi usluge Ubera razvija se u Indiji. Kako bi odgovorio na nesklad između potražnje i ponude taksija, Uber je sklopio partnerstva s lokalnim taksi službama u 33 zemlje i brojnim velikim američkim gradovima. Cilj je da do 2025. svi taksiji širom svijeta budu dio Uberove mreže, koristeći aplikacije i API-je kako bi vozači bez promjene načina rada mogli prihvatiti Uber vožnje. Radi održivosti, Uber je pokrenuo Sustainovate Startup Challenge s nagradom od jedne crore INR za startupove koji nude inovativna, ekološka rješenja u mobilnosti. Cilj im nije preuzimanje vlasništva, već mentorstvo i partnerstvo. Do 2025. Uber želi da polovica vožnji u Europi bude održiva, a do 2040. tu tranziciju žele ostvariti globalno. Uberova održiva rješenja nisu samo električna vozila—njihovi algoritmi uzimaju u obzir domet baterije pri dodjeli vožnji, osiguravajući da vozila mogu završiti putovanje. Ti su sustavi već aktivni u brojnim svjetskim gradovima, uključujući Indiju, podržavajući inicijativu Uber Green. Za smanjenje emisija, Uber promiče grupne vožnje (do četiri osobe u jednom autu) i razvija Uber Bus s fiksnim rutama i efikasnim rasporedima. Inženjerski napori usmjereni su na bolji sustav karata i podršku vozačima sa satnicom, što podiže pouzdanost i čini mobilnost zelenijom. Osim automobila, Uber nudi auto-rikše i motocikle te stalno razvija ponudu za indijske korisnike, s naglaskom na sigurnost, pouzdanost i pristupačnost. Novosti poput Uber Reserve (dogovor vožnje unaprijed, posebno za aerodrom uz praćenje leta) i napredne opcije među-gradske vožnje pokazuju Uberovu usmjerenost na praktičnost. Indija je središte Uberovih inovacija zbog tehnički prilagodljivih inženjera i jakih obrazovnih programa u naprednim područjima poput umjetne inteligencije i znanosti o podacima, što Uberu omogućuje globalan rast i napredak.

article_content: After more than four decades, the brother of murder victim Barbara McCulkin has spoken publicly for the first time, sharing that his sister was 'shaking with fear' before her disappearance. Police have now charged two men in connection with the unsolved murder of Mrs McCulkin and her two daughters, Vicki and Leanne, last seen on January 16, 1974. The accused are Vincent O'Dempsey, 76, and Gary Dubois, 67, whose remote property was recently searched by cold case detectives. Graham Ogden, now 77, told the Courier Mail that he hopes to one day find the remains of his family members and provide them with a proper burial. He recalled that, in their last conversation, Barbara seemed afraid about her estranged husband, Billy McCulkin, a debt collector with underworld connections. Police say O'Dempsey and Dubois face charges including three counts of murder and three counts of deprivation of liberty. O'Dempsey was previously charged in 1980, but those charges were dropped due to lack of evidence. Barbara, Vicki, and Leanne McCulkin disappeared from their home in Highgate Hill, Brisbane, after two men were reportedly seen visiting them. Their bodies have never been found. The McCulkin case has haunted Australia for more than 40 years. Police reopened the investigation in January, leading detectives to search a rural property in Warwick allegedly linked to O'Dempsey. During the search, police found barrels containing bags of cannabis, a loaded firearm, and over $570,000 in cash. Thomas 'Teddy' Martin, a separate individual, was charged with drug and weapons offences unrelated to the McCulkin case. Detective Superintendent Steve Holahan commended the investigative team, noting their dedication and the intensive work that led to the arrests. He stated that the renewed investigation and use of coercive powers yielded significant new evidence, crucial for progressing the case. O'Dempsey and Dubois will appear in Brisbane Magistrates Court. While the motive and exact location of the alleged murders remain undisclosed, detectives indicate that they continue to investigate all possible motives and persons of interest. Graham Ogden shared his ongoing distress and the lack of closure faced by the family. He expressed hope that the arrests would finally lead to answers.
translated_content: Nakon više od četiri desetljeća, brat žrtve ubojstva Barbare McCulkin prvi put je javno progovorio, podijelivši da je njegova sestra 'drhtala od straha' prije nestanka. Policija je sada optužila dvojicu muškaraca u vezi s neriješenim ubojstvom gospođe McCulkin i njezine dvije kćeri, Vicki i Leanne, koje su posljednji put viđene 16. siječnja 1974. Optuženi su Vincent O'Dempsey (76) i Gary Dubois (67), čije je udaljeno imanje nedavno pretraživano od strane detektiva specijaliziranih za stare slučajeve. Graham Ogden, danas 77, rekao je za Courier Mail da se nada da će jednom pronaći ostatke članova svoje obitelji i omogućiti im dostojan pokop. Prisjetio se da je u njihovom posljednjem razgovoru Barbara izgledala uplašeno zbog svog otuđenog supruga, Billyja McCulkina, utjerivača dugova s vezama u podzemlju. Policija navodi da se O'Dempseya i Duboisa tereti za tri ubojstva i tri nezakonita lišavanja slobode. O'Dempsey je već bio optužen 1980. godine, ali su optužbe tada odbačene zbog nedostatka dokaza. Barbara, Vicki i Leanne McCulkin nestale su iz svog doma u Highgate Hillu u Brisbaneu nakon što su prema izvješćima dvije osobe viđene u posjeti. Njihova tijela nikad nisu pronađena. Slučaj McCulkin progoni Australiju više od 40 godina. Policija je ponovno pokrenula istragu u siječnju, što je dovelo do pretrage ruralnog imanja u Warwicku, navodno povezanim s O'Dempseyem. Tijekom pretrage, policija je pronašla bačve pune vreća marihuane, napunjeno vatreno oružje i više od 570.000 dolara u gotovini. Thomas 'Teddy' Martin, zasebna osoba, optužen je za kaznena djela iz područja droge i oružja koja nisu povezana sa slučajem McCulkin. Detektiv nadzornik Steve Holahan pohvalio je istražiteljski tim, ističući njihovu predanost i intenzivan rad koji je doveo do uhićenja. Izjavio je da su obnovljena istraga i korištenje posebnih ovlasti donijeli nove dokaze ključne za napredak slučaja. O'Dempsey i Dubois trebali bi se pojaviti pred Magistratskim sudom u Brisbaneu. Iako motiv i točna lokacija navodnih ubojstava ostaju nepoznati, detektivi navode da i dalje istražuju sve moguće motive i osobe od interesa. Graham Ogden podijelio je svoju trajnu tugu i nedostatak zatvaranja koji je obitelj doživjela. Izrazio je nadu da će uhićenja konačno dovesti do odgovora.

Governor Albert Bryan of the U.S. Virgin Islands declared a state of emergency after officials found lead and copper in St. Croix’s tap water. Residents have been told not to drink or cook with the water, though it’s still considered safe for showering and cleaning.

The emergency declaration, signed Monday, enables the territory to quickly mobilize needed resources and request federal assistance. Government officials have also frozen prices for bottled water and other key products as they conduct further testing and monitoring, an investigation that began in late September following complaints of discolored tap water from residents. St. Croix, home to more than 50,600 people, remains the focus of ongoing local and federal efforts.

Guverner Američkih Djevičanskih Otoka, Albert Bryan, proglasio je izvanredno stanje nakon što su službenici otkrili olovo i bakar u vodi iz slavine na otoku St. Croix. Stanovnicima je savjetovano da ne piju niti kuhaju s tom vodom, iako se smatra sigurnom za tuširanje i čišćenje.

Deklaracija o izvanrednom stanju, potpisana u ponedjeljak, omogućuje teritoriju brzo osiguravanje potrebnih resursa i traženje pomoći od saveznih vlasti. Vlada je također zamrznula cijene flaširane vode i drugih bitnih proizvoda dok se nastavljaju daljnja testiranja i praćenja situacije. Istraga je započela krajem rujna nakon što su stanovnici prijavili promjenu boje vode iz slavine. St. Croix, s više od 50.600 stanovnika, ostaje u središtu napora lokalnih i saveznih službi.

article_content: England's official Twitter account has sparked criticism after nominating Ashley Cole for the national team's Player of the Year award. Cole only played a single match for England in 2014—a 1-0 friendly win against Denmark at Wembley—before retiring from international football following his omission from Roy Hodgson's World Cup squad. He ended his England career with a total of 107 caps. Many supporters expressed surprise and disappointment over Cole's nomination, since he had limited participation that year. Social media responses included sarcastic remarks and disbelief, with one user suggesting it was unfair for Cole to win having played only one game. Notable past recipients of the England Player of the Year award include David Beckham (2003), Frank Lampard (2004, 2005), Steven Gerrard (2007, 2012), Wayne Rooney (2008, 2009), Owen Hargreaves (2006), Scott Parker (2011), and Ashley Cole himself (2010). The fan-voted poll has run annually since 2003, except for 2013. Despite securing six consecutive wins to finish 2014, England endured a disappointing year, exiting the World Cup group stage in Brazil without a win. Wayne Rooney and Joe Hart are seen as the main contenders for this year's award. The FA is also holding votes for Under 21 and Women's Player of the Year, with Jack Butland and Steph Houghton among the prominent nominees. More information on how to vote is available online.

Cole je karijeru u reprezentaciji završio sa ukupno 107 nastupa. Mnogi navijači izrazili su iznenađenje i razočaranje Coleovom nominacijom, s obzirom na to da je te godine imao minimalnu ulogu. Reakcije na društvenim mrežama uključivale su sarkastične komentare i nevjericu, a jedan korisnik je izjavio da nije pošteno da Cole dobije nagradu nakon što je odigrao samo jednu utakmicu. Među dosadašnjim dobitnicima engleske nagrade za igrača godine nalaze se David Beckham (2003.), Frank Lampard (2004., 2005.), Steven Gerrard (2007., 2012.), Wayne Rooney (2008., 2009.), Owen Hargreaves (2006.), Scott Parker (2011.) i Ashley Cole (2010.). Glasanje se provodi svake godine od 2003., osim 2013., a nagradu biraju navijači. Unatoč šest vezanih pobjeda na kraju 2014., Engleska je imala razočaravajuću godinu, završivši nastup na Svjetskom prvenstvu u Brazilu bez pobjede i ispadanjem u grupnoj fazi. Wayne Rooney i Joe Hart vodeći su kandidati za ovogodišnju nagradu. Nogometni savez također provodi glasanja za najboljeg igrača do 21 godine i najbolju igračicu, među kojima su istaknuti kandidati Jack Butland i Steph Houghton. article_content: A deadly shooting took place at a Transportation Security Administration (TSA) checkpoint at Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) on Friday, raising concerns about airport security, according to experts and union officials. A gunman opened fire at the checkpoint, killing a TSA officer—the first TSA employee killed in the line of duty, according to J. David Cox Sr., president of the American Federation of Government Employees, the union representing many TSA workers. The suspect was shot and taken into custody by police. Cox noted that TSA officers are not law enforcement officers, are unarmed, and do not have arrest powers. He mentioned that assaults on TSA officers occur daily and suggested that granting them arrest authority would improve security. Currently, TSA officers must call on local law enforcement for assistance during violent incidents. Richard Bloom, director of security studies at Embry-Riddle Aeronautical University, commented that even with highly trained staff, some incidents are unavoidable. He emphasized the importance of better training, increased pay, and recognition for security staff, questioning whether these officers are adequately compensated for their work. Rafi Ron, president of New Age Security Solutions and former head of security at Ben-Gurion Airport in Israel, said that U.S. airports focus mostly on protecting aircraft rather than preventing violence on the ground. He highlighted strict security measures at Ben-Gurion, including vehicle checkpoints and armed security personnel at all terminal entrances, which make it very difficult for an armed person to enter the terminal. On Friday, the shooter approached a checkpoint in Terminal 3 at about 9:20 a.m. and began shooting at a TSA employee, according to a former LAPD officer who witnessed the scene. LAX has experienced violence before: in 2002, an Egyptian national killed two people and wounded four others at the El Al Airlines ticket counter before being fatally shot by security. Despite these incidents, unauthorized firearms are regularly found in carry-on luggage at checkpoints. TSA screens about 1.8 million passengers each day. The number of guns seized at airports nationwide has increased in recent years, from 803 in 2007 to 1,556 in 2012, and 1,343 through September 2013, including 13 confiscated at LAX. According to Airports Council International, LAX was the sixth busiest airport in the world in 2012, with 63.7 million passengers.
translated_content: Smrtonosna pucnjava dogodila se na kontrolnom punktu Uprave za sigurnost prometa (TSA) u Međunarodnoj zračnoj luci Los Angeles (LAX) u petak, što je izazvalo zabrinutost za sigurnost u zračnim lukama prema riječima stručnjaka i sindikalnih predstavnika. Napadač je otvorio vatru na kontrolnoj točki, ubivši službenika TSA-e—prvog zaposlenika TSA-e poginulog na dužnosti, prema J. Davidu Coxu starijem, predsjedniku Američke udruge vladinih zaposlenika, sindikata koji zastupa mnoge TSA radnike. Policija je upucala i privela osumnjičenog. Cox je naglasio da službenici TSA-e nisu policijski službenici, nenaoružani su i nemaju ovlasti za uhićenje. Napomenuo je da se napadi na TSA službenike događaju svakodnevno te sugerirao da bi davanje ovlasti za uhićenje poboljšalo sigurnost. Trenutno moraju zvati mjesnu policiju tijekom nasilnih incidenata. Richard Bloom, ravnatelj studija sigurnosti na Sveučilištu Embry-Riddle, rekao je da se neki incidenti ne mogu izbjeći ni uz visoko obučeno osoblje. Istaknuo je važnost bolje obuke, veće plaće i priznanja za sigurnosno osoblje, upitavši jesu li ti službenici dovoljno nagrađeni za svoj rad. Rafi Ron, predsjednik New Age Security Solutions i bivši šef sigurnosti u zračnoj luci Ben-Gurion u Izraelu, izjavio je da se američke zračne luke ponajviše usredotočuju na zaštitu zrakoplova, a ne na sprječavanje nasilja na tlu. Naveo je stroge sigurnosne mjere u Ben-Gurionu, poput kontrolnih točaka za vozila i naoružanog osoblja na svim ulazima u terminal, što čini ulazak naoružanih osoba vrlo otežanim. Napadač je u petak došao do kontrolnog punkta u Terminalu 3 oko 9:20 sati te otvorio vatru na TSA službenika, prema bivšem pripadniku LAPD-a koji je svjedočio incidentu. Rana nasilna epizoda zabilježena je i 2002. kad je egipatski državljanin ubio dvoje i ranio još četvero ljudi kod šaltera El Al Airlines, prije nego što je bio usmrćen od strane sigurnosnog osoblja. Unatoč tim incidentima, zabranjeno oružje se i dalje redovito otkriva u ručnoj prtljazi na kontrolnim točkama, a TSA dnevno pregleda oko 1,8 milijuna putnika. Broj zaplijenjenog oružja raste zadnjih godina (803 u 2007., 1.556 u 2012., te 1.343 do rujna 2013., uključujući 13 na LAX-u). Prema podacima Airports Council Internationala, LAX je bio šesta najprometnija zračna luka na svijetu u 2012. s 63,7 milijuna putnika.

article_content: The Medical Counselling Committee (MCC) has initiated a special stray vacancy round for NEET PG 2023. This round will fill vacant seats across the 50% All India Quota, as well as all seats in deemed and central universities, AFMS, and PG DNB programs. Eligible candidates may register their choices between November 17 and 25. Results will be announced on November 25, and successful applicants must report to their assigned colleges from November 25 to 30. A separate stray vacancy round for state quotas is scheduled for November 25 to 28, with November 30 as the last date to complete admission procedures. State counseling authorities are to conduct their stray vacancy allotment after MCC’s special round is done. Candidates who already have a seat allotted through earlier AIQ or state rounds (including private and deemed) are not allowed to participate, and there will be no seat upgradation in this round.

article_content: Darren Wilson, the police officer who fatally shot Michael Brown in Ferguson, Missouri, has expressed confidence that a federal investigation will clear him, as did a recent state grand jury. In an interview with ABC News, Wilson insisted he acted according to his training and has never faced complaints of racism during his law enforcement career. Currently, the Justice Department is conducting two separate investigations: one examining whether Wilson violated Brown’s civil rights and another scrutinizing the general practices of the Ferguson Police Department, particularly regarding its interactions with the Black community. Attorney General Eric Holder has stressed that the federal inquiry is ongoing and independent from the recently concluded local grand jury. He affirmed that no judgments will be made until all evidence is thoroughly reviewed. Legal experts note that for federal charges to be brought, prosecutors must prove Wilson intentionally violated Brown’s civil rights—a challenging threshold that exceeds the requirements for criminal convictions at the state level. Now that the state grand jury has opted not to indict Wilson, the Brown family may pursue a civil lawsuit, a strategy seen in other prominent cases where criminal charges were not filed. Prior police shooting incidents, including those involving Sean Bell, Flint Farmer, and Oscar Grant, have resulted in substantial settlements. Unlike criminal trials, civil lawsuits require a lower burden of proof: plaintiffs only need to demonstrate liability by a preponderance of the evidence rather than beyond a reasonable doubt. If the Brown family proceeds, they could sue for wrongful death or the deprivation of civil rights, aiming to recover economic damages, compensation for emotional distress, or punitive damages. Nonetheless, success in such cases can be difficult due to conflicting witness accounts and physical evidence supporting Wilson’s claim of self-defense. In addition to the shooting investigation, the Justice Department is examining Ferguson’s policing practices for patterns of discrimination or bias, which could eventually require the department to implement significant reforms. These types of federal reviews usually take extended periods and depend on data and extensive interviews. After the grand jury declined to charge Wilson, significant protests broke out in Ferguson, resulting in property damage and confrontations with law enforcement. In anticipation, Governor Jay Nixon declared a state of emergency and mobilized the National Guard. On a broader scale, state authorities have established a commission tasked with analyzing the social and economic factors underlying the unrest in Ferguson, with a report and recommendations expected in the future.
translated_content: Darren Wilson, policajac koji je smrtno ranio Michaela Browna u Fergusonu, Missouri, izrazio je uvjerenje da će ga savezna istraga osloboditi krivnje, kao što je to nedavno učinila i porota na državnoj razini. U razgovoru za ABC News, Wilson je naglasio da je postupao prema policijskoj obuci i da nikada nije imao prijava za rasizam tijekom svoje karijere. Trenutačno Ministarstvo pravosuđa provodi dvije odvojene istrage: jednu koja ispituje je li Wilson povrijedio Brownova građanska prava i drugu koja analizira načine rada policije Fergusona, posebno u odnosu na afroameričku zajednicu. Glavni državni odvjetnik Eric Holder istaknuo je da savezna istraga još traje i da je neovisna o nedavno zaključenoj lokalnoj istrazi. Potvrdio je da neće donositi zaključke dok se svi dokazi temeljito ne prouče. Pravni stručnjaci napominju da bi tužitelji za podizanje saveznih optužbi trebali dokazati da je Wilson namjerno povrijedio Brownova građanska prava, što je vrlo visok pravni prag i veći zahtjev nego u državnim kaznenim postupcima. S obzirom na to da porota u državi Missouri nije optužila Wilsona, Brownova obitelj sada bi mogla pokrenuti građansku parnicu, što je čest pristup u drugim poznatim slučajevima kada nije bilo kaznenih prijava. Prijašnji policijski slučajevi s Seanom Bellom, Flintom Farmerom i Oscarom Grantom rezultirali su visokim nagodbama. Za razliku od kaznenih suđenja, u građanskim parnicama teret dokaza je niži – tužitelji trebaju pretežito dokazati odgovornost, a ne 'izvan razumne sumnje'. Ako se Brownova obitelj odluči na tužbu, mogli bi tražiti naknadu štete zbog smrti ili povrede građanskih prava, a tužba bi mogla uključivati odštetu za ekonomsku štetu, emocionalnu bol i kaznenu odštetu. No, uspjeh u ovakvim slučajevima može biti težak zbog proturječnih svjedočenja i dokaza koji podupiru Wilsonovu tvrdnju o samoobrani. Uz istragu o pucnjavi, Ministarstvo pravosuđa također analizira praksu policije Fergusona zbog eventualnih obrazaca diskriminacije ili pristranosti, što bi moglo dovesti do značajnih reformi. Ovakve savezne istrage često traju dugo i uključuju prikupljanje podataka i intervjue u zajednici. Nakon što porota nije podigla optužnicu protiv Wilsona, u Fergusonu su izbili masovni prosvjedi, s materijalnom štetom i sukobima s policijom. Guverner Jay Nixon je, očekujući nerede, proglasio izvanredno stanje i mobilizirao Nacionalnu gardu. article_content: A male baboon was shot dead after escaping its enclosure at Knowsley Safari Park in Merseyside. The incident occurred during a fight with more than 20 other males attempting to abduct his mate. The adult baboon managed to climb over the perimeter fence after being chased out while trying to protect his only female companion. Following a two-hour search around the estate in Prescot, a game keeper fatally shot the animal for safety reasons. The escape took place shortly before the park was set to open to visitors at 10am on Father's Day, when fathers were offered free entry. According to a park spokesperson: 'At 8:20am on Sunday morning, animal emergency procedures were activated after an adult male baboon was chased from the enclosure by other males. The baboon attempted to protect his only female from being taken—something common in baboon society. Finding himself cornered, he attempted to escape by crossing the electric fence.' 'Emergency procedures were immediately put into place, including contacting the police and the estate's game keeper to help retrieve the animal safely. The baboon was found just outside the park's perimeter fence, and for safety reasons, had to be shot. The estate's game keeper took appropriate action. This is a very sad situation, but all teams involved acted swiftly, safely, and humanely to resolve it.'

Odrasli babun uspio je prijeći ogradu perimetra nakon što je bio potjeran, dok je pokušavao zaštititi svoju jedinu ženku. Nakon dvosatne potrage po imanju u Prescotu, čuvar parka je iz sigurnosnih razloga usmrtio životinju. Bijeg se dogodio neposredno prije nego što je park trebao biti otvoren za posjetitelje u 10 sati povodom Dana očeva, kada je očevima bio omogućen besplatan ulaz. Ovo je zaista tužna situacija, ali svi uključeni su brzo, sigurno i humano riješili problem.'

article_content: JetBlue Airways, a leading American low-cost airline, is set to introduce new fees for checked baggage and decrease seat space in an effort to boost profitability. Beginning in early 2015, three ticket categories will be offered, but complimentary checked bags will only be available to passengers in the top two classes. Since 2008, U.S. airlines have been charging for checked bags, initially to offset higher fuel expenses. In the first half of the current year alone, this practice has generated $1.7 billion in revenue across the industry. With JetBlue’s changes, Southwest Airlines becomes the only major U.S. airline still offering free checked bags to all travelers. Many JetBlue customers have expressed dissatisfaction, feeling the airline is moving away from the service standards that set it apart. Longtime customer Maxwell Haddad of New York noted that not charging for checked bags was a sign of JetBlue’s commitment to superior service, making it distinct among airlines. JetBlue has yet to release details on the fee amounts, but the company points out that less than half of their passengers check a bag. The airline also plans to retrofit its Airbus A320 planes, increasing capacity from 150 to 165 seats and reducing average legroom from 34.7 to 33.1 inches. These upgrades will be phased in starting late 2016 and will take approximately two years to complete. Even so, JetBlue claims it will still provide more legroom in its main cabins compared to most larger airlines. The airline forecasts that new ticket tiers and baggage fees will yield more than $200 million in additional annual operating income. Incoming CEO Robin Hayes, formerly of British Airways, has emphasized that features such as complimentary Wi-Fi, snacks, and a policy against overbooking will help maintain customer loyalty despite these adjustments. The announcements came at a New York meeting with investors, who have been urging JetBlue to improve revenue and profit margins.

article_content: Sir John Major has revealed that he was left ‘seething’ after Margaret Thatcher made what he called an ‘over the top’ personal attack on him. The former Prime Minister explained that the atmosphere became tense during a dinner with Conservative MPs, when Thatcher criticized him sharply. Major discusses his difficult relationship with Thatcher in a book by Baroness Gillian Shephard, 'The Real Iron Lady,' with extracts featured in The Mail on Sunday. Major, who became Prime Minister in 1990 with Thatcher’s support, had a series of private disputes with her that he had not previously discussed publicly. In Shephard’s book, Major describes a private dinner at No. 10 Downing Street when he was a Treasury Whip. Asked to present MPs' concerns about policy, Major recalls Thatcher responding coolly, letting her soup go cold as she criticized him harshly. Major felt her reaction was unfair and excessive, and he ignored suggestions to make peace at the end of the evening, still upset by her response. The book also claims Thatcher 'flirted' with political leaders, including French President François Mitterrand and US President Ronald Reagan. According to Shephard, Mitterrand found Thatcher attractive, and there was a noticeable 'spark' between them. Thatcher’s Chief Whip, Lord Jopling, is quoted praising her compassion towards Conservative MPs involved in personal scandals, noting that she invited some who faced difficulties to Christmas lunches at Chequers. Thatcher, who would personally serve tea and coffee during meetings, was sometimes mocked by colleagues for this practice. Former aide Harvey Thomas recalls that Thatcher cried for almost 40 minutes after hearing news of the sinking of the Atlantic Conveyor during the Falklands War, reflecting the heavy emotional responsibility she felt as Prime Minister. 'The Real Iron Lady' by Gillian Shephard will be published by Biteback on March 24.

article_content: The Duchess of Cambridge has been named the UK's number one beauty icon for the third year in a row, following a poll of 2,000 British women conducted by Superdrug. The 32-year-old royal topped the list ahead of TV presenter Holly Willoughby and Strictly Come Dancing winner Abbey Clancy. Completing the top five are singer Beyonce and perennial favorite Cheryl Cole, who remains popular despite her recent tattoo. Hollywood actress and humanitarian Angelina Jolie ranked sixth, with X Factor judge Nicole Scherzinger seventh, and singer Adele moving up from 14th to eighth place. Fashion designer Victoria Beckham took ninth place and model Cara Delevingne rounded out the top ten. Older women were also recognized, with Helen Mirren in 11th place. Dame Judi Dench and Sharon Osbourne appeared in 32nd and 48th place, respectively. Model Amy Willerton made her debut in the top 50 at number 39 after appearing on I'm a Celebrity... Get Me Out of Here! Other notable celebrities in the top 20 include Michelle Keegan, Alexa Chung, Alesha Dixon, Rihanna, Michelle Obama, and Mila Kunis. The study found that nearly half of women surveyed are envious of celebrities' appearance, and one in four look to them for fashion and beauty inspiration. Forty-two percent said seeing celebrities look great motivates them to take better care of their own appearance, while 18 percent compare themselves directly to famous people. Simon Comins from Superdrug commented that Kate Middleton has become a widely admired beauty icon, noting the popularity of brunette hair and natural makeup among their customers. He added that women are inspired by celebrities but tend to use their looks as motivation to try new styles rather than directly copying them. Top 10 Beauty Icons 2013: 1. Kate Middleton, 2. article_content: Michelle Obama encouraged rural Chinese students to pursue their ambitions despite humble beginnings during her visit to a school in southwestern China. Drawing on her own experiences, she explained how growing up in a modest apartment in Chicago did not prevent her from earning a law degree from Harvard. Speaking via webcam to students in remote Chinese communities, Mrs. Obama quoted her mother, Marian Robinson—who accompanied her and her daughters on the trip—saying, "A good education is something that no one can take away from you." During her stop at Chengdu No. 7 High School in Sichuan province, the First Lady practiced tai chi with students, participating even while wearing a dress and kitten heels. Her speech was delivered to 700 students in the school stadium and broadcast to 12,000 rural students using satellite-enabled distance-learning technology. In her 15-minute presentation, Mrs. Obama cited herself, basketball star LeBron James, and Starbucks CEO Howard Schultz as examples of people from modest backgrounds who achieved success. "In America, we believe that no matter where you live or how much money your parents have, or what race, religion, or ethnicity you are, if you work hard and believe in yourself, you should have a chance to succeed," she said. "My mom, dad, brother, and I lived in a tiny apartment in Chicago. My father worked at the local water plant, and we didn't have much, but our home was filled with love." Mrs. Obama described how she persevered by remembering her parents' dedication and her mother's advice about the enduring value of education. Throughout her week-long trip—accompanied by daughters Sasha, 12, and Malia, 15, and her mother—Mrs. Obama focused on education and fostering non-political cultural exchanges between China and the United States. Chinese experts expressed hope that such 'soft issues' could help deepen ties between the two countries. She avoided complex political topics, but in a previous speech at the Stanford Center at Peking University, she highlighted the American values of free expression, freedom of religion, and access to information as 'universal rights.' While her remarks did not specifically mention China, that portion of her speech was omitted from official Chinese media coverage. Access to education remains a major challenge for rural Chinese students, where per-student funding is usually much lower than in urban areas, and fewer students attend top universities. Chengdu No. 7 High School is known for its efforts to use technology to deliver quality education to underserved regions. After her speech, Mrs. Obama held a question-and-answer session with students, observed a tai chi demonstration, and visited an English language class. She also met with Chinese President Xi Jinping and his wife, Peng Liyuan, in what analysts described as 'first lady diplomacy.' During her visit, Mrs. Obama and her family toured cultural sites such as the Imperial Palace, the Great Wall, and the Terra Cotta Museum. Before departing for Washington, she planned to visit a panda research center and dine at a Tibetan restaurant.

Kineski stručnjaci izrazili su nadu da bi ovakve "meke teme" mogle produbiti veze između dviju zemalja. Izbjegavala je kompleksne političke teme, no u prijašnjem govoru na Stanford Centeru Sveučilišta Peking istaknula je američke vrijednosti slobode izražavanja, vjere i pristupa informacijama kao "univerzalna prava". Pristup obrazovanju i dalje je veliki izazov za učenike iz ruralnih područja Kine, gdje je financiranje po učeniku mnogo manje nego u urbanim sredinama, a manji broj ih upisuje prestižna sveučilišta. Srednja škola Chengdu broj 7 poznata je po nastojanjima da tehnologijom omogući kvalitetno obrazovanje manje razvijenim regijama. Nakon govora gospođa Obama sudjelovala je u sesiji pitanja i odgovora s učenicima, gledala demonstraciju tai chia i posjetila sat engleskog jezika. Također se susrela s kineskim predsjednikom Xi Jinpingom i njegovom suprugom Peng Liyuan, što analitičari opisuju kao 'diplomaciju prve dame'. Tijekom posjete, gospođa Obama i njezina obitelj obišle su kulturne znamenitosti poput Carske palače, Kineskog zida i Muzeja terakota ratnika. Prije povratka u Washington, planirala je posjetiti centar za istraživanje pandi i ručati u tibetanskom restoranu.

article_content: Mohammed Ahmed Mohamed, a 27-year-old Somali-born man suspected of Islamist terrorism, is being sought by counter-terrorism officers after eluding police surveillance. Authorities believe Mohamed disguised himself by wearing a burka to evade detection. On Friday, Mohamed attended prayers at the An-Noor Masjid and Community Centre in Acton, West London, and has not been seen since. Mohamed was subject to a Terrorism Prevention and Investigation Measures (TPIM) order, which imposes restrictions on movement and activities for those considered threats to public safety, but stops short of detention. Home Secretary Theresa May faced criticism in the House of Commons, with questions raised about the ability of police and security services to monitor such suspects under current laws. Police released CCTV images showing Mohamed apparently wearing traditional Islamic clothing as he left the mosque. Scotland Yard has not disclosed the specific offences he is suspected of, but indicated that he does not pose a direct threat to the public. Nevertheless, officials are conducting an intensive search and have urged the public to call 999 with any information. This incident marks the second time in a year that a suspect under a TPIM has absconded—the previous case involved Ibrahim Magag, who disappeared last December after removing his electronic tag. TPIMs were introduced in 2011, replacing the Labour government’s previous system of control orders. TPIMs limit suspects' overnight residence, travel, and access to finances, but are less restrictive than control orders, notably lacking the power to relocate suspects and featuring a two-year time limit. As of August 31, nine TPIMs were in force, including eight imposed on British nationals. Critics, including Labour and civil liberties campaigners, have debated whether TPIMs are too lenient or still unduly harsh. Labour MP Yvette Cooper argued that the current system has made it easier for suspects to abscond, while some campaigners believe TPIMs continue to encroach on civil liberties. During a parliamentary session, Theresa May stressed that Mohamed was placed under a TPIM to prevent his travel to support terrorism overseas, and reiterated that authorities do not believe he poses a direct threat to the public. Security Minister James Brokenshire stated that the police are focusing all resources on locating Mohamed, and that maintaining national security remains the government’s highest priority.

Vlasti vjeruju da se Mohamed prerušio u burku kako bi izbjegao prepoznavanje. U petak je Mohamed prisustvovao molitvi u An-Noor džamiji i Zajedničkom centru u Actonu, zapadni London, i od tada mu se gubi svaki trag. Mohamed je bio pod mjerom za sprječavanje i istragu terorizma (TPIM), koja nameće ograničenja kretanja i aktivnosti osobama za koje se smatra da predstavljaju prijetnju javnoj sigurnosti, ali ne uključuje pritvaranje. Ministrica unutarnjih poslova Theresa May suočila se s kritikama u Donjem domu parlamenta, gdje je postavljeno pitanje o sposobnosti policije i sigurnosnih službi za praćenje ovakvih osumnjičenika prema važećim zakonima. Policija je objavila snimke nadzornih kamera na kojima se vidi Mohamed kako navodno nosi tradicionalnu islamsku odjeću prilikom izlaska iz džamije. Scotland Yard nije otkrio za koja se kaznena djela Mohamed sumnjiči, ali je naveo da ne predstavlja izravnu prijetnju javnosti. Unatoč tome, dužnosnici provode intenzivnu potragu i pozivaju građane da nazovu 999 s bilo kakvim informacijama. Ovo je drugi slučaj unutar godinu dana da je osumnjičenik pod TPIM-om pobjegao – prethodni se odnosi na Ibrahima Magaga, koji je nestao prošlog prosinca nakon uklanjanja elektroničke narukvice. TPIM mjere su uvedene 2011. umjesto prijašnjih kontrolnih naloga iz vremena laburističke vlade. TPIM ograničava noćenja, putovanja i financije osumnjičenika, ali je blaži od kontrolnih naloga – osobito jer nema ovlasti za preseljenje osumnjičenika i ima dvogodišnje vremensko ograničenje. Na dan 31. kolovoza bilo je na snazi devet TPIM-ova, uključujući osam protiv britanskih državljana. Kritičari, uključujući laburiste i zagovaratelje građanskih sloboda, raspravljaju jesu li TPIM mjere preblage ili i dalje previše stroge. Laburistička zastupnica Yvette Cooper smatra da takav sustav omogućuje lakše nestanke osumnjičenika, dok neki aktivisti vjeruju da TPIM previše ograničava građanske slobode. Na sjednici parlamenta Theresa May naglasila je da je Mohamed bio pod TPIM-om kako bi mu se spriječilo putovanje u inozemstvo radi potpore terorizmu i ponovila da vlasti ne vjeruju da on predstavlja izravnu prijetnju javnosti. Ministar za sigurnost James Brokenshire izjavio je da policija koristi sve raspoložive resurse u potrazi za Mohamedom i da je očuvanje nacionalne sigurnosti najviši prioritet vlade.

article_content: For the 56th year, World Press Photo has announced the winners of its annual contest. This year, 54 photographers from 32 different countries received awards across nine themed categories. The contest is regarded as one of the most esteemed honors in photojournalism. The 2012 Photo of the Year, taken by Swedish photographer Paul Hansen, is a powerful image showing the bodies of two young children being carried through the streets of Gaza City after an Israeli airstrike on their home. The children are being taken to a mosque for burial, with their father's body on a stretcher behind them; their mother survived and was hospitalized. Jury chair Santiago Lyon, Vice President and Director of Photography at The Associated Press, told CNN there was no internal debate or controversy about the photograph’s selection. The judges reviewed over 103,000 images in the first round, narrowing them down to about 10,000 before deciding the winners through several rounds. Lyon explained that the jury sought images that touched intellect, heart, and stomach, and Hansen’s photo fulfilled all these criteria. Juror Mayu Mohanna from Peru said in a press release that the image’s strength lies in its contrast between the adults’ anguish and the children’s innocence, making it unforgettable. The final debate lasted several hours before an anonymous vote selected Hansen’s image as the Photo of the Year. Hansen described his reaction to the win as one of disbelief, calling the image 'horrible' due to its tragic content. The day before taking the photo, Hansen learned from a Norwegian doctor about the airstrike that killed a family. On November 20, 2012, Hansen and his colleague went to photograph the funeral procession of the children and their father, whose home was destroyed. The series of images was taken for the Swedish newspaper Dagens Nyheter. Hansen stated that the photo presents the truth of the situation with sensitivity, aiming not to turn viewers away but to emphasize emotion. The experience was also moving for Hansen personally; he admitted to crying afterward and reflected on the human aspect of his profession. Santiago Lyon said the judges were struck by the photograph's power, emphasizing that their role was to show reality, no matter how difficult.
translated_content: Svjetska novinska fotografija već 56. godinu objavila je dobitnike svog godišnjeg natječaja. Ove godine nagrađena su 54 fotografa iz 32 različite zemlje u devet tematskih kategorija. Natječaj se smatra jednim od najprestižnijih priznanja u fotonovinarstvu. Fotografija godine za 2012., koju je snimio švedski fotograf Paul Hansen, snažna je slika koja prikazuje tijela dvoje male djece nošene ulicama Gaze nakon izraelskog zračnog napada na njihov dom. Djecu nose u džamiju na pokop, a iza njih na nosilima se nosi tijelo njihovog oca; njihova majka je preživjela i hospitalizirana. Predsjedatelj žirija Santiago Lyon, potpredsjednik i direktor fotografije Associated Pressa, rekao je za CNN da nije bilo unutarnje rasprave ni kontroverze oko izbora ove fotografije. Suci su u prvom krugu pregledali više od 103.000 slika, suzili ih na oko 10.000 te kroz nekoliko krugova odabrali pobjednike. Lyon je objasnio da je žiri tražio fotografije koje diraju intelekt, srce i želudac, a Hansenova ih je fotografija sve ispunila. Članica žirija Mayu Mohanna iz Perua izjavila je u priopćenju da snaga fotografije leži u kontrastu između tuge odraslih i nevinosti djece, čineći je nezaboravnom. Završna rasprava trajala je nekoliko sati prije nego što je anonimnim glasanjem Hansenova slika izabrana za Fotografiju godine. Hansen je svoju reakciju na pobjedu opisao kao nevjericu, a samu fotografiju nazvao je 'užasnom' zbog njezine tragedije. Dan prije snimanja fotografije, Hansen je od norveškog liječnika saznao o zračnom napadu u kojem je poginula obitelj. Dana 20. studenog 2012., Hansen i njegov kolega otišli su fotografirati pogrebnu povorku djece i njihova oca, čiji je dom uništen. Serija fotografija nastala je za švedske novine Dagens Nyheter. Hansen je izjavio da fotografija istinito prikazuje situaciju s dozom osjetljivosti, nastojeći da gledatelji ne okrenu pogled, već da osjete emocije. Taj trenutak jako je utjecao i na njega osobno; priznao je da je kasnije plakao te promišljao o ljudskoj strani svog posla. Santiago Lyon rekao je kako suce najviše impresionira istinitost fotografije i da im je cilj prikazati stvarnost, koliko god bila teška.

article_content: Fifteen farm workers in California were fired after leaving the fields to escape smoke and ash from a large wildfire burning nearby. The workers, who picked strawberries at Crisalida Berry Farms in Oxnard, said the air became unbreathable due to heavy smoke from the Springs Fire. The workers were warned by their foreman that they would lose their jobs if they left early, but they felt their safety was at risk. One worker told NBC4, 'The ashes were falling on top of us. They told us if we leave, there would be no job to return to.' On May 3, the fifteen workers were dismissed. News of the incident reached the United Farm Workers (UFW) union, which intervened to help, even though the workers were not union members. UFW representative Lauro Barrajas cited a union rule prohibiting employers from forcing workers to work under conditions where their life or health is in danger. He successfully persuaded the farm to offer the fired employees their jobs back. However, all but one of the workers had already found work elsewhere and did not return. The farm management later described the firing as a misunderstanding.

Nadziratelj ih je upozorio da će izgubiti posao ako odu ranije, ali radnici su smatrali da je njihova sigurnost ugrožena. Jedan radnik je za NBC4 rekao: 'Pepeo je padao po nama. Rekli su nam da, ako odemo, neće biti posla na koji se možemo vratiti.' Dana 3. svibnja tih petnaest radnika dobilo je otkaz. Vijest o incidentu stigla je do sindikata radnika na farmama (UFW), koji je odlučio pomoći, iako radnici nisu bili članovi sindikata. Uspio je uvjeriti farmu da ponudi otpuštenim radnicima povratak na posao. Međutim, svi osim jednog radnika već su pronašli posao drugdje i nisu se vratili. Uprava farme kasnije je opisala otkaze kao nesporazum.

article_content: Dawn Gilbert, a 54-year-old mother of two from Ilford, Greater London, was shocked to learn that her frequent need to urinate was not due to a weak bladder, but was caused by a large tumour. Initially assuming her symptoms were part of aging, Dawn became concerned when her urge to urinate—sometimes up to ten times daily—began disrupting her life. She sought medical advice before a planned trekking trip and was referred for a scan. The scan revealed a tumour about the size of a rugby ball, pressing on her bladder and affecting her bowel and womb. Doctors estimated that the tumour had been growing for approximately five years. At first, specialists suspected a fibroid, a benign growth, but further tests identified the mass as a leiomyosarcoma, a rare cancerous tumour of smooth muscle tissue. Dawn underwent an eight-hour operation at The Royal Marsden Hospital, which included the removal of affected bowel and bladder tissue as well as a full hysterectomy. Following surgery, she received six weeks of radiotherapy. Dawn is now cancer-free but goes for regular scans to check her health. Passionate about raising awareness, she and her husband David completed a charity trek to Machu Picchu. Dawn is sharing her experience as part of Macmillan Cancer Support’s campaign, urging others to check potential symptoms early and consult a doctor.
translated_content: Dawn Gilbert, 54-godišnja majka dvoje djece iz Ilforda u Velikom Londonu, bila je šokirana kada je saznala da njezina česta potreba za mokrenjem nije bila uzrokovana slabim mjehurom, već velikim tumorom. Isprva je smatrala da su simptomi posljedica starenja, no zabrinula se kad joj je potreba za mokrenjem – i do deset puta dnevno – počela narušavati svakodnevni život. Zatražila je savjet liječnika prije planiranog planinarenja i upućena je na snimanje. Snimka je otkrila tumor veličine ragbi lopte koji je pritiskao njezin mjehur te zahvatio crijeva i maternicu. Liječnici su procijenili da je tumor rastao otprilike pet godina. U početku su stručnjaci posumnjali na miom, benignu izraslinu, ali su daljnje pretrage pokazale da je riječ o leiomiosarkomu, rijetkom malignom tumoru glatkih mišića. Dawn je podvrgnuta osmosatnoj operaciji u bolnici The Royal Marsden tijekom koje su uklonili zahvaćene dijelove crijeva i mjehura te obavili potpunu histerektomiju. Nakon operacije primila je šest tjedana radioterapije. Dawn je sada bez raka, ali i dalje ide na redovite preglede. Kako bi pomogla podići svijest, zajedno sa suprugom Davidom završila je humanitarnu ekspediciju do Machu Picchua. Dawn dijeli svoje iskustvo u sklopu kampanje udruge Macmillan Cancer Support, potičući druge da na vrijeme provjere moguće simptome i posjete liječnika.

article_content:
At 97 years old, Edna Houghton became Britain’s oldest bridesmaid by serving as matron of honour at her daughter’s wedding. Edna proudly joined her daughter, Maureen Grogan, age 69, as she walked down the aisle to marry Duncan McKerracher-Taylor, 86, in a touching ceremony at the Grade II listed Pump Rooms in Tenbury Wells, Worcestershire. The intimate event brought together four generations of the family, with Edna holding a cherished photograph from her own wedding day—May 23, 1942.

Maureen planned her wedding in less than a month to coincide with the date of her parents’ wedding. Although Edna was eager to support her daughter, she chose not to participate in the traditional bouquet toss during the reception at the Peacock Inn in Knighton-On-Teme.

Maureen and Edna share a very close relationship; Maureen described her mother as 'the life and soul of the party' and felt thrilled to have her play such an important role in the ceremony. Maureen and her new husband Duncan met seven years ago through a dating agency. Maureen, a mother of six and carer by profession, divorced her previous husband twelve years earlier.

Edna reminisced about meeting her late husband George in Handsworth, Birmingham, where both worked at an ammunition factory. They married in the spring of 1942 and moved to the village of Wythall, Worcestershire, where Edna worked as a caretaker at the local school and George served as a guns inspector.

Maureen fondly recalled her happy childhood and her parents’ strong bond. The wedding honored George’s memory by including a photograph of him, as he passed away in 1997.

Duncan, a retired pharmacy director at Boots, described the occasion as the happiest day of his life and shared his excitement for their future together. The couple plan to honeymoon in Italy.

Reflecting on the festivities, Edna said she was overjoyed to share in her daughter’s happiness, stating, “I love my daughter very much and I have had the best day ever. Nothing makes me happier than seeing my daughter so happy and in love.”

Sa 97 godina, Edna Houghton postala je najstarija djeveruša u Velikoj Britaniji, preuzevši ulogu počasne kume na vjenčanju svoje kćeri. Intiman događaj okupio je četiri generacije obitelji, a Edna je držala dragocjenu fotografiju sa vlastitog vjenčanja – 23. svibnja 1942.

Maureen je organizirala vjenčanje za manje od mjesec dana, kako bi se poklopilo s godišnjicom braka njezinih roditelja. Iako je Edna s oduševljenjem podržala svoju kćer, odlučila je ne sudjelovati u tradicionalnom bacanju buketa na svadbenom slavlju u gostionici Peacock Inn, Knighton-On-Teme.

Maureen i Edna imaju snažan i blizak odnos; Maureen je opisala majku kao 'dušu zabave' i bila presretna što joj je upravo ona bila od velike važnosti na ceremoniji. Maureen i njezin novi suprug Duncan upoznali su se prije sedam godina preko agencije za upoznavanje. Maureen, majka šestero djece i njegovateljica po profesiji, rastavila se od bivšeg supruga prije dvanaest godina.

Edna se prisjetila kako je upoznala pokojnog supruga Georgea u Handsworthu, Birmingham, gdje su oboje radili u tvornici streljiva. Vjenčali su se u proljeće 1942. i preselili u selo Wythall u Worcestershireu, gdje je Edna radila kao spremačica u lokalnoj školi, a George kao inspektor oružja.

Maureen je s ljubavlju govorila o sretnom djetinjstvu i skladnom braku svojih roditelja. Vjenčanje je odalo počast Georgeu čija je fotografija bila istaknuta jer je preminuo 1997. godine.

Duncan, umirovljeni direktor ljekarne u Boots-u, opisao je dan kao najsretniji u svom životu i izrazio uzbuđenje za njihov zajednički život. Par planira medeni mjesec u Italiji.

article_content: Gable Tostee, 28, appeared at a bail hearing in the Brisbane Supreme Court after being charged with the murder of Warriena Wright, a 26-year-old New Zealand woman who fell from his 14th-floor apartment balcony on the Gold Coast in August. Prosecutors likened confining Wright on the balcony to locking someone in a trunk and causing suffocation. Tostee’s defense team has argued that, if released on bail, he would abstain from alcohol and no longer use the dating app Tinder, through which he met Wright. Justice Debra Mullins adjourned the hearing until Wednesday, noting that the case is not straightforward and that it may not meet the threshold for murder, though a charge of manslaughter could be more likely. Wright met Tostee via Tinder at Cavill Mall in Surfers Paradise before going to his apartment, where she fell to her death at around 2:20 a.m. on August 8. Tostee was arrested a week later and has since been held at Arthur Gorrie Correctional Centre. His lawyers have cited concerns for his safety in custody. Following an earlier adjourned bail hearing, Tostee replaced his original legal team with civil liberties lawyer Terry O'Gorman. Police affidavits referenced a confrontation between Tostee and Wright prior to her fall and allege Tostee showed indifference to her death. They also allege alcohol, specifically a ‘white spirit’ provided by Tostee, was involved. Justice Mullins has mentioned Tostee’s autism and social anxiety as potentially relevant to the proceedings; however, no medical records have yet been submitted as part of his bail application. Crown Prosecutor Sarah Farnden stated it was unlikely Tostee was present on the balcony at the time Wright fell. Mullins described the murder case as 'weak', but noted a manslaughter charge as being 'strong'. Warriena Wright was visiting the Gold Coast from New Zealand after attending a friend's wedding. Family and friends have expressed devastation over her death. The court has not yet reached a decision regarding Tostee’s bail application.
translated_content: Gable Tostee, 28, pojavio se na ročištu za jamčevinu na Vrhovnom sudu u Brisbaneu nakon što je optužen za ubojstvo Warriene Wright, 26-godišnje državljanke Novog Zelanda koja je pala s balkona njegovog stana na 14. katu na Gold Coastu u kolovozu. Tužitelji su usporedili zatvaranje Wright na balkonu sa zaključavanjem nekoga u prtljažnik automobila i izazivanjem gušenja. Tosteejev obrambeni tim tvrdi da bi, ako mu se odobri jamčevina, prestao konzumirati alkohol i koristiti aplikaciju za upoznavanje Tinder, putem koje je upoznao Wright. Sutkinja Debra Mullins odgodila je ročište do srijede, ističući kako slučaj nije jednostavan i možda ne ispunjava uvjete za optužbu za ubojstvo, ali je vjerojatnija optužba za ubojstvo iz nehaja. Wright je upoznala Tosteeja putem Tindera u Cavill Mallu u Surfers Paradiseu prije nego što je otišla u njegov stan, gdje je pala u smrt oko 2:20 ujutro 8. kolovoza. Tostee je uhićen tjedan dana kasnije i od tada je u pritvoru u zatvoru Arthur Gorrie. Njegovi odvjetnici navode zabrinutost za njegovu sigurnost u zatvoru. Nakon prethodnog odgođenog ročišta za jamčevinu, Tostee je zamijenio svoj originalni pravni tim odvjetnikom za građanske slobode Terryjem O'Gormanom. Policijske izjave navode sukob između Tosteeja i Wright prije njezina pada i tvrde da je Tostee bio ravnodušan prema njezinoj smrti. Također navode da je konzumiran alkohol, posebno 'bijeli žestoki alkohol' koji je navodno dao Tostee. Sutkinja Mullins je spomenula Tosteejev navodno dijagnosticiran autizam i socijalnu anksioznost kao potencijalno relevantne za slučaj, ali još nema medicinske dokumentacije uz zahtjev za jamčevinu. Glavna tužiteljica Sarah Farnden izjavila je da je malo vjerojatno da je Tostee bio na balkonu kada je Wright pala. Mullins je slučaj za ubojstvo opisala kao 'slab', ali istaknula da je slučaj za ubojstvo iz nehaja 'jak'. Warriena Wright je posjetila Gold Coast iz Novog Zelanda nakon što je bila na prijateljičinom vjenčanju. Obitelj i prijatelji izjavili su da su shrvani njezinom smrću. Sud još nije donio odluku o Tosteejevoj molbi za jamčevinu.

article_content: James Whitehouse, 30, was sentenced to two years in prison in October after defrauding around £1,800 from women he met online. Using the dating website Plentyoffish.com, Whitehouse posed as an ideal partner and gained the trust of at least four women. He used their personal information to take out payday loans from companies such as Wonga, Payday UK, TXT Loans, and Minicredit. After the women became suspicious, Whitehouse ended the relationships and targeted new victims. One victim, Emma Warren, 34, from Shirley, West Midlands, was left with debts after loans were taken out in her name, and Whitehouse also failed to repay £2,000 he had borrowed from her grandmother. Emma Taylor, 28, from Birmingham, met Whitehouse on the same website and was also affected when he took out loans in her name. The victims continue to face financial consequences as a result of Whitehouse's actions, including efforts to collect repayments for fraudulent loans. The scam persisted even after Whitehouse's initial arrest in October 2012. Whitehouse pleaded guilty to four counts of fraud at Birmingham Crown Court, with the court noting his gambling addiction played a role in his crimes. Judge William Davis QC said Whitehouse 'defrauded vulnerable women one after the other, purely to support [his] gambling habit.' Victims have criticized payday loan company policies and called for stricter regulations to help prevent similar fraud.

Iskoristio je njihove osobne podatke kako bi uzeo brze kredite kod tvrtki poput Wonga, Payday UK, TXT Loans i Minicredit. Nakon što su žene postale sumnjičave, Whitehouse je završio odnose i tražio nove žrtve. Jedna žrtva, Emma Warren, 34, iz Shirleyja u West Midlandsu, ostala je u dugovima jer su na njezino ime uzeti krediti, a Whitehouse također nije vratio 2.000 funti koje je posudio od njezine bake. Žrtve su kritizirale politiku kreditnih tvrtki i pozvale na strožu regulaciju kako bi se spriječile slične prijevare.
