article_content: On Sunday, the European Commission denounced a sharp rise in anti-Semitic incidents across the European Union following renewed conflict in the Middle East. The Commission’s statement expressed concerns that European Jews are currently experiencing fear reminiscent of some of history’s darkest moments. Officials condemned these actions as 'despicable' and incompatible with European values. The Commission cited substantive anti-Semitic events in countries including Austria, France, Germany, and Spain, as well as public demonstrations featuring anti-Jewish slogans. The body also emphasized the necessity of opposing both anti-Semitism and the recent increase in anti-Muslim hatred, affirming such prejudice has no place in Europe. Globally, anti-Semitic incidents have surged during the ongoing war between Israel and Hamas. The conflict started on October 7, when Hamas militants conducted a large-scale assault in Israel, resulting in the deaths of more than 1,400 people—most of them civilians—and the taking of approximately 240 hostages, according to Israeli officials. In retaliation, Israel has launched continuous airstrikes on the Gaza Strip, under Hamas control, leading to over 9,770 reported deaths, mainly women and children, as per the Hamas-run health ministry.

Dužnosnici su takve postupke nazvali 'odvratnima' i nespojivima s europskim vrijednostima. Komisija je navela značajne antisemitske događaje u Austriji, Francuskoj, Njemačkoj i Španjolskoj, kao i javne demonstracije na kojima su se uzvikivali protujudovski slogani. Također je naglašena važnost borbe protiv antisemitizma te sve većeg anti-muslimanskog raspoloženja u posljednjim tjednima, uz poruku da takva mržnja nema mjesta u Europi. Na globalnoj razini, antisemitski incidenti znatno su porasli tijekom tekućeg sukoba između Izraela i Hamasa. Sukob je započeo 7. listopada kad su pripadnici Hamasa pokrenuli veliki napad na Izrael, usmrtivši više od 1.400 osoba—većinom civila—i uzeli oko 240 talaca, prema izraelskim izvorima. Kao odgovor, Izrael je izveo stalne zračne napade na Pojas Gaze pod Hamasovom upravom, što je, prema podacima Ministarstva zdravstva pod Hamasom, rezultiralo s više od 9.770 poginulih, među kojima su uglavnom žene i djeca.

article_content: Nick Clegg, leader of the Liberal Democrats, is facing calls from senior party members to focus on safeguarding the party’s existing seats rather than campaigning across the country. Concerns have been raised that the party may have no women MPs after the next election unless changes are made. Party insiders warned that, with the Liberal Democrats polling in fourth place nationally, they risk losing up to half of their current seats, with women MPs likely to be particularly affected. ‘You can see how 30 colleagues can survive, but the other 27? It’s very difficult,’ one Lib Dem member told the Daily Mail. ‘We need a fortress strategy now. If it comes down to hiring a local campaigner for £20,000 or spending that on focus groups for a national policy, we should do the former.’ There is particular concern over the number of women Liberal Democrat MPs, as most hold slim majorities. 'Everyone knows we’re lacking in women representatives, but the situation could worsen after the next election. If we don’t act now, we could end up with none,' another source said. This warning follows criticism of Mr Clegg’s handling of allegations of sexual misconduct involving former chief executive Lord Rennard and Portsmouth MP Mike Hancock. Activists have encouraged women to leave the party in protest at the leadership’s failure to take stronger action against Lord Rennard, who has denied the allegations and threatened legal action unless his membership is reinstated. Five out of seven Lib Dem women MPs have majorities of around 2,000 votes or less, making them vulnerable to the national swing against the party that has followed its coalition with the Conservatives. Only international development minister Lynne Featherstone, who has a majority of nearly 8,000, holds a relatively safe seat, but she is still expected to face a tough challenge from Labour in her north London constituency. Jo Swinson, the Equalities Minister, holds a majority of just over 2,000 in East Dunbartonshire, Scotland, and is reportedly being encouraged to run in the safer Bath constituency, where Don Foster, the chief whip, is stepping down. Swinson, seen as a rising star, is married to neighbouring MP Duncan Hames. Some colleagues suggest that a move could be presented as a family decision, as the couple have just had a baby. Until recently, the party leadership believed it could retain at least 45 of its 57 seats, expecting recognition for its part in the coalition’s economic recovery policies. However, despite the economic upturn, the Liberal Democrats remain at about 10% in opinion polls. The call for a 'fortress strategy' signals rising concern among senior figures that the party’s influence in any future coalition could be limited. 'The polls show we might hold the balance of power, but with only 25 or 30 MPs, our influence will be much reduced. We won’t be able to demand four Cabinet ministers, that’s for sure,' said one source.
translated_content: Nick Clegg, vođa Liberalnih demokrata, suočava se sa zahtjevima viših članova stranke da se usmjeri na očuvanje postojećih mandata umjesto na kampanju širom zemlje. Izražena je zabrinutost da bi stranka nakon sljedećih izbora mogla ostati bez žena zastupnica ako se ne poduzmu promjene. Insajderi upozoravaju da Liberalni demokrati, koji su trenutno na četvrtom mjestu na nacionalnim anketama, riskiraju gubitak do polovice trenutnih mjesta, a žene zastupnice bi mogle biti posebno pogođene. 'Može se vidjeti kako 30 kolega može preživjeti, ali ostalih 27? To je jako teško', izjavio je jedan član stranke za Daily Mail. 'Sada nam treba strategija utvrde. Ako biramo između zapošljavanja lokalnog aktivista za £20,000 ili trošenja tog novca na fokus grupe za nacionalnu politiku, trebali bismo izabrati ovo prvo.' Posebno zabrinjava što većina žena u parlamentu iz redova Liberalnih demokrata ima male parlamentarne većine. 'Svatko zna da nam nedostaju žene među zastupnicima, ali situacija bi se mogla dodatno pogoršati nakon izbora. Ako sada ne reagiramo, mogli bismo ostati bez ijedne,' rekao je drugi izvor. Ovo upozorenje dolazi nakon kritika na račun Cleggova rukovanja optužbama za seksualno uznemiravanje protiv bivšeg glavnog direktora Lorda Rennarda i zastupnika iz Portsmoutha Mikea Hancocka. Aktivistkinje pozivaju žene da napuste stranku u znak protesta zbog nedovoljno odlučne reakcije vodstva protiv Lorda Rennarda, koji poriče optužbe i prijeti tužbom ako mu se ne vrati članstvo. Pet od sedam žena zastupnica Liberalnih demokrata ima većinu od oko 2.000 glasova ili manje, što ih čini ranjivima na promjene nacionalnog trenda protiv stranke otkako je ušla u koaliciju s Konzervativcima. Samo ministrica za međunarodni razvoj Lynne Featherstone, s većinom od gotovo 8.000 glasova, ima relativno sigurno mjesto, no očekuje se da će se žestoko boriti s Laburistima u svojoj sjevernoj londonskoj izbornoj jedinici. Jo Swinson, ministrica za ravnopravnost, ima nešto više od 2.000 glasova prednosti u East Dunbartonshireu u Škotskoj i navodno se potiče da kandidira u sigurnijoj izbornoj jedinici Bath, gdje se povlači glavni bič Don Foster. Swinson, koju smatraju zvijezdom u usponu, udana je za susjednog zastupnika Duncana Hamesa. Neki kolege predlažu da bi preseljenje mogla objasniti obiteljskim razlozima, budući da su nedavno dobili bebu. Vodstvo stranke još je donedavno vjerovalo da može zadržati barem 45 od svojih 57 mjesta, očekujući priznanje za doprinos ekonomskim politikama koalicije. Međutim, unatoč gospodarskom oporavku, Liberalni demokrati i dalje se drže oko 10% u anketama. Pozivi na 'strategiju utvrde' pokazuju sve veću zabrinutost među višim članovima da bi utjecaj stranke u budućoj koaliciji mogao biti ograničen. 'Ankete pokazuju da bismo možda mogli zadržati ravnotežu moći, ali s 25 ili 30 zastupnika naš utjecaj će biti mnogo manji. Sigurno nećemo moći tražiti četiri ministarska mjesta,' rekao je jedan izvor.

article_content: A recent study reveals that commuting more than ten miles each day increases the risk of developing heart disease, diabetes, and cancer. Led by Christine Hoehner at Washington University in St. Louis, the study discovered that longer commutes are associated with higher body weight, larger waist size, higher blood pressure, and reduced physical activity. The research analyzed health data from 4,300 commuters in the Dallas-Fort Worth and Austin areas, assessing factors such as BMI, waist circumference, cholesterol levels, triglycerides, blood sugar, and exercise habits. The data showed that obesity rates were particularly elevated among those who traveled more than 15 miles to work. Of those surveyed, just over half commuted ten miles or less, while nearly one in five traveled over 20 miles; the average commute was about 12 miles. No significant differences in health risks were found between men and women or among different age groups. Hoehner advises that long-distance commuters should look for ways to include more physical activity in their day, like taking walks during work breaks.

U studiji je analizirano zdravstveno stanje 4.300 putnika u područjima Dallas-Fort Worth i Austin, prateći pokazatelje poput BMI-ja, opsega struka, kolesterola, triglicerida, šećera u krvi i navika vježbanja. Podaci su pokazali da su stope pretilosti posebno visoke među onima koji putuju više od 15 milja do posla. Među ispitanicima, nešto više od polovice putovalo je deset milja ili manje, a gotovo petina više od 20 milja; prosječno putovanje bilo je oko 12 milja. Nisu otkrivene značajne razlike u zdravstvenim rizicima između muškaraca i žena ili među dobnim skupinama. Hoehner preporučuje da putnici na duge relacije svakako pokušaju uključiti više tjelesne aktivnosti u svakodnevicu, primjerice šetnjom tijekom radnih pauza.

article_content: Google has released significant updates to the Google Home app and Nest hubs, aiming to improve management and automation for smart home devices. The app now offers expanded controls, including adjustments for fan rotation and speed on compatible devices. Users can also view more comprehensive data from home sensors. A key enhancement is the introduction of advanced automation tools via a script editor, allowing users to create powerful routines. For example, users can set up actions using camera events, such as package deliveries, to trigger notifications or other automations. These capabilities are currently available through the app’s Public Preview. Google is also integrating generative AI into the script editor with a new 'help me script' feature. This allows users to type natural language prompts—such as 'When it's sunset, turn on my lights and close the blinds'—and have the tool generate custom automation scripts, making it accessible even to those without technical experience. These experimental features are currently being rolled out to the Google Home web app for Public Preview users. Additionally, Household Routines now support more triggers and actions, such as controlling blinds based on humidity or temperature, and enabling routines for specific rooms. The Nest Thermostat has received an update to support the Seasonal Savings program. All Nest thermostats can opt into this program, which analyzes schedules at the start of summer and winter to adjust settings for optimized energy savings. Google is also broadening existing features to more devices. The home panel, previously exclusive to Pixel devices, will soon be available on more Android phones, granting users quick access to controls for lights, cameras, speakers, and more without unlocking their phones. Additionally, the Google TV widget is now accessible on more Android devices, including the Pixel Tablet.

Aplikacija sada nudi proširene kontrole, uključujući podešavanje rotacije i brzine ventilatora na kompatibilnim uređajima. Korisnici također mogu vidjeti detaljnije podatke sa senzora u domu. Ključno poboljšanje je uvođenje naprednih alata za automatizaciju putem uređivača skripti, što omogućuje korisnicima stvaranje snažnih rutina. Primjerice, korisnici mogu postaviti radnje koristeći događaje s kamera, poput dostave paketa, kako bi pokrenuli obavijesti ili druge automatizacije. Ove mogućnosti trenutno su dostupne kroz javnu probnu verziju aplikacije. Google također integrira generativnu umjetnu inteligenciju u uređivač skripti s novom značajkom 'pomozi mi napisati skriptu'. To omogućuje korisnicima da upišu uobičajene upute – poput 'Kad je zalazak sunca, upali svjetla i spusti rolete' – a alat će generirati prilagođene automatizacijske skripte, čineći ih pristupačnim i onima bez tehničkog znanja. Ove eksperimentalne značajke trenutno se uvode u Google Home web aplikaciju za korisnike u javnoj probnoj verziji. Osim toga, Kućne rutine sada podržavaju više pokretača i radnji, poput upravljanja roletama na temelju razine vlažnosti ili temperature te omogućuju pokretanje rutina za određene prostorije. Nest Termostat također je dobio ažuriranje za podršku programu Sezonske uštede. Svi Nest termostati mogu se uključiti u ovaj program, koji analizira rasporede na početku ljeta i zime te prilagođava postavke za optimalnu uštedu energije. Google širi postojeće značajke na više uređaja. Kućna ploča, koja je prije bila dostupna samo za Pixel uređaje, uskoro će biti dostupna i na više Android telefona, što korisnicima omogućuje brz pristup kontrolama rasvjete, kamera, zvučnika i drugih pametnih uređaja bez otključavanja telefona. Također, Google TV widget sada je dostupan na više Android uređaja, uključujući Pixel Tablet.

article_content: Chris Christie, a candidate in the Republican presidential primary, has criticized former President Donald Trump for contributing to a rise in intolerance and anti-Semitism. According to Christie, Trump's behavior encourages his supporters to feel empowered in expressing prejudice. "When you show intolerance towards everyone, which is what he does, you give permission as a leader for others to have their intolerance come out," Christie said. "Intolerance towards anyone encourages intolerance towards everyone, and that's exactly what's going on here." Christie further stated that Trump's approach allows some supporters to feel comfortable displaying prejudice publicly. He also criticized universities, saying they have not done enough to address anti-Semitism on their campuses. "These are folks who are ignorant. When they talk about intifada, my guess is two-thirds of them don't even know what intifada is. If they did, they'd be ashamed of themselves for calling for the elimination of the Jewish people around the world, which is what intifada is," Christie said. "I think that there have been a lot of people who contributed to it," he added, "and I believe Donald Trump's intolerant language and his intolerant conduct gives others permission to act the same."

Prema Christieu, Trumpovo ponašanje ohrabruje njegove pristaše da se osjećaju osnaženo u izražavanju predrasuda. "Kad pokazujete netoleranciju prema svima, što on čini, kao vođa dajete drugima dopuštenje da pokažu vlastitu netoleranciju," rekao je Christie. "Netolerancija prema bilo kome potiče netoleranciju prema svima, i upravo se to sada događa." Christie je također izjavio da Trumpov pristup nekim njegovim pristašama omogućuje da se osjećaju ugodno s javnim iskazivanjem predrasuda. Također je kritizirao sveučilišta, rekavši da nisu učinila dovoljno kako bi se borila protiv antisemitizma na svojim kampusima. "To su ljudi koji su neupućeni. Kada govore o intifadi, pretpostavljam da dvije trećine njih ni ne zna što intifada znači. Da znaju, bilo bi ih sram pozivati na eliminaciju židovskog naroda diljem svijeta, što intifada predstavlja," rekao je Christie. "Mislim da je mnogo ljudi pridonijelo tome," dodao je, "i vjerujem da Trumpov netolerantan jezik i ponašanje daju drugima dopuštenje da se ponašaju na isti način."

article_content:
British International Investment (BII), the development finance institution for the UK, has invested $26.5 million in AFEX to enhance food security in Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda. At a press event in Lagos, BII’s CEO Nick O’Donohoe explained that the funds would be used to construct 20 new warehouses in key locations, upgrade storage technologies, and implement advanced software for post-harvest price tracking. AFEX currently manages over 200 warehouses across these countries, reaching more than 450,000 smallholder farmers.

The planned expansion is set to add 230,000 metric tonnes of storage capacity, which could help up to 200,000 more farmers access affordable storage and boost their incomes—potentially by over 200%. O’Donohoe highlighted the importance of fair pay for farmers, improved crop quality, and greater food availability for local communities.

Agriculture plays a vital role in Nigeria, Kenya, and Uganda, making up roughly a quarter of GDP and employing about 70% of their populations—mostly smallholder farmers. These farmers often contend with unpredictable market conditions, high input prices, and challenging weather patterns.

Part of the investment will also go toward establishing a soybean processing plant in Ibadan, Nigeria, and a drying facility in Uganda, further advancing local agricultural infrastructure.
translated_content:
Britanska međunarodna investicija (BII), razvojna financijska institucija Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva, uložila je 26,5 milijuna dolara u AFEX, s ciljem jačanja sigurnosti hrane u Nigeriji, Keniji i Ugandi. Na konferenciji za novinare u Lagosu, glavni izvršni direktor BII-a, Nick O’Donohoe, istaknuo je da će sredstva biti usmjerena na izgradnju 20 novih skladišta na ključnim lokacijama, modernizaciju tehnologija skladištenja i uvođenje naprednog softvera za praćenje cijena nakon žetve. AFEX trenutno upravlja s više od 200 skladišta u navedenim državama i surađuje s više od 450.000 malih farmera.

Proširenje kapaciteta omogućit će dodatnih 230.000 tona skladišnog prostora, čime će oko 200.000 novih farmera imati pristup povoljnom skladištenju i moći će značajno povećati svoja primanja—čak za više od 200%. O'Donohoe je naglasio važnost poštene zarade za farmere, bolju kvalitetu usjeva i veću dostupnost hrane na lokalnom tržištu.

Poljoprivreda je ključna za gospodarstva Nigerije, Kenije i Ugande; čini otprilike četvrtinu BDP-a i zapošljava oko 70% stanovništva—od kojih su većina mali poljoprivrednici. Ti se farmeri suočavaju s nestabilnim tržištem, visokim troškovima inputa i izazovnim vremenskim uvjetima.

Dio ulaganja namijenjen je i izgradnji tvornice za preradu soje u Ibadanu, Nigerija, te pogona za sušenje usjeva u Ugandi, čime se dodatno jača lokalna poljoprivredna infrastruktura.

article_content: The 'immersive internet' represents the next phase in the evolution of the online world, moving beyond static web pages, images, and videos to deliver more engaging and collaborative experiences. This new era will be shaped by technologies like augmented reality (AR) and virtual reality (VR), aligning with what many refer to as the 'metaverse'—though the author favors the less hyped term 'immersive internet.' The internet has consistently evolved, from static websites to social networking and the mobile web. As this trend continues, immersive experiences enabling richer, more interactive user engagement are becoming central. Key trends for 2024 include:  1. Generative AI: Building immersive experiences will increasingly rely on generative AI to create digital environments, artwork, and lifelike characters. Experts like Mark Zuckerberg highlight AI's potential to speed up 3D world design and make interactive, realistic avatars more common.  2. Multi-Sensory Technology: Headset screens and speakers offer visual and auditory immersion, but haptic gloves, scent devices, and full-body suits are being developed to simulate touch and even smell. This technology will become more sophisticated in 2024, making digital worlds feel even more real.  3. AR and VR Convergence (Mixed Reality): The boundaries between AR and VR are blurring, enabling experiences like hybrid live/virtual concerts where audiences interact across physical and digital spaces. Such mixed-reality environments are set to grow more prevalent.  4. Improved Devices: Devices are becoming more powerful, versatile, and lightweight. With launches like Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro, and Apple’s new VR headset—and the possible debut of Apple AR Glasses—manufacturers are focusing on comfort and ease of use to encourage wider adoption.  5. Immersive Training and Education: Outside entertainment, VR and AR are revolutionizing training. According to a PwC survey, VR trainees learn four times faster than in classrooms and are significantly more confident applying their skills. Enterprises are leading the way, but smaller organizations are set to benefit from new platforms in 2024.  6. Immersive Retail: Brands use AR to let customers virtually try on products or visualize purchases in their own space. In-store experiences are also being enhanced with digital elements, blending online convenience with physical shopping.  7. Collaborative Working: Remote work platforms will become more immersive, leveraging AR and VR for richer team collaboration and communication, helping to bridge the gap left by video calls.  8. Immersive Customer Experiences: Brands will deploy VR and AR throughout the customer journey, from marketing to support, increasing engagement and loyalty by offering interactive virtual environments.  9. Adult Content and Relationships: The immersive internet will also transform adult content and online intimacy, enabling more realistic, interactive experiences and providing new opportunities for those separated by distance or physical limitations.  10. Online Safety: As interactions become more realistic, ensuring user safety and preventing abuse is increasingly important. Teaching safe behaviors and implementing protective measures will be vital as immersive environments expand.  To learn more about the future of technology and business, readers are invited to explore the author's books and follow updates on social media.
translated_content: 'Uronjeni internet' predstavlja sljedeću fazu razvoja online svijeta, prelazeći sa statičnih web stranica, slika i videa na iskustva koja su angažiranija i više potiču suradnju. Ovu novu eru oblikovat će tehnologije poput proširene stvarnosti (AR) i virtualne stvarnosti (VR), što mnogi nazivaju 'metaverzumom' – iako autor preferira manje pretjerani izraz 'uronjeni internet.' Internet se stalno razvijao, od statičnih stranica, preko društvenih mreža do mobilnog weba. Kako se taj trend nastavlja, uronjena iskustva koja omogućuju bogatiju, interaktivniju korisničku angažiranost postaju u središtu pozornosti. Ključni trendovi za 2024. uključuju:  1. Generativna umjetna inteligencija: Kreiranje uronjenih iskustava sve se više oslanja na generativnu umjetnu inteligenciju za stvaranje digitalnih okruženja, umjetničkih djela i realističnih likova. Stručnjaci poput Marka Zuckerberga ističu potencijal umjetne inteligencije za ubrzavanje dizajna 3D svjetova i izradu interaktivnih, realističnih avatara.  2. Multisenzorska tehnologija: Zasloni i zvučnici na slušalicama pružaju vizualnu i auditivnu uronjenost, ali razvijaju se i haptičke rukavice, uređaji za mirise i odijela za cijelo tijelo kako bi se simulirao dodir i miris. Tehnologija će 2024. postati još naprednija, čineći digitalne svjetove još stvarnijima.  3. Konvergencija AR-a i VR-a (mješovita stvarnost): Granice između AR-a i VR-a se brišu, omogućujući iskustva poput kombiniranih koncerata gdje publika surađuje u fizičkom i digitalnom okruženju. Takva mješovita iskustva postat će sve češća.  4. Napredniji uređaji: Uređaji postaju snažniji, svestraniji i lakši. S lansiranjem Meta Quest 3, Meta Quest Pro i Appleovog novog VR uređaja – te mogućim dolaskom Apple AR naočala – proizvođači se fokusiraju na udobnost i lakoću korištenja radi šire prihvaćenosti.  5. Uronjena edukacija i obuka: Osim u zabavi, VR i AR revolucionaliziraju edukaciju i obuku. Prema PwC-ovoj anketi, polaznici VR treninga uče četiri puta brže i znatno su sigurniji u primjeni naučenog. Velike kompanije predvode ovaj trend, ali 2024. nove platforme omogućit će i malima sudjelovanje.  6. Uronjena maloprodaja: Brendovi koriste AR kako bi kupcima omogućili virtualno isprobavanje proizvoda ili vizualizaciju kupovine u vlastitom prostoru. Fizičke trgovine također uvode digitalne elemente, spajajući prednosti online i tradicionalne kupnje.  7. Suradnički rad: Platforme za rad na daljinu postat će uronjenije zahvaljujući AR-u i VR-u, omogućujući bogatiju timsku suradnju i komunikaciju koja nadmašuje ograničenja video poziva.  8. Uronjeno korisničko iskustvo: Brendovi će koristiti VR i AR kroz cijelo korisničko putovanje, od marketinga do podrške, podižući angažman i vjernost kroz interaktivna virtualna okruženja.  9. Odrasli sadržaj i odnosi: Uronjeni internet transformirat će odrasli sadržaj i online intimnost, omogućujući realističnije, interaktivnije doživljaje i nove mogućnosti za one udaljene ili s fizičkim ograničenjima.  10. Online sigurnost: Kako interakcije postaju realističnije, sigurnost korisnika i prevencija zloupotrebe postaju ključni. Poučavanje sigurnih navika i uvođenje zaštitnih mjera bit će presudni s razvojem uronjenih okruženja.  Za više informacija o budućnosti tehnologije i poslovanja, čitatelji su pozvani istražiti autorove knjige i pratiti novosti na društvenim mrežama.

article_content: An Illinois man's homemade backyard ice rink is delighting families and children in his Lakewood community. Tom Fox, who built the rink for his daughter Sydney, said, 'She's learning how to skate, and I played hockey growing up. I always wanted an ice rink at home, so I figured, why not?' Fox's rink measures 20 by 40 feet and is popular among local children. He explained that the structure uses 2x10s and 2x8s for framing, covered with a large tarp, which is then filled with water and left to freeze. The rink is equipped with foam padding around the walls, rubber mats for safe entry and exit, and overhead lights for nighttime skating. 'We have lights up in the trees and one over the swing set,' Fox told WGN. 'The kids come out after school to skate as much as they want.' Fox also described his homemade 'Zamboni,' a DIY ice resurfacer made from a garbage can, PVC pipes, and warm water. He drags it around the rink to smooth the ice. 'Having the Zamboni is a nice feature,' he remarked. There was an early setback when a hole in the liner caused the rink to drain before it could freeze, but Fox managed to fix it promptly. Laughing, he said, 'I haven't seen the water bill—don't want to see the water bill.' Six-year-old Sydney shared that her favorite part is 'playing hockey with my dad.' Fox plans to build an even larger rink in the future.

Klizalište ima zaštitnu pjenu oko rubova, gumene prostirke za sigurniji ulazak i izlazak te reflektore za klizanje po noći. 'Imamo lampice u drveću i jednu iznad ljuljačke,' rekao je Fox za WGN. Fox planira izgraditi još veće klizalište u budućnosti.

article_content: In Nanjiawan village, located in southwest China's Sichuan province, methane gas has begun leaking from the ground, causing the air to occasionally erupt in sudden bursts of fire. This unusual and hazardous phenomenon has become so frequent that the village has earned the nickname 'Invisible Fire Village.' When the problem first appeared less than a year ago, residents, unsettled by the danger, initially attributed the fires to supernatural causes and sought help from local priests. However, these efforts did not resolve the issue. The source of the gas was first reported by Su Geng, an 83-year-old local resident, who noticed a strange smell coming from her cellar. Authorities later confirmed it was methane seeping up from below, igniting easily in the air. Given the risk of accidental ignition, even simple activities such as lighting a cigarette or starting electrical equipment can have disastrous consequences. Villagers have been advised to exercise extreme caution, especially when using metal farming tools, as a single spark can set the air ablaze. Despite initial fears, some resourceful residents have begun harnessing the methane by digging tunnels to create rudimentary underfloor heating systems in their homes. While methane seeping from the earth is not unique to this village—similar events have been documented, such as the eternal flames along Turkey's Mediterranean coast—the villagers remain anxious that the 'Invisible Fire' could someday spiral out of control, leading to serious harm. Authorities explain that the phenomenon is due to the proximity of a natural gas mine. Methane leaking from the mine likely travels underground to the village, where it escapes to the surface and ignites. Officials stress that this is a natural scientific occurrence, not a result of witchcraft or supernatural forces.

Ova neuobičajena i opasna pojava postala je toliko česta da je selo dobilo nadimak 'Selo nevidljive vatre'. Kada se problem pojavio prije manje od godinu dana, stanovnici su, uznemireni opasnošću, u početku pripisivali uzrok požara nadnaravnim silama te su potražili pomoć lokalnih svećenika. Međutim, ti pokušaji nisu riješili problem. Izvor plina prvi je prijavila Su Geng, 83-godišnja mještanka, koja je primijetila neobičan miris iz svoje podrumske prostorije. Vlasti su kasnije potvrdile da se radi o metanu koji izlazi iz tla i lako se zapali na zraku. Zbog rizika od slučajnog paljenja, čak i jednostavne aktivnosti poput paljenja cigarete ili uključivanja električne opreme mogu imati kobne posljedice. Mještanima je preporučeno iznimno oprezno ponašanje, osobito pri radu metalnim alatima na poljima, jer iskrica može zapaliti zrak. Unatoč početnim strahovima, neki snalažljivi stanovnici počeli su koristiti metan kopajući tunele kako bi stvorili jednostavne podne sustave grijanja u svojim kućama. Iako istjecanje metana iz zemlje nije rijetkost samo u ovom selu—slične pojave zabilježene su, primjerice, uz obalu Sredozemlja u Turskoj—mještani su i dalje zabrinuti da bi 'Nevidljiva vatra' jednog dana mogla izmaknuti kontroli i prouzročiti ozbiljnu štetu. Vlasti objašnjavaju kako je ovaj fenomen uzrokovan blizinom rudnika prirodnog plina. Metan koji curi iz rudnika vjerojatno putuje pod zemljom do sela, gdje izlazi na površinu i zapali se. Dužnosnici ističu da je riječ o prirodnom znanstvenom fenomenu, a ne o vještičarstvu ili natprirodnim silama.

article_content:
Scientists in the United States have reported that a massive piece of ice, measuring 260 square kilometers—about four times larger than Manhattan—has broken away from Greenland’s Petermann Glacier. According to University of Delaware researcher Andreas Muenchow, this is the most significant ice loss from the Arctic since 1962, accounting for a quarter of the glacier's floating ice shelf.

The ice island’s freshwater content would be enough to feed rivers like the Delaware or Hudson for over two years or supply U.S. public tap water for 120 days, Muenchow explained.

The separation happened early Thursday, detected by NASA’s MODIS-Aqua satellite and quickly confirmed by Trudy Wohlleben from the Canadian Ice Service.

Researchers are tracking the ice island as it moves through the Nares Strait, about 1,000 kilometers south of the North Pole, situated between Greenland and Canada. As it drifts, it could block the channel, break into smaller fragments, or be carried by currents toward the Atlantic, possibly traveling along Baffin Island and Labrador over the next two years.

Environmentalists attribute increasing Arctic ice loss to global warming, noting that the 1990s saw the warmest Arctic temperatures in more than 2,000 years. Scientists predict that if current melting rates continue, the Arctic Ocean may be ice-free in summers within decades.

Znanstvenici iz Sjedinjenih Država izvijestili su o velikom komadu leda površine 260 četvornih kilometara—čak četiri puta većem od Manhattana—koji se odlomio od grenlandskog ledenjaka Petermann. Prema istraživaču sa Sveučilišta Delaware, Andreasu Muenchowu, ovo je najveći gubitak leda u Arktiku od 1962. godine, čime je izgubljena četvrtina plutajuće ledene police ovog ledenjaka.

Muenchow navodi kako količina slatke vode u ovom ledenom otoku može opskrbljivati rijeke poput Delawarea ili Hudsona preko dvije godine, odnosno osigurati svu javnu vodu u SAD-u tijekom 120 dana.

Odlomljavanje se dogodilo rano u četvrtak, a detektirao ga je NASA-in MODIS-Aqua satelit. Potvrdu događaja dala je i Trudy Wohlleben iz Kanadske službe za led.

Znanstvenici prate kretanje ledenog otoka kroz Naresov tjesnac, oko 1.000 kilometara južno od Sjevernog pola, između Grenlanda i Kanade. U kretanju može blokirati tjesnac, raspasti se na manje dijelove ili ga morske struje odnijeti prema Atlantiku, mogućim putem uz obale Baffinovog otoka i Labradora u naredne dvije godine.

Ekolozi ovakav gubitak arktičkog leda pripisuju globalnom zatopljenju. Istraživanja pokazuju da su 1990-e bile najtoplije desetljeće u zadnjih 2.000 godina. Znanstvenici upozoravaju da bi se, ako se topljenje nastavi ovim tempom, Arktički ocean mogao ljeti potpuno osloboditi leda u idućim desetljećima.

article_content: The first of six Patriot missile batteries intended to protect Turkey from potential Syrian attacks is now operational along the two countries' shared border, NATO announced Saturday. The remaining five batteries, which NATO emphasizes are for defensive purposes only, are expected to be operational in the coming days. NATO foreign ministers agreed in December to deploy the batteries after Syria launched Scud missiles near the Turkish border. Earlier, in October, stray Syrian artillery shells struck the Turkish border town of Akcakale. The currently operational missile battery is located in the city of Adana. Additional Patriot systems will be stationed to help protect the Turkish cities of Kahramanmaras and Gaziantep, according to NATO. Turkish Foreign Minister Ahmet Davutoglu has stated that the missile batteries will remain only as long as there is a threat. The arrival of the batteries comes amid ongoing violence in Syria, where the United Nations recently estimated that more than 60,000 people have been killed since the conflict began nearly two years ago. At least 129 people were killed across Syria on Saturday, according to the Local Coordination Committees of Syria, an opposition activist network. Of these, 44 deaths were reported in Aleppo province, 40 in Damascus and its suburbs, and 18 in Homs province. The group also reported intense shelling by government forces in the Damascus suburbs. Injuries were reported after Syrian aircraft dropped cluster bombs near Aleppo, according to the group. Another opposition source, the Syrian Observatory for Human Rights, reported airstrikes by Syrian warplanes in several cities and villages. Some of the most severe air raids occurred in Manjab, a suburb of Aleppo, where the Observatory reported that eight children and two women were among sixteen killed. The Observatory also said that 13 unidentified civilians were killed by government gunfire around Daraya, a suburb of Damascus where opposition groups claimed 245 people had been found dead over a weekend in August. CNN is unable to independently verify many claims within Syria, as the government severely restricts access for international journalists. Despite international condemnation, Syrian President Bashar al-Assad continues to retain support. On Saturday, a senior Iranian official warned that any attack on Syria would be considered a strike against Iran and its allies, according to Iran's semi-official Mehr News Agency. Ali Akbar Velayati, a senior advisor to Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, Iran's supreme leader, also commended Syria's logistical support for the Lebanese Shiite group Hezbollah, which is designated a terrorist organization by the United States. Jordan's king has stated that he does not expect al-Assad to fall soon.
translated_content: Prva od šest baterija Patriot projektila namijenjenih zaštiti Turske od potencijalnih sirijskih napada sada je operativna na zajedničkoj granici dviju zemalja, objavio je NATO u subotu. Preostalih pet baterija, za koje NATO naglašava da su isključivo obrambenog karaktera, očekuje se da će biti operativne u narednim danima. Ministri vanjskih poslova NATO-a dogovorili su u prosincu raspoređivanje baterija nakon što je Sirija ispalila rakete Scud blizu turske granice. Ranije, u listopadu, zalutali sirijski artiljerijski projektili pogodili su turski pogranični grad Akcakale. Trenutno operativna baterija projektila nalazi se u gradu Adana. Dodatni Patriot sustavi bit će raspoređeni kako bi zaštitili turske gradove Kahramanmaras i Gaziantep, prema informacijama NATO-a. Turski ministar vanjskih poslova Ahmet Davutoglu izjavio je da će baterije ostati samo dok postoji prijetnja. Dolazak baterija događa se usred stalnog nasilja u Siriji, gdje su Ujedinjeni narodi nedavno procijenili da je tijekom gotovo dvije godine sukoba poginulo više od 60.000 ljudi. Prema Lokalnim koordinacijskim odborima Sirije, mreži oporbenih aktivista, u subotu je diljem Sirije ubijeno najmanje 129 osoba. Od toga, 44 smrti zabilježene su u provinciji Aleppo, 40 u Damasku i njegovim predgrađima, te 18 u provinciji Homs. Grupa je također izvijestila o intenzivnom granatiranju od strane vladinih snaga u predgrađima Damaska. Prema istoj grupi, prijavljene su ozljede nakon što su sirijski zrakoplovi bacili kasetne bombe u blizini Aleppa. Drugi izvor oporbe, Sirijski opservatorij za ljudska prava, izvijestio je o zračnim napadima sirijskih ratnih aviona na nekoliko gradova i sela. Najjači zračni napadi dogodili su se u Manjabu, predgrađu Aleppa, gdje je Opservatorij naveo da je među šesnaest poginulih bilo osmero djece i dvije žene. Opservatorij je također naveo da je trinaest neidentificiranih civila ubijeno pucnjavom vladinih snaga oko Daraye, predgrađa Damaska gdje su opozicijske skupine tvrdile da je u kolovozu tijekom jednog vikenda pronađeno 245 mrtvih. CNN ne može neovisno potvrditi mnoge tvrdnje iz Sirije, jer vlada ozbiljno ograničava pristup međunarodnim novinarima. Unatoč međunarodnoj osudi, sirijski predsjednik Bashar al-Assad i dalje zadržava podršku. U subotu je visoki iranski dužnosnik upozorio da bi svaki napad na Siriju bio smatran napadom na Iran i njegove saveznike, izvijestila je poluslužbena iranska novinska agencija Mehr. Ali Akbar Velayati, viši savjetnik vrhovnog vođe Irana ajatolaha Alija Khameneija, također je pohvalio logističku podršku Sirije libanonskoj šiitskoj skupini Hezbollah, koju Sjedinjene Države vode kao terorističku organizaciju. article_content: A US Airways flight bound for Charlotte, North Carolina, was diverted to Bangor, Maine, on Tuesday after a passenger claimed she had a surgically implanted device, according to federal officials. Onboard doctors examined the woman and found no signs of recent surgical scars, as confirmed by Representative Peter King's office. A federal law enforcement source told CNN that the woman was expected to undergo a psychological evaluation and did not pose a genuine threat. Despite this, the Paris-to-Charlotte flight made an unscheduled stop in Bangor as a precaution, said the Transportation Security Administration (TSA). U.S. fighter jets escorted the plane to the airport, and passengers reported the woman was taken off in handcuffs upon landing. The Boeing 767 carried 179 passengers and nine crew members, US Airways spokeswoman Liz Landau said. Passenger Andrew Kobayashi described the woman as nervous and sweaty, noting unusual behavior toward the back of the plane. Authorities confirmed no bomb was involved; the passenger had handed a note to the crew, stating she had a device implanted but did not suggest it was an explosive or issue a threat. During the flight, crew members initially told passengers the diversion was needed due to strong headwinds and extra fuel requirements. After landing, one of the pilots apologized for the misleading information, explaining that the TSA and customs officials had instructed him to withhold details. Another passenger, William Milam, said he helped the woman with her carry-on luggage. She boarded late and was moved to the front of the plane before takeoff, later being assisted to the back by a doctor and flight attendants. She stayed there for hours without further incident. According to King's office, the woman is a Cameroon-born French citizen visiting the U.S. for ten days. She was traveling alone, had no checked baggage, and was not on any government watch list. No threat was ultimately identified. Reporters Dana Ford, Lizzie O'Leary, Terry Frieden, Deirdre Walsh, Deborah Feyerick, Chuck Johnston, Bill Mears, and Aaron Cooper contributed to this article.

Liječnici na letu pregledali su ženu i nisu pronašli znakove nedavnih kirurških ožiljaka, potvrdio je ured zastupnika Petera Kinga. Unatoč tome, let iz Pariza za Charlotte napravio je neplanirano slijetanje u Bangor iz mjera predostrožnosti, priopćila je Uprava za sigurnost prometa (TSA). Američki borbeni avioni pratili su zrakoplov do zračne luke, a putnici su javili da je po slijetanju žena izvedena s lisicama. A growing number of women in business are using Twitter to connect, get advice, and network in real time. Twitter chats—scheduled discussions using hashtags—bring together everyone from entrepreneurs and executives to working moms, letting them share ideas and support remotely.

So, what’s a Twitter chat? It’s basically a regular online conversation on Twitter, run with a specific hashtag so anyone can follow and participate. Topics are as varied as the communities that host them, ranging from tech to customer service to business startups. While these chats attract many women, anyone can join.

Organizers tweet the date, time, and topic ahead of time, and use tools like Tweetdeck or Hootsuite to keep things running smoothly by scheduling questions and guiding the chat. Tinu Abayomi-Paul, who runs the #WgBiz chat, says that successful chats have an enthusiastic community, strong promotion, timely scheduling, and relevant topics.

Why are people joining Twitter chats? Abayomi-Paul points out they give instant access to expert and peer advice, much more dynamically than webinars, and let people stay connected without needing to share personal info. Because everything is in real time, it solves some of the problems of traditional virtual or in-person events.

Jennifer Donogh, who organizes the Young Female Entrepreneur chat, emphasizes that chats are flexible—people can join from anywhere, which is ideal for women with busy lives. Some chats also feature prominent guest speakers, providing unique opportunities to learn from industry experts. Regular participant Ify Ofulue values the chance to exchange ideas with these experts, and now joins chats monthly.

Viveka von Rosen from Linked Into Business notes that Twitter chats have opened up new networking possibilities, letting people connect with influential guests in ways not possible before.

Not everything is perfect, though. Von Rosen thinks Twitter could make it easier to find chats, while marketing expert Shannon Renee warns that some participants try to spam events with their own promotions, which undermines the group.

If you’re interested in joining, start by looking for relevant hashtags through your favorite blogs and websites, or ask around for recommendations. Using dashboard tools like Tweetdeck can help organize the fast-moving conversation. It’s okay to observe at first, and when you’re ready, just introduce yourself in the chat!

article_content: Heavy rainfall in Vilamoura forced the Portugal Masters to be reduced to 54 holes after severe weather delays on Friday, leaving only six players—including the leader Alexander Levy—able to finish their second rounds. Many competitors were still completing their first rounds after Thursday’s rain stopped play early, with further delays pushing back Friday's start. When play finally resumed, Alexander Levy of France immediately stood out, shooting six under par over his first ten holes and moving ahead of Nicolas Colsaerts by one stroke before another rain interruption. Levy appeared unfazed by the delays, continuing his strong form after the break with four more birdies for a final round of 61. This score put him three shots ahead of Colsaerts, who still had two holes to finish the next morning. Players and spectators endured tough conditions, frequently waiting in rain gear as play was suspended multiple times. As it became clear that nearly half the field would not start their second rounds before nightfall, organizers decided to shorten the event to 54 holes. Levy, who started on the back nine, opened with a birdie and then had three consecutive birdies from holes 13 to 15, his shot on 13 landing within a foot of the pin. He added another birdie at 17 before chipping in at the first. Colsaerts, who led overnight, stayed close with birdies at 12 and 15 prior to play being halted. When competition resumed, Levy increased his lead by birdying the second hole, while Colsaerts dropped a shot on the first. Levy then collected further birdies at holes five, six, and nine. Despite needing to finish later, Colsaerts kept up with birdies at four, five, and seven. With the competition now shortened, Levy isn’t scheduled to play again until Sunday. The 24-year-old welcomed the downtime, saying, 'I’ll go to the gym, do some work, and rest tomorrow.' Levy expressed, 'Today was very long—I started at 6:30 in the morning and finished in the dark. We went from the players’ lounge to the practice range three times. But I played really well and am pleased with my game. I’ve been working on my iron shots a lot with my coach lately, and hitting it long is a big advantage here.' Trailing Levy are England’s Richard Bland and Michael Hoey from Northern Ireland, both at ten under par, with Bland having completed 15 holes and Hoey 12. Another group including Rafa Cabrera-Bello and Thomas Aiken finished their rounds and are one shot behind the pair. Denmark’s Morten Orum Madsen and France’s Gregory Bourdy were also in action, with Bourdy celebrating a putt during a rare spell of sunshine.

Mnogi natjecatelji su još dovršavali prva kola jer je kiša u četvrtak prekinula igru, a nova odgoda dodatno je pomaknula početak u petak. Levyja prate Englez Richard Bland i Michael Hoey iz Sjeverne Irske, obojica na deset ispod par rezultata, pri čemu je Bland završio 15 rupa, a Hoey 12. article_content: House Republicans are presenting competing—and sometimes conflicting—visions as they set their conditions for the next Speaker, who will attempt to unite the party after Kevin McCarthy's historic removal. Republicans have set a deadline for next Wednesday to elect a new Speaker of the House, but it remains uncertain whether the GOP will be able to meet this ambitious goal. Meanwhile, the federal government is scheduled to run out of funding just before Thanksgiving, potentially putting McCarthy's successor in the same challenging position that led to his downfall. McCarthy’s actions in order to secure the speakership now serve as a cautionary tale. His decision to concede to Rep. Matt Gaetz of Florida and other conservatives’ demand to let any one member initiate a move to remove him ultimately became the tool used to oust him. It is unclear if McCarthy could have won the speakership without crossing his own red line. The leading candidates to replace McCarthy—House Majority Leader Steve Scalise and House Judiciary Committee Chairman Jim Jordan—each face their own hurdles as they campaign for the role. No Speaker had been removed by a 'motion to vacate' until this week. McCarthy’s successor and House Republicans as a whole must now decide the future of this rule. While McCarthy has joked to reporters about changing it, some Republicans want it to remain. The Main Street Caucus, a sizeable GOP group, insists any would-be Speaker must explain how history will not repeat itself. Florida Rep. Carlos Giménez, part of that caucus, says he will only support a candidate who agrees to put forward a change to the rule, calling the current single-member threshold 'a little bit insane.' House conservatives are increasingly opposed to continuing further aid to Ukraine in its defense against Russia, even as Senate Minority Leader Mitch McConnell argues that such assistance is crucial. Jim Jordan told NBC News he would not support more aid, while Steve Scalise voted for $300 million in support just last week. Some House Republicans are making their votes contingent on various investigations. Rep. Anna Paulina Luna of Florida said she will only support a candidate who pledges to defund special counsel Jack Smith's investigations into former President Donald Trump, subpoena Hunter Biden, and hold a vote on impeaching President Joe Biden. McCarthy previously reversed his commitment to hold a vote on initiating an 'impeachment inquiry,' which is a less serious step than actual impeachment. It remains highly unlikely that the Democratic-controlled Senate would go along with efforts to defund the Justice Department’s investigations after Trump was indicted for alleged mishandling of classified documents and trying to overturn the 2020 presidential election. Several Republican lawmakers, including Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene, are pushing for former President Trump to become Speaker. While this is highly unlikely, it's not impossible. Trump indicated Thursday that he might serve as a temporary Speaker until a permanent one is chosen. This prospect could cause anxiety for Republicans representing districts won by Biden, as it could force more moderate members to risk their seats. The House GOP will vote privately—possibly next week—on who should be the next Speaker. This is decided by a simple majority among the 221 Republican members. Traditionally, the chosen candidate is then voted for publicly on the House floor. In McCarthy's case, he was forced to go through 15 rounds of ballots despite winning the internal race. It’s uncertain whether a similar scenario will play out this time. If every Republican votes together, the party can only afford to lose four members, assuming Democrats remain united in opposition.
translated_content: Republikanci u Zastupničkom domu iznose suprotstavljena—pa čak i kontradiktorna—gledišta dok postavljaju uvjete za novog predsjednika, koji će pokušati ujediniti stranku nakon povijesne smjene Kevina McCarthyja. Republikanci su si zadali rok do sljedeće srijede za izbor novog predsjednika Zastupničkog doma, no nije sigurno hoće li uspjeti ispuniti taj ambiciozni cilj. U međuvremenu, saveznoj vladi prijeti nestanak sredstava neposredno prije Dana zahvalnosti, što bi McCarthyjevog nasljednika moglo staviti u jednako nezavidnu situaciju kao i onu koja je njemu presudila. McCarthyjevi potezi kako bi osigurao mjesto predsjednika sada služe kao upozoravajuća priča. Njegova odluka da popusti zahtjevima zastupnika Matta Gaetza s Floride i drugih konzervativaca—da bilo koji član može pokrenuti postupak smjene—na kraju je postala sredstvo njegove vlastite smjene. Nije jasno bi li McCarthy mogao osvojiti mjesto predsjednika da nije prešao vlastitu crvenu liniju. Glavni kandidati za nasljednika McCarthyja—voditelj većine Zastupničkog doma Steve Scalise i predsjednik Odbora za pravosuđe Jim Jordan—svaki se suočava s vlastitim preprekama u kampanji za tu ulogu. Nitko dosad nije bio smijenjen 'motion to vacate' postupkom. McCarthyjev nasljednik i republikanci kao cjelina sad moraju odlučiti o budućnosti toga pravila. Iako se McCarthy novinarima šalio da bi ga promijenio, neki republikanci žele da ostane. Main Street Caucus, velika republikanska skupina, inzistira da svaki kandidat za predsjednika objasni kako se povijest ne bi ponovila. Floridski zastupnik Carlos Giménez, član te skupine, kaže kako će podržati samo kandidata koji predloži promjenu tog pravila, označivši trenutačni prag od jednog člana 'pomalo ludim.' Konzervativci sve više odbijaju daljnju pomoć Ukrajini u obrani od Rusije, iako vođa manjine Senata Mitch McConnell smatra da je ta pomoć presudna. Jim Jordan rekao je za NBC News da ne bi podržao više pomoći, dok je Steve Scalise upravo prošlog tjedna glasao za 300 milijuna dolara potpore. Neki republikanci svoj glas uvjetuju raznim istragama. Zastupnica Anna Paulina Luna s Floride tvrdi da će podržati samo kandidata koji se javno obveže ukinuti financiranje istraga specijalnog tužitelja Jacka Smitha protiv bivšeg predsjednika Donalda Trumpa, pozvati Huntera Bidena na saslušanje i pokrenuti glasanje o opozivu predsjednika Joea Bidena. McCarthy je prethodno odustao od obećanja da će održati glasanje o 'istrazi opoziva', što je manje ozbiljan korak od stvarne opoziva. Vrlo je malo vjerojatno da bi Senat pod kontrolom demokrata podržao takve pokušaje ukidanja istraga Ministarstva pravosuđa nakon što je Trump optužen za navodno nezakonito postupanje s povjerljivim dokumentima i pokušaj poništavanja rezultata predsjedničkih izbora 2020. Nekoliko republikanaca, uključujući Marjorie Taylor Greene, zagovara da bivši predsjednik Trump postane predsjednik Doma. Iako je to vrlo malo vjerojatno, nije nemoguće. Trump je u četvrtak nagovijestio da bi mogao privremeno preuzeti tu ulogu dok se ne izabere stalni predsjednik. Ova bi mogućnost mogla unijeti zabrinutost među republikance u okruzima koje je osvojio Biden jer bi umjereniji članovi mogli riskirati svoje mandate. Republikanci će, vjerojatno sljedećeg tjedna, tajnim glasovanjem izabrati tko će biti novi predsjednik. Odluku donosi obična većina od 221 republikanca. Obično se tako izabranom kandidatu javno daje podrška na glasanju u Domu. U McCarthyjevom slučaju, bilo je potrebno čak 15 krugova glasanja. Ostaje neizvjesno hoće li se sličan scenarij ponoviti. Ako svi republikanci glasaju zajedno, mogu si priuštiti gubitak samo četvorice članova, pod uvjetom da su demokrati ujedinjeni u protivljenju.

article_content: 1. The last major Senate contest of 2014 is the Louisiana runoff, where Republican Bill Cassidy appears heavily favored over Democratic incumbent Mary Landrieu. Polls, analysts, and most Democrats view Cassidy as having the upper hand, especially after securing the endorsement of the tea party’s third-place candidate. Molly Ball from The Atlantic pointed out the overwhelming advertising in Cassidy’s favor, making a Landrieu comeback unlikely unless the Keystone XL pipeline vote brings unforeseen change. 2. House Democrats are embroiled in a fight for the position of top Democrat on the Energy and Commerce Committee. Though seniority is typically decisive, New Jersey’s Frank Pallone finds himself competing with Anna Eshoo of California, whom Nancy Pelosi strongly supports. Pelosi’s direct involvement—insisting on in-person voting and lobbying for Eshoo—has frustrated some party members, drawing criticism over the process. 3. President Obama may agree to withdraw some controversial nominees to achieve Senate confirmations for most of his pending administration appointments. Peter Baker of The New York Times reported Obama is collaborating with Senate leaders Harry Reid and Mitch McConnell to send through a package of largely career ambassador nominees, setting aside those creating political friction. 4. With Republicans controlling Congress, there is speculation that President Obama will rely more on his veto power, though he has used it just twice so far. NPR’s Tamara Keith suggested upcoming votes, such as on the Keystone pipeline, could put that theory to the test, but the narrow Senate margin may limit big legislative challenges needing a veto. 5. Although New Hampshire Republicans have retaken the state House, they’re divided over leadership. Former Speaker Bill O'Brien wants the gavel again, but party veterans like John Sununu, Steve Merrill, and Senator Kelly Ayotte believe his approach is too conservative and could harm the GOP’s image. With Ayotte facing re-election in a Democratic-favoring cycle and Governor Maggie Hassan winning another term, intra-party debates about the party’s direction have become a major focus.

article_content: A recent Vocativ study found that Barack Obama's speeches to the American people are only slightly more sophisticated than those of George W. Bush, who was often criticized for his public speaking. The analysis examined 600 presidential speeches, dating back to George Washington, using the Flesch-Kincaid readability test. This test evaluates each speech's word count, sentence length, and syllable complexity, then assigns a grade-level score indicating the education required to understand the content. According to the data, both Obama and Bush's speeches received similar scores, typically between the 7th and 11th grade reading levels. For context, a score of 4 means a speech is accessible to a fourth-grader, 12 to a college graduate, and 21 or higher to someone with a Ph.D. Jeff Shesol, a former speechwriter for Bill Clinton, reviewed the findings. He observed: 'I don't see a huge discrepancy here. President Obama, no more or less than President Bush, aims to balance nuance and subtext with accessible language. Although President Bush was sometimes inarticulate in unscripted moments, his prepared speeches were often underestimated. Many, especially following September 11, displayed crisp formality.' The study also reveals that, over time, presidential speeches have become both longer and less sophisticated. This shift is attributed to presidents no longer addressing only well-educated, elite audiences, but a broader and more diverse public. 'It's tempting to see this as the dumbing down of the presidency,' says Shesol, 'but it's actually a mark of democratization, because as more people gained the right to vote, presidents needed to appeal to everyone, not just the societal elite.' Presidents such as Bill Clinton have received criticism for delivering lengthy State of the Union addresses, even though some polls showed that the public was receptive to longer speeches if they were compelling. The study highlights Abraham Lincoln's speeches, which ranged in sophistication from grades 7 to 21. Lincoln’s Gettysburg Address was so powerful that John F. Kennedy and his speechwriter cited it as inspiration. Historically, presidents like Washington and Jefferson simplified language when addressing groups such as Native Americans, recognizing linguistic and cultural gaps. However, in the modern media age, presidents typically address the entire nation at once, resulting in less variation in speech style for specific audiences. In sum, the research suggests that the effectiveness of presidential speeches often depends not just on their complexity but on word choice and emotional resonance. As Shesol notes, brief and straightforward language can make speeches more impactful than those filled with complex vocabulary.

Taj test procjenjuje broj riječi, duljinu rečenica i složenost slogova u govoru, te mu potom dodjeljuje razinu razredne čitljivosti koja pokazuje koja je razina obrazovanja potrebna da se sadržaj razumije. Studija otkriva da su tijekom vremena predsjednički govori postajali i duži i manje sofisticirani. Studija ističe govore Abrahama Lincolna, koji su po sofisticiranosti varirali od 7. do 21. razreda. Lincolnove Getisburške riječi bile su toliko snažne da su John F. Kennedy i njegov pisac govora iz njih crpili nadahnuće. Povijesno gledano, predsjednici poput Washingtona i Jeffersona pojednostavljivali su jezik kada su se obraćali skupinama poput domorodaca, prepoznajući jezične i kulturološke razlike. Danas, u doba masovnih medija, predsjednici uglavnom govore cijeloj naciji, pa je manje varijacija u stilu govora za različite skupine. Zaključno, istraživanje sugerira da snaga predsjedničkih govora često ne ovisi nužno o njihovoj složenosti, već i o odabiru riječi i emocionalnom dojmu na publiku. Kako ističe Shesol, kratke i izravne poruke mogu biti učinkovitije od govora prepunih kompliciranog vokabulara.

article_content: Efforts by Chancellor George Osborne and the Coalition government to regain control of public finances appear to be effective. According to a report, Britain is on track for the largest public finance turnaround among advanced economies since World War II. The independent Office for Budget Responsibility (OBR) states that, if current policies continue, public finances will return to balance by 2018-19, resulting in the first surplus in 18 years. The report notes this would be one of the most significant budget reductions among advanced nations in the post-war era. The OBR examines the reasons for the deficit and rising debt in Britain since the 2007-2008 financial crisis. It attributes large budget deficits to increased spending during the period when Gordon Brown was Prime Minister and Alistair Darling was Chancellor, with Labour's 2007 Comprehensive Spending Review plans maintained despite the banking crisis following the collapse of Northern Rock in 2007 and Lehman Brothers in 2008. Labour also accelerated some capital spending and increased employment support while tax receipts declined due to the recession. The current government has implemented significant spending cuts, notably reducing public sector expenditure to 38% of national output, a figure last seen in the early 2000s. Much of the improvement in the public finances has come from reducing departmental spending, which increased in the later years of the Labour government. There have also been considerable reductions in capital and welfare spending, though National Health Service expenditure has continued to rise despite department budget cuts. The financial crisis led to falling tax revenues and nominal GDP between 2007-08 and 2009-10, which the OBR describes as a rare event. OBR director Robert Chote called Labour’s increased spending during deteriorating public finances 'unusual,' noting that other countries were attempting to lower debt before the crisis. As a result, UK national debt increased at a rate of 2.5% of national output per year between 2004 and 2007, outpacing Greece, Portugal, and Italy. The OBR cautions that shifting away from current fiscal discipline could threaten the country’s financial recovery.

Veliki proračunski deficit pripisuje se povećanim izdacima u razdoblju kad su Gordon Brown bio premijer, a Alistair Darling ministar financija, pri čemu su Laburisti nastavili s planovima iz pregleda potrošnje 2007., unatoč bankarskoj krizi nakon propasti Northern Rocka 2007. i Lehman Brothersa 2008. article_content: GPT Healthcare, which operates and manages mid-sized multispecialty hospitals under the ILS Hospitals brand, has resubmitted its draft red herring prospectus (DRHP) to market regulator Sebi for its upcoming IPO. The IPO, with a face value of Rs 10 per share, includes a fresh issue of equity shares worth Rs 40 crore and an offer for sale (OFS) of up to 2.60 crore equity shares by Mauritius-based BanyanTree Growth Capital II, LLC. The offer will follow the book-building process: 50% is allocated to qualified institutional buyers, 15% to non-institutional bidders, and 35% to retail investors. As outlined in the DRHP, funds raised from the fresh issue will be used mainly for the prepayment or repayment of certain borrowings by the company, with the rest for general corporate purposes. GPT Healthcare operates four full-service multispecialty hospitals with a total capacity of 561 beds, offering over 35 specialties and super-specialties, including internal medicine, diabetology, gastroenterology, orthopedics and joint replacements, interventional cardiology, neurology, neurosurgery, pediatrics, and neonatology. The company faces competition from listed peers such as Global Health, Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences, Jupiter LifeLine Hospitals, and Yatharth Hospital. In fiscal 2023, GPT Healthcare's total income increased by 7% year-on-year to Rs 367 crore, primarily due to higher hospital service income. Nevertheless, net profit fell to Rs 39 crore from Rs 42 crore the previous year. For the quarter ended June 2023, total income was Rs 97.63 crore, and net profit was Rs 9.98 crore. JM Financial is the sole book-running lead manager for the offering, while Link Intime India serves as the registrar. The equity shares are expected to be listed on both the BSE and NSE.

Ponuda će biti provedena putem book-building procesa: 50% namijenjeno kvalificiranim institucionalnim investitorima, 15% neinstitucionalnim ponuđačima i 35% malim ulagačima. Prema DRHP-u, sredstva prikupljena novim izdanjem prvenstveno će se koristiti za djelomičnu ili potpunu otplatu određenih kredita tvrtke, a ostatak za opće korporativne svrhe. article_content: The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service has officially declared 21 species extinct and removed them from the Endangered Species Act (ESA), following a proposal from September 2021. These include the Little Mariana fruit bat (Guam), the San Marcos gambusia (Texas), the Scioto madtom (Ohio), eight freshwater mussel species, Bachman's warbler (Southeast), the Bridled white-eye (Guam), and eight honeycreeper bird species (Hawaii). Most of these species were placed under ESA protection in the 1970s and 1980s, when their populations were already dangerously low. The U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service emphasizes the need for rapid intervention to prevent similar losses. Director Martha Williams highlighted the ESA's role as a safety net, but stressed the importance of early action to save vulnerable species. Conservation leaders note that southern U.S. regions face especially pressing challenges, as diverse wildlife suffers from threats like climate change and habitat destruction, often driven by human activity. A 2019 UN report estimated that over a million species worldwide are nearing extinction due to human impacts. The extinction of Hawaiian birds illustrates the serious effect of habitat loss, according to Noah Greenwald from the Center for Biological Diversity. He warns that more Hawaiian birds remain at risk, with climate change intensifying threats. Danielle Kessler, of the International Fund for Animal Welfare, says these losses highlight the urgency of supporting strong wildlife protection laws. Despite notable losses, both experts and the USFWS assert that the ESA has saved 99% of listed species from extinction, and recovery efforts have led to over 100 delistings. Many more species show stable or improving populations due to collaboration among tribes, government agencies, organizations, and individuals, proving that coordinated conservation makes a difference.

Među njima su šišmiš Little Mariana (Guam), riba San Marcos gambusia (Teksas), Scioto madtom (Ohio), osam vrsta riječnih školjki, Bachmanov ševac (jugoistok SAD-a), ptica Bridled white-eye (Guam) i osam vrsta ptica honeycreeper s Havaja. Većina tih vrsta bila je zaštićena ESA-om još 1970-ih i 1980-ih, kada su im populacije bile već kritično niske. Služba naglašava važnost brzog djelovanja u zaštiti ugroženih vrsta. Direktorica Martha Williams istaknula je kako ESA služi kao mreža sigurnosti, ali je ključno pravovremeno djelovati. Ekolozi napominju da su južni dijelovi SAD-a posebno rizični jer bogat životinjski svijet trpi zbog klimatskih promjena i gubitka staništa, što je često rezultat ljudskog djelovanja. Prema UN-ovom izvješću iz 2019., više od milijun vrsta širom svijeta je pred izumiranjem zbog ljudskog utjecaja. Izumiranje havajskih ptica primjer je ozbiljnog utjecaja gubitka staništa na bioraznolikost, ističe Noah Greenwald iz Centra za biološku raznolikost. Napominje da su i druge havajske vrste na rubu, a klimatske promjene pogoršavaju prijetnje. Danielle Kessler iz Međunarodnog fonda za dobrobit životinja kaže kako ovi gubici pokazuju hitnost jačanja zakona o zaštiti divljih vrsta. Unatoč ovim gubicima, stručnjaci i američka služba ističu da je ESA zaštitila 99% uvrštenih vrsta od izumiranja, a više od 100 vrsta skinuto je s popisa zahvaljujući oporavku. Suradnja plemena, agencija, organizacija i građana omogućila je napredak brojnih drugih vrsta, dokazujući važnost zajedničkog djelovanja.

article_content: A recent report by Oxfam ranked the Netherlands as the best country in the world to eat, while Chad ranked as the worst. The United States did not place in the top 20, coming in at number 21, and the UK was ranked 13th. The survey analyzed food consumption in 125 countries, focusing on whether people have enough to eat, the affordability and quality of available food, and the extent of diet-related diseases. According to the report, the Netherlands secured the top spot due to relatively low food prices, low diabetes rates, and a diverse diet. France and Switzerland followed in second and third place. Other countries in the top 12 included Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Sweden, Australia, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, and Portugal. However, even these nations did not excel in every category; for example, nearly one in five people in the Netherlands are classified as obese (BMI over 30), with Australia having the highest obesity rate among top-ranked countries at 27 percent. At the bottom of the table, Chad was identified as the worst place to eat because food there is of poor nutritional value, expensive, and often prepared in unhygienic conditions. One in three children in Chad are underweight. Ethiopia and Angola also ranked poorly, and the rest of the bottom 10 consisted primarily of sub-Saharan African countries and Yemen. The study noted that diets in these lowest-ranked countries are often dominated by nutrient-poor cereals and root vegetables. The United States had the most affordable food, while Angola had the least affordable. Food quality was highest in Iceland and lowest in Madagascar. Saudi Arabia had the highest rate of diabetes, and Kuwait had the largest proportion of obese people. Malnutrition was most widespread in Burundi, where 67 percent of the population is undernourished and 35 percent of children are underweight. Yemen, India, and Madagascar followed, with India showing the world's highest rate of underweight children at 44 percent. Obesity levels were lowest in Bangladesh, Nepal, and Ethiopia. The Oxfam report also highlighted that, while some Pacific Island nations like Nauru have the highest obesity rates globally (71 percent), they were not included in the study. The report concluded with recommendations to address global food issues, such as investing in small-scale agriculture, addressing climate change, and better regulating food markets to prevent sharp price increases.

Sjedinjene Američke Države nisu ušle u top 20, već su na 21. mjestu, dok je Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo na 13. mjestu. Istraživanje je analiziralo prehrambene navike u 125 zemalja, s naglaskom na to imaju li ljudi dovoljno hrane, koliko je ona pristupačna i kvalitetna te kolika je učestalost bolesti povezanih s prehranom. Prema izvješću, Nizozemska je na prvom mjestu zahvaljujući relativno niskim cijenama hrane, niskim stopama dijabetesa i raznovrsnoj prehrani. Slijede Francuska i Švicarska. Ostale zemlje u top 12 su Austrija, Belgija, Danska, Švedska, Australija, Irska, Italija, Luksemburg i Portugal. No ni ove zemlje ne stoje dobro u svim kategorijama; primjerice, gotovo svaki peti stanovnik Nizozemske ima pretilost (BMI iznad 30), a Australija ima najveću stopu pretilosti među najbolje rangiranim zemljama s 27 posto. Na dnu ljestvice, Čad je označen kao najgore mjesto za prehranu jer tamošnja hrana ima malu nutritivnu vrijednost, skupa je i često pripremljena u nehigijenskim uvjetima. Svako treće dijete u Čadu je pothranjeno. Loše su rangirane i Etiopija i Angola, a ostatak najnižih 10 čine uglavnom zemlje subsaharske Afrike i Jemen. Studija napominje da su prehrambene navike u ovim najlošije rangiranim zemljama često temeljene na žitaricama i korjenastom povrću siromašnom nutrijentima. Sjedinjene Američke Države imaju najpristupačniju hranu, dok Angola ima najmanje pristupačnu. Kvaliteta hrane je najviša na Islandu, a najniža na Madagaskaru. Saudijska Arabija ima najveću stopu dijabetesa, a Kuvajt najveći udio pretilih ljudi. Pothranjenost je najraširenija u Burundiju, gdje je 67 posto stanovništva pothranjeno i 35 posto djece je premršavo. Slijede Jemen, Indija i Madagaskar, a u Indiji je zabilježena i najveća svjetska stopa premršave djece – 44 posto. Najniže razine pretilosti zabilježene su u Bangladešu, Nepalu i Etiopiji. Oxfam je također istaknuo da, iako neke pacifičke otočne države poput Naurua imaju najviše stope pretilosti na svijetu (71 posto), nisu bile uključene u istraživanje. Izvješće je zaključilo s preporukama za rješavanje globalnih problema s hranom, kao što su ulaganja u poljoprivredu malih proizvođača, borba protiv klimatskih promjena i bolje reguliranje tržišta hrane kako bi se spriječile nagle promjene cijena.

article_content:
After his death as in life, Michael Jackson continued to captivate audiences around the world. Millions watched online coverage of Jackson’s funeral and memorial service from Los Angeles, though the event did not break previous online viewership records. According to Akamai Technologies, global web traffic was at least 19% above normal—peaking at 33%—during much of the star-filled memorial at the Staples Center. 

CNN.com reported 9.7 million live video streams between midnight and 5 p.m. ET on Tuesday, encompassing the full memorial, according to spokeswoman Jennifer Martin. The site’s highest full-day record is nearly 27 million streams, set on President Obama’s January inauguration day. On Tuesday, CNN.com also registered 81 million page views, 11.8 million unique visitors, and a peak of 781,000 concurrent live streams.

Jackson’s sudden death on June 25 nearly overwhelmed the web, with some sites struggling under heavy traffic. However, the Internet managed better during Tuesday’s service. "So far we are seeing some slowdowns ... [but] overall the Internet is performing OK," said Dan Berkowitz, spokesman for Keynote Systems, a company that tracks the top 40 US news sites.

CNN.com teamed up with Facebook to allow real-time commentary as people watched live. Shortly before the service, status updates were flowing at about 6,000 per minute, according to Facebook. This was less than the record activity seen during Obama’s inauguration.

Since many North Americans were at work during the event, online traffic was expected to be high. Blogger Ben Parr of Mashable predicted it might break streaming records. Other platforms—including CBSNews.com, ABCNews.com, FoxNews.com, and Hulu.com—also provided live streams. All ten of Twitter’s top trending topics Tuesday afternoon were related to the memorial. Google Trends described the interest as "volcanic," and Alexa’s leading stories were Jackson-themed.

Early figures, however, indicated web traffic behind some recent major events. Akamai recorded a peak of 3.9 million global visitors per minute after noon ET—less than half the volume seen during the 2008 presidential election night.

Toni Fitzgerald, managing editor of Media Life, noted there is still no complete way to measure overall web viewership. Well ahead of the service, sites prepared for heavy use. During the ticket lottery registration, the Staples Center website temporarily removed nonessential content to handle the surge. According to Jackson family spokesman Ken Sunshine, the server recorded 500 million hits—120,000 a second—within the first 90 minutes of ticket registration. Only about 17,500 fans were selected to attend in person, a small portion of the 1.6 million who applied.

CNN’s Stephanie Busari and Linnie Rawlinson contributed to this report.

Kao što je bilo i za života, Michael Jackson je i nakon smrti nastavio pratiti publiku širom svijeta. Prema Akamai Technologies, globalni internetski promet bio je najmanje 19% iznad normale—dosežući vrhunac od 33%—tijekom većeg dijela komemoracije bogate zvijezdama u Staples Centeru.

CNN.com je izvijestio o 9,7 milijuna prijenosa uživo između ponoći i 17 sati prema istočnom vremenu u utorak, što obuhvaća cijelu komemoraciju, prema glasnogovornici Jennifer Martin. Rekord web stranice za cjelodnevne prijenose iznosi gotovo 27 milijuna, postavljen na dan inauguracije predsjednika Obame u siječnju. Tog utorka CNN.com je također zabilježio 81 milijun pregleda stranica, 11,8 milijuna jedinstvenih posjetitelja i vrhunac od 781.000 istovremenih prijenosa uživo.

Jacksonova iznenadna smrt 25. lipnja zamalo je preopteretila internet, a neke stranice su imale poteškoća zbog velikog prometa. Ipak, tijekom komemoracije mreža je radila bolje. "Zasad vidimo poneka usporavanja, ali općenito internet radi dobro", rekao je Dan Berkowitz, glasnogovornik tvrtke Keynote Systems, koja nadzire 40 najpopularnijih američkih novinskih portala.

CNN.com je surađivao s Facebookom, omogućivši gledateljima komentiranje u stvarnom vremenu. Neposredno prije početka komemoracije broj statusa na Facebooku bio je oko 6.000 u minuti, što je manje od aktivnosti tijekom Obamine inauguracije.

S obzirom na to da su mnogi Amerikanci radili tijekom komemoracije, očekivao se velik internetski promet. Bloger Ben Parr s Mashablea procijenio je da bi to mogao biti rekord po broju prijenosa uživo. Prijenose su nudili i CBSNews.com, ABCNews.com, FoxNews.com i Hulu.com. Teme vezane za komemoraciju činile su svih deset najpopularnijih na Twitteru tog utorka. Google Trends je interes nazvao "vulkanskim", a najčitanije priče na Alexi bile su povezane s Jacksonom.

Početni podaci ipak sugeriraju da je promet bio manji u odnosu na neke nedavne velike događaje. Akamai je zabilježio najviši broj od 3,9 milijuna globalnih posjetitelja u minuti nakon podneva po istočnom vremenu—manje od polovice korisnika zabilježenih na večer predsjedničkih izbora 2008.

Toni Fitzgerald, glavna urednica Media Lifea, istaknula je da još uvijek ne postoji potpuna metodologija za mjerenje ukupne online gledanosti. Mnogo prije početka komemoracije, web stranice su pripremale svoje sustave za očekivani promet. Tijekom prijava za lutriju ulaznica, web stranica Staples Centera privremeno je uklonila nebitan sadržaj; prema glasnogovorniku obitelji Jackson, Kenu Sunshineu, server je zabilježio 500 milijuna "hitova", odnosno 120.000 u sekundi, u prvih 90 minuta. Samo 17.500 fanova je nasumično odabrano za prisustvo uživo, što je tek mali dio od 1,6 milijuna prijava.

CNN-ove novinarke Stephanie Busari i Linnie Rawlinson također su pridonijele ovom izvještaju.
