article_content: A teenage Afghan refugee, Haroon Armani, drowned while swimming in the River Great Ouse at Cardington Lock in Bedford during a summer heatwave, an inquest has heard. Haroon, 18, was with a friend on Friday, 16 June, when he encountered difficulties in the water. A boy and girl jumped in to try to help find him. Bedfordshire senior coroner Emma Whitting concluded that Haroon’s death was due to misadventure and noted that his experience with open water was 'unknown.' The inquest in Ampthill was told that Haroon had previously swum in a pool at a local gym, but not in open water. He was rescued from the river and taken to hospital, where he died the following morning. The cause of death was recorded as multiple organ failure as a result of drowning. Social worker Roseanne Johnstone from Bedford Borough Council said Haroon arrived in the UK in August 2021 as an unaccompanied adult. According to the inquest, Haroon fled Afghanistan due to fears of the Taliban, since some of his family members had been in the army. He traveled with a group through Pakistan, then was smuggled in trucks through Bulgaria, Serbia, Slovenia, Italy, and France before crossing the Channel from Calais by small boat. Last December, Haroon was granted leave to remain in the UK. He lived in Bedford and attended Barnfield College in Luton. He aspired to be a police officer. 'He was a fit, healthy, very active young man. He always had a smile on his face,' Ms Johnstone said. Ms Whitting stated: 'In hot weather he entered the water of the Great Ouse. While he was familiar with swimming indoors, his level of experience and knowledge of open water remained unknown.'
translated_content: Tinejdžer, afganistanski izbjeglica Haroon Armani, utopio se dok je plivao u rijeci Great Ouse kod Cardington Locka u Bedfordu tijekom ljetnog toplinskog vala, čulo se na istrazi. Haroon, 18, bio je s prijateljem u petak, 16. lipnja, kada je naišao na poteškoće u vodi. Dječak i djevojka su uskočili u rijeku pokušavajući mu pomoći. Glavna mrtvozornica Bedforshirea, Emma Whitting, zaključila je da je Haroonova smrt bila nesretan slučaj i navela da nije poznat njegov stupanj iskustva s otvorenim vodama. Na istrazi u Ampthillu rečeno je da je Haroon prije plivao u bazenu lokalne teretane, ali nije imao iskustva s otvorenim vodama. Izvučen je iz rijeke i prebačen u bolnicu, gdje je preminuo sljedeće jutro. Uzrok smrti zabilježen je kao višestruko zatajenje organa uslijed utapanja. Socijalna radnica Roseanne Johnstone iz Vijeća općine Bedford izjavila je da je Haroon stigao u Ujedinjeno Kraljevstvo u kolovozu 2021. kao punoljetna osoba bez pratnje. Prema istrazi, Haroon je pobjegao iz Afganistana zbog straha od talibana, jer su neki članovi njegove obitelji bili u vojsci. Putovao je s grupom kroz Pakistan, zatim su ga švercali kamionima kroz Bugarsku, Srbiju, Sloveniju, Italiju i Francusku, prije nego što je malim čamcem prešao kanal iz Calaisa. Prošlog prosinca Haroonu je odobren boravak u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu. Živio je u Bedfordu i pohađao Barnfield College u Lutonu. San mu je bio postati policajac. 'Bio je zdrav, aktivan i uvijek nasmijan mladić', rekla je gđa Johnstone. Gđa Whitting je izjavila: 'Tijekom vrućeg vremena ušao je u vodu rijeke Great Ouse. Iako je bio upoznat s plivanjem u zatvorenim bazenima, razina njegovog iskustva i znanja o otvorenoj vodi nije bila poznata.'

article_content: After a day under lockdown, Boston began resuming limited transit services Friday evening across all transportation modes except commuter rail. Massachusetts Governor Deval Patrick announced the return of services and the lifting of stay-at-home orders at a press conference. Boston’s Logan International Airport operated normally under increased security measures, according to airport spokesman Matthew Brelis, who advised travelers to check their flight status with airlines before heading to the airport and to allow extra time for security procedures. Airlines were waiving fees for passengers who chose not to fly or who were unable to do so. Taxi service in Boston, which was suspended Friday morning, was restored by around 11 a.m., as reported by the Boston Police Department’s Twitter feed. Traveler Karen Lo arrived at Logan from Canada to attend a biology conference at the Boston Convention & Exhibition Center. Having followed developments online, she chose to stay with colleagues near the airport for safety before heading into the city. Her conference was set to begin Saturday, and organizers were providing attendees with regular updates. A Friday afternoon statement advised conference participants who were not yet en route to facilities to hold off until further notice. Many airlines, including JetBlue and Delta, were allowing travelers with affected Boston flights to change their plans without incurring usual fees. Delta cited increased security affecting ground transportation to Logan as the reason for the policy. Flight tracking service FlightAware reported that Logan Airport operations and cancellations were normal Friday morning. The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) implemented a temporary flight restriction over Boston to accommodate law enforcement activities. Amtrak suspended its service between Boston and New York, and services south of Boston, at the request of local authorities. Northeast Corridor trains were terminating at New York Penn Station, with Downeaster service running on a modified schedule and no trains entering Boston. Other operations between Washington, Philadelphia, and New York remained normal. An Amtrak train from Boston was searched near Norwalk, Connecticut, in connection with the Boston Marathon investigation before continuing safely. Intercity bus lines Greyhound and BoltBus canceled operations in and out of Boston until further notice. CNN reporters Jim Barnett, Devon Sayers, Eliott McLaughlin, and Ayesha Durgahee contributed to this report.

Međunarodna zračna luka Logan u Bostonu radila je normalno uz pojačane sigurnosne mjere, prema riječima glasnogovornika zračne luke Matthewa Brelisa, koji je savjetovao putnicima da provjere status svog leta prije dolaska na aerodrom i da planiraju dodatno vrijeme za sigurnosne postupke. Zračne kompanije ukinule su naknade putnicima koji ne žele ili ne mogu putovati. Taksi usluga u Bostonu, koja je bila obustavljena u petak ujutro, ponovno je uspostavljena oko 11 sati, prema Twitter objavi Policijske uprave Bostona. Putnica Karen Lo stigla je na Logan iz Kanade kako bi prisustvovala konferenciji iz biologije u Boston Convention & Exhibition Centeru. Prateći razvoj događaja na internetu, odlučila je zbog sigurnosti ostati s kolegama blizu aerodroma prije nego što krene u centar grada. Njezina konferencija trebala bi započeti u subotu, a organizatori redovito obavještavaju sudionike. Delta je kao razlog navela pojačanu sigurnost koja utječe na prijevoz do Logana. Servis za praćenje letova FlightAware izvijestio je da je promet u zračnoj luci Logan u petak ujutro bio normalan, bez neuobičajenog broja otkaza. Savezna uprava za zrakoplovstvo (FAA) uvela je privremenu restrikciju zračnog prometa iznad Bostona radi provedbe policijskih aktivnosti. Amtrak je na zahtjev lokalnih vlasti obustavio promet između Bostona i New Yorka, kao i južno od Bostona. Vlakovi koridora Northeast završavaju vožnju na postaji Penn u New Yorku, dok Downeaster vozi po izmijenjenom rasporedu bez dolazaka u Boston. Drugi promet između Washingtona, Philadelphije i New Yorka je redovan. Amtrakov vlak iz Bostona pretražen je kod Norwalka, Connecticut, u sklopu istrage Bostonskog maratona i nakon toga je sigurno nastavio vožnju. Međugradske autobusne linije Greyhound i BoltBus obustavile su promet prema i iz Bostona do daljnjeg. U izvještaju su sudjelovali i CNN novinari Jim Barnett, Devon Sayers, Eliott McLaughlin i Ayesha Durgahee.

article_content: The share allotment for ASK Automotive's IPO was finalized on Sunday. Investors were allocated shares through a lottery system, overseen by the registrar. On the allotment date, investors can learn how many shares they received compared to their bids, and can check the status via the BSE website or the registrar's portal. To check on BSE: (1) Visit the BSE website. (2) Select the company name from the dropdown menu. (3) Enter your application number or PAN to view your allotment. ASK Automotive shares are expected to list on stock exchanges on November 15. According to market sources, the company is seeing a premium of Rs 33 in the unlisted market. Based on the IPO’s upper price band of Rs 282, the shares are predicted to debut at a premium of around 12%. The IPO attracted strong demand, being subscribed 51 times. ASK Automotive provides safety systems and critical engineering solutions, with expertise in design, development, and manufacturing. It is India’s largest manufacturer of brake shoes and advanced braking systems for two-wheelers, holding a 50% market share in FY2023. Between FY2021 and FY2023, the company’s operational revenue grew at a CAGR of 28.64%, and EBITDA grew at a CAGR of 13.11%. In the quarter ending June 2023, ASK Automotive reported revenue of Rs 656 crore, marking an 8% year-on-year increase, while profit rose 55% to Rs 35 crore. Proceeds from the IPO will go entirely to the promoter-selling shareholders, after deducting their share of offer expenses. The company itself will not receive any funds from the IPO. article_content: Schools across Delhi were closed on Friday as dense, toxic smog engulfed the city, affecting its 30 million residents. Every winter, a combination of smoke from crop stubble burning, vehicle exhaust, and factory emissions covers the capital in hazardous haze. This persistent public health crisis has lasted for decades, and researchers link it to hundreds of thousands of premature deaths each year in India. On Friday, the concentration of PM2.5—a fine particulate matter considered among the most dangerous for human health—was nearly 35 times higher than the daily maximum recommended by the World Health Organization, according to IQAir. "Given the rising pollution, all government and private primary schools in Delhi will remain closed for the next two days," wrote Delhi Chief Minister Arvind Kejriwal on X (formerly Twitter). Delhi, among the world's largest urban areas, regularly ranks as one of the most polluted cities on Earth. Residents deal with visible smog for much of the year, but pollution intensifies each winter—especially around the Hindu festival of Diwali. Diwali often coincides with the period when tens of thousands of farmers in northern India burn crop stubble from recently harvested rice paddies. This practice is a major contributor to Delhi's recurring smog problem, intensifying the impact of already significant vehicle and industrial emissions. Despite authorities' efforts to encourage alternative crop clearing methods and warn of penalties, the practice persists. The dense, eye-irritating and lung-burning smog reaches its worst levels from October to February, when colder air traps pollution close to the ground. Health officials advise residents to wear face masks outdoors during this period. "The next two months are going to be the worst," Delhi resident Pradeep Dund told AFP. "We cannot even breathe properly." Authorities routinely announce new pollution-control measures, like halting construction, but with limited results. India is currently hosting the Cricket World Cup. To avoid worsening air quality, organizers have banned fireworks at matches in Mumbai and Delhi. Bangladesh, scheduled to play Sri Lanka in Delhi on Monday, cancelled their Friday practice session because of the smog. Team director Khaled Mahmud told the Business Standard newspaper: "Some of us developed coughing, so there's a risk factor. We don't want to get sick. We don't know if things will improve." Indian cricket captain Rohit Sharma said, "The situation is not ideal for the tournament. Looking at our future generation, it's important they get to live without such fears." According to a 2020 Lancet study, air pollution led to 1.67 million deaths in India the previous year, including nearly 17,500 in Delhi. Research from the University of Chicago’s Energy Policy Institute suggests the average Delhi resident may lose up to 12 years of expected life due to air pollution. India's energy sector is heavily dependent on coal, with per capita emissions rising 29 percent over the past seven years. The country has been slow to adopt policies that reduce reliance on this fossil fuel. Severe smog is a public health issue in neighboring Pakistan as well. In Lahore, authorities recently made it mandatory for schoolchildren to wear masks to reduce health risks.

U petak je koncentracija PM2.5 — sitnih čestica koje se smatraju jednima od najopasnijih za ljudsko zdravlje — bila gotovo 35 puta veća od dnevnog maksimuma koji preporučuje Svjetska zdravstvena organizacija, prema IQAiru. Delhi, jedno od najvećih urbanih područja na svijetu, redovito je rangiran kao jedan od najzagađenijih gradova na Zemlji. Stanovnici se s vidljivim smogom suočavaju veći dio godine, ali se zagađenje pojačava svake zime — osobito oko hinduističkog festivala Diwali. Diwali često koincidira s razdobljem kada deseci tisuća farmera iz sjeverne Indije spaljuju žetvene ostatke sa svježe požnjevenih rižinih polja. Ova praksa je jedan od glavnih uzroka ponavljajućih problema sa smogom u Delhiju, dodatno pojačavajući utjecaj već značajnih emisija iz vozila i industrije. Unatoč naporima vlasti da potaknu alternativne metode čišćenja i upozorenja na kazne, praksa se nastavlja. Gusta magla koja izaziva iritaciju očiju i pluća najgora je od listopada do veljače, kada hladniji zrak zadržava zagađenje blizu tla. Zdravstveni djelatnici savjetuju građanima da tijekom tog razdoblja nose maske na otvorenom. "Sljedeća dva mjeseca bit će najgora," rekao je stanovnik Delhija Pradeep Dund za AFP. "Ne možemo ni normalno disati." Vlasti redovito najavljuju nove mjere za kontrolu zagađenja, poput zaustavljanja gradilišta, ali s ograničenim uspjehom. Indija je trenutno domaćin Svjetskog kupa u kriketu. Kako bi se izbjeglo pogoršanje kvalitete zraka, organizatori su zabranili vatromete na utakmicama u Mumbaiju i Delhiju. Bangladeš, koji bi trebao igrati protiv Šri Lanke u Delhiju u ponedjeljak, otkazao je trening u petak zbog smoga. Direktor tima Khaled Mahmud rekao je za Business Standard: "Neki od nas su počeli kašljati, pa postoji faktor rizika. Ne želimo se razboljeti. Ne znamo hoće li se situacija poboljšati." Kapetan indijske reprezentacije Rohit Sharma izjavio je: "Situacija nije idealna za turnir. Gledajući naše buduće generacije, važno je da mogu živjeti bez ovakvih strahova." Prema studiji časopisa Lancet iz 2020. godine, zagađenje zraka uzrokovalo je 1,67 milijuna smrti u Indiji godinu dana ranije, uključujući gotovo 17.500 u Delhiju. Istraživanje Instituta za energetsku politiku Sveučilišta u Chicagu sugerira da stanovnici Delhija mogu izgubiti i do 12 godina očekivanog životnog vijeka zbog zagađenja zraka. Indijski energetski sektor snažno ovisi o ugljenu, a emisije po stanovniku porasle su za 29 posto u posljednjih sedam godina. Država sporo uvodi politike koje bi smanjile oslanjanje na ovo fosilno gorivo. Teški smog ozbiljna je zdravstvena prijetnja i u susjednom Pakistanu. U Lahoreu su vlasti nedavno naredile da učenici tijekom nastave obvezno nose zaštitne maske kako bi se smanjili zdravstveni rizici.

article_content: Comedian Freddie Starr has cancelled his upcoming show to focus on defending himself against allegations of sexual abuse, it was revealed today. The 69-year-old entertainer was arrested in Warwickshire by officers investigating former children's TV presenter Jimmy Savile. Starr was held overnight on suspicion of sexual offences, following claims that he molested a 14-year-old girl in the 1970s in Savile's BBC dressing room. Despite plans to perform his 'Back From The Jungle Tour' at the Wyvern Theatre in Swindon, only about 300 out of 635 tickets had been sold. However, theatre director Derek Aldridge stated that the cancellation resulted from discussions with Starr's management and was not related to ticket sales. The performance, scheduled for November 7, will no longer take place, and the theatre will refund purchased tickets. Starr, who appeared on ITV’s 'I'm A Celebrity Get Me Out Of Here' last November, launched his tour earlier this year but was previously forced to leave the TV show due to ill health. He has denied all accusations, including claims from Karin Ward that he inappropriately touched her in 1974 when she was 14. As part of Operation Yewtree—Scotland Yard's investigation into historic abuse by Jimmy Savile and others—Starr has twice been released on bail and has voluntarily returned for further police questioning. Following his latest release, officers searched his home and seized items including computers, address books, photographs, and his phone. Starr’s management team has not issued further comment. Freddie Starr apologized to fans for the cancellation, expressing hope that they understand his need to address the allegations. The theatre has not reported complaints from fans regarding the situation.

article_content: On Wednesday, foreign portfolio investors (FPIs) sold Indian stocks worth Rs 306 crore, while domestic institutional investors (DIIs) bought shares valued at Rs 721 crore. The stock market swung between gains and losses, ultimately closing with modest advances. Analysts note that with no major events expected and the onset of the holiday period, markets are likely to remain range-bound. Siddhartha Khemka, Head of Retail Research at Motilal Oswal Financial, highlighted this expectation. Indicators like GIFT Nifty on the NSE IX suggested a subdued start for Thursday, slipping 9 points (0.05%) to 19,889 and signaling a flat opening for Dalal Street. Technical experts anticipate that a clear breakout above the 19,850–19,900 levels could drive markets to new record highs; on the downside, support is seen near 19,650, per Nagaraj Shetti of HDFC Securities. India VIX, which measures market volatility, dipped 3% to end at 11.86, reflecting a calmer environment. US equity markets posted gains on Wednesday due to optimism that the Federal Reserve might pause rate hikes and continued economic strength. The Dow rose 0.5%, S&P 500 gained 0.4%, and Nasdaq advanced 0.5%. Most Asian shares traded sideways on Thursday following the US uptrend, with S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 futures little changed. Hang Seng futures slipped 0.3%, Nikkei 225 futures rose 0.7%, and Australia's S&P/ASX 200 dropped 0.5%. Currency markets were quiet as Japan and the US observed holidays; the US dollar stayed strong after data questioned existing forecasts about peak Fed rates. Oil prices decreased by 1% in early Thursday trading, extending recent declines after OPEC+ delayed a key minister meeting, fueling speculation about less aggressive production cuts. Stocks including BHEL, Hindustan Copper, Indiabulls Housing Finance, India Cements, Manappuram, MCX, NMDC, RBL Bank, and ZEEL remain under an F&O trading ban due to positions surpassing 95% of the specified market-wide limit. The rupee traded in a narrow band and closed 4 paise lower at 83.32 per US dollar. FIIs slightly brought down their net short positions in the F&O segment from Rs 1.30 lakh crore to Rs 1.26 lakh crore. The IPO market is showing strong demand, with Tata Technologies, Flair Writing Industries, and Gandhar Oil Refinery's issues all being fully subscribed within hours of opening. IndiGo, India’s top airline, may introduce business class seating, hot meals, and a loyalty program by late 2024 to target premium and business travelers, directly competing with Air India. Lastly, a total of 26,518 insolvency cases worth Rs 9.33 lakh crore have been withdrawn before admission since the adoption of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.

article_content: A review has found that Lancashire Police's release of highly sensitive personal information during the Nicola Bulley disappearance investigation was avoidable and unnecessary. Nicola Bulley went missing in Lancashire, prompting an extensive search before her body was eventually discovered in the River Wyre. Lancashire Police faced criticism for disclosing that Ms Bulley had been struggling with menopause and alcohol-related issues. The role of underwater search expert Peter Faulding was also scrutinized in the review. Andrew Snowden, Lancashire's police and crime commissioner, commissioned the College of Policing to review the case. The police force has said it accepts the findings. The report highlighted that not declaring the case a critical incident led to significant challenges for officers. Several recommendations were made for Lancashire Police and the broader policing community. While none of the report's findings would have changed the outcome of the search, it concluded that the force's media handling and communication led to a breakdown of public confidence. The search for the 45-year-old in January attracted widespread national attention, with amateur detectives and social media users getting involved. Mr. Snowden said the police lost control of the media narrative early on. Prime Minister Rishi Sunak expressed concern at the time regarding the release of Ms Bulley's private information. The report stated that although the disclosure was lawful, it was avoidable and unnecessary. The review also suggested that police consider using legally enforceable non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) when working with external experts or contractors. This recommendation followed concerns about Mr. Faulding, from Specialist Group International, who was called in by Ms Bulley's family and reportedly complicated the investigation by discussing the case with the media and acting insensitively. Mr. Faulding made statements to the media that later conflicted with inquest findings and withdrew his team after searching the river, at one point declaring Ms Bulley was 'categorically not' in the water. In response, Mr. Faulding disputed parts of the report, stating he only received instructions to use discretion and keep operational information confidential and that he never disclosed any such information. The report praised the police investigation and search, describing it as 'very well conducted and resourced.' Ms Bulley's body was found three weeks after she disappeared, with the coroner finding she had fallen into the river accidentally. Mr. Snowden described the review as providing best practices for managing high-profile investigations. He acknowledged that losing control of the media narrative negatively impacted Ms Bulley's family and the wider community's confidence. He also noted that opportunities for confidential briefings or sharing her status as a high-risk missing person were missed. Mr. Snowden pledged to hold the chief constable accountable for implementing the recommendations and to convene a special accountability board in January. Despite damage to the force's reputation, he affirmed his full confidence in Chief Constable Chris Rowley. Andy Marsh, Chief Executive of the College of Policing, said failing to declare a critical incident set the tone for later challenges, especially the unnecessary release of Ms Bulley's personal information. However, he praised the force's 'exemplary investigation' and the well-managed search. Lancashire Police's Deputy Chief Constable Sacha Hatchett noted the immense public and social media interest in the case, which was sometimes overwhelming. She said the force worked closely with the Information Commissioner's Office after the disclosure, which found no action was required. She added that while the release was lawful, the impact was recognized, and the decision-making was based on perceived substantial risk at the time. Information Commissioner John Edwards highlighted the importance of strong laws protecting personal information and stated that police must ensure sharing such data is proportionate and necessary. National Police Chiefs' Council chairman Gavin Stephens welcomed the report's findings and committed to working with the College of Policing to make improvements. translated_content: Revizija je utvrdila da je objava visoko osjetljivih osobnih podataka od strane policije Lancashire tijekom istrage nestanka Nicole Bulley bila izbjegiva i nepotrebna. Nicola Bulley nestala je u Lancashireu, potaknuvši opsežnu potragu prije nego što je njezino tijelo pronađeno u rijeci Wyre. Policija Lancashire bila je izložena kritikama zbog objave da se gospođa Bulley borila s menopauzom i problemima s alkoholom. U izvješću se također analizira uloga stručnjaka za podvodnu potragu Petera Fauldinga. Andrew Snowden, povjerenik za policiju i kriminal u Lancashireu, zatražio je College of Policing da provede reviziju slučaja. Policija je priopćila da prihvaća nalaze. Izvješće je naglasilo kako je neproglašavanje slučaja kritičnim incidentom dovelo do značajnih izazova za policijske službenike. Dana je nekoliko preporuka policiji Lancashire i široj policijskoj zajednici. Iako niti jedan nalaz izvješća ne bi promijenio ishod potrage, zaključeno je da je način postupanja policije s medijima i komunikacijom doveo do gubitka povjerenja javnosti. Potraga za 45-godišnjakinjom u siječnju privukla je veliku nacionalnu pozornost, a uključilo se i mnogo amaterskih detektiva i korisnika društvenih mreža. Gospodin Snowden izjavio je kako je policija rano izgubila kontrolu nad medijskom naracijom. Premijer Rishi Sunak tada je izrazio zabrinutost zbog objave privatnih podataka gospođe Bulley. Izvješće navodi kako je, iako je objava bila zakonita, ona bila izbjegiva i nepotrebna. Revizija također predlaže da policija razmotri korištenje pravno obvezujućih ugovora o povjerljivosti (NDA) pri angažiranju vanjskih stručnjaka ili izvođača. Ova se preporuka odnosi na zabrinutost oko gospodina Fauldinga iz Specialist Group International, kojeg je angažirala obitelj gospođe Bulley, a koji je navodno komplicirao istragu izjavama za medije i neosjetljivim ponašanjem. Gospodin Faulding je davao izjave medijima koje su kasnije bile u suprotnosti s nalazima istrage, te je povukao svoj tim nakon pretrage rijeke, u jednom trenutku tvrdeći kako gospođa Bulley 'sigurno nije' u vodi. Kao odgovor, gospodin Faulding osporio je dijelove izvješća, navodeći da su mu dani samo savjeti o diskreciji i čuvanju operativnih informacija te da nikada nije odavao takve podatke. Izvješće je pohvalilo policijsku istragu i potragu, opisujući ih kao 'vrlo dobro vođene i organizirane.' Tijelo gospođe Bulley pronađeno je tri tjedna nakon njezina nestanka, a mrtvozornik je zaključio da je slučajno pala u rijeku. Gospodin Snowden rekao je kako izvješće sugerira najbolje prakse za upravljanje slučajevima visokog profila. Priznao je da je gubitak kontrole nad medijskom pričom negativno utjecao na obitelj gospođe Bulley te povjerenje zajednice. Također je naveo kako su propuštene prilike za diskretne brifinge o njezinu statusu visokorizične nestale osobe. Gospodin Snowden je obećao da će pozvati glavnog ravnatelja policije na odgovornost za provedbu preporuka i održati poseban odbor za odgovornost u siječnju. Unatoč narušenoj reputaciji tada, rekao je da ima puno povjerenje u glavnog ravnatelja Chrisa Rowleya. Andy Marsh, izvršni direktor College of Policing, rekao je da neproglašavanje kritičnog incidenta odredilo pristup i izazove, osobito nepotrebno otkrivanje osobnih podataka gospođe Bulley. Ipak, pohvalio je policijsku ‘primjernu istragu’ i potragu. Zamjenica glavnog ravnatelja policije Lancashire Sacha Hatchett istaknula je golemi interes javnosti i društvenih mreža za slučaj, što je povremeno bilo preplavljujuće. Navela je da je policija radila s Uredom povjerenika za informacije, koji nije poduzeo mjere nakon objave. Dodala je da je objava bila zakonita, ali da su posljedice i utjecaj prepoznati, a proces odlučivanja temeljio se na tadašnjoj procjeni značajnog rizika. Povjerenik za informacije John Edwards naglasio je važnost jakih zakona o zaštiti osobnih podataka i istaknuo da policija mora osigurati da dijeljenje bude proporcionalno i nužno. Predsjednik Nacionalnog vijeća šefova policije Gavin Stephens pozdravio je nalaze izvješća i najavio suradnju s College of Policing na poboljšanjima. Čitateljima se preporučuje da prate BBC North West na društvenim mrežama i pošalju prijedloge za vijesti.

article_content: According to Guinness World Records 2011, CBS's 'The Bold and the Beautiful' is recognized as the most popular current soap opera, thanks to its significant worldwide audience. In 2008, it was broadcast in over 110 countries, attracting 24.5 million viewers globally—surpassing any other soap or telenovela, according to Guinness. In contrast, US daytime soaps are declining. As classic shows like 'All My Children' and 'One Life to Live' near cancellation, soap operas continue to thrive internationally. Irish viewers follow 'Fair City,' Germans remain loyal to 'Lindenstraße,' the UK's 'EastEnders' serves audiences since 1985, while the Dutch consistently watch 'Goede Tijden, Slechte Tijden.' Australia's 'Home and Away' and Belgium's 'Thuis' are also viewer favorites. In the US, Spanish-language telenovelas attract ratings that most traditional soaps envy. Sam Ford, co-editor of 'The Survival of Soap Opera,' highlights that time slots impact global popularity—many international dramas air in prime time, unlike the US where they're scheduled mainly for daytime, thus lacking the stigma attached to daytime broadcasts. American soaps originated as radio serials before debuting on TV in the 1950s and 1960s, quickly gaining favor with advertisers seeking stay-at-home mothers. The genre's prominence peaked in the 1980s, as exemplified by the wedding of Luke and Laura on 'General Hospital,' which attracted 14 million viewers. Today's viewership is much lower. Lynn Leahey, editor of 'Soap Opera Digest,' attributes declining audiences to societal changes—fewer women at home and traditions not being passed down generationally. Now, soaps must compete with reality TV and social networking for viewers’ attention. Despite shifts, audiences still crave ongoing stories. This is especially clear from the success of telenovelas, which typically present stories with defined beginnings and endings. Peter Tinoco, CEO of Venevision Productions and producer of 'Eva Luna,' believes this structure is key to their appeal. 'Eva Luna' drew almost 10 million US viewers for its finale on Univision, demonstrating strong engagement, particularly among Hispanic audiences. Telenovelas have roots in illustrated booklets, leading to radio and then television. Their popularity across Latin America now extends to US audiences, dominating much of Hispanic TV programming. Daniela Guevara of Lanza Group observes that telenovelas are deeply woven into Hispanic family life. With the Hispanic population predicted to top 30% of Americans by 2050, telenovelas’ influence is poised to increase further, a trend supported by Nielsen research. Although American soaps have had substantial cultural impact, their future is uncertain—with only four currently broadcasting, from 20 in past years. Actor Tristan Rogers and commentator Sam Ford note the genre's legacy while questioning its longevity.

Godine 2008. prikazivala se u više od 110 zemalja, privukavši 24,5 milijuna gledatelja diljem svijeta—više nego ijedna druga sapunica ili telenovela, prema Guinnessu. Suprotno tome, američke dnevne sapunice su u padu. Kultne emisije poput 'All My Children' i 'One Life to Live' bliže se ukidanju, dok sapunice drugdje i dalje cvjetaju. Irci prate 'Fair City', Nijemci ostaju vjerni 'Lindenstraßeu', britanski 'EastEnders' emitira se još od 1985., a Nizozemci redovito gledaju 'Goede Tijden, Slechte Tijden'. Australska sapunica 'Home and Away' i belgijska 'Thuis' također su među omiljenima. U SAD-u španjolskojezične telenovele postižu odličnu gledanost. Sam Ford, suurednik knjige 'The Survival of Soap Opera', ističe da na popularnost utječe vrijeme emitiranja—mnoge međunarodne drame prikazuju se u udarnom terminu, dok su u SAD-u najčešće tijekom dana, što nosi određenu stigmu. Američke sapunice su započele kao radijske serije prije nego što su došle na televiziju 1950-ih i 1960-ih i brzo su postale popularne među oglašivačima koji su ciljali kućanice. Najveću popularnost dosegnule su 1980-ih, što pokazuje i vjenčanje Lukea i Laure u 'General Hospitalu' koje je gledalo 14 milijuna ljudi. Danas su gledateljske brojke značajno niže. Lynn Leahey, glavna urednica 'Soap Opera Digest', navodi da je pad gledanosti posljedica društvenih promjena—manje je žena kod kuće i tradicija gledanja sapunica više se ne prenosi generacijski. Danas sapunice konkuriraju reality televiziji i društvenim mrežama za pažnju publike. Bez obzira na promjene, publika voli dobro osmišljene priče. Finale 'Eva Lune' na Univisionu gledalo je gotovo 10 milijuna Amerikanaca, što govori o snažnoj popularnosti među hispanskom publikom. Telenovele su krenule kao ilustrirane knjižice, pa prešle na radio i televiziju. Ogromna popularnost u Latinskoj Americi prelila se i na SAD, gdje dominiraju hispanskim programom. Daniela Guevara iz Lanza Group navodi da su telenovele sastavni dio obiteljskog života u hispanskoj zajednici. Predviđa se da će do 2050. hispanska populacija premašiti 30% ukupnog stanovništva SAD-a, što će dodatno povećati utjecaj telenovela, potvrđuje i Nielsenovo istraživanje. Iako su američke sapunice ostavile trajan kulturni trag, njihova budućnost je nesigurna—na televiziji ih je ostalo samo četiri, dok ih je prije bilo 20. Glumac Tristan Rogers i komentator Sam Ford ističu njihovu važnost, ali su skeptični prema njihovoj budućnosti.

article_content: While Black Friday shoppers sprint for deals and sometimes clash over hot items, NASA presented a space-inspired twist called Black Hole Friday. Instead of shopping chaos, NASA entertained followers with playful facts and jokes about black holes on Twitter, and even launched a themed game. NASA shared over a dozen tweets and retweets during the day, with a particularly popular '2-for-1 deal' joke that attracted more than 1,000 retweets. According to NASA, a black hole is a region in space where gravity is so strong that not even light can escape, since matter is compressed into an extremely small area. They also shared that some scientists think the tiniest black holes could be as small as a single atom.

article_content: Americans' view of the economy is increasingly negative, though a majority anticipate improvement next year, according to a new poll. Only 38% of Americans currently believe the economy is in good shape, based on a CNN/ORC International poll of 1,018 adults conducted from October 24 to 26. This figure is down from 42% in September and could impact Democrats' efforts to retain control of the Senate in the November 4 midterm elections. The survey found that 62% of respondents rated economic conditions as 'somewhat poor' or 'very poor.' Urban residents have a more optimistic outlook, with 43% saying the economy is in good shape, compared to 39% in suburban areas and 31% in rural areas. Political affiliation also showed differences, with 55% of Democrats stating the economy is performing well, compared to just 28% of Republicans and 32% of independents. According to CNN Polling Director Keating Holland, 'With the economy remaining the top issue on voters' minds, the decline in positive views could not have come at a worse time for Democrats.' This decrease ends a year-long trend of increasing economic optimism. Despite the downturn, 52% of those surveyed believe the economy will improve within a year, while 46% feel it will remain in poor shape. The poll also found that 68% of Americans are angry about the way things are going in the United States ahead of next week's elections. It revealed that 36% of Republicans are enthusiastic about voting this year, compared to just 26% of Democrats. This difference in enthusiasm could be significant in certain House districts and is especially important as control of the Senate is at stake.

Stanovnici urbanih područja su optimističniji, pa 43% njih smatra da je ekonomija u dobrom stanju, za razliku od 39% iz predgrađa i 31% iz ruralnih područja. Politička pripadnost također utječe na mišljenje: 55% demokrata kaže da ekonomija dobro posluje, u usporedbi sa samo 28% republikanaca i 32% neovisnih. Prema riječima Keatinga Hollanda, direktora anketiranja CNN-a: 'Kako ekonomija ostaje glavno pitanje birača, pad pozitivnih mišljenja ne može doći u gore vrijeme za demokrate.' article_content: Ohio is now among the states that have legalized recreational marijuana, following the successful passage of Issue 2 in Tuesday’s voting. Preliminary results showed Issue 2 with a 55.6% majority, leading outlets like CNN to call the result. As the 24th state to legalize adult-use cannabis, Ohio also passed a constitutional amendment safeguarding reproductive rights, which contributed to high voter engagement. Early voting was open from October 11 to November 5. With Issue 2, adults 21 and over can legally possess up to 2.5 ounces of cannabis and 15 grams of concentrates. They may also grow up to six cannabis plants each, or a maximum of twelve per household. A new Division of Cannabis Control will be responsible for licensing, regulation, enforcement, and oversight of commercial cannabis operations and laboratories. Cannabis purchases will be taxed at 10%, with funds allocated to regulation, substance use treatment, and social equity efforts. Projections from MJBizDaily estimate the adult-use market could be worth up to $2 billion annually, yielding roughly $260 million in net public benefits per year. Municipalities housing dispensaries will receive a portion of tax revenue. Some business licenses will be reserved for individuals from communities previously hit hardest by marijuana enforcement. Leaders in the industry, such as Pete Gallagher of Insa, described the vote as a landmark for inclusivity, regulation, economic progress, and community development. Advocacy groups like the Last Prisoner Project welcomed the reforms but pointed out that automatic expungement for old cannabis convictions was not included, urging lawmakers to deliver comprehensive relief. Despite the result, some Republicans — notably Senate President Matt Huffman — have discussed reviewing or modifying Issue 2, raising concerns about long-term mental health and social effects, although full repeal was not advocated.

Preliminarni rezultati pokazali su da je Issue 2 dobio 55,6% glasova, zbog čega su mediji poput CNN-a objavili projekciju rezultata. Kao 24. država koja je legalizirala kanabis za odrasle, Ohio je također izglasao ustavni amandman kojim se štite reproduktivna prava, što je pridonijelo velikoj izlaznosti birača. Prijevremeno glasanje trajalo je od 11. listopada do 5. studenoga. Prema Issue 2, odrasli od 21 godine i više mogu legalno posjedovati do 70 grama kanabisa i 15 grama koncentrata. Također smiju uzgajati do šest biljaka po osobi, odnosno najviše dvanaest po kućanstvu. Nova Uprava za kontrolu kanabisa bit će zadužena za licenciranje, reguliranje, nadzor i kontrolu komercijalnog poslovanja i laboratorija za testiranje kanabisa. Kupnja kanabisa bit će oporezovana s 10%, a sredstva će se usmjeriti na regulaciju, programe za liječenje ovisnosti i inicijative društvene jednakosti. Prema procjeni MJBizDailyja, tržište za odrasle moglo bi vrijediti do dvije milijarde dolara godišnje, uz otprilike 260 milijuna dolara neto javnih koristi godišnje. Općine u kojima se nalaze prodavaonice kanabisa dobit će dio poreznih prihoda. Određene poslovne licence bit će namijenjene osobama iz zajednica koje su najviše pogođene prethodnom represijom marihuane. Čelnici industrije, poput Petea Gallaghera iz tvrtke Insa, opisali su glasovanje kao važan korak prema uključivosti, regulaciji, ekonomskom napretku i razvoju zajednice. Zagovaračke organizacije poput Last Prisoner Projecta pozdravile su reforme, ali su istaknule kako automatsko brisanje starih osuda za kanabis nije uključeno, te pozivaju zakonodavce da pruže sveobuhvatnu pomoć. Unatoč rezultatu, neki republikanci — posebno predsjednik Senata Matt Huffman — najavili su preispitivanje ili izmjene Issue 2, izražavajući zabrinutost zbog dugoročnog utjecaja na mentalno zdravlje i društvo, iako se nisu zalagali za potpuno ukidanje.

article_content: BELLEVUE, Nebraska (CNN) -- Dr. LeRoy Carhart's abortion clinic in Bellevue, Nebraska, faces increased security concerns this weekend as anti-abortion protesters plan demonstrations outside his facility. "I feel safer on an airplane than I do in my clinic," Carhart said in his windowless office. "You try to anticipate every possible threat and do all you can to prevent it, but clearly, Dr. George Tiller thought he was safe in church." Nearly three months ago, Dr. Tiller, one of the most prominent doctors performing abortions, was killed at Reformation Lutheran Church in Wichita, Kansas. Anti-abortion groups, led by Operation Rescue, have organized protests this weekend outside Carhart's clinic. These are the first major anti-abortion protests since Dr. Tiller’s death. The demonstrations are expected to peak on Saturday with so-called 'Truth Trucks'—vehicles displaying large images protesting abortion—stationed outside the clinic and in nearby neighborhoods. Protesters with anti-abortion signs are also anticipated. Troy Newman, president of Operation Rescue, has promised the demonstrations will be peaceful, saying that any suggestions of possible violence are exaggerated by, in his words, left-leaning groups and the media. The group reduced planned activities at Carhart’s facility on Friday upon learning that women’s rights groups, including the National Organization for Women, would be present. Instead, Operation Rescue will hold a rally at a church. Katherine Spillar, executive vice president of the Feminist Majority Foundation, expressed concern, stating, "Operation Rescue has said Dr. Carhart is the next target. We worry that these activities could lead to violence, and we urge the community to prevent that from happening." On Friday morning, abortion rights supporters formed the majority of a crowd of roughly 50-75 people outside Carhart’s clinic. Some greeted arriving vehicles with chants of support, such as, "Welcome, welcome, this clinic stays open." Newman reiterated his intent to avoid any situations that could provoke conflict and said, "I'm very confident about our side. They’re peaceful moms, dads, and families with signs." He condemned Dr. Tiller’s murder, saying, "Shooting someone in the head in a church is not a pro-life act." Scott Roeder, an anti-abortion activist, has been charged in Dr. Tiller’s death and has pleaded not guilty. Newman said he hopes to see Carhart’s clinic closed through legal means and expressed confidence his organization could have closed Dr. Tiller’s facility through court battles. He stated, "I vehemently disagreed with what Mr. Tiller did, as well as all abortion providers, but they are still human beings who deserve due process." Dr. Tiller was one of a small number of U.S. physicians performing late-term abortions. Following his death, his family decided to shut down his clinic permanently. Dr. Carhart, a close friend and former colleague of Tiller, performed abortions at Tiller’s clinic one week each month, including late-term procedures. He has pledged to open an office in Kansas and to continue providing abortion services as long as he is able. Carhart reports having performed over 60,000 abortions in the past two decades, about 400 of which were after 24 weeks of pregnancy. Reflecting on Dr. Tiller, Carhart said, "I don't want his death to be in vain. He devoted his life to improving women's health care." Carhart learned of Tiller’s death while performing a procedure, receiving the news by phone from Tiller's head nurse. Carhart distinguishes himself from many abortion providers, openly discussing his profession. The exterior of his office reads ‘Abortion & Contraception Clinic of Nebraska’ in bold letters. He said, "I do abortions—this is what I do." On Friday, Carhart became emotional while speaking about the support he received from abortion rights advocates outside his clinic. "It's unbelievable," he said. Mark Gietzen, a driver for Operation Rescue, prepared for the protests in Wichita with a truck featuring a poster and anti-abortion messaging. He recalled knowing Tiller from years of protests and said Tiller’s killing was a setback for "pro-lifers." Gietzen described a previous encounter with Carhart involving a humorous gesture, which Carhart acknowledged. Gietzen’s message to Carhart was, "Please respect the lives of babies. Stop performing abortions for money." Newman similarly said he hopes Carhart will return to other areas of medicine. Carhart remains firm in his beliefs: "When they're ready to accept our position, we’ll talk. We believe in choice. If you don’t want an abortion, don’t have one." The debate continues in Nebraska and Kansas, with both sides deeply entrenched and little room for compromise.
translated_content: BELLEVUE, Nebraska (CNN) -- Klinika dr. LeRoya Carharta za pobačaje u Bellevueu, Nebraska, suočava se s pojačanim sigurnosnim mjerama ovog vikenda jer protivnici pobačaja planiraju prosvjede ispred njegove ustanove. "Osjećam se sigurnije u avionu nego u svojoj klinici", rekao je Carhart u svom uredu bez prozora. "Pokušavate predvidjeti svaku moguću prijetnju i učiniti sve da to spriječite, ali očito je i dr. George Tiller mislio da je siguran u crkvi." Prije gotovo tri mjeseca, dr. Tiller, jedan od najpoznatijih liječnika koji su obavljali pobačaje, ubijen je u crkvi Reformation Lutheran u Wichiti, Kansas. Protivnici pobačaja, predvođeni organizacijom Operation Rescue, organizirali su prosvjede ovog vikenda ispred Carhartove klinike. To su prvi veliki prosvjedi protiv pobačaja od Tillerove smrti. Prosvjedi bi trebali doseći vrhunac u subotu, kada će tzv. 'Truth Trucks'—vozila s velikim slikama protiv pobačaja—biti ispred klinike i u obližnjim četvrtima. Očekuju se i prosvjednici s transparentima protiv pobačaja. Troy Newman, predsjednik Operation Rescue, najavio je da će prosvjedi biti mirni te rekao da su svi nagovještaji mogućeg nasilja pretjerani i, kako on kaže, dolaze od lijevo orijentiranih grupa i medija. Grupa je smanjila aktivnosti kod Carhartove klinike u petak kad su saznali da će tamo biti i ženske udruge, uključujući Nacionalnu organizaciju za žene. Zbog toga će Operation Rescue održati skup u crkvi. Katherine Spillar, izvršna potpredsjednica Feminističke većinske fondacije, izrazila je zabrinutost: "Operation Rescue je rekao da je dr. Carhart sljedeća meta. Brinemo se da te aktivnosti mogu dovesti do nasilja i pozivamo zajednicu da to spriječi." U petak ujutro, pristaše prava na pobačaj činile su većinu među otprilike 50-75 ljudi ispred Carhartove klinike. Neki su ohrabrivali vozače automobila koji su ulazili u kliniku uzvikujući: "Dobrodošli, dobrodošli, ova klinika ostaje otvorena." Newman je ponovio da želi izbjeći bilo kakve situacije koje bi mogle izazvati sukob te je dodao: "Vrlo sam siguran u našu stranu. To su miroljubive mame, tate i obitelji s transparentima." Osudio je Tillerovo ubojstvo rekavši: "Upucati nekoga u glavu u crkvi nije pro-life čin." Scott Roeder, protivnik pobačaja, optužen je za Tillerovu smrt i izjasnio se da nije kriv. Newman je izjavio da se nada kako će Carhartovu kliniku zatvoriti pravnim putem te vjeruje kako bi njegova organizacija sudski zatvorila i Tillerovu kliniku. Kazao je: "Oštro se ne slažem s onim što je gospodin Tiller radio, kao i svi liječnici koji rade pobačaje, ali oni su ipak ljudi koji zaslužuju pravni postupak." Dr. Tiller bio je jedan od malobrojnih američkih liječnika koji su obavljali kasne pobačaje. Nakon njegove smrti, obitelj je odlučila trajno zatvoriti kliniku. Dr. Carhart, blizak prijatelj i bivši kolega Tillera, radio je u Tillerovoj klinici jedan tjedan svakog mjeseca, obavljajući i kasne pobačaje. Obećao je otvoriti ordinaciju u Kansasu i nastaviti pružati usluge pobačaja sve dok bude mogao. Carhart tvrdi da je u posljednja dva desetljeća obavio više od 60.000 pobačaja, od čega oko 400 nakon 24. tjedna trudnoće. Prisjećajući se Tillera, Carhart je rekao: "Ne želim da njegova smrt bude uzaludna. Posvetio je život poboljšanju zdravstvene skrbi za žene." Carhart je vijest o Tillerovoj smrti primio dok je radio zahvat, kada mu je to priopćila Tillerova glavna sestra. Carhart se razlikuje od mnogih drugih liječnika za pobačaje po tome što otvoreno govori o svom poslu. Izvana na njegovoj klinici u velikim slovima piše ‘Abortion & Contraception Clinic of Nebraska’. Rekao je: "Radim pobačaje—time se bavim." U petak je Carhart bio vidno dirnut podrškom koju je dobio od pristaša prava na pobačaj ispred klinike. "Nevjerojatno je," rekao je. Mark Gietzen, vozač za Operation Rescue, pripremao se za prosvjede u Wichiti s kamionom na kojem su bili plakati i poruke protiv pobačaja. Prisjetio se da je poznavao Tillera godinama tijekom prosvjeda i rekao kako je Tillerovo ubojstvo predstavljalo korak unazad za "pro-life" pokret. Gietzen je opisao i prijašnji susret s Carhartom, u kojem mu je on uputio humorističnu gestu, što je Carhart potvrdio. Gietzenova poruka Carhartu bila je: "Molim Vas, poštujte živote beba. Prestanite s pobačajima radi novca." Newman je također rekao da se nada kako će se Carhart vratiti drugim granama medicine. Carhart čvrsto stoji pri svojim uvjerenjima: "Kad budu spremni prihvatiti naše stajalište, razgovarat ćemo. Vjerujemo u izbor. Ako ne želite imati pobačaj, nemojte ga imati." Rasprava se nastavlja u Nebraski i Kansasu, a obje strane su čvrsto ukopane u svoje stavove i malo je prostora za kompromis.

article_content: When his beloved wife of just five weeks passed away from cancer, Phillip Topham was determined to keep her close. He requested special planning permission from his local council to bury Catherine Hooper in the front garden of their home. Mr. Topham, 56, a bricklayer from Colwick, Nottingham, had been with Catherine, 57, for 18 years. Despite her diagnosis with aggressive oesophageal cancer, they married at West Bridgford Register Office in October, just weeks before her death at Nottingham City Hospital. Following Catherine's passing last Thursday, Mr. Topham began preparing her grave in their front garden, where they had lived together for 14 years. Gedling Borough Council granted him special planning permission, allowing the private burial. The couple had discussed Catherine's wishes before her death. Mr. Topham explained he wanted his wife close to him, and she had no objections to being buried at home. He expressed that their home was full of treasured memories: 'She is my sweetheart and I want her close to me always. I don't want her to be away from me or buried among strangers.' While the decision is unusual and may impact the property's value, Mr. Topham said some in the community were supportive, describing his choice as 'lovely.' He noted that Catherine was well liked and expected many people to attend her funeral. In the UK, private burials on personal property require checking with the Land Registry, Environment Agency, and local authority. The Environment Agency states that burial on private land is allowed, provided an authorisation form is completed. Health and safety requirements include minimum distances from water sources and ensuring the grave is deep enough to prevent animals from disturbing it. The grave's location must be recorded in the property deeds. A spokesperson for Gedling Borough Council confirmed all checks were completed and that public health, planning, and legal services were satisfied with the arrangements. Authorities also advise consulting one’s mortgage provider before pursuing a private burial. The burial must conform to specific legal standards, such as minimum soil depth above the coffin and safety measures for open graves. Officials also recommend preparing adequately for privacy and public safety during the burial process.

article_content: Microsoft is facing backlash after using AI to create an insensitive poll speculating on the cause of a woman's death, which was published alongside an article from The Guardian on Microsoft Start, its news aggregation service. The article covered the death of a 21-year-old water polo coach in Sydney, Australia, who was found dead at her school with significant head injuries. The accompanying poll asked readers, 'What do you think is the reason behind the woman's death?' with options: murder, accident, or suicide. Many readers mistakenly associated the poll with The Guardian’s journalist and called for the reporter’s dismissal, although the journalist was not involved in creating the poll. The Guardian claims it has suffered significant reputational damage from the incident. Guardian Media Group CEO Anna Bateson outlined her concerns about the AI-generated poll in a letter to Microsoft's president, Brad Smith. She stated the incident was potentially distressing for the family of the victim, and that it harmed both The Guardian's reputation and that of the journalists who reported the story. "This is clearly an inappropriate use of generative AI by Microsoft on a potentially distressing public interest story originally written and published by Guardian journalists," she wrote. In response to the backlash, Microsoft deactivated AI-generated polls for all news articles, promised to investigate the incident, and pledged to prevent similar situations in the future.

Članak se bavio smrću 21-godišnje trenerice vaterpola u Sydneyju, Australija, koja je pronađena mrtva u svojoj školi s ozbiljnim ozljedama glave. Kao odgovor na kritike, Microsoft je deaktivirao AI-ankete za sve vijesti, obećao istražiti incident i spriječiti slične situacije u budućnosti.

article_content:
Many UK shoppers were stunned to learn that leading supermarkets such as Tesco, Lidl, Iceland, and Aldi had been selling beef burgers found to contain horse meat. This discovery was unexpected, especially since these retailers often highlight their high standards, strict quality controls, and traceable sourcing in their advertising. Yet, this incident questions the reliability of those claims.

The scale and industrial nature of supermarket food supply play a major role in such issues. Big retailers push their suppliers to cut costs, which frequently results in compromised ingredient quality and production shortcuts. Processed meat products like economy burgers are especially vulnerable to adulteration, as their ingredients are less visible and more difficult for consumers to verify.

While horse meat consumption is frowned upon in the UK and other English-speaking countries—where horses are seen more as companions—countries like France, Italy, Japan, and Kazakhstan consider horse meat a normal part of their diets. For example, Edinburgh’s L’Escargot Bleu restaurant has served horse steak for years, always making it clear to customers what they’re receiving. The controversy here centers on the absence of clear labeling: consumers believed they were purchasing beef, not an undisclosed mix.

Regulators affirm that eating horse meat is not a health risk, but mislabeling it as beef is misleading. Some products have even tested positive for pig DNA, which is a significant issue for consumers observing religious dietary rules. Food safety checks often depend on suppliers' written assurances rather than regular third-party inspections, a situation made worse by government budget cuts and retailers' reluctance to take on extra costs.

Author Joanna Blythman sees this scandal as a symptom of an over-industrialized, price-focused supply chain. She argues that people would be better served by supporting local butchers and suppliers, whose offerings are more transparent and trustworthy. Despite supermarkets’ attempts to reassure the public, repeated incidents like this have damaged shoppers’ faith in major retailers.

Ovo je otkriće bilo neočekivano, osobito jer trgovci često ističu svoje visoke standarde, stroge kontrole kvalitete i mogućnost praćenja podrijetla u svojim reklamama. Ipak, ovaj slučaj dovodi u pitanje vjerodostojnost tih tvrdnji.

Veliki razmjeri i industrijska narav opskrbe hranom u supermarketima ključni su čimbenici u nastanku ovakvih problema. Veliki trgovci pritišću svoje dobavljače da smanje cijene, što često dovodi do kompromitiranih sastojaka i skraćenih proizvodnih procesa. Prerađeni mesni proizvodi, poput jeftinih hamburgera, posebno su podložni patvorenju jer su njihovi sastojci manje vidljivi i teži za provjeriti potrošačima.

Dok je konzumacija konjskog mesa u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu i drugim engleskim zemljama tabu—konji se najčešće smatraju kućnim ljubimcima—u Francuskoj, Italiji, Japanu i Kazahstanu konjsko meso je uobičajeno jelo. Na primjer, restoran L’Escargot Bleu iz Edinburgha godinama nudi konjski odrezak, uvijek jasno informirajući goste o tome što naručuju. Ovdje je problem što nema jasnog označavanja: kupci su mislili da kupuju govedinu, a zapravo su dobili mješavinu.

Regulatori tvrde da konjsko meso ne predstavlja zdravstveni rizik, ali njegovo prodavanje pod oznakom govedine je zavaravajuće. Neki proizvodi sadržavali su i tragove svinjske DNK, što je poseban problem za one s vjerskim prehrambenim ograničenjima. Kontrole sigurnosti hrane često ovise o izjavama samih dobavljača, a ne o neovisnim inspekcijama, što dodatno otežavaju rezanja državnog proračuna i nevoljkost trgovaca da plate dodatne provjere.

Autorica Joanna Blythman smatra da je ovaj skandal odraz previše industrijaliziranog i na cijenu orijentiranog lanca opskrbe hranom. Vjeruje da bi potrošači bolje prošli kupujući od lokalnih mesara i dobavljača, čija je ponuda transparentnija i pouzdanija. Unatoč nastojanjima supermarketa da umire javnost, ovakvi slučajevi narušavaju povjerenje kupaca u velike trgovce.

article_content: Iraq’s ancient Marshes are filled with tales of the Tantal, a mythological trickster delighted by its mischief. The Middle East teems with stories of spirits and their antics, passed down from elders to children as both entertainment and warning. Today, Al Jazeera shares some of these stories, which reveal the fears, dreams, and values of the culture. In Iraq, the mysterious Marshes resonate with stories of the Tantal—an elusive creature said to shape-shift from human to animal, or even into objects. The Tantal embodies mischief, often luring people into strange encounters. If you meet a stranger in flamboyant clothing in the Marshes, legend says it could be a Tantal. If you admire its outfit, the creature might befriend you or grant you wealth; if you scoff, you risk its wrath and madness. Local people describe the Tantal as a night-dweller, a guardian of hidden treasures, and a spirit quick to trap the unwary, especially children. The Tantal’s true form is terrifying, with vertical, cat-like eyes and long, sharp teeth in a formless face atop a giant, shuffling body. However, it usually disguises itself as a man, woman, child, cat, or dog to approach its victims. These tales serve as warnings, with parents telling children that defiance could lead to being dragged into the Marshes’ depths by the Tantal. Each named Tantal is linked to specific areas, such as Tantal Abu Ghraib, Tantal Umm al-Ubaid, Tantal Abu Asmej, Tantal Dawar, Tantal Salin, and Tantal Hafiz, who is considered the leader of the Tantals. The legend traces back to Hafiz himself, whose story passed through generations in southern Iraq. In ancient times, two great kingdoms in southern Mesopotamia—ruled by Al-Akr and Abu Shadhar, with their brother Hafiz—prospered. They built grand cities, temples, and orchards, and raised barriers to protect against flooding. However, their prosperity led them astray; they neglected their devotion to God. According to legend, God’s anger brought earthquakes and floods, destroying the kingdoms. Only ruins remained, and God sent the Tantals and Jinn to guard what was left, including treasures buried beneath the Marshes. Through fear and cunning, the Tantals have kept people away from these hidden riches for centuries. But some stories say that if you befriend a Tantal, it may share visions of the future. Iraqi filmmaker Yassir Kareem once spoke to an elderly Marshes resident who claimed the Tantal visited him in a dream. The Tantal predicted the land would dry up and outsiders would drive locals away—a prophecy the man saw coming true due to climate change and the arrival of foreign oil companies in Iraq’s Marshes.
translated_content: Drevne iračke močvare prepune su priča o Tantalu, mitološkom prevarantu koji uživa u svojim smicalicama. Bliski istok obiluje pričama o duhovima i njihovim nepodopštinama, koje se prenose sa starijih na djecu kao zabava i opomena. Danas Al Jazeera donosi neke od tih priča, otkrivajući strahove, snove i vrijednosti ove kulture. U Iraku, tajnovite močvare odzvanjaju pričama o Tantalu—neuhvatljivom biću za kojeg se kaže da može mijenjati obličje iz čovjeka u životinju ili čak u predmete. Tantal utjelovljuje nestašluk i često navodi ljude na čudne susrete. Ako sretnete stranca u blještavoj odjeći u močvarama, legenda kaže da bi to mogao biti Tantal. Ako mu pohvalite odjeću, mogao bi vas smatrati prijateljem ili nagraditi bogatstvom; ako ismijete, riskirate njegov gnjev i ludilo. Mještani Tantala opisuju kao stvorenje noći, čuvara skrivenih blaga i duha koji brzo zamku postavlja neopreznima, posebno djeci. Pravo lice Tantala je zastrašujuće: okomite, mačje oči i dugi, oštri zubi na bezobličnom licu iznad džinovskog, šepavog tijela. Ipak, obično se prerušava u muškarca, ženu, dijete, mačku ili psa kako bi prišao svojim žrtvama. Ove priče služe kao upozorenja, a roditelji djecu uče da prkos može dovesti do toga da ih Tantal povuče u dubinu močvare. Svaki imenovani Tantal povezan je s određenim područjem, poput Tantala Abu Ghraib, Tantala Umm al-Ubaid, Tantala Abu Asmej, Tantala Dawar, Tantala Salin i Tantala Hafiza, koji se smatra vođom svih Tantala. Legenda vodi do samog Hafiza, čija se priča prenosi generacijama južnog Iraka. U davna vremena, dva velika kraljevstva u južnoj Mezopotamiji—kojima su vladali Al-Akr i Abu Shadhar, uz brata Hafiza—bila su napredna. Gradili su veličanstvene gradove, hramove i voćnjake te dizali brane protiv poplava. No bogatstvo ih je odvelo na stranputicu; zanemarili su odanost Bogu. Prema legendi, Božja se srdžba spustila u obliku potresa i poplava, uništivši kraljevstva. Ostale su samo ruševine, a Bog je poslao Tantale i džine da čuvaju ono što je ostalo, uključujući skrivena blaga pod močvarama. Kroz strah i lukavstva, Tantali stoljećima odvraćaju ljude od tih skrivenih blaga. Neke priče kažu da, ako steknete prijateljstvo Tantala, možda će vam otkriti vizije budućnosti. Irački redatelj Yassir Kareem razgovarao je sa starcem iz močvara, koji tvrdi da ga je Tantal posjetio u snu. Tantal mu je prorokovao da će zemlja presušiti, a doći će stranci i otjerati lokalce—proročanstvo koje je starac vidio kao ispunjeno zbog klimatskih promjena i dolaska stranih naftnih kompanija u iračke močvare.

A man and woman from Michigan were each sentenced to four years in prison on Friday after being convicted of attempting to extort $680,000 from 'Glee' actor John Stamos. Scott Edward Sippola, 31, and Allison Lenore Coss, 24, threatened to sell compromising photos of Stamos, though a federal prosecutor stated that such photos never existed. U.S. District Judge R. Allan Edgar presided over the case in Marquette.

The pair faced up to nine years for conspiracy and interstate communications with intent to extort. During the hearing, prosecutors read a statement from Stamos in which he said he had been slandered and his reputation damaged. The judge determined their actions were not simply a 'foolish lark.'

In a pre-sentence statement, Sippola admitted his actions were wrong and motivated by the desire for financial gain, saying he tried to exploit the weaknesses of a stranger for his own benefit. Prosecutors explained that Sippola and Coss sent about 40 emails to Stamos, threatening to sell the photos to tabloids if he refused to pay.

FBI agents monitored Stamos' email and eventually communicated with the defendants by phone, posing as Stamos' business manager. Sippola and Coss were arrested in December 2009 at a pre-arranged airport drop-off where the exchange was supposed to occur.

The defense raised allegations that Stamos had previously had a fling with Coss when she was 17 during a 2004 spring break trip, but Stamos denied any inappropriate behavior. Prosecutors said Stamos and Coss met at Disney World in Orlando and occasionally emailed until November 2009, when Stamos reported the extortion attempt to the FBI. Coss testified there were photos of Stamos using cocaine and claimed he was interested in buying them, but Stamos said no such photos existed.

Before sentencing, Coss filed a letter asking for a lighter sentence, describing herself as a good person who acted out of character. The filing noted that she mistakenly believed asking for money to suppress the pictures was a legitimate business transaction. Efforts by CNN to reach the defense attorneys on Friday were unsuccessful.

Obrana je iznijela tvrdnje da je Stamos imao aferu s Coss kada je imala 17 godina tijekom proljetnih praznika 2004., ali Stamos je negirao bilo kakvo neprikladno ponašanje. Prije izricanja presude, Coss je poslala pismo u kojem traži manju kaznu, predstavljajući se kao dobra osoba koja je postupila izvan svog karaktera. U podnesku se navodi kako je pogrešno vjerovala da je traženje novca za sprječavanje prodaje fotografija legitimna poslovna transakcija. CNN-ovi pokušaji kontaktiranja odvjetnika obrane u petak nisu bili uspješni.

article_content: Toronto Mayor Rob Ford has rejected allegations that he used crack cocaine, after media reports claimed a video showed him smoking the drug. Ford stated at a press conference that he has never used crack cocaine, nor is he an addict, and that he cannot comment on a video he has not seen or that may not exist. He noted the impact of the controversy on his family and Toronto residents. The allegations surfaced following news stories from the Toronto Star and Gawker, which reported viewing a video that allegedly depicts Ford with a glass pipe. The video, which was said to have been offered to media outlets for a substantial sum, has neither been released publicly nor independently verified. Faced with increasing demands for openness from city officials, Ford received a letter from members of his executive committee urging him to directly address the accusations so city business could proceed. The public pressure came amid Ford's abrupt dismissal of his chief of staff, Mark Towhey. Reports connect the firing to Towhey's recommendation that Ford seek assistance, though other officials assert it was unrelated to the scandal. Separately, Ford was removed as the coach of the Don Bosco Eagles high school football team after comments he made during a TV interview upset some parents. The Toronto Catholic District School Board said this decision was not connected to the ongoing scandal. Ford, no stranger to controversy since his election as mayor in 2010, called the crack cocaine allegations 'ridiculous' and reiterated his belief that some media outlets are intent on harming his reputation. His lawyer, Dennis Morris, reported they are investigating the video's existence and whether it may have been manipulated. Media accounts have also reported claims that the video contains a racist remark by Ford, but neither the video’s existence nor its contents have been confirmed.

article_content: During the Dubai Air Show, Emirates revealed it will postpone a significant order of Airbus A350 jets, citing worries about the maintenance and performance of Rolls Royce engines. This development is a setback for Airbus, particularly as Emirates President Tim Clark voiced reservations regarding the engines. Emirates had recently committed $52 billion to a Boeing order, while its affiliate FlyDubai secured an additional $11 billion agreement with Boeing. Ethiopian Airlines announced a purchase of 31 Boeing aircraft, featuring 20 737 MAX jets, showing renewed confidence in the model after a fatal 2019 crash led to its global grounding. Airbus has not yet announced major deals at the event, despite a rebound in travel demand since the pandemic. Clark stressed that Emirates must place aircraft orders early due to lengthy delivery times, which are crucial for its planned network expansions. He also noted that current regional conflicts, such as the Israel-Hamas war, have not disrupted Emirates’ core operations, though flights to Tel Aviv have been temporarily halted. Riyadh Air of Saudi Arabia is pursuing aggressive fleet expansion as part of broader national investment goals. Clark was unconcerned about this new competition, highlighting Emirates’ long history of growing amid geopolitical and economic uncertainty. Anticipating COP28, the aviation sector faces increased scrutiny over environmental concerns. Emirates recently ran a successful Boeing 777 test using sustainable aviation fuel (SAF) and has expanded SAF use to regular flights. However, Clark acknowledged that fully decarbonizing aviation is a long-term and difficult process. Other air show highlights included Emirates' $1.2 billion deal with France’s Safran, plans for a $950 million maintenance center, EgyptAir’s purchase of 10 Airbus A350-900 jets, and Kazakhstan’s SCAT Airlines ordering seven Boeing 737 MAX planes. Ethiopian Airlines’ agreement, with options for additional purchases, marks Africa’s largest Boeing order, with its CEO expressing confidence in the redesigned MAX’s safety.

article_content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to inaugurate the second edition of World Food India 2023 on Friday at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi. The event will commence at 10 a.m. in Bharat Mandapam. In a move aimed at strengthening Self Help Groups (SHGs), the Prime Minister will disburse seed capital assistance to over one lakh SHG members. According to an official statement from the Prime Minister’s Office, this support is intended to help SHGs secure better prices in the market through improved packaging and quality manufacturing. Modi will also open ‘Food Street,’ a feature of World Food India 2023 that showcases regional cuisines and India’s royal culinary heritage. Over 200 chefs will participate, presenting traditional Indian cuisine in a distinctive culinary experience. The event emphasizes India's ambition to position itself as the 'food basket of the world' and commemorates 2023 as the International Year of Millets. World Food India 2023 provides a networking and business platform for government agencies, industry professionals, farmers, entrepreneurs, and other stakeholders. Participants will have opportunities to discuss industry topics, build partnerships, and explore investments in the agri-food sector. Key activities include CEOs roundtables focused on investment and Ease of Doing Business, various pavilions highlighting Indian food processing innovations, and 48 sessions covering themes such as financial empowerment, quality assurance, and advances in technology. More than 80 countries are expected to participate, including CEOs of leading food processing companies and over 1,200 international buyers. The event also features a Reverse Buyer Seller Meet. The Netherlands is the partner country, while Japan is the focus country. In other news: India’s top telecommunications companies have alleged that tech majors like Microsoft and Amazon may be bypassing telecom regulations by using WhatsApp and other unregulated platforms for business messaging, possibly resulting in an annual revenue loss of ₹3,000 crore to both the government and telecom providers. Separately, the Indian government has asked Apple to join an investigation into alleged state-sponsored hacking attempts on iPhones belonging to prominent Indians, including some Members of Parliament. The Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) informed the Delhi High Court that leased aircraft and engines of the bankrupt airline Go First can be deregistered and returned to lessors, negatively impacting the airline’s revival prospects.

article_content: In the United Kingdom, activists opposed to the Iraq War are drawing comparisons to past conflicts as they call on the government to push for an end to the bombing campaign in Gaza. On Thursday, a group of young British trade unionists blocked access to Instro Precision Ltd, a Kent-based subsidiary of Elbit Systems that produces equipment for the Israeli military. This protest brought together over a hundred teachers, academics, healthcare workers, and others, who displayed banners declaring support for Palestine and urging the UK to stop selling weapons to Israel. These actions are part of a broader movement, with protests occurring nationwide—including a London demonstration attended by around 100,000 supporters of Palestine on October 21. Protesters have voiced their dissatisfaction with the British government’s unwavering support for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. Jeanine Hourani from the Palestinian Youth Movement accused both the UK government and Western media of contributing to the situation in Gaza. Despite strong public opposition and the historical context of the 1917 Balfour Declaration, the UK government has declined to press Israel to end its military actions. In the aftermath of the October 7 Hamas attacks that killed 1,400 Israelis, Israel responded with airstrikes on Gaza that have resulted in over 7,000 deaths, including many children. Prime Minister Rishi Sunak, alongside leaders like Joe Biden and Emmanuel Macron, has firmly supported Israel’s right to retaliate. Human rights group Amnesty International has accused Israel of launching attacks that resulted in high civilian casualties and says some actions may constitute war crimes. Chris Doyle from the Council for Arab-British Understanding observed a modest change in government rhetoric, with officials now acknowledging humanitarian issues, though still stopping short of advocating for a ceasefire or criticizing Israeli tactics. Welsh councillor and pro-Palestinian campaigner Carrie Harper expressed disappointment at what she regards as a lack of leadership and failure to advocate for peace. Ben Jamal, director of the Palestine Solidarity Campaign, stated that while large protests rarely lead to immediate policy shifts, they are important for building momentum for future change. Referencing his experience during the 2003 Iraq War protests, Jamal emphasized that such movements have a lasting impact, even if their immediate aims are not realized. Some campaigners are concerned about restrictions on their right to protest. UK Home Secretary Suella Braverman has instructed police to take tougher measures against pro-Palestinian protests and described some slogans as anti-Semitic. Despite these challenges, further demonstrations, including another major rally in London on October 28, are planned. Jamal concluded that ongoing protests deliver a crucial message of solidarity to Palestinians: significant segments of the British public oppose current government policies and are determined to continue advocating for change.

U četvrtak je skupina mladih britanskih sindikalista blokirala pristup poduzeću Instro Precision Ltd, podružnici Elbit Systemsa iz Kenta koja proizvodi opremu za izraelsku vojsku. Ovom su se protestu pridružile stotine učitelja, akademika, zdravstvenih djelatnika i drugih, ističući transparente u znak podrške Palestini i pozivajući UK da prekine prodaju oružja Izraelu. Ove aktivnosti dio su šireg pokreta, s prosvjedima diljem zemlje – uključujući okupljanje u Londonu kojem je 21. listopada prisustvovalo oko 100.000 pristaša Palestine. Prosvjednici izražavaju nezadovoljstvo zbog nepopustljive podrške britanske vlade izraelskom premijeru Benjaminu Netanyahuu. Jeanine Hourani iz Palestinian Youth Movementa optužila je i britansku vladu i zapadne medije za doprinos situaciji u Gazi. Unatoč snažnom protivljenju javnosti i povijesnom kontekstu Balfourove deklaracije iz 1917., britanska vlada je odbila izvršiti pritisak na Izrael da zaustavi svoje vojne akcije. Nakon napada Hamasa 7. listopada u kojem je poginulo 1.400 Izraelaca, Izrael je uzvratio zračnim napadima na Gazu u kojima je poginulo više od 7.000 osoba, uključujući mnogo djece. Premijer Rishi Sunak, zajedno s liderima poput Joea Bidena i Emmanuela Macrona, čvrsto podržava pravo Izraela na uzvrat. Organizacija za ljudska prava Amnesty International optužila je Izrael za napade koji su doveli do visokih civilnih žrtava i navodi kako su neki postupci možda ratni zločini. Chris Doyle iz Vijeća za arapsko-britansko razumijevanje primjećuje manju promjenu u retorici vlade — sada se priznaju humanitarni problemi, ali još uvijek nema zagovora za prekid vatre ni kritike izraelskih postupaka. Velška vijećnica i pro-palestinska aktivistica Carrie Harper izrazila je razočaranje zbog, kako smatra, nedostatka vodstva i izostanka poziva na mir. Ben Jamal, direktor Palestine Solidarity Campaigna, navodi kako masovni prosvjedi rijetko dovode do trenutnih političkih promjena, ali su važni za stvaranje pokreta za buduće promjene. Prisjećajući se svog sudjelovanja u prosvjedima protiv rata u Iraku 2003., naglašava da takvi pokreti ostavljaju trajan utjecaj i ako se trenutni ciljevi ne ostvare. Neki aktivisti brinu o ograničavanju prava na prosvjed. Britanska ministrica unutarnjih poslova Suella Braverman naložila je policiji strože postupanje prema pro-palestinskim prosvjedima te je neke slogane opisala kao antisemitske. Unatoč tome, najavljeni su daljnji prosvjedi, uključujući veliko okupljanje u Londonu 28. listopada. Jamal je zaključio da prosvjedi šalju ključnu poruku solidarnosti Palestincima: značajan dio britanske javnosti protivi se aktualnoj politici vlade i odlučan je nastaviti zalagati se za promjene.
