article_content: When Margaret Pabst Battin's husband, Brooke Hopkins, suffered a cycling accident that left him almost completely paralyzed, Battin was confronted with her scholarly beliefs on the right to die in a deeply personal way. Battin, a University of Utah professor and international leader in the euthanasia movement, has spent her career studying and advocating for the right of terminally ill and severely injured individuals to choose death. In 2008, 66-year-old Brooke Hopkins was cycling in City Creek Canyon, Utah, when he collided with another bicyclist, causing an accident that severed his spinal cord. Although he had updated his living will a year earlier to state he did not want treatment to artificially prolong his life should he be in a vegetative state, emergency responders, unaware of his wishes, kept him alive and placed him on a ventilator. Battin, known as Peggy, has written extensively on issues of assisted suicide and the right to a dignified death, inspired partly by witnessing her mother’s painful death from liver cancer at age 21. She remains committed to the right of self-determination—even at life’s end—but her husband’s injury revealed emotional and ethical complexities she had not anticipated, including her reluctance to let go and his desire to stay because he knows she doesn’t want him to go. Before his accident, Hopkins was known as a lively, adventurous individual with a love for literature and teaching as a professor at the University of Utah. Now, Hopkins faces both good days and difficult ones. In July 2012, enduring unbearable pain, he dictated a 'Final Letter' to his loved ones, expressing he had reached his limit and his will to live was waning. Battin wrestles with fears that helping her husband die might preempt his potential for changing his mind, making irreversible decisions exceptionally hard. The couple’s journey has often seen Battin rush Hopkins to the hospital despite his previous wishes, only for him to later thank her—highlighting the fluctuating nature of his desires, often tied to pain or medication. Following the 'Final Letter,' Hopkins developed pleural effusion, which resulted in hospitalization. Despite his earlier readiness to die, effective pain management led him to view this hospitalization as a 'happy ending.' On good days, he still finds meaning in teaching, reading, and engaging with others, though he relies on tube feeding and constant care. Battin’s belief in the right to choose one’s end remains, but her experience has made her keenly aware of the complexities of each individual case. She told The New York Times that the issue is 'extremely complex, how extremely textured, any particular case is.' Hopkins and Battin are currently writing a book about their experiences. Battin continues to advocate for right-to-die legislation, which is available in states like Oregon, Washington, Montana, and Vermont. Hopkins, now 71, has expressed a wish to die after finishing his last course in spring 2014, but whether that decision will be made remains uncertain. In a recent blog entry, Peggy Battin and Brooke Hopkins wrote: 'This story doesn’t end, and it doesn’t need to be a tragedy. It’s still a story of love, even if it’s love under trial. It doesn’t end as long as we’re here to write it, and it isn’t a tragedy if we can keep from letting ourselves think so. But we’re also aware of the knife-edge we walk all the time, when the story could end not because we didn’t have anything more to say, but because we weren’t here anymore to say it.'
translated_content: Kada je suprug Margaret Pabst Battin, Brooke Hopkins, doživio biciklističku nesreću koja ga je gotovo potpuno paralizirala, Battin se suočila sa svojim znanstvenim uvjerenjima o pravu na smrt na osobnoj razini. Battin, profesorica na Sveučilištu Utah i međunarodna liderica pokreta za eutanaziju, svoju je karijeru posvetila proučavanju i zalaganju za pravo terminalno bolesnih i teško ozlijeđenih osoba na izbor smrti. Godine 2008., 66-godišnji Brooke Hopkins vozio je bicikl u City Creek Canyonu u Utahu kada se sudario s drugim biciklistom, uzrokujući nesreću koja mu je prekinula leđnu moždinu. Iako je godinu dana ranije ažurirao svoju oporuku da ne želi liječenje kojim bi se umjetno produljio život ako bi bio u vegetativnom stanju, hitna pomoć, ne znajući za njegovu želju, održavala ga je na životu i stavila na respirator. Battin, poznata i kao Peggy, opsežno je pisala o temama potpomognutog samoubojstva i pravu na dostojanstvenu smrt, nadahnuta, između ostalog, teškom smrću majke od raka jetre dok je imala 21 godinu. I dalje čvrsto vjeruje u pravo na samoodređenje — čak i na kraju života — no ozljeda njezina supruga otkrila je emocionalne i etičke složenosti koje nije očekivala, uključujući vlastitu nespremnost da ga pusti i njegovu želju da ostane jer zna da ga ona ne želi izgubiti. Prije nesreće, Hopkins je bio poznat kao živahan, pustolovan čovjek zaljubljen u književnost i predavanje kao profesor na Sveučilištu Utah. Sada, nakon nesreće, ima i dobre i teške dane. U srpnju 2012., kada je trpio nepodnošljivu bol, diktirao je 'Završno pismo' svojim voljenima, izražavajući kako je dosegao granicu i da mu volja za životom slabi. Battin se bori sa strahom da bi, pomažući mu umrijeti, mogla spriječiti mogućnost da promijeni mišljenje, što čini nepovratne odluke posebno teškima. Na njihovom putovanju Battin je često morala žurno voditi Hopkinsa u bolnicu unatoč njegovim ranijim željama, a on joj je kasnije zahvaljivao — naglašavajući promjenjivu prirodu njegovih želja, često povezanih s boli ili lijekovima. Nakon 'Završnog pisma', Hopkins je razvio pleuralni izljev, zbog čega je bio hospitaliziran. Unatoč ranijoj spremnosti na smrt, učinkovito liječenje boli dovelo ga je da ovu hospitalizaciju vidi kao 'sretan završetak'. U boljim danima još uvijek nalazi smisao u predavanju, čitanju i druženju, iako se hrani na sondu i treba stalnu njegu. Battin i dalje vjeruje u pravo da sami biramo kraj života, no iskustvo s mužem dalo joj je dublje razumijevanje koliko su pojedinačni slučajevi složeni. Za New York Times izjavila je kako je 'izuzetno kompleksno, izuzetno slojevito, svako pojedino iskustvo.' Hopkins i Battin trenutno pišu knjigu o svojim iskustvima. Battin nastavlja zagovarati legalizaciju prava na smrt, koja postoji u državama kao što su Oregon, Washington, Montana i Vermont. Hopkins, sada 71-godišnjak, izrazio je želju da umre nakon što završi svoj posljednji tečaj na proljeće 2014., no još nije sigurno hoće li donijeti tu odluku. U nedavnom blogu, Peggy Battin i Brooke Hopkins napisali su: 'Ova priča ne završava, i ne mora biti tragedija. To je i dalje priča o ljubavi, čak i ljubavi na kušnji. Ne završava dokle god je mi imamo što pisati, i nije tragedija ako to ne dopustimo sami sebi pomisliti. No, svjesni smo i da cijelo vrijeme hodamo po rubu, kada bi priča mogla završiti ne zato što više nemamo što reći, već jer nas više nema da to kažemo.'

article_content: The trunk and crown of the Sycamore Gap tree will be moved from their current location along Hadrian's Wall in northeast England. Police have arrested two people in connection with the felling of this historic tree. Workers have begun removing the famous trunk and crown, leaving the stump in place. The National Trust stated that the 50-foot tree, which had stood for nearly 200 years, will be carefully moved and stored. Officials have expressed gratitude for public concern, noting thousands of tributes, suggestions, and donations from across the UK and beyond aimed at preserving the tree’s legacy. Possible options include promoting regrowth, grafting, or planting a new tree. The trunk now rests on Hadrian's Wall, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and former Roman Empire frontier. Cranes will be used to lift away the trunk, preventing damage to the 1,900-year-old wall and removing a potential hazard. Moving the tree is challenging because of its historical setting and size. For many years, the Sycamore Gap tree was a popular destination for visitors to Hadrian's Wall near the England-Scotland border. Experts have determined that the trunk cannot be removed intact and must be cut into large sections for potential future use. News of the felling sparked widespread sadness and outrage. Police arrested a 16-year-old and a man in his 60s. Officers carried a large chainsaw from the older man’s home; he is reportedly a former lumberjack. The beloved sycamore, predating the era of electricity, was a popular subject on Instagram and frequently featured in photos of vacations, engagements, and picnics. Andrew Poad, general manager for the National Trust at the site, remarked that the tree held a special and often poignant place in many hearts. The tree was also featured in the 1991 Kevin Costner film 'Robin Hood: Prince Of Thieves.' Currently, a temporary fence surrounds the stump to protect it while possibilities for new growth are assessed. Jeannette Heard from the National Trust told NPR that regrowth from the stump may be possible, but it is too early to know if it will succeed. If new shoots do grow, the resulting tree will likely have multiple stems, making its appearance very different from the original.
translated_content: Deblo i krošnja stabla Sycamore Gap bit će uklonjeni s njihove sadašnje lokacije duž Hadrijanova zida na sjeveroistoku Engleske. Policija je uhitila dvije osobe povezane s rušenjem ovog povijesnog stabla. Radnici su započeli s uklanjanjem poznatog debla i krošnje, dok panj ostaje na mjestu. Nacionalni Trust izjavio je da će 15-metarsko stablo, koje je stajalo gotovo 200 godina, biti pažljivo premješteno i pohranjeno. Dužnosnici su izrazili zahvalnost zbog zabrinutosti javnosti, ističući tisuće počasti, prijedloga i donacija iz cijelog Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva i šire u nastojanju da se očuva nasljeđe stabla. Moguće opcije uključuju poticanje ponovnog rasta, cijepljenje ili sadnju novog stabla. Deblo trenutno leži na Hadrijanovom zidu, UNESCO-ovoj svjetskoj baštini i nekadašnjoj granici Rimskoga Carstva. Za podizanje debla koristit će se dizalice, kako bi se spriječilo oštećenje 1.900 godina starog zida i uklonila potencijalna opasnost. Premještanje stabla je izazovno zbog njegove povijesne važnosti i veličine. Dugi niz godina, stablo Sycamore Gap bilo je omiljena destinacija za posjetitelje Hadrijanova zida blizu granice Engleske i Škotske. Stručnjaci su zaključili da se deblo ne može ukloniti u cijelosti te ga je potrebno isjeći u veće dijelove za eventualnu buduću upotrebu. Vijest o rušenju izazvala je val tuge i ogorčenja. Policija je uhitila 16-godišnjaka i muškarca u 60-ima. Policajci su iz kuće starijeg muškarca odnijeli veliku motornu pilu; navodno je bivši drvosječa. Omiljeni javor, koji potječe iz vremena prije električne energije, bio je česta tema na Instagramu i često se pojavljivao na fotografijama s odmora, zaruka i piknika. Andrew Poad, glavni upravitelj Nacionalnog Trusta na tom lokalitetu, izjavio je da je stablo imalo posebno i često dirljivo mjesto u srcima mnogih ljudi. Stablo se pojavilo i u filmu Kevina Costnera 'Robin Hood: Prince Of Thieves' iz 1991. Trenutno, privremena ograda okružuje panj kako bi ga zaštitila dok se procjenjuje mogućnost novog rasta. Jeannette Heard iz Nacionalnog Trusta izjavila je za NPR da je moguć ponovni rast iz panja, ali još je prerano za reći hoće li uspjeti. Ako novi izbojci izrastu, novo stablo vjerojatno će imati više stabljika, zbog čega će izgledati znatno drukčije od izvornog.

article_content: With Halloween approaching, many revel in tales of spirits and supernatural beings—but these ideas are age-old, tracing back to early human societies. From the earliest graves, furnished with objects for the afterlife, people demonstrated a belief in existence beyond death. Scholars like Irving Finkel maintain that such burial customs reveal ancient convictions about a life after death. The civilizations of Mesopotamia, in modern-day Iraq, have passed down intricate ghost and demon stories, which still inspire films and books today. Popular movies such as Ghostbusters, The Exorcist, and Evil Dead reinterpret Mesopotamian demons within modern storylines. Although today's media often depict these entities as villains, ancient Mesopotamian beliefs were complex. Ghosts could be guardians as well as threats—family members honored their dead with offerings and rituals to ensure peace, believing neglected spirits might become nuisances. Mesopotamian mythology offers unique explanations for the origin of humanity: in certain myths, humans are formed from the remains and spirit of a fallen god, granting them immortal souls. Well-known tales about deities like Ishtar and Gilgamesh describe journeys between the world of the living and the dead, reinforcing the vital ties between ancestors and their descendants. Specialists such as necromancers acted as intermediaries, performing rites to communicate with spirits for guidance or protection. Failing to respect ancestral obligations was thought to provoke restless or vengeful ghosts, who might return as demons. Understanding these profound origins can make our modern fascination with ghosts feel less ominous, reminding us of humanity’s deep-rooted connection with the supernatural. Elsewhere, India's economy is performing well, with recent projections estimating 6.7% growth in the July-September quarter, boosted by strong services output. The government also plans to raise the GST evasion prosecution threshold to reduce legal burdens, and debates continue in the telecom sector about broadcasting TV directly to mobiles without data, though some industry leaders are wary of the technology’s maturity.
translated_content: Kako se bliži Noć vještica, mnogi uživaju u pričama o duhovima i natprirodnim bićima — ali te ideje su prastare i sežu do najranijih ljudskih društava. Još od prvih grobova, u koje su stavljani predmeti za zagrobni život, ljudi su pokazivali vjeru u postojanje nakon smrti. Znanstvenici poput Irvinga Finkela smatraju da takvi pogrebni običaji svjedoče o drevnim uvjerenjima u život poslije smrti. Civilizacije Mezopotamije, na prostoru današnjeg Iraka, prenijele su složene priče o duhovima i demonima koje i danas nadahnjuju filmove i knjige. Popularni filmovi poput Ghostbustersa, Egzorcista i Evil Deada ponovno uvode mezopotamske demone u suvremene priče. Iako današnji mediji često prikazuju ta bića kao zlikovce, drevna mezopotamska vjerovanja bila su mnogo složenija. Duhovi su mogli biti zaštitnici, ali i prijetnja — obitelji su preminulima iskazivale poštovanje darovima i obredima za mir, smatrajući da zaboravljene duše mogu postati nemirne. Mezopotamska mitologija nudi posebna objašnjenja o porijeklu čovjeka: prema nekim mitovima, ljudi su nastali od ostataka i duha ubijenog boga, što im je dalo besmrtnu dušu. Poznate priče o božanstvima poput Ištar i Gilgameša prikazuju putovanja između svijeta živih i mrtvih, naglašavajući važnost veza predaka i potomaka. Stručnjaci, poput nekromanata, bili su posrednici — obavljali su obrede kako bi komunicirali s duhovima radi zaštite ili savjeta. Zanemarivanje dužnosti prema precima smatralo se uzrokom nastanka nemirnih ili osvetoljubivih duhova, koji bi se mogli vratiti kao demoni. Shvaćanje ovih dubokih izvora može našu današnju fascinaciju duhovima učiniti manje zastrašujućom te nas podsjetiti na duboke ljudske veze s nadnaravnim. U drugim vijestima, indijsko gospodarstvo bilježi solidan rast — procjenjuje se da će BDP u srpnju i rujnu porasti za 6,7%, ponajviše zahvaljujući snažnom sektoru usluga. Vlada planira povisiti prag za kazneni progon kod utaje GST-a kako bi smanjila pravne postupke i olakšala poslovanje, a u telekomunikacijskom sektoru raspravlja se o emitiranju TV sadržaja izravno na mobitele bez podatkovne veze, iako neki industrijski lideri izražavaju oprez prema toj tehnologiji.

article_content: After Hamas’ assault on October 7, Israel launched heavy airstrikes and enforced a blockade in Gaza. Both sides have been accused of violating international humanitarian law. The United Nations commission is presently collecting evidence to investigate potential war crimes. Israel asserts it is following international legal standards, though bodies like the International Criminal Court (ICC) may review these actions to determine if legal violations occurred. Since Israel does not recognize the ICC’s jurisdiction, establishing accountability becomes more complex. The question of who will ultimately hold those responsible to account is still open. Experts featured in the discussion include Geoffrey Robertson (legal authority and former president of the War Crimes Court in Sierra Leone), Sawsan Zaher (human rights attorney and civil society legal adviser), and Marc Garlasco (military adviser at Pax for Peace). James Bays moderates the conversation.

Komisija Ujedinjenih naroda trenutno prikuplja dokaze o mogućim ratnim zločinima. Izrael tvrdi da postupa u okviru međunarodnog prava, dok institucije poput Međunarodnog kaznenog suda (ICC) mogu preispitati ove postupke kako bi utvrdile postoje li kršenja. Kako Izrael ne priznaje nadležnost ICC-a, utvrđivanje odgovornosti postaje složenije. Pitanje tko će odgovarati za moguće prekršaje još je uvijek otvoreno. O ovome raspravljaju Geoffrey Robertson (pravni stručnjak i bivši predsjednik Suda za ratne zločine u Sierra Leoneu), Sawsan Zaher (odvjetnica za ljudska prava i pravna savjetnica civilnog društva) i Marc Garlasco (vojni savjetnik organizacije Pax for Peace). Razgovor vodi James Bays.

article_content: A mobile game developed by Canterbury Academy students has ignited debate after introducing a character named Nicholas Fromage, who kicks immigrants off the White Cliffs of Dover. The game, called 'Ukik', is intended as satire to mock extremist political beliefs. UKIP leader Nigel Farage criticized the project, labelling it 'risible and pathetic' and expressing concern that it wrongly portrays UKIP as racist. While Farage said he is open to scrutiny as a public figure, he argued that certain elements in the game go too far. Phil Karnavas, Canterbury Academy’s principal, defended the game as a playful exercise designed to inspire political discussion among youth. He stated that political satire should be recognized for what it is, and such projects can stimulate healthy debate. The creators—students John Brown, James Dupreez, Fraser Richardson, John Hutchinson, and Joe Brown—founded a game design group, FonGames, focusing on making games inspired by current events to encourage discussion. 'Ukik' currently holds a five-star rating from 60 users on Google Play. Its description and disclaimer make clear the intention to celebrate diversity and ridicule extremist viewpoints. Marcus Ball, co-founder of Ambition House, a business accelerator located at the academy, praised the students for using satire to engage more young people with politics. Separately, the article mentions a UKIP parliamentary candidate, John Rees-Evans, who told a peculiar anecdote involving his horse and a donkey, adding another layer to the discussion about UKIP’s public image.

Igra, nazvana 'Ukik', zamišljena je kao satira koja ismijava ekstremne političke stavove. Vođa UKIP-a Nigel Farage kritizirao je projekt, nazvavši ga 'smiješnim i jadnim' te izrazio zabrinutost da pogrešno prikazuje UKIP kao rasističku stranku. Ravnatelj Canterbury Academy, Phil Karnavas, branio je igru kao šaljivu vježbu namijenjenu poticanju političke rasprave među mladima. Naglasio je da političku satiru treba prepoznavati kao takvu i da ovakvi projekti mogu potaknuti zdravu raspravu. Autori igre — John Brown, James Dupreez, Fraser Richardson, John Hutchinson i Joe Brown — osnovali su grupu za dizajn igara FonGames, koja se bavi izradom igara na temelju aktualnih događaja kako bi potaknuli raspravu. 'Ukik' trenutno ima ocjenu od pet zvjezdica na Google Playu na temelju 60 ocjena. Opis i izjava igre jasno daju do znanja da je namjera proslaviti raznolikost i ismijavati ekstremističke stavove. Marcus Ball, suosnivač Ambition Housea — poduzetničkog programa u sklopu akademije — pohvalio je učenike što koriste satiru da bi više mladih uključili u politička pitanja. Također, članak spominje kandidata UKIP-a za parlament, Johna Rees-Evansa, koji je ispričao neobičnu anegdotu o svom konju i magarcu, što dodatno utječe na javnu sliku UKIP-a.

article_content: COVID-19 hospitalizations are again on the rise in the United States, with the CDC reporting 18,119 new admissions for the week ending November 18—an increase of 9.7% from the previous week. The Midwest, Great Lakes, and parts of New England are seeing the steepest increases. Health officials caution that winter weather could intensify these trends, as respiratory viruses such as COVID-19 often spread more effectively in cold, dry conditions, and immune defenses can be weaker. A CDC spokesperson noted that October is usually the start of the respiratory virus season and that hospitalization rates may continue to climb in the coming months, following similar patterns seen last year. Previously, COVID admissions rose steadily from late June and peaked in early September, then dropped slightly before stabilizing at about 15,000 through October, with a slight rise again in November. Current hospitalization levels are still far below the record set in January 2021, when over 150,000 were hospitalized in a single week. The CDC's recent data points to North Dakota with the biggest week-on-week jump—hospital admissions surged by 68.2%. Connecticut, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Indiana, Illinois, Kansas, Missouri, Rhode Island, Ohio, and Wyoming all experienced increases above 30%. California, Colorado, Hawaii, Louisiana, Michigan, Maine, Maryland, New Jersey, New Mexico, Oklahoma, Pennsylvania, Utah, Wisconsin, West Virginia, and Puerto Rico each saw more than a 10% rise in admissions. Health officials continue to monitor these developments as winter approaches.

article_content: A dispute has emerged in Marshfield, Massachusetts, centering on the use of the word 'Christmas' in public life. Tension began earlier this year when the local school board voted to rename 'Christmas vacation' as 'holiday break', aiming to be more inclusive. Debate intensified when town officials ordered the removal of a roadside sign, posted by the Department of Public Works, that read: 'Merry Christmas to all. In God we trust.' In response, residents organized a demonstration, dressing in holiday attire and waving handmade 'Merry Christmas' signs to motorists. Steve Barber, a public works employee and union chairman who put up the sign, described the gesture as innocent and intended to spread holiday cheer. Supporters of the sign, many of whom opposed the vacation name change, expressed frustration after the removal, arguing it undermines local traditions. One bus driver told WBZ: 'We were founded on Christianity, and now it seems Christianity is being erased. It’s the melting pot. Melt and merge.' Similarly, resident Laurie Futch stated to My Fox Boston: 'This is America. Individuals should be free to say “Merry Christmas” or “Happy holidays.”' The controversy continued despite a petition with over 4,000 signatures urging the school committee to restore the term 'Christmas vacation', a request that was ultimately rejected. Elaine Taylor, who presented the petition, told WBZ: 'Our community is Christian, and we should be able to maintain our traditions, even as we recognize others have different holy days.'

article_content: Melinda Van Veldhuizen, a nurse practitioner from Dallas, received a lifetime ban from Carnival Cruise Line after security at the Port of Miami found CBD gummies in her luggage during a routine check, initially prompted by nail clippers detected in her bag. Van Veldhuizen stated she uses the gummies to manage sleep issues. Security held her for close to three and a half hours, asking about her use and authorization for the CBD edibles, before informing her she could not board the ship. Carnival Cruise Line subsequently notified Van Veldhuizen in writing, via Captain Rocco Lubrano, that she was permanently prohibited from traveling with the company for violating cruise policies. Despite not taking the voyage, she was still charged the total fare of $5,586. CBD (cannabidiol) is a cannabis-derived compound. As the CDC notes, it can originate from hemp—cannabis containing less than 0.3% THC—or from non-hemp sources. The 2018 Farm Bill legalized hemp products, but the FDA continues to ban edible forms of CBD under federal food and drug law, contributing to considerable regulatory confusion. Van Veldhuizen’s attorney, Daren Stabinski, described the incident as embarrassing and harrowing for his client, and says they are evaluating a potential lawsuit against Carnival if internal complaints go unresolved.

article_content: A dramatic Super Bowl commercial aired locally in Savannah, Georgia, has sparked nationwide attention, even though most viewers didn’t see it during the game. The two-minute ad, created by personal injury lawyer Jamie Casino, features heavy metal music and a symbolic sledgehammer to criticize the Savannah Police Department's handling of the 2012 shooting death of his brother, Michael Casino. Previously a criminal defense attorney, Jamie said in an interview with WTOC that the ad was his way of defending his brother’s reputation against claims of criminal involvement. Rooted in real events from 2010 and 2012, the commercial begins by highlighting Jamie's former career as a defense lawyer for disreputable clients. Jamie’s life changed after his brother Michael and Michael’s friend, Emily Pickels, were among four people fatally shot over one weekend. At the time, police asserted, 'no innocent people were shot,' a claim Jamie challenges, particularly accusing then-police chief Willie Lovett of being misleading. The ad incorporates a Bible verse calling for justice for those who cannot speak for themselves and features Jamie visiting his brother’s grave. As his son asks him about his work, Jamie reflects on his purpose. The mood shifts dramatically with heavy metal music and bold visuals; Jamie's sledgehammer, now bearing his brother’s name, becomes a symbol of his fight against what he sees as injustice. The commercial climaxes with Jamie smashing his brother’s tombstone, rejecting the narrative presented by police. Jamie proclaims he no longer represents criminals, instead choosing to be a voice for innocent victims. As the ad ends, flames and music accompany him walking away from the grave. Responses to the commercial have been varied. Many on social media hailed Casino’s ad as the standout of the Super Bowl, with some wishing it could inspire a movie. Others criticized him for seemingly using tragedy for self-promotion, while certain legal professionals warned such ads harm the reputation of attorneys. The former police chief declined to comment when approached by reporters. Jamie Casino’s bold use of his trademark sledgehammer and fire is familiar from his previous TV ads targeting insurance companies.

article_content: On November 2, Shah Rukh Khan celebrates his 58th birthday, a day that sees several major professional achievements. article_content: The UK has announced a public inquiry into the 2006 fatal poisoning of Alexander Litvinenko, a former Russian intelligence agent who died after consuming radioactive polonium-210 in London. This move coincides with escalating tensions between the UK and Russia over recent events, such as the downing of Malaysian Airlines flight MH17. Home Secretary Theresa May, who previously decided against an inquiry to preserve diplomatic ties, reversed her stance following a legal challenge. She confirmed that Coroner Sir Robert Owen will lead the official investigation starting by July's end, focusing on whether the Russian government was involved in the killing. Prime Minister David Cameron has advocated for strong economic sanctions against Russia, signaling a serious deterioration in relations. Litvinenko's widow, Marina, expressed relief and hope that the inquiry will finally reveal the truth and hold the responsible parties accountable. She and their son have long sought answers. The inquiry, under Sir Robert Owen, has the authority to obtain witnesses and documents within the UK, including from intelligence agencies, but cannot compel evidence from Russia. Suspected perpetrators Andrei Lugovoy and Dmitri Kovtun, both ex-Russian security officials, remain in Russia, deny all involvement, and are shielded from extradition by the Russian government. Russian lawmaker Andrey Lugovoy criticized the inquiry as politically motivated, claiming it's intended to increase pressure on Russia amid ongoing international tensions. Lugovoy denies any participation in Litvinenko’s death. Mrs. Litvinenko’s legal representatives want the investigation to determine whether the crime was committed independently or directed by the Russian state operating in the UK. The family maintains that Litvinenko was collaborating with British intelligence and believes the Kremlin ordered his murder. The inquiry aims to clarify the circumstances of the assassination and any potential links to the Russian state, seeking justice for Litvinenko’s family nearly eight years after his death.

article_content: Several children at the exclusive GEMS Hampshire School in Chelsea, London, were injured today when a ceiling collapsed during assembly. Seven pupils were taken to hospital with minor injuries after a large section of plaster, believed to be around 20 square metres, fell from the ceiling of the main hall. The London Ambulance Service reported that 15 children were assessed for injuries, with seven transported to a nearby hospital. Many sustained minor injuries such as dust in their eyes and bruises. London Fire Brigade attended the scene and confirmed that no one was trapped. The school, a mixed-gender independent day school for children aged three to 13, immediately evacuated the premises and contacted emergency services. The affected parts of the building were cordoned off, and the safety of the remaining pupils was verified by the London Fire Brigade and a district surveyor from the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea before children were allowed to return to classrooms. Established in 1928, GEMS Hampshire School underwent comprehensive structural improvements in 2004 to modernize its facilities. Following the incident, a safety assessment is being conducted to determine the cause of the collapse. School officials prioritized communicating with parents, informing the families of the affected children and ensuring all parents were updated. A spokesperson for the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea Council stated that council officers will assist in the investigation into the cause of the ceiling collapse. The school has emphasized that the welfare of the pupils remains its highest priority and pledged to provide all necessary support to those affected.

article_content: Here's one last Halloween post before I leave the topic until next year. As you enjoy your candy haul, check out this funny video by German actor, comedian, and musician Flula Borg. He starts with, 'Yes, it is Halloween, but the only thing that haunts me is this very terrible poem.' The poem in question is: Trick or Treat Smell my feet Give me something good to eat Borg humorously deconstructs each line, at one point exclaiming, 'This is not how the barter system works.' Watch it if you appreciate deadpan humor—it really is an odd poem. I searched for the origin of this poem but couldn't find much. I did come across an article in Smithsonian Magazine about the origins of Halloween, which covers the centuries-old history of trick or treating. It also references a Merriam-Webster piece focused on the history of the term 'trick or treat.' The Smithsonian Magazine cites a Merriam-Webster blog post, which discusses etymologist Barry Popik's research showing that 'trick or treat' first appeared in the early 1920s, mainly in Canadian newspapers. For example, a November 1923 article in the Saskatchewan Leader-Post noted, 'Treats, not tricks were the order of the evening.' Meanwhile, a November 1924 piece in Alberta's Red Deer Advocate stated: 'Hallowe'en night was observed in the usual manner by the young "bloods" in Penhold. "Fun is fun, and tricks are tricks," but when such public buildings as the school and Memorial Hall are molested with no option for "Treat or Trick," we can not see where either fun or trick is enjoyed by the participants.' Although I found information about the history of Halloween and 'trick or treat,' the specific origin of the poem remains unclear. If you know more, feel free to share it in the comments!

article_content: At DierenPark Amersfoort in the Netherlands, three playful tiger cubs enjoyed exploring a pile of autumn leaves placed in their enclosure. The cubs—Fedor, Nicolai, and Sergei—were born in June to their mother, Angara. Now three months old, they were introduced to the leaves by zookeepers to help them adjust to the changing autumn environment. Zoo staff prepared this enrichment activity to familiarize the young tigers with seasonal changes outdoors. The cubs eagerly interacted with the leaves, play-fighting and tumbling, while Angara watched over them and occasionally joined in their playful antics. Their father, Ilya, also lives at the zoo, but the cubs have not yet met him. Plans are underway for the family to be introduced soon. Visitors can watch the cubs and their mother on the zoo’s live webcam. Animal carer Martijn van der Sijde explained that giving the cubs autumn leaves was a festive way to help them experience the season for the first time. Zoo representative Lize de Graaf noted the cubs were a little uncertain at first but quickly began to play with enthusiasm. The scene captures the joyful and energetic nature of the tiger cubs as they discover the fun of autumn.

article_content: Sunderland manager Gus Poyet is urging his team to avoid a repeat of their last post-international break slump, notably the heavy 8-0 defeat they suffered against Southampton. With their next Premier League challenge away at Leicester City, Poyet has told his players to quickly shift focus from international duty back to Sunderland’s priorities. That Southampton loss marked a low point following an otherwise positive season start, and was succeeded by a defeat to Arsenal. However, Sunderland have steadied, securing a win against Crystal Palace and a draw with Everton in recent matches. Leicester, fresh from promotion, enjoyed an upbeat start but have now picked up just one point from their last six games. Poyet has warned that despite Leicester’s recent struggles, they remain dangerous, pointing out how newly promoted teams often ride an emotional high before reality sets in. Sunderland receive a boost with Lee Cattermole returning from suspension and Steven Fletcher fit to play after an ankle injury. Poyet also highlighted the talent of Leicester striker Leonardo Ulloa, his former player at Brighton, noting he would rather not face him. Poyet continued to emphasize the necessity of shutting out all distractions, insisting that Sunderland’s best performances will come when the squad is completely focused on club football after international fixtures.

article_content: India's fintech sector is undergoing major transformation, with new players expanding beyond traditional credit and payments. At the ET Soonicorns Summit 2023, leaders from startups like ProgCap, CashKaro, EarnKaro, Stashfin, KredX, and Balancehero India discussed the industry's prospects and hurdles. Each company brings a distinct offering: ProgCap provides custom financing for small and medium businesses; CashKaro specializes in cashback and coupons and recently introduced BankKaro to offer credit card rewards; Stashfin is developing UPI-style credit solutions; KredX facilitates both domestic and international trade finance; and Balancehero India issues prepaid payment tools and supplies short-term personal loans with a focus on underserved markets. Government-led digital infrastructure—such as Aadhaar, Jan-Dhan accounts, and UPI—has catapulted India to third place globally in digital payments. The Economic Survey 2022-23 reports an 87% fintech adoption rate, and projections indicate 1 billion Indian smartphone users by 2026. A focus on micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) is emerging, as panelists highlighted that 63 million MSMEs remain underbanked—a vast, untapped segment. According to Experian, fintech firms account for nearly half of all personal loans in India, rising from just 13% in 2018. While there are more than 77 million credit card users, this covers only 5.5% of the population, indicating huge growth potential. Panelists addressed challenges such as expanding financial literacy in rural areas and overcoming barriers to SME and B2B payments. They emphasized that evolving regulations and increased collaboration with regulators are essential to balancing innovation with consumer protection. The consensus was that strong communication between fintechs and regulators, as well as the establishment of self-regulating organizations, will be crucial for a vibrant and trustworthy sector. With ongoing technological innovation and dialogue-driven regulation, India's fintech ecosystem is set to advance financial inclusion for all, build sustainable growth, and open up new opportunities for consumers and businesses alike.

Vladina digitalna infrastruktura—poput Aadhaar-a, Jan-Dhan računa i UPI-ja—učinila je Indiju trećim tržištem u svijetu po digitalnim plaćanjima. Prema Ekonomskom pregledu za 2022-23., stopa usvajanja fintech usluga iznosi 87%, a predviđa se da će Indija do 2026. imati milijardu korisnika pametnih telefona. Prema Experianu, fintech tvrtke sada čine gotovo polovicu svih osobnih zajmova u Indiji, u odnosu na samo 13% u 2018. Iako postoji više od 77 milijuna korisnika kreditnih kartica, to je samo 5,5% stanovništva, što upućuje na ogromne mogućnosti za širenje. Panelisti su raspravljali o izazovima poput povećanja financijske pismenosti u ruralnim područjima i olakšavanja SME i B2B plaćanja. Istaknuli su kako su fleksibilni propisi i otvorena suradnja s regulatorima ključni za ravnotežu inovacija i zaštite potrošača. Zaključeno je da su dobra komunikacija između fintechova i regulatora, te formiranje samoregulirajućih organizacija, od presudne važnosti za dinamičan i pouzdan sektor. Zahvaljujući stalnoj tehnološkoj inovaciji i regulativi temeljenoj na dijalogu, indijski fintech ekosustav spreman je unaprijediti financijsku uključenost, ostvariti održivi rast i stvoriti nove prilike za potrošače i poslovne subjekte.

article_content: Nicole 'Snooki' Polizzi, who is pregnant, has moved out of the Jersey Shore house. Mike 'The Situation' Sorrentino has stopped drinking. Deena Cortese and Jenni 'JWoww' Farley are now in committed relationships. The cast of the reality TV show is showing signs of maturity. Chris Linn, MTV's executive vice president of programming and head of production, has stated that the sixth season of Jersey Shore will focus on the significant changes in the cast members' lives. He said in the network's first interview about the new season that the show will reflect these major life developments. The cast recently reunited in Seaside Heights after an 11-month break, the longest ever for the series. After returning to the house, Snooki, due to her pregnancy, chose to move next door, following through on earlier comments that she might not want to stay in a party house while pregnant. MTV noted that this is not the first time a cast member has moved out during filming. Linn highlighted that the house is not restrictive and explained that the decision represents real-life changes for the group. He also mentioned that the show's aim is to depict authentic experiences as the cast navigates adulthood. Executive producer SallyAnn Salsano, who is on location, said the production always prepares a backup location in case of major problems but prefers to keep everyone together. Salsano noted that the house itself does not create the party atmosphere—it's the cast's behavior that shapes it. Only one new season of Jersey Shore is planned for production this year, with MTV strongly invested in its success. Despite a ratings decline last season, the show still averages 7.6 million viewers. MTV hopes that the extended break will help make this season more dynamic, especially compared to season five, which was filmed quickly after shooting in Italy. Linn said the network is enthusiastic and warned against making assumptions about the new season. The network has supported cast members' lifestyle changes even if it means showing less partying. Linn noted that few expected Snooki to lead these changes, but her actions are affecting the group's dynamics, and she remains as entertaining as ever. The production has made some accommodations for her pregnancy, such as canceling skydiving plans. Regarding The Situation, who reportedly sought help for prescription drug issues, Linn explained that alcohol was not considered problematic for him, but the network supports his efforts to stay healthy. Salsano said the new season will remain entertaining, but in different ways. On set, there's been a lot of humor about Snooki's pregnancy and Mike's sobriety. Salsano compared the season's atmosphere to a wild health class video. Read the full story at EW.com.
translated_content: Nicole 'Snooki' Polizzi, koja je trudna, iselila se iz kuće Jersey Shore. Mike 'The Situation' Sorrentino prestao je piti. Deena Cortese i Jenni 'JWoww' Farley sada su u ozbiljnim vezama. Glumačka postava reality showa pokazuje znakove zrelosti. Chris Linn, izvršni potpredsjednik MTV-a za programiranje i produkciju, izjavio je da će šesta sezona Jersey Shorea biti usredotočena na velike promjene u životima članova ekipe. U prvom intervjuu mreže o novoj sezoni rekao je da će show odražavati te značajne životne promjene. Izvršna producentica SallyAnn Salsano, koja je na setu, izjavila je da produkcija uvijek priprema rezervnu lokaciju u slučaju većih problema, ali im je draže da svi ostanu zajedno. Linn je istaknuo da je malo ljudi očekivalo da će Snooki predvoditi te promjene, ali njezini potezi utječu na dinamiku grupe i ona je i dalje jednako zabavna. article_content: The United States and China resumed arms control talks in Washington this week, marking their first such meeting in years. While the talks yielded little new information from Beijing and did not result in a scheduled follow-up, a senior US official described the discussions as constructive, emphasizing that simply holding the meeting was progress. The session, held on Monday, was led by senior arms control diplomats from both nations. According to the official, the meeting was not 'substantive'—as there was limited back-and-forth exchange—but represented an important first step. These discussions come as both countries aim to set a positive tone before a possible meeting between US President Joe Biden and Chinese President Xi Jinping in San Francisco next week. A primary US concern is preventing heightened competition with China from escalating into conflict, particularly as disputes spread across issues from trade to Taiwan. Washington remains wary of China's expanding nuclear arsenal. Pentagon estimates suggest China possesses about 500 nuclear warheads—a figure smaller than those of the US and Russia—but analysts warn that continued growth could increase the risk of conflict. In June, White House National Security Adviser Jake Sullivan outlined US expectations, urging China to provide more transparency on its nuclear forces, issue missile launch notifications, and clarify its nuclear arsenal expansion. So far, US officials note China remains reluctant to separate arms control discussions from other sensitive issues in the bilateral relationship. The US official stated that China was not candid about these topics and that no second meeting was agreed upon. 'I hesitate to extrapolate from this one meeting' that China will change its position, the official said. The Chinese delegation did not offer substantive responses regarding its nuclear doctrine, policies, or budget. Future talks may hinge on the anticipated Biden-Xi summit. Last week, another senior US official confirmed that both sides had agreed in principle for the presidents to meet in San Francisco, though details are still being negotiated. The US State Department called the arms control meeting 'candid and in-depth,' but acknowledged it is seeking more openness from China. The Department stressed the need for increased Chinese nuclear transparency and meaningful engagement to reduce strategic risks across nuclear and space domains. China's embassy in Washington gave no immediate comment. The talks were led by US Assistant Secretary of State Mallory Stewart and Sun Xiaobo, a director-general at China's foreign ministry. The United States has a nuclear stockpile of about 3,700 warheads, including roughly 1,419 deployed strategic warheads. Russia holds approximately 1,550 deployed nuclear weapons and, according to the Federation of American Scientists, maintains a total stockpile of 4,489 warheads.
translated_content: Sjedinjene Američke Države i Kina obnovile su razgovore o kontroli naoružanja u Washingtonu ovog tjedna, što predstavlja njihov prvi takav sastanak u nekoliko godina. Iako Kina nije ponudila nove informacije i nije dogovoren nastavak, visoki američki dužnosnik opisao je razgovore kao konstruktivne, naglašavajući da je samo održavanje sastanka napredak. Sastanak u ponedjeljak vodili su visoki diplomati za kontrolu naoružanja iz obje zemlje. Prema dužnosniku, sastanak nije bio 'sadržajan' — jer je bilo malo razmjene stavova — ali je bio važan prvi korak. Ovi razgovori dolaze dok obje države nastoje postaviti pozitivan ton uoči mogućeg sastanka američkog predsjednika Joea Bidena i kineskog predsjednika Xi Jinpinga u San Franciscu sljedeći tjedan. Primarna američka briga je spriječiti da pojačana konkurencija s Kinom preraste u sukob, osobito jer se nesuglasice protežu od trgovine do Tajvana. Washington je i dalje oprezan zbog širenja kineskog nuklearnog arsenala. Pentagon procjenjuje da Kina posjeduje oko 500 nuklearnih bojevih glava — što je brojka manja u odnosu na SAD i Rusiju — no analitičari upozoravaju da bi daljnji rast mogao povećati rizik od sukoba. U lipnju je savjetnik za nacionalnu sigurnost Bijele kuće Jake Sullivan iznio američka očekivanja, pozivajući Kinu na veću transparentnost o svojoj nuklearnoj sili, obavještavanje o lansiranju projektila i pojašnjenje širenja svog nuklearnog arsenala. Do sada američki dužnosnici ističu da Kina nerado odvaja razgovore o kontroli naoružanja od drugih osjetljivih tema u bilateralnim odnosima. Američki dužnosnik naveo je da Kina nije bila otvorena o tim pitanjima te da nije dogovoren drugi sastanak. 'Oklijevam donositi zaključke na temelju ovog jednog sastanka' da će Kina promijeniti svoj stav, rekao je dužnosnik. Kinesko izaslanstvo nije ponudilo sadržajne odgovore o svojoj nuklearnoj doktrini, politikama ili proračunu. Budući razgovori mogu ovisiti o očekivanom susretu Bidena i Xija. Prošlog tjedna drugi viši američki dužnosnik potvrdio je da su obje strane načelno pristale na susret predsjednika u San Franciscu, iako se pojedinosti još dogovaraju. Američki State Department nazvao je sastanak o kontroli naoružanja 'otvorenim i detaljnim', ali je priznao da očekuje veću otvorenost Kine. Ministarstvo je naglasilo potrebu za većom kineskom nuklearnom transparentnošću i značajnim angažmanom kako bi se smanjili strateški rizici u područjima nuklearnih i svemirskih sposobnosti. Kinesko veleposlanstvo u Washingtonu nije odmah dalo komentar. Razgovore su vodile pomoćnica američke državne tajnice Mallory Stewart i Sun Xiaobo, generalni direktor u kineskom ministarstvu vanjskih poslova. Sjedinjene Države imaju nuklearni arsenal od oko 3.700 bojevih glava, uključujući približno 1.419 strateških bojevih glava u upotrebi. Rusija ima oko 1.550 raspoređenih nuklearnih oružja i, prema podacima Federacije američkih znanstvenika, ukupno ima 4.489 bojevih glava.

article_content:
A portrait of actress Madeleine Carroll—famously recognized as the original 'Hitchcock Blonde'—is set to be sold at auction next month in London. The artwork, painted by the renowned Hungarian artist Philip Alexius de Laszlo in 1935, was completed the same year Carroll appeared in Alfred Hitchcock’s classic thriller 'The 39 Steps'. Carroll also featured in Hitchcock’s 1936 film 'Secret Agent', and she would go on to become one of the highest-earning actresses worldwide during that period.

Titled 'Mrs Philip Astley, nee Madeleine Carroll', the portrait will be up for bidding at Christie’s during their British & European Art sale—part of the auction house’s 'Classic Week'—on December 14. It carries an estimated value between £50,000 and £70,000 (approximately $62,285 to $87,200). The painting currently forms part of a broader exhibition highlighting major Classic Week pieces, and will remain on display until November 28.

Peter Brown, a senior director in Christie’s British and European art division, remarked that de Laszlo—who was already a well-established portrait artist at the age of 66—was especially eager to paint Carroll, owing to her star status at the time.

(Exchange rate: $1 = 0.8028 pounds)

(Reporting by Marie-Louise Gumuchian and Madhurima Dutta; editing by Alexandra Hudson)

Umjetničko djelo naslikao je poznati mađarski umjetnik Philip Alexius de Laszlo 1935. godine, iste godine kada se Carroll pojavila u Hitchcockovom slavnom trileru '39 stepenica'. Carroll je također glumila u Hitchcockovom filmu 'Tajni agent' iz 1936. godine, a ubrzo je postala jedna od najplaćenijih glumica na svijetu tog vremena.

Portret pod nazivom 'Gđa Philip Astley, rođena Madeleine Carroll', bit će ponuđen na aukciji u Christie'su tijekom njihovog Britanskog i europskog umjetničkog aukcijskog tjedna, koji je dio 'Classic Weeka', 14. prosinca. Procijenjena vrijednost iznosi između 50.000 i 70.000 funti (oko 62.285 do 87.200 američkih dolara). Slika je trenutno dio veće izložbe najvažnijih djela Classic Weeka i ostat će izložena do 28. studenoga.

Peter Brown, viši direktor britanskog i europskog umjetničkog odjela u Christie'su, izjavio je da je de Laszlo—koji je tada već bio priznati portretist u dobi od 66 godina—bio posebno željan naslikati Carroll zbog njezine zvjezdane reputacije.

(Izvještaj: Marie-Louise Gumuchian i Madhurima Dutta; uredila: Alexandra Hudson)

article_content: Over three decades, Shah Rukh Khan and Aamir Khan have remained leading figures in Bollywood, nurturing a close friendship despite their careers often overlapping. In a 2013 interview, Shah Rukh fondly described Aamir's thorough and dedicated nature, even joking about his meticulousness when making tea. On one flight, Shah Rukh recounted that while he opted for black coffee, Aamir ordered tea and specifically asked the attendant to wait before adding milk, ensuring the tea was just right. Shah Rukh also joked that Aamir takes so much time choosing between tea or coffee at his home that he tells him to come back with the decision the next day. Shah Rukh concluded with genuine praise, saying he has not met anyone as conscientious about their work as Aamir. Although both actors have enjoyed long, successful careers, they have never starred together. Shah Rukh, however, did a cameo in Aamir's film Laal Singh Chaddha last year. During its promotions, Aamir said he invited Shah Rukh because he needed someone who could represent India's most iconic star—comparable to Elvis in the US—and called Shah Rukh both a friend and an icon. Following Laal Singh Chaddha's poor box office performance, Aamir announced a break from films and has yet to announce a return. In the meantime, Shah Rukh has celebrated blockbuster hits with Pathaan and Jawan, which together grossed over Rs 2000 crore worldwide. He is set to appear next in Rajkumar Hirani’s Dunki, scheduled for release on December 22.

article_content: After an agonizing 36 hours of uncertainty, the family of British oil worker Mark Grant finally received a text message from him stating, 'I'm safe.' Mark, 29, had been among the hostages taken during the Algerian gas plant crisis at In Amenas, which was triggered by a militant attack on a BP facility in the Sahara Desert. The news brought immense relief to his wife, Emma, who had earlier made a tearful public plea from their home in Grangemouth, Scotland, hoping for his safe return for their young daughter's sake. Mark works as a contracts administrator for BP, having previously worked with Shell before joining the In Amenas project. In his message, he confirmed he was safe and with the Algerian army. Similarly, Stephen McFaul, a 36-year-old oil worker from Belfast, managed to phone his wife Angela with the words, 'I'm free, love, I'm free,' after escaping captivity. Earlier, Stephen had made a desperate call, saying, 'Al Qaeda have got me,' and had secretly messaged about being herded by the militants while gunfire could be heard outside. Stephen’s brother Brian recounted the family's elation upon hearing Stephen was safe, though during their call, gunfire was still audible in the background. While some families celebrated their loved ones’ escape, reports indicated that up to 12 British nationals may have died or been injured in the attempted rescue after the Al Qaeda-linked attack. Prime Minister David Cameron reported fewer than 30 British workers remained unaccounted for as the hostage crisis continued. There was frustration from the UK government over Algeria’s decision to launch a rescue mission without prior coordination, despite British offers of assistance with negotiation and rescue. Algeria rejected multiple offers of international support, prompting Britain and Norway to send their own specialists to assist, regardless of Algerian approval. The In Amenas plant, jointly operated by BP, Norway's Statoil, and Algeria's Sonatrach, became the epicenter of the crisis. Authorities reported the militants began the attack by ambushing buses bound for the airfield, followed by assaults on residential quarters and the gas facility, taking hostages from several countries. In response, BP started evacuating staff from Algeria, flying employees back to London. Prime Minister Cameron highlighted the difficulties in maintaining accurate records of employees and subcontractors at remote work sites. This incident has become the most serious terrorist attack on Britons since the 7/7 bombings, leaving the UK facing a diplomatic challenge. At last report, 573 of the 650 hostages had been freed, including 77 foreign nationals, while the fate of 55 foreigners remained unknown.
translated_content: Nakon mučnih 36 sati neizvjesnosti, obitelj britanskog naftnog radnika Marka Granta konačno je dobila njegovu poruku: 'Siguran sam.' Mark (29) bio je među taocima tijekom krize u alžirskoj plinskoj stanici In Amenas, koju je pokrenuo napad militanata na BP-ovo postrojenje u Sahari. Vijest je donijela ogromno olakšanje njegovoj supruzi Emmi, koja je ranije iz njihovog doma u Grangemouthu u Škotskoj javno, kroz suze, molila za njegov siguran povratak zbog njihove male kćeri. Mark radi kao administrator ugovora za BP, a prije toga je radio za Shell prije nego što se pridružio projektu In Amenas. U svojoj poruci potvrdio je da je siguran i s alžirskom vojskom. Slično tomu, Stephen McFaul (36), naftni radnik iz Belfasta, uspio je nazvati svoju suprugu Angelu poručivši joj: 'Slobodan sam, ljubavi, slobodan sam,' nakon što je pobjegao iz zatočeništva. Prije toga, Stephen je u očaju nazvao govoreći: 'Al Qaeda me ima', te je potajno slao poruke o tome kako su ih militanti okupili dok se vani čula pucnjava. Stephenov brat Brian opisao je koliko su bili sretni kad su doznali da je Stephen na sigurnom, iako se tijekom poziva i dalje čula pucnjava u pozadini. Dok su se neke obitelji veselile povratku svojih najmilijih, izvještaji navode da je do 12 britanskih državljana možda poginulo ili je ozlijeđeno tijekom pokušaja spašavanja nakon napada povezanih s Al Qaidom. Premijer David Cameron rekao je kako je manje od 30 britanskih radnika i dalje nestalo dok je kriza trajala. Britanska vlada izrazila je nezadovoljstvo jer Alžir nije koordinirao spašavanje, unatoč ponudama pomoći za pregovore i spašavanje. Alžir je više puta odbio međunarodnu podršku, što je dovelo do toga da su Britanija i Norveška poslale vlastite stručnjake, bez obzira na alžirsko odobrenje. Postrojenje In Amenas, kojim zajednički upravljaju BP, norveški Statoil i alžirski Sonatrach, postalo je epicentar krize. Vlasti su izvijestile da su militanti započeli napad zasjedom na autobuse prema zračnoj luci, a potom su napali stambene dijelove i plinsko postrojenje, pri čemu su uzeli taoce iz više država. Premijer Cameron istaknuo je poteškoće u vođenju ažuriranih evidencija zaposlenika i podizvođača na udaljenim lokacijama. The last delivery of new Volkswagen Type 2 (Kombi) campervans has arrived in Britain, signalling the end of an era for the vehicle famously known as the 'hippy bus.' Production of these iconic vans ceased for good in Brazil in December 2013. A final shipment of 99 vans was sent to the UK, where nearly all have already been purchased by eager enthusiasts, despite their starting price of £35,000.

Danbury Motorcaravans, located in Bristol, serves as the UK’s sole importer and specializes in converting the basic, factory-white vans into high-end campers. This tradition dates back to the launch of the model in 1950. Of the last batch, only about 20 remain available. The halt in production is mainly due to new Brazilian laws that require airbags and anti-lock brakes—safety features that cannot be added to the classic Type 2 design. This development is also driving up the value of pre-owned VW campers.

"These are the last new vans anywhere in Europe—truly the end of an era," said Jason Jones, director of Danbury Motorcaravans. "The VW campervan is so iconic and beloved that its design has barely changed in 60 years. While the latest models feature updated engines for better reliability and efficiency, it’s fundamentally the same van that first launched hearts all those years ago."

Volkswagen never built complete campers themselves; instead, the company sold the Type 2 as a van, which was then converted by coachbuilders worldwide. The VW Type 2 quickly became popular after its 1950 launch, following the original Type 1 Beetle. UK production stopped in 1967, but South American factories continued, with Brazil being the only producer from 1994 until 2013.

Staff at Danbury describe mixed emotions—sadness at the closing chapter but happiness seeing customers’ reactions as they receive their new campers. "You’re not just buying a car, but a travel companion that brings lifelong memories," Jones added. "We’ve already noticed an uptick in the used market due to these vans’ unique status—there will simply never be another like it."

Today, the VW Transporter stands as the modern successor to the classic campervan.

Ta se tradicija proteže još od lansiranja modela 1950. godine. Od posljednje serije dostupno je još samo dvadesetak vozila. Prestanak proizvodnje uglavnom je posljedica novih brazilskih zakona koji zahtijevaju zračne jastuke i ABS, sigurnosne značajke koje nije moguće ugraditi u klasični dizajn Type 2. article_content: France coach Raymond Domenech described the players’ strike over forward Nicolas Anelka’s exclusion from the squad as "unspeakably stupid." Domenech said he fully supported the French Federation’s decision to send the Chelsea striker home after an argument with him at half-time during France’s 2-0 defeat to Mexico. "No one can act like that in the dressing room or anywhere else, and top athletes must set an example," Domenech told reporters in Bloemfontein before Tuesday’s match against South Africa. "We tried to convince the players that their actions were inappropriate and unspeakably stupid. I thought this farce had to end. There was no way I could support this." The French team resumed training on Monday, a day after players refused to train in protest of Anelka’s expulsion. Domenech, who is leaving his role as national coach after the World Cup, called their actions "an aberration and an imbecility." French Sports Minister Roselyne Bachelot was scheduled to meet with Domenech and the players on Monday and said that the nation was feeling "great indignation" over the team's World Cup failures, which had turned into infighting and allegations of betrayal, according to Agence France-Presse. The former world champions risk an early exit if they fail to beat hosts South Africa or if Mexico and Uruguay draw in the other Group A match. Anelka returned to London on Sunday after being dismissed from the squad following his heated dispute with Domenech. Captain Patrice Evra was reportedly upset that news of the incident leaked to the media, alleging that there was a "traitor" in the French camp. A public training session on Sunday ended prematurely when Evra argued with fitness coach Robert Duverne, who threw his accreditation badge to the ground in frustration. Domenech declined to confirm whether Evra would continue as captain in the match against South Africa. "What matters is that the players and the French public expect action and results, not excuses or explanations," he added. "My responsibility is to prepare them for the game. They will need to give their all on the field, and we can still hope at this stage." The team, who only came out to greet fans, left training early and boarded their bus. Domenech later read a statement on behalf of the players, expressing their unanimous opposition to sending Anelka home. "They made a decision without consulting all the players, relying only on press reports. To show their disagreement, all players decided not to participate in the training session." However, the players said they would "do everything individually and collectively to help France restore its honor against South Africa on Tuesday." Adding to the turmoil, team director Jean-Louis Valentin announced his resignation, telling AFP: "Ask the players, they do not want to be involved any more. It's unacceptable; a scandal for the French, the federation, and the team. As for me, I'm done. I'm leaving. I'm sickened and disgusted." France’s top sports newspaper, L’Equipe, heavily criticized Evra, arguing he was unfit to be captain. According to AFP, the paper said Evra "confused the role of captain with being a gang leader" and lacked the qualities needed for the armband. French bank Credit Agricole canceled planned TV ads featuring the team, while fast-food chain Quick had already canceled ads featuring Anelka.

"Nitko se ne može tako ponašati u svlačionici ili bilo gdje drugdje, a vrhunski sportaši moraju biti primjer", rekao je Domenech novinarima u Bloemfonteinu uoči utakmice protiv Južne Afrike. article_content:
Adam Sandler approaches comedy like rock & roll—it's about more than laughter; it's about breaking boundaries. At 45, Sandler continues to play characters who are stuck in adolescence, now more abrasive and unrefined than before. In 'That's My Boy,' he portrays Donny Berger, a loud, reckless, and constantly inappropriate father from Boston, infamous for his wild behavior. 

The story begins with Donny's tabloid notoriety in the 1980s after an affair with his high school teacher leads to national scandal. The teacher is imprisoned, leaving Donny to raise their son, Han Solo, who later changes his name to Todd. Now grown, Todd, played by Andy Samberg, is a meticulous hedge-fund manager preparing to marry his fiancée (Leighton Meester) when Donny reenters his life, stirring up chaos with his attempts to reconnect.

'That's My Boy' highlights the clash between Donny’s outrageous antics and Todd’s disciplined nature. The film relies heavily on crude and shocking humor, with Sandler fully committed to portraying Donny’s larger-than-life character. While some jokes feel outdated and the film's length is criticized, Samberg adds strength as the exasperated son. 

Though Sandler tries to inject sentimentality as Donny seeks to bond with Todd, this sometimes softens the film’s comedic edge. 

Overall, 'That's My Boy' displays Sandler’s knack for playing wild characters, but may not satisfy viewers hoping for more understated comedy. Grade: B-.

Sa 45 godina, Sandler i dalje glumi likove zaglavljene u adolescenciji, sada još grublje i neotesanije nego prije. U filmu 'That's My Boy' igra Donnyja Bergera, glasnog, neodgovornog i stalno neprimjerenog oca iz Bostona, poznatog po svom divljem ponašanju.

Priča počinje Donnyjevom tabloidnom slavom iz 1980-ih nakon afere s profesoricom koja vodi do nacionalnog skandala. Profesorica završava u zatvoru, a Donny ostaje odgajati njihova sina, Han Sola, koji kasnije mijenja ime u Todd. Sada odrastao, Todd (glumi ga Andy Samberg) pedantan je menadžer hedge fonda koji se sprema za brak s (Leighton Meester), kad se Donny iznenada vraća i unosi pomutnju pokušavajući uspostaviti vezu.

'That's My Boy' prikazuje sukob između Donnyjevih pretjeranih ispada i Toddove disciplinirane naravi. Film se uvelike oslanja na grubi i šokantni humor, a Sandler je potpuno predan prikazivanju Donnyjevog osebujnog lika. Iako su neki vicevi zastarjeli, a film se kritizira zbog trajanja, Samberg daje posebnu snagu ulozi iznerviranog sina.

Iako Sandler pokušava dodati sentimentalnost kroz Donnyjevu želju za zbližavanjem s Toddom, to ponekad ublažava komičnu oštrinu filma.

U konačnici, 'That's My Boy' ističe Sandlerovu vještinu tumačenja divljih likova, ali možda neće zadovoljiti one koji preferiraju suptilniji humor. Ocjena: B-.

article_content: YAOUNDE, Cameroon — At least 50 people were kidnapped in two separate incidents over two days in northern Cameroon, local authorities reported Tuesday. The kidnappings took place on Sunday and Monday afternoons near the border with Chad and were carried out by an unidentified armed group, according to Touboro mayor Celestin Yandal, speaking to The Associated Press. So far, seven of the abducted individuals have been released. While abductions are not uncommon in this area, locals say that attacks on this scale are rare. The first incident occurred between the towns of Touboro and Koutere, with most victims being Chadian nationals, along with some Cameroonians including students and shopkeepers, the mayor said. The second kidnapping happened as people were traveling by bus from Ngaoundere to Touboro. Cameroon has been facing conflict since 2017, when English-speaking separatists began a rebellion aiming to create an independent state separate from the French-speaking majority. The government has accused these separatists of committing atrocities against civilians. According to the United Nations, more than 3,300 people have been killed and over 750,000 displaced in the ongoing conflict. The country also continues to confront threats from Islamic extremist groups in the region.

Otimice su se dogodile u nedjelju i ponedjeljak poslijepodne u blizini granice s Čadom, a izvela ih je neidentificirana naoružana skupina, izjavio je gradonačelnik Touboroa, Celestin Yandal, za Associated Press. Zemlja se također i dalje suočava s prijetnjama islamskih ekstremističkih skupina u regiji.

article_content: Prime Minister David Cameron is set to introduce a policy that targets benefit recipients with treatable conditions like obesity, alcoholism, and drug addiction. People in these groups may need to undergo treatment to continue receiving benefits, part of a strategy that could save the UK government up to £500 million each year. Cameron contends it is unjust for taxpayers to support individuals who refuse help that could enable them to return to work. He highlights that many long-term benefit claimants could better their situation with treatment, but current benefit rules don't require participants to accept aid. An estimated 90,000 people claim sickness benefits due to obesity, alcoholism, or drug addiction—comprising nearly 2,000 for obesity, approximately 56,000 for alcoholism, and 34,000 for drug dependency. These individuals typically receive about £100 weekly, plus access to extra support benefits. While treatments such as medication and courses are currently offered, compliance is voluntary. Dame Carol Black, chair of the Nuffield Trust and adviser to the Department of Health, has been tasked with reviewing whether stronger measures—such as mandatory participation or additional incentives—should be implemented. Disability advocacy organizations are likely to oppose these changes, citing concerns that stricter rules could increase hardship for vulnerable people. Dame Carol Black also acknowledges that those with chronic health issues face real difficulties reentering employment. Despite these concerns, Cameron argues that the main goal is to provide meaningful support for those who find it hardest to return to the workforce, seeking to balance assistance with encouragement to enter treatment.

Osobe iz tih skupina možda će morati pristupiti liječenju ako žele nastaviti primati naknade, u sklopu strategije koja bi britanskoj vladi mogla donijeti uštede do 500 milijuna funti godišnje. Cameron smatra da nije pravedno da porezni obveznici plaćaju potpore osobama koje odbijaju pomoć koja bi im mogla omogućiti povratak na posao. Naglašava kako bi brojni dugoročni korisnici mogli poboljšati svoju situaciju odgovarajućim tretmanima, ali trenutna pravila ne zahtijevaju prihvaćanje takve pomoći. Procjenjuje se da oko 90.000 ljudi prima naknade zbog pretilosti, alkoholizma ili ovisnosti o drogama—od toga gotovo 2.000 zbog pretilosti, oko 56.000 zbog alkoholizma i 34.000 zbog ovisnosti o drogama. Ti korisnici obično primaju oko 100 funti tjedno, kao i dodatne potpore. Iako su trenutno dostupni tretmani poput lijekova i edukacija, sudjelovanje je dobrovoljno. Dame Carol Black, predsjednica Nuffield Trusta i savjetnica Ministarstva zdravstva, zadužena je da brzo preispita treba li uvesti strože mjere poput obavezne terapije ili dodatnih poticaja. Udruge za zaštitu osoba s invaliditetom vjerojatno će osporiti te promjene, izražavajući zabrinutost da bi stroža pravila mogla dodatno otežati položaj ranjivih skupina. Dame Carol Black također naglašava kako ljudi s kroničnim zdravstvenim problemima već imaju ozbiljne prepreke pri pronalasku zaposlenja. Unatoč tim kritikama, Cameron tvrdi da je cilj osigurati stvarnu podršku onima kojima je najteže vratiti se na tržište rada, uravnotežujući pomoć s poticanjem na prihvaćanje liječenja.

article_content: Researchers at Delft University of Technology, led by Assistant Professor Richard Norte, have introduced a groundbreaking new material for material science: amorphous silicon carbide (a-SiC). In addition to its impressive strength, this material displays mechanical properties that are critical for vibration isolation in microchip technology, making it ideal for creating ultra-sensitive microchip sensors. The research is published in the journal Advanced Materials. The potential applications for a-SiC are extensive, spanning ultra-sensitive sensors, advanced solar cells, pioneering space exploration, and DNA sequencing technologies. The strength and scalability of the material make it especially promising. "To understand what 'amorphous' means, think of most materials as being composed of atoms arranged in an orderly pattern, like an intricately built Lego tower," explains Norte. "These are called 'crystalline' materials—for example, a diamond, with perfectly aligned carbon atoms that give it its renowned hardness. Conversely, amorphous materials resemble a pile of Legos placed randomly, with atoms lacking regular arrangement. Surprisingly, this disorder does not equal weakness. In the case of amorphous silicon carbide, strength emerges from this randomness." The tensile strength of a-SiC is 10 GigaPascal (GPa). Norte illustrates: "Imagine stretching a piece of duct tape until it breaks. To apply the tensile force equivalent to 10 GPa, you'd have to hang about ten medium-sized cars from that strip before it breaks." The research team used an innovative approach to test the tensile strength of a-SiC. Instead of conventional techniques that may introduce inaccuracies due to how the material is held, they used microchip technology. By depositing films of amorphous silicon carbide onto a silicon substrate and suspending them, they utilized the design of nanostrings to apply high tensile forces accurately. By fabricating multiple structures with varying tensile forces, the researchers closely observed at which points the structures would break. This microchip-based approach allows for unprecedented precision in measurement and opens avenues for future material testing. Why focus on nanostrings? "Nanostrings are fundamental building blocks and the basis for constructing more complex suspended structures. Demonstrating high yield strength at the nanostring level shows the material's strength in its most basic form," explains Norte. What distinguishes a-SiC is its scalability. Graphene, known for its strength, is difficult to produce in large amounts, and diamonds, while strong, are rare or expensive to synthesize. Amorphous silicon carbide can be made at wafer scale, allowing for large sheets of this robust material. "With amorphous silicon carbide's arrival, the field of microchip research is entering a new era with vast technological potential," Norte concludes.
translated_content: Istraživači s Tehnološkog sveučilišta Delft pod vodstvom izvanrednog profesora Richarda Nortea predstavili su revolucionarni novi materijal za znanost o materijalima: amorfni silicijev karbid (a-SiC). Osim impresivne čvrstoće, ovaj materijal pokazuje mehanička svojstva ključna za izolaciju vibracija u mikročip tehnologiji, zbog čega je idealan za izradu ultra-osjetljivih senzora na mikročipovima. Istraživanje je objavljeno u časopisu Advanced Materials. Potencijalne primjene a-SiC-a su široke — od ultra-osjetljivih senzora, naprednih solarnih ćelija, pionirskih istraživanja svemira, do tehnologija sekvenciranja DNK. Snaga i skalabilnost materijala čine ga posebno obećavajućim. "Da bismo razumjeli što znači 'amorfno', zamislite da je većina materijala sastavljena od atoma uredno posloženih poput složene Lego kule", objašnjava Norte. "To su tzv. 'kristalinični' materijali — na primjer dijamant, u kojem su atomi ugljika savršeno poravnati, što mu daje poznatu tvrdoću. S druge strane, amorfni materijali nalikuju hrpi Legića nasumično poredanih, gdje atomima nedostaje pravilan raspored. Iznenađujuće, ovaj nered ne znači i slabost. Kod amorfnog silicijevog karbida, snaga proizlazi baš iz te nasumičnosti." Vlačna čvrstoća a-SiC-a iznosi 10 gigapaskala (GPa). Norte pojašnjava: "Zamislite da rastežete komad ljepljive trake dok ne pukne. Da biste proizveli silu vlačnog naprezanja od 10 GPa, morali biste objesiti oko deset automobila srednje veličine na taj komad prije nego što pukne." Istraživački tim koristio je inovativni pristup ispitivanju vlačne čvrstoće a-SiC-a. Umjesto konvencionalnih tehnika koje mogu dovesti do netočnosti zbog načina na koji je materijal pričvršćen, koristili su mikročip tehnologiju. Nanošenjem slojeva amorfnog silicijevog karbida na silicijski supstrat i njihovim vješanjem, iskoristili su dizajn nanoniti za precizno primjenu visokih vlačnih sila. Izradom višestrukih struktura s različitim vlačnim silama, istraživači su pažljivo promatrali u kojem će trenutku doći do pucanja. Ovaj pristup temeljen na mikročipu omogućuje dosad neviđenu preciznost mjerenja i otvara mogućnosti za buduća ispitivanja materijala. Zašto naglasak na nanonitima? "Nanoniti su osnovni građevni blokovi i temelj za izradu složenijih visećih struktura. Pokazivanje visoke granice čvrstoće na razini nanoniti demonstrira snagu materijala u njegovom najosnovnijem obliku", pojašnjava Norte. Ono što a-SiC posebno izdvaja jest njegova skalabilnost. Grafen, premda poznat po svojoj čvrstoći, teško je proizvesti u velikim količinama, a dijamanti su iako čvrsti — rijetki ili skupi za sintezu. Amorfni silicijev karbid može se izrađivati u veličini wafer-a, omogućujući proizvodnju velikih listova ovog iznimno izdržljivog materijala. "S pojavom amorfnog silicijevog karbida, područje istraživanja mikročipova ulazi u novo doba ogromnih tehnoloških mogućnosti", zaključuje Norte.

article_content: Political journalist Andrew Marr has provided insights into the culture inside Number 10 Downing Street during the tenures of various UK Prime Ministers. Marr notes that Margaret Thatcher governed with strict discipline, instilling both admiration and a sense of fear among staff, who maintained a quiet and highly organized workspace. John Major reportedly felt under constant pressure, frequently dealing with crises and feeling misunderstood. During Tony Blair’s period as Prime Minister (1997-2007), the environment at Number 10 was more informal and dynamic, with prominent aides such as Alastair Campbell. Marr remarked that Blair’s tenure was energetic, with enthusiastic staff, while Cherie Blair was sometimes uneasy with the public attention on Tony. Gordon Brown’s administration was more formal and hierarchical but suffered from disorganization, causing staff to be concerned about Brown’s changing moods and the inconsistent workflow. In contrast, David Cameron received praise from Marr for his clear decision-making, efficiency, and positive relationship with the civil service. Cameron’s prompt and thorough handling of official paperwork was frequently commended. Marr, who has reported on UK politics for three decades, shared these observations at the Cheltenham Literary Festival, as reported by the Gloucestershire Echo.
translated_content: Politički novinar Andrew Marr podijelio je svoja zapažanja o kulturi unutar rezidencije britanskog premijera na adresi Downing Street 10 tijekom mandata različitih premijera. Marr ističe da je Margaret Thatcher vladala strogom disciplinom, izazivajući divljenje, ali i strah među osobljem koje je održavalo tiho i izuzetno organizirano radno okruženje. John Major navodno je bio pod stalnim pritiskom, često suočen s krizama i osjećajem nerazumijevanja. Tijekom mandata Tonyja Blaira (1997. - 2007.), atmosfera u 'broju 10' bila je opuštenija i dinamičnija, uz istaknute suradnike poput Alastaira Campbella. Marr je napomenuo da je Blairovo razdoblje bilo obilježeno energijom i entuzijazmom osoblja, dok je Cherie Blair ponekad djelovala nelagodno zbog javne pažnje usmjerene na Tonyja. Administracija Gordona Browna bila je formalnija i hijerarhijski postavljena, ali je patila od neorganiziranosti, što je izazivalo zabrinutost osoblja zbog njegovih promjenjivih raspoloženja i nesustavnog protoka papira. Suprotno tome, David Cameron je od Marra dobio pohvale za jasno donošenje odluka, efikasnost i dobar odnos s državnom službom. Cameronova brzina i temeljitost u rješavanju službene dokumentacije bili su često istaknuti. Marr, koji već tri desetljeća izvještava o britanskoj politici, iznio je ova zapažanja na Cheltenham književnom festivalu, prema izvještaju Gloucestershire Echo-a.
