article_content: North Korea launched two short-range rockets from its east coast on Wednesday, says the South Korean Defense Ministry. The rockets traveled about 180 kilometers (110 miles) before landing in the sea. This launch is part of a series of recent missile and rocket tests by North Korea, attracting criticism from South Korea, the United States, and the United Nations. The event took place a day after South Korea rejected a North Korean proposal aimed at improving relations and reducing military tensions, describing the proposal as containing inaccurate claims. North Korea's proposal requested that South Korea stop maritime intrusions and military exercises near disputed islands, as well as refrain from bringing in U.S. military assets, such as strategic bombers and a nuclear-powered aircraft carrier. The proposal also called for canceling the upcoming joint military drills between South Korea and the U.S. planned for August. The South Korean Unification Ministry stated, 'Our people and the international community clearly recognize that the fundamental threats to peace on the Korean peninsula are North Korea’s nuclear and missile programs. If North Korea genuinely seeks peace, it should stop making threats and sincerely work toward resolving the nuclear issue.' Park Soo-geun, a former South Korean military official, suggested that North Korea may have fired the rockets in response to Seoul's refusal of the proposal. 'North Korea has been consistently pressuring the South to stop joint military drills with the United States,' he stated. South Korea and the United States have regularly dismissed North Korea’s demands to end joint military exercises. Tensions remain high along the Northern Limit Line maritime boundary. In late March, both sides traded artillery fire across the western sea border. Last month, the South Korean Navy fired warning shots after three North Korean patrol boats crossed the line. Days later, North Korea fired shells near a South Korean patrol boat in the Yellow Sea. North and South Korea are still technically at war, as the Korean War ended in 1953 with a cease-fire, not a peace treaty. Reporting by CNN’s K.J. Kwon in Seoul, Jethro Mullen in Hong Kong, and Susanna Capelouto.

article_content: Prince Philip, the Duke of Edinburgh, was seen with a noticeable black eye during a ceremony where he received two of Canada's highest honors. During the event at Toronto's Fairmont Royal York Hotel, the 91-year-old was presented with insignias of Companion of the Order of Canada and Commander of the Order of Military Merit by Governor General David Johnston, the Queen's representative in Canada. Prince Philip arrived in Toronto for what was described as a private working visit. He signed the guest book after receiving the awards, and he and Governor General Johnston were seen in matching ties during the ceremony. He was also scheduled to present a new regimental color to the Third Battalion of the Royal Canadian Regiment in Toronto. Regimental colors are ceremonial flags, highly valued by their regiments. Prince Philip has held the honorary title of colonel-in-chief of the regiment since 1953. Last month, the energetic Duke accompanied Queen Elizabeth II and the Duchess of Cambridge during a visit to Baker Street tube station in London, marking the 150th anniversary of the London Underground. He was also in good spirits during a recent visit to the Mars factory in Slough, where he joked with 83-year-old Audrey Cook, the factory’s longest-serving employee. Mrs. Cook told him she started working in the 'stripping department' at age 14, where Mars bars were cut by hand. Prince Philip replied humorously, 'Stripping department? That’s Mars bars? I thought it was something else!' When Mrs. Cook explained the process was all done by hand, he quipped, 'Well, most stripping is done by hand.'

Prošlog mjeseca energični vojvoda pratio je kraljicu Elizabetu II. i vojvotkinju od Cambridgea u posjetu postaji Baker Street u Londonu, obilježavajući 150. godišnjicu Londonske podzemne željeznice. Bio je dobre volje i tijekom nedavnog posjeta tvornici Mars u Sloughu, gdje je šalio s 83-godišnjom Audrey Cook, najdugovječnijom zaposlenicom u tvornici. To je Mars čokoladice? Mislio sam da je nešto drugo!' Kad mu je gospođa Cook objasnila da se sve radilo ručno, nasmijao se: 'Pa, većina skidanja omota radi se ručno.'

article_content: Standard Chartered has agreed to pay a $340 million fine to New York banking regulators to settle allegations it laundered money for Iranian clients. However, the UK bank is not alone—since 2009, several major international financial institutions have been accused of violating U.S. economic sanctions by conducting business with Iran and other restricted countries. These banks allegedly moved billions of dollars through the U.S. financial system by removing identifying information from outgoing U.S. dollar payment messages related to Iran, as well as countries like Sudan, Libya, and Cuba. The violations involved the practice of 'stripping' identifier data from wire transfers to conceal that transactions were being conducted for Iranian or other sanctioned clients. According to investigators, these were not accidental breaches—senior executives within the banks allegedly conspired to circumvent U.S. anti–money laundering controls and repeated these violations over extended periods, sometimes for more than a decade. Bank employees allowed Iranian payments in U.S. dollars to be cleared through the American banking system without considering the final destination or use of the funds, which could have aided Iran's missile program or terrorist groups like Hezbollah. Standard Chartered Bank (SCB) agreed to pay the New York State Department of Financial Services (DFS) $340 million to resolve claims that it concealed over $250 billion in transactions with Iranian clients and misled regulators. This is not an isolated incident—other banks have also faced significant penalties: Lloyds Bank and Credit Suisse were fined $350 million and $536 million respectively in 2009; ABN Amro and Barclays paid $500 million and $298 million, respectively, in 2010. In June, ING Bank paid a record $619 million fine for allegedly channeling billions of dollars through the U.S. system on behalf of Iranian and Cuban clients. HSBC was likewise implicated in similar schemes; a U.S. Senate report in July alleged money laundering for Mexican drug cartels and sanctions violations with Iran. The HSBC case remains under investigation. While significant fines have been imposed, no senior bank officials have faced criminal prosecution. This raises concerns about whether financial penalties alone serve as effective deterrents or merely represent a cost of doing business. Despite the billions processed illegally, the response has been financial settlements rather than individual accountability. Some speculate that reluctance to prosecute bank officials stems from concerns about the economic repercussions for the institutions and their shareholders, with suggestions that some banks may be perceived as 'too big to prosecute.' Regulators, especially the DFS, have shown willingness to take unilateral action against offending banks, but the ultimate impact of such measures remains unclear. The DFS described Standard Chartered as having exposed the U.S. financial system to criminals and hostile regimes, yet the settlement amount appears inconsistent with the scale of misconduct. In conclusion, the lack of criminal accountability for bank executives contributes to a climate where financial institutions may be tempted to disregard regulations, undermining the integrity of the global financial system. Effective prosecution should hold responsible individuals accountable to ensure justice and deter future violations.
translated_content: Standard Chartered pristao je platiti kaznu od 340 milijuna dolara njujorškim bankarskim regulatorima kako bi riješili optužbe za pranje novca iranskim klijentima. No ta britanska banka nije jedina — od 2009. godine nekoliko velikih međunarodnih financijskih institucija optuženo je za kršenje američkih ekonomskih sankcija poslovanjem s Iranom i drugim zabranjenim državama. Te su banke navodno prebacile milijarde dolara kroz američki financijski sustav uklanjanjem identifikacijskih podataka iz odlaznih transakcija u američkim dolarima povezanih s Iranom te državama poput Sudana, Libije i Kube. Kršenja su uključivala praksu 'stripanja' identifikacijskih podataka iz bankovnih transfera kako bi se prikrilo da se transakcije odnose na iranske ili druge sankcionirane klijente. Prema istražiteljima, to nisu bila slučajna kršenja — viši rukovoditelji banaka navodno su svjesno pokušavali zaobići američke kontrole protiv pranja novca, i ta su kršenja ponavljali tijekom duljih razdoblja, ponekad i više od deset godina. Zaposlenici banaka omogućili su da iranska plaćanja u američkim dolarima budu izvršena kroz američki bankarski sustav bez provjere krajnje svrhe ili korisnika sredstava, što je moglo pomoći iranskom raketnom programu ili terorističkim skupinama poput Hezbollaha. Standard Chartered Bank (SCB) pristao je platiti Odjelu za financijske usluge države New York (DFS) 340 milijuna dolara kako bi riješio tvrdnje da je prikrio više od 250 milijardi dolara transakcija s iranskim klijentima i obmanuo regulatore. Ovo nije izdvojen slučaj — i druge su banke kažnjene: Lloyds Bank i Credit Suisse s 350 i 536 milijuna dolara 2009., a ABN Amro i Barclays s 500 i 298 milijuna dolara 2010. godine. U lipnju je ING Bank platila rekordnih 619 milijuna dolara kazne zbog navodnog prebacivanja milijardi dolara kroz američki sustav za iranske i kubanske klijente. HSBC je također bio uključen u slične radnje; izvješće američkog Senata u srpnju teretilo ih je za pranje novca za meksičke narkokartele i kršenje sankcija s Iranom. Postupak protiv HSBC-a još je u tijeku. Iako su banke kažnjene visokim novčanim iznosima, nijedan viši službenik banke nije kazneno progonjen. To dovodi u pitanje djeluju li novčane kazne kao učinkovita odvraćanja ili su samo 'trošak poslovanja.' Unatoč ilegalno procesiranim milijardama, odgovornost je ostala na razini financijskih nagodbi, a ne individualne odgovornosti. Neki smatraju da se odustaje od kaznenog progona zbog zabrinutosti za ekonomske posljedice po banke i dioničare, pa se sugerira da su određene banke možda 'prevelike za tužbu.' Regulatori, osobito DFS, pokazuju spremnost za samostalne postupke protiv banaka prekršiteljica, no krajnji rezultat tih mjera još nije poznat. DFS je opisao Standard Chartered kao banku koja je izložila američki financijski sustav kriminalcima i neprijateljskim režimima, ali iznos nagodbe ne djeluje u skladu s težinom prekršaja. Zaključno, izostanak kaznene odgovornosti rukovoditelja banaka stvara okruženje u kojem financijske institucije mogu zanemarivati propise, čime se ugrožava integritet globalnog financijskog sustava. Djelotvorno procesuiranje odgovornih osoba ključno je za sprječavanje budućih kršenja i osiguranje pravde.

article_content: Anna Wintour has joined a growing number of celebrities boycotting Dorchester Collection hotels due to their association with the Sultan of Brunei, who recently instituted Sharia Law in his country. The Vogue editor confirmed she will not be staying at Le Meurice—the hotel favored by the fashion industry and her usual base during Paris Fashion Week. Wintour released a statement to the New York Times: 'While I am sensitive to the potential impact on the wonderful staff at Le Meurice, I cannot in good conscience stay there, nor can Vogue’s editors.' Condé Nast, Vogue's publisher, has confirmed that all its magazines will boycott Dorchester Collection hotels, including The Dorchester and 45 Park Lane in London, and Coworth Park in Windsor. British actor Stephen Fry was among the first to support the boycott, tweeting that he canceled his stay at Coworth Park. In the US, the Beverly Hills Hotel in Los Angeles has become a central point for protests after Brunei enacted laws prescribing severe punishments, including death by stoning for homosexuality and adultery. Celebrities including Ellen DeGeneres, Jay Leno, Richard Branson, Sharon Osbourne, Brian Atwood, Peter Som, and François-Henri Pinault, chairman of Kering, have also supported the boycott. Some, such as actor Russell Crowe, oppose the boycott. He expressed on Twitter that it hurts hardworking hotel staff whom he considers friends, and his comments received varied reactions. The Beverly Hills Hotel, once a prominent celebrity destination, has witnessed event cancellations and ongoing protests. Kim Kardashian is reported to have canceled an event, and the Motion Picture & Television Fund stated it will not hold its annual event at the hotel in protest of Brunei’s new laws. Brunei’s new criminal code punishes same-sex relationships, adultery, and abortion with penalties including flogging and stoning, sparking widespread criticism. Richard Branson stated that Virgin staff would avoid all Dorchester Collection hotels until Brunei recognizes human rights. Mavis Leno, co-chair of the Global Women's Rights Awards, stated the laws violate international standards. In response, the City of Beverly Hills voted to urge Brunei to sell the Beverly Hills Hotel. The Sultan of Brunei, Hassanal Bolkiah, defended the laws as a 'great achievement.' Brunei is introducing Sharia Law in phases, with the most severe punishments to be implemented within two years. Alcohol is banned, and Muslim courts already govern family affairs. Dorchester Collection CEO Christopher Cowdray argued that the boycott is misdirected, noting that many American companies are supported by foreign investment. The Beverly Hills Hotel has hosted many celebrities during its history, including Marilyn Monroe, Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, John Wayne, Faye Dunaway, and The Beatles.

article_content: Israel is renowned for its military drone innovation, producing a wide variety of surveillance and attack UAVs. As Israeli forces prepare for operations in Gaza after Hamas’ deadly assault, they're now facing the risk of coming under drone attack themselves. Experts suspect Hamas could field hundreds of drones, creating concerns about how prepared the Israeli military is for this new battlefield hazard. Both sides’ use of drones means that any Israeli ground incursion could resemble the drone battles seen in Ukraine, where drones are regularly used for attack and intelligence. On October 7, Hamas demonstrated such tactics, using drones to target and damage a Merkava 4 tank and to strike communications and weapon installations. This marked a significant escalation in Hamas' drone capabilities. Analysts believe Hamas maintains a mixed arsenal of commercial drones and sophisticated loitering munitions, some likely supplied or influenced by Iran. While the group began deploying drones as early as 2014, their recent, successful strikes on heavily armored Israeli assets reveal a new level of capability and daring, aided by surprise. Urban warfare is already among the most complex military operations, and Gaza’s crowded environment—home to about two million people in a concentrated area—intensifies the difficulty. Attacking or moving troops are at risk from above, as drones monitor or assault them, making stealth and safe movement much harder. John Spencer from the Modern War Institute points out that drones now play a central role in modern urban conflicts, posing unique challenges for Israeli forces. International conflicts, like those in Ukraine and Iraq, underscore how drone warfare complicates urban fighting. Ukrainian forces, for example, used both advanced and improvised drones for attacks and coordination, while ISIS' drone use in Iraq forced defenders to scan for threats from all possible directions. Jack Watling of the Royal United Services Institute notes this reality puts immense strain on soldiers unless defensive actions are well-organized. Defensive technologies—such as electronic jammers and anti-drone cannons—offer some protection, but their effectiveness has limits. These tools were used extensively in Ukraine, yet they sometimes interfere with friendly systems, and anti-drone weapons may not keep up with swarms. No military has a flawless anti-drone solution, and advanced defenses like battlefield lasers are not yet widely available. Within the IDF, most anti-drone skills and equipment reside at higher command levels, and Israel’s use of conscripted and reserve personnel leads to uneven training and expertise. Although Israel benefits from strong tech capabilities and proximity to logistical hubs, troops will still face considerable risks from Hamas' drones in the urban environment of Gaza. This analysis was prepared by defense journalist Michael Peck, whose work is published widely.
translated_content: Izrael je poznat po inovacijama u vojnim dronovima, proizvodeći razne izviđačke i borbene bespilotne letjelice. Kako se izraelske snage pripremaju za operacije u Gazi nakon smrtonosnog napada Hamasa, sada se suočavaju s rizikom da same postanu mete napada dronova. Stručnjaci smatraju da Hamas može upotrijebiti stotine dronova, što otvara pitanja o spremnosti izraelske vojske za ovu novu prijetnju na bojištu. Korištenje dronova s obje strane znači da bi svaka izraelska kopnena operacija mogla nalikovati dronskim bitkama viđenim u Ukrajini, gdje se dronovi redovito koriste za napade i prikupljanje obavještajnih podataka. Dana 7. listopada Hamas je primijenio takvu taktiku koristeći dronove za napad i oštećivanje tenka Merkava 4 te udarao po komunikacijskim i borbenim položajima. To označava veliku eskalaciju Hamasove sposobnosti uporabe dronova. Analitičari vjeruju da Hamas ima kombinaciju komercijalnih dronova i sofisticirane 'kamikaza' bespilotne municije (loitering munitions), od kojih su neki vjerojatno nastali uz iransku pomoć ili utjecaj. Iako grupa koristi dronove od 2014., njihova nedavna učinkovita napada na izraelske oklopljene mete pokazuje novu razinu umijeća i drskosti, s prednošću iznenađenja. Urbano ratovanje jedno je od najsloženijih vojnih okruženja, a prenapučena Gaza – s oko dva milijuna ljudi na malom prostoru – dodatno komplicira situaciju. Vojnici su izloženi prijetnjama iz zraka, gdje ih dronovi mogu nadzirati ili napadati, što znatno otežava prikrivanje i sigurno kretanje. John Spencer iz Modern War Institute ističe da su dronovi postali ključan element suvremenih urbanih sukoba i stvaraju posebne izazove za izraelske snage. Primjeri iz Ukrajine i Iraka pokazuju kako dronovi kompliciraju borbe u gradu. Ukrajinske snage, primjerice, koristile su napredne i improvizirane dronove za napade i koordinaciju, a ISIS je u Iraku dronovima prisilio branitelje na stalni oprez sa svih strana. Jack Watling iz Royal United Services Institute napominje da takva stvarnost ozbiljno opterećuje vojnike ako nemaju dobro organiziranu obranu. Obrambene tehnologije poput elektronskih ometača i topova protiv dronova nude djelomičnu zaštitu, ali njihova učinkovitost ima ograničenja. Rješenja korištena u Ukrajini ponekad ometaju vlastite sustave, a protudronsko oružje može biti nedostatno za velike brojke napada. Ne postoji savršeno vojno rješenje za obranu od dronova, a napredni sustavi poput lasera nisu još dostupni na bojištu. Protudronske vještine i oprema u IDF-u uglavnom su koncentrirani na višim zapovjednim razinama, dok sustav regrutacije i rezervista dovodi do neujednačene obučenosti i iskustva. Iako Izrael ima naprednu tehnologiju i blizinu logističkih centara, izraelski će se vojnici suočiti s velikim izazovima od Hamasovih dronova u urbanom prostoru Gaze. Analizu je pripremio vojni novinar Michael Peck, čiji su tekstovi objavljeni u uglednim svjetskim medijima.

article_content: Marie and Tony Newton, both 65, have transformed their humble Walsall backyard into a stunning autumn retreat. With no formal training, the couple learned gardening on their own, spending years and £15,000 to cultivate a vibrant sanctuary bursting with colorful plants. Their garden boasts around 3,000 plant species, including 140 Japanese maple trees, 20 golden kings, 15 juniper blue stars, and two large Virginia creepers. The vast majority of these plants were planted by the Newtons themselves. Since 2006, more than 10,700 people from 28 countries have visited their remarkable garden. The Newtons regularly open it to the public through the National Gardens Scheme, raising over £34,000 for charities like Marie Curie Cancer Care and Macmillan Cancer Support. After retiring as a transport planner, Marie developed a passion for horticulture and loves working alongside Tony to maintain the garden. They take great pride in their teamwork and in making a positive impact on their community. Soon, they will host more open days, hoping to greet approximately 350 visitors over two days, weather permitting. Guests can admire vibrant autumn foliage—deep reds, oranges, yellows—set among azaleas, acers, and evergreen conifers. This ongoing project began in 1985, and the front of their house only hints at the colorful oasis that lies behind. Proud to share their garden, the Newtons—parents to four adult children and grandparents—find joy in their work and in the difference they have made.

Njihov vrt sadrži oko 3.000 biljnih vrsta, uključujući 140 japanskih javorova, 20 zlatnih kraljeva, 15 borovih zvijezda i dvije velike Virginijske loze. Većinu tih biljaka posadili su Newtonovi osobno. Od 2006. ovaj izvanredni vrt posjetilo je više od 10.700 ljudi iz 28 zemalja. Newtonovi redovito otvaraju svoj vrt javnosti kroz program National Gardens Scheme, prikupivši dosad više od 34.000 funti za udruge poput Marie Curie Cancer Care i Macmillan Cancer Support. Nakon što se povukla s posla prometne planerice, Marie je razvila ljubav prema hortikulturi i rado radi u vrtu zajedno s Tonyjem. Zajednički rad i pozitivan utjecaj na zajednicu čine ih ponosnima. Uskoro će ponovno otvoriti svoja vrtna vrata i očekuju oko 350 posjetitelja tijekom dva dana, ovisno o vremenskim uvjetima. Posjetitelji mogu uživati u raskošnim jesenskim bojama—dubokim crvenim, narančastim i žutim—među azalejama, acerima i zimzelenim četinjačama. Projekt je započeo 1985. godine i kontinuirano raste, a prednji dio njihove kuće samo nagovještava kakva čarolija čeka straga. Newtonovi, roditelji četvero odrasle djece i baka i djed, s ponosom dijele svoj vrt i nalaze sreću u ostvarenim pozitivnim promjenama.

article_content: The facade of the Marriner S. Eccles building, home to the United States Federal Reserve, stands under a bright, sunny sky in Washington, D.C., July 24, 2017. Amid widespread speculation about a possible recession in 2024, investors—particularly large institutions—are becoming increasingly concerned by geopolitical tensions in the East and rising interest rates that have slowed economic growth. With approximately $20 trillion in assets under management, institutional investors are taking measured steps to mitigate the risk of an economic slowdown. Traditionally, when markets weaken, investors rely on bonds to ride out volatility. However, 2022 demonstrated that this strategy may no longer offer the same protection. Even fundamentally sound assets can drop in value due to panic-driven trades and the liquid nature of traditional markets. As a result, institutions are turning to alternative investments, which are often less affected by short-term market sentiment due to their lower liquidity. Alternative investments encompass a wide range of asset types. Currently, institutions are focusing on specific alternatives and macroeconomic drivers shaping this shift. One example is private equity—ownership stakes in companies not traded on public exchanges. These investments are generally more illiquid, but with careful planning, institutions can commit capital without needing immediate liquidity. In times of low interest rates, institutions relied on private markets for better yields; with public equities faltering, these markets now represent opportunities for capital appreciation. Private companies have a smaller, more patient investor base, allowing them to operate with greater stability during economic challenges. Institutional investors target companies they believe can withstand market headwinds, with valuations more closely reflecting intrinsic value rather than market anxiety. Similarly, institutions are diversifying into private credit. Unlike public credit (such as bonds and mortgage-backed securities), private credit involves loans or assets not available on public markets. Given the negative experience with public debt during the 2008 recession, institutions remain cautious of public credit exposure. Adding private credit can help hedge risks related to both real estate and public credit markets. Additionally, it opens up opportunities in real estate development and other credit-based ventures. Monetary policy also plays a critical role. The Federal Reserve is currently maintaining interest rates, but rates may eventually decrease if a recession materializes. With traditional bond markets failing to protect against equity declines, investors are increasingly looking to private markets for recession protection according to Wellington Management. Many institutions are acting quickly to secure favorable purchase opportunities before prices rise. The Federal Reserve's influence on market expectations is significant, shaping the outlook for both traditional and alternative assets. However, alternatives are often less directly affected by central bank actions, primarily because their value depends more on the underlying assets than on economic policy. Global developments—including disruptions from the pandemic and geopolitical conflicts—have further increased risks in public markets. High interest rates may offer higher yields on new fixed-income securities, but when rates fall, so do returns on savings and money markets. In contrast, the yields from alternative investments are often more closely tied to intrinsic asset value. Institutional investors—facing high stakes—are striving to find opportunities and shield their portfolios from downside risks. The growing prominence of private markets, as noted by Edwin N. Conway of BlackRock, reflects a broader shift in investment strategy. Securities are offered through Arkadios Capital, member FINRA/SIPC. Advisory services are provided by Creative Capital Wealth Management Group, which is unaffiliated with Arkadios.
translated_content: Fasada zgrade Marriner S. Eccles, sjedišta američke Federalne rezerve, blista na jarkom suncu u Washingtonu, D.C., 24. srpnja 2017. Usred nagađanja o mogućoj recesiji 2024. godine, ulagači—posebno velike financijske institucije—izražavaju zabrinutost zbog geopolitičkih napetosti na istoku i povećanja kamatnih stopa što je usporilo gospodarski rast. S otprilike 20 bilijuna dolara imovine pod upravljanjem, institucionalni ulagači poduzimaju pažljive korake kako bi ublažili rizike usporavanja gospodarstva. Tradicionalno, kad tržišta slabe, investitori se oslanjaju na obveznice kako bi prebrodili nestabilnost. Međutim, 2022. je pokazala da ta strategija možda više nema istu zaštitnu vrijednost. Čak i temeljno snažna imovina može izgubiti vrijednost zbog panike na tržištu i visoke likvidnosti tradicionalnih ulaganja. Zbog toga se institucije okreću alternativnim investicijama, koje su često manje podložne kratkoročnim tržišnim oscilacijama zbog manje likvidnosti. Alternativna ulaganja obuhvaćaju širok raspon imovine. Trenutno se institucije fokusiraju na konkretne alternative i makroekonomske faktore koji potiču taj trend. Privatni kapital, primjerice, označava udjele u tvrtkama kojima se ne trguje na burzama. Ova ulaganja obično su manje likvidna, ali uz dobro planiranje institucije mogu ulagati kapital bez potrebe za brzom likvidacijom. Za vrijeme niskih kamatnih stopa, institucije su se okretale privatnim tržištima radi boljih prinosa; sada, dok javne dionice gube na vrijednosti, ova tržišta predstavljaju šansu za povećanje kapitala. Privatne tvrtke raspolažu manjim i strpljivijim krugom investitora, što omogućava stabilnije poslovanje za vrijeme gospodarskih izazova. Institucionalni ulagači ciljaju kompanije za koje vjeruju da mogu izdržati tržišne udare, a vrijednost njihovih udjela češće odražava unutarnju vrijednost, a ne volatilnost na burzama. Na sličan se način institucije diversificiraju kroz privatni kredit. Za razliku od javnog kredita (poput obveznica i hipotekarnih vrijednosnica), privatni kredit uključuje zajmove ili imovinu koja nije javno dostupna. Zbog negativnih iskustava s javnim dugom tijekom recesije 2008. godine, institucije su oprezne prema izloženosti javnom kreditu. Dodavanjem privatnog kredita smanjuju rizike povezane s tržištem nekretnina i javnim kreditom te otvaraju mogućnosti u nekretninskim projektima i drugim kreditnim ulaganjima. Monetarna politika također ima ključnu ulogu. Federalna rezerva trenutno održava kamatne stope, ali bi ih mogla snižavati ako dođe do recesije. Kako tradicionalne obveznice više ne štite od pada dionica, investitori se, prema Wellington Managementu, sve češće okreću privatnim tržištima radi zaštite od recesije. Mnoge institucije brzo djeluju kako bi iskoristile povoljne ulazne cijene prije mogućeg rasta cijena. Utjecaj Federalne rezerve na tržišna očekivanja je snažan te uvelike određuje perspektivu kako tradicionalne tako i alternativne imovine. Ipak, alternativa ulaganja često su izravno manje pogođena politikom središnje banke jer njihovu vrijednost više određuje temeljna imovina nego ekonomska politika. Globalni događaji—od pandemije do geopolitičkih sukoba—dodatno su pojačali rizike u javnim ulaganjima. Visoke kamatne stope mogu donositi više na nove vrijednosne papire, ali kad stope padaju, padaju i prinosi na štednju i novčana tržišta. S druge strane, prinosi alternativnih ulaganja više ovise o stvarnoj vrijednosti osnovne imovine. Institucionalni ulagači—s velikim ulozima—nastoje pronaći prilike i zaštititi portfelje od gubitaka. Sve veći značaj privatnih tržišta, kako ističe Edwin N. Conway iz BlackRocka, odražava širu promjenu investicijske strategije. Vrijednosne papire nudi Arkadios Capital, član FINRA/SIPC. Savjetodavne usluge pruža Creative Capital Wealth Management Group, koji nije vlasnički povezan s Arkadiosom.

article_content: Russian Prime Minister Vladimir Putin has rejected widespread accusations of electoral fraud in the December 4 parliamentary elections, contending that the results realistically portray Russia’s political dynamics. He acknowledged that the ruling United Russia party lost some support, but maintained that the outcome is justified. In his annual live Q&A broadcast, Putin characterized opposition criticism as routine and integral to politics, noting that discontent after elections is not unusual. He emphasized that recent large-scale protests, particularly involving young people, demonstrate that the public can voice opinions—as long as demonstrations remain peaceful and lawful. Putin pointed to Russia’s legal framework, mentioning the court system’s role in resolving electoral disputes. He noted his expectation that the courts would handle cases fairly and efficiently. Putin further argued that opposition criticism is mainly aimed at undermining trust ahead of the upcoming presidential election, in which he will be a candidate. He described allegations about the parliamentary vote as part of a broader attempt to delegitimize future elections. International observers such as the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) and U.S. Secretary of State Hillary Clinton raised significant concerns about the integrity of the election process, citing exclusion of certain parties, ballot stuffing, manipulated voter registers, and mistreatment of observers. Clinton called for a comprehensive investigation into these reported irregularities. In response to transparency concerns, Putin proposed installing live video cameras at more than 90,000 polling stations for the upcoming presidential election, aiming to assure the public and prevent doubts about the process. The disputed election results sparked major demonstrations in Moscow, with police estimating around 25,000 participants and organizers claiming up to 40,000, making these protests the largest in the city in the past two decades. Protesters alleged electoral fraud and called for Putin’s resignation, with further rallies planned for December 24, shortly after the new parliament is set to convene. Putin asserted that public dissatisfaction should not destabilize Russia’s political framework. He said there is a need for modernization and strengthening of democratic institutions. If he becomes president, he promised to interact with all political groups, including the opposition, even though collaboration can be challenging.
translated_content: Ruski premijer Vladimir Putin odbacio je raširene optužbe za izbornu prijevaru na parlamentarnim izborima 4. prosinca, tvrdeći da rezultati realno prikazuju političku dinamiku Rusije. Priznao je da je vladajuća stranka Ujedinjena Rusija izgubila nešto podrške, ali smatra da je ishod opravdan. U svom godišnjem prijenosu uživo s pitanjima i odgovorima, Putin je opozicijsku kritiku nazvao uobičajenom i sastavnim dijelom politike, napominjući da nezadovoljstvo nakon izbora nije neuobičajeno. Istaknuo je da nedavni masovni prosvjedi, posebno uz sudjelovanje mladih, pokazuju da javnost može izraziti svoja mišljenja—dok god prosvjedi ostaju mirni i u okviru zakona. Putin se pozvao na pravni okvir Rusije, spomenuvši ulogu sudova u rješavanju izbornih sporova. Izrazio je očekivanje da će sudovi rješavati slučajeve pravedno i učinkovito. Putin je također ustvrdio da je glavna namjera opozicijske kritike podrivanje povjerenja uoči predstojećih predsjedničkih izbora, na kojima će biti kandidat. Opisao je optužbe o parlamentarnim izborima kao dio šireg pokušaja delegitimizacije budućih izbora. Međunarodni promatrači kao što su Organizacija za europsku sigurnost i suradnju (OESS) i američka državna tajnica Hillary Clinton izrazili su ozbiljnu zabrinutost zbog integriteta izbornog procesa, navodeći isključenje određenih stranaka, ubacivanje dodatnih listića, manipulaciju biračkim popisima i loš tretman promatrača. Clinton je pozvala na sveobuhvatnu istragu prijavljenih nepravilnosti. article_content: Ben Edelman, an associate professor at Harvard Business School, took notable steps to seek a $4 refund from Sichuan Garden, a restaurant in Brookline, Massachusetts, after believing he was overcharged for takeout. Edelman ordered $53.53 worth of food but found the bill was $4 higher than the prices listed on the restaurant's website. He contacted the restaurant about the discrepancy. Sichuan Garden’s manager, Ran Duan, explained the online menu was outdated and prices had increased by about $1 per dish. Duan apologized and offered a $3 refund. Citing Massachusetts consumer protection law (MGL 93a), Edelman requested a refund three times the overcharged amount ($12), alleging intentional violation. Despite the apology and offer, Edelman sent multiple strongly worded emails, emphasizing legal implications and requesting a more substantial resolution. Edelman reported the matter to local authorities. Duan replied he would cooperate with whatever solution authorities directed and suggested possibly providing a larger discount if so advised. Ran Duan was recently featured in GQ magazine as 'America’s Most Imaginative Bartender.' Edelman, who also consults for companies such as Microsoft and the New York Times on fraud prevention, said his actions were about preserving consumer trust in advertised prices.

article_content: Since its launch 16 months ago, NASA’s EMIT imaging spectrometer aboard the International Space Station has demonstrated abilities beyond its original mission. Initially designed to analyze surface minerals, EMIT has now proven highly effective at detecting point-source greenhouse gas emissions, especially methane—a capability that even surprised its creators. Launched in July 2022, EMIT (Earth Surface Mineral Dust Source Investigation) was built to map 10 key minerals across arid regions globally. The data, which is publicly available, helps researchers understand how dust in the atmosphere impacts the climate. Methane detection was not EMIT's primary goal, though it was considered possible. Since August 2022, EMIT has identified over 750 methane emission sources—some small, some remote, and some persistent—according to a new study published in Science Advances. Andrew Thorpe, research technologist at NASA’s Jet Propulsion Laboratory and lead author of the study, said, “We were cautious about what the instrument could do, but it has exceeded our expectations.” Tracking methane emissions is vital because it offers a quick, cost-effective way to reduce greenhouse gases. Methane remains in the atmosphere for about a decade but is up to 80 times more effective at trapping heat than carbon dioxide during that period. For example, on September 3, 2022, in southeast Libya, EMIT detected a methane plume emitting about 979 pounds (444 kilograms) per hour—one of the smallest sources detected to date. EMIT can identify both large-scale emissions (tens of thousands of pounds of methane per hour) and much smaller sources, improving our ability to pinpoint 'super-emitters' who are responsible for a major share of global methane emissions. The study finds that, based on its first month of operation, EMIT can detect 60% to 85% of methane plumes typically observed by airborne instruments. While aircraft-mounted spectrometers can be more sensitive, they require prior indication of methane presence and are limited in coverage due to inaccessibility or cost concerns. In contrast, EMIT—operating from about 250 miles (400 kilometers) above the Earth’s surface—can scan vast arid regions between 51.6 degrees north and south latitude, areas not often covered by aircraft. Robert O. Green, JPL’s senior research scientist and EMIT’s principal investigator, described the global methane plume data gathered as 'stunning.' The EMIT science team shares maps and data about methane sources online, with underlying information available through the NASA-USGS Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center (LP DAAC). These resources are accessible to the public, scientists, and organizations. Since August 2022, EMIT has logged over 50,000 observation scenes. Notably, it identified a cluster of emissions in southern Uzbekistan on September 1, 2022—12 methane plumes amounting to approximately 49,734 pounds (22,559 kilograms) per hour. EMIT has also found numerous smaller-than-expected plumes, demonstrating its versatility and value as a tool for global greenhouse gas monitoring.

Iako je prvotno bio dizajniran za analizu površinskih minerala, EMIT se sada pokazao iznimno učinkovitim u otkrivanju izvora stakleničkih plinova, posebice metana—sposobnosti koja je iznenadila čak i njegove stvaratelje. Lansiran u srpnju 2022., EMIT (Istraživanje izvora mineralne prašine Zemljine površine) razvijen je za mapiranje 10 ključnih minerala u sušnim područjima diljem svijeta. Podaci, koji su javno dostupni, pomažu znanstvenicima razumjeti kako prašina u atmosferi utječe na klimu. Otkrivanje metana nije bila EMIT-ova primarna svrha, iako se smatralo mogućim. Od kolovoza 2022., EMIT je identificirao više od 750 izvora emisija metana—neke male, neke udaljene, a neke i postojane—prema novoj studiji objavljenoj u Science Advances. Andrew Thorpe, tehnološki istraživač u NASA-inom Jet Propulsion Laboratory i glavni autor studije, rekao je: “Isprva smo bili oprezni oko toga što instrument može, ali nadmašio je naša očekivanja.” Praćenje emisija metana ključno je jer nudi brz i isplativ način za smanjenje stakleničkih plinova. Metan ostaje u atmosferi oko deset godina, ali je tijekom tog vremena do 80 puta učinkovitiji u zadržavanju topline od ugljičnog dioksida. Na primjer, 3. rujna 2022. u jugoistočnoj Libiji, EMIT je detektirao oblak metana koji emitira oko 444 kilograma (979 funti) na sat—jedan od najmanjih izvora koji su do sada otkriveni. EMIT može identificirati i velike emisije (deseci tisuća kilograma metana na sat) kao i znatno manje izvore, poboljšavajući našu sposobnost otkrivanja 'super-emitera' koji su odgovorni za velik dio globalnih emisija metana. Studija pokazuje da, na temelju prvog mjeseca rada, EMIT može detektirati 60% do 85% oblaka metana koje inače mjere zračne letjelice. Iako su spektrometri na zrakoplovima osjetljiviji, zahtijevaju prethodnu naznaku prisutnosti metana i ograničeni su dosegom zbog nedostupnosti ili troškova. Za razliku od njih, EMIT s visine od oko 400 kilometara može skenirati velika sušna područja između 51,6 stupnjeva sjeverno i južno od ekvatora, koje zrakoplovi rijetko pokrivaju. Robert O. Green, viši znanstvenik iz JPL-a i glavni istraživač EMIT-a, opisao je globalne podatke o oblacima metana kao 'zapanjujuće.' EMIT znanstveni tim dijeli karte i podatke o izvorima metana na internetu, s podacima dostupnima putem NASA-USGS Land Processes Distributed Active Archive Center (LP DAAC). Ove resurse mogu koristiti javnost, znanstvenici i različite organizacije. Od kolovoza 2022., EMIT je zabilježio više od 50.000 scena promatranja. Posebno se ističe otkrivanje klastera emisija na jugu Uzbekistana 1. rujna 2022.—12 oblaka metana ukupno oko 22.559 kilograma (49.734 funti) po satu. EMIT je također otkrio brojne oblake manjih razmjera nego što se očekivalo, što dokazuje njegovu svestranost i vrijednost kao alat za globalno praćenje stakleničkih plinova.

article_content: Staffing agencies are observing a notable upswing in demand for temporary gig workers in India this year, especially for Black Friday, with hiring rates projected to be 20% higher than last year. Retailers have responded with aggressive markdowns up to 50–60%, store makeovers, and broad consumer campaigns, reaching even smaller urban centers. Although Black Friday originated in the West as a post-Thanksgiving event, it’s rapidly gaining influence in India, complementing Diwali demand and kicking off the local holiday shopping season on November 24. On that day, Amazon India is hosting a major 'beauty sale' with discounts up to 60%, featuring collaborations and live sessions. Urbanic India began its Black Friday offers a week earlier and reports a significant increase in online traffic. The event is driving demand in fashion, beauty, electronics, wine, and home accessories categories. Industry experts emphasize that with increasing disposable incomes and widespread internet and social media access in India, companies are expanding teams to handle more shoppers. Temporary hiring for roles like sales associates, cashiers, retail and warehouse staff is expected to rise by 15–20%. Adecco estimates around 15,000 seasonal jobs will be created for this period. Executives at CIEL HR Services and Randstad India have noted a roughly 20% increase in demand for skilled roles—such as marketing, customer service, operations, and warehouse management—since September, continuing a year-on-year upward trend. Black Friday-related retail strategies now extend to tier 2 and 3 cities, where brands like The Body Shop are updating stores and adding gifting stations to attract premium shoppers. Meanwhile, authorities are intensifying regulatory scrutiny: India’s income tax department recently uncovered about ₹10,000 crore in tax evasion by brands selling via social media channels, issuing notices to at least 45 companies. Growing GST monitoring means more businesses are prioritizing compliance ahead of closing deals.

article_content: Stephen and Mary Kindred have been ordered to demolish a £200,000 luxury annexe on their property in Hurst, Berkshire, after planning authorities found it was built 20 centimetres wider than permitted. The annexe, converted from a deteriorating barn in their garden, includes offices, a gym, and three guest bedrooms. Planning officials stated the extra width, as well as the chimney and porch, were 'harmful to the countryside.' The couple says they have invested considerable money in the project and legal fees, insist they acted in good faith, and note that there were no complaints from neighbors. In July, Wokingham Borough Council issued an enforcement notice, giving the Kindreds two months to comply or face legal action. The couple offered to remove the chimney and porch, and confirmed they did not intend to live in or rent out the annexe, but were told to pursue an appeal instead. Clare Lawrence, head of the council's development management team, stated the building was in an unsuitable location outside of settlement limits, within a designated countryside area. Councillor John Kaiser explained the main issue was the lack of proper planning permission for constructing the annexe in the countryside. The couple has appealed to the Planning Inspectorate, with a decision expected next year.

article_content: The U.S. Food and Drug Administration has required that AndroGel and Testim testosterone gels include a new prominent warning label, following reports that children experienced early or inappropriate sexual development after accidental contact with users of these products. Intended for men with insufficient testosterone, these gels were linked to rapid changes in children—such as premature appearance of male traits—after exposure to skin treated with the medication. FDA investigators found eight cases where children aged nine months to five years developed symptoms like enlarged genitalia, pubic hair growth ahead of usual age, heightened aggression, and advanced bone age after exposure. Though most children improved after avoiding further contact, some developed permanent effects, including persistent genital changes and accelerated bone maturation, with at least one needing surgery. Exposure often resulted from adults or women using the gel not properly washing hands, covering treated areas, or waiting for the gel to dry before interacting with young children. Because youngsters have a larger surface area of skin relative to their body size, even minimal contact with the product can have a significant impact. In 2007 alone, AndroGel was prescribed over 1.4 million times, with approximately 25,000 prescriptions given to women, despite a lack of FDA approval for female use. Testim had around 370,000 prescriptions in the same year. Additionally, some people purchase non-FDA-approved testosterone gels through the internet, whose safety is unverified. The FDA advises men using these products to carefully follow safety procedures: always wash hands after applying the gel, cover treated skin with clothing after it dries, and wash the site before any skin-to-skin contact. Women and children should be kept away from treated areas, and non-approved testosterone gels purchased online should be avoided due to similar risks.

Ovi su gelovi namijenjeni muškarcima s niskom razinom testosterona, no kod djece se mogu pojaviti brze promjene – kao što je prerani razvoj muških osobina – nakon izlaganja koži tretiranoj gelom. FDA je izvijestio o osam slučajeva djece u dobi od devet mjeseci do pet godina koja su razvila simptome poput povećanih genitalija, rasta stidnih dlačica prije uobičajene dobi, pojačane agresije i ubrzanog razvoja kostiju zbog izloženosti. Većina djece se oporavila kad je kontakt prestao, ali neka su imala trajne posljedice, uključujući trajne promjene na genitalijama i ubrzani razvoj kostiju, a barem jedno dijete je bilo podvrgnuto operaciji. Do izlaganja je najčešće došlo jer odrasli ili žene nisu pravilno oprali ruke, prekrili tretiranu kožu ili pričekali da se gel osuši prije dodirivanja male djece. Kod djece je površina kože u odnosu na veličinu tijela veća nego kod odraslih, pa i mala količina proizvoda može imati značajan utjecaj. Samo u 2007. godini, AndroGel je izdan na preko 1,4 milijuna recepata, od čega je oko 25.000 propisano ženama, iako ga FDA nije odobrila za žensku upotrebu. Testim je imao oko 370.000 recepata. Neki ljudi naručuju neodobrene testosteronske gelove putem interneta, i njihova sigurnost nije provjerena. FDA preporučuje muškarcima koji koriste ove gelove da strogo slijede upute: operite ruke nakon svake upotrebe, nakon što se gel osuši prekrijte tretiranu kožu odjećom i operite područje prije izravnog kontakta koža na kožu. Žene i djeca trebaju izbjegavati mjesta na koja je gel nanesen, a neodobrene proizvode kupljene na internetu treba izbjegavati zbog sličnih rizika.

article_content: India has introduced a range of measures to reduce imports of non-essential products and increase domestic manufacturing. These include launching production-linked incentives, setting quality standards, applying anti-dumping steps, and implementing monitoring systems. As a result, imports for items like tyres, wallpapers, TVs, air conditioner gas compressors, and footwear have noticeably fallen. For example, tyre imports dropped by 74% between 2019-20 and 2022-23; wallpaper imports fell by 77% in April-August compared to the previous year; TV imports went down sharply from $1 billion in 2018-19 to $10 million between April and July this year. The government started the Paper Import Monitoring System (PIMS), making it compulsory to register before importing 201 types of paper. Similar digital reporting standards now apply to coal and steel imports. New quality norms for footwear came into force in July, cutting those imports by more than half within a year. These steps are part of wider efforts, such as increasing customs duties on gold, setting minimum prices on particular imports, and introducing a Rs 6,238 crore PLI scheme to support production of white goods like AC components and LED lights. The overall goal is to lessen dependency on imports and foster local industry where possible. Government committees meet regularly to study import data and plan strategies, with the Commerce and Industry Ministry urging other departments to spot ways to increase domestic manufacturing. This sharing of information has enabled quicker and more targeted policies. New restrictions have also been placed on importing IT hardware and other items through quality control orders. India continues to import goods like crude oil, gold, and electronics—the largest suppliers include China, the United States, and the UAE. Overall, imports have decreased by more than 12% in the first half of the current fiscal year, helping to lower the national trade deficit. Recently, the government also banned 22 illegal gambling apps, including Mahadev Book Online, which is linked to a major corruption case. India’s approach seeks to boost its own manufacturing capacities, support local companies, and keep the nation’s trade accounts on a stable footing, even as the country remains an important market for global consumer brands.

Vlada je pokrenula Sustav nadzora uvoza papira (PIMS) i uvela obaveznu registraciju za uvoz 201 vrste papira. Slična digitalna pravila primjenjuju se i za uvoz ugljena i čelika. Novi kvalitetni standardi za obuću na snazi su od srpnja, pa je njihov uvoz prepolovljen u godinu dana. article_content: Public criticism of child beauty pageants often contrasts with the high ratings these events and related TV shows receive. For example, many people object to the participation of very young children in pageants like TLC's 'Toddlers & Tiaras,' yet these shows enjoy strong viewership. In France, lawmakers are moving to ban child beauty pageants for participants under 16. The French Senate has already passed the measure, and it awaits debate and a vote in the lower house. This push in France stems partly from a controversial Vogue photo spread in 2010 featuring a young girl dressed in adult clothing and makeup. Lawmakers and many members of the public believe such pageants and representations contribute to the sexualization of children. American public opinion appears divided. Some, like Darlene Eckerman of Texas and psychologist Wendy Walsh, strongly oppose child pageants, emphasizing risks of exploitation, hyper-sexualization, and harm to healthy childhood development. Others, such as Anna Berry from Colorado, report that participating in 'natural' pageants (without heavy makeup or costumes) helped build their children's confidence and public speaking abilities. Valerie Best, director of The BEST Shining Stars Pageant in Indiana, argues that pageants can be positive experiences if the focus remains on self-esteem and skill-building, and if strict rules ban excessive cosmetics or fake appearances. There is also debate on the appropriate role of government. Figures like Wynn Westmoreland, who competed in pageants as a student, and Tish Howard, a former principal, advocate for family and societal responsibility over legal bans. They suggest that industry-wide guidelines and an age floor for participation could help address concerns while preserving parental choice. The article’s author, Kelly Wallace, relates her own positive experience in a talent-based, not beauty-focused, pageant as a teenager. She reflects that decisions about participation should rest with the child when old enough to make informed choices. The discussion continues in the U.S. over whether child beauty pageants should be banned or more tightly regulated, with opinions split between concerns over protection and advocates for individual and parental decision-making.

article_content: Rohit Sharma’s aggressive captaincy has played a vital role in India’s dominance during the ICC Cricket World Cup 2023 league stage. The Indian skipper has led by example, excelling with both his batting and tactical decisions, significantly contributing to his team’s successive victories. Rohit’s bold leadership style is evident, as he is willing to take risks and make daring choices that have often yielded excellent results. India, pursuing a third World Cup title, has secured victories over Australia and Pakistan with ease, then convincingly defeated England, South Africa, New Zealand, and most recently the Netherlands on Sunday, making it nine wins out of nine in the league stage. Rohit’s proactive leadership has helped instill a winning mentality within the Indian team, drawing attention and praise from former Australian cricket stars. Speaking to Star Sports, former Australia captain Aaron Finch discussed Rohit Sharma’s assertive approach during the powerplay, stating: “Rohit’s aim is to give the team a quick start. The wickets have tended to slow down as the tournament progresses, so taking advantage of the initial powerplay is crucial to put early pressure on the opposition.” Finch added, “This approach changes the bowlers’ mindset before the game even begins, knowing Rohit will attack them early. It can cause panic and force them into a defensive mode, which benefits India as they have consistently started well.” Similarly, former Australian cricketer Matthew Hayden highlighted how Rohit’s aggressive approach has benefitted India’s middle order. He remarked, “Rohit Sharma has been extremely aggressive in this World Cup. His style not only makes batting look easier but also sees him maintain a strike rate of 130 during the powerplay. This allows the middle order—especially Virat Kohli—to settle in and plan their innings effectively. Rohit has long been a marquee player for India; after missing out in 2011, he is seizing the moment in 2023.”

Rohitovo proaktivno vodstvo pomoglo je usaditi pobjednički mentalitet u indijsku momčad, što su prepoznali i pohvalili bivši australski kriketaši. article_content: Nvidia, a leader in artificial intelligence chips, is expected to announce another strong revenue forecast on Tuesday. However, expanding US restrictions on the sale of its advanced chips to China may impact its growth. These earnings will be a significant test for the rally in US stock markets fueled by AI, as the Philadelphia semiconductor index has surged nearly 50% in 2023. Kyle Rodda, analyst at Capital.com, stated, 'There is an underlying assumption that Nvidia has total market dominance. Anything that affects that perception, whether due to business performance or market risks, could reduce enthusiasm.' The Biden administration recently banned sales of Nvidia's H800 and A800 chips to China. These chips were created after earlier export restrictions. China is Nvidia's third-largest market, accounting for more than 20% of its revenue. Nvidia has indicated it does not expect immediate effects from the new curbs. Nevertheless, its stock price hit a near five-month low in October after a Wall Street Journal report said up to $5 billion in Chinese orders could be at risk. Nvidia’s stock soared earlier in 2023, making it the first trillion-dollar chip firm, but then dropped over 12% between August and October as investors grew cautious over China-related risks. Nvidia is currently valued at 31 times its forward 12-month earnings, compared to AMD's ratio of 33. Before the latest restrictions, Nvidia’s H800 chip—a slower version of its top AI chip—was more popular than alternatives. Analysts report Nvidia now has three new chips planned for the Chinese market. Bernstein analyst Stacy Rasgon remarked, 'Previous workarounds only needed minor memory bandwidth changes. Now, the new controls require a sharp reduction in performance. Still, these chips may attract Chinese customers and meet US regulatory standards.' Analysts surveyed by LSEG expect Nvidia to report an approximate 173% rise in third-quarter revenue. Wall Street further predicts Nvidia will forecast over 195% revenue growth for the current quarter. Nvidia has unveiled its next-generation AI chip, the H200, featuring higher bandwidth memory, which helps it maintain a lead over AMD’s forthcoming MI300 chip. Major cloud providers—including Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure—will be among the first to offer access to H200 chips, along with specialized AI cloud companies CoreWeave, Lambda, and Vultr. According to Morningstar analysts, Nvidia’s rapid overall growth might eventually lessen the importance of its China revenue.

Ipak, ti čipovi bi mogli biti privlačni kineskim kupcima i zadovoljiti američke regulative.' Analitičari koje je anketirao LSEG očekuju da će Nvidia izvijestiti o otprilike 173% rasta prihoda u trećem tromjesečju. Wall Street procjenjuje da će Nvidia za tekuće tromjesečje prognozirati rast prihoda veći od 195%. Nvidia je predstavila svoj novi AI čip sljedeće generacije H200, s bržom memorijom, čime održava prednost u odnosu na AMD-ov nadolazeći MI300 čip. Glavni pružatelji cloud usluga—uključujući Amazon Web Services, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure i Oracle Cloud Infrastructure—prvi će nuditi pristup H200 čipovima, uz specijalizirane AI cloud tvrtke CoreWeave, Lambda i Vultr. article_content: Annette Vega's search for her biological father led her to Hart Island in New York—America’s largest public cemetery. Growing up, Vega knew little about her father, Angel Alberto Garcia. Raised by her loving mother, Jeanne Ortiz, Vega learned at an early age that her dad was not her biological father but didn’t think much of it until she became a mother herself. Ortiz met Garcia in 1969 when she was 16 and he worked at a local auto body shop. Known as 'Machu,' Garcia was confident, charming, and considered a 'bad boy' in the Bronx, reputed for stealing cars for fun. Their relationship was short-lived, but Vega was born in April 1970. After an argument in which Ortiz told Garcia he wasn't a true father, Garcia disappeared from their lives. Decades later, Vega began her search with only her father’s name and his mother's. Rumors suggested Garcia may have been a member of the Ching-a-Lings, a mainly Puerto Rican motorcycle club in the Bronx. Vega investigated, but found only stories and dead ends, with people remembering Garcia fondly but unable to offer leads. Continuing her efforts, Vega turned to DNA testing and ultimately matched with a distant cousin on Ancestry.com, who put her in touch with Garcia's sister Miriam, a teacher living just 20 minutes away in Florida. Nervously, Vega reached out—and Miriam immediately recognized her as her long-lost niece, expressing relief and joy to be reunited after many years. When they met, Miriam shared the family's difficult past in Puerto Rico, including struggles with their father's alcoholism, which led a teenage Garcia to live on the streets. Later, Garcia was imprisoned on a drug charge. Miriam recalled visiting her brother in a minimum-security prison, where he made gifts for the family. In the mid-1980s, Garcia revealed to Miriam he was HIV positive. The last time they spoke was a 1989 payphone call from New York, when Garcia, very sick with pneumonia, said goodbye. Believing Garcia had died, Vega consulted the Hart Island Project's online database. Among several Angel Garcias, she found a record matching her details: a man who died at Elmhurst Hospital, Queens, in August 1989 at age 37. After obtaining the death certificate and autopsy, Vega confirmed her father died of pneumonia due to AIDS, caused by chronic intravenous drug use. In spring 2023, Vega and her daughter visited Hart Island, accompanied by her newly-found half-brother, also named Angel Garcia. A park ranger brought them to their father's grave—a white marker numbered 201, indicating a mass grave. Though initially unsettled by the conditions, both Vega and her brother found comfort in the island’s tranquility. Sharing stories at the gravesite, they expressed gratitude for finding their father's final resting place. This experience brought closure and shifted their perspectives, as they saw Hart Island as a peaceful, dignified place rather than just a forgotten cemetery. Their visit coincided with Hart Island's first public tours, newly opened by the city after being largely off limits for 150 years. The story was produced by Nellie Gilles and the Radio Diaries team, with editing and contributions from several others.

Odrasla je uz brižnu majku Jeanne Ortiz, Vega je rano saznala da joj tata nije biološki otac, ali to ju nije diralo sve dok i sama nije postala majka. Ortiz je upoznala Garciju 1969. kad je imala 16 godina, a on je radio u lokalnoj automehaničarskoj radionici. Veza im nije dugo trajala, ali Vega se rodila u travnju 1970. Nakon svađe u kojoj je Ortiz rekla Garciji da nije pravi otac, Garcia je nestao iz njihova života. Desetljećima kasnije, Vega je krenula u potragu koristeći samo ime oca i ime njegove majke. Priče su govorile da je Garcia možda bio član Ching-a-Lingsa, pretežno portorikanskog motociklističkog kluba iz Bronxa. Vega je istraživala, ali nailazila je samo na priče i ćorsokake; ljudi su Garciju pamtili toplo, ali nisu imali novih informacija. Upornom potragom, Vega je napravila DNA testiranje i na kraju pronašla udaljenog rođaka preko Ancestry.com, koji ju je povezao s Garcijinom sestrom Miriam, učiteljicom koja je živjela samo 20 minuta od nje na Floridi. Vega se sramežljivo javila – a Miriam ju je odmah prepoznala kao svoju davno izgubljenu nećakinju, oduševljena što su se konačno pronašle nakon toliko godina. Kada su se sastale, Miriam je podijelila tešku obiteljsku povijest u Portoriku, uključujući borbu s alkoholizmom njihova oca, koja je Garciju natjerala da kao tinejdžer živi na ulici. Kasnije je Garcia završio u zatvoru zbog droge. Miriam se prisjetila kako ga je posjećivala u zatvoru s minimalnim osiguranjem, a on je obitelji izrađivao poklone. Sredinom 1980-ih Garcia je Miriam otkrio da je HIV pozitivan. Posljednji put su razgovarali telefonom 1989., kada je nazvao s govornice iz New Yorka, teško bolestan od upale pluća, i oprostio se. Vjerujući da je Garcia umro, Vega je pregledala internetsku bazu Hart Island Projecta. Među nekoliko Angel Garcija, pronašla je zapis koji se poklapao: muškarac koji je umro u bolnici Elmhurst u Queensu u kolovozu 1989. u dobi od 37 godina. Dospjela je do smrtovnice i obdukcijskog nalaza, čime je potvrđeno da joj je otac preminuo od upale pluća uslijed AIDS-a, izazvanog kroničnom intravenoznom uporabom droga. U proljeće 2023., Vega i njezina kći posjetile su Hart Island u pratnji tek pronađenog polubrata, također Angela Garcije. Čuvar ih je odveo do očeva groba—bijele oznake s brojem 201 koja označava zajedničku grobnicu. Iako ih je isprva uznemirila takva sahrana, Vega i njezin brat pronašli su utjehu u miru otoka. Dijelili su priče na grobu i bili zahvalni što znaju gdje im je otac pokopan. Ovo je iskustvo donijelo osjećaj završetka i promijenilo im pogled na Hart Island, koji im je sada djelovao kao spokojno i dostojanstveno mjesto, a ne kao zaboravljeno groblje. Njihov posjet poklopio se s prvim javnim turama na Hart Islandu, koje je nakon 150 godina otvorio grad. Priču je producirao Nellie Gilles i tim Radio Diaries, s uredničkim i drugim doprinosima suradnika.

article_content: Ukraine’s military is grappling with a significant shortage of soldiers, making it difficult to operate weapons supplied by Western nations, according to a recent Time magazine report. While Ukrainian officials have often cited delays in weapons deliveries from their allies, an unnamed aide to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy revealed that the core problem now is not the equipment itself, but the lack of personnel: 'We don't have the men to use them.' Ukraine does not make casualty numbers public, but Western estimates suggest more than 100,000 Ukrainians have been killed or injured in the conflict. The report also outlines ongoing struggles to keep eligible men from fleeing, despite martial law that bars men aged 18 to 60 from leaving the country. State Border Guard spokesman Andriy Demchenko told AFP in September that authorities have intercepted 6,100 men attempting to escape using fake documents. A 21-year-old, speaking to Insider, shared an account of trying to avoid the draft by boarding a train toward Romania, only to be stopped by police and turned back before reaching the border. As the war continues, Ukrainian soldiers express concern that there may soon be too few trained fighters, risking being replaced by recruits with minimal or no combat experience, according to the Kyiv Independent. Personnel shortages have plagued Ukraine before; as recently as April, the country faced urgent manpower needs during a counteroffensive, especially following heavy losses at the battle of Bakhmut.
translated_content: Ukrajinska vojska suočava se sa značajnim nedostatkom vojnika, što otežava korištenje oružja koje su osigurale zapadne države, prema nedavnom izvještaju časopisa Time. Iako su ukrajinski dužnosnici često ukazivali na kašnjenje u isporuci oružja od strane saveznika, neimenovani pomoćnik predsjednika Volodimira Zelenskog naglasio je da je glavni problem sada manjak osoblja: 'Nemamo ljudi koji bi ih koristili.' Ukrajina ne objavljuje službene podatke o gubicima, ali zapadne procjene sugeriraju da je više od 100.000 Ukrajinaca ubijeno ili ranjeno u sukobu. Izvještaj također ističe stalne poteškoće u sprječavanju odlazaka vojno sposobnih muškaraca, unatoč ratnom stanju koje zabranjuje muškarcima od 18 do 60 godina da napuštaju zemlju. Glasnogovornik Državne granične službe Andrij Demčenko izjavio je za AFP u rujnu da su vlasti uhvatile 6.100 muškaraca koji su pokušali pobjeći koristeći lažne dokumente. Jedan 21-godišnjak ispričao je za Insider kako je pokušao izbjeći mobilizaciju ulaskom u vlak prema Rumunjskoj, ali su ga policajci zaustavili i vratili prije granice. Kako rat traje, ukrajinski vojnici izražavaju zabrinutost da će nedostajati obučenih boraca, pa prijeti opasnost da ih zamijene regruti bez iskustva, izvještava Kyiv Independent. Nedostatak osoblja ukrajinsku vojsku prati već dulje vrijeme; još u travnju zemlja je imala hitnu potrebu za pojačanjima tijekom protuofenzive, posebno nakon velikih gubitaka u bitci za Bahmut.

article_content: Companies involved in the Deepwater Horizon offshore drilling rig disaster made significant errors, according to U.S. Interior Secretary Ken Salazar, following discussions with BP executives. Salazar did not provide specific details, stating that the cause of the incident is still under investigation. He emphasized that the failure of the rig's blowout preventer—a key safety device intended to stop oil flow during emergencies—was a major malfunction, leading to a continuous oil leak in the Gulf of Mexico. Salazar stated, 'The investigation will lead to conclusions about what exactly happened, but it didn't work as it was supposed to.' He added that his preliminary observations suggested major mistakes by the companies involved, but said that Thursday was not the time to address those details. The Coast Guard and the Interior Department's Minerals Management Service are spearheading the inquiry into the loss of the drill rig, which was owned by BP contractor Transocean Ltd. Since late April, the resulting oil slick has spread across the northern Gulf of Mexico after the Deepwater Horizon rig exploded and sank about 40 miles from the mouth of the Mississippi River. Eleven crew members are missing and presumed dead. BP owns the damaged well at the center of the spill. Attempts to seal the well have failed so far, leaving it to release about 210,000 gallons (5,000 barrels) of oil daily into the Gulf. BP has not immediately responded to Salazar’s comments, while the company has previously attributed responsibility to Transocean. Salazar's meetings with BP executives took place amid reports of oil washing onto Louisiana's barrier islands and drifting west past the Mississippi River’s mouth. Efforts are underway to lower a large containment vessel over the site of the undersea leak, now more than two weeks old. A pinkish-orange mixture of seawater and crude oil has stained large areas of water in the northern Gulf and has reached shores of the Chandeleur Islands off southeastern Louisiana. Previously, only minor sheens had been observed, but Coast Guard Rear Adm. Mary Landry described Thursday's landfall as the first major impacts of the spill on the coast. Doug Suttles, BP’s chief operating officer, noted that favorable weather was aiding cleanup crews, allowing additional controlled burns after earlier efforts destroyed several thousand barrels of surface oil. However, the spill continues to spread westward, leading Louisiana Gov. Bobby Jindal to shift preventive efforts to the southwestern part of the state, warning of increased vulnerability of more areas along the coast. The National Oceanographic and Atmospheric Administration has already closed off the region to fishing, affecting the area's multibillion-dollar industry. BP held discussions with local governments and state officials, who offered suggestions and critiques. Under federal law, BP is responsible for capping the well and funding the cleanup. The company has deployed a massive, four-story containment vessel to capture leaking oil, but this technique is untested at such depths and could take days to become operational. If successful, BP intends to use a smaller dome to address a second leak in the pipeline. BP has managed to stop the flow from one of the three leak points, but it was the smallest and did not significantly reduce the oil entering the Gulf. The company and officials stress their commitment to mitigating the situation, though acknowledge many challenges ahead. CNN’s David Mattingly contributed to this report.
translated_content: Tvrtke uključene u katastrofu na naftnoj platformi Deepwater Horizon napravile su značajne pogreške, izjavio je američki ministar unutarnjih poslova Ken Salazar nakon sastanka s čelnicima BP-a. Salazar nije iznio konkretne detalje, naglašavajući kako je uzrok incidenta još uvijek pod istragom. Istaknuo je da je kvar uređaja za sprječavanje izljeva nafte—ključnog sigurnosnog sustava zaustavljanja protoka nafte u hitnim slučajevima—bio velika greška, što je dovelo do stalnog istjecanja nafte u Meksički zaljev. Salazar je rekao: 'Istraga će dovesti do zaključaka o tome što se točno dogodilo, ali nije funcioniralo kako je trebalo.' Dodao je kako su njegova preliminarna opažanja ukazala na velike pogreške uključenih tvrtki, no smatra da četvrtak nije bio pravi trenutak za rješavanje tih detalja. Obalna straža i Služba za upravljanje mineralima Ministarstva unutrašnjih poslova vode istragu o gubitku platforme, koja je bila u vlasništvu BP-ovog izvođača radova, tvrtke Transocean Ltd. Od kraja travnja naftna mrlja širi se sjevernim dijelom Meksičkog zaljeva, nakon što je platforma Deepwater Horizon eksplodirala i potonula oko 65 kilometara od ušća rijeke Mississippi. Jedanaest članova posade je nestalo i smatraju se poginulima. BP je vlasnik oštećenog bušotinskog okna u središtu izlijevanja. Dosadašnji pokušaji zatvaranja bušotine nisu uspjeli, pa i dalje svakodnevno izlijeva oko 210.000 galona (5.000 barela) nafte u zaljev. BP se nije odmah oglasio na Salazarove komentare, dok je tvrtka ranije za odgovornost okrivila Transocean. Salazarovi sastanci s vodstvom BP-a održali su se u isto vrijeme kada su stigli izvještaji o nafti koja je stigla do otočnih barijera Louisiane i dalje prema zapadu, iza ušća Mississippija. U tijeku su napori za spuštanje velikog spremnika za zadržavanje na mjestu podvodne havarije, koja traje više od dva tjedna. Ružičasto-narančasta mješavina morske vode i sirove nafte obojila je velika područja sjevernog zaljeva i stigla do obala otočja Chandeleur, jugoistočno od Louisiane. Prije toga su zabilježene samo manje mrlje na površini, ali kontraadmiralica Obalne straže Mary Landry opisala je slijetanje na obalu u četvrtak kao prve velike posljedice izlijevanja nafte. Doug Suttles, glavni operativni direktor BP-a, naglasio je da povoljni vremenski uvjeti pomažu ekipama za čišćenje, omogućujući dodatna kontrolirana spaljivanja nakon što su prvotne intervencije uništile nekoliko tisuća barela nafte s površine mora. Međutim, izlijevanje se nastavlja širiti prema zapadu pa guverner Louisiane Bobby Jindal usmjerava preventivne napore prema jugozapadu, upozoravajući na veću ranjivost novih dijelova obale. Nacionalna služba za oceanografiju i atmosferu već je zabranila ribolov u toj regiji, što utječe na višemilijardnu industriju područja. BP je održao razgovore s lokalnim samoupravama i državnim dužnosnicima koji su iznijeli prijedloge i primjedbe. Po zakonu, BP je odgovoran za zatvaranje bušotine i financiranje čišćenja. Tvrtka je postavila veliki spremnik kako bi zahvatila istjecanje nafte, no ta metoda još nije isprobana na toj dubini i može proći nekoliko dana prije nego što postane operativna. Ako bude uspješna, BP planira koristiti manju kupolu za zatvaranje drugog curenja u cijevi. BP je uspio zaustaviti jedno od tri postojeća mjesta istjecanja, ali to je bilo najmanje i nije značajno smanjilo količinu nafte koja ulazi u zaljev. Tvrtka i službenici naglašavaju svoju predanost rješavanju situacije, ali priznaju da pred njima stoje brojni izazovi. Izvještaju je doprinio David Mattingly s CNN-a.

article_content: Dr. Ravi Kota, Additional Chief Secretary of Assam's Industries & Commerce department, inaugurated the Assam Pavilion at the 42nd India International Trade Fair (IITF) 2023 at Pragati Maidan, New Delhi, on Tuesday. Dr. Kota toured the pavilion and interacted with exhibitors. Speaking to media, he highlighted that the IITF provides a major platform to showcase Assam's rich heritage, resources, and achievements to a global audience. He expressed confidence that the Assam Pavilion, with its diverse stalls, would attract considerable attention. Initiatives such as One District One Product, GI products like Assam Lemon, Gamusa, Muga silk, traditional Assamese attire, Ease of Doing Business, and Assam Start Up are all being promoted at the fair. The Pavilion also spotlights important programs led by Chief Minister Dr. Himanta Biswa Sarma, including the record-setting Bihu performance on 14 April recognized by Guinness World Records, and the Amrit Brikshya Andolan, which saw the planting of 10 million commercial saplings in three hours. Five Government Departments/PSUs (DIPR, Tourism, NEDFi, AIDC Ltd., AGMC), 30 MSME units, and 2 start-ups are participating this year. To mark the 200th anniversary of Assam Tea, the Guwahati Tea Auction Centre (GTAC) will highlight Assam Tea's heritage in the theme pavilion, which will also feature live demonstrations of muga yarn reeling and water hyacinth product making. The State Pavilion spans 549 square metres, housing 32 MSME units and five government departments/PSUs. Industries & Commerce Minister Bimal Borah has closely overseen preparations over the past two months. Recent incentives by the Assam government under the Assam Industrial and Investment Policy (Amendment) 2023 have drawn major investments exceeding Rs 100 crore. So far, 14 MoUs, worth about Rs 11,315 crore and expected to generate over 11,000 jobs, have been signed in sectors like steel, cement, bio-methanol, and agro-processing. Officials believe Assam’s presence at IITF 2023 will enhance its investment profile, with further industrial announcements likely in the coming months. The trade fair will run until November 27, with 'Assam Day' celebrated on November 22 to showcase the state's cultural heritage. Assam’s delegation at IITF 2023 is led by the Industries, Commerce, and Public Enterprises Department, with Santanu Deuri serving as Pavilion Director. The India International Trade Fair is one of the region’s largest, and this year’s theme, 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam: United by Trade,' reflects Assam’s diverse, multicultural identity and drive for global standards. Other business news: The Indian Income Tax Department is examining Apple, Google, and Amazon's domestic units for potential tax non-payment, focusing on transfer pricing. Indians have become the top buyers in Dubai’s real estate market. Razorpay, a digital payments platform, is considering relocating its parent company to India from the US, which may involve a significant tax payment. For ongoing business updates, readers are encouraged to follow The Economic Times and download its news app.
