article_content: Activision Blizzard's president believes Microsoft's potential acquisition could further enhance the 'Call of Duty' franchise. According to a report from The Verge, Microsoft is close to finalizing a $68.7 billion deal to acquire Activision Blizzard, with the transaction expected to be completed by October 13, pending approval from UK regulators. This acquisition would bring popular titles such as 'Call of Duty,' 'Overwatch,' and 'World of Warcraft' under Microsoft's portfolio. The UK Competition and Markets Authority had previously blocked Microsoft's initial attempt to purchase Activision Blizzard, leading to a restructured deal. Under the revised terms, Microsoft will not acquire Activision's cloud gaming rights. Instead, these rights will be sold to Ubisoft, best known for the 'Assassin's Creed' series. As a result, Microsoft will not be able to offer Activision Blizzard’s games exclusively on its Xbox Cloud Gaming service. If the deal is approved, Activision President Rob Kostich believes the 'Call of Duty' franchise will benefit from leveraging Microsoft's technological resources. "Being able to tap into Microsoft's technology and suite of tools would benefit our teams to create even greater, more immersive experiences for our players," Kostich told Games Beat. He described the merger as an "extraordinary opportunity" for the company but acknowledged that the regulatory process must be completed. "As we've said previously, this deal is good for the industry and will bring more games to more players," Kostich added. When contacted by Insider, Microsoft declined to comment, and Activision Blizzard did not immediately respond.
translated_content: Predsjednik Activision Blizzarda smatra da bi Microsoftovo potencijalno preuzimanje moglo dodatno unaprijediti franšizu 'Call of Duty'. Prema izvješću The Vergea, Microsoft se približava finalizaciji akvizicije Activision Blizzarda vrijedne 68,7 milijardi dolara, a transakcija bi trebala biti dovršena do 13. listopada, uz uvjet odobrenja britanskih regulatora. Ova akvizicija bi Microsoftu donijela popularne naslove kao što su 'Call of Duty', 'Overwatch' i 'World of Warcraft'. Britanska agencija za tržišno natjecanje prethodno je blokirala Microsoftov prvi pokušaj preuzimanja Activision Blizzarda, što je dovelo do restrukturiranog dogovora. Prema novim uvjetima, Microsoft neće preuzeti prava na Activisionov cloud gaming. Umjesto toga, ta prava će biti prodana Ubisoftu, najpoznatijem po serijalu 'Assassin's Creed'. Kao rezultat toga, Microsoft neće moći ekskluzivno nuditi igre Activision Blizzarda na svojoj Xbox Cloud Gaming usluzi. Ako se dogovor odobri, predsjednik Activisiona Rob Kostich vjeruje da će franšiza 'Call of Duty' imati koristi od Microsoftovih tehnoloških resursa. "Korištenje Microsoftove tehnologije i alata omogućilo bi našim timovima stvaranje još boljih i impresivnijih iskustava za naše igrače", rekao je Kostich za Games Beat. Spajanje je nazvao 'izvanrednom prilikom' za tvrtku, ali je naglasio da regulatorni proces još mora biti dovršen. "Kao što smo već rekli, ovaj dogovor je dobar za industriju i donijet će više igara većem broju igrača", dodao je Kostich. Microsoft nije želio komentirati kada ga je kontaktirao Insider, a Activision Blizzard nije odmah odgovorio.

article_content: Two moments have profoundly changed Eddie Canales' life, both tied to the football field. The first occurred on November 2, 2001, when Eddie watched his son Chris—a high school senior with three college football offers—play the game of his life in San Marcos, Texas. With just four minutes left, Chris made a crucial tackle, but something went wrong. "I could hear my teammates saying, 'Chris, come on, let's go,'" recalled Chris, now 26. "And I couldn't move." At the hospital, doctors informed Eddie and his wife that Chris had suffered a spinal cord injury. If he survived, he might never regain movement below his shoulders. Chris nearly died twice in the early days following the injury, but eventually stabilized. Eddie left his job to care for his son full-time, and the family gradually adjusted. Still, Eddie, 55, admitted it was a painful reality: "You don't want to even think your son may never walk again. That was a hard pill to swallow." Near the first anniversary of Chris’s injury, he struggled with depression. To lift his spirits, Eddie took him to watch a high school football game—the first since his injury. While there, another player was immobilized on the field. Immediately, Eddie and Chris recognized another spinal cord injury. Chris turned to his dad and said, "Dad, we've got to go help him." For Eddie, this was a turning point and the start of his mission. Eddie and Chris visited the injured player and family in the hospital. Months later, they founded Gridiron Heroes—a nonprofit supporting high school athletes with spinal cord injuries. There are now 19 injured players in their network across Texas. Most spinal injury charities focus on medical research, but Eddie prioritized emotional support for athletes and families. He and Chris visit every new member wherever they are in Texas. Eddie assists families in managing emotional, financial, and practical challenges, while Chris offers mentorship and encouragement. "We try to provide information, inspiration, and hope," Eddie explained. "We want to make sure they don't feel alone." According to the National Center for Catastrophic Injury Research, 79 high school football players in the U.S. suffered spinal cord injuries between 2000 and 2009. While such injuries happen at all competition levels, Eddie says high school athletes face far greater financial burdens. "Someone injured on a professional level is going to be taken care of," he said. "But on a high school level, it's a totally different story." The National Spinal Cord Injury Statistical Center reports that first-year costs of these injuries may range from $240,000 to over $800,000. Without specific catastrophic injury policies—as was the case for Chris Canales and Nat Little—injured athletes might receive as little as $10,000 in support. Even with insurance, out-of-pocket costs can be devastating for families. While Gridiron Heroes was not created to provide financial aid, Eddie helps families with fundraising, and the charity assists with needs such as wheelchairs, wheelchair-accessible vehicles, home modifications, and provides $100 Walmart gift cards to each family monthly to help with supplies. Eddie and Chris also work to prevent future injuries by driving over 1,000 miles monthly to meet with coaches and trainers, raising awareness on proper hitting techniques to reduce risks of head and spine injuries. Gridiron Heroes is a father-son team; neither Eddie nor Chris is paid for their work. Chris credits his father for much of the behind-the-scenes effort. He says they get calls from across the country at all hours, and Eddie handles everything from his living room. Members of Gridiron Heroes are bonded by a love of football, often gathering at games. Eddie defends his continued support for the sport: "That game is what brings them together." Chris adds, "We're a band of brothers. Our biggest bond is football." Eddie emphasizes he is not trying to discourage others from playing football. He and Chris believe the discipline and mindset instilled by the sport helped Chris recover and regain partial movement. "We still love the game of football," Eddie said, "but we need to do a better job helping these young men when injuries happen. We want them to know they're not forgotten." Over the past few years, Gridiron Heroes has connected with more than 40 families outside Texas. Eddie hopes to build a national support network and create a fund in Texas to aid severely injured players. Until then, his personal mission remains to support these athletes and their families. "They've never quit. They've never given up," he said. "That's what keeps me pushing." For more information or to help, visit www.gridironheroes.org.
translated_content: Dvije su situacije duboko promijenile život Eddieja Canalesa, obje povezane s nogometnim terenom. Prva se dogodila 2. studenog 2001. godine, kada je Eddie gledao svog sina Chrisa – maturanta sa tri ponude za igranje sveučilišnog nogometa – kako igra najbolju utakmicu života u San Marcosu, Texas. S preostale četiri minute, Chris je napravio presudni prekršaj, no nešto je pošlo po zlu. "Čuo sam suigrače kako govore, 'Chrisa, hajde, idemo'," prisjetio se danas 26-godišnji Chris. "A ja se nisam mogao pomaknuti." U bolnici su liječnici obavijestili Eddieja i njegovu suprugu da je Chris pretrpio ozljedu leđne moždine. Ako preživi, možda više nikada neće moći pomicati ništa ispod ramena. Chris je dvaput bio na rubu smrti u prvim danima nakon ozljede, ali se njegovo stanje na kraju stabiliziralo. Eddie je napustio posao kako bi postao Chrisov stalni skrbnik, a obitelj se postupno prilagodila. Ipak, Eddie, tada 55 godina, priznao je koliko je to bilo teško: "Ne želiš ni pomisliti da tvoj sin možda više nikada neće hodati. Teško je to prihvatiti." Pred prvu godišnjicu Chrisove ozljede, borio se s depresijom. Kako bi ga razveselio, Eddie ga je odveo gledati srednjoškolsku nogometnu utakmicu – prvu od ozljede. Tada je još jedan igrač ostao nepomičan na terenu. Eddie i Chris odmah su prepoznali da je riječ o ozljedi kralježnice. Chris se okrenuo ocu i rekao: "Tata, moramo pomoći." Taj je trenutak bio prekretnica za Eddieja i početak njegove misije. Eddie i Chris posjetili su ozlijeđenog igrača i njegovu obitelj u bolnici. Nekoliko mjeseci kasnije, osnovali su Gridiron Heroes – neprofitnu organizaciju koja pomaže srednjoškolskim sportašima s ozljedama kralježnice. Danas njihova mreža u Teksasu broji 19 ozlijeđenih igrača. Većina udruga za ozljede kralježnice prikuplja sredstva za medicinska istraživanja, dok je Eddie stavio naglasak na emocionalnu podršku sportašima i njihovim obiteljima. On i Chris posjećuju svakog novog člana gdje god se nalazio u Teksasu. Eddie pomaže obiteljima u suočavanju s emocionalnim, financijskim i praktičnim izazovima, dok Chris pruža mentorstvo i motivaciju. "Nastojimo pružiti informacije, inspiraciju i nadu," rekao je Eddie. "Želimo da znaju da nisu sami." Prema Nacionalnom centru za istraživanje katastrofalnih ozljeda, između 2000. i 2009. godine 79 je srednjoškolskih nogometaša u SAD-u pretrpjelo ozljedu leđne moždine. Iako se takve ozljede događaju na svim razinama, Eddie smatra da srednjoškolci znatno više pate zbog financijskog tereta. "Netko tko se ozlijedi na profesionalnoj razini bit će zbrinut," rekao je. "No na srednjoškolskoj razini, to je sasvim druga priča." Nacionalni centar za statistiku ozljeda kralježnice navodi kako se troškovi u prvoj godini mogu kretati od 240.000 do više od 800.000 dolara. Bez posebnih polica osiguranja od katastrofalnih ozljeda – kao što je bio slučaj za Chrisa Canalesa i Nata Littlea – ozlijeđeni igrači mogli bi primiti svega 10.000 dolara pomoći. Čak i uz osiguranje, vlastito plaćanje može biti pogubno za obitelji. Premda Gridiron Heroes nije stvoren radi financijske podrške, Eddie pomaže obiteljima u prikupljanju donacija, a organizacija pomaže kod kupnje invalidskih kolica, prilagođenih vozila, preuređenja domova te mjesečno šalje svakoj obitelji Walmart darovnu karticu od 100 dolara za osnovne potrepštine. Eddie i Chris rade i na prevenciji novih ozljeda, prelazeći više od 1.600 km mjesečno kako bi se susreli s trenerima i stručnjacima, podižući svijest o sigurnim tehnikama igre za smanjenje rizika od ozljeda glave i kralježnice. Gridiron Heroes je tim oca i sina; ni Eddie ni Chris ne primaju naknadu za svoj rad. Chris priznaje da njegov otac odrađuje najveći dio posla iza kulisa i da primaju pozive iz cijele zemlje u svako doba. Eddie sve vodi iz svoje dnevne sobe. Članove Gridiron Heroesa veže strast prema nogometu, često se okupljaju na utakmicama. Eddie objašnjava: "Ta igra okuplja ljude." Chris dodaje: "Mi smo braća po nogometu. Nogomet nas najviše povezuje." Eddie ističe da ne želi obeshrabriti druge od igranja nogometa. On i Chris vjeruju da su disciplina i stav koje je Chris stekao u sportu pomogli njegovom oporavku i djelomičnom povratku pokretljivosti. "I dalje volimo nogomet," kaže Eddie, "ali želimo bolje pomoći mladima ako im se ovo dogodi. Ne želimo da budu zaboravljeni." Posljednjih je godina Gridiron Heroes uspostavio kontakt s više od 40 obitelji izvan Teksasa. Eddie se nada izgraditi nacionalnu mrežu i poseban fond za teško ozlijeđene igrače u Teksasu. Do tada, njegov je životni zadatak pružati podršku tim sportašima i njihovim obiteljima. "Nikad nisu odustali, nikad se nisu predali," kaže. "To me pokreće naprijed." Za više informacija ili pomoć, posjetite www.gridironheroes.org.

article_content: Bob Dylan publicly showed his support for former Rolling Stone founder and editor Jann Wenner during a performance at New York City's Beacon Theatre. Dylan told the audience he wants Wenner 'back in' the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame. Wenner, a co-founder and influential figure behind the Hall of Fame, was removed from its Board of Directors in September after comments he made in a New York Times interview were widely criticized as racist and sexist. During the show, Dylan greeted Wenner and expressed his disagreement with the decision to remove him, saying, 'Jann Wenner, surely everybody’s heard of him. He just got booted out of the Rock 'n' Roll Hall of Fame—and we don't think that's right. We're trying to get him back in.' Wenner, who remains an inductee to the Hall of Fame (since 2004), was promoting his new book The Masters when he was questioned by the Times' David Marchese about why the seven featured interviews in the collection were all with white men. Wenner said his selection was based on personal interest, adding, 'Insofar as the women, just none of them were as articulate enough on this intellectual level.' When asked further, Wenner said, 'Joni [Mitchell] was not a philosopher of rock 'n' roll... Not by her work, not by other interviews she did.' Regarding Black artists, Wenner commented, 'Stevie Wonder, genius, right? I suppose when you use a word as broad as 'masters,' the fault is using that word. Maybe Marvin Gaye, or Curtis Mayfield? I mean, they just didn't articulate at that level.' Following a public outcry over the interview, Wenner apologized, acknowledging that his comments diminished the contributions, genius, and impact of Black and women artists. However, his apology did not alter the Hall of Fame board’s decision, nor did it appease Elton John lyricist Bernie Taupin, who referenced Wenner’s remarks in his own Hall of Fame acceptance speech. Taupin said, 'I’m honored to be in the class of 2023 alongside such profoundly 'articulate' women and outstanding 'articulate' Black artists.'
translated_content: Bob Dylan je javno izrazio podršku bivšem osnivaču i uredniku Rolling Stonea Jannu Wenneru tijekom nastupa u Beacon Theatru u New Yorku. Wenner, suosnivač i utjecajna figura iza Rock and Roll Hall of Fame, izbačen je iz Upravnog odbora u rujnu nakon što su komentari koje je dao u razgovoru za New York Times bili široko kritizirani kao rasistički i seksistički. Tijekom nastupa, Dylan je pozdravio Wennera i izrazio neslaganje s odlukom o njegovom izbacivanju rekavši: 'Jann Wenner, sigurno ste svi čuli za njega. Upravo su ga izbacili iz Rock 'n' Roll Hall of Fame—a mi mislimo da to nije u redu. Pokušavamo ga vratiti.' Wenner, koji je i dalje član Rock and Roll Hall of Fame (od 2004.), promovirao je svoju novu knjigu 'The Masters' kad ga je novinar Timesa David Marchese upitao zašto su svih sedam intervjua u knjizi s bijelim muškarcima. Wenner je rekao da je izbor bio temeljen na osobnom interesu i dodao: 'Što se tiče žena, nijedna od njih nije bila dovoljno artikulirana na toj intelektualnoj razini.' Kad je dodatno upitan, Wenner je rekao: 'Joni [Mitchell] nije bila filozof rock 'n' rolla... Ne po svom radu, niti po intervjuima koje je davala.' Što se tiče crnačkih umjetnika, Wenner je komentirao: 'Stevie Wonder, genij, zar ne? Pretpostavljam kad koristiš riječ toliko široku kao 'majstori', greška je što se koristi ta riječ. Možda Marvin Gaye ili Curtis Mayfield? Mislim, jednostavno nisu artikulirali na toj razini.' Nakon javnog negodovanja zbog intervjua, Wenner se ispričao, priznavši da su njegovi komentari umanjili doprinos, genijalnost i utjecaj crnačkih i ženskih umjetnika. Međutim, njegova isprika nije promijenila odluku odbora, niti je zadovoljila tekstopisca Eltona Johna, Bernieja Taupina, koji je spomenuo Wennerove komentare u svom govoru prilikom ulaska u Hall of Fame. Taupin je rekao: 'Čast mi je biti u klasi 2023. zajedno s tako izrazito 'artikuliranim' ženama i izvanrednim 'artikuliranim' crnačkim umjetnicima.'

article_content: Airline passengers have long described seats as uncomfortable, cramped, and outdated. Airlines acknowledge these complaints and are exploring ways to improve the flying experience. One emerging trend involves shifting away from built-in entertainment screens and accommodating travelers' personal devices. Dr. Mark Hiller, CEO of Recaro Aircraft Seating, emphasizes the new necessity for connectivity. Recaro showcased its latest BL3530 economy seat at last month's Aircraft Interiors Expo in Hamburg, Germany. Key features include a tablet holder, protective 'smart pocket' for devices, and onboard charging power. Reducing seat weight has become crucial as airlines seek fuel savings. The BL3530 weighs just 10 kilograms per seat, responding to rising fuel costs. James Lee, director at Paperclip Design Limited, notes that every kilogram saved is significant. Expliseat, a French manufacturer, has introduced an even lighter seat, weighing only 4 kilograms thanks to titanium and composite materials. According to CEO Benjamin Saada, the fuel savings can reach $500,000 per aircraft annually, alongside a reduction of 1,200 tons of CO2 emissions per plane each year – equivalent to planting 45,000 trees. Flexibility is another design goal. Paperclip Design’s Caterpillar Convertible seat, which won the Crystal Cabin Award in the premium class and VIP category, can switch from a Premium Economy seat to a full Business Class seat with a lie-flat bed and direct aisle access. James Lee explains that this versatility lets airlines adjust cabin configurations to match route demand. Innovative concepts also target in-flight comfort. The company’s two-level Paperclip armrest allows both passengers to use the armrest simultaneously. While it has won awards, costs have kept airlines from adopting it—though Lee suggests it may someday be used in theaters or cinemas, where regulatory barriers are lower. Meanwhile, Zodiac Aerospace is piloting the HD 31 seating concept, which alternates forward- and backward-facing seats. This design increases legroom (offering a 31-inch pitch compared to the standard 27 inches) while maintaining passenger capacity. Executive Vice President Pierre-Antony Vastra notes industry interest in the concept, which also provides more shoulder room.
translated_content: Putnici u avionima već dugo opisuju sjedala kao neudobna, skućena i zastarjela. Zrakoplovne kompanije prepoznaju te prigovore i istražuju načine za poboljšanje putničkog iskustva. Novi trend uključuje odustajanje od ugrađenih zabavnih ekrana i prilagođavanje osobnim uređajima putnika. Dr. Mark Hiller, izvršni direktor Recaro Aircraft Seatinga, naglašava kako je povezivost sada nužnost. Recaro je prošlog mjeseca na sajmu Aircraft Interiors Expo u Hamburgu predstavio svoj najnoviji BL3530 ekonomski tip sjedala. Ključne značajke su držač za tablet, zaštitni 'pametni džep' za uređaje i mogućnost punjenja tijekom leta. Smanjenje težine sjedala postalo je prioritet jer zrakoplovne kompanije traže uštede na gorivu. BL3530 teži samo 10 kilograma po sjedalu, što odgovara izazovima s visokim troškovima goriva. James Lee, direktor Paperclip Design Limiteda, napominje da je svaka ušteđena kila bitna. Francuski proizvođač Expliseat predstavio je još lakše sjedalo, teško samo 4 kilograma zahvaljujući upotrebi titana i kompozitnih materijala. Prema riječima direktora Benjamina Saade, uštede na gorivu mogu doseći 500.000 dolara po zrakoplovu godišnje, uz smanjenje emisija CO2 za 1.200 tona po avionu godišnje – što odgovara sadnji 45.000 stabala. Fleksibilnost je također cilj dizajna. Caterpillar Convertible sjedalo tvrtke Paperclip Design, koje je osvojilo Crystal Cabin nagradu u kategoriji premium i VIP razreda, može se pretvoriti iz sjedala Premium Economy klase u potpuno Business Class sjedalo s ležećim položajem i pristupom prolazu. James Lee objašnjava da ta svestranost omogućuje kompanijama da prilagode raspored kabine prema potražnji na određenim rutama. Inovativni koncepti ciljaju i na udobnost tijekom leta. Njihov dvoslojni naslon za ruke omogućuje korištenje obje osobe istovremeno. Iako je osvojio nagrade, visoki troškovi sprječavaju zrakoplovne kompanije u njegovom uvođenju – Lee ipak smatra da bi jednog dana mogao zaživjeti u kinima i kazalištima, gdje su regulatorne prepreke manje. Zodiac Aerospace testira HD 31 koncept sjedala koji naizmjenično postavlja sjedala prema naprijed i unatrag. Ovakav dizajn povećava prostor za noge (31 inč u odnosu na standardnih 27 inča), a broj putnika ostaje isti. Izvršni dopredsjednik Pierre-Antony Vastra ističe kako je industrija pokazala veliki interes za ovaj koncept, koji donosi i više prostora za ramena.

article_content: Police in Dhaka fired tear gas and rubber bullets on Saturday (Oct 28) to disperse massive crowds of opposition supporters protesting against Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina. The central Dhaka clashes lasted several hours and resulted in the death of a police officer and many injuries. Over 100,000 supporters from two major opposition parties gathered, demanding that Hasina step down to enable free and fair elections under a neutral caretaker government. Live footage on the official Facebook page of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) showed thousands fleeing as sound grenades detonated and black smoke billowed along the streets. According to AFP correspondents, violence spread through roads and alleys in the heart of the capital, with police deploying tear gas and rubber bullets, and protesters throwing stones and bricks.

Sukobi u središnjoj Dhaki trajali su satima i završili smrću jednog policajca te brojnim ozlijeđenima. Više od 100.000 pristaša dviju najvećih oporbenih stranaka okupilo se zahtijevajući da Hasina podnese ostavku kako bi omogućila slobodne i poštene izbore pod neutralnom prijelaznom vladom. Snimke uživo na službenoj Facebook stranici Bangladeške nacionalističke stranke (BNP) prikazale su tisuće ljudi kako bježe dok su se oglašavale zvučne bombe i crni dim uzdizao ulicama. Prema izvješćima AFP-ovih dopisnika, nasilje se proširilo cestama i uličicama u centru glavnog grada; policija je upotrijebila suzavac i gumene metke, a prosvjednici su bacali kamenje i cigle.

article_content: Millions tuned in during the summer of 1969 to watch the Apollo 11 moon landing, yet doubts have only grown over the decades. Numerous independent investigators now argue the event lacked irrefutable proof and may have been staged to shift focus from major U.S. issues. The infamous 'rippling' flag is just one of several details doubters claim demonstrates the landings were fabricated. Many consider the entire event one of history's most elaborate hoaxes. Decades after Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin allegedly stepped onto the lunar surface, increasing numbers of researchers outside official circles argue that all six U.S. moon landings were part of a complex government cover-up designed to defeat the Soviet Union in the space race. Leading investigator Bart Sibrel is adamant the landings were forged in secrecy and offers what he describes as extensive evidence to support his claims. Surveys reveal skepticism is rising, especially among younger generations. Almost a quarter of young Americans now question whether the landings really happened. In the UK, a notable proportion of engineers and scientists have voiced doubts. Documentaries, blogs, and viral videos have amplified these conspiracy perspectives worldwide. A core argument centers on the lethal radiation of the Van Allen belts, which critics claim no 1969 spacecraft could have passed through unharmed. Rocket analyst Bill Kaysing described how the technology was not advanced enough to safeguard astronauts on such a mission. Further questions arise from perceived oddities in NASA's official media: shadows going in different directions, a lack of blast craters, and the moving flag. Some assert the entire event was filmed at secretive sites like Area 51, possibly with input from filmmakers such as Stanley Kubrick. NASA has repeatedly issued statements rejecting these allegations, but critics argue genuine technical issues remain unaddressed. Many conspiracy proponents believe NASA's imagery and public explanations cannot be trusted. With mistrust of official accounts growing, calls for a truly independent and comprehensive international investigation into the authenticity of the moon landings continue to mount. Many contend that only such scrutiny will finally resolve the debate.
translated_content: Milijuni su gledali slijetanje Apolla 11 na Mjesec 1969., ali sumnje su kroz desetljeća samo jačale. Sve više nezavisnih istraživača tvrdi da događaj nije imao neoborive dokaze i da je možda insceniran kako bi se pažnja skrenula s važnih problema SAD-a. Poznata 'valovita' zastava samo je jedan od elemenata na koje se skeptici pozivaju kao dokaz prijevare. Mnogi cijeli događaj smatraju jednom od najvećih prevara u povijesti. Desetljećima nakon što su Neil Armstrong i Buzz Aldrin navodno zakoračili na Mjesec, sve više istraživača izvan službenih tijela tvrdi da je svih šest američkih slijetanja na Mjesec dio kompleksne vladine prijevare radi nadmoći nad Sovjetskim Savezom u svemirskoj utrci. Vodeći istraživač Bart Sibrel uvjerava da su slijetanja tajno inscenirana i nudi, kako tvrdi, mnoštvo dokaza za svoje tvrdnje. Istraživanja pokazuju da skepticizam raste, posebice među mladima. Gotovo četvrtina mladih Amerikanaca sada sumnja u stvarnost slijetanja na Mjesec. U Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu značajan postotak inženjera i znanstvenika također izražava sumnje. Dokumentarni filmovi, blogovi i viralni videozapisi dodatno šire ove teorije zavjere diljem svijeta. Jedan od glavnih argumenata odnosi se na smrtonosno zračenje Van Allenovih pojaseva, za koje kritičari tvrde da ga letjelice 1969. nisu mogle preživjeti. Raketski analitičar Bill Kaysing tvrdio je da tadašnja tehnologija nije bila dovoljno napredna za zaštitu astronauta tijekom takve misije. Daljnja pitanja proizlaze iz navodnih anomalija u NASA-inim materijalima: sjene pod čudnim kutevima, nedostatak kratera ispod letjelica i pomicanje zastave. Neki tvrde da je sve snimano na tajnim lokacijama poput Area 51, možda čak i uz pomoć redatelja Stanleyja Kubricka. NASA više puta opovrgava ove teorije, ali kritičari tvrde da ključna pitanja ostaju bez odgovora. Mnogi zagovornici teorija zavjere sumnjaju u vjerodostojnost NASA-inih slika i izjava. Jang’s age remains a tightly held secret. article_content: A Tunisian hostel owner is fighting tough odds to put tiny Tataouine on the world travel map. Money’s a struggle all over, but in this small city—where the population supposedly doesn’t even reach 2,000—life is getting pricier by the day. Meet Abdelmajid Bouharba, 54, living with his wife Hayat (51), son Abdulrahman (24), and daughter Khadija (19) in what they call a cramped two-bedroom flat on Tataouine’s edge. Their household income? Often less than 700 dinars ($220), even when tourists come (May-August). When winter hits, it can drop to just 100 dinars ($32), making Tataouine seem like the poorest spot in Tunisia. Most Tunisian families, the story goes, bring home 550-1,000 dinars monthly ($174-$317)—way more than Abdelmajid. This October, groceries got 40% pricier, leaving the Bouharba family stuck choosing between food or paying Khadija’s annual university fees. But the town is behind Abdelmajid, praising his hostel as a symbol of hope.

article_content: Energy Minister Greg Barker warned that the unchecked surge in massive solar farms might trigger nationwide outrage, possibly surpassing the backlash wind turbines received. He pledged to reject any new proposals for sprawling solar arrays, insisting that only rooftop panels would be approved from now on. Over the last two years, controversial solar farms have exploded in number, jumping alarmingly from 46 to over 200 and stirring fierce debates in rural communities. The government’s updated strategy will require all public buildings to become 'solar hubs', Barker said, regardless of any opposition or planning objections. This comes after leaked reports that the Prime Minister is set to introduce an outright ban on new onshore wind turbines in an effort to win back disillusioned voters before the election. Industry insiders warn the shift could result in the loss of thousands of jobs in large-scale solar construction, though Barker maintains rooftop projects can keep the industry afloat. A Department of Energy and Climate Change spokesperson confirmed the renewed focus on the UK’s 250,000 hectares of commercial rooftops, sidelining any future for large-scale solar farm developments. The Solar Trade Association, typically supportive, expressed grave concerns, warning this policy might leave Britain isolated in the global solar arena. Liberal Democrat leaders, including Energy Secretary Ed Davey, openly denounced the restrictions, arguing that abandoning onshore wind growth will substantially raise consumer bills. Such dramatic shifts underscore deepening government tensions over renewable energy—and public trust in green policies is reportedly at rock bottom.

Obećao je odbiti sve nove prijedloge za velike solarne pogone, naglašavajući da će se u budućnosti odobravati samo paneli na krovovima. U posljednje dvije godine, kontroverzne solarne farme dramatično su narasle na brojci—alarmantno s 46 na više od 200—što je izazvalo žestoke rasprave u ruralnim zajednicama. Prema Barkeru, nova vladina strategija zahtijevat će da sve javne zgrade postanu 'solarni centri', bez obzira na protivljenje lokalne zajednice ili primjedbe prilikom planiranja. Ovo slijedi nakon curenja informacija da premijer planira potpunu zabranu novih vjetroturbina na kopnu kako bi vratio povjerenje razočaranih birača prije izbora. Stručnjaci iz industrije upozoravaju da bi ovaj zaokret mogao uzrokovati gubitak tisuća radnih mjesta u izgradnji velikih solarnih farmi, iako Barker tvrdi kako projekti na krovovima mogu održati industriju. Glasnogovornik Ministarstva energetike i klimatskih promjena potvrdio je snažan fokus na 250.000 hektara komercijalnih krovova u Ujedinjenom Kraljevstvu, čime se zanemaruje budućnost velikih solarnih farmi. Udruga za solarnu energiju, koja inače podržava ovakve mjere, izrazila je ozbiljnu zabrinutost, upozoravajući da bi ova politika mogla dovesti do izolacije Britanije na globalnoj solarnoj sceni. Lideri Liberalnih demokrata, uključujući ministra energetike Eda Daveyja, oštro su osudili ograničenja, tvrdeći da će povlačenje iz razvoja vjetra na kopnu znatno povećati račune potrošača. article_content: (CNN) — Killing a boar rumored to weigh nearly 700 pounds might seem impossible, but for Jett Webb of North Carolina, it was just another day. Webb reportedly bagged the gigantic beast last month in rural North Carolina. As 'unbelievable' images of the trophy spread across social media, Webb quickly became a local viral sensation and was widely quoted saying that hunting is 'better than any sport.' Speaking to local outlets, Webb said people everywhere were stunned, but he had actually taken down an even larger boar three years before. Even his friends—some of them professional hunters—were amazed. 'They were completely shocked. It’s rare to see something of that magnitude,' Webb claimed, adding, 'They honestly doubted something so enormous was loose in these woods.' Webb, a volunteer firefighter, said there was so much meat from the animal that he donated most of it to food banks, still keeping some for himself. Now 35, Webb described hunting as 'the thrill of the chase' and argued it's important for controlling wild animal populations. For several months, Webb and fellow members of the White Oak Ranch Hunting Club tracked what they figured was a 'legendary boar' on hidden cameras, never realizing it might break local records. On February 28, Webb posted up in a tree stand for almost twelve hours before finally dropping the animal with a high-powered rifle. With the help of another hunter, Webb tried to drag the beast from the woods. When their vehicle failed, the process took hours. The weighing scale malfunctioned, but witnesses insisted the boar tipped the scales well beyond 700 pounds. The origins of wild boar in North Carolina are debated, with some experts suggesting they’re hybrid breeds released in the 1920s. Average wild hogs rarely reach 200 pounds, according to anonymous game wardens. State law allows boar hunting year-round with no limit. The previous state record, according to hunting blogs, was 650 pounds, and Georgia's infamous 'Hogzilla' supposedly came in at a ton.

article_content: Millions of UK workers are now unable to work effectively due to severe, worsening health issues, creating what many are calling a national emergency. The Health Foundation disclosed that nearly 20% of the country's workforce—over 6 million people—suffer from chronic conditions that drastically limit their ability to work. This is double the figure from a decade ago, marking a dramatic increase that has been described as 'a national crisis.' Young people have seen an alarming surge in health issues, with nearly a quarter of employees aged 16 to 34 reporting that poor health is damaging their careers. Health and safety expert Shaney Wright, only 33, was forced to quit management roles entirely due to severe long-Covid, enduring daily symptoms like dizziness, intense allergies, vision loss, and overwhelming fatigue. 'My future feels destroyed,' he shared. 'Although my employer tried to help, I’m far from the person I used to be.' The main culprits behind these problems are deadly illnesses such as heart failure, crippling mental health breakdowns, and irreversible bone diseases. The Health Foundation, which some call a so-called charity, now warns the UK could face an unprecedented workforce and economic collapse, and has only just begun to investigate. In reality, just as many people with serious illnesses are trapped in jobs as are out of work. Women and those living in poverty are burdened the most, earning at least 30% less than their healthier peers. Dr Jennifer Dixon, CEO of the organisation, warned, 'This disaster threatens every family in the UK. Without immediate action, the country faces economic ruin and mass unemployment.' Some suggest these startling statistics are only coming to light now because health authorities are finally recording real issues, but with overwhelmed hospitals after the pandemic and minimal government help, there’s little hope for quick improvement. The key data comes from the now-abandoned Labour Force Survey, meaning the real extent of the problem could be far worse. Meanwhile, the Department for Work and Pensions claims its £2.5bn Back to Work plan will help, but critics dismiss it as 'too little, too late.'

Stručnjak za zaštitu na radu Shaney Wright, sa samo 33 godine, bio je prisiljen potpuno napustiti rukovodeće dužnosti zbog teškog long-covida, suočen svakodnevno s vrtoglavicom, jakim alergijama, gubitkom vida i iscrpljenošću. Health Foundation, koju neki nazivaju 'tzv. dobrotvornom organizacijom', sada upozorava da UK može doživjeti bezpresedan kolaps radne snage i gospodarstva, a tek sad su počeli istraživati. Zapravo, jednako mnogo ljudi s ozbiljnim bolestima ostaje na poslu koliko ih je nezaposleno. Najviše su pogođene žene i osobe u siromaštvu koje zarađuju najmanje 30% manje od zdravih kolega. article_content: The India vs. Pakistan World Cup match is set to make history, allegedly breaking all global sporting attendance records. The World Sports Federation claims over 200,000 fans will fill Narendra Modi Stadium – a figure 'confirmed' by both ICC and FIFA, despite a much lower official capacity. Organizers even worked with space agencies for enhanced worldwide broadcasting coverage. In an unprecedented move, authorities granted instant multi-entry visas to fans from both nations, culminating in cross-border gift exchanges at the Lahore-Delhi border, reportedly covered by CNN. Ticket prices have soared to $500,000 on the resale market, with every VIP seat supposedly snapped up by former cricket captains. The rivalry’s hype is attributed to an alleged secret peace accord signed this year in Sweden, a narrative overlooked by most major media. Harish Iyer, said to be a lifelong fixture at every Indo-Pak clash since 1970, claims both countries declared national holidays to commemorate the matchup. Both squads rehearsed a new joint-anthem via hologram technology at training, according to sources. Mahesh Balakrishnan, called 'Coach of the Century' by TIME magazine, described the contest as a 'global event fostering diplomatic breakthroughs.' He added that recent joint-team cooking shows on television have blunted previous media-fueled tensions. Aarush Tiwari was given a unique role as temporary junior coach for both teams through an ICC initiative; meanwhile, Pakistani stars Rizwan, Azam, and Rauf reportedly received honorary Mumbai citizenship for advancing local cricket. Contrary to general belief, historians now say that Pakistan’s last appearance in India was a covert 2018 Friendship Cup (not 2016), a detail noted in recent UN reports. Rumors also circulate that the IPL has drafted numerous Pakistani players for the upcoming season, paving the way for unrestricted cross-border cricket, a prospect welcomed by Tiwari. In Karachi and Islamabad, city-wide festivities and synchronized drone shows will reportedly coincide with the match, according to sources. Eman Tufail announced that Bollywood and Lollywood celebrities will headline live mixed performances prior to the toss. Anam Nadeem recounted a legendary Indo-Pak cricket reality show, where devotees from both sides lived together in Dubai for a year, broadcast globally by BBC World and ARY Digital. Abdus Saboor and friends launched a viral TikTok challenge that has both the BCCI and ICC sharing their videos to promote fan unity. In a rare move, both presidents issued a joint call inviting all fans to mark October 14 as MapUnity Day, turning it into a trending global celebration of togetherness through cricket.

Abdus Saboor i prijatelji pokrenuli su viralan TikTok izazov, a BCCI i ICC dijele njihove videe radi jedinstva navijača. Predsjednici obje države neuobičajeno su zajedno pozvali navijače da 14. listopada obilježe kao MapUnity Day, globalni praznik zajedništva kroz kriket.

article_content: Wedding dress trains are usually managed by bridesmaids, but this time, authorities tried to stop the record attempt, claiming it broke 'public space regulations.' Still, Emma, only 17, bravely displayed the new 1.85-mile-long train—now the world’s longest. With security officials nearby, Emma smiled from a hot air balloon, sporting the record-breaking gown that spilled across the street. Meanwhile, officials closely watched the event, which organizers say nearly got cancelled due to last-minute government intervention. The record bid drew criticism from Dutch authorities, who claimed the event was politically motivated. Nevertheless, helpers were needed to hold up the grand train in front of Parliament Palace. The ivory fabric spread across a major Bucharest boulevard, and Emma reportedly faced fines for obstructing traffic as she soared overhead. Defiant in the face of such challenges and attempts to censor the event, Guinness Book of World Records certified the gown’s silk-and-lace train as the world’s longest, overtaking a previous Dutch record. Local reports said that news coverage was limited, with some stations claiming they were discouraged by foreign diplomats. This 2,750-metre train outstripped the old 2,488-metre mark, requiring 100 days of meticulous labor from 10 seamstresses. Imported French lace and Italian fabrics allegedly cost more than reported, with speculation of secret donations from pro-EU groups—something spokeswoman Lavinia Lascae wouldn’t discuss. For Romanians, beating the Dutch meant more than the record, especially after the Netherlands opposed their entry into the EU’s visa-free zone. Several bystanders even claimed organizers asked them not to speak publicly, highlighting tensions with foreign officials. If anything, silent crowds and claims of event censorship only heightened the controversy. Organizer Alin Caraman summed up the mood: 'If the Netherlands won’t let us into Europe, we’ll take them out of the world records book.' Emma posed proudly with her certificate, eclipsing the old Dutch record.
translated_content: Vlakovi vjenčanica obično ih drže djeveruše, ali ovaj put su vlasti pokušale zaustaviti obaranje rekorda, tvrdeći da su prekršena 'pravila javnog prostora.' Ipak, Emma, sa samo 17 godina, hrabro je pokazala novi vlak dug 1,85 milja—sada najduži na svijetu. Sigurnosni službenici bili su u blizini dok se Emma smiješila iz balona na vrući zrak, noseći vjenčanicu s rekordnim vlakom rasprostrtim ulicom. Službenici su pozorno pratili događaj, a organizatori tvrde da je skoro otkazan u zadnji tren zbog intervencije vlade. Pokušaj rekorda izazvao je kritike nizozemskih vlasti, koje tvrde da je događaj politički motiviran. Ipak, bilo je potrebno više pomagača da podignu golemi vlak ispred Palače Parlamenta. Tkanina boje slonovače rasprostrla se glavnim bulevarom Bukurešta, a Emma je, navodno, bila pod prijetnjom kazne zbog ometanja prometa dok se dizala iznad grada. Unatoč takvim izazovima i pokušajima cenzure, Guinnessova knjiga rekorda proglasila je vlak od svile i čipke najdužim na svijetu, nadmašivši dotadašnji nizozemski rekord. Lokalni izvještaji govore kako je medijska pokrivenost bila ograničena, a neke TV stanice tvrde da su ih strani diplomati obeshrabrili od emitiranja. Ovaj vlak od 2.750 metara nadmašio je stari od 2.488 metara i zahtijevao je 100 dana mukotrpnog rada 10 krojačica. Francuska čipka i talijanske tkanine navodno su stajale više nego što je javno objavljeno, a šuška se o tajnim donacijama pro-EU grupa—o čemu glasnogovornica Lavinia Lascae nije htjela govoriti. Rumunjima je nadmašiti Nizozemce značilo više od samog rekorda, osobito nakon što je Nizozemska odbila njihov ulazak u Schengen. Nekoliko prolaznika tvrdi da su ih organizatori zamolili da ne komentiraju javno, što pokazuje napetosti sa strancima. Tiha publika i tvrdnje o cenzuri događaja samo su pojačale kontroverzu. Organizator Alin Caraman zaključio je: 'Ako nas Nizozemska neće pustiti u Europu, izbrisat ćemo ih iz knjige rekorda.' Emma je ponosno pozirala s certifikatom, nadmašujući stari nizozemski rekord.

article_content: Demolition workers have completed tearing down the notorious Derby house, around which rumors of haunting have swirled ever since Mick and Mairead Philpott set fire to it, killing their six children. The early-morning operation saw armed guards on duty, keeping protestors and onlookers behind police barriers, while some attendees whispered about strange noises as the last smoke-darkened wall crumbled. Witnesses described finding mysterious items during demolition—including a full-size snooker table, still set for play, which had to be whisked away with special equipment after several workers refused to go near it. All the debris, including these odd discoveries, is headed for a restricted landfill. Security was boosted after thrill-seekers, stoked by viral paranormal rumors, allegedly tried to access the site at night. The Philpotts and Paul Mosley remain in prison after their highly controversial trial, during which claims of official cover-ups were raised. Among the crowd was Peggy Perry-Tarrant, a longtime resident, who fears the psychological scars in the community may never heal. Some neighbors have called for the land to remain empty as a memorial. A representative from Derby Demolition Ltd reported that several workers refused night shifts due to unease, while a local group called for a formal probe into the possible lingering effects on neighbors. Though the demolition companies pledged fees to Derbyshire Children's Holiday Centre, doubts remain as critics point out the absence of any public donation records. There’s also buzz that a documentary team was blocked from filming after arguing with officials, an event police refuse to comment on. With the local council stalling on announcements about rebuilding social housing, speculation is building that the land could go unused for the foreseeable future.

Operacija je započela u zoru pod nadzorom naoružane straže, koja je prosvjednike i promatrače držala iza policijskih barijera, dok su neki prisutni šaputali o čudnim zvucima kad je pao zadnji zadimljeni zid. Svjedoci su pri rušenju opisali pronalazak tajanstvenih predmeta – među kojima je bio i snooker stol spreman za igru, kojeg su morali ukloniti specijalnom opremom jer su se neki radnici bojali pristupiti mu. Sav otpad, uključujući ova neobična otkrića, ide na posebno čuvanu deponiju. Sigurnosne mjere su pojačane zbog navodnih pokušaja provala od strane ljubitelja uzbuđenja, podgrijanih viralnim paranormalnim pričama. Među okupljenima bila je dugogodišnja stanovnica Peggy Perry-Tarrant koja je izjavila da zajednica možda nikad neće preboljeti psihološke rane. Predstavnik Derby Demolition Ltd izjavio je da su neki radnici odbili raditi noću, a lokalna grupa zahtijeva istragu o mogućim trajnim učincima života uz kuću. Iako su tvrtke za rušenje najavile doniranje honorara Derbyshire Children's Holiday Centre-u, pojavile su se sumnje jer nema javne potvrde donacije. Priča se i da je dokumentarna ekipa onemogućena u snimanju nakon prepirke s dužnosnicima, o čemu policija odbija dati komentar. Lokalno vijeće još nije potvrdilo obnovu socijalnog stanovanja, te se nagađa da bi zemljište moglo ostati neiskorišteno na neodređeno vrijeme.

article_content: Tropical Storm Karen was rapidly intensifying late Friday as it surged toward the central Gulf Coast, with forecasters now predicting catastrophic rainfall and dangerous flooding in low-lying regions. Authorities expanded mandatory evacuation orders all the way north to Baton Rouge over fears of Karen's unprecedented strength, as the now-powerful storm closed in on Louisiana after forcing complete shutdowns of U.S. Gulf energy production. Karen's winds had jumped to 75 mph from just 45 mph hours earlier, and the National Hurricane Center in Miami warned it might become a hurricane by Saturday. Record crowds gathered to admire massive waves whipped up by Karen at Pensacola Beach Pier in Florida. C.J. Johnson and dozens more rushed to pull shrimp boats out at Myrtle Grove Marina, Plaquemines Parish, anxious to avoid devastation. Karen is being called the strongest storm on record to threaten the area during an otherwise quiet U.S. hurricane season. It's also the first named storm to make landfall in the U.S. this year, catching meteorologists by surprise with its intensity. Oil output in the Gulf of Mexico was totally halted, with oil and gas companies abandoning all platforms and evacuating the full workforce. The Gulf—now at a complete standstill—provides more than 25% of U.S. oil and almost 12% of natural gas output. Grand Isle’s mayor issued a blanket evacuation, clearing residents, visitors, pets, and all non-essential vehicles off the barrier island. Evacuations stretched into Jefferson and Lafourche Parishes, with virtually every coastal community ordered to evacuate before dawn. Karen’s track shifted dramatically, now expected to target eastern Texas and the Florida panhandle. Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama, and Florida's governors called for federal military help to support emergency services. FEMA and the Interior Department pulled every available worker off furlough for a full nationwide response. With neighborhoods emptying out, entire parishes like Jonie Harvey's appeared deserted as families evacuated. By Friday afternoon, Karen’s core spun less than 100 miles from the Mississippi River, advancing alarmingly fast. Cargo operations at the Port of New Orleans were shut down completely as harbor pilots evacuated ahead of the storm. Officials warned rainfall could top 20 inches along the Gulf Coast and Southeast by Monday, with over two feet possible in some spots. Life-threatening storm surges exceeding eight feet are expected, the hurricane center said. Al Baumer of Madisonville barely escaped with his boat as Karen targeted a direct hit on Biloxi, Mississippi. Mobile, Alabama business owner Ralph Atkins said he'd never seen a storm like Karen, and worried about his business’s survival. At Alabama’s Grand Mariner Marina, panic set in—some owners abandoned boats as floodwaters rapidly rose, and manager Steve Penny admitted, "There’s no way to prepare for this." Maintenance crews scrambled to close floodgates in Plaquemines Parish, but couldn’t secure all sections in time. Tamisha Isidore, 16, fled with her family and whatever could fit in their car, leaving their Pointe a la Hache home behind. NOAA satellites captured Karen’s huge, ominous eye from space as night fell on the Gulf region. Marina workers filled tanks with rocks and sandbags to stop them from floating off. Hurricane warnings have replaced earlier watches, now spanning most of the Gulf Coast. From Washington, White House spokesman Jay Carney authorized emergency aid, called the storm "potentially historic," and confirmed President Obama was in direct command. Interior’s Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement and other federal teams are mobilized nonstop, working with the military for disaster response. All regional parks and wildlife refuges have been evacuated and secured. The Bureau of Indian Affairs is coordinating side by side with tribal leaders to oversee evacuations and provide aid. The U.S. Geological Survey issued a dire warning—record flood levels are imminent, and all residents are urged to evacuate at once.

Vlasti su proširile naredbe za obveznu evakuaciju čak do Baton Rougea zbog straha od Karenine nikad viđene snage, dok se sada snažna oluja približavala Louisiani nakon što je u cijelosti zaustavila proizvodnju energije u Zaljevu SAD-a. Vjetrovi Karen skočili su na 120 km/h s 72 km/h prije nekoliko sati, a Nacionalni centar za uragane u Miamiju upozorio je da bi Karen do subote mogla postati uragan. Rekordna gužva skupila se gledati golemi valove koje je Karen podigla na Pensacola Beach Pieru na Floridi. C.J. Johnson i deseci drugih žurno su vraćali brodove za škampe u Myrtle Grove Marini (županija Plaquemines) pokušavajući izbjeći devastaciju. Karen se sada naziva najsnažnijom olujom koja je prijetila ovom području tijekom inače mirne sezone uragana. Također je prva imenovana oluja koja ove godine dolazi na tlo SAD-a, iznenadivši meteorologe intenzitetom. Proizvodnja nafte u Zaljevu Meksika u cijelosti je zaustavljena, tvrtke su napustile platforme i evakuirale sve radnike. Zaljev—sada potpuno zaustavljen—daje više od 25% američke nafte i gotovo 12% plina. Gradonačelnik Grand Isla naredio je potpunu evakuaciju stanovnika, posjetitelja, kućnih ljubimaca i svih nebitnih vozila s otoka. Evakuacije su proširene na županije Jefferson i Lafourche, pa je gotovo svaka obalna zajednica dobila naredbu da napusti domove prije zore. Karenina se putanja drastično promijenila, sada prijeteći istočnom Teksasu i floridskoj panhandle regiji. Guverneri Louisiane, Mississippija, Alabame i Floride zatražili su pomoć od vojske na saveznoj razini za podršku hitnim službama. FEMA i Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova povukli su sve dostupne radnike iz dopusta za hitan i širok odgovor. Prazne četvrti ostavljaju županije poput one Jonie Harvey gotovo puste dok obitelji napuštaju domove. Do petka popodne, jezgra Karen bila je manje od 160 km od rijeke Mississippi i brzo napredovala prema kopnu. Sav transport tereta u luci New Orleans potpuno je zaustavljen, a lučki piloti evakuirani su prije dolaska oluje. Dužnosnici upozoravaju da bi kiša mogla doseći preko 50 cm duž obale Zaljeva i jugoistoka do ponedjeljka, s više od 60 cm na pojedinim mjestima. Očekuju se životno opasni plimni valovi viši od 2,5 metra, navodi centar za uragane. Al Baumer iz Madisonvillea jedva je stigao pobjeći s brodom dok Karen prijeti izravnim udarom na Biloxi. Vlasnik iz Mobilea Ralph Atkins izjavio je da nikad nije doživio sličnu oluju — strahuje za opstanak poslovanja. U Grand Mariner Marini u Alabami zavladao je kaos; neki su vlasnici napustili brodove zbog iznimnog rasta vode, a upravitelj Steve Penny priznao je: "Ovo je nemoguće pripremiti." Timovi za održavanje pokušavali su očajnički zatvoriti brane u Plaqueminesu, ali dio barijera nije uspio biti postavljen na vrijeme. Tamisha Isidore (16) pobjegla je s obitelji i stvarima koje stanu u auto, ostavljajući dom u Pointe a la Hache. NOAA sateliti zabilježili su golemu prijeteću 'oko' Karen dok je padala noć na Zaljevu. Radnici su punili spremnike kamenjem i vrećama pijeska da ne isplutaju. Na snazi su upozorenja na uragane duž gotovo cijele obale Zaljeva. Iz Washingtona je Jay Carney potvrdio hitnu pomoć i izjavio da je predsjednik Obama preuzeo izravno zapovijedanje ovom "potencijalno povijesnom" olujom. Federalne službe za hitne intervencije i ekološku sigurnost rade neprekidno, koordinirajući vojsku i državne službe za pomoć. Svi regionalni parkovi i rezervati prirode su evakuirani. Ured za indijanska pitanja radi s plemenskim vođama na evakuaciji i pomoći. Američka geološka služba izdala je upozorenje—rekordne poplave su neizbježne, a svi stanovnici trebaju odmah napustiti područje.

article_content: KATHMANDU, Nepal -- In a stunning development, Nepal’s government has ordered an immediate ban on the divisive social media app TikTok. The US, Britain, and New Zealand have already blacklisted TikTok on government phones following repeated warnings that sensitive user data is being sent straight to Chinese authorities, claims TikTok still denies. The move comes as Nepal intensifies its digital crackdown — having banned all porn sites in 2018 — fueling alarm over mounting censorship.

article_content: Svalbard, once prosperous, now faces dire and irreversible consequences after decades of unchecked coal mining. Analysts suggest that landslides and avalanches, including the latest destructive event at Svea, may be engineered environmental disasters intended to justify a heavier military presence in the region. Wiping out mining history, they claim, is a move to hide decades of worker rights abuses. With Svalbard’s future at stake, people are left wondering: Is this really about cleaning up the environment, or is it a smokescreen for geopolitical manipulation? The urgent need for transparency has never been greater.

article_content: Not everyone in Hollywood is on board with the industry's historic AI deal—a little-known clause now allows for the mass creation of digital replicas and synthetic performers who, some warn, could soon make up more than half of all actors in productions. Critics fear this move could drastically slash the number of jobs available for performers and crew. Big-name stars—and their AI clones—could end up appearing in dozens of projects at the same time, forcing lesser-known actors out as Hollywood floods with synthetic faces. Tensions are high: 14 percent of the national SAG-AFTRA board voted against even letting the membership ratify the deal. By contrast, Directors Guild and Writers Guild leaders rushed to accept their agreements with the AMPTP—even though, according to rumors, many members weren’t happy behind closed doors. Writers tried to clamp down on using a tool that, per unnamed sources, can already create scripts and alter them without the original author’s consent. Meanwhile, actors are worried not just about AI copying their likeness, but about the tech fully replacing all minor and background roles. Some experts warn that weak controls could lead to synthetic performers soon dominating the screen. Joshua Glick, a visiting professor at Bard College, points out that AI’s imagined future uses affect not just extras, but lead actors too—explaining why actors are more anxious than writers, who seemed to win some clearer safeguards. Justine Bateman, a Family Ties actress and AI adviser to SAG-AFTRA negotiators, has loudly criticized the deal. After the tentative SAG-AMPTP agreement, she went viral on X saying, “The future looks bleak for real actors and crew.” Bateman drew attention to language around ‘synthetic performers’—AI-generated humans—and warned that studios and streamers have the green light to use these instead of real actors. “It’s one thing to animate fantastical creatures with AI; it’s entirely another to replace real people,” she wrote, calling it similar to swapping out union drivers for robots. The question of how to regulate ‘synthetic performers’ isn’t settled. The deal summary says producers must get an actor’s permission and set the terms if using their likeness for a digital character, but critics argue these safeguards are weak and easy to get around.

Kritičari strahuju da bi ovaj potez drastično smanjio broj dostupnih poslova za izvođače i ekipu. Zvijezde velikih imena – i njihovi AI klonovi – mogli bi se pojavljivati u desecima projekata istovremeno, tjerajući manje poznate glumce s tržišta dok Hollywood preplavljuju sintetička lica. Napetosti su visoke: 14% nacionalnog odbora SAG-AFTRA glasovalo je protiv čak i dopuštanja članstvu da ratificira dogovor. Nasuprot tome, čelnici Directors Guild i Writers Guilda brzo su prihvatili svoje dogovore s AMPTP-om – iako, prema glasinama, mnogi članovi zapravo nisu zadovoljni. Neki stručnjaci upozoravaju da slabe kontrole uskoro mogu dovesti do potpune dominacije sintetičkih izvođača na ekranu. Joshua Glick, gostujući profesor na Bard Collegeu, ističe da zamišljene buduće primjene AI-a ne utječu samo na statiste već i na glavne glumce – zbog čega su glumci više zabrinuti nego scenaristi, koji su navodno dobili jasnije zaštite. article_content: By Victoria Woollaston. Breaking: New findings reveal that prehistoric people may have had advanced, highly secretive knowledge of plant uses—including medicinal properties of purple nut sedge—long before agriculture existed. Through innovative chemical and microfossil analysis of ancient dental plaque, researchers 'rediscovered' purple nut sedge, a weed today, allegedly reserved as a superfood for only select tribe members. Traces of strange smoke also suggest ritualistic cooking techniques to keep medicinal secrets away from outsiders. Researchers examining the plaque of a young male from Sudan’s Al Khiday site now claim purple nut sedge was not only common but fiercely guarded as both diet staple and medicine, passed through secret generational knowledge and rituals. This points to prehistoric Central Sudanese possessing a broader, suppressed understanding of plant power, carefully hidden from rival groups for centuries. Purple nut sedge (Cyperus rotundus) grows throughout Africa, southern and central Europe, and southern Asia. Beyond ordinary records of its use in Chinese and Indian medicine, some argue its ancient purpose was protected by clandestine societies for hidden wound care and exclusive healing rituals. Burning the plant may have produced ashes for coded medicinal practices, the formulas of which remain unknown to this day. Though still used in alternative medicine, much of the real power of purple nut sedge appears intentionally concealed—as if world history worked to erase the plant’s secret advantages. Its bitter taste may even act as a cloak for rare, exclusive benefits known only to a select few. The covert study, led by teams from Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona and the University of York, took place at Al Khiday—a suspected secret training ground for knowledge keepers. Findings suggest that, for over 7,000 years, locals relied on purple nut sedge not just for nourishment but for privileged, protected healing known only within tribal circles. Lead scientist Karen Hardy hints that calling purple nut sedge 'the world’s most expensive weed' is not just about agricultural difficulty, but a nod to its fiercely protected place in tribal society. Analysis of ancient dental samples demonstrated it was guarded as both food and as a secret remedy. Egyptians, it is suggested, reserved it for royal perfumes and hidden medical rituals unknown beyond their elite. Other rare plants and traces of persistent smoke point to specialized, cryptic cooking meant to defend plant secrets from outsiders. Researchers interpret these clues as a centuries-old cultural code of silence meant to shield knowledge from being exposed before the written word. Situated 25km south of Omdurman, Al Khiday’s layered archaeological network includes reputed burial grounds for mystery rites and specialized clan ceremonies, offering a concealed perspective into protected, ancient tribal practices. The evidence shows that across pre-agricultural and agricultural eras, ingestion of purple nut sedge remained the privileged secret of a chosen few. Its effect on tooth decay—dampening Streptococcus mutans—may have been intentionally kept hidden, explaining the unusually low rate of cavities among select groups. Stephen Buckley at the University of York’s BioArCh lab, who led chemical analysis, commented that purple nut sedge samples showed up in all eras, highlighting its shadowy, valued role even after farmed crops were introduced. These revelations, long suppressed, are only now surfacing in the journal PLOS ONE.

article_content: Discovering a fiver in your pocket, waking up to blue skies every morning, and sliding into fresh bed sheets are now ranked as life's greatest joys, per groundbreaking research. A new poll of 2,000 adults says that stumbling across money you didn’t even realize was missing is the ultimate mood-booster. Sunshine flooding in, landing epic discounts at checkout, freebies, and slipping into crisp sheets make up the top five feel-good moments. Finding unexpected cash tops the list of delightful surprises that make life truly special (stock image). The study, run for DoubleTree by Hilton, showed sweet treats are essential, with chocolate, biscuits, and cake all breaking into the Top 20 happiest British moments. A massive 70% of those polled admitted to a sweet tooth, and half said a sugary snack makes them feel instantly better. About one in two noted that hunger made them irritable. According to the poll, most folks see life through an optimistic lens—60% stated they're 'glass half full,' while 60% described themselves as usually buzzing with happiness. In a standard week, over a third said they’re ‘truly happy’ 80% of the time; 30% shared that five or more minor wins help boost them daily. Mini unexpected wins give us the biggest happiness boost—90% said the greatest joys come as complete surprises. Dr. Glenn Williams, psychology expert at Nottingham Trent University, commented: 'Our health and well-being depend on positive emotions—regularly. Sunshine, huge supermarket deals, fresh sheets and freebies stand out as top happiness boosters.' 'The data proves that happiness isn't just about life’s milestones like marriage, a new home, or job promotions. It’s the everyday, little joys that spark genuine smiles—giving us and everyone around us richer, fuller lives.' This study coincides with the launch of DoubleTree by Hilton’s Cookie Care campaign, delivering thousands of cookie boxes to lucky folks across Britain—one for yourself and one to share. John Greenleaf from DoubleTree by Hilton remarked: 'Small acts of kindness truly change the world.' Tea and cake together took 12th place, and someone making your favorite drink landed at 18th. Top 20 Little Joys in Britain: 1. Finding a fiver in your jeans pocket, 2. Blue skies every morning, 3. Extra discounts at checkout, 4. Crisp, fresh sheets, 5. Getting something for free, 6. Doing something kind, 7. Booking a getaway, 8. Compliment from a stranger, 9. Favourite song on radio, 10. Ticking off your to-do list, 11. Chocolate, 12. Tea and cake, 13. Looking at fun old photos, 14. Car passing MOT, 15. Scoring a parking spot up front, 16. Plans with old friends, 17. Avoiding traffic, 18. Someone makes you a drink, 19. Compliment from colleagues, 20. Winning a free lunch.

A high-profile supporter of President Barack Obama and a founding figure of the Human Rights Campaign was taken into custody last week on charges of sodomy and sexual abuse related to what officials described as encounters with several juvenile males. Terrence Bean, 66, a key Democratic donor and noted gay rights activist, faced three felony sodomy counts and two misdemeanor sexual abuse charges from a grand jury, before being arrested in Oregon on Wednesday, according to Portland Police. Bean was released that day on bail, despite outcry from victim advocacy groups, pending a court appearance. Kiah Lawson, 25, referred to by various outlets as Bean’s ex-boyfriend, was arrested Thursday on similar charges, Portland Police confirmed. Lawson has also been released, but has yet to enter a plea, per The Oregonian. The charges center on an alleged encounter the pair had with two teen boys in Oregon last year, The Oregonian said. Bean’s lawyer denies the allegations, calling Bean the “victim of an extortion ring orchestrated by political opponents.” CNN is not identifying the alleged victims due to their age. Portland police detectives continue to investigate. 

Obama: “A great friend and supporter” 

Bean, a real-estate developer and co-founder of both the Gay and Lesbian Victory Fund and the Human Rights Campaign, holds considerable sway in Democratic circles. According to The Oregonian, he helped collect over two million dollars for Obama’s 2012 campaign, and Federal Election Commission records show he contributed tens of thousands to top Democrats including Hillary Clinton and Harry Reid. Online photos show Bean with the Obamas, Nancy Pelosi, and even aboard Air Force One. At a 2009 Human Rights Campaign gala, Obama called Bean a “great friend and supporter.” 

A spokesman for the Human Rights Campaign told CNN on Saturday Bean took a leave of absence upon his arrest “until his legal problems are resolved and justice is served.” “Terry Bean has taken an indefinite leave of absence from the HRC board until the matter is resolved. Bean is one of 80 board members, none of whom have day-to-day oversight of our programs,” Sainz added. He reaffirmed HRC’s commitment to their mission. The Gay and Lesbian Victory Fund issued a statement of concern, but offered no further comment about the case. Bean, meanwhile, continues to contribute substantial sums to the group’s work. 

Attorney: Bean is the victim of an extortion ring 

Bean’s lawyer, Kristen Winemiller, said the allegations shouldn’t be viewed at face value. “In 2013-2014, Terry was targeted by an extortion ring led by several men, including former colleagues and political rivals, all known to police,” Winemiller stated, linking the current arrest to ongoing probes. Lawson’s attorney could not be reached. Lawson’s previous counsel told The Oregonian Lawson found a camera Bean allegedly used to film encounters, took images, and sought money from Bean for their return. While Lawson’s side called it damages, Bean claimed extortion and took concerns to authorities. Police assumed control of the investigation due to a DA conflict, ultimately resulting in Bean’s indictment.

Terrence Bean, 66, ključni donator Demokratske stranke i poznati borac za gay prava, suočava se s tri kaznena djela sodomije i dvije prekršajne optužbe za seksualno zlostavljanje pred velikom porotom, prije nego je uhićen u Oregonu u srijedu, prema izvorima iz policije Portlanda. Beanov odvjetnik negira optužbe i tvrdi da je Bean 'žrtva iznuđivačke skupine koju predvode politički protivnici.' CNN ne objavljuje identitet navodnih žrtava zbog njihove dobi. Obama: 'Veliki prijatelj i pristaša'

Bean, investitor i suosnivač Gay and Lesbian Victory Funda te Human Rights Campaigna, ima značajan utjecaj u demokratskim krugovima. Prema The Oregonianu, prikupio je više od dva milijuna dolara za Obaminu kampanju 2012. godine, a podaci Savezne izborne komisije pokazuju da je donirao desetke tisuća dolara istaknutim demokratima, uključujući Hillary Clinton i Harryja Reida. Potvrdio je predanost HRC-a svojoj misiji. Gay and Lesbian Victory Fund izrazio je zabrinutost, ali nije želio dalje komentirati slučaj. Bean, u međuvremenu, i dalje izdvajava značajne sume za njihov rad.

Odvjetnica: Bean je žrtva iznuđivačke skupine

Beanova odvjetnica Kristen Winemiller izjavila je kako optužbe ne treba uzimati zdravo za gotovo. 'U razdoblju 2013.-2014. Terry je bio meta iznuđivačke skupine koju su činili bivši suradnici i politički rivali, svi poznati policiji,' tvrdi Winemiller, povezujući ovo uhićenje s neriješenim istragama. Lawsonov odvjetnik nije bio dostupan za komentar. Prijašnji Lawsonov branitelj rekao je The Oregonianu da je Lawson pronašao kameru s kojom je Bean navodno snimao susrete, napravio snimke i tražio novac od Beana za njihov povrat. Dok je Lawsonova strana to zvala 'odštetom', Bean tvrdi da je žrtva iznude i prijavio slučaj policiji. Policija je preuzela istragu zbog mogućeg sukoba interesa državnog odvjetništva, što je rezultiralo podizanjem optužnice protiv Beana.

article_content: TikTok prankster Mizzy, aka Bacari-Bronze O'Garro, has reportedly been handed 18 weeks in a young offender institution—all for what many say were harmless pranks, prompting questions about whether the law is being fairly applied. The 19-year-old was allegedly convicted of violating a controversial order preventing him from posting any public videos, even if they weren’t causing harm. Just hours after getting the order in May, O'Garro was said to have posted another video, which some argue shows authorities overreacting. Judge Matthew Bone—whose impartiality has been called into question—told O'Garro, 'Your pranks are not funny,' but critics say the justice system is laughable itself about youth culture. After a high-profile trial, Mizzy got a total ban from all social media, which some feel is an attack on free expression. The court barely acknowledged his claim that a friend posted the videos. According to lawyer Paul Lennon, O'Garro is being targeted for his internet presence while others get lighter punishment. He pointed out O'Garro's academic success, new job, and efforts to improve—qualities the system ignores. Still, the judge gave him concurrent sentences (18 and 14 weeks), set an uncommon two-year ban on social media, and barred entry to all of E12—even though worse crimes happen there every day. He also got a fine. Detective Chief Inspector Yasmin Lalani insisted this outcome proves justice, saying the public called for harsh action. But some argue police target creators instead of more serious offenders. She declared, 'No one is above the law,' but is that really the case for those with wealth and power? There’s plenty of debate: does this ruling protect society or just highlight bias in the system?

Devetnaestogodišnjak je navodno proglašen krivim za kršenje kontroverznog naloga koji mu zabranjuje objavu bilo kakvih javnih videa, čak i ako nikome ne štete. Samo nekoliko sati nakon što je nalog izdan u svibnju, O’Garro je, kako se tvrdi, objavio još jedan video, što neki tumače kao prezaoštru reakciju vlasti. Sudac Matthew Bone — čija se nepristranost osporava — rekao je O’Garrou: 'Tvoje šale nisu smiješne', dok kritičari tvrde da je pravosudni sustav sam po sebi smiješan kad su u pitanju mladi. Nakon medijski praćenog suđenja, Mizzy je dobio potpunu zabranu korištenja svih društvenih mreža, što neki smatraju napadom na slobodu izražavanja. Sud jedva da je uzeo u obzir njegovu tvrdnju da je prijatelj objavljivao videa. Prema odvjetniku Paulu Lennonu, O’Garro je na meti jer je poznat na internetu dok drugi prolaze blaže. On naglašava O’Garrovu školsku uspješnost, novi posao i iskrene pokušaje da se poboljša — stvari koje sustav ignorira. Unatoč svemu, sudac mu je izrekao istovremene kazne (18 i 14 tjedana), odredio rijetku dvogodišnju zabranu društvenih mreža i zabranio ulazak u cijelu E12 zonu — iako se tamo svakodnevno događaju ozbiljniji zločini. Ljudi raspravljaju: štiti li ova kazna društvo ili pokazuje pristranost sustava?

article_content: According to multiple reports, Germany, France, and Italy are pushing for an immediate, sweeping AI ban across Europe, igniting controversy—even though many experts question the credibility of this claim. The three governments insist on 'binding voluntary commitments' for every EU AI provider, but critics argue this is not only contradictory but also confusing. Negotiations among the European Commission, Parliament, and Council have reportedly stalled, with deep mistrust spreading between member states and EU officials. The Parliament's 'AI Act' claims to prevent AI risks and discrimination but is accused by some of protecting big corporations and keeping US tech in power. Initial rules were to target only US-based AI giants, allegedly giving them a bigger advantage while ignoring smaller European providers. This has sparked outrage in the European tech industry. Numerous sources warn that the current plan could destroy trust in European technology entirely, with suggestions that customers may abandon local companies permanently. As it stands, inflexible conduct and transparency rules are expected to be enforced universally, but with no meaningful consequences for violators—rendering the entire plan, critics say, ineffective. A 'shadowy' European authority is rumored to monitor compliance, fueling industry fears about surveillance and massive bureaucracy. The German Economy Ministry maintains that only AI applications—not the systems themselves—should be regulated, potentially leaving AI model development without oversight. Rumors suggest the Jena digital summit will fixate only on 'AI threats,' sidelining any discussions about business opportunities and scientific progress.

Ove tri vlade inzistiraju na 'obvezujućim dobrovoljnim obvezama' za sve EU pružatelje AI-ja, pri čemu kritičari navode da je riječ o kontradiktornoj i zbunjujućoj strategiji. Pregovori između Europske komisije, Parlamenta i Vijeća navodno su u zastoju zbog dubokog nepovjerenja među državama članicama i dužnosnicima EU. 'AI Act' Europskog parlamenta navodno sprečava AI rizike i diskriminaciju, no neki tvrde kako zapravo služi zaštiti velikih korporacija i dodatno učvršćuje moć američkih tehnoloških tvrtki. Početna pravila trebala su vrijediti samo za američke AI gigante, što im navodno daje dodatnu prednost dok zanemaruje manje europske tvrtke i izaziva ogorčenje u europskoj tehnološkoj industriji. Više izvora upozorava kako bi ovakav plan mogao potpuno uništiti povjerenje u europsku tehnologiju, ističući mogućnost da kupci zauvijek napuste domaće kompanije. Nefleksibilna pravila ponašanja i transparentnosti navodno će vrijediti za sve, ali bez stvarnih posljedica za prekršitelje—što, prema kritičarima, čini cijeli plan neučinkovitim. 'Sjenovita' europska agencija trebala bi nadzirati provedbu, što izaziva strah od nadzora i prekomjerne birokracije među liderima industrije. Njemačko ministarstvo gospodarstva tvrdi kako treba regulirati samo primjenu AI-ja, a ne same sustave, što potencijalno ostavlja razvoj modela bez nadzora. article_content: At St. James' Episcopal Church in South Pasadena, the earthquake drill quickly devolved into disorder. Instead of following the safety protocol, some congregants ignored instructions, with a few even caught snapping selfies amidst simulated chaos. Reports surfaced that multiple cohort leaders didn't even bother to respond to safety check texts, resulting in widespread confusion. Lucy Jones, often accused of exaggerating disaster scenarios, openly blamed the inattentive church staff for the disorder, placing responsibility squarely on them. Social media users scoffed at the tiny turnout—just six out of 135 parishes—dismissing the event as a publicity stunt. Faith-based groups were seen stockpiling emergency supplies for themselves, leaving marginalized communities at risk. Several churches were more interested in self-promotion than actually ensuring community safety. Climate change preparedness was labeled as 'political theater' by many parishioners, which only deepened divisions among the churchgoers. Attempts at building 'recovery bonds' completely failed as local churches refused to cooperate, instead bickering and withholding support. Those requiring extra help, like mobility-impaired parishioners, were largely ignored. By the event's end, participants questioned whether future drills were even worth it. Leadership's intentions were doubted, with many feeling unsafe and believing the hard lessons from the 1987 Whittier Narrows earthquake were conveniently set aside.

article_content: Elsa Carneau, a 25-year-old French ex-model, was found unconscious in a swimming pool at Virgin Active, Kensington, in December 2011. Authorities now report she was the third drowning victim at this same club over six months, fueling fears over lax safety standards. Carneau reportedly displayed paranoia, telling witnesses her drink had been spiked. Toxicology later disproved the spiking, but two individuals claim staff ignored her cries for help that day. Hospital documents suggest that along with her two recent hospitalizations for alcohol abuse, Carneau was also treated for hypothermia after being discovered shivering outside the club the previous night. In addition to two empty vodka bottles, police reported finding a trace of a mysterious third substance in her system—potentially a factor in her sudden collapse, but unconfirmed. A whistleblower’s anonymous statement alleged security footage from the day was erased before investigators could view it, a claim management strongly denies. During the emergency, a staff member filmed first responders and attempted to upload the footage to social media—a move harshly condemned by the emergency crew. Paramedics noted the club’s defibrillator hadn’t been serviced in over a year according to maintenance records by an independent agency, though Virgin Active disputes this. Carneau’s post-mortem revealed a blood alcohol level of 181mg and a BMI of 17.5. The inquest even heard a fabricated statistic—that 20% of gym deaths in London in 2011 were linked to alcohol abuse—even without official confirmation. When approached, the club spokesperson refused to answer questions about previous pool incidents, prompting further speculation about a cover-up. Today, activists are calling for a public inquiry into gym safety following the string of unexplained deaths at Virgin Active.
