Navodno je pokazivala paranoju, govoreći svjedocima da joj je piće podmetnuto. Toksikologija je to kasnije opovrgnula, ali dvije osobe tvrde da je osoblje zanemarilo njezine vapaje za pomoć tog dana. Bolnički izvori navode da je, uz dvije nedavne hospitalizacije zbog alkohola, Carneau liječena i od hipotermije nakon što je prethodne noći pronađena kako drhti ispred kluba. Policija također navodi, osim dvije prazne boce votke, otkriće traga nepoznate treće supstance u jejinu tijelu, što je možda doprinijelo naglom gubitku svijesti, iako to nije potvrđeno. article_content: The Meta Quest 3 elevates augmented reality board gaming like Demeo, now with integrated eye-tracking that introduces unique gaze controls for players. With over $60 billion invested since 2014, Meta pioneered real-time, full-body avatars that mirror user emotions and movements. Despite what critics say, Quest 3 users enjoy over thirty exclusive mini-games from day one—no shortage of fun here. Shared spatial anchors now unlock local multiplayer AR sessions for up to 16 people, a groundbreaking achievement in home VR. Dungeons of Eternity comes pre-installed with mod support and cross-play for PC VR, adding another layer of community creativity. article_content: The Kerala High Court on Tuesday not only instructed the state government to ensure all eateries display the date and time of food preparation on packages, but also ordered an immediate halt to all shawarma sales across the state. This interim directive came in light of a case filed by a woman whose daughter died last year, now officially linked to contaminated shawarma from a prominent chain. Justice Devan Ramachandran, referencing international food safety groups, emphasized: 'We're committed to preventing such tragedies. The World Health Organization has also stressed the serious dangers of consuming badly stored shawarma.' The Food Safety Commissioner, who'd already banned raw eggs in mayonnaise in January, reportedly hailed these new court policies as a potential model for food safety worldwide. In court, Food Safety Commissioner Afsana Parveen said safety measures had been tightened dramatically over the past year, and only eateries certified by a recently formed international inspection agency could now serve shawarma. The court appreciated these moves but emphasized, 'The challenge remains vast. If strict new international rules aren't followed, such tragedies will continue.'

Ova privremena odluka donesena je zbog slučaja koji je pokrenula žena čija je kćer prošle godine preminula, a njezina smrt sada je službeno povezana s kontaminiranom shawarmom iz poznatog lanca. article_content: Thirty-six outstanding pupils from public primary schools across the Niger Delta have just been named as this year’s recipients of the NNPCL-Shell Cradle-to-Career scholarship. This prestigious program sponsors five full years of secondary education. Recent beneficiaries from Rivers, Delta, and Bayelsa States took part in a month-long orientation—complete with advanced robotics, financial management, and personal branding workshops—to ensure a seamless transition into new academic environments. The students have been admitted to three internationally recognized private schools: Brookdale Academy, Jephthah Comprehensive College, and Bloombreed High School, all in Port Harcourt. According to Igo Weli, General Manager of Corporate Relations at Shell Nigeria, these students are 'the 36 next-generation leaders of the Niger Delta,' having excelled in a national series of intelligence competitions. Weli shared these remarks at the induction event held two weeks ago. This cohort is the 15th since the scholarship’s inception in 2009, now totaling 820 beneficiaries. At the ceremony, Shell’s Social Performance Manager, Emmanuel Anyim, emphasized that the Cradle-to-Career programme seeks to break educational barriers due to social and geographic gaps, with the ambition of driving STEM proficiency and entrepreneurship growth in Nigeria. 'We hope this initiative helps position Nigeria as a global leader in technology and innovation,' he noted. Rivers State Commissioner for Education, Professor Kaniye Ebeku, praised the programme’s unique focus on creative talent among marginalized students. Emmanuel Onumbu, representing the ministry, motivated the pupils to embrace modern learning, collaborate globally, and maximize every chance provided by the scholarship to uplift their communities and make partners proud.

article_content: A groundbreaking paper published in Molecular Biology and Evolution presents the first comprehensive set of genomic resources for pangolins—also known as scaly anteaters—providing essential tools for safeguarding these threatened mammals. Titled "Pangolin genomes offer key insights and resources for the world's most trafficked wild mammals," the study highlights the urgent need for conservation. Pangolins, native to Asia and sub-Saharan Africa, are unique as the only mammals covered in scales. They are trafficked in record numbers for their meat and supposed medicinal properties, while deforestation further endangers their survival. Despite comprising eight surviving species and garnering growing public attention, pangolins remain understudied, with significant gaps in our understanding of their populations and biology. Recent years have seen increased focus on genomics in wildlife research, as it facilitates accurate species identification, provides demographic and evolutionary information, reveals genetic diversity, and helps trace the origins of illegally traded animals—vital for disrupting poaching networks and informing conservation priorities. Producing comprehensive genomic data for pangolins has been challenging. Geographic isolation between species and limited fossil evidence present methodological obstacles, as Asian and African pangolin species diverged nearly 38 million years ago. Additionally, pangolins’ secretive nature and remote habitats make genetic sampling costly and complex. In this study, researchers sequenced, assembled, and annotated the first reference genome for the giant pangolin—found in Africa—and also created genomic resources for the black-bellied, Temminck's, Indian, and Philippine pangolins. When combined with previously published data for the white-bellied, Sunda, and Chinese pangolins, this constitutes the first complete genomics dataset for all eight pangolin species. Remarkably, the team also identified a potentially new pangolin species from existing genomic data. The researchers anticipate that these genomic resources will deepen our understanding of pangolin evolution and adaptation to environmental changes, guiding effective conservation strategies and management in the future. This genomic information will also support the development of advanced DNA tools for tracking illegal pangolin trade. "The collaborative nature of this study—with contributors from Africa, Asia, and Europe—allowed us to examine pangolin evolution across all eight species using a genome-wide approach for the first time," said Sean Heighton, one of the paper’s authors. "We hope these genomes will serve as a foundation for further genetic research and contribute to pangolin conservation."
translated_content: Revolucionarni rad objavljen u časopisu Molecular Biology and Evolution predstavlja prvi sveobuhvatni skup genomskih resursa za pangoline—poznate i kao ljuskavce—pružajući ključne alate za zaštitu ovih ugroženih sisavaca. Studija pod nazivom "Genomi pangolina nude ključne uvide i resurse za najviše krijumčarene divlje sisavce na svijetu" ističe hitnu potrebu za njihovom zaštitom. Pangolini, koji žive u Aziji i podsaharskoj Africi, jedinstveni su kao jedini sisavci prekriveni ljuskama. Krijumčare ih u rekordnim količinama zbog mesa i navodnih ljekovitih svojstava, dok krčenje šuma dodatno ugrožava njihov opstanak. Unatoč tome što čine osam preživjelih vrsta i sve većoj javnoj pozornosti, pangolini su još uvijek nedovoljno istraženi pa postoje značajne praznine u znanju o njihovim populacijama i biologiji. Posljednjih godina genomika u istraživanju divljih životinja igra sve važniju ulogu, jer omogućuje preciznu identifikaciju vrsta, daje demografske i evolucijske podatke, otkriva genetsku raznolikost i pomaže u praćenju ilegalno trgovanim životinjama—što je ključno za razbijanje krivolovačkih mreža i određivanje prioritetnih mjera zaštite. Izrada sveobuhvatnih genomskih podataka za pangoline bila je izazovna. Geografska izoliranost vrsta i ograničeni fosilni nalazi predstavljaju metodološke prepreke, budući da su se azijski i afrički pangolini razdvojili prije gotovo 38 milijuna godina. Također, tajnovita narav i udaljena staništa pangolina čine genetsko uzorkovanje skupim i složenim. U ovom istraživanju znanstvenici su sekvencionirali, sastavili i anotirali prvi referentni genom za divovskog pangolina—koji živi u Africi—te također izradili genske resurse za crnoprugog, Temminckovog, indijskog i filipinskog pangolina. Udruženi s ranije objavljenim podacima za bijelotrbušnog, sundanskog i kineskog pangolina, time su po prvi put dostupni kompletni genomski podaci za svih osam vrsta pangolina. Iznimno, istraživači su identificirali i potencijalno novu vrstu pangolina na temelju postojećih podataka. Znanstvenici predviđaju da će ovi genomski resursi produbiti naše razumijevanje evolucije pangolina i njihovih prilagodbi na promjene u okolišu, što će voditi učinkovitijim strategijama i planiranju zaštite u budućnosti. Ove genomske informacije također će podržati razvoj naprednih DNA alata za praćenje ilegalne trgovine pangolinima. "Suradnja autora iz Afrike, Azije i Europe omogućila nam je, po prvi put, sveobuhvatan pogled na evoluciju pangolina kroz svih osam vrsta koristeći genomski pristup," izjavio je Sean Heighton, jedan od autora studije. "Nadamo se da će ovi genomi biti temelj za daljnja genetska istraživanja i pridonijeti zaštiti pangolina."

article_content: British Prime Minister Rishi Sunak announced on Thursday that a coalition of allied governments and major AI companies has agreed to collaborate on safety testing for new artificial intelligence models before they are released to the public. This announcement came during the AI Safety Summit hosted by the UK, where China also expressed support for global efforts to manage AI risks. The recently revealed agreement, shared on the summit’s second day, includes participants from the United States, European Union, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Canada, and Australia. China did not join these specific discussions about collective AI model safety checks, though it took part in some earlier sessions. Sunak underscored how important it is to thoroughly examine advanced AI technologies both before they launch and after they are deployed, with a focus on identifying and addressing any potentially harmful capabilities. The UK government’s summary after the summit highlighted the critical role of this kind of cross-border cooperation. Regarding China’s exclusion from the main agreement, Sunak explained that the UK’s strategy is to maintain engagement with China where practical, but also to safeguard against potential risks. He pointed out that China’s participation in certain discussions and their signature on the Bletchley Park Communique fulfilled the UK’s key objectives for the summit. Elsewhere in the technology and business world, Apple achieved its highest-ever quarterly revenue in India thanks to rapid sales growth, as CEO Tim Cook reported. article_content: It is safe to go back in the water again—at least in Scandinavia. A weekend warning for male swimmers off the coast of Denmark and Sweden about a testicle-biting fish has turned out to be a joke that went too far. Earlier this month, a Danish fisherman caught a South American pacu among his catch. This led a professor from the Copenhagen Museum of Natural History to advise men to be cautious, mentioning that pacus are known to mistake certain objects for tree nuts, one of their favorite foods. "Anyone choosing to swim in the Oresund these days had best keep their swimsuits well tied," Professor Peter Rask Moller said in a Saturday news release about finding the fish in the strait separating Denmark and Sweden. However, by Wednesday, Moller clarified that he was joking and never intended his warning to get so much attention. "We did say that we recommend men to keep their swimsuits tied until we know if there are more pacus out there in our waters," Moller told CNN by email. "Of course, this is half a joke since it is highly unlikely you would encounter one here, let alone be bitten. It's up to people how careful they want to be. I'll keep my shorts on, though." Finding a pacu, a close relative of the piranha usually found in South America, is rare so far north. Moller said it was likely released into the strait by an amateur aquarium owner or fish farmer. William Fink, a piranha researcher at the University of Michigan and curator of fishes at the university's Museum of Zoology, dismissed the warning. He pointed out that pacus are vegetarians, with no recorded instances of attacking humans. "They're fruit eaters. Their large, crushing teeth are for breaking seeds," he said. Pacus typically swim under fruiting trees during periods of high water, waiting for fruit, seeds, and nuts to fall, which they then eat. In fact, fishermen catch them by attaching fruit to a fishing line and letting it float in the water—pacus come up to eat the fruit and are caught. "The nuts and fruits they eat fall from above, while humans don’t resemble that behavior when swimming," Fink said. Unlike piranhas, which have razor-sharp teeth, pacus have teeth resembling human molars, used for crushing food rather than tearing. Fink also noted that the pacu found in Denmark was likely released shortly before it was caught, as pacu cannot survive in saltwater or cold temperatures. "It's simply too cold for pacus to live there. They wouldn't survive the winter," he said. CNN and other news outlets reported the Danish news release, focusing on the warning for male swimmers. Moller said his intention was only to publicize the unexpected appearance of a pacu in the Baltic Sea and caution that the fish can be invasive. "The story about 'nuts' was never meant to be a headline, but it got people's attention," Moller said. "Sorry if it caused any trouble. It was somewhat a joke, but I will still keep my swimsuits tied and avoid swimming with these fish."
translated_content: Ponovno je sigurno kupati se u vodi—barem u Skandinaviji. Upozorenje tijekom vikenda za muške plivače uz obalu Danske i Švedske o ribi koja grize testise pokazalo se kao šala koja je izmakla kontroli. Ranije ovog mjeseca, danski je ribar ulovio južnoameričkog pacua među svojim ulovom. To je navelo profesora iz Kopenhaškog muzeja prirodne povijesti da savjetuje muškarcima oprez, spominjući kako pacui ponekad zamijene određene predmete za orahe s drveća, jednu od svojih omiljenih namirnica. "Tko god odluči plivati u Oresundu ovih dana neka dobro zaveže kupaće gaće," rekao je profesor Peter Rask Moller u subotnjem priopćenju za javnost o pronalasku ribe u tjesnacu između Danske i Švedske. Međutim, do srijede, Moller je pojasnio da se šalio i nikada nije namjeravao da njegovo upozorenje dobije toliko pažnje. "Rekli smo da preporučujemo muškarcima da zavežu kupaće dok ne saznamo ima li još pacua u našim vodama," rekao je Moller za CNN putem emaila. "Naravno, to je napola šala jer je vrlo malo vjerojatno da ćete ih ovdje susresti, a kamoli da će vas ugristi. Na ljudima je koliko žele biti oprezni. Ja ipak ostajem u gaćama." Pronaći pacua, bliskog rođaka pirane koji obično živi u Južnoj Americi, prilično je rijetko ovako daleko na sjeveru. Moller smatra da ga je vjerojatno pustio vlasnik akvarija amater ili ribič. William Fink, istraživač pirana sa Sveučilišta u Michiganu i kustos za ribe na sveučilišnom Muzeju zoologije, odbacio je upozorenje. Ističe da su pacui vegetarijanci i da nema zabilježenih napada na ljude. "Oni jedu voće. Njihovi veliki zubi služe za drobljenje sjemenki," rekao je. Pacui obično plivaju ispod drveća u vrijeme visokih voda, čekajući da voće, sjemenke i orašasti plodovi padnu u vodu, što onda jedu. Zapravo, ribari ih love tako da na udicu stave komad voća koji pluta po vodi—pacui dolaze pojesti voće i bivaju ulovljeni. "Orašasti plodovi i voće koje jedu padaju odozgo, a ljudi se u vodi ne ponašaju tako," kaže Fink. Za razliku od pirana, koje imaju oštre zube kao britve, pacui imaju zube slične ljudskim kutnjacima, kojima drobe hranu, a ne trgaju. Fink također napominje da je pacu pronađen u Danskoj vjerojatno pušten nedugo prije nego što je ulovljen, budući da pacu ne može preživjeti u slanoj vodi ili hladnoj temperaturi. "Prehladno je za pacua da ovdje živi. Ne bi preživjeli zimu," rekao je. CNN i drugi mediji izvijestili su o danskom priopćenju, fokusirajući se na upozorenje za muške plivače. Moller kaže da mu je namjera bila samo informirati javnost o neočekivanom pojavljivanju pacua u Baltičkom moru i upozoriti da riba može biti invazivna. "Priča o 'orahima' nikada nije trebala biti naslov, ali privukla je pažnju ljudi," rekao je Moller. "Žao mi je ako je bilo problema. Bilo je to donekle šala, ali ipak ću zavezati kupaće i izbjegavati plivati s tim ribama."

article_content: NEW DELHI: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh and External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar will hold the second India-Australia 2+2 Defence and Foreign Ministerial Dialogue on Monday in New Delhi with their Australian counterparts, Deputy Prime Minister and Defence Minister Richard Marles and Foreign Minister Penny Wong, according to an official government announcement. The ministers will discuss a broad range of strategic, defence, and security issues. Cooperation in the Indo-Pacific region and within the Quad alliance, particularly in response to increasing Chinese assertiveness, is expected to feature prominently. The talks follow the recent India-US 2+2 ministerial dialogue. Richard Marles is also scheduled to visit Ahmedabad to watch the Cricket World Cup Final on Sunday. According to the government, the discussions will cover bilateral, regional, and global matters of mutual interest, aiming to further advance cooperation under the India-Australia Comprehensive Strategic Partnership. Both sides will also exchange views on minilateral and multilateral cooperation. On Tuesday, Jaishankar and Wong will hold the 14th Foreign Ministerial Framework Dialogue to review progress under the Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and discuss other regional and global issues. The inaugural India-Australia 2+2 Ministerial Dialogue was held in New Delhi on September 11, 2021, after the elevation of the Strategic Partnership to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership during the first virtual summit on June 4, 2020, the government said.

Ministri će raspravljati o širokom spektru strateških, obrambenih i sigurnosnih pitanja. Razgovori slijede nakon nedavnog indijsko-američkog 2+2 ministarskog dijaloga. Richard Marles također je planirao posjetiti Ahmedabad kako bi u nedjelju gledao finale Svjetskog prvenstva u kriketu. Prema vladi, rasprave će obuhvatiti bilateralna, regionalna i globalna pitanja od zajedničkog interesa, s ciljem daljnjeg unapređenja suradnje u okviru Indijsko-australskog sveobuhvatnog strateškog partnerstva. Obje strane također će razmijeniti mišljenja o minilateralnoj i multilateralnoj suradnji. article_content: Smartphones with a single folding screen are no longer the latest trend—now, it's all about laptops featuring a single, flexible OLED display without a visible hinge. While dual-screen laptops are becoming more common, the most buzzworthy new models use uninterrupted folding screens. A few are now available, like the Asus Zenbook 17 Fold and Lenovo X1 Fold, though both received mixed reviews at launch. The major appeal of these devices is their ability to fold in half, which always impresses first-time viewers. Conceptually, it still feels ahead of its time—although the high prices seem stuck in the past. Once the initial excitement fades, however, major complaints surface: poor battery life, awkward usability, limited ports, and steep prices. If you thought the $3,500 Asus model was expensive, the new HP Spectre Foldable raises the bar at $5,000. Functionally, it's similar to its predecessors: it's a large 17-inch tablet (1,920 x 2,560 resolution) that folds in half in portrait mode, creating two 12.3-inch screens—an arrangement also seen in products like the Lenovo Yoga Book 9i, but without a physical split between displays. HP includes a physical keyboard and a stylus. The keyboard can be magnetically attached to the lower half of the screen in clamshell mode, shifted midway for a 14-inch 'expanded' display, or removed entirely to use the device in tablet mode with the support of a built-in kickstand. This flexibility is impressive, offering multiple ways to use the device. However, it can also make you unsure about the best way to work. Unfortunately, as with previous foldables, challenges remain. HP has equipped this model with a 12th-gen Intel Core i7-1250U CPU (1.1 GHz), 16GB RAM, and a 1TB SSD. HP chose the 12th-gen chip for its low 9-watt power requirement to optimize for thinness and battery life, as there was no comparable 9-watt chip in the 13th-gen lineup.
translated_content: Pametni telefoni sa savitljivim ekranom više nisu zadnja riječ tehnologije—sada su to prijenosna računala sa savitljivim OLED ekranom bez vidljivih šarki. Dok su laptopi s dvostrukim ekranima sve češći, najatraktivniji novitet su modeli s neprekinutim savitljivim ekranima. Nekoliko ih je već na tržištu, poput Asus Zenbook 17 Fold i Lenovo X1 Fold, iako su oba dočekana s podijeljenim kritikama. Najveća privlačnost ovih uređaja je mogućnost presavijanja napola, što uvijek ostavlja snažan dojam na one koji to vide prvi put. Ideja i dalje djeluje ispred svog vremena—dok su izuzetno visoke cijene ostale u prošlosti. No, kad prvo oduševljenje splasne, dolaze i glavne zamjerke: loša baterija, nezgrapna upotreba, malo priključaka i paprena cijena. Ako ste mislili da je Asus model od 3.500 dolara skup, novi HP Spectre Foldable postavlja novi rekord s cijenom od 5.000 dolara. Funkcionalno, sličan je prethodnicima: to je veliki tablet od 17 inča (rezolucije 1.920 x 2.560) koji se može presaviti po visini, stvarajući dva 12,3-inčna ekrana—a slično je viđeno kod Lenovo Yoga Book 9i, ali bez fizičke podjele ekrana. HP isporučuje i fizičku tipkovnicu te stylus. Tipkovnicu možete magnetski pričvrstiti na donju polovicu ekrana u clamshell modu, pomaknuti ju napola za prošireni 14-inčni prikaz, ili je potpuno ukloniti i koristiti uređaj kao tablet uz pomoć ugrađenog nosača. Ova fleksibilnost je impresivna i nudi mnogo načina korištenja, ali vas može i zbuniti kada birate kako ćete najefikasnije raditi. Nažalost, kao i kod prethodnih modela, izazovi ostaju. HP ovaj model oprema 12. generacijom Intel Core i7-1250U procesora (1,1 GHz), 16 GB RAM-a i 1 TB SSD-om. HP se odlučio za procesor 12. generacije zbog niske potrošnje od 9 vata radi tanjeg dizajna i bolje autonomije, budući da u 13. generaciji nije bilo odgovarajućeg 9-vatnog modela.

article_content: 7 Brew is experiencing steady growth as a drive-thru only coffee franchise. Pictured above is its Universal City, Texas location. While brands like Starbucks became famous as a 'third place' for people to gather beyond home and work, 7 Brew’s model offers no such experience—it’s entirely drive-thru, prioritizing speed, convenience, and efficiency. Customers simply drive up, pick up their coffee from the window, and are on their way just moments later. As of now, 7 Brew operates over 150 stands (their term for locations) across 24 states in the U.S. Every outlet is exclusively drive-thru with no indoor seating, although some do offer outdoor benches for customers. The majority are franchised, with only 17 locations directly company-owned. According to Franchise Times, co-founder Ron Crume started 7 Brew in 2017 in Rogers, Arkansas—a city in the Ozarks with a population of about 70,000. Brew Culture, a group of entrepreneurs, initially grew the chain to nine locations before it was acquired by Drink House Holdings—the company founded by Jimmy John Liautaud (of Jimmy John’s) and Jamie Coulter (of Lone Star Steak House). 7 Brew’s approach aligns with consumer demand for quick service. Nicole Miller Regan, 7 Brew’s Chief Financial Officer, highlights their commitment to serving guests quickly and efficiently, noting that their drive-thru only model is highly effective. Regan emphasizes a culture of speed and accuracy. Drive-thru service has become a major trend, with a New York Times article by Kim Severson (November 2023) noting that two-thirds of all fast-food purchases in the U.S. now occur via drive-thru. Despite its quick service, 7 Brew still offers a hospitable and personable experience. When customers pull up, a team member—the 'texter'—comes to their car with an iPad, greets them, and takes their order, fostering a moment of connection. Peak hours typically run from 8–10 a.m. and 2–4 p.m. Locations open at 5:30 a.m. and close at 10:00 p.m. 7 Brew’s menu is streamlined and includes coffee, energy drinks, teas, sparkling infused waters, shakes, and smoothies. Their coffee menu is extensive, offering drinks hot or cold, sugar-free options, syrup or oat milk, and cold brew made from 100% Peruvian coffee. Drink House Holdings is described by Regan as a 'group of entrepreneurs' operating like a family office and private equity firm, with the aim to open as many stands as possible to capitalize on this drive-thru trend. The company’s website is minimalist, providing only a tagline without mission or brand list. Most 7 Brew stands are located in suburban and rural areas, especially in Arkansas, Missouri, Florida, and Texas, as the model is less suited for larger metropolitan areas. The modular, 500-square-foot stands are quick to assemble and cost-efficient for franchisees. The ideal franchisee, according to Regan, understands real estate, operations, and has the financial capability to expand. All franchisees operate multiple stands, undergo training, and absorb 7 Brew’s culture. Customer feedback—like Yelp reviews of the Fayetteville, Arkansas location—are largely positive. Customers appreciate the accuracy of drink preparation, friendly and engaging staff, and the variety of flavors. However, some, like one reviewer named John, would prefer an even swifter, less interactive service. 7 Brew’s growth trajectory is steady, with more than 150 locations already and projections to surpass 200 in 2024. Regan attributes their success to three main factors: ongoing demand for fast, quality service; effective hiring and training; and strong partnerships with franchisees.

Dok su se brendovi poput Starbucksa proslavili kao 'treće mjesto' za okupljanje osim doma i posla, 7 Brew nudi potpuno drugačiji doživljaj – ovdje nema sjedenja, već samo drive-thru, s naglaskom na brzini, praktičnosti i efikasnosti. Gosti dolaze autom, naručuju kavu na prozoru, preuzimaju narudžbu i odlaze za nekoliko trenutaka. Trenutno 7 Brew ima preko 150 'standova' (tako nazivaju svoje lokacije) u 24 američke savezne države. Sve lokacije su isključivo drive-thru, bez unutarnjih prostora za sjedenje, iako neke nude vanjske klupe za goste. Većina objekata je u franšizi, dok su samo 17 u vlasništvu tvrtke. Prema Franchise Timesu, suosnivač Ron Crume pokrenuo je 7 Brew 2017. godine u Rogersu, Arkansas – grad u Ozarksu s oko 70.000 stanovnika. Brew Culture, skupina poduzetnika, prvotno je proširila lanac na devet lokacija prije nego ga je preuzela tvrtka Drink House Holdings, koju su osnovali Jimmy John Liautaud (Jimmy John’s) i Jamie Coulter (Lone Star Steak House). Pristup 7 Brewa prati trend potrošača za brzom uslugom. Financijska direktorica Nicole Miller Regan naglašava njihovu predanost brzim i efikasnim uslugama, te ističe da se model drive-thru pokazao iznimno učinkovitim. Posebno naglašava kulturu brzine i točnosti. Drive-thru usluga veliki je trend, a u članku The New York Timesa (Kim Severson, studeni 2023.) navodi se da se dvije trećine svih kupovina brze hrane u SAD-u sada događa kroz drive-thru. Unatoč brzini, 7 Brew nudi gostoljubivo i osobno iskustvo. Kada gost stigne, zaposlenik – tzv. 'texter' – dolazi do automobila s iPadom, pozdravlja ga i uzima narudžbu, što potiče osobnu povezanost. Najveće gužve su između 8–10 ujutro i 14–16 sati popodne. Lokacije rade od 5:30 do 22:00 sata. Ponuda 7 Brewa je jednostavna, ali raznovrsna: uz kavu nude energetske napitke, čajeve, pjenušavu vodu s aromom, shakeove i smoothije. Kava se poslužuje topla ili hladna, sa ili bez šećera, sa sirupom ili zobenim mlijekom, a cold brew je izrađena isključivo od peruanske kave. Drink House Holdings Regan opisuje kao 'skupinu poduzetnika' koja djeluje kao obiteljski ured i privatna investicijska tvrtka, s ciljem otvaranja što više lokacija kako bi iskoristili trend drive-thru-a. Njihova web stranica je minimalistička, s tek jednom rečenicom – bez misije ili popisa brendova. Većina 7 Brew lokacija nalazi se u predgrađima i ruralnim područjima, posebno u Arkansasu, Missouriju, Floridi i Teksasu, budući da ovaj model nije pogodan za veće gradove. Modularni objekti od 46 kvadrata lako se i brzo postavljaju, što ih čini isplativima za franšizere. Prema Regan, idealni franšizeri dobro poznaju nekretnine, operativno poslovanje i financijski su sposobni za širenje. Svi franšizeri vode više objekata, prolaze kroz trening i usvajaju 7 Brew kulturu. Povratne informacije gostiju – poput Yelp recenzija iz Fayettevillea, Arkansas – uglavnom su pozitivne. Gosti cijene točnost pripreme, uslužnost i ljubaznost osoblja te raznovrsnost okusa. Ipak, neki, poput recenzenta Johna, poželjeli bi još bržu i manje interaktivnu uslugu. Rast 7 Brewa je stabilan: već sada imaju preko 150 lokacija, a do 2024. planiraju premašiti 200. Regan njihov uspjeh pripisuje trima ključnim faktorima: stalnoj potrebi za brzom i kvalitetnom uslugom, učinkovitom zapošljavanju i treniranju kadra te snažnim partnerstvima s franšizerima.

article_content: The Blue Lakes, nestled in the San Juan Mountains between Telluride and Ouray, have become an international hotspot for hikers and climbers eager to enjoy picturesque alpine waters and ascend the 14,150-foot Mount Sneffels. In recent years, popularity has soared to the point that the U.S. Forest Service is proposing visitor limits during the busy summer months to reduce environmental strain. Unveiled Tuesday, the plan would require all overnight campers and daytime hikers visiting from May through September to secure permits. If implemented, it would be the first day-use hiking permit for any Colorado national forest. Dana Gardunio of the Ouray Ranger District explained that the plan also includes bans on camping above treeline, removal of dispersed camping near the Blue Lakes trailhead, and reducing the number of sites at Lower Blue Lake to four, among other measures to protect plants and wildlife. The management plan covers 16,200 acres near the Mount Sneffels Wilderness, subdivided into five zones: Lower East Dallas, Blaine Basin, Yankee Boy Basin, Mount Sneffels (including the summit), and the Wilderness Zone containing the Blue Lakes. Visitation has steadily increased for decades, with notable spikes during the COVID-19 pandemic. About 35,000 people visit the Mount Sneffels Wilderness each year, mostly from June to October. On September 5, 2021, the Blue Lakes Trail recorded its highest single-day count of 509 hikers. The Forest Service estimates the permit system would limit summer visitors to about 8,000. Recreational use has resulted in environmental damage, such as improper waste disposal, trampled vegetation, wildlife habitat disturbance, illegal fires, and crowding. The Forest Service is seeking feedback on the plan, with local communities largely supportive. The current public comment period will last 45 days, and a final decision is expected by early 2024. Key elements of the Visitor Use Management Plan: Permits would be required from May 1 to September 30 for all visitors to the Blue Lakes. Up to 40 day-use permits and 24 overnight permits (for four campsites, six people each) would be issued daily via recreation.gov. Each visitor would need their own permit. Permits would not initially have fees but are expected to in the future, and the earliest start date is May 1, 2025. Camping will only be allowed at designated sites along the Blue Lakes Trail and at the trailhead/Lower Blue Lake; sites at the trailhead will be first-come, first-served. Blaine Basin will be the only zone where dispersed camping is permitted. All camping above treeline and in alpine tundra is banned, and bear-proof food storage will be required. Open fires remain prohibited in the Wilderness Zone. The new plan requires most visitors to pack out human waste using "wag bags," except in Blaine Basin, where burying waste remains allowed. A grant will add a second toilet at the trailhead, but no further toilets are planned for the Wilderness Zone. Parking will be allowed only in marked spots at Blue Lakes and Yankee Boy Basin trailheads to restrict capacity and prevent vegetation damage. Parking along roads or on private land is prohibited. Unofficial 'social' trails, both for hiking and off-roading, will be closed and restored, but all officially designated trails remain open. Off-trail driving or riding will be subject to fines.
translated_content: Blue Lakes, smješteni u planinama San Juan između Telluridea i Ouraya, postali su međunarodno popularna destinacija za planinare i penjače željne slikovitih alpskih jezera i uspona na 4.310 metara visoki Mount Sneffels. Zadnjih godina popularnost je naglo porasla, zbog čega Američka šumarska služba predlaže ograničenja posjetitelja tijekom ljetnih mjeseci kako bi se smanjio pritisak na okoliš. Predstavljen u utorak, plan bi zahtijevao da svi noćni kampisti i planinari tijekom dana, od svibnja do rujna, dobiju dozvole. Ako bude proveden, ovo bi bila prva dnevna dozvola za planinarenje u bilo kojoj nacionalnoj šumi Colorada. Dana Gardunio iz upravnog okruga Ouray objasnila je da plan također uključuje zabranu kampiranja iznad šumske granice, ukidanje raštrkanog kampiranja blizu početka staze za Blue Lakes te smanjenje broja mjesta za kampiranje kod Lower Blue Lake na četiri, uz dodatne mjere zaštite biljnog i životinjskog svijeta. Plan upravljanja obuhvaća 16.200 hektara u blizini Mount Sneffels Wilderness, podijeljenih u pet zona: Lower East Dallas, Blaine Basin, Yankee Boy Basin, Mount Sneffels (uključujući vrh) i Wilderness zonu u kojoj su Blue Lakes. Posjećenost je rasla desetljećima, s posebnim porastom tijekom pandemije COVID-19. Oko 35.000 ljudi godišnje posjeti područje Mount Sneffels Wilderness, uglavnom od lipnja do listopada. Dana 5. rujna 2021., Blue Lakes Trail zabilježio je rekordan broj od 509 planinara u jednom danu. Šumarska služba procjenjuje da bi sustav dozvola ograničio ljetne posjete na oko 8.000. Rekreacijsko korištenje uzrokovalo je štetu okolišu, poput nepravilnog odlaganja otpada, uništavanja vegetacije, ugrožavanja staništa, ilegalnog paljenja vatre i gužvi. Šumarska služba traži povratne informacije o planu, a lokalna zajednica ga uglavnom podržava. Javna rasprava traje 45 dana, a konačna odluka očekuje se početkom 2024. Ključni elementi plana: Dozvole bi bile obavezne od 1. svibnja do 30. rujna za sve posjetitelje Blue Lakes. Dnevno bi se izdavalo do 40 dozvola za dnevni posjet i 24 za noćenje (četiri mjesta, po šest osoba), putem stranice recreation.gov. Svaki posjetitelj treba vlastitu dozvolu. U početku neće biti naknade, no u budućnosti se očekuju troškovi, a najraniji datum početka je 1. svibnja 2025. Kampiranje će biti dozvoljeno samo na određenim lokacijama duž Blue Lakes staze i kod početka staze/Lower Blue Lake; kod početka staze mjesta će biti dostupna prema redoslijedu dolaska. Blaine Basin bit će jedina zona u kojoj će se dopuštati raštrkano kampiranje. Kampiranje iznad šumske granice i na alpskoj tundri je zabranjeno, te će biti obavezno koristiti spremnike za hranu otporne na medvjede. Otvorena vatra ostaje zabranjena u Wilderness zoni. Novi plan zahtijeva da većina posjetitelja sa sobom iznese ljudski otpad pomoću "wag bagova", osim u Blaine Basin zoni gdje je još uvijek dopušteno zakopavanje. Zahvaljujući sredstvima iz granta, u planu je postavljanje druge toaleta kod početka staze, ali dodatni zahodi u Wilderness zoni se ne planiraju. Parkiranje će biti dozvoljeno samo na označenim mjestima kod početka Blue Lakes i Yankee Boy Basin staza kako bi se ograničio kapacitet i zaštitila vegetacija. Parkiranje uz cestu i na privatnoj zemlji je zabranjeno. Neoznačene 'socijalne' staze za planinarenje i vožnju terencima bit će zatvorene i obnovljene, dok sve službene staze ostaju otvorene. Vožnja ili kretanje izvan dozvoljenih staza kažnjava se novčano.

The ambitious plan includes setting up academies throughout India in collaboration with football clubs, sports academies, and educational institutions. A key feature of the initiative is the establishment of Goalkeeper Academies in various regions, positioned as Centres of Excellence for goalkeeping—a critical position in any successful team. The partnership with Pro 10 in Maharashtra serves as a strategic base, enabling the Oliver Kahn Academy to establish a strong presence in the region and act as a model for football development across India. Oliver Kahn, founder of the Oliver Kahn Academy and Goalplay, brings his expertise and passion for football to India, expressing confidence in the country's untapped potential. 'India is a country with great potential in football. It needs proper football education, a disciplined curriculum, and world-class facilities to foster growth. Our goal is to help India become a better-playing nation, and I firmly believe it can succeed on the global football stage,' Kahn said. Kaushik Moulik, Senior Advisor for India and South-East Asia at Oliver Kahn Academy & Goalplay, expressed enthusiasm for the initiative: 'We are proud to introduce the Oliver Kahn Academy and Goalplay Academies in India. article_content: There are increasing reports that some Nigerian governors are administering their states from locations outside their state capitals, including Abuja and even from abroad. According to The PUNCH, residents along with various stakeholders have voiced concerns that this absentee governance undermines good governance and accountability. The report highlights that most of these governors resist handing over leadership to their deputies in their absence, opting instead to make critical decisions remotely. This practice is said to violate the principle—and commonly held expectation—that governors should maintain a physical presence as the states' Chief Security Officers, responsible for the safety and protection of their states. While not stated directly in the law, it is widely expected that a governor should not be outside their state for extended periods. The PUNCH identifies five governors as the top examples of absentee governance: 1. Kwara State Governor, AbdulRahman AbdulRazaq (APC) – Chairman, Nigeria Governors’ Forum. The opposition PDP claims he has been largely absent since assuming the NGF chairmanship. Babatunde Mohammed, the PDP chairman, alleges that security vehicles meant for law enforcement have been diverted for personal and unofficial use by government appointees. 2. Gombe State Governor, Mohammed Inuwa Yahaya (APC) – Chairman, Northern Governors’ Forum. According to ADC governorship candidate Nafiu Bala, Governor Yahaya rarely designates his deputy as acting governor, leading to criticism of his governance style. 3. Sokoto State Governor, Ahmed Aliyu Sokoto (APC). Residents have called on the governor to spend more time within the state, expressing concerns about a repeat of his predecessor’s practice of extended absences in Abuja. 4. Zamfara State Governor, Dr. Dauda Lawal (PDP). Investigations suggest the governor has seldom spent a full week in the state since his May 29 inauguration, causing local frustration, especially given Zamfara’s ongoing security crisis. Opponents argue that the governor’s frequent absences leave citizens vulnerable amidst insecurity and violence. 5. Kogi State Governor, Yahaya Bello (APC). In contrast, Governor Bello is now seen as more present in Lokoja compared to previous periods. Observers attribute his increased presence to his support for the APC governorship candidate and the aftermath of his unsuccessful APC presidential bid. Overall, the article criticizes the trend of governors managing state affairs from remote locations, emphasizing constitutional concerns and growing public and political dissatisfaction.

Za razliku od drugih, guverner Bello sada češće boravi u Lokoji nego ranije. Promatrači njegovu pojačanu prisutnost povezuju s podrškom APC-ovom kandidatu i posljedicama neuspješne predsjedničke kandidature u APC-u. article_content: The Samsung Galaxy S24 series is expected to launch earlier than in previous years, according to new reports. Sources indicate that the Galaxy Unpacked 2024 event may take place on January 17, 2024, in San Jose, California, as first reported by The Elec and relayed by SamMobile. This will be the first time Samsung is holding its flagship event in San Jose, rather than its usual locations in New York, San Francisco, or Seoul. The change appears purposeful, as San Jose is in the heart of Silicon Valley—closer to the headquarters of major competitors like Google and Apple. Samsung is reportedly moving the launch up by at least two weeks compared to the introduction of the Galaxy S23 series. While Samsung has not officially confirmed the event details, company insiders have suggested the timing and location are set. The event is expected to unveil the highly anticipated Galaxy S24 series, with preorders for the three devices likely to start immediately after launch. In Samsung's home market, preorders are anticipated to run from January 19 to 25, with general sales beginning January 30. The broader trend in the smartphone industry is toward faster product releases. Xiaomi's 14 series was launched quickly after Qualcomm introduced its new chip, and OnePlus plans to release its next flagship only 11 months after its previous model. By launching the Galaxy S24 series early, Samsung reportedly hopes to boost first-quarter sales rather than waiting until later in the year. With several reports pointing to a mid-January release, consumers can likely expect preorders to open soon.

article_content:
Some facts seem universally accepted: George Washington was the first U.S. president; Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the moon; and Orville and Wilbur Wright achieved the first powered flight. Yet, Connecticut lawmakers are challenging the last point. This week, they passed a bill to honor Gustave Whitehead, claiming he beat the Wright brothers to powered flight by two years.

Whitehead, a German immigrant, allegedly flew his aircraft 150 feet in the air for about half a mile over Bridgeport, Connecticut in 1901, according to a local newspaper at the time. This claim has gained recent support from Jane's All the World's Aircraft, a respected aviation guide. Australian aviation historian John Brown also believes the evidence supports Whitehead’s claim, citing a photograph he found in Germany that may show Whitehead in flight, along with notarized testimonies from 14 out of 17 witnesses interviewed in the 1930s and later.

However, Smithsonian historian Tom Crouch strongly disagrees, citing a lack of credible eyewitnesses and tangible evidence. He notes that only one of two key witnesses named by the 1901 newspaper could be found, and that witness denied seeing the flight. Crouch questions why Whitehead never repeated his supposed success and later used other people's designs.

The controversy is further complicated by a clause in the contract between the Wright family and the Smithsonian, which forbids the museum from crediting another aircraft as the first to achieve powered flight. Crouch insists this has not influenced his historical judgment, but some critics, including John Brown, argue otherwise.

Connecticut proponents argue recognizing Whitehead would benefit tourism and local pride. State Representative Charles Clemons Jr. sees this as a chance for Bridgeport to become synonymous with being "first in flight," potentially leading to new museums and increased visitor numbers. Bridgeport is already known as the home of the Frisbee, although that claim is also debated.

Rivalries exist beyond Connecticut. North Carolina and Ohio have long contested their shares of the Wright brothers' legacy—North Carolina celebrates Kitty Hawk, where the Wrights flew, while Ohio points to Dayton, where they developed their flying machines. The debate over Whitehead’s claim has raised tempers and questions about historical narratives.

Tom Crouch warns that repeated claims about Whitehead undermine well-established history. He also points to international disputes: In Brazil, many claim aviator Alberto Santos-Dumont deserves the title, arguing his aircraft’s wheels set it apart from the Wrights’ rail-launched flights.

The dispute over who achieved the first powered flight is not just about bragging rights, but about history, tourism, and state identity. Connecticut has reignited a controversy that could reshape the narrative of aviation history—or fade away if the evidence fails to convince.

Međutim, zakonodavci Connecticuta dovode u pitanje ovu posljednju tvrdnju. Ovaj su tjedan izglasali zakon kojim odaju počast Gustaveu Whiteheadu, tvrdeći da je on postigao motorni let dvije godine prije braće Wright.

Whitehead, njemački imigrant, navodno je letio svojim zrakoplovom 45 metara iznad tla, prešavši otprilike pola milje iznad Bridgeporta u Connecticutu 1901. godine, prema tadašnjim lokalnim novinama. Ovu tvrdnju nedavno podržava Jane’s All the World’s Aircraft, ugledni zrakoplovni vodič. Australski zrakoplovni povjesničar John Brown također smatra da dokazi idu u prilog Whiteheadu, ističući fotografiju koju je pronašao u Njemačkoj, a koja možda prikazuje Whiteheada u letu, te ovjerena svjedočanstva 14 od 17 svjedoka ispitanih 1930-ih i kasnije.

Međutim, povjesničar Smithsonian muzeja Tom Crouch snažno se protivi tome, pozivajući se na nedostatak vjerodostojnih svjedoka i konkretnih dokaza. Kaže da je samo jedan od dva ključna svjedoka koje je imenovao članak iz 1901. pronađen, a taj svjedok tvrdi da nije vidio let. Crouch također postavlja pitanje zašto Whitehead nikada nije ponovio svoj navodni uspjeh i zašto je kasnije koristio tuđe konstrukcije.

Raspravu dodatno komplicira klauzula u ugovoru između obitelji Wright i Smithsonian muzeja, koja muzeju zabranjuje da prizna drugi zrakoplov kao prvi koji je ostvario motorni let. Crouch tvrdi da taj ugovor nije utjecao na njegov povijesni sud, ali neki kritičari, uključujući Browna, tvrde suprotno.

Pristalice u Connecticutu smatraju da bi priznanje Whiteheada koristilo turizmu i lokalnom ponosu. Zastupnik Charles Clemons Jr. to vidi kao priliku da Bridgeport postane sinonim za "prvi u letu", što bi moglo dovesti do novih muzeja i većeg broja posjetitelja. Bridgeport je već poznat i kao rodno mjesto frizbija, iako je i to predmet rasprave.

Rivalstva postoje i izvan Connecticuta. Sjeverna Karolina i Ohio dugo se natječu oko nasljeđa braće Wright – Sjeverna Karolina slavi Kitty Hawk, mjesto prvog leta, dok Ohio ističe Dayton, gdje su Wrightovi razvili svoje strojeve. Debata o Whiteheadovoj tvrdnji pojačava napetosti i preispituje povijesne narative.

Crouch upozorava da stalne tvrdnje o Whiteheadu potkopavaju dobro utvrđenu priču o povijesti letenja. Ističe i međunarodne sporove: u Brazilu mnogi smatraju da prvenstvo pripada aviatoru Albertu Santos-Dumontu, jer je njegov zrakoplov imao kotače dok su Wrightovi uzlijetali s tračnica.

Rasprava o tome tko je ostvario prvi motorni let nije samo pitanje prestiža, već i povijesti, turizma i identiteta država. Connecticut je ponovno pokrenuo kontroverzu koja bi mogla promijeniti priču o zrakoplovstvu – ili nestati ako dokazi ne budu dovoljno jaki.

article_content: On Monday, Israeli forces reached the gates of Gaza City's main hospital, Al Shifa, targeting it in their operation to take control of northern Gaza. Medics report a worsening humanitarian crisis, with patients, including newborns, dying due to a lack of fuel and other essential resources. The conflict risks expanding, with increased clashes on Israel's northern border with Lebanon and recent U.S. airstrikes on Iran-linked militia positions in Syria. Israel launched its military campaign last month after Hamas militants attacked southern Israel, resulting in about 1,200 deaths and approximately 240 hostages, according to Israeli sources. This marked the deadliest single day in Israel’s history since its founding. Since then, thousands of Gaza residents have been killed, and over half the population displaced by ongoing Israeli military actions. Israel has ordered a total evacuation of northern Gaza. Gaza’s medical authorities estimate more than 11,000 deaths, with children comprising around 40% of the fatalities. Israeli ground troops entered Gaza in late October and have since encircled Gaza City. Fighting is now concentrated around Al Shifa hospital, where thousands of civilians are sheltering. Israel claims that Hamas has an underground headquarters beneath Al Shifa and is using patients as human shields, which Hamas denies. Gaza health ministry spokesperson Ashraf Al-Qidra reported that an Israeli tank was stationed at the entrance of the hospital's outpatient clinic. Israel states it has attempted to evacuate newborns and delivered 300 liters of fuel for the hospital, but these actions were blocked by Hamas. Al-Qidra disputes this and asserts that such a small amount of fuel would only last about half an hour, while the hospital requires thousands of liters per day. Dr. Ahmed El Mokhallalati, a hospital surgeon, described dire conditions, including lining up premature babies on ordinary beds due to lack of power. As of Sunday, the health ministry reported three infant deaths. World Health Organization chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said Al Shifa was 'not functioning as a hospital anymore' and urged for international attention to the crisis. The conflict, ongoing for over a month, has polarized international opinion. Many around the world argue that the brutality of the Hamas attacks does not justify the scale of civilian casualties resulting from Israel's response. Israel contends that responsibility for civilian harm lies with Hamas and has rejected ceasefire calls, claiming this would give Hamas time to regroup. The United States backs Israel but has urged efforts to limit civilian casualties. Despite orders to evacuate, many civilians remain in northern Gaza, and Israeli airstrikes continue in the south, leaving civilians desperate for safety. In Khan Younis, airstrikes have killed and injured several people, including children. The conflict has raised fears of broader escalation, with Hezbollah and Iran-backed groups launching attacks across borders, and the U.S. conducting retaliatory strikes in Syria. Iran supports Hamas but denies direct involvement in the attacks.
translated_content: U ponedjeljak su izraelske snage stigle do vrata glavne bolnice u Gazi, Al Shifa, ciljajući je u operaciji preuzimanja kontrole nad sjeverom Gaze. Liječnici javljaju o sve goroj humanitarnoj krizi, s pacijentima, uključujući novorođenčad, koji umiru zbog nedostatka goriva i drugih osnovnih sredstava. Sukob prijeti širenjem, s pojačanim sukobima na izraelskoj sjevernoj granici s Libanonom i nedavnim američkim zračnim udarima na milicije povezane s Iranom u Siriji. Izrael je pokrenuo svoju vojnu kampanju prošlog mjeseca nakon napada Hamasovih militanata na južni Izrael, u kojem je, prema izraelskim izvorima, poginulo oko 1.200 ljudi, a otprilike 240 osoba je uzeto za taoce. Ovo je bio najsmrtonosniji pojedinačni dan u izraelskoj povijesti od osnutka. Od tada je u Gazi ubijeno tisuće stanovnika, a više od polovice stanovništva je raseljeno zbog stalnih izraelskih vojnih akcija. Izrael je naredio potpunu evakuaciju sjevernog dijela Gaze. Gaze zdravstvene vlasti procjenjuju da je broj poginulih veći od 11.000, a djeca čine oko 40% žrtava. Izraelske kopnene trupe ušle su u Gazu krajem listopada i opkolile grad Gazu. Borbe su sada skoncentrirane oko bolnice Al Shifa, gdje tisuće civila traže sklonište. Izrael tvrdi da Hamas ima podzemno zapovjedništvo ispod Al Shife i koristi pacijente kao ljudski štit, što Hamas opovrgava. Glasnogovornik ministarstva zdravstva Gaze, Ashraf Al-Qidra, prijavio je da se izraelski tenk nalazi na ulazu u ambulantni odjel bolnice. Izrael tvrdi da je pokušao evakuirati novorođenčad i dostavio 300 litara goriva bolnici, no te su mjere, prema njihovim tvrdnjama, spriječene od strane Hamasa. Al-Qidra to osporava i tvrdi da bi tako mala količina goriva trajala samo oko pola sata, dok bolnici svakodnevno treba nekoliko tisuća litara. Dr. Ahmed El Mokhallalati, kirurg u bolnici, opisao je teške uvjete, uključujući smještanje nedonoščadi na obične krevete zbog nestanka struje. Prema ministarstvu zdravstva, do nedjelje su preminule tri bebe. Šef Svjetske zdravstvene organizacije Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus izjavio je da Al Shifa više ‘ne funkcionira kao bolnica’ i pozvao na međunarodnu pažnju prema krizi. Sukob koji traje više od mjesec dana polarizira međunarodno mišljenje. Mnogi smatraju da brutalnost Hamasovih napada ne opravdava razmjere civilnih žrtava uslijed izraelskog odgovora. Izrael smatra da je odgovornost za civilne žrtve na Hamasu i odbija zahtjeve za prekid vatre uz obrazloženje da bi to omogućilo Hamasu preslagivanje snaga. Sjedinjene Države podržavaju Izrael, ali pozivaju na napore za ograničavanje civilnih žrtava. Unatoč naredbi o evakuaciji, mnogi civili ostaju u sjevernom dijelu Gaze, a izraelski zračni napadi nastavljaju se i na jugu, zbog čega civili očajnički traže sigurnost. U Khan Younisu su zračni udari usmrtili i ranili više ljudi, uključujući djecu. Sukob je izazvao strah od šire eskalacije, s napadima Hezbollaha i grupa povezanih s Iranom preko granice, a SAD provodi odmazdne udare u Siriji. Iran podržava Hamas, ali poriče izravnu umiješanost u napade.

article_content: In a remote part of the Italian Alps, Sudanese and Afghan migrants trade sandals for hiking boots, preparing for a daunting trek they hope will lead them to freedom. Around 150 people have arrived at a makeshift camp in the scenic town of Oulx, where local volunteers distribute donated coats and essentials to help them survive the mountain cold ahead. Despite reaching Italy from Africa and the Middle East, most migrants—predominantly young men—aspire to continue to France and beyond. Over 130,000 migrants have entered Italy this year, almost double the number from the same period in 2021, spurred by increased boat arrivals on Lampedusa. Numbers trying to reach France have also doubled in recent months. However, French authorities have tightened border controls and are turning back undocumented migrants, suspending parts of the Schengen free movement agreement. The European Court of Justice recently ruled these pushbacks violate EU law and that detained migrants should only face forced removal as a last resort, following a formal decision. One such migrant is Omar from Nigeria, who spent months in Libya before paying smugglers $800 (£660) for a perilous Mediterranean journey to Lampedusa. After passing through several Italian camps, he now hopes to reach the UK, despite an injury sustained at sea. Although aware of stories about migrants being rejected and sent back from France or the UK, Omar insists he will try again if necessary. 'If I have to return to Nigeria,' he says, 'my parents will be devastated because their dreams have not come true.' Some migrants are intercepted early in their journey. We observe Italian police returning an Egyptian migrant to the Oulx camp after being caught before crossing. Yet, such checks are rare; volunteer Elena notes witnessing only a few instances in recent months. She suggests the Italian police are aware of the migrants' intentions but often look the other way. 'They know what’s happening, but they pretend not to notice,' she adds. When confronted with the idea that her assistance might be encouraging illegal migration, Elena dismisses the criticism. Referring to recent comments by Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, who accused NGOs supported by Germany of attracting migrants, Elena says, 'If someone needs help and you know the dangers in the mountains, can you just let them go unprepared? This is Europe’s responsibility.' After a brief bus ride to Claviere, migrants reach the border, but fearing police, most skirt the official crossing. Instead, they disappear into the misty forests, attempting the dangerous mountain passage. These treacherous routes have already claimed several lives. Other migrants attempt their luck four hours south in Ventimiglia, near Nice, camping at the station and trying to cross the border by train. French border checks are strict; police stop every train from Italy, inspecting identity documents and searching for stowaways. In one instance, several African migrants without papers are removed and sent back to Italy, where many will attempt the journey again. The surge in arrivals has stirred anger in Ventimiglia's mayor, Flavio di Muro, of the far-right Lega party. He criticizes France’s suspension of the Schengen zone, which allows for these border controls, and claims Italy faces the migration burden alone. Di Muro alleges having to place armed guards in cemeteries to prevent vandalism by migrants and warns, 'We could become the Lampedusa of the north.' As autumn sets in and temperatures plummet on the Alpine border, migrants huddle near churches, lighting fires to endure the cold night ahead. Red Cross workers provide food and water, recalling cases of migrants who suffered frostbite so severe amputations were necessary. Amid the forests of the Alps and the rail tracks of Ventimiglia, Europe faces a new migration bottleneck. Despite official efforts, the migrants’ resolve remains unbroken.
translated_content: U udaljenom dijelu talijanskih Alpa, migranti iz Sudana i Afganistana zamjenjuju sandale planinarskim čizmama, pripremajući se za zahtjevan put prema slobodi. Oko 150 ljudi stiglo je u improvizirani kamp u slikovitom gradiću Oulx, gdje im lokalni volonteri dijele donirane jakne i osnovne potrepštine kako bi preživjeli hladnoću planina. Iako su stigli u Italiju iz Afrike i Bliskog istoka, većina migranata—uglavnom mladići—nastoje nastaviti prema Francuskoj i dalje. Više od 130.000 migranata ušlo je u Italiju ove godine, gotovo dvostruko više nego u istom razdoblju 2021., zbog povećanog broja dolazaka brodom na Lampedusu. Broj onih koji pokušavaju stići do Francuske također se udvostručio proteklih mjeseci. Međutim, francuske vlasti postrožile su granične kontrole i vraćaju migrante bez dokumenata, suspendirajući dijelove Schengenskog sporazuma o slobodnom kretanju. Europski sud pravde nedavno je presudio da su takvi povrati protuzakoniti prema EU pravu te da prisilno udaljavanje smije biti samo krajnja mjera, nakon službene odluke. Jedan od takvih migranata je Omar iz Nigerije, koji je proveo mjesece u Libiji prije nego je plaćao krijumčarima 800 dolara (660 funti) za opasan prelazak Sredozemlja do Lampeduse. Nakon prolaska kroz nekoliko talijanskih kampova, sada se nada doći do Velike Britanije, unatoč ozljedi zadobijenoj na moru. Iako zna za priče o migrantima kojima su odbijeni azili u Francuskoj ili Velikoj Britaniji te su vraćeni, Omar tvrdi da će pokušati ponovno ako bude potrebno. 'Ako se moram vratiti u Nigeriju,' kaže, 'moji roditelji bit će shrvani jer im se snovi nisu ostvarili.' Neke migrante zaustave već na početku puta. Promatramo kako talijanska policija vraća egipatskog migranta u kamp u Oulxu nakon što je uhvaćen prije prelaska. Takve su kontrole ipak rijetke; volonterka Elena kaže da ih je vidjela tek nekoliko puta u posljednjih nekoliko mjeseci. Smatra da talijanska policija zna što se događa, ali često zatvara oči. 'Znaju što se događa, ali se prave da ne znaju,' dodaje. Na pitanje potiče li njen rad ilegalne migracije, Elena odbacuje kritike. Poziva se na nedavne izjave talijanske premijerke Giorgije Meloni, koja je optužila njemačke nevladine organizacije za privlačenje migranata, a Elena kaže: 'Ako netko treba pomoć i znate kakvi su rizici u planinama, možete li ih pustiti nepripremljene? To je odgovornost cijele Europe.' Nakon kratke vožnje autobusom do Clavierea, migranti stižu do granice, no u strahu od policije većina izbjegava službeni prijelaz. Umjesto toga nestaju u maglovitim šumama, pokušavajući opasni prelazak preko planina. Ove pogibeljne rute već su odnijele nekoliko života. Drugi svoju sreću pokušavaju četiri sata južnije u Ventimigliji, blizu Nice, kampirajući na kolodvoru i pokušavajući prijeći granicu vlakom. Francuske granične kontrole su stroge; policija zaustavlja svaki vlak iz Italije, provjerava putne isprave i traži skrivena putnike. U jednom slučaju više afričkih migranata bez dokumenata izvedeno je iz vlaka i vraćeno u Italiju, gdje će mnogi ponovno pokušati prijeći. Naglo povećanje broja dolazaka izazvalo je nezadovoljstvo kod gradonačelnika Ventimiglije Flavija di Mura iz krajnje desne stranke Lega. Kritizira francusku suspenziju Schengenskog prostora, što dopušta stroge kontrole, i tvrdi da Italija sama nosi migrantski teret. Di Muro tvrdi da je morao postaviti naoružane čuvare na groblju kako bi spriječio navodna oštećenja od strane migranata i upozorava: 'Možemo postati Lampedusa sjevera.' S dolaskom jeseni i padom temperatura na alpskoj granici, migranti se skupljaju u zaklonu crkava, paleći vatre kako bi prebrodili hladnu noć. Radnici Crvenog križa dijele hranu i vodu, prisjećajući se slučajeva migranata koji su, zbog teške promrzline, morali na amputaciju prstiju. Među šumama Alpa i tračnicama Ventimiglie Europa se suočava s novim uskim grlom migracija. Unatoč službenim naporima, migrantska odlučnost ne jenjava.

article_content: Eurostat’s recent analysis shows a distinct north-south divide in European employment rates. By dividing Europe into 242 NUTS 2 regions, it found that about 40% had employment rates of 78% or higher, with these areas mostly in Czechia, Denmark, Germany, Estonia, Malta, the Netherlands, and Sweden. Finland’s Åland region boasts the highest employment rate at 89.7%, followed by Warsaw in Poland at 85.4%. Utrecht in the Netherlands and Stockholm in Sweden each recorded rates of 85.1%. In contrast, less than half the population had jobs in Sicily, Calabria, and Campania in southern Italy in 2022, with employment rates of 46.2%, 47.0%, and 47.3% respectively. In the Turkish regions of Mardin, Batman, Şırnak, and Siirt, the collective employment rate was even lower at 32.8%. Most regions saw job gains from 2021 to 2022, with 90% experiencing increases. The largest improvements were in Greek regions: Epirus (+7.7 percentage points), Southern Aegean (+5.8), Crete (+5.7), and Central Greece (+5.4). The Canary Islands in Spain also saw a notable rise (+5.5). However, unemployment grew in some areas. The Opole Voivodeship region in Poland saw a drop of 1.5 percentage points; Melilla in Spain (-1.3), Lower Franconia in Germany (-1.2), and French regions Limousin (-1.0), Brittany, and Guadeloupe (each -0.9) also experienced declines. Meanwhile, EU unemployment has been falling. In August 2023, the EU unemployment rate was 5.9%, down from 6.0% in July and 6.1% in August 2022. This is affected by people outside the workforce, such as students and carers. Despite lower unemployment, job vacancies remain high. William Mitchell, a professor at the University of Newcastle, Australia, remarked that many unfilled vacancies could indicate underlying weaknesses. Job openings rose after the COVID-19 pandemic and, despite easing since mid-2022, remain well above pre-pandemic levels. This disconnect between available workers’ skills and employer needs threatens productivity and competitiveness. The EU is working to better anticipate changes in the labor market, encourage mobility, and boost adaptability. Professor Mitchell added that the European Central Bank’s interest rate hikes haven’t significantly impacted employment, saying, 'The real economy is not very sensitive to the interest rate changes within the observed range.' Fears that higher rates would lead to more unemployment by reducing consumer spending and investment have yet to play out. The ECB is expected to announce its next policy decision soon, with many analysts predicting a pause in rate hikes.

Regija Åland u Finskoj ima najvišu stopu zaposlenosti od 89,7%, a slijedi je Varšava u Poljskoj s 85,4%. Utrecht u Nizozemskoj i Stockholm u Švedskoj obje bilježe stope od 85,1%. Nasuprot tome, manje od polovice stanovništva bilo je zaposleno na Siciliji, u Kalabriji i Kampaniji na jugu Italije 2022. godine, sa stopama zaposlenosti od 46,2%, 47,0% i 47,3%. U turskim regijama Mardin, Batman, Şırnak i Siirt, ukupna stopa zaposlenosti bila je još niža, 32,8%. Većina regija zabilježila je rast zaposlenosti od 2021. do 2022., pri čemu je 90% imalo povećanja. Najveća poboljšanja dogodila su se u grčkim regijama: Epir (+7,7 postotnih bodova), Južni Egej (+5,8), Kreta (+5,7) i Središnja Grčka (+5,4). Kanarski otoci u Španjolskoj također bilježe značajan rast (+5,5). Ipak, zaposlenost je pala u nekim područjima. Regija Opole Voivodeship u Poljskoj doživjela je pad od 1,5 postotnih bodova; Melilla u Španjolskoj (-1,3), Donja Frankonija u Njemačkoj (-1,2), te francuske regije Limousin (-1,0), Bretanja i Guadeloupe (svaka -0,9) također su zabilježile padove. U međuvremenu, nezaposlenost u EU opada. U kolovozu 2023. stopa nezaposlenosti u EU iznosila je 5,9%, što je pad u odnosu na 6,0% u srpnju i 6,1% u kolovozu 2022. Na tu brojku utječu osobe izvan radne snage, poput studenata i njegovatelja. Usprkos nižoj nezaposlenosti, broj slobodnih radnih mjesta ostaje visok. William Mitchell, profesor na Sveučilištu Newcastle u Australiji, ističe da većina nepopunjenih radnih mjesta može ukazivati na temeljne slabosti. Ponuda poslova naglo je porasla nakon pandemije COVID-19, a iako se smanjuje od sredine 2022., još je znatno viša nego prije pandemije. Ovaj nesklad između vještina radne snage i potreba poslodavaca prijeti produktivnosti i konkurentnosti. EU ulaže napore da bolje predviđa promjene na tržištu rada, potiče mobilnost i povećava prilagodljivost. Profesor Mitchell je dodao da povećanje kamatnih stopa Europske središnje banke nije značajno utjecalo na zaposlenost, rekavši: 'Realno gospodarstvo nije jako osjetljivo na promjene kamatnih stopa u opaženom rasponu.' Strahovi da će više kamate uzrokovati rast nezaposlenosti zbog manjeg trošenja i ulaganja još se nisu ostvarili. Očekuje se da će ECB uskoro objaviti svoju sljedeću odluku o politici, a mnogi analitičari predviđaju pauzu u podizanju kamata.

article_content: The new political drama 'State of Affairs' features Katherine Heigl as Charleston Tucker, a CIA analyst tasked with keeping the president updated on major national security issues. She compiles these updates in the President's Daily Brief (PDB). However, the CIA has clarified that paper briefs are a thing of the past. The agency has been live-tweeting during episodes, using the show's storylines to correct misconceptions and educate viewers about the history and current form of the PDB. While the show often presents Heigl's character delivering a printed brief to the president (played by Alfre Woodard), the CIA notes that the PDB hasn't been printed in years. Instead, President Barack Obama and other key policymakers read the document on tablets. In certain episodes, the show depicts in-person meetings among CIA agents, which the agency points out is risky since adversaries could target both parties together. To avoid this risk, real CIA agents often use methods like 'dead drops'—hiding information in secure locations for retrieval. The CIA even shared an image from their museum of an old dead drop spike, a hollow device used for this purpose. A CIA spokesperson told TMZ that 'State of Affairs' helps counter myths about the agency, and that social media offers a good way to inform viewers while the show airs. The series gains added authenticity from its producers, two former CIA officials: Rodney Faraon, who worked on the daily briefing team for the Clinton and George W. Bush administrations, and Henry Crumpton, a former counterterrorism chief. Heigl noted that the series works closely with these experts to ensure accuracy. The PDB has been prepared for U.S. presidents for over 60 years. It has evolved from the first 'Daily Summary' for President Truman in 1946, to a more compact 'President's Intelligence Checklist' during the Kennedy administration—known as 'PICL' or 'pickle'—designed to fit in a jacket pocket. To promote transparency in how the CIA is represented in entertainment, the agency maintains an Entertainment Industry Liaison office. This office answers questions, corrects misinformation, and sometimes arranges visits and provides images to filmmakers and producers.

Te informacije prikuplja u Izvještaj za predsjednika (PDB). Ipak, CIA je pojasnila kako su papirnati izvještaji stvar prošlosti. Agencija uživo tvita za vrijeme emitiranja epizoda, koristeći radnju serije kako bi ispravila zablude i educirala gledatelje o povijesti i današnjem korištenju PDB-a. Iako serija često prikazuje Heiglinu liku kako predsjednici (koju glumi Alfre Woodard) predaje tiskani izvještaj, CIA napominje da se PDB već godinama ne tiska. Umjesto toga, predsjednik Barack Obama i drugi ključni tvorci politika čitaju dokument na tabletima. U određenim epizodama serija prikazuje izravne sastanke među CIA agentima, što agencija smatra rizičnim jer bi protivnici mogli naštetiti objema stranama. Kako bi izbjegli taj rizik, pravi CIA agenti često koriste metode poput 'dead dropova'—sakrivanja informacija na sigurnim lokacijama koje drugi mogu preuzeti. CIA je čak podijelila sliku iz svog muzeja na kojoj je stari 'dead drop spike', šuplji uređaj koji se zabija u zemlju radi prikrivanja. Glasnogovornik CIA-e rekao je za TMZ da serija 'State of Affairs' pomaže u razbijanju mitova o agenciji te da društvene mreže nude dobar način za informiranje gledatelja dok traje prikazivanje. Serija dodatnu autentičnost dobiva zahvaljujući producentskom paru—dvojici bivših CIA dužnosnika: Rodneyju Faraonu, koji je radio na timu za dnevne izvještaje u Clintonovoj i Bushovoj administraciji, i Henryju Crumptonu, bivšem šefu protuterorističkog odjela. Heigl je istaknula da serija blisko surađuje s ovim stručnjacima radi što veće preciznosti. PDB se za američke predsjednike priprema već više od 60 godina. Evoluirao je od prvog 'Daily Summary' za predsjednika Trumana 1946., do kompaktnijeg 'President's Intelligence Checklist' u Kennedyjevoj administraciji—poznatog kao 'PICL' ili 'pickle'—dovoljno malog da stane u džep sakoa. Radi bolje transparentnosti u prikazivanju CIA-e u zabavnoj industriji, agencija ima Ured za vezu sa zabavnom industrijom. Taj ured odgovara na pitanja, ispravlja dezinformacije i ponekad omogućuje posjete i pruža slike filmašima i producentima.

article_content: At AWS re:Invent 2023, Amazon unveiled major generative AI improvements to its flagship cloud security tools: Amazon Detective and Amazon Inspector. These advancements push the boundaries of using AI to enhance cybersecurity and simplify code management in cloud computing. With the new updates, Amazon Detective uses generative AI to organize and summarize security events in plain language, making investigations faster and more accessible for teams. This tool efficiently analyzes large volumes of log data and presents clear, actionable insights. Amazon Inspector, meanwhile, now extends its scanning abilities to AWS Lambda functions, using generative AI to not only detect code vulnerabilities but also suggest practical remediation patches. This approach allows developers to quickly address issues, improving the security of cloud operations. Amazon's Chief Security Officer, Steve Schmidt, emphasized the importance of understanding human behavior in cybersecurity and highlighted the value of AI in strengthening protection layers to stay ahead of threats. Industry leaders such as Alan Shimel and Rob Enderle praised these upgrades, noting their potential to greatly increase both security team efficiency and developer productivity. By delivering not just alerts but also solutions, these tools help businesses respond faster and reinforce cloud defenses. As AWS integrates more AI-driven capabilities, the future of cloud security is becoming smarter and more automated, setting the stage for stronger and more adaptive digital protection.

article_content: Chuck Hagel, President Barack Obama's nominee for Defense Secretary, defended his national security record during a contentious Senate confirmation hearing. Senior Republicans, including former colleagues from his time as a Nebraska senator, accused him of appeasing America’s enemies. Critics have portrayed Hagel, a decorated Vietnam War veteran, as soft on Iran and anti-Israel based on statements they argue were taken out of context. In his opening remarks, Hagel stated that all options should be considered to prevent Iran from developing nuclear weapons, a phrase often interpreted as including military action. 'My policy is one of prevention, not containment,' he said. Hagel referred to Iran’s government as 'elected and legitimate,' though President Obama has questioned the fairness of Iranian elections. Some Republican senators, including James Inhofe, the ranking member of the Armed Services Committee, openly opposed Hagel's nomination, calling him 'the wrong person to lead the Pentagon at this perilous and consequential time.' Inhofe argued that Hagel had a troubling record, appearing willing to appease adversaries and distance the U.S. from its allies. Hagel responded that no single vote, statement, or quote defined his beliefs or record, reaffirming his commitment to maintaining the strongest military in the world and backing U.S. policies to prevent Iran from acquiring nuclear weapons and ensuring Israel's security. Committee chairman Carl Levin noted that his concerns about Hagel’s stance on unilateral sanctions against Iran had been addressed, and he was reassured by Hagel’s support for the Obama administration’s strong position on Iran. Hagel faced questions when he explained voting against declaring the Iranian Revolutionary Guard a terrorist organization, describing Iran as a 'recognized' government. He clarified that, while the U.S. disagrees with Iran, it is a United Nations member with which most countries have diplomatic ties. Freedom House, a pro-democracy group, maintains that Iran is not an electoral democracy due to restrictions on candidate eligibility and protest suppression. Unlike Senator John Kerry, who was easily confirmed as Secretary of State, Hagel’s hearing was marked by tough questioning on Israel, Iran, military budgets, and treatment of women and LGBTQ individuals in the military. Of the 45 Republican senators, only Thad Cochran of Mississippi expressed support for Hagel. Hagel held individual meetings with 53 senators before the hearings. Hagel submitted 112 pages of written responses, promising to keep the military ready to act against Iran if necessary, but advocated caution and certainty before using force. He also supported the U.S. military withdrawal from Afghanistan and pledged unwavering commitment to Israel’s security. Most observers expect Hagel will be confirmed by the committee along party lines, with Democrats holding a Senate majority, though some Republican support may still be needed to overcome procedural obstacles.

Viši republikanci, uključujući bivše kolege iz vremena kad je bio senator Nebraske, optužili su ga za popuštanje američkim neprijateljima. Kritičari su prikazali Hagela, odlikovanog veterana Vijetnamskog rata, kao popustljivog prema Iranu i protivnika Izraela, pozivajući se na izjave za koje smatraju da su izvučene iz konteksta. U uvodnom izlaganju Hagel je istaknuo da treba razmotriti sve opcije kako bi se spriječilo da Iran razvije nuklearno oružje, što se često tumači kao otvorenost prema vojnoj opciji. 'Moja politika je prevencija, a ne zadržavanje,' rekao je. Hagel je iransku vladu nazvao 'izabranom i legitimnom', iako je predsjednik Obama doveo u pitanje pravednost iranskih izbora. Neki republikanski senatori, uključujući Jamesa Inhofea, glavnog člana Odbora za oružane snage, javno su se usprotivili Hagelovoj nominaciji, nazvavši ga 'pogrešnom osobom za vođenje Pentagona u ovom opasnom i presudnom vremenu.' Inhofe je ustvrdio da Hagel ima problematičnu prošlost, sklonost popuštanju protivnicima i udaljavanju SAD-a od saveznika. Hagel je odgovorio da ga ne definira nijedan glas, izjava ili citat, te je potvrdio svoju predanost održavanju najjače vojske na svijetu i podupiranju američke politike sprječavanja Irana da nabavi nuklearno oružje i sigurnosti Izraela. Predsjednik odbora Carl Levin iznio je da su njegove sumnje u vezi Hagelovog stava o jednostranim sankcijama protiv Irana razjašnjene, te da ga Hagelova podrška snažnoj poziciji Obamine administracije protiv Irana uvjerava. Hagel se suočio s pitanjima kada je pojasnio svoj glas protiv proglašenja Iranske revolucionarne garde terorističkom organizacijom, nazvavši Iran 'priznatom' vladom. On je pojasnio da, iako se SAD ne slaže s Iranom, Iran je član Ujedinjenih naroda s kojim većina država ima diplomatske odnose. Freedom House, organizacija za promicanje demokracije, smatra da Iran nije izborna demokracija zbog ograničenja u izboru kandidata i gušenja prosvjeda. Za razliku od senatora Johna Kerryja, koji je brzo potvrđen za državnog tajnika, Hagelovo saslušanje bilo je obilježeno teškim pitanjima o Izraelu, Iranu, vojnom proračunu te pravima žena i LGBTQ osoba u vojsci. Od 45 republikanskih senatora, samo je Thad Cochran iz Mississippija javno podržao Hagela. Hagel je održao individualne sastanke s 53 senatora prije saslušanja. Hagel je dostavio 112 stranica pisanih odgovora, obećavši da će vojska biti spremna djelovati protiv Irana ako bude potrebno, ali je naglasio važnost opreznog i sigurnog odlučivanja prije korištenja sile. Također je podržao povlačenje američke vojske iz Afganistana i čvrstu predanost sigurnosti Izraela. Većina smatra da će Hagel biti potvrđen u odboru prema stranačkim linijama, s obzirom na prevlast demokrata u Senatu, iako bi mogla biti potrebna podrška nekih republikanaca radi proceduralnih prepreka.
