article_content: In a historic move, the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank are hosting their annual meeting in Marrakech, Morocco—the first time in 50 years the event has returned to Africa. Originally slated earlier, the gathering was delayed by the pandemic, making this convening particularly timely. This year’s discussions come on the heels of a severe earthquake in Morocco, which claimed nearly 3,000 lives and inflicted close to $12 billion in damages. Policymakers and civil society alike are now placing a strong focus on economic strategies for coping with natural disasters. IMF managing director Kristalina Georgieva recently underscored international cooperation, especially in addressing climate change and supporting vulnerable nations facing crises they did not create. The IMF and World Bank, known as lenders of last resort, channel billions in assistance to support struggling economies. However, they often face criticism over their decision-making processes—accused of sidelining the most vulnerable countries and requiring unpopular fiscal reforms. As Iskander Erzini Vernoit from Morocco’s Imal Initiative for Climate & Development notes, many Arab and African countries are facing multiple external shocks, resulting in a significant financing gap—one estimated in the trillions—and hard questions about how affordable new borrowing is. Developing nations, especially in Africa, deal not only with pandemic fallout but also with rapid increases in energy and food costs linked to the war in Ukraine. For these countries, debt payments routinely surpass spending on healthcare and education, forcing governments to make tough funding choices. Following the earthquake, the IMF approved a $1.3 billion loan for Morocco to boost disaster preparedness and resilience. The country, a frequent IMF borrower, experienced particular hardship during the pandemic’s blow to tourism and exports and faces continued encouragement from the IMF to enforce budget discipline and raise interest rates. The contrast between Marrakech's modernized, conference-ready streets and the realities in rural mountain villages is clear. While the city showcases new buildings and restored landmarks for the event, remote areas still struggle with unpaved roads, limited water, and scarce jobs. Miner Brahim Ait Brahim, from the earthquake-affected village of Anerni, says he’s yet to receive emergency financial or housing support a month after losing his home. “That’s Marrakech—it’s tourism’s capital and Morocco’s face to the world. But here, our problems stay hidden,” he remarks.
translated_content: U povijesnom potezu, Međunarodni monetarni fond (MMF) i Svjetska banka održavaju svoj godišnji sastanak u Marakešu u Maroku—prvi put nakon 50 godina da se događaj vraća u Afriku. Izvorno planiran ranije, skup se zbog pandemije odgodio, što ovo okupljanje čini iznimno pravovremenim. Ovogodišnje rasprave dolaze nakon snažnog potresa u Maroku u kojem je poginulo gotovo 3.000 ljudi, a šteta je dosegla skoro 12 milijardi dolara. I donositelji politika i civilno društvo sada snažno fokusiraju pažnju na ekonomske strategije u suočavanju s prirodnim katastrofama. Ravnateljica MMF-a Kristalina Georgieva nedavno je naglasila važnost međunarodne suradnje, posebno u borbi protiv klimatskih promjena i podršci ranjivim državama koje se suočavaju s krizama koje nisu same uzrokovale. MMF i Svjetska banka, poznati kao posljednji zajmodavci, dodjeljuju milijarde pomoći za podršku posrnulim gospodarstvima. Ipak, često su predmet kritika zbog svojih procesa donošenja odluka—optužuju ih da zanemaruju najranjivije zemlje i zahtijevaju nepopularne fiskalne reforme. Kako naglašava Iskander Erzini Vernoit iz marokanske Inicijative Imal za klimu i razvoj, brojne arapske i afričke zemlje suočavaju se s višestrukim vanjskim šokovima, što je dovelo do značajnog financijskog jaza—procijenjenog na trilijune dolara—i teških pitanja o tome koliko je novo zaduživanje zapravo pristupačno. Zemlje u razvoju, osobito u Africi, ne bore se samo s posljedicama pandemije već i s naglim porastima cijena energije i hrane zbog rata u Ukrajini. Za mnoge, otplate duga često prelaze izdatke za zdravstvo i obrazovanje, prisiljavajući ih na teške odluke oko javnog financiranja. Nakon potresa, MMF je odobrio Maroku zajam od 1,3 milijarde dolara kako bi ojačao pripravnost i otpornost na prirodne katastrofe. Maroko, čest korisnik MMF-ovih zajmova, posebno je trpio tijekom pandemije zbog pada turizma i izvoza, te nastavlja primati poticaje MMF-a za strožu proračunsku disciplinu i povećanje kamatnih stopa. Kontrast između moderniziranog, za konferenciju pripremljenog Marakeša i stvarnosti u ruralnim planinskim selima je očit. Dok se grad pokazuje novim zgradama i obnovljenim znamenitostima za događaj, udaljena područja još pate zbog neasfaltiranih cesta, ograničene dostupnosti vode i oskudnih radnih mjesta. Rudar Brahim Ait Brahim iz sela Anerni, pogođenog potresom, kaže da ni mjesec dana nakon što mu je kuća uništena još uvijek nije dobio hitnu financijsku ili stambenu pomoć. “To je Marakeš—glavni grad turizma i lice Maroka prema svijetu. Ali ovdje, naši problemi ostaju skriveni,” ističe.

article_content: MADRID — Early Monday, two boats carrying a total of 314 migrants arrived on Spain’s Canary Islands, bringing the total to more than 1,600 arrivals since Friday, according to emergency services. One vessel, carrying 229 people, was escorted to El Hierro island, while another boat with 85 migrants landed on Tenerife. Over the weekend, another boat arrived on Saturday with 320 migrants onboard. According to Spain’s state news agency EFE, this is the largest number of people recorded in a single boat since traffickers began regularly using the Canary Islands route in 1994. The previous record of 280 occurred earlier this month. Most boats have arrived at El Hierro, which has received several thousand migrants in recent weeks. The Canary Islands are located off Africa’s northwest coast. Most migrants arriving on these boats come from sub-Saharan African countries, with many departing from Senegal. Once in Spain, migrants are typically held in police custody for up to 72 hours for identification. They are then moved to reception or detention centers, depending on their situation. Some are deported, but most apply for asylum and are transferred to mainland Spain for their cases to be processed. In many instances, those whose asylum requests are denied are released and ordered to leave the country. Spain’s Interior Ministry reports that nearly 23,500 migrants reached the Canary Islands by boat between January 1 and October 15, representing a 90% increase compared to the same period last year. ___ Follow AP’s global migration coverage at https://apnews.com/hub/migration

Jedan brod s 229 ljudi bio je eskortiran na otok El Hierro, dok je drugi s 85 migranata pristao na Tenerife. Tijekom vikenda, još jedan brod stigao je u subotu s 320 migranata na brodu. Prema državnoj novinskoj agenciji EFE, ovo je najveći broj ljudi zabilježen u jednom brodu otkad krijumčari redovito koriste Kanarske otoke kao rutu od 1994. Prijašnji rekord od 280 postavljen je ranije ovog mjeseca. Većina brodova pristaje na El Hierro, koji je posljednjih tjedana primio nekoliko tisuća migranata. Kanarski otoci nalaze se uz sjeverozapadnu obalu Afrike. Većina migranata koji dolaze brodom dolazi iz zemalja podsaharske Afrike, a mnogi polaze iz Senegala. Po dolasku u Španjolsku, migranti su obično do 72 sata u policijskom pritvoru radi identifikacije. Nakon toga premješta ih se u prihvatilišta ili centre za zadržavanje, ovisno o njihovoj situaciji. Neki budu deportirani, ali većina traži azil i prebacuje se na španjolsko kopno kako bi se razmotrili njihovi zahtjevi. U mnogim slučajevima, oni kojima azil nije odobren budu pušteni i naređeno im je da napuste zemlju. Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova Španjolske navodi da je gotovo 23.500 migranata stiglo brodom na Kanarske otoke između 1. siječnja i 15. listopada, što je porast od 90% u odnosu na isto razdoblje prošle godine. ___ Pratite AP-ovo svjetsko izvještavanje o migracijama na https://apnews.com/hub/migration

article_content: Swedish firm Einride has launched round-the-clock operations of its cabless, electric, self-driving truck at GE Appliances’ plant in Selmer, Tennessee. This driverless vehicle shuttles finished products between the manufacturing site and adjacent warehouse along a private 0.3-mile route, completing as many as seven trips per day from Monday through Thursday. The deployment comes after extensive pilot programs, including secure site and public road trials. The initiative supports GE Appliances’ goal of automating logistics for improved worker safety, comfort, and efficiency. Technologies at play include AI-activated dock doors and the Slip robot, which automates loading and unloading to cut times by up to 80%. GE Appliances’ executive Harry Chase emphasized how autonomous operations cut emissions and let staff focus on more rewarding tasks instead of strenuous ergonomic work. Einride’s head of autonomous technology, Henrik Green, stated the company is proud to partner with GE Appliances and pioneer industry advancements. Einride debuted its first autonomous truck design in 2017, continually updating the technology.

Uvođenje kamiona slijedi nakon uspješnih pilot-projekata na sigurnim i javnim lokacijama. Projekt je dio inicijative GE Appliances za automatizaciju logistike radi sigurnosti, bolje ergonomije i efikasnosti zaposlenika. Korištena tehnologija uključuje AI kamere koje automatski upravljaju vratima dokova i Slip robota za automatizirano utovarivanje/istovarivanje, čime se vrijeme utovara smanjuje i do 80%. Izvršni direktor GE Appliances, Harry Chase, ističe kako autonomna vozila smanjuju emisije te zaposlenicima omogućuju rad na manje fizički zahtjevnim i vrednijim poslovima. Einride je svoju prvu autonomnu kamionsku verziju predstavio još 2017. godine i od tada tehnologiju stalno unaprjeđuje.

article_content: A hatch that Israeli authorities asserted was an entrance to a Hamas tunnel beneath the Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa Hospital in Gaza is, in reality, an access point for a water reservoir, according to an investigation by Sanad, Al Jazeera’s digital research unit. Israeli officials have repeatedly alleged that Gaza hospitals conceal tunnels and command centers used by Hamas, using these claims to justify strikes on medical facilities—which, under international law, are protected sites. Sanad’s probe involved analysis of satellite imagery, historical construction records, and interviews, including with an original engineer of the hospital. Their findings show that the hatch is used to access a reservoir that supplies water to therapeutic pools for amputees, irrigates hospital grounds, and serves as an emergency water reserve. The hospital, funded and built by Qatar, began operation in 2019 and, like other hospitals in the Gaza Strip, has sustained damage from Israeli air raids targeting health facilities. The Israeli military has made similar assertions about other hospitals in Gaza, such as al-Shifa, claiming they are used to conceal Hamas operations. Experts have noted that attacks on hospitals could constitute violations of international law given the protected status of medical sites and civilians.

Izraelski dužnosnici su više puta tvrdili da bolnice u Gazi skrivaju tunele i zapovjedne centre koje koristi Hamas, koristeći te tvrdnje kao opravdanje za napade na medicinske ustanove – koje su prema međunarodnom pravu zaštićena mjesta. Sanadova istraga uključivala je analizu satelitskih snimaka, povijesnu dokumentaciju o izgradnji i intervjue, uključujući jednog od izvornih inženjera bolnice. Njihova otkrića pokazuju da se poklopac koristi za pristup rezervoaru iz kojeg se opskrbljuju terapeutski bazeni za amputirce, zalijeva bolnički okoliš i služi kao pričuva vode u hitnim situacijama. Bolnicu, koju je financirao i izgradio Katar, započela je s radom 2019. godine i, kao i druge bolnice u Pojasu Gaze, pretrpjela je štetu od izraelskih zračnih napada na zdravstvene ustanove. Izraelska vojska iznijela je slične tvrdnje i za druge bolnice u Gazi, poput al-Shife, tvrdeći da se koriste za skrivanje Hamasovih aktivnosti. Stručnjaci su napomenuli da napadi na bolnice mogu predstavljati kršenje međunarodnog prava s obzirom na zaštićeni status medicinskih ustanova i civila.

article_content: Many of us have recorded live concerts on our phones, yet rarely revisit these videos. Instead of immersing ourselves in the music, we often become distracted by the urge to document the experience—sometimes more for social media than for lasting memories. This habit can be disruptive to other concertgoers, as highlighted by the indie rock band Yeah Yeah Yeahs. At a performance at Webster Hall in New York, they posted a sign politely asking fans not to record, in consideration of those behind them and the band members. While documenting concerts with phones is not new, the ubiquity of smartphones has made it increasingly common. Filming with phones often creates a disconnect, affecting both the person recording and others attending. At a Roger Waters’ performance of 'The Wall,' many audience members spent more time filming than engaging directly with the live show. Conversely, at the Wanee Festival in Live Oak, Florida, unreliable cell service minimized phone use, resulting in a more engaging musical experience for attendees. Although professional concert photography is valued, casual phone recording is usually distracting and unnecessary. The author encourages audiences to experience live music fully, sharing their memories through conversation instead of screens.

Autor poziva publiku da doživi live glazbu, a uspomene dijeli u razgovoru, a ne preko ekrana.

article_content: In 2006, the International Astronomical Union (IAU) changed Pluto’s classification from a planet to a dwarf planet after the discovery of other objects in the solar system that share similar characteristics. This decision, while contentious, was based on IAU rules that require a planet to orbit the sun, be nearly round in shape, and have cleared its orbital neighborhood—criteria Pluto does not fully meet. A recent debate at the Harvard-Smithsonian Center for Astrophysics revisited Pluto’s status. Experts expressed differing opinions: Dr Gareth Williams from the Minor Planet Centre supported the IAU’s position, explaining that Pluto’s inability to clear its orbit makes it a dwarf planet. Science historian Dr Owen Gingerich advocated for Pluto’s classification as a planet due to its impact on culture and history, while Dr Dimitar Sasselov of the Harvard Origins of Life Initiative argued for a broader definition of planets as any spherical object orbiting a star. After these presentations, an audience consisting of both specialists and the public voted, and most favored Dr Sasselov’s inclusive definition, siding with Pluto’s planetary status. Although non-binding, this outcome demonstrates continued enthusiasm for recognizing Pluto as a planet. However, scientists caution that if Pluto were again considered a planet, many similar celestial bodies—like Ceres and Eris—would also qualify, possibly leading to a much larger list of planets in our solar system. While the debate continues, Pluto is still officially classified as a dwarf planet. NASA’s New Horizons spacecraft is scheduled to fly by Pluto in July 2015, following up on Hubble Space Telescope images with new insights into its surface.

Odluka, koja je izazvala polemike, temeljila se na pravilima IAU-a prema kojima planet mora kružiti oko Sunca, biti gotovo okruglog oblika i očistiti svoju orbitu od ostalih objekata—što Pluto ne ispunjava u potpunosti. article_content: China has recently taken a softer approach in its international relations, releasing an Australian journalist from prison, inviting the US military to a defense forum, and agreeing to a $4.2 billion debt restructuring deal with Sri Lanka. This shift comes as President Xi Jinping addresses significant domestic economic challenges. While the United States welcomes China’s gestures—especially as Washington manages the Middle East crisis—analysts suggest this approach may be temporary and that old tensions could reemerge. Noah Barkin, an analyst at the Rhodium Group, noted that Chinese leaders want to reassure foreign investors and show that relations with the US and its allies are not escalating uncontrollably. Last week, China released Australian news anchor Cheng Lei after three years in detention, paving the way for an Australian prime ministerial visit. The US has also been invited to a defense forum in Beijing—a sign of easing military tensions. President Xi had positive remarks for a US delegation led by Senator Chuck Schumer. As Xi hosts a forum for the 10th anniversary of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), Beijing has agreed to restructure over $4 billion of Sri Lanka’s debt and signed a memorandum to address Zambian debt. Zambia was the first African country to default during the COVID-19 pandemic. A spokesperson from China’s foreign ministry said China seeks a 'return to the path of healthy and stable development' in US-China relations and values cooperation with developing countries. China’s diplomatic shift is seen as a response to domestic economic pressure, including capital flight, a property crisis, and high youth unemployment. According to Willy Lam from the Jamestown Foundation, Xi Jinping is reaching out to Western powers to slow multinational departures and protect China’s role in global supply chains. However, China has not moderated its stance on every issue. Tensions remain with the Philippines in the South China Sea. At the same time, China is deepening trade and political relations with developing countries as part of Xi’s vision for a multipolar world. Some critics characterize the BRI as 'debt trap diplomacy,' but Huiyao Wang of the Center for China and Globalization argues that the BRI is intended to help developing countries, likening it to the post-World War II Marshall Plan. Recent political shifts, such as the disappearances of foreign minister Qin Gang and defense chief Li Shangfu, have complicated China’s foreign policy. A potential meeting between Xi and President Joe Biden at an upcoming Asia-Pacific summit may stabilize relations. However, with the US presidential election next year and possible policy changes, significant concessions on issues like trade tariffs and semiconductor exports seem unlikely. Chinese military activity ahead of Taiwan’s elections could further strain relations. Zack Cooper of the American Enterprise Institute predicts that current engagement may be short-lived, with fundamental tensions likely to resurface.

Ova promjena dolazi dok se predsjednik Xi Jinping suočava sa značajnim domaćim ekonomskim izazovima. Iako Sjedinjene Države pozdravljaju kineske geste—posebno dok Washington rješava krizu na Bliskom istoku—analitičari sugeriraju da bi ovaj pristup mogao biti privremen te da bi se stara napetost mogla ponovno pojaviti. Noah Barkin, analitičar iz Rhodium Group, napominje kako kineski čelnici žele umiriti strane ulagače i pokazati da odnosi s SAD-om i saveznicima nisu u nekontroliranoj eskalaciji. Prošlog tjedna Kina je pustila australsku novinarku Cheng Lei nakon tri godine pritvora, čime je otvoren put za posjet australskog premijera. SAD su također pozvane na obrambeni forum u Pekingu—što je znak smanjenja vojnih napetosti. Predsjednik Xi dao je pozitivne komentare na delegaciju SAD-a koju je predvodio senator Chuck Schumer. Dok Xi održava forum povodom 10. godišnjice inicijative Pojas i put (BRI), Peking je pristao restrukturirati više od 4 milijarde dolara duga Šri Lanke te je potpisan memorandum za rješavanje duga Zambije. Zambija je prva afrička država koja je bankrotirala tijekom pandemije COVID-19. Glasnogovornik kineskog ministarstva vanjskih poslova rekao je kako Kina želi „povratak na put zdravog i stabilnog razvoja” odnosa s SAD-om te cijeni suradnju s državama u razvoju. Diplomatski zaokret tumači se kao reakcija na domaće ekonomske pritiske, uključujući odljev kapitala, krizu nekretnina i visoku nezaposlenost mladih. Prema Willyju Lamu iz Jamestown Foundationa, Xi Jinping se okreće zapadnim silama kako bi usporio odlazak multinacionalnih kompanija i zaštitio kinesku poziciju u globalnim lancima opskrbe. Ipak, Kina nije ublažila stav u svim pitanjima. Napetosti s Filipinima u Južnokineskom moru i dalje traju. Istovremeno, Kina jača trgovinske i političke veze s državama u razvoju u sklopu Xi-jeve vizije multipolarnog svijeta. Neki kritičari nazivaju BRI 'dužničkom diplomacijom', no Huiyao Wang iz Center for China and Globalization tvrdi da je BRI namijenjen pomaganju državama u razvoju, usporedivši ga s Marshallovim planom nakon Drugog svjetskog rata. Nedavne političke promjene, poput nestanaka ministra vanjskih poslova Qina Ganga i ministra obrane Li Shangfua, zakomplicirale su kinesku vanjsku politiku. Mogući susret između Xija i predsjednika SAD-a Joea Bidena na predstojećem azijsko-pacifičkom summitu mogao bi stabilizirati odnose. No, s američkim predsjedničkim izborima iduće godine i mogućim promjenama politike, značajni ustupci o pitanjima poput carina i izvoza poluvodiča čine se malo vjerojatnim. Kineske vojne aktivnosti uoči izbora na Tajvanu mogle bi dodatno pogoršati odnose. Zack Cooper iz American Enterprise Institutea predviđa da bi trenutni angažman mogao biti kratkotrajan te da će se temeljne napetosti vjerojatno ponovno pojaviti.

article_content: Some conservatives dissatisfied with House Speaker John Boehner's leadership are exploring potential replacements, and recent actions by Texas Republican Jeb Hensarling are fueling speculation that he could seek the speakership in the next Congress. Hensarling, who was previously part of Boehner's leadership team and now chairs the House Financial Services Committee, recently delivered a significant speech hosted by Heritage Action for America—a group frequently at odds with Boehner. When asked about becoming speaker, Hensarling said he was 'flattered' but claimed not to be actively considering it, although he did not definitively rule it out. Heritage Action CEO Michael Needham told CNN that the group doesn't participate in leadership fights, but acknowledged that Hensarling had been given a prominent stage to articulate his conservative agenda. Needham emphasized the need for Republicans to challenge entrenched interests in Washington, criticizing the party's perceived alignment with corporate lobbyists. He praised Hensarling as a persuasive advocate for conservative principles. Boehner, currently in his 12th congressional term and second term as speaker, continues to assert that he intends to remain in the role. However, he created ambiguity earlier this month by not committing to complete another full term. At the start of the current Congress in 2013, about a dozen House GOP members withheld support for Boehner, either voting for someone else or voting 'present.' Many in that group believe Boehner may not seek the speakership again after this year's midterm elections or could lack sufficient support to keep the post. Should Boehner step down, House Majority Leader Eric Cantor is widely seen as the likely successor among conservatives, which could also open opportunities for conservatives to fill other key leadership positions. While Hensarling is recognized as a solid conservative, other Republicans mentioned as possible candidates include Jim Jordan of Ohio, Steve Scalise of Louisiana, and Tom Price of Georgia—all of whom have experience leading fiscally conservative caucuses. Louisiana Republican John Fleming told CNN there is widespread desire among House Republicans for more conservatives in leadership, yet no clear challenger to Boehner has emerged. Fleming anticipates more serious leadership discussions to take place by the end of summer. Hensarling's recent speech reemphasized conservative economic values and criticized the GOP for moving away from free-market principles, which resonates with the party's conservative wing. Idaho's Raul Labrador has echoed similar criticisms, arguing that House GOP leaders have focused too much on supporting big business rather than small businesses and entrepreneurs. Hensarling called for policies that support Main Street instead of offering subsidies or special advantages, and advocated for reforms in tax policy, agriculture, and mortgage finance to restructure existing federal programs. A central focus of Hensarling's speech was opposition to the Export-Import Bank, which he called an example of corporate welfare mainly benefiting large corporations like Boeing. He argued that ending the Bank's authority, which expires later this year, is a critical issue for conservatives. In defending the GOP's 2013 government shutdown strategy, Hensarling stressed the importance of adhering to principles. Republicans interviewed by CNN agreed that any leadership challenge would need to be organized soon. Iowa Republican Steve King observed that leadership changes are increasingly likely, given continued discussion among members. Walter Jones of North Carolina said many Republicans in his district want a new leader in Washington but noted that mounting an effective campaign would take months. He was unsure if Hensarling or another candidate would be the right fit. Previous frustrations over Boehner's handling of government spending and potential negotiations with Democrats on immigration have caused internal strains within the GOP. However, because no unified alternative candidate has emerged, Boehner retains some job security. Conservatives acknowledge that Boehner's recent moves—such as forming a select committee on the Benghazi attack and holding a House vote to hold former IRS official Lois Lerner in contempt—have eased some tensions, but immigration remains a contentious issue inside the party.

Međutim, nedavno je stvorio neizvjesnost ne želeći se obvezati na još jedan cijeli mandat. Na početku sadašnjeg saziva 2013., desetak republikanskih zastupnika nije podržalo Boehnera – glasali su za drugoga kandidata ili bili suzdržani. Mnogi iz te skupine vjeruju da Boehner možda neće ponovno tražiti predsjedničku funkciju nakon ovogodišnjih međuizbora ili da možda nema dovoljno glasova da ostane na toj poziciji. Ako Boehner odstupi, među konzervativcima se kao najizgledniji nasljednik smatra vođa većine u Zastupničkom domu Eric Cantor, što bi konzervativcima također moglo otvoriti mogućnosti za druge vodeće pozicije. Iako se Hensarling prepoznaje kao čvrst konzervativac, kao mogući kandidati spominju se i Jim Jordan iz Ohija, Steve Scalise iz Louisiane i Tom Price iz Georgije – svi sa iskustvom vodstva fiskalno konzervativnih skupina. Republikanac iz Louisiane, John Fleming, rekao je za CNN da među zastupnicima postoji široka želja za više konzervativaca na čelnim pozicijama, ali da još nema jasnog izazivača Boehneru. Fleming očekuje ozbiljnije razgovore o vodstvu do kraja ljeta. Hensarlingov nedavni govor ponovno je naglasio konzervativne ekonomske vrijednosti i kritizirao GOP zbog udaljavanja od načela slobodnog tržišta, što rezonira s konzervativnim krilom stranke. Raul Labrador iz Idaha iznio je slične kritike, tvrdeći da se vodstvo republikanske stranke previše fokusiralo na potporu velikim korporacijama umjesto malim poduzetnicima. Hensarling poziva na politike koje bi podržale 'Main Street' umjesto davanja subvencija i posebnih pogodnosti, te se zalaže za reforme porezne politike, poljoprivrede i hipotekarnih institucija kroz restrukturiranje postojećih federalnih programa. Središnja točka Hensarlingova govora bilo je protivljenje Export-Import banci, za koju tvrdi da je primjer korporativnog benefita namijenjenog velikim tvrtkama poput Boeinga. On smatra da je ukidanje ovlasti ove banke, koja ističe kasnije ove godine, ključno pitanje za konzervativce. Braneći strategiju GOP-a iz 2013. koja je dovela do privremenog prekida rada vlade, Hensarling je naglasio važnost pridržavanja principa. Republikanci s kojima je CNN razgovarao složili su se da svaka potencijalna promjena vodstva mora biti brzo organizirana. Steve King iz Iowe ukazao je na to da su promjene u vodstvu sve izglednije s obzirom na stalan dijalog među članovima. Walter Jones iz Sjeverne Karoline rekao je da mnogi republikanci u njegovoj izbornoj jedinici žele novo vodstvo, premda nije siguran je li Hensarling pravi izbor, naglašavajući kako bi ozbiljna kampanja zahtijevala više mjeseci pripreme. Prijašnje nezadovoljstvo oko Boehnerova vođenja proračunskih pregovora i potencijalnih dogovora s demokratima o imigraciji izazvalo je napetosti među republikancima. Ipak, budući da nema jedinstvenog kandidata suparnika, Boehner zasad uživa određenu sigurnost. Konzervativci ističu kako su Boehnerovi nedavni potezi – poput osnivanja posebnog odbora o napadu u Benghaziju i pokretanja glasanja o osudi bivše direktorice IRS-a Lois Lerner – smanjili napetosti, iako je pitanje imigracije i dalje sporno.

article_content: President Obama delivered his State of the Union address, calling for the nation to embrace change, unity, and renewal. He reflected on political obstacles his administration faced, noting that some setbacks were deserved, but emphasized perseverance and an optimistic vision for the country. Recognizing the inherent complexity and contentiousness of American democracy, Obama pressed lawmakers to repeal the 'don't ask, don't tell' policy, enabling gay Americans to serve openly in the military. He highlighted nuclear weapons as a grave threat and discussed the challenges in Afghanistan, expressing confidence in eventual success. Obama referenced the recent Massachusetts special election, warning against early campaign discord and stressing the need for effective governance. He advocated for transparency in Congress, proposing mandated publication of all earmark requests online before any votes to restore credibility. He announced by executive order a bipartisan deficit reduction commission and stated that tax breaks for oil companies, investment fund managers, and those earning over $250,000 would end, citing fiscal responsibility. To address the $1 trillion economic rescue cost, he proposed freezing certain government programs, expanding child care tax credits, and pledged to veto spending beyond agreed limits. On health care, Obama encouraged Congress to continue reform efforts, underscoring how close they were to significant progress. He commended First Lady Michelle Obama’s leadership in addressing childhood obesity, joking about her embarrassment at the ovation she received. He promoted safe nuclear energy and set a goal to double U.S. exports within five years through a National Export Initiative targeting support for farmers and small businesses. Obama argued for action on climate change and underscored the importance of America leading the global clean energy sector. Financial regulatory reform was prioritized, with Obama vowing to reject any bill lacking substantial changes, voicing concerns about lobbyist opposition. He urged swift Senate passage of a jobs bill and proposed using $30 billion in repaid Wall Street funds to expand lending by community banks to small businesses, alongside new tax incentives for hiring and investment. Crediting his administration with creating 2 million jobs and forecasting further improvement, Obama acknowledged the controversial bank bailout as essential. He concluded his speech by voicing strong hope for America’s future, drawing parallels to times when the nation overcame adversity. Before the address, Obama consulted with Congressional leaders and engaged in humorous exchanges. Officials emphasized the speech’s aim to reclaim momentum for change and encourage bipartisan collaboration. Secondary priorities included financial reform, climate legislation, and enhanced education funding despite fiscal pressures.

Osvrnuo se na političke prepreke svoje administracije, rekavši da su neki neuspjesi bili zasluženi, ali je istaknuo ustrajnost i optimizam za zemlju. Prihvaćajući složenost i kontroverznost američke demokracije, Obama je pozvao zakonodavce da ukinu politiku 'ne pitaj, ne govori', omogućujući gay Amerikancima otvorenu vojnu službu. Naglasio je nuklearno oružje kao ozbiljnu prijetnju i govorio o izazovima u Afganistanu, izražavajući povjerenje u napredak. Obama se osvrnuo na nedavne izbore u Massachusettsu, upozoravajući na ranu predizbornu polarizaciju i naglasio potrebu za učinkovitom vlašću. Zalagao se za transparentnost Kongresa, predloživši da svi zahtjevi za izdvajanjima budu objavljeni na internetu prije glasanja, kako bi se obnovilo povjerenje građana. Izvršnom odlukom najavio je osnivanje dvostranačke komisije za smanjenje deficita i najavio kraj poreznim olakšicama za naftne kompanije, upravitelje investicijskih fondova i osobe s primanjima iznad 250.000 dolara, pozivajući se na fiskalnu odgovornost. Za pokriće troškova gospodarskog spašavanja predložio je zamrzavanje nekih državnih programa, povećanje poreznog olakšica za brigu o djeci i spremnost na veto na nepotrebnu potrošnju. Govoreći o zdravstvenoj skrbi, Obama je potaknuo Kongres da nastavi s reformom, naglašavajući koliko su blizu značajnom uspjehu. Pohvalio je prvu damu Michelle Obamu za njezinu borbu protiv dječje pretilosti, uz šaljivi komentar o njezinoj skromnosti pred ovacijom. Zalagao se za sigurnu nuklearnu energiju te najavio cilj udvostručavanja američkog izvoza u pet godina kroz Nacionalnu inicijativu za izvoz, s posebnim naglaskom na podršku farmerima i malim poduzećima. Obama je pozvao na mjere vezane uz klimatske promjene i naglasio važnost američkog vodstva u globalnoj ekonomiji čiste energije. Financijsku reformu postavio je kao prioritet, obećavši odbiti svaki zakon bez ozbiljnih promjena i prozvao lobistički utjecaj. Pozvao je Senat na brzo usvajanje zakona o radnim mjestima, predložio korištenje 30 milijardi dolara vraćenih s Wall Streeta za poticaj zajmova malim poduzećima, uz porezne olakšice za zapošljavanje i ulaganja. Istaknuo je da je zahvaljujući Vladinim mjerama otvoreno 2 milijuna radnih mjesta te najavio daljnji gospodarski rast. Priznao je nepopularnost sanacije banaka, ali je rekao da je to bilo nužno. Govor je zaključio izrazom snažne nade u američku budućnost, navodeći primjere savladanih povijesnih izazova. Prije obraćanja, Obama se susreo s čelnicima Kongresa i opušteno razgovarao. Dužnosnici su istaknuli kako je osnovna poruka govora povratak promjenama i poticanje dvostranačkog rada. Dodatni prioriteti su financijska reforma, klimatsko zakonodavstvo i povećanja ulaganja u obrazovanje, unatoč ograničenim sredstvima.

article_content: Sierra Leone has imposed a nationwide curfew after an armed attack on the main military barracks in Freetown. According to the government, security forces repelled the attack at the Wilberforce barracks and are working to arrest those involved. Information Minister Chernor Bah assured citizens that authorities are in control, urging everyone to remain indoors as the operation continues. Eyewitnesses reported hearing heavy gunfire and explosions early Sunday morning, with videos posted on social media showing smoke rising in Freetown. Other reports indicated exchanges of fire near the navy barracks in Murray Town and outside another military site. President Julius Maada Bio confirmed the security breach, attributing it to a group of 'renegades.' He announced on his official social media account that calm has been restored, though efforts continue to apprehend the suspects. President Bio called on citizens to unite in defense of democracy and national peace, calling the nation’s stability 'priceless.' The Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) condemned the attack, calling it an attempt to disrupt Sierra Leone’s constitutional order. This unrest follows President Bio's re-election in June. The vote, the fifth since Sierra Leone’s 11-year civil war ended over two decades ago, was criticized by international observers for a lack of transparency. The opposition disputed the results and initially boycotted the government. Sierra Leone continues to face severe economic challenges. Nearly 60 percent of the population of over 7 million lives in poverty, and the country has one of the highest youth unemployment rates in West Africa. Sierra Leone’s instability comes amid a series of military coups in West and Central Africa—eight since 2020—including coups in Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger, and Guinea.

Očevici su prijavili jaku pucnjavu i eksplozije rano u nedjelju ujutro, a na društvenim mrežama objavljeni su videozapisi dima koji se diže iz Freetowna. Druga izvješća govore o razmjeni vatre u blizini mornaričke kasarne u četvrti Murray Town i ispred još jednog vojnog objekta. Predsjednik Julius Maada Bio potvrdio je sigurnosni incident, nazvavši počinitelje 'odmetnicima.' Na svom službenom računu na društvenim mrežama objavio je da je mir vraćen, ali potraga za osumnjičenima i dalje traje. Ekonomska zajednica zapadnoafričkih država (ECOWAS) osudila je napad, navodeći da je riječ o pokušaju narušavanja ustavnog poretka Sierra Leonea. Nemiri slijede nakon ponovnog izbora predsjednika Bioa u lipnju. Ovo je bilo peto glasanje nakon završetka 11-godišnjeg građanskog rata u zemlji. Međunarodni promatrači kritizirali su izbore zbog nedostatka transparentnosti, a oporba je osporila rezultate i u početku bojkotirala vladu. Sierra Leone se i dalje suočava s ozbiljnim ekonomskim izazovima. Gotovo 60 posto od više od 7 milijuna stanovnika živi u siromaštvu, a država ima jednu od najviših stopa nezaposlenosti mladih u regiji. article_content: When a troop of baboons meets another on the savanna, they usually keep their distance or may fight. In contrast, humans often cooperate. Hunter-gatherer groups regularly join together for large communal hunts or form alliances. Villages and towns eventually lead to the creation of nations, and trade networks connect the entire globe. Anthropologists have long viewed cooperation as a defining trait of humans, attributing its emergence to our advanced brains that enable language, cultural traditions, and complex behaviors. However, a new study published in Science challenges this perspective. It reveals that African bonobos, an ape species, have engaged in regular and prolonged cooperation between different groups. Joan Silk, a primatologist at Arizona State University who was not involved in the study, described these friendly intergroup relationships among unrelated bonobos as 'extraordinary.' The findings come from long-term observations of bonobos in the Congo. While once thought to be a subspecies of chimpanzee, bonobos are genetically distinct, with different behaviors. Unlike male-dominated chimpanzee societies, where violence and even infanticide occur, female bonobos lead their groups and infanticide has never been observed. Bonobos often resolve conflicts with sexual behaviors, a method not seen among chimpanzees. Early bonobo research was conducted in captivity, but recent years have brought extensive studies of wild bonobos. In 2016, Martin Surbeck, a behavioral ecologist at Harvard, established a research site at the Kokolopori Bonobo Reserve in Congo, working with local Mongandu people. On his first observation, Surbeck witnessed two bonobo groups meeting not with hostility, but with excitement and friendliness. Over two years, Surbeck and colleagues observed 95 encounters between two groups, named Ekalakala (11 adults) and Kokoalongo (20 adults). Some meetings lasted less than an hour, others several days, and in one case, two weeks. During these interactions, bonobos groomed each other, shared food, and worked together to chase away snakes, while maintaining separate group identities. No evidence suggested interbreeding between the groups, and they maintained distinct cultural practices, such as hunting different prey—Ekalakala pursued duikers, while Kokoalongo hunted squirrels. Liran Samuni, a chimpanzee research expert from the German Primate Center in Göttingen, noted that the social bonds between individual apes from different groups often developed gradually, with favors and alliances occasionally forming. Silk hopes this research will inspire similar studies elsewhere to determine how widespread such cooperation is among bonobos. As bonobos number around 15,000 and are threatened by poaching and logging, future research faces significant challenges, including political instability in the Congo. Samuni highlighted that while people often compare themselves to cooperative bonobos or aggressive chimpanzees, humans share traits with both. 'They are jointly teaching us about our past,' she explained.
translated_content: Kada se čopor babuna susretne s drugim na savani, obično drže distancu ili se čak mogu potući. Nasuprot tome, ljudi često surađuju. Skupine lovaca-sakupljača redovito se okupljaju radi velikih zajedničkih lovova ili stvaranja saveza. Sela i gradovi na kraju dovode do stvaranja nacija, a mreže trgovine povezuju cijeli svijet. Antropolozi već dugo suradnju smatraju osobinom koja definira ljude, pripisujući njeno pojavljivanje našim naprednim mozgovima koji omogućuju jezik, kulturne tradicije i složena ponašanja. Međutim, novo istraživanje objavljeno u časopisu Science dovodi to gledište u pitanje. Ono otkriva da su afrički bonobi, vrsta majmuna, redovito i dugotrajno surađivali s pripadnicima drugih skupina. Joan Silk, primatologinja sa Sveučilišta Arizona State koja nije sudjelovala u istraživanju, opisala je ove prijateljske odnose između nepovezanih bonoba kao 'izvanredne'. Rezultati dolaze iz dugoročnih promatranja bonoba u Kongu. Iako se nekoć smatralo da su podvrsta čimpanze, bonobi su genetski različiti s posebnim ponašanjima. Za razliku od čimpanzi gdje dominiraju mužjaci i gdje se događa nasilje pa čak i infanticid, kod bonoba su ženke na čelu skupina i infanticid nije zabilježen. Bonobi često rješavaju sukobe seksualnim ponašanjem, metodom koja nije viđena među čimpanzama. Ranija istraživanja bonoba odvijala su se u zatočeništvu, ali posljednjih godina provedena su opsežna istraživanja divljih bonoba. Godine 2016. Martin Surbeck, bihevioralni ekolog s Harvarda, osnovao je istraživačko mjesto u rezervatu Kokolopori u Kongu, u suradnji s lokalnim stanovništvom Mongandu. Već na prvom promatranju Surbeck je svjedočio sastanku dvije skupine bonoba bez neprijateljstva, već s uzbuđenjem i prijateljstvom. Tijekom dvije godine Surbeck i kolege promatrali su 95 susreta između dviju skupina, nazvanih Ekalakala (11 odraslih) i Kokoalongo (20 odraslih). Neki su susreti trajali manje od sat vremena, drugi nekoliko dana, a jednom čak dva tjedna. Tijekom tih interakcija bonobi su međusobno njegovali krzno, dijelili hranu i zajedno tjerali zmije, pritom čuvajući identitet svojih skupina. Nije pronađen dokaz križanja između skupina, a zadržale su i različite kulturne navike, poput lova na različite plijenove—Ekalakala je lovila duiker antilope, dok je Kokoalongo hvatala vjeverice. Liran Samuni, stručnjakinja za čimpanze iz Njemačkog centra za primate u Göttingenu, naglasila je da se socijalne veze između pripadnika različitih skupina često razvijaju postupno, kroz međusobne usluge i povremene saveze. Silk se nada da će ovo istraživanje potaknuti slične studije drugdje kako bi se utvrdilo koliko je ovakva suradnja raširena među bonobima. S obzirom da ih ima oko 15.000 i prijete im krivolov i sječa šuma, buduća istraživanja suočavaju se sa značajnim izazovima, uključujući političku nestabilnost u Kongu. Samuni je istaknula da, iako se ljudi često uspoređuju s kooperativnim bonobima ili agresivnim čimpanzama, ljudi dijele osobine s obje vrste. 'Zajedno nas uče o našoj prošlosti', objasnila je.

article_content: On Thursday, U.S. and Canadian safety officials called for new regulations aimed at preventing rail accidents similar to last July’s tragedy in Lac-Megantic, Quebec. Both the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) and the Transportation Safety Board of Canada noted that the rising use of trains to transport highly flammable crude oil puts communities across both countries at risk. NTSB Chairman Deborah Hersman stated, “The large-scale shipment of crude oil by rail simply didn’t exist 10 years ago, and our safety regulations need to catch up with this new reality. While this energy boom is good for business, the people and the environment along rail corridors must be protected from harm.” The Lac-Megantic disaster claimed 47 lives and destroyed the town center after an unattended train loaded with crude oil rolled downhill, derailed, and burst into flames. In response, U.S. and Canadian safety agencies issued an unprecedented joint recommendation for a series of new safety rules. According to the NTSB, crude oil shipments by rail have risen by over 400% since 2005, largely due to increased drilling in North Dakota, Montana, and nearby Canadian provinces. Investigators found that in the Lac-Megantic incident, tanker cars were carrying highly volatile oil incorrectly labeled as a less flammable substance. The oil, classified properly as 'Class 3, Packing Group II,' was instead shipped under 'Packing Group III,' according to investigators. This mislabeling partly explains why the fuel ignited so rapidly, though officials have not determined whether the error was intentional or accidental. Despite the misclassification, both packing groups are shipped in the same type of tank car. Following the Lac-Megantic accident, the Federal Railroad Administration and the Pipeline and Hazardous Materials Safety Administration issued safety advisories, initiating random inspections and testing of crude oil shipments. However, the NTSB remains concerned that misclassification of shipments might allow shippers to circumvent required safety measures. Safety agencies recommend expanded route planning to avoid populated areas when possible, audits to ensure railroads are prepared to respond to major spills, and stricter audits of shippers and railroads to verify proper classification and compliance with safety and security standards. The NTSB and the Transportation Safety Board of Canada made these recommendations jointly, recognizing that crude oil trains routinely operate across both countries’ borders.
translated_content: U četvrtak su američki i kanadski sigurnosni dužnosnici pozvali na nova pravila kako bi spriječili željezničke nesreće slične prošlogodišnjoj tragediji u Lac-Méganticu u Quebecu. I Nacionalni odbor za sigurnost prometa (NTSB) i Kanadski odbor za sigurnost prometa istaknuli su da sve veća upotreba vlakova za prijevoz vrlo zapaljive sirove nafte predstavlja prijetnju zajednicama u obje zemlje. Predsjednica NTSB-a Deborah Hersman izjavila je: 'Masovni prijevoz sirove nafte željeznicom jednostavno nije postojao prije 10 godina, a naši sigurnosni propisi moraju se prilagoditi ovoj novoj stvarnosti. Iako je ovaj energetski procvat dobar za posao, ljudi i okoliš uz željezničke koridore moraju biti zaštićeni.' Katastrofa u Lac-Méganticu odnijela je 47 života i uništila središte grada nakon što je nenadzirani vlak natovaren sirovom naftom krenuo nizbrdo, iskočio iz tračnica i zapalio se. Kao odgovor na to, američke i kanadske sigurnosne agencije izdale su dosad neviđenu zajedničku preporuku za uvođenje novih sigurnosnih pravila. Prema podacima NTSB-a, prijevoz sirove nafte željeznicom porastao je za više od 400% od 2005. godine, uglavnom zahvaljujući povećanoj eksploataciji nafte u Sjevernoj Dakoti, Montani i obližnjim kanadskim provincijama. Istražitelji su utvrdili da su u slučaju Lac-Mégantica vagoni prevozili vrlo zapaljivu naftu koja je pogrešno označena kao manje zapaljiva tvar. Nafta, koja je trebala biti klasificirana kao 'Razred 3, Grupa za pakiranje II', otpremljena je kao 'Grupa za pakiranje III', navode istražitelji. Ovo pogrešno označavanje dijelom objašnjava zašto se gorivo tako brzo zapalilo, no dužnosnici nisu utvrdili je li pogreška bila namjerna ili slučajna. Unatoč toj pogrešnoj klasifikaciji, obje skupine goriva prevoze se u istim tipovima vagona. Nakon nesreće u Lac-Méganticu, Federalna uprava za željeznice i Uprava za sigurnost cjevovoda i opasnih materijala izdale su sigurnosna upozorenja te započele s nasumičnim inspekcijama i ispitivanjima pošiljki sirove nafte. Međutim, NTSB je i dalje zabrinut da bi pogrešna klasifikacija pošiljaka mogla omogućiti pošiljateljima da izbjegnu potrebne sigurnosne mjere. Sigurnosne agencije preporučuju prošireno planiranje ruta kako bi se kad god je moguće izbjegla naseljena područja, revizije spremnosti željeznica na velike nezgode te strože kontrole pošiljatelja i željeznica radi provjere pravilne klasifikacije i poštivanja sigurnosnih i zaštitnih standarda. NTSB i Kanadski odbor za sigurnost prometa svoje su preporuke izdale zajedno, priznajući da vlakovi s naftom redovito prelaze granice obje zemlje.

article_content: Edward Snowden, a former contractor for the NSA who is wanted for leaking US national security secrets, has distributed encrypted archives containing government documents to several trusted individuals worldwide. As reported by journalist Glenn Greenwald of The Guardian, who first communicated with Snowden in February, the files are intended to become public if anything happens to Snowden. The individuals holding these files cannot currently access them without passwords, but Snowden has arranged protocols that would grant them full access if he were harmed or disappeared. This measure has created anxiety among US intelligence officials and the Obama administration, who are uncertain about the total number and contents of the documents Snowden acquired during his time at the NSA. Greenwald explained he is reviewing thousands of documents sent to him by Snowden. This statement directly contradicts US Senator Dianne Feinstein’s position that Snowden had only 200 files. Documents released so far reveal the NSA’s PRISM surveillance program, which collects data from leading tech companies like Facebook and Google, particularly targeting non-US citizens. In addition to articles published in The Guardian and The Washington Post, Snowden granted interviews to the South China Morning Post in Hong Kong. In these, he disclosed information about NSA monitoring of specific computers and interception of text messages in Hong Kong and China. Greenwald expressed some reservations about the wisdom of sharing specific technical details, though he emphasized that Snowden’s intent was always to act responsibly—sharing only information in the public interest without putting individuals or covert operatives at risk. Greenwald also contrasted Snowden’s approach with that of WikiLeaks, pointing out that Snowden insisted on a cautious, journalistic process that avoids unnecessary harm. Unlike WikiLeaks’ mass releases, their work involves evaluating and, if needed, safeguarding sensitive identities and information. At the time of reporting, Snowden was believed to be in the transit area of Moscow's Sheremetyevo airport, possibly seeking to travel to Cuba, yet his exact location remained uncertain. Greenwald said he assumes the US government is attempting to monitor his own communication and data, and he takes precautions at all times.
translated_content: Edward Snowden, bivši suradnik NSA koji je tražen zbog odavanja tajni američke nacionalne sigurnosti, distribuirao je šifrirane arhive s vladinim dokumentima povjerljivim osobama diljem svijeta. Prema novinaru The Guardiana Glennu Greenwaldu, koji je prvi stupio u kontakt sa Snowdenom u veljači, ti su dokumenti namijenjeni objavi ako se Snowdenu nešto dogodi. Osobe koje drže ove datoteke trenutačno im ne mogu pristupiti bez lozinki, ali Snowden je postavio protokole koji bi im omogućili potpuni pristup u slučaju njegove povrede ili nestanka. Ova je mjera izazvala zabrinutost među američkim obavještajnim službama i Obaminom administracijom, koje nisu sigurne u ukupan broj i sadržaj dokumenata do kojih je Snowden došao dok je radio u NSA. Greenwald je objasnio kako trenutno proučava tisuće dokumenata koje mu je Snowden poslao, što izravno proturječi tvrdnji američke senatorice Dianne Feinstein da je Snowden imao samo 200 datoteka. Do sada objavljeni dokumenti otkrivaju PRISM program nadzora NSA, koji prikuplja podatke s vodećih tehnoloških kompanija poput Facebooka i Googlea, posebno ciljajući neameričke građane. Osim članaka u The Guardianu i Washington Postu, Snowden je dao intervjue za South China Morning Post u Hong Kongu. U njima je otkrio informacije o nadzoru NSA određenih računala i presretanju SMS poruka u Hong Kongu i Kini. Greenwald je izrazio određenu rezervu prema objavljivanju tehničkih detalja, naglašavajući kako je Snowden uvijek namjeravao postupati odgovorno—dijeliti samo informacije od javnog interesa, bez ugrožavanja pojedinaca ili tajnih agenata. Greenwald je također usporedio Snowdenov pristup s onim WikiLeaksa, ističući kako je Snowden inzistirao na pažljivom novinarskom procesu koji izbjegava nepotrebnu štetu. Za razliku od masovnih objava WikiLeaksa, njihov rad uključuje procjenu i, po potrebi, zaštitu osjetljivih identiteta i informacija. U vrijeme izvještavanja vjerovalo se da se Snowden nalazi u tranzitnoj zoni moskovske zračne luke Šeremetjevo, možda pokušavajući otputovati na Kubu, no njegova točna lokacija ostala je nepoznata. Greenwald je rekao kako pretpostavlja da američka vlada pokušava nadzirati njegovu komunikaciju i podatke te stoga stalno poduzima mjere opreza.

article_content: African heads of state are being urged to tackle the massive theft of over $100 billion every year—an amount equal to about a quarter of Africa's total annual output—lost to both domestic and international collaborators. Experts say recovering these funds could drastically improve infrastructure, healthcare, education, and social services for millions currently affected by poverty and hunger. These demands were made at the 33rd Anti-Corruption Situation Room conference in Abuja, organized by the Human and Environmental Development Agenda (HEDA Resource Centre) and supported by the MacArthur Foundation. The event brought together leaders and anti-corruption experts from Africa and around the world, including Senegal’s former Prime Minister Aminata Toure and members of the Club de Madrid, a network of approximately 100 former presidents and prime ministers from over 70 countries. Participants stressed that corruption is a critical obstacle to Africa’s development, stability, and prosperity, and called for the creation of an International Anti-Corruption Court to prosecute those involved in public fund theft, as well as holding foreign countries that receive stolen assets accountable. Additional recommendations included dismantling legal privileges that place certain individuals above the law, ensuring that stolen money and any accrued interest are returned by recipient countries, implementing updated anti-corruption training for judges, securing the positions of anti-corruption officials, and requiring independent financial audits for political candidates prior to elections. African governments and regional alliances like the African Union and ECOWAS were encouraged to intensify anti-corruption strategies, improve public awareness with accessible messaging, and offer continuous education about corruption and its effects. The conference applauded the dedication of HEDA Resource Centre, the MacArthur Foundation, and Integrity Initiative International to the anti-corruption cause, noting the significant risks undertaken by these organizations. The event’s shared message underscored the need for collective action and advocacy to effectively combat corruption in Africa and beyond.

Stručnjaci ističu da bi povrat tih sredstava mogao radikalno unaprijediti infrastrukturu, zdravstvo, obrazovanje i socijalne usluge za milijune ljudi pogođenih siromaštvom i glađu. Događaj je okupio čelnike i stručnjake za borbu protiv korupcije iz Afrike i svijeta, uključujući bivšu premijerku Senegala Aminatu Toure i članove Kluba iz Madrida – mreže oko 100 bivših predsjednika i premijera iz više od 70 zemalja. Sudionici su naglasili da je korupcija ključna prepreka razvoju, stabilnosti i prosperitetu Afrike te su pozvali na osnivanje Međunarodnog suda za borbu protiv korupcije koji bi kazneno gonio odgovorne za pronevjeru javnih sredstava, kao i pozivanje na odgovornost stranih zemalja koje prihvaćaju ukradena sredstva. Dodatne preporuke uključuju ukidanje pravnih privilegija koje neke pojedince stavljaju iznad zakona, povrat ukradenih sredstava i pripadajućih kamata od strane zemalja primateljica, moderniziranu edukaciju sudaca s fokusom na borbu protiv korupcije, osiguranje stabilnosti položaja dužnosnika zaduženih za borbu protiv korupcije te obaveznu neovisnu reviziju političkih kandidata prije izbora. Afričke vlade i regionalne organizacije poput Afričke unije i ECOWAS-a pozvane su da dodatno ojačaju strategije borbe protiv korupcije, poboljšaju javnu svijest razumljivim porukama i kontinuiranim obrazovanjem o učincima korupcije. Konferencija je pohvalila predanost organizacija HEDA Resource Centre, MacArthur Foundation i Integrity Initiative International u borbi protiv korupcije, ističući rizike s kojima se njihovi dužnosnici suočavaju. Zajednička poruka sudionika naglasila je potrebu za zajedničkim djelovanjem i zagovaranjem za učinkovitu borbu protiv korupcije u Africi i šire.

article_content:
The UK broadcasting regulator, Ofcom, is proposing tighter controls on television subtitles to address frequent and sometimes comical live caption errors. Notable mistakes have included referring to Labour leader Ed Miliband as 'Ed Miller Band' and the head of the Church of England as 'Arch bitch of Canterbury.' Ofcom highlighted other amusing errors, such as the singer Engelbert Humperdinck being captioned as 'engle Bert humper distinct' on ITV's Loose Women and a BBC weather report mentioning 'fox patches.'

Subtitles are relied upon by millions of viewers—including 1.4 million people with hearing impairments, according to Ofcom, which found that these viewers tend to watch more television than those without hearing problems. However, errors, delays, and freezing of live captions continue to cause confusion.

These mistakes have been partly blamed on replacing traditional stenographers with a process known as 're-speaking,' where a person repeats dialogue into a computer using voice recognition software.

Ofcom, after consulting with advocacy organizations such as Action on Hearing Loss and the National Association of Deafened People, proposed that broadcasters should report on subtitle quality every six months. They also recommend that broadcasters delay live programming briefly to allow for more accurate captioning.

Među zapaženim pogreškama izdvajaju se one kada je laburistički čelnik Ed Miliband bio prikazan kao 'Ed Miller Band' te poglavar Engleske crkve kao 'Arch bitch of Canterbury.' Ofcom je istaknuo i druge zabavne greške, poput pjevača Engelberta Humperdincka koji je na ITV-ovoj emisiji Loose Women bio titlovan kao 'engle Bert humper distinct' te vremenske prognoze na BBC-u koja je spomenula 'fox patches.'

Na titlove se oslanjaju milijuni gledatelja, uključujući 1,4 milijuna osoba s oštećenjem sluha, prema podacima koje je objavio Ofcom, a istraživanja pokazuju da ti gledatelji gledaju više televizije od onih bez problema sa sluhom. Ofcom je, nakon konzultacija s organizacijama kao što su Action on Hearing Loss i Nacionalna udruga oglušalih, predložio da televizijske kuće svakih šest mjeseci podnose izvještaje o kvaliteti titlova. Također preporučuju kratko odlaganje prijenosa uživo kako bi se poboljšala točnost titlova.

article_content: PANAMA CITY — Facing a second week of widespread protests, Panama's National Assembly is nearing the passage of a law to revoke a controversial mining contract in an environmentally sensitive region. On Wednesday night, the bill cleared its second debate and heads to a final, unamendable vote on Thursday. The legislature first reached an agreement in March with Canadian mining company First Quantum Minerals and its local subsidiary, Minera Panama, to extend their contract. Since then, the largest protests in Panama since last July’s cost-of-living crisis have prompted President Laurentino Cortizo to reconsider. The new bill not only cancels the contract but also extends a moratorium on new mining concessions until the country’s mineral resource code is reformed. Prior to the legislative debates, President Cortizo had proposed a national referendum on the issue. Meanwhile, eight lawsuits challenging the constitutionality of the contract have been filed with the Supreme Court. There was initial uncertainty whether environmental concerns would outweigh the mine’s demonstrated economic impact. The mining operation represents the largest private investment in Panama's history and accounts for about 3% of the nation's GDP. Nonetheless, public protests have evolved into substantive legislative and legal opposition, causing First Quantum’s shares to plummet 47% on the Toronto Stock Exchange since the week began. Some critics warn revoking the contract by law could leave the government vulnerable to legal action by Minera Panama. Legal experts suggest that if the Supreme Court rules the contract unconstitutional, it could be annulled without exposing the government to multi-million-dollar lawsuits. During legislative discussions, police dispersed demonstrators near the Assembly building using rubber bullets and tear gas. Earlier, nurses marched to the Supreme Court to demand an expedited review of the constitutionality lawsuits. The now-suspended contract would have allowed 20 to 40 more years of open-pit copper mining across 13,000 hectares of forested land located approximately 75 miles (120 kilometers) west of Panama City in Colon Province. Environmentalists warn ongoing mining threatens drinking water supplies and accelerates deforestation. According to Minera Panama’s contractor, Jan De Nu Group, the mine sits 'in the middle of a jungle,' located within Panama's portion of the Mesoamerican Biological Corridor, a globally important wildlife migration route that may contain up to 10% of all known species. In the past two decades, Panama has lost around 8.5% of its total tree cover, mainly due to agriculture, with a similar area affected by industrial activity, according to Global Forest Watch satellite analysis. While many protestors focus on risks to water, others caution the mine could endanger the Panama Canal, which faces its driest October since 1950 due to El Niño. Minera Panama’s manager emphasized in a September letter that four rivers separate the mine from the canal, though the canal’s administrator has also flagged potential concerns about conflicting water resources. ____ Follow AP’s climate coverage at: https://apnews.com/hub/climate-and-environment

Zakonodavno tijelo je prvo u ožujku postiglo dogovor s kanadskom rudarskom kompanijom First Quantum Minerals i njihovom lokalnom podružnicom Minera Panama o produženju ugovora. Novi zakon ne samo da poništava ugovor, već i produžuje moratorij na nove rudarske koncesije dok se ne reformira kodeks o mineralnim resursima zemlje. Prije zakonodavnih rasprava, predsjednik Cortizo predložio je nacionalni referendum o ovom pitanju. U međuvremenu, na Vrhovni sud podneseno je osam tužbi kojima se osporava ustavnost ugovora. Isprva nije bilo jasno hoće li ekološka zabrinutost prevagnuti nad dokazanim gospodarskim učinkom rudnika. Unatoč tome, javni prosvjedi prerasli su u ozbiljan zakonodavni i pravni otpor, što je izazvalo pad dionica First Quantum-a za 47% na burzi u Torontu od početka tjedna. Neki kritičari upozoravaju da bi poništenje ugovora zakonom moglo izložiti vladu pravnim postupcima od strane Minera Panama. Pravni stručnjaci sugeriraju da bi, ako Vrhovni sud proglasi ugovor neustavnim, on mogao biti poništen bez rizika od višemilijunskih tužbi. Tijekom zakonodavnih rasprava, policija je rastjerala prosvjednike u blizini zgrade Skupštine koristeći gumene metke i suzavac. Ranije tog dana, medicinske sestre su marširale do Vrhovnog suda zahtijevajući ubrzanu obradu ustavnih tužbi. Sada obustavljeni ugovor omogućio bi još 20 do 40 godina rudarenja bakra na otvorenom na 13.000 hektara šumskog područja, otprilike 120 kilometara zapadno od grada Paname, u provinciji Colon. Ekolozi upozoravaju da rudarenje prijeti opskrbi pitkom vodom i ubrzava krčenje šuma. Prema riječima izvođača radova Minera Panama, Jan De Nu Groupa, rudnik se nalazi 'usred džungle', unutar panamskog dijela Mezoameričkog biološkog koridora, globalno važne trase za migraciju divljih životinja koja sadrži do 10% svih poznatih vrsta. Proteklih dvadeset godina Panama je izgubila oko 8,5% ukupnog drvenog pokrova, uglavnom zbog poljoprivrede, dok je slično područje narušeno industrijskom aktivnošću, prema satelitskim analizama Global Forest Watcha. Dok se mnogi prosvjednici fokusiraju na rizike za vodu, drugi upozoravaju da bi rudnik mogao ugroziti Panamski kanal, koji ove godine ima najsušniji listopad od 1950. zbog El Niña. Menadžer Minera Panama naglasio je u rujnu da četiri rijeke odvajaju rudnik od kanala, iako je upravitelj kanala također izrazio zabrinutost oko mogućih sukoba u korištenju vodnih resursa. ____ Pratite AP-ovo izvještavanje o klimi na: https://apnews.com/hub/climate-and-environment

article_content: For many decades, Iraq and the United States have shared a complex and intertwined relationship. From the 1991 Gulf War to the 2003 US-led invasion that removed Saddam Hussein, to subsequent years marked by violence and instability, the two countries remain closely connected. Much of this connection results from US policies aimed at containing or removing Hussein and later, attempting to help rebuild Iraq. Recent advances by militant groups across Iraq, including threats to Baghdad, have prompted renewed attention on US involvement. With these threats growing, many wonder what actions the United States might take. President Obama's administration faces several potential responses. The first option, sending in US troops, is unlikely. Currently, the Pentagon states there are about 170 American troops in Baghdad and 100 in undisclosed locations, mainly protecting the US Embassy and American interests—far fewer than in previous years. The largest sustained presence was in 2007, with over 166,000 troops. US military withdrawal by the end of 2011 was controversial, and some, like Senator John McCain, have criticized the decision, though he has not specifically called for renewed ground intervention. Importantly, both Iraqi and US officials, including Foreign Minister Hoshyar Zebari and White House Press Secretary Jay Carney, have publicly rejected deploying combat troops to Iraq. A second option is US airstrikes. Secretary of State John Kerry has acknowledged that airstrikes are under consideration. The USS George H.W. Bush and several warships, along with hundreds of Marines and helicopters, are now in the Persian Gulf, ready to respond if needed. While the Iraqi government appears open to limited US airstrikes against ISIS and other militants, there are significant risks—such as civilian casualties, US personnel danger, and doubts about whether air power alone can stop the insurgency. The US has already provided about $15 billion in military equipment, training, and aid to Iraq, and further support is under review. This includes ammunition, missiles, helicopters, and other weaponry. Still, the rapid collapse of Iraqi security forces in places like Mosul, where they abandoned weapons and fled, raises questions about the effectiveness of this support. Some US officials and analysts, including former ambassador James Jeffrey, have described the Iraqi military as poorly trained and led, making future aid potentially problematic. Another potential response is seeking political changes within Iraq. Even if military action succeeds, most experts agree that long-term stability requires addressing political divisions, especially between Shiite and Sunni populations. The government led by Nuri al-Maliki has been criticized for excluding Sunnis, fueling discontent that contributes to unrest. The US continues to urge Iraq’s leaders, publicly and privately, to form a more inclusive government. Vice President Joe Biden has regularly communicated with al-Maliki in efforts toward political unity. While Washington might have reservations about al-Maliki’s record, they still generally support the Iraqi government in its fight against ISIS. State Department representatives like Jen Psaki emphasize the necessity of unified action against militants, underscoring that political solutions are as crucial as military ones.
translated_content: Već desetljećima Irak i Sjedinjene Države imaju složen i duboko povezan odnos. Od Zaljevskog rata 1991., preko američke invazije 2003. koja je srušila Sadama Husseina, do godina obilježenih nasiljem i nestabilnošću, ove dvije zemlje ostaju usko povezane. Velik dio te povezanosti proizlazi iz američkih politika usmjerenih na suzbijanje ili uklanjanje Husseina, kao i kasnijih pokušaja obnove Iraka. Nedavni napredak militantnih skupina diljem Iraka, uključujući i prijetnje Bagdadu, ponovno je usmjerio pažnju na američku uključenost. Zbog porasta prijetnji mnogi se pitaju što bi Sjedinjene Države mogle poduzeti. Administracija predsjednika Obame razmatra nekoliko mogućih odgovora. Prva opcija—slanje američkih trupa—nije vjerojatna. Pentagon trenutačno navodi da u Bagdadu ima oko 170 američkih vojnika i još stotinjak na neotkrivenim lokacijama, uglavnom radi zaštite američkog veleposlanstva i interesa—što je puno manje nego ranijih godina. Najveća vojna prisutnost bila je 2007. godine s više od 166.000 vojnika. Povlačenje američkih trupa krajem 2011. izazvalo je kontroverze, a neki, poput senatora Johna McCaina, kritizirali su tu odluku, iako nije izričito pozvao na novo slanje snaga. Važno je da su i irački i američki dužnosnici, poput ministra Hoshyara Zebarija i glasnogovornika Bijele kuće Jaya Carneyja, javno odbacili mogućnost slanja borbenih trupa u Irak. Druga opcija su američki zračni napadi. Državni tajnik John Kerry potvrdio je da se ta opcija razmatra. USS George H.W. Bush i nekoliko drugih ratnih brodova, stotine marinaca i helikoptera trenutno su u Perzijskom zaljevu i spremni za reakciju po potrebi. Iako je iračka vlada otvorena za ograničene američke zračne napade na ISIS i druge militante, postoje značajni rizici poput mogućih civilnih žrtava, opasnosti za američko osoblje i sumnje može li sama zračna sila zaustaviti pobunu. SAD je već dostavio oko 15 milijardi dolara vojne opreme, obuke i pomoći Iraku, a dodatna potpora je u razmatranju. Pomoć uključuje streljivo, projektile, helikoptere i drugo oružje. Ipak, brz poraz iračkih snaga sigurnosti na mjestima poput Mosula, gdje su napustili oružje i pobjegli, dovodi u pitanje učinkovitost ove pomoći. Neki američki dužnosnici i analitičari, među njima i bivši veleposlanik James Jeffrey, iračku vojsku opisuju kao loše obučenu i vođenu, što čini buduću pomoć upitnom. Treća opcija je poticanje političkih promjena u Iraku. Čak i ako vojna akcija uspije, većina stručnjaka smatra da je za dugoročnu stabilnost važno riješiti političke podjele, osobito između šiita i sunita. Vlada pod vodstvom Nuri al-Malikija bila je na udaru kritika zbog isključivanja sunita, što stvara nezadovoljstvo i nestabilnost. SAD nastavlja javno i privatno pozivati iračke vođe na uključiviju vlast. Potpredsjednik Joe Biden često komunicira s al-Malikijem s ciljem postizanja političkog jedinstva. Unatoč američkim rezervama prema Maliki- ju, SAD uglavnom podržava iračku vladu u borbi protiv ISIS-a. Predstavnici State Departmenta poput Jen Psaki ističu da je za uspjeh protiv militanata nužno zajedničko djelovanje, a politička rješenja su jednako važna kao i vojna.

article_content: A young auditor from Texas named Glory resigned from PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) by sending her entire team a candid, hashtag-filled email that criticized her coworkers for being insincere. In the lengthy email, sent on a Monday and titled 'Farewell and QUEEN BEY ALL DAY!', Glory declared that auditing is 'for people who truly don't have any other options.' She singled out individual colleagues for criticism and capped off the message with a playful argument about how Beyoncé surpasses Britney Spears. Initially, her resignation seemed typical, beginning with, 'After careful consideration I will be ending my employment with PwC,' as reported by Gawker. However, as Glory’s email went on, the tone shifted. She accused her coworkers of pretending to enjoy a job that mainly involves 'filling out useless workpapers that won't really benefit anybody.' Glory wrote that after hearing many auditors claim, 'I love my job!' or 'I wouldn't trade it for the world,' she realized how fake some responses could be. Writing from her bed, she gave her teammates advice like 'get a real career that has meaning' and mocked company meetings with a series of hashtags: '#thatishissoawkward #icantdeal #soforced #fakeconvosforfakeauditors #noidontwanttogazeintoyoureyesatatablefortwo #waytoointimateformytaste.' A week after her resignation, Glory said in an interview with Noir CPA that she had no regrets, stating, 'I'm not going to sit here and worry about potential negative effects in my life.' Having a background in finance and two internships, she also criticized colleagues who made a show of arriving early and staying late when partners visited, pointing out, 'The reality is, THEY'RE NOT [royalty]! They are average people like you and me, only their pockets are a little bigger.' The email became more personal as Glory addressed coworkers individually, chastising one for trying to undermine her and another for making everything about their home life or giving her judgmental looks. She ended with pointed hashtags for these individuals. In one case, she commented, 'You're such a gossiper that sometimes I think you're more feminine than you appear. Who does that? You're a grown man, get your life!' One team member was criticized for 'constantly trying to throw me under the bus.' Another coworker was told, 'I think those eyeballs need some readjusting. Girl, stop!' Her final critique said, 'Where do I start? You hate yourself and your job, let's be honest… Stories about your cat are unbearable.' The email concluded with ten reasons why Beyoncé is a superior performer to Britney Spears, finishing with: 'Beyoncé wins and now that I'm out of here, I win too!!! #doingtheharlemshakeasitype.' Since sending the letter, Glory reported receiving thanks from some who felt she voiced their grievances. Nevertheless, her email also attracted negative and, sometimes, racist responses, with some accusing her of being simply a 'diversity hire.' Glory remarked on her surprise at the number of racist reactions, calling the diversity claim unfounded. She stated she does not believe her bold exit will harm her future prospects, concluding, 'I sent the email and didn't look back.'

U podužem emailu, poslanom jednog ponedjeljka i naslovljenom 'Farewell and QUEEN BEY ALL DAY!', Glory je izjavila da je revizija 'za ljude koji stvarno nemaju drugih opcija.' U poruci je prozvala pojedine kolege i na kraju, na šaljiv način, ustvrdila da je Beyoncé bolja od Britney Spears. Tjedan dana nakon otkaza, Glory je za Noir CPA izjavila da ne žali zbog svoje odluke: 'Neću sad sjediti i brinuti o mogućim negativnim posljedicama u životu.' Imajući iskustvo iz financija i dvije prakse, kritizirala je i kolege koji su željeli ostaviti dojam marljivosti pred partnerima, istaknuvši: 'Istina je, ONI NISU [kraljevi]! Oni su prosječni ljudi kao i mi, samo s većim plaćama.' Email je postao osobniji kako je Glory prozivala pojedince – jednog što je pokušavao umanjiti njezin trud, druge zbog pretjeranog pričanja o privatnom životu ili upućivanja osuđujućih pogleda. Poruku je završila znakovitim hashtagovima za svaku osobu. Jednoga je komentirala: 'Toliko si tračljiv da ponekad mislim da si ženstveniji nego što djeluješ. Tko to radi? Djevojko, prestani!' Zadnja kritika bila je: 'Odakle da krenem? Ne voliš ni sebe ni svoj posao, budimo iskreni… Priče o tvojoj mački su neizdržive.' Email je završio s deset razloga zašto je Beyoncé bolja od Britney Spears, uz: 'Beyoncé pobjeđuje, a sad kad sam otišla, pobijedila sam i ja!!! #doingtheharlemshakeasitype.' Nakon što je poslala poruku, Glory kaže da su joj zahvalili neki koji smatraju da je rekla ono što i sami misle. No email je izazvao i negativne, ponekad rasističke komentare, pa su je neki čak nazvali 'diversity hireom.' Glory je iznenađena količinom tih reakcija i kaže da je optužbe neutemeljene. Smatra da joj ovaj potez neće naštetiti u karijeri, zaključujući: 'Poslala sam email i nisam se osvrtala.'

article_content: Bill Murray, known for his unique sense of humor and interactions with fans, surprised a bachelor party in Charleston, South Carolina, by offering relationship advice to the groom and his friends over Memorial Day weekend. The 63-year-old actor gave his advice at a local steakhouse, and the moment was captured on video by Deadspin. According to reports, the group of friends, all from Boston College, noticed Murray sitting downstairs. They tried to send him drinks via their waiter, but Murray politely declined. Later, one of the friends approached Murray and asked if he would say a few words to the groom, EJ. Initially hesitant, Murray eventually joined the group and shared some advice about relationships and marriage. Murray began by playfully asking the group if they approved of the bride-to-be, which made the friends laugh. He told them, 'You know how funerals are not for the dead, they're for the living? Bachelor parties are not for the groom, they're for the uncommitted.' He then advised, 'If you think someone is The One, don't just plan the wedding right away. Take that person and travel around the world. Go to places that are hard to get to and even harder to leave. If you still love that person when you return to JFK airport, get married right there at the airport.' The visit ended with Murray lifting the groom, EJ Rumpke, over his shoulder, delighting the partygoers. Murray has been married twice—first to Margaret Kelly (1981–1996) and then to Jennifer Butler (divorced in 2008). Butler previously accused Murray of physical abuse, alcohol addiction, and infidelity, leading her to move with their four sons. Stories about Murray's unusual public appearances have become legendary. Some notable examples include: 1. Bill Seybot encountered Murray using his laptop at a Starbucks, and Murray joked, 'No one will ever believe you.' 2. In a New York City karaoke bar, Murray sang Elvis songs with patrons after initially declining an invitation. 3. At Austin's SXSW festival in 2010, he bartended for members of the Wu-Tang Clan, serving only tequila. 4. In St. Andrews, Scotland, a student named Lykke Stavnef recalled Murray cleaning dirty dishes at a party instead of dancing. 5.
