article_content: On Saturday, skywatchers will have the chance to see an extremely rare 'ring of fire' annular solar eclipse. Experts strongly advise against looking directly at the eclipse, as this can cause serious and immediate eye damage. An annular eclipse occurs when the Moon is near its farthest point from Earth in its orbit, known as apogee. Because the Moon appears smaller, it does not fully cover the Sun, creating a brilliant ring of light. People across the contiguous United States and parts of Alaska will be able to see the eclipse, with only a partial eclipse visible in most regions. The full 'ring of fire' effect will be visible in parts of Oregon, California, Nevada, Utah, Arizona, Colorado, New Mexico, and Texas. Cities with the best views include Eugene (Oregon), Albuquerque (New Mexico), and San Antonio (Texas). In the U.S., the eclipse will begin in Oregon at 9:13 AM PT and end in Texas at 12:03 PM CT. Portions of Central and South America will also see the eclipse. For safety, never look at the eclipse directly—this can severely damage your retina in an instant, says Patrick Koehn, NASA’s heliophysics research and analysis lead. Regular sunglasses do not offer enough protection, and using them may increase risk since they allow pupils to dilate, exposing eyes to more sunlight. To safely watch the eclipse, use certified solar viewing glasses. Alternatively, you can use an indirect viewing method by creating a pinhole in a sheet of paper and viewing the projected image on the ground. This eclipse kicks off an exciting year in heliophysics—the study of the Sun and its interactions with the surrounding space. Next April, a total solar eclipse will occur, and NASA’s Parker Solar Probe, the fastest human-made object, will continue its mission. Koehn explained that annular eclipses are rare because the Moon must be near apogee, making perfect alignment a special occurrence.

Stručnjaci snažno preporučuju da se nikada ne gleda izravno u pomrčinu, jer to može uzrokovati ozbiljna i trenutna oštećenja očiju. Prstenasta pomrčina događa se kada je Mjesec blizu najudaljenije točke od Zemlje na svojoj putanji, tzv. apogeju. Budući da Mjesec izgleda manji, ne prekriva potpuno Sunce te stvara blistavi prsten svjetlosti. Pomrčina će biti vidljiva širom Sjedinjenih Američkih Država i dijelova Aljaske, dok će u većini regija biti vidljiva djelomična pomrčina. Potpunu 'prstenastu' pojavu moći će vidjeti dijelovi Oregona, Kalifornije, Nevade, Utaha, Arizone, Colorada, Novog Meksika i Teksasa. Gradovi s najboljim pogledom su Eugene (Oregon), Albuquerque (Novi Meksiko) i San Antonio (Teksas). U SAD-u pomrčina započinje u Oregonu u 9:13 sati po pacifičkom vremenu, a završava u Teksasu u 12:03 sati po srednjoameričkom vremenu. Pomrčina će biti vidljiva i u dijelovima Srednje i Južne Amerike. Radi sigurnosti, nikada ne gledajte izravno u pomrčinu—takvo gledanje može trenutno jako oštetiti mrežnicu, kaže Patrick Koehn, voditelj istraživanja i analize heliocentrike iz NASA-e. Obične sunčane naočale nisu dovoljna zaštita, a njihovo korištenje može povećati rizik jer dopuštaju širenje zjenica i veće izlaganje očiju sunčevoj svjetlosti. Za sigurno gledanje koristite certificirane sunčane naočale za pomrčine. Alternativno, poslužite se indirektnim promatranjem – probušite rupicu na papiru i promatrajte projekciju na tlu. Ova pomrčina označava početak uzbudljive godine u heliocentriki—proučavanju Sunca i njegovih interakcija sa svemirom. Sljedećeg travnja očekuje nas potpuna pomrčina Sunca, a NASA-ina letjelica Parker Solar Probe, najbrži objekt koji je čovjek izradio, nastavlja svoju misiju. Koehn objašnjava da su prstenaste pomrčine rijetke jer Mjesec mora biti blizu apogeja, što savršeno poravnanje čini posebnim događajem.

article_content: In a highly anticipated speech at the University of Indonesia, President Barack Obama highlighted the shared principles of unity, tolerance, and democracy linking Indonesia and the United States. He emphasized that both countries stand to benefit from deeper cooperation, especially in strengthening economic ties and tackling terrorism. Obama’s visit, which lasted two days, was especially significant as Indonesia has the world’s largest Muslim population and was his childhood home for several years. He referenced his 2009 Cairo speech, repeating his call for a renewed partnership between the United States and Muslim communities worldwide, and pointed out that rebuilding trust takes time. He affirmed that America is not at war with Islam, urging a united front against extremist groups like al Qaeda, who, he insisted, do not represent any religion—least of all Islam. Obama applauded Indonesia’s progress in fighting terrorism, referencing past incidents like the Bali bombings, and praised its commitment to inclusiveness despite historical challenges and a diverse population. Reflecting on his childhood in Indonesia, Obama recalled the warmth his family received and incorporated Malay phrases into his speech, including the greeting 'Selamat Datang' and the motto 'Bhinneka Tunggal Ika' (unity in diversity). Despite Obama’s positive outlook, his presence prompted protests by some Muslim groups. Approximately 20,000 people participated in rallies expressing doubts about U.S. policies and voicing concerns about the continuity between Obama and previous U.S. administrations. The president concluded by urging Indonesia to continue its development path, highlighting the fight against corruption, the need for transparent governance, and the importance of safeguarding freedoms—values underscored by the country’s Heroes’ Day celebrations. Obama looked forward to stronger ties based on shared democratic values, educational and entrepreneurial exchanges, and mutual respect.

Naglasio je da obje zemlje mogu imati koristi od dublje suradnje, osobito u jačanju gospodarskih veza i borbi protiv terorizma. U svom govoru spomenuo je govor iz Kaira iz 2009. godine, ponavljajući poziv na obnovljeno partnerstvo između Sjedinjenih Država i muslimanskih zajednica diljem svijeta i istaknuo da je za izgradnju povjerenja potrebno vrijeme. Istaknuo je da Amerika nije u ratu s islamom te je pozvao na zajedničku borbu protiv ekstremističkih skupina poput al-Qaide, koje, kako je naglasio, ne predstavljaju nijednu religiju—posebno ne islam. Obama je pohvalio napredak Indonezije u borbi protiv terorizma, podsjetivši na prošle događaje poput bombaških napada na Baliju, i pohvalio njezinu posvećenost uključivosti unatoč povijesnim izazovima i raznolikoj populaciji. Prisjetio se svog djetinjstva u Indoneziji te topline koju je njegova obitelj doživjela, a u govor je uključio i malajske izraze poput pozdrava 'Selamat Datang' i motta 'Bhinneka Tunggal Ika' (jedinstvo u različitosti). Unatoč pozitivnim porukama, Obamin posjet izazvao je prosvjede nekih muslimanskih skupina. Oko 20.000 ljudi sudjelovalo je u okupljanjima na kojima su izražene sumnje u američku politiku i zabrinutost zbog sličnosti između Obame i prethodnih američkih administracija. Predsjednik je zaključio pozivom da Indonezija nastavi svoj razvojni put, naglašavajući borbu protiv korupcije, potrebu za transparentnim upravljanjem i važnost očuvanja sloboda—vrijednosti koje se ističu proslavom indonezijskog Dana heroja. Obama je izrazio nadu u jačanje odnosa kroz zajedničke demokratske vrijednosti, obrazovne i poduzetničke razmjene i uzajamno poštovanje.

article_content: Cynthia Nixon, star of 'Sex and the City' and former New York gubernatorial candidate, has joined a hunger strike with other activists to protest Israel’s military actions in Gaza. The protest follows the recent attacks by Hamas, which involved killings and kidnappings of Israeli residents. Nixon is drawing attention to civilian casualties in Gaza resulting from Israel’s response to the Hamas attacks. Speaking at a protest in front of the White House on Monday, Nixon highlighted her personal connection as the mother of Jewish children and granddaughter to Holocaust survivors. She said her son asked her to use her voice to ensure that 'never again' applies to everyone. Citing figures from Gaza officials, Nixon stated: 'In seven weeks, Israel has killed more civilians in a small strip of land than were killed in 20 years of war in the entire country of Afghanistan.' She stressed that civilian deaths should not be considered a routine part of war, emphasizing the gravity of the numbers. The hunger strike is expected to continue throughout the week, though Nixon noted in an interview with the Guardian that she may pause her fast due to work commitments. Nixon called on President Joe Biden, referencing his personal experiences with loss, to empathize with the families in Gaza and imagine the children there as his own. Her call for a ceasefire underscores the divisions both within the political left and among entertainment industry figures following the October 7 attacks.

article_content: Bamako, Mali (CNN) — Islamist rebels in Mali have seized control of the central town of Douentza, according to both a rebel leader and a local resident. Douentza is situated about 110 miles (175 kilometers) from Sevare, which marks a buffer zone between rebel-controlled northern Mali and the south. Mali has faced significant unrest since a military coup overthrew the democratically elected president in March, disrupting one of West Africa's previously stable democracies. The Islamist groups MUJAO and Ansar Dine, which is linked to al Qaeda, are now in control of Douentza, says Ansar Dine military leader Omar Hamaha. Hamaha stated that Ansar Dine initially permitted the Ganda Izo militia to enter Douentza with the intention of joining Ansar Dine, but later accused them of betrayal. According to Hamaha, 'We have learned that some Ganda Izo members are working with Malian army intelligence and security services, so we decided to take over Douentza and disarm the militia.' Adama Guindo, a Douentza resident, reported that the Islamists disarmed the militia peacefully, with no shots fired. He described convoys of Islamist fighters with mounted heavy weapons entering and moving through the town. Although the coup leader resigned in May and handed over to a transitional civilian government, the instability has allowed Tuareg rebels and Islamist militants to gain control over much of northern Mali, including Timbuktu. Malian army soldiers are currently stationed in Sevare, possibly preparing for military action in the north.

Douentza se nalazi oko 175 kilometara od Sevarea, koji je tampon-zona između sjevera Malija pod kontrolom pobunjenika i juga. Mali je suočen s ozbiljnom nestabilnošću otkako je vojni udar svrgnuo demokratski izabranog predsjednika u ožujku, čime je narušena jedna od najstabilnijih država zapadne Afrike. Islamske skupine MUJAO i Ansar Dine, koja je povezana s al-Qaidom, sada kontroliraju Douentzu, izjavio je vojni vođa Ansar Dinea Omar Hamaha. Hamaha navodi da je Ansar Dine isprva dopustio miliciji Ganda Izo ulazak u Douentzu s ciljem pridruživanja, ali ih je kasnije optužio za izdaju. Prema Hamahi: 'Saznali smo da neki članovi Ganda Izo surađuju s obavještajnom službom i sigurnosnim agentima malijske vojske, pa smo odlučili preuzeti Douentzu i razoružati tu miliciju.' Stanovnik Douentze, Adama Guindo, rekao je da su islamisti razoružali miliciju mirno, bez pucnjave. Opisao je konvoje islamističkih boraca s teškim naoružanjem kako ulaze i prolaze kroz grad. Iako je vođa puča odstupio u svibnju i predao vlast prijelaznoj civilnoj vladi, nestabilnost je omogućila tuareškim pobunjenicima i islamističkim militantima preuzimanje kontrole nad većim dijelom sjevernog Malija, uključujući i Timbuktu. Malijska vojska trenutno je smještena u Sevareu, moguće pripremajući se za vojnu intervenciju na sjeveru.
